/-- Contributions outside the current coordinate. -/
def β (weights : Fin 10 → K) (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 10) (r : Fin 1024) : K :=
  (∑ i : Fin 10, if i.val < j.val then weights i * a i else 0) +
    ∑ i : Fin 10, if j.val < i.val then weights i * (if rowBits r i then 1 else 0) else 0

/-- Equality weight of the fixed prefix, in the source's MSB-first order. -/
def eqPrefix (a : Fin 10 → K) (r : Fin 1024) (j : Fin 10) : K :=
  ∏ i : Fin 10, if i.val < j.val then bitFactor (rowBits r i) (a i) else 1

theorem w_zero (i : Fin 10) : w (K := K) 0 i = (3 + 22*i.val : Nat) := by
  simp only [w, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.add_zero]

theorem w_sixteen (i : Fin 10) : w (K := K) 16 i = (275 + 150*i.val : Nat) := by
  unfold w
  congr 1
  omega

theorem maskOnly_degree (c : Fin 10) : (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val + 1 ≤ 22 := by
  simp only [R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent]
  split_ifs <;> omega

theorem bitFactor_bool (b t : Bool) :
    bitFactor b (if t then (1 : K) else 0) = if b = t then 1 else 0 := by
  cases b <;> cases t <;> simp [bitFactor]

theorem selector_round_match (ch : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) (z : K)
    (r : Fin 1024) :
    selAt (roundPoint ch j z (fun k => rowBits r ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩)) r =
      eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j * bitFactor (rowBits r j) z := by
  rw [selAt_eq_bitWeight]
  have he (i : Fin 10) :
      bitFactor (rowBits r i)
        (roundPoint ch j z (fun k => rowBits r ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩) i) =
      (if i.val < j.val then bitFactor (rowBits r i) (alpha ch i) else 1) *
        (if i = j then bitFactor (rowBits r j) z else 1) := by
    by_cases hlo : i.val < j.val
    · have hne : i ≠ j := by intro h; subst i; omega
      simp only [roundPoint, dif_pos hlo, if_pos hlo, if_neg hne, mul_one]
    · by_cases heq : i = j
      · subst i
        simp only [roundPoint, Nat.lt_irrefl, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte, one_mul]
      · have hv : i.val ≠ j.val := fun h => heq (Fin.ext h)
        have hi : (⟨j.val+1+(i.val-j.val-1), by omega⟩ : Fin 10) = i := by
          apply Fin.ext; simp only [Fin.val_mk]; omega
        simp only [roundPoint, dif_neg hlo, dif_neg hv, hi, bitFactor_bool,
          if_neg hlo, if_neg heq, ↓reduceIte, mul_one]
  change (∏ i : Fin 10, bitFactor (rowBits r i) _) = _
  simp only [he, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
    if_true, eqPrefix]

theorem selector_round_mismatch (ch : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) (z : K)
    (r : Fin 1024) (tail : Fin (9-j.val) → Bool)
    (hne : tail ≠ fun k => rowBits r ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩) :
    selAt (roundPoint ch j z tail) r = 0 := by
  rw [selAt_eq_bitWeight]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hne
  let i : Fin 10 := ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩
  have hi : ¬i.val < j.val := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have he : i.val ≠ j.val := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have ht : (⟨i.val-j.val-1, by omega⟩ : Fin (9-j.val)) = k := by
    apply Fin.ext; dsimp [i]; omega
  change (∏ c : Fin 10, bitFactor (rowBits r c) (roundPoint ch j z tail c)) = 0
  apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
  simp only [roundPoint, dif_neg hi, dif_neg he, ht, bitFactor_bool,
    ]
  exact if_neg (Ne.symm hk)

theorem linear_round_match (weights : Fin 10 → K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (j : Fin 10) (z : K) (r : Fin 1024) :
    (∑ i : Fin 10, weights i *
      roundPoint ch j z (fun k => rowBits r ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩) i) =
      weights j * z + β weights (alpha ch) j r := by
  have he (i : Fin 10) : weights i *
      roundPoint ch j z (fun k => rowBits r ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩) i =
      (if i = j then weights j * z else 0) +
      (if i.val < j.val then weights i * alpha ch i else 0) +
      (if j.val < i.val then weights i * (if rowBits r i then 1 else 0) else 0) := by
    by_cases hlo : i.val < j.val
    · have hne : i ≠ j := by intro h; subst i; omega
      have hng : ¬ j.val < i.val := by omega
      simp only [roundPoint, dif_pos hlo, if_neg hne, if_pos hlo, if_neg hng,
        zero_add, add_zero]
    · by_cases heq : i = j
      · subst i
        simp only [roundPoint, Nat.lt_irrefl, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
      · have hv : i.val ≠ j.val := fun h => heq (Fin.ext h)
        have hgt : j.val < i.val := by omega
        have hi : (⟨j.val+1+(i.val-j.val-1), by omega⟩ : Fin 10) = i := by
          apply Fin.ext; simp only [Fin.val_mk]; omega
        simp only [roundPoint, dif_neg hlo, dif_neg hv, hi, if_neg heq,
          if_neg hlo, if_pos hgt, zero_add]
  simp_rw [he]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
    if_true, β, add_assoc]

theorem tail_sum_selector (ch : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) (z : K)
    (r : Fin 1024) (f : PayloadSplit.PointFunction K) :
    (∑ tail : Fin (9-j.val) → Bool,
      f (roundPoint ch j z tail) * selAt (roundPoint ch j z tail) r) =
      f (roundPoint ch j z (fun k => rowBits r ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩)) *
        (eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j * bitFactor (rowBits r j) z) := by
  rw [← selector_round_match]
  apply Fintype.sum_eq_single (fun k : Fin (9-j.val) => rowBits r ⟨j.val+1+k.val, by omega⟩)
  intro tail hne
  rw [selector_round_mismatch ch j z r tail hne, mul_zero]

/-- Equality on the 28 distinct source nodes, with explicit degree bounds. -/
theorem polynomial_ext28 (p q : K[X]) (hp : p.natDegree < 28)
    (hq : q.natDegree < 28) (he : ∀ z : K, p.eval z = q.eval z) : p = q := by
  apply Polynomial.eq_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq p q
    (fun i j hij => nodes_injOn (K := K) (Finset.mem_univ i) (Finset.mem_univ j) hij)
    (fun i : Fin 28 => he (i.val : K))
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using max_lt hp hq

theorem weighted_vdeg (weights : Fin 10 → K) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => 1) (fun a => ∑ i, weights i * a i) := by
  apply vdeg_sum Finset.univ
  intro i _
  apply vdeg_smul
  apply vdeg_mono (vdeg_proj i)
  intro k
  simp only [Pi.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> omega

theorem word_vdeg (u : Fin 1024 → K) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => 1) (fun a => ∑ r, selAt a r * u r) :=
  vdeg_honestClaims_zero (fun _ => u) 0

theorem power_word_vdeg (weights : Fin 10 → K) (τ q : K) (e : Nat)
    (u : Fin 1024 → K) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => e+1)
      (fun a => τ * (q + (∑ i, weights i * a i)^e) * ∑ r, selAt a r * u r) := by
  have hp := vdeg_pow (weighted_vdeg weights) e
  have hq := vdeg_add (vdeg_const 10 (fun _ => 0) q) hp
  simpa only [Nat.mul_one, Nat.zero_max] using vdeg_mul (vdeg_smul τ hq) (word_vdeg u)

theorem row_power_degree (a b q : K) (e : Nat) (bit : Bool) :
    ((if bit then (X : K[X]) else 1-X) * (C q + (C a * X + C b)^e)).natDegree ≤ e+1 := by
  have hb : (if bit then (X : K[X]) else 1-X).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    cases bit
    · exact (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (by simp)
    · simp
  have ha : (C a * X + C b).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    apply (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans
    apply max_le
    · simpa only [natDegree_C, natDegree_X, Nat.zero_add] using
        (natDegree_mul_le (p := C a) (q := (X : K[X])))
    · simp
  have he : (C q + (C a * X + C b)^e).natDegree ≤ e := by
    apply (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans
    apply max_le (by simp)
    simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using natDegree_pow_le_of_le e ha
  exact natDegree_mul_le.trans (by omega)

/-- One symbolic formula covers a power and G's added constant term. -/
theorem power_rounds (weights : Fin 10 → K) (τ q : K) (e : Nat) (he : e ≤ 26)
    (ch : Challenges K) (u : Fin 1024 → K) (j : Fin 10) :
    PayloadSplit.rounds ch j
      (fun a => τ * (q + (∑ i, weights i * a i)^e) * ∑ r, selAt a r * u r) =
      ∑ r, u r • (τ * eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j) •
        ((if rowBits r j then X else 1-X) *
          (C q + (C (weights j)*X + C (β weights (alpha ch) j r))^e)) := by
  apply polynomial_ext28
  · exact rounds_natDegree_lt ch j _
  · apply lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ (fun r _ =>
      (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans ((natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans
        (row_power_degree _ _ _ _ _))))
    omega
  · intro z
    rw [rounds_eval_of_vdeg ch j _
      (vdeg_mono (power_word_vdeg weights τ q e u) (fun _ => by omega))]
    simp only [eval_finsetSum, eval_smul, smul_eq_mul, eval_mul, eval_add,
      eval_C, eval_pow, apply_ite, eval_X, eval_sub, eval_one]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    have hs := tail_sum_selector ch j z r
      (fun a => τ * (q + (∑ i, weights i * a i)^e))
    rw [linear_round_match] at hs
    calc
      _ = (∑ tail : Fin (9-j.val) → Bool,
          (τ * (q + (∑ i, weights i * roundPoint ch j z tail i)^e)) *
            selAt (roundPoint ch j z tail) r) * u r := by
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro tail _
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hs]; simp only [bitFactor]; ring

theorem pureRound_maskOnly (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (c : Fin 10) (u : Fin 1024 → K) (j : Fin 10) :
    PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fun a =>
      R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ *
        R0P.Mask.maskLinear 0 a ^ (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val *
          ∑ r, selAt a r * u r) =
      ∑ r, u r • (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ *
        eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j) • ((if rowBits r j then X else 1-X) *
          (C (w 0 j)*X + C (β (w 0) (alpha ch) j r)) ^
            (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val) := by
  simpa only [R0P.Mask.maskLinear, w, zero_add, map_zero] using
    power_rounds (w 0) (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩)
      0 (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val (by have := maskOnly_degree c; omega) ch u j

theorem pureRound_G (ch : Challenges K) (u : Fin 1024 → K) (j : Fin 10) :
    PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fun a =>
      (1 + R0P.Mask.maskLinear 16 a ^ 26) * ∑ r, selAt a r * u r) =
      ∑ r, u r • eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j • ((if rowBits r j then X else 1-X) *
        (1 + (C (w 16 j)*X + C (β (w 16) (alpha ch) j r)) ^ 26)) := by
  simpa only [R0P.Mask.maskLinear, w, one_mul, map_one] using
    power_rounds (w 16) 1 1 26 (by omega) ch u j

/-- The mask-only substituted function has coordinate degree at most e_c+1 (at most 22). -/
theorem maskOnly_word_vdeg (B : PackBasis F) (c : Fin 10) (u : Fin 1024 → K) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val+1)
      (fun a => R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ *
        R0P.Mask.maskLinear 0 a ^ (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val *
          ∑ r, selAt a r * u r) := by
  simpa only [w, R0P.Mask.maskLinear, zero_add] using
    power_word_vdeg (w 0)
      (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩)
      0 (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val u

theorem pureRound_maskOnly_degree (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (c : Fin 10) (u : Fin 1024 → K) (j : Fin 10) :
    (PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fun a =>
      R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ *
        R0P.Mask.maskLinear 0 a ^ (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val *
          ∑ r, selAt a r * u r)).natDegree ≤ (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val+1 := by
  rw [pureRound_maskOnly]
  apply natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro r _
  apply (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans
  apply (natDegree_smul_le _ _).trans
  simpa only [map_zero, zero_add] using
    row_power_degree (w 0 j) (β (w 0) (alpha ch) j r) (0 : K)
      (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val (rowBits r j)

/-- A symbolic Boolean cube has 2^n elements. -/
theorem sum_bool_const (n : Nat) (c : K) :
    (∑ _ : Fin n → Bool, c) = (2 : K)^n * c := by
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun,
    Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]

/-- Isolate one Boolean coordinate by a tuple equivalence, without enumerating a cube. -/
theorem sum_bool_coordinate (n : Nat) (k : Fin n) (f : Bool → K) :
    (∑ b : Fin n → Bool, f (b k)) = (2 : K)^(n-1) * (f false + f true) := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact k.elim0
  | succ n =>
    have hs : (∑ b : Fin (n+1) → Bool, f (b k)) =
        ∑ p : Bool × (Fin n → Bool), f p.1 := by
      exact (Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.insertNthEquiv (fun _ => Bool) k)
        (fun p => f p.1) (fun b => f (b k))
        (fun p => by simp only [Fin.insertNthEquiv_apply, Fin.insertNth_apply_same])).symm
    rw [hs, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [sum_bool_const, Fintype.sum_bool, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    ring

theorem sum_bool_power (n : Nat) (k : Fin n) (e : Nat) :
    (∑ b : Fin n → Bool, (if b k then (1 : K) else 0)^e) =
      (2 : K)^(n-1) * (if e = 0 then 2 else 1) := by
  rw [sum_bool_coordinate n k (fun b => (if b then (1 : K) else 0)^e)]
  by_cases he : e = 0
  · simp only [he, pow_zero, if_true]; ring
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true, zero_pow he, one_pow,
      zero_add, if_neg he]

theorem coordinate_power_vdeg (k : Fin 10) (e : Nat) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => e) (fun a : Fin 10 → K => a k ^ e) := by
  apply vdeg_mono (vdeg_pow (vdeg_proj k) e)
  intro i
  simp only [Pi.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

/-- The round of one coordinate monomial, before specializing to Libra's two coordinates. -/
theorem coordinate_power_round (ch : Challenges K) (k j : Fin 10) (e : Nat)
    (he : e ≤ 27) :
    PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fun a => a k ^ e) =
      if j.val < k.val then C ((2 : K)^(8-j.val) * (if e = 0 then 2 else 1))
      else if j = k then C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val)) * X^e
      else C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val) * alpha ch k ^ e) := by
  apply polynomial_ext28
  · exact rounds_natDegree_lt ch j _
  · by_cases hjk : j.val < k.val
    · rw [if_pos hjk, natDegree_C]; omega
    · rw [if_neg hjk]
      by_cases heq : j = k
      · rw [if_pos heq]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ e) (by omega)
      · rw [if_neg heq, natDegree_C]; omega
  · intro z
    rw [rounds_eval_of_vdeg ch j _
      (vdeg_mono (coordinate_power_vdeg k e) (fun _ => he))]
    by_cases hjk : j.val < k.val
    · have hkj : ¬ k.val < j.val := by omega
      have hne : k.val ≠ j.val := by omega
      simp only [if_pos hjk, eval_C, roundPoint, dif_neg hkj, dif_neg hne]
      have hs := sum_bool_power (K := K) (9-j.val) ⟨k.val-j.val-1, by omega⟩ e
      simpa only [show 9-j.val-1 = 8-j.val by omega] using hs
    · by_cases heq : j = k
      · subst k
        simp only [if_neg hjk, if_true, if_false, roundPoint, Nat.lt_irrefl, ↓reduceDIte,
          eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_X, sum_bool_const]
      · have hkj : k.val < j.val := by
          have hne : j.val ≠ k.val := fun h => heq (Fin.ext h)
          omega
        simp only [if_neg hjk, if_neg heq, roundPoint, dif_pos hkj, eval_C,
          sum_bool_const]

/-- T2b-2a″: cell d has local degree d % 28, not degree d. -/
theorem pureRound_libra (ch : Challenges K) (d : Fin 56) (j : Fin 10) :
    let k : Fin 10 := if d.val < 28 then 8 else 9
    let e := d.val % 28
    PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fun a => a k ^ e) =
      if j.val < k.val then C ((2 : K)^(8-j.val) * (if e = 0 then 2 else 1))
      else if j = k then C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val)) * X^e
      else C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val) * alpha ch k ^ e) := by
  dsimp only
  exact coordinate_power_round ch _ j _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)))

theorem pureLibra_maskSum (d : Fin 56) :
    let k : Fin 10 := if d.val < 28 then 8 else 9
    let e := d.val % 28
    (∑ b : Fin 10 → Bool, (ofBool b : Fin 10 → K) k ^ e) =
      (512 : K) * (if e = 0 then 2 else 1) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [show (512 : K) = (2 : K)^(10-1) by norm_num]
  exact sum_bool_power 10 _ _

/-- The pure trace is the actual affine mask applied to the zero trace. -/
theorem pureTrace_applyAff (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) :
    pureTrace B m = applyAff B 0 (pureAff m) := by
  rw [applyAff_eq_base_add]
  have hz : traceBase (0 : Trace K) = 0 := by
    funext c r
    simp only [traceBase, Pi.zero_apply, ite_self]
  rw [hz, zero_add]
  simp only [pureTrace, LinearMap.comp_apply]

theorem pureTrace_maskOnly_word (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) (c : Fin 10) :
    pureTrace B m ⟨16+c.val, by omega⟩ =
      maskOnlyColumns (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) c := by
  rw [pureTrace_applyAff]
  funext r
  simp only [applyAff, Fin.val_mk, if_neg (show ¬16+c.val < 16 by omega),
    dif_pos (show 16+c.val < 26 by omega)]
  congr 2
  omega

theorem pureTrace_G_word (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) :
    pureTrace B m 27 = balance 0 (extensionRaw B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) 0) := by
  rw [pureTrace_applyAff]
  rfl

theorem pureTrace_D_word (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) :
    pureTrace B m 28 = dWord B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) := by
  rw [pureTrace_applyAff]
  rfl

/-- Only the stated column is read by each point-claim functional. -/
theorem claims_zero_of_word_zero (t : Trace K) (a : Fin 10 → K)
    (j : Fin 3) (l : Fin 29) (hz : t l = 0) : honestClaims t a j l = 0 := by
  simp only [honestClaims, hz, AspisR0.LinearDual.dot, Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero,
    Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem extra_zero_of_word_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (t : Trace K)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (l : Fin 29) (hz : t l = 0) :
    extraLinear π a l t = 0 := by
  simp only [extraLinear, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, hz,
    map_zero]

/-- The mask-only factor on a trace supported in that lane. -/
theorem maskLinear_maskOnly (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (t : Trace K) (c : Fin 10)
    (hs : ∀ l : Fin 29, l ≠ ⟨16+c.val, by omega⟩ → t l = 0) :
    PayloadSplit.maskLinear π B a t =
      R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ *
        R0P.Mask.maskLinear 0 a ^ (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val *
          ∑ r, selAt a r * t ⟨16+c.val, by omega⟩ r := by
  have hc1 (i : Fin 16) : honestClaims t a 0 (Fin.castLE (by omega) i) = 0 := by
    apply claims_zero_of_word_zero
    apply hs
    intro he
    have := congrArg Fin.val he
    simp only [Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_mk] at this
    omega
  have hg : honestClaims t a 0 27 = 0 := by
    apply claims_zero_of_word_zero
    apply hs
    intro he
    have := congrArg Fin.val he
    change 27 = 16+c.val at this
    omega
  have hd : extraLinear π a 28 t = 0 := by
    apply extra_zero_of_word_zero
    apply hs
    intro he
    have := congrArg Fin.val he
    change 28 = 16+c.val at this
    omega
  have hm (i : Fin 10) (hne : i ≠ c) :
      honestClaims t a 0 ⟨16+i.val, by omega⟩ = 0 := by
    apply claims_zero_of_word_zero
    apply hs
    intro he
    apply hne
    apply Fin.ext
    have := congrArg Fin.val he
    simp only [Fin.val_mk] at this
    omega
  simp only [PayloadSplit.maskLinear, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, claimsLinear_apply, hc1, hg, hd,
    mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, add_zero]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single c (fun i hi => by rw [hm i hi, mul_zero])]
  have ht : (⟨c.val%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ : Fin 4) =
      ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change c.val%4 = (16+c.val)%4
    omega
  simp only [R0P.Mask.maskFactors, R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis, ht]
  rfl

theorem maskLinear_G (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (t : Trace K) (hs : ∀ l : Fin 29, l ≠ 27 → t l = 0) :
    PayloadSplit.maskLinear π B a t =
      (1 + R0P.Mask.maskLinear 16 a ^ 26) * ∑ r, selAt a r * t 27 r := by
  have hc1 (i : Fin 16) : honestClaims t a 0 (Fin.castLE (by omega) i) = 0 := by
    apply claims_zero_of_word_zero
    apply hs
    intro he
    have := congrArg Fin.val he
    change i.val = 27 at this
    omega
  have hm (i : Fin 10) : honestClaims t a 0 ⟨16+i.val, by omega⟩ = 0 := by
    apply claims_zero_of_word_zero
    apply hs
    intro he
    have := congrArg Fin.val he
    change 16+i.val = 27 at this
    omega
  have hd : extraLinear π a 28 t = 0 :=
    extra_zero_of_word_zero π t a 28 (hs 28 (by decide))
  simp only [PayloadSplit.maskLinear, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, claimsLinear_apply, hc1, hm, hd,
    mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, add_zero, R0P.Mask.maskFactors]
  rfl

theorem maskLinear_D (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (t : Trace K) (hs : ∀ l : Fin 29, l ≠ 28 → t l = 0) :
    PayloadSplit.maskLinear π B a t = extraLinear π a 28 t := by
  have hz (l : Fin 29) (hl : l.val < 28) : honestClaims t a 0 l = 0 := by
    apply claims_zero_of_word_zero
    apply hs
    intro he
    subst l
    exact (Nat.lt_irrefl 28) hl
  have hc (i : Fin 16) : honestClaims t a 0 (Fin.castLE (by omega) i) = 0 :=
    hz _ (by simp only [Fin.val_castLE]; omega)
  have hm (i : Fin 10) : honestClaims t a 0 ⟨16+i.val, by omega⟩ = 0 :=
    hz _ (by simp only [Fin.val_mk]; omega)
  simp only [PayloadSplit.maskLinear, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, claimsLinear_apply, hc, hm, hz 27 (by omega),
    mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]

theorem extra_coefficient_unit (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (t : Trace K)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (d : Fin 56)
    (hu : coeffsOf π t 28 = Pi.single ⟨d.val, by omega⟩ 1) :
    extraLinear π a 28 t = a (if d.val < 28 then 8 else 9) ^ (d.val%28) := by
  rw [extraLinear_apply]
  unfold R0P.Mask.honestExtra
  rw [hu]
  simp only [AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot, Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one,
    mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  change libraWeight a ⟨d.val, by omega⟩ = _
  by_cases hd : d.val < 28
  · simp only [libraWeight, Fin.val_mk, if_pos hd, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hd]
  · have hm : d.val%28 = d.val-28 := by omega
    simp only [libraWeight, Fin.val_mk, if_neg hd, if_pos d.isLt, hm]

/-- A zero raw lane stays zero under its symbolic balance. -/
theorem pureTrace_maskOnly_zero (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) (c : Fin 10)
    (hz : ∀ r, m.1 (c,r) = 0) : pureTrace B m ⟨16+c.val, by omega⟩ = 0 := by
  rw [pureTrace_maskOnly_word]
  have hr : maskOnlyRaw (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) c = 0 := by
    funext r
    change (m.1 (c,r) : K) = 0
    rw [hz]
    rfl
  funext r
  simp only [maskOnlyColumns, hr, balance, Pi.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero,
    neg_zero, ite_self]

theorem pureTrace_G_zero (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F)
    (hz : m.2.1 = 0) : pureTrace B m 27 = 0 := by
  rw [pureTrace_G_word]
  have hr : extensionRaw B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) 0 = 0 := by
    funext r
    change pack4 B (fun limb => (m.2.1 (r,limb) : K)) = 0
    simp only [hz, Pi.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, pack4, mul_zero, add_zero]
  funext r
  simp only [hr, balance, Pi.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_zero, ite_self]

theorem pureTrace_D_zero (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F)
    (hz : m.2.2 = 0) : pureTrace B m 28 = 0 := by
  rw [pureTrace_D_word]
  have hr : extensionRaw B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) 2 = 0 := by
    funext r
    change pack4 B (fun limb => (m.2.2 (r,limb) : K)) = 0
    simp only [hz, Pi.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, pack4, mul_zero, add_zero]
  funext r
  simp only [dWord, hr, balance, Pi.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_zero, ite_self]

/-- Raw support in mask-only lane c supplies the support premise of L_pure_maskOnly. -/
theorem pureTrace_maskOnly_support (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) (c : Fin 10)
    (hm : ∀ i : Fin 10, i ≠ c → ∀ r, m.1 (i,r) = 0)
    (hg : m.2.1 = 0) (hd : m.2.2 = 0) :
    ∀ l : Fin 29, l ≠ ⟨16+c.val, by omega⟩ → pureTrace B m l = 0 := by
  intro l hne
  by_cases hf : l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26
  · exact pureTrace_fixed B m l hf
  · by_cases hl : l.val < 26
    · let i : Fin 10 := ⟨l.val-16, by omega⟩
      have he : l = (⟨16+i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29) := by
        apply Fin.ext; dsimp [i]; omega
      have hi : i ≠ c := by intro h; apply hne; simpa only [h] using he
      rw [he]
      exact pureTrace_maskOnly_zero B m i (hm i hi)
    · by_cases he : l = 27
      · subst l; exact pureTrace_G_zero B m hg
      · have he' : l = 28 := by
          apply Fin.ext
          have hn : l.val ≠ 27 := fun h => he (Fin.ext h)
          change l.val = 28
          omega
        subst l
        exact pureTrace_D_zero B m hd

/-- Raw support in G supplies the support premise of L_pure_G. -/
theorem pureTrace_G_support (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F)
    (hm : m.1 = 0) (hd : m.2.2 = 0) :
    ∀ l : Fin 29, l ≠ 27 → pureTrace B m l = 0 := by
  intro l hne
  by_cases hf : l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26
  · exact pureTrace_fixed B m l hf
  · by_cases hl : l.val < 26
    · let i : Fin 10 := ⟨l.val-16, by omega⟩
      have he : l = (⟨16+i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29) := by
        apply Fin.ext; dsimp [i]; omega
      rw [he]
      exact pureTrace_maskOnly_zero B m i (fun r => by rw [hm]; rfl)
    · have he : l = 28 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hn : l.val ≠ 27 := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
        change l.val = 28
        omega
      subst l
      exact pureTrace_D_zero B m hd

/-- Raw support in D supplies the support premise of L_pure_libra. -/
theorem pureTrace_D_support (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F)
    (hm : m.1 = 0) (hg : m.2.1 = 0) :
    ∀ l : Fin 29, l ≠ 28 → pureTrace B m l = 0 := by
  intro l hne
  by_cases hf : l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26
  · exact pureTrace_fixed B m l hf
  · by_cases hl : l.val < 26
    · let i : Fin 10 := ⟨l.val-16, by omega⟩
      have he : l = (⟨16+i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29) := by
        apply Fin.ext; dsimp [i]; omega
      rw [he]
      exact pureTrace_maskOnly_zero B m i (fun r => by rw [hm]; rfl)
    · have he : l = 27 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hn : l.val ≠ 28 := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
        change l.val = 27
        omega
      subst l
      exact pureTrace_G_zero B m hg

/-- The post-balance mask-only word is the input of the row formula. -/
theorem L_pure_maskOnly (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (c : Fin 10) (j : Fin 10)
    (hm : ∀ i : Fin 10, i ≠ c → ∀ r, m.1 (i,r) = 0)
    (hg : m.2.1 = 0) (hd : m.2.2 = 0) :
    Chain.roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m)) =
      ∑ r, maskOnlyColumns (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) c r •
        (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ *
          eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j) • ((if rowBits r j then X else 1-X) *
            (C (w 0 j)*X + C (β (w 0) (alpha ch) j r)) ^
              (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val) := by
  rw [roundPoly_L]
  have hs := pureTrace_maskOnly_support B m c hm hg hd
  have hf := funext (fun a => maskLinear_maskOnly π B a (pureTrace B m) c hs)
  rw [hf, pureTrace_maskOnly_word, pureRound_maskOnly]

/-- G uses its balanced packed word, with the degree-26 factor plus one. -/
theorem L_pure_G (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (j : Fin 10)
    (hm : m.1 = 0) (hd : m.2.2 = 0) :
    Chain.roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m)) =
      ∑ r, balance 0 (extensionRaw B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) 0) r •
        eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j • ((if rowBits r j then X else 1-X) *
          (1 + (C (w 16 j)*X + C (β (w 16) (alpha ch) j r)) ^ 26)) := by
  rw [roundPoly_L]
  have hs := pureTrace_G_support B m hm hd
  have hf := funext (fun a => maskLinear_G π B a (pureTrace B m) hs)
  rw [hf, pureTrace_G_word, pureRound_G]

/-- Coefficient d is selected only after balancing the D row word and transporting it. -/
theorem L_pure_libra (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (d : Fin 56) (j : Fin 10)
    (hm : m.1 = 0) (hg : m.2.1 = 0)
    (hu : (fun k => dWord B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) (π.symm k)) =
      Pi.single (⟨d.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) 1) :
    let k : Fin 10 := if d.val < 28 then 8 else 9
    let e := d.val%28
    Chain.roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m)) =
      if j.val < k.val then C ((2 : K)^(8-j.val) * (if e = 0 then 2 else 1))
      else if j = k then C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val)) * X^e
      else C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val) * alpha ch k ^ e) := by
  have hs := pureTrace_D_support B m hm hg
  have hu' : coeffsOf π (pureTrace B m) 28 = Pi.single ⟨d.val, by omega⟩ 1 := by
    change (fun k => pureTrace B m 28 (π.symm k)) = _
    rw [pureTrace_D_word]
    exact hu
  have hf : (fun a => PayloadSplit.maskLinear π B a (pureTrace B m)) =
      fun a => a (if d.val < 28 then 8 else 9) ^ (d.val%28) := by
    funext a
    rw [maskLinear_D π B a _ hs, extra_coefficient_unit π _ a d hu']
  dsimp only
  rw [roundPoly_L, hf]
  exact pureRound_libra ch d j

theorem L_pure_libra_maskSum (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (d : Fin 56)
    (hm : m.1 = 0) (hg : m.2.1 = 0)
    (hu : (fun k => dWord B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) (π.symm k)) =
      Pi.single (⟨d.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) 1) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m) .maskSum =
      (512 : K) * (if d.val%28 = 0 then 2 else 1) := by
  have hs := pureTrace_D_support B m hm hg
  have hu' : coeffsOf π (pureTrace B m) 28 = Pi.single ⟨d.val, by omega⟩ 1 := by
    change (fun k => pureTrace B m 28 (π.symm k)) = _
    rw [pureTrace_D_word]
    exact hu
  rw [L_maskSum]
  simp_rw [maskLinear_D π B _ _ hs, extra_coefficient_unit π _ _ d hu']
  exact pureLibra_maskSum d

/-- Reconstructing the round polynomial preserves each disclosed coefficient. -/
theorem roundPoly_coeff_L (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    (Chain.roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch t)).coeff i.val =
      PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch t (.semanticCoeff j i) := by
  rw [roundPoly_L, PayloadSplit.L_round]


theorem L_pure_maskOnly_coeff (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (c : Fin 10) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28)
    (hm : ∀ i : Fin 10, i ≠ c → ∀ r, m.1 (i,r) = 0)
    (hg : m.2.1 = 0) (hd : m.2.2 = 0) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m) (.semanticCoeff j i) =
      (∑ r, maskOnlyColumns (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) c r •
        (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B ⟨(16+c.val)%4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ *
          eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j) • ((if rowBits r j then X else 1-X) *
            (C (w 0 j)*X + C (β (w 0) (alpha ch) j r)) ^
              (R0P.Mask.maskOnlyFactorExponent c).val)).coeff i.val := by
  rw [← roundPoly_coeff_L]
  exact congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff i.val) (L_pure_maskOnly π B ch m c j hm hg hd)

theorem L_pure_G_coeff (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28)
    (hm : m.1 = 0) (hd : m.2.2 = 0) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m) (.semanticCoeff j i) =
      (∑ r, balance 0 (extensionRaw B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) 0) r •
        eqPrefix (alpha ch) r j • ((if rowBits r j then X else 1-X) *
          (1 + (C (w 16 j)*X + C (β (w 16) (alpha ch) j r)) ^ 26))).coeff i.val := by
  rw [← roundPoly_coeff_L]
  exact congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff i.val) (L_pure_G π B ch m j hm hd)

theorem L_pure_libra_coeff (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (d : Fin 56) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28)
    (hm : m.1 = 0) (hg : m.2.1 = 0)
    (hu : (fun k => dWord B (Sum.elim 0 (pureAff m)) (π.symm k)) =
      Pi.single (⟨d.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) 1) :
    let k : Fin 10 := if d.val < 28 then 8 else 9
    let e := d.val%28
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m) (.semanticCoeff j i) =
      (if j.val < k.val then C ((2 : K)^(8-j.val) * (if e = 0 then 2 else 1))
      else if j = k then C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val)) * X^e
      else C ((2 : K)^(9-j.val) * alpha ch k ^ e)).coeff i.val := by
  dsimp only
  rw [← roundPoly_coeff_L]
  exact congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff i.val) (L_pure_libra π B ch m d j hm hg hu)

#print axioms mem_silentMasks_iff
#print axioms L_pure_maskOnly_coeff
#print axioms L_pure_G_coeff
#print axioms L_pure_libra_coeff
#print axioms L_pure_libra_maskSum
#print axioms pureRound_libra
#print axioms silent_mem_chain0
#print axioms pureRound_maskOnly
#print axioms pureRound_G
end R0Z.PureRounds

R0Z.K4.text:
import R0P.CoreExt
import R0P.MaskValue
import R0Z.PureRounds

/-! J1 (T2b-2b design §1.1, §1.2, §5): the packing subfields `K₂ = F(i)` and
`K₄ = F(i, u)`, the prefix spans `Λ_j`, the quadratic-subfield lemma, and
`Good₃ → Λ_j = K₄` for `j ≥ 4`.

Payload-generic part: everything up to `lambda4_eq_K4` uses only a finite field
`K`, a subfield `F`, a packing basis and the closure premise `PackField`.  The
only protocol objects are `eqPrefix` (the multilinear prefix weight of
PureRounds) and, in `Good3`, the R0 challenge record (`alpha`, `sem`, `Good`).
No concrete row set is enumerated; `Λ_j` is a span over the symbolic range of
`eqPrefix`, and every row used below is built as `rowOf` of an updated bit
vector. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.K4
open R0P R0P.SemDegree R0Z.HonestView

section Field
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The closure premise and the two subfields -/

/-- The packing basis spans a field: `i² ∈ F` and `u² ∈ F + F·i`.  For the
QM31 tower `i² = −1`, `u² = 2 + i`; a refinement fact of the concrete basis. -/
def PackField (B : PackBasis F) : Prop :=
  B.i * B.i ∈ F ∧ ∃ a b : K, a ∈ F ∧ b ∈ F ∧ B.u * B.u = a + B.i * b

/-- Scalar action of the base subfield is multiplication. -/
theorem fsmul_eq (c : F) (x : K) : c • x = (c : K) * x := rfl

/-- In a finite field every subring is closed under inversion. -/
theorem inv_mem_of_subring (S : Subring K) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ S) : x⁻¹ ∈ S := by
  by_cases h0 : x = 0
  · rw [h0, inv_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  · have hc : 1 < Fintype.card K := Fintype.one_lt_card
    have hm : x * x ^ (Fintype.card K - 2) = 1 := by
      calc x * x ^ (Fintype.card K - 2) = x ^ (Fintype.card K - 2 + 1) := (pow_succ' x _).symm
        _ = x ^ (Fintype.card K - 1) := by congr 1; omega
        _ = 1 := FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one x h0
    rw [inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hm]
    exact pow_mem hx _

/-- A subring of a finite field, as a subfield. -/
def subfieldOfSubring (S : Subring K) : Subfield K :=
  { S with inv_mem' := fun _ hx => inv_mem_of_subring S hx }

/-- `F + F·i` as a subring. -/
def K2Subring (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subring K where
  carrier := {x | ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ b ∈ F, x = a + B.i * b}
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ ⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a * c + (B.i * B.i) * (b * d),
      F.add_mem (F.mul_mem ha hc) (F.mul_mem hB.1 (F.mul_mem hb hd)),
      a * d + b * c, F.add_mem (F.mul_mem ha hd) (F.mul_mem hb hc), by ring⟩
  one_mem' := ⟨1, F.one_mem, 0, F.zero_mem, by ring⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ ⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a + c, F.add_mem ha hc, b + d, F.add_mem hb hd, by ring⟩
  zero_mem' := ⟨0, F.zero_mem, 0, F.zero_mem, by ring⟩
  neg_mem' := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-a, F.neg_mem ha, -b, F.neg_mem hb, by ring⟩

/-- `K₂ = F(i)`. -/
def K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subfield K :=
  subfieldOfSubring (K2Subring B hB)

theorem mem_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K2 B hB ↔ ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ b ∈ F, x = a + B.i * b := Iff.rfl

theorem F_le_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ F) :
    x ∈ K2 B hB :=
  (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨x, hx, 0, F.zero_mem, by ring⟩

theorem i_mem_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.i ∈ K2 B hB :=
  (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨0, F.zero_mem, 1, F.one_mem, by ring⟩

theorem uu_mem_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.u * B.u ∈ K2 B hB := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, h⟩ := hB.2
  exact (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩

/-- `K₂ + u·K₂` as a subring. -/
def K4Subring (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subring K where
  carrier := {x | ∃ A ∈ K2 B hB, ∃ C ∈ K2 B hB, x = A + B.u * C}
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩ ⟨A', hA', C', hC', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A * A' + (B.u * B.u) * (C * C'),
      (K2 B hB).add_mem ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hA hA')
        ((K2 B hB).mul_mem (uu_mem_K2 B hB) ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hC hC')),
      A * C' + C * A',
      (K2 B hB).add_mem ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hA hC') ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hC hA'), by ring⟩
  one_mem' := ⟨1, (K2 B hB).one_mem, 0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, by ring⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩ ⟨A', hA', C', hC', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A + A', (K2 B hB).add_mem hA hA', C + C', (K2 B hB).add_mem hC hC', by ring⟩
  zero_mem' := ⟨0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, 0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, by ring⟩
  neg_mem' := by
    rintro _ ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-A, (K2 B hB).neg_mem hA, -C, (K2 B hB).neg_mem hC, by ring⟩

/-- `K₄ = F(i, u)`. -/
def K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subfield K :=
  subfieldOfSubring (K4Subring B hB)

theorem mem_K4_iff_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K4 B hB ↔ ∃ A ∈ K2 B hB, ∃ C ∈ K2 B hB, x = A + B.u * C := Iff.rfl

/-- The carrier characterisation through `pack4` used by every word lemma. -/
theorem mem_K4_iff_pack4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K4 B hB ↔ ∃ v : Fin 4 → K, (∀ j, v j ∈ F) ∧ x = pack4 B v := by
  rw [mem_K4_iff_K2]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := (mem_K2 B hB).1 hA
    obtain ⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩ := (mem_K2 B hB).1 hC
    let v : Fin 4 → K := fun j =>
      if j.val = 0 then a else if j.val = 1 then b else if j.val = 2 then c else d
    refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j
      simp only [v]
      split_ifs
      · exact ha
      · exact hb
      · exact hc
      · exact hd
    · have h0 : v 0 = a := rfl
      have h1 : v 1 = b := rfl
      have h2 : v 2 = c := rfl
      have h3 : v 3 = d := rfl
      unfold pack4
      rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
      ring
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨v 0 + B.i * v 1, (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨v 0, hv 0, v 1, hv 1, rfl⟩,
      v 2 + B.i * v 3, (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨v 2, hv 2, v 3, hv 3, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    unfold pack4
    ring

theorem K2_le_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : K2 B hB ≤ K4 B hB :=
  fun x hx => (mem_K4_iff_K2 B hB).2 ⟨x, hx, 0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, by ring⟩

theorem F_le_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ F) :
    x ∈ K4 B hB :=
  K2_le_K4 B hB (F_le_K2 B hB hx)

theorem u_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.u ∈ K4 B hB :=
  (mem_K4_iff_K2 B hB).2 ⟨0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, 1, (K2 B hB).one_mem, by ring⟩

theorem i_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.i ∈ K4 B hB :=
  K2_le_K4 B hB (i_mem_K2 B hB)

theorem pack4_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (v : Fin 4 → K)
    (hv : ∀ j, v j ∈ F) : pack4 B v ∈ K4 B hB :=
  (mem_K4_iff_pack4 B hB).2 ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

theorem towerBasis_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (j : Fin 4) :
    R0P.Mask.towerBasis B j ∈ K4 B hB := by
  unfold R0P.Mask.towerBasis
  split_ifs
  · exact (K4 B hB).one_mem
  · exact i_mem_K4 B hB
  · exact u_mem_K4 B hB
  · exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem (i_mem_K4 B hB) (u_mem_K4 B hB)

theorem natCast_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (n : ℕ) :
    (n : K) ∈ K4 B hB :=
  natCast_mem (K4 B hB) n

theorem half_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : (1 / 2 : K) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have h2 : (2 : K) ∈ K4 B hB := by
    have h := natCast_mem_K4 B hB 2
    simpa using h
  exact (K4 B hB).div_mem (K4 B hB).one_mem h2

/-! ### F-dimensions -/

/-- `K₄` as an `F`-subspace of `K` (same carrier). -/
def K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Submodule F K where
  carrier := (K4 B hB : Set K)
  add_mem' := fun ha hb => (K4 B hB).add_mem ha hb
  zero_mem' := (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
    rw [fsmul_eq]
    exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem (F_le_K4 B hB c.2) hx

theorem mem_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K4F B hB ↔ x ∈ K4 B hB := Iff.rfl

/-- `K₂` as an `F`-subspace of `K`. -/
def K2F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Submodule F K where
  carrier := (K2 B hB : Set K)
  add_mem' := fun ha hb => (K2 B hB).add_mem ha hb
  zero_mem' := (K2 B hB).zero_mem
  smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
    rw [fsmul_eq]
    exact (K2 B hB).mul_mem (F_le_K2 B hB c.2) hx

theorem mem_K2F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K2F B hB ↔ x ∈ K2 B hB := Iff.rfl

theorem towerBasis_zero (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 0 = 1 := rfl
theorem towerBasis_one (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 1 = B.i := rfl
theorem towerBasis_two (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 2 = B.u := rfl
theorem towerBasis_three (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 3 = B.i * B.u := rfl

/-- `{1, i, u, iu}` is `F`-independent (from `PackBasis.indep`). -/
theorem towerBasis_linearIndependent (B : PackBasis F) :
    LinearIndependent F (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B) := by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  have h : (g 0 : K) + B.i * g 1 + B.u * g 2 + B.i * B.u * g 3 = 0 := by
    rw [← hg, Fin.sum_univ_four]
    simp only [fsmul_eq, towerBasis_zero, towerBasis_one, towerBasis_two, towerBasis_three]
    ring
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := B.indep _ _ _ _ (g 0).2 (g 1).2 (g 2).2 (g 3).2 h
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact Subtype.ext h0
  · exact Subtype.ext h1
  · exact Subtype.ext h2
  · exact Subtype.ext h3

theorem K4F_eq_span (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    K4F B hB = Submodule.span F (Set.range (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (mem_K4_iff_pack4 B hB).1 hx
    have e : pack4 B v =
        v 0 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 0 + v 1 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 1 +
        v 2 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 2 + v 3 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 3 := by
      rw [towerBasis_zero, towerBasis_one, towerBasis_two, towerBasis_three]
      unfold pack4
      ring
    rw [e]
    have hm (j : Fin 4) : v j * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B j ∈
        Submodule.span F (Set.range (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B)) :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (⟨v j, hv j⟩ : F) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (hm 0) (hm 1)) (hm 2))
      (hm 3)
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact towerBasis_mem_K4 B hB j

theorem finrank_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    Module.finrank F (K4F B hB) = 4 := by
  rw [K4F_eq_span B hB, finrank_span_eq_card (towerBasis_linearIndependent B),
    Fintype.card_fin]

/-- The `K₂` basis `{1, i}`. -/
def k2Basis (B : PackBasis F) : Fin 2 → K := fun j => if j.val = 0 then 1 else B.i

theorem k2Basis_linearIndependent (B : PackBasis F) :
    LinearIndependent F (k2Basis B) := by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  have h' : (g 0 : K) + B.i * g 1 = 0 := by
    rw [← hg, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [fsmul_eq]
    have e0 : k2Basis B 0 = 1 := rfl
    have e1 : k2Basis B 1 = B.i := rfl
    rw [e0, e1]
    ring
  have h : (g 0 : K) + B.i * g 1 + B.u * 0 + B.i * B.u * 0 = 0 := by
    rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, add_zero]
    exact h'
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, -, -⟩ := B.indep _ _ _ _ (g 0).2 (g 1).2 F.zero_mem F.zero_mem h
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact Subtype.ext h0
  · exact Subtype.ext h1

theorem K2F_eq_span (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    K2F B hB = Submodule.span F (Set.range (k2Basis B)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := (mem_K2 B hB).1 hx
    have e : a + B.i * b = a * k2Basis B 0 + b * k2Basis B 1 := by
      have e0 : k2Basis B 0 = 1 := rfl
      have e1 : k2Basis B 1 = B.i := rfl
      rw [e0, e1]
      ring
    rw [e]
    have h0 : a * k2Basis B 0 ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range (k2Basis B)) :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (⟨a, ha⟩ : F) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, rfl⟩)
    have h1 : b * k2Basis B 1 ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range (k2Basis B)) :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (⟨b, hb⟩ : F) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, rfl⟩)
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ h0 h1
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    unfold k2Basis
    split_ifs
    · exact (K2 B hB).one_mem
    · exact i_mem_K2 B hB

theorem finrank_K2F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    Module.finrank F (K2F B hB) = 2 := by
  rw [K2F_eq_span B hB, finrank_span_eq_card (k2Basis_linearIndependent B),
    Fintype.card_fin]

theorem K2F_le_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : K2F B hB ≤ K4F B hB :=
  fun _ hx => K2_le_K4 B hB hx

/-! ### The quadratic-subfield lemma -/

/-- Frobenius over `F` (power `|F|`) squares to the identity on every root of
a quadratic over `F`. -/
theorem frob_sq_of_quadratic [Fintype F] {y a b : K} (ha : a ∈ F) (hb : b ∈ F)
    (hy : y * y = a + b * y) :
    (y ^ Fintype.card F) ^ Fintype.card F = y := by
  let φ := FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom F K
  have hφ (w : K) : φ w = w ^ Fintype.card F := rfl
  have hfix {c : K} (hc : c ∈ F) : φ c = c := φ.commutes ⟨c, hc⟩
  rw [← hφ, ← hφ]
  set z := φ y with hzdef
  have hz : z * z = a + b * z := by
    have h := congrArg φ hy
    rw [map_mul, map_add, map_mul, hfix ha, hfix hb] at h
    exact h
  have hprod : (z - y) * (z + y - b) = 0 := by linear_combination hz - hy
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hprod with h | h
  · have h1 : z = y := sub_eq_zero.1 h
    rw [h1]
    exact h1
  · have h2 : z = b - y := by linear_combination h
    rw [h2, map_sub, hfix hb]
    have h3 : φ y = z := rfl
    rw [h3, h2]
    ring

/-- An element of `K` that is quadratic over `F` lies in `K₂`.  The proof is
by Frobenius and the root count of `X^(q²) − X` against the `q²` elements of
`K₂`, with `q = |F|`; it needs no premise beyond finiteness of `K` (the
cardinality of `F` is read from its `Fintype` structure), and it holds for
every `x : K`, not only `x ∈ K₄`. -/
theorem mem_K2_of_quadratic (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K}
    (hx : x * x ∈ Submodule.span F ({1, x} : Set K)) : x ∈ K2 B hB := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype F := Fintype.ofFinite F
  set q := Fintype.card F with hq
  have hq1 : 1 < q := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have hqq : 1 < q * q := by nlinarith
  by_contra hxK
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.1 hx
  rw [fsmul_eq, fsmul_eq, mul_one] at hab
  have hroot {w : K} (hw : (w ^ q) ^ q = w) :
      w ∈ (Polynomial.X ^ (q * q) - Polynomial.X : Polynomial K).roots := by
    rw [Polynomial.mem_roots (FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_ne_zero K hqq)]
    simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_X]
    rw [pow_mul, hw, sub_self]
  let S : Finset K := Finset.univ.image (fun p : F × F => (p.1 : K) + B.i * p.2)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun p : F × F => (p.1 : K) + B.i * p.2) := by
    intro p p' h0
    have h : (p.1 : K) + B.i * p.2 = p'.1 + B.i * p'.2 := h0
    have h' : ((p.1 : K) - p'.1) + B.i * ((p.2 : K) - p'.2) + B.u * 0 + B.i * B.u * 0 = 0 := by
      linear_combination h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := B.indep _ _ _ _ (F.sub_mem p.1.2 p'.1.2)
      (F.sub_mem p.2.2 p'.2.2) F.zero_mem F.zero_mem h'
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 h1)) (Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 h2))
  have hS : S.card = q * q := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod]
  have hxS : x ∉ S := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨p, -, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 h
    exact hxK ((mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨p.1, p.1.2, p.2, p.2.2, hp.symm⟩)
  have hsub : (insert x S).val ⊆
      (Polynomial.X ^ (q * q) - Polynomial.X : Polynomial K).roots := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : w ∈ insert x S := hw
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hw' with h | h
    · rw [h]
      exact hroot (frob_sq_of_quadratic a.2 b.2 hab.symm)
    · obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 h
      apply hroot
      have hs := hB.1
      refine frob_sq_of_quadratic (a := -((p.1 : K) * p.1) + (B.i * B.i) * ((p.2 : K) * p.2))
        (b := 2 * (p.1 : K)) ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact F.add_mem (F.neg_mem (F.mul_mem p.1.2 p.1.2)) (F.mul_mem hs (F.mul_mem p.2.2 p.2.2))
      · have h2 : (2 : K) ∈ F := by
          have h := natCast_mem F 2
          simpa using h
        exact F.mul_mem h2 p.1.2
      · ring
  have hcard := Polynomial.card_le_degree_of_subset_roots hsub
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hxS, hS,
    FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_natDegree_eq K hqq] at hcard
  omega

/-! ### Invariant subspaces of `K₄` -/

/-- A subspace of `K₄` containing 1 and stable under multiplication by some
`β ∈ K₄ ∖ K₂` is all of `K₄`. -/
theorem K4F_le_of_invariant (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    {T : Submodule F K} (hT : T ≤ K4F B hB) (h1 : (1 : K) ∈ T)
    {β : K} (hβ : β ∈ K4 B hB) (hβ2 : β ∉ K2 B hB)
    (hinv : ∀ y ∈ T, β * y ∈ T) : K4F B hB ≤ T := by
  have hβT : β ∈ T := by simpa using hinv 1 h1
  have hββ : β * β ∈ T := hinv β hβT
  have hβF : β ∉ F := fun h => hβ2 (F_le_K2 B hB h)
  have hTle : Module.finrank F T ≤ 4 := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_mono hT
    rw [finrank_K4F] at this
    exact this
  have hP1 : Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K)) = 1 :=
    finrank_span_singleton one_ne_zero
  have hlt : Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K) < Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Submodule.span_mono (by simp)) ?_
    intro heq
    have hm : β ∈ Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hm
    rw [fsmul_eq, mul_one] at hc
    exact hβF (hc ▸ c.2)
  have hP2 : 2 ≤ Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K)) := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt
    omega
  have hP2T : Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) ≤ T := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with rfl | hw
    · exact h1
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hw]
      exact hβT
  by_cases hT4 : Module.finrank F T = 4
  · exact (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hT (hT4.trans (finrank_K4F B hB).symm)).ge
  by_cases hT3 : Module.finrank F T = 3
  · exfalso
    have hne : ¬ K4F B hB ≤ T := fun h => by
      have := Submodule.finrank_mono h
      rw [finrank_K4F] at this
      omega
    obtain ⟨y, hyK, hyT⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.1 hne
    have hlt' : T < T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne le_sup_left ?_
      intro h
      apply hyT
      rw [h]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self y)
    have hsup_le : T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) ≤ K4F B hB :=
      sup_le hT (by
        rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact hyK)
    have hfin : Module.finrank F ↥(T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K)) = 4 := by
      have h3 := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt'
      have h4 := Submodule.finrank_mono hsup_le
      rw [finrank_K4F] at h4
      omega
    have hsup : T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) = K4F B hB :=
      Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hsup_le (hfin.trans (finrank_K4F B hB).symm)
    have hβy : β * y ∈ T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) := by
      rw [hsup]
      exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem hβ hyK
    obtain ⟨p, hp, q', hq', hpq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hβy
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hq'
    rw [fsmul_eq] at hpq
    have key : ∀ w ∈ K4F B hB, (β - (c : K)) * w ∈ T := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hsup] at hw
      obtain ⟨t, ht, s, hs, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hw
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hs
      rw [fsmul_eq]
      have e : (β - (c : K)) * (t + (d : K) * y) =
          β * t + ((-c : F) : K) * t + (d : K) * p := by
        have hn : ((-c : F) : K) = -(c : K) := rfl
        rw [hn]
        linear_combination (d : K) * hpq.symm
      rw [e]
      have m2 : ((-c : F) : K) * t ∈ T := by
        rw [← fsmul_eq]
        exact T.smul_mem _ ht
      have m3 : (d : K) * p ∈ T := by
        rw [← fsmul_eq]
        exact T.smul_mem _ hp
      exact T.add_mem (T.add_mem (hinv t ht) m2) m3
    apply hne
    intro w hw
    have hβc : β - (c : K) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hβF
      rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h]
      exact c.2
    have hm : (β - (c : K))⁻¹ * w ∈ K4F B hB :=
      (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem hβ (F_le_K4 B hB c.2))) hw
    have := key _ hm
    rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hβc, one_mul] at this
  · exfalso
    have h2 : Module.finrank F T ≤ Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K)) := by
      have := Submodule.finrank_mono hP2T
      omega
    have heq : Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) = T :=
      Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hP2T h2
    have hm : β * β ∈ Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hββ
    exact hβ2 (mem_K2_of_quadratic B hB hm)

/-! ### One growth step -/

/-- `T + β·T`. -/
def stepT (T : Submodule F K) (β : K) : Submodule F K :=
  T ⊔ T.map (LinearMap.mulLeft F β)

/-- Indicator of `β ∉ S`, as a natural number. -/
def notIn (S : Subfield K) (β : K) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact if β ∈ S then 0 else 1

theorem notIn_of_not_mem {S : Subfield K} {β : K} (h : β ∉ S) : notIn S β = 1 := by
  unfold notIn
  rw [if_neg h]

/-- The growth invariant: `K₄ ⊆ T` or `n ≤ dim T`. -/
def Grow (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (T : Submodule F K) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  K4F B hB ≤ T ∨ n ≤ Module.finrank F T

theorem step_grow (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    {T : Submodule F K} (hT : T ≤ K4F B hB) (h1 : (1 : K) ∈ T)
    {β : K} (hβ : β ∈ K4 B hB) {n : ℕ} (hG : Grow B hB T n) :
    stepT T β ≤ K4F B hB ∧ (1 : K) ∈ stepT T β ∧
      Grow B hB (stepT T β) (n + notIn (K2 B hB) β) := by
  have hle : T ≤ stepT T β := le_sup_left
  have hT' : stepT T β ≤ K4F B hB := by
    refine sup_le hT ?_
    rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro y hy
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
    exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem hβ (hT hy)
  refine ⟨hT', hle h1, ?_⟩
  have hmono : Module.finrank F T ≤ Module.finrank F (stepT T β) := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  by_cases hb : β ∈ K2 B hB
  · have h0 : notIn (K2 B hB) β = 0 := by
      unfold notIn
      rw [if_pos hb]
    rw [h0, add_zero]
    rcases hG with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (h.trans hle)
    · exact Or.inr (h.trans hmono)
  · rw [notIn_of_not_mem hb]
    rcases hG with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (h.trans hle)
    · by_cases hinv : stepT T β ≤ T
      · left
        refine (K4F_le_of_invariant B hB hT h1 hβ hb ?_).trans hle
        intro y hy
        apply hinv
        exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hy)
      · right
        have hlt : T < stepT T β := lt_of_le_of_ne hle (fun h => hinv (by rw [← h]))
        have := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt
        omega

theorem grow_mono (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {T : Submodule F K}
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (hG : Grow B hB T n) : Grow B hB T m := by
  rcases hG with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (hmn.trans h)

end Field

/-! ### The prefix spans `Λ_j` -/

section Lambda
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- `Λ_j = span_F {eqPrefix(a, r, j) : r}`; the range is symbolic. -/
def Lambda (F : Subfield K) (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 10) : Submodule F K :=
  Submodule.span F (Set.range fun r : Fin 1024 => R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j)

/-- Extending a prefix by one bit multiplies by that bit's factor. -/
theorem eqPrefix_update (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) (r : Fin 1024) (b : Bool) :
    R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a (rowOf (Function.update (rowBits r) j.castSucc b)) j.succ =
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * bitFactor b (a j.castSucc) := by
  unfold R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix
  rw [rowBits_rowOf]
  have h : ∀ i : Fin 10,
      (if i.val < j.succ.val then
        bitFactor (Function.update (rowBits r) j.castSucc b i) (a i) else 1) =
      (if i.val < j.castSucc.val then bitFactor (rowBits r i) (a i) else 1) *
        (if i = j.castSucc then bitFactor b (a j.castSucc) else 1) := by
    intro i
    by_cases h1 : i = j.castSucc
    · subst h1
      have hlt : j.castSucc.val < j.succ.val := by
        rw [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
        omega
      rw [if_pos hlt, if_neg (lt_irrefl _), if_pos rfl, Function.update_self, one_mul]
    · rw [if_neg h1, mul_one, Function.update_of_ne h1]
      have hne : i.val ≠ j.val := fun h => h1 (Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.val_castSucc]; exact h))
      by_cases h2 : i.val < j.castSucc.val
      · rw [if_pos h2, if_pos]
        rw [Fin.val_succ]
        rw [Fin.val_castSucc] at h2
        omega
      · rw [if_neg h2, if_neg]
        rw [Fin.val_succ]
        rw [Fin.val_castSucc] at h2
        omega
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => h i), Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_ite_eq']
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

theorem bitFactor_true (x : K) : bitFactor true x = x := rfl
theorem bitFactor_false (x : K) : bitFactor false x = 1 - x := rfl

variable {F : Subfield K}

theorem eqPrefix_mem_succ (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) (r : Fin 1024) :
    R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc ∈ Lambda F a j.succ ∧
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * a j.castSucc ∈ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  have g (b : Bool) : R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a
      (rowOf (Function.update (rowBits r) j.castSucc b)) j.succ ∈ Lambda F a j.succ :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e1 := eqPrefix_update a j r true
  have e0 := eqPrefix_update a j r false
  rw [bitFactor_true] at e1
  rw [bitFactor_false] at e0
  have h1 := g true
  have h0 := g false
  rw [e1] at h1
  rw [e0] at h0
  refine ⟨?_, h1⟩
  have hs := Submodule.add_mem _ h1 h0
  have e : R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * a j.castSucc +
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * (1 - a j.castSucc) =
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc := by ring
  rw [e] at hs
  exact hs

theorem Lambda_le_succ (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) :
    Lambda F a j.castSucc ≤ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  rw [Lambda, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
  exact (eqPrefix_mem_succ a j r).1

theorem mul_mem_Lambda_succ (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) {x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ Lambda F a j.castSucc) : x * a j.castSucc ∈ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  have hle : Lambda F a j.castSucc ≤
      (Lambda F a j.succ).comap (LinearMap.mulRight F (a j.castSucc)) := by
    rw [Lambda, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulRight_apply]
    exact (eqPrefix_mem_succ a j r).2
  have := hle hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulRight_apply] at this
  exact this

theorem Lambda_mono (a : Fin 10 → K) {j k : Fin 10} (h : j ≤ k) :
    Lambda F a j ≤ Lambda F a k := by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k : Fin 10, k.val = j.val + n → Lambda F a j ≤ Lambda F a k := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk
      have hkj : k = j := Fin.ext (by omega)
      subst hkj
      exact le_rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk
      have hk9 : j.val + n < 9 := by omega
      let k' : Fin 9 := ⟨j.val + n, hk9⟩
      have h1 : k'.castSucc.val = j.val + n := rfl
      have h2 : k'.succ = k := Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.val_succ]; show j.val + n + 1 = k.val; omega)
      refine (ih k'.castSucc h1).trans ?_
      rw [← h2]
      exact Lambda_le_succ a k'
  exact key (k.val - j.val) k (by have := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp h; omega)

theorem one_mem_Lambda (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 10) : (1 : K) ∈ Lambda F a j := by
  have h0 : R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a 0 0 = 1 := by
    unfold R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix
    simp
  have hm : (1 : K) ∈ Lambda F a 0 := Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, h0⟩
  exact Lambda_mono a (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.2 (Nat.zero_le _)) hm

theorem alpha_mem_Lambda (a : Fin 10 → K) {i j : Fin 10} (h : i < j) :
    a i ∈ Lambda F a j := by
  have hi : i.val < 9 := by have := Fin.lt_def.mp h; have := j.isLt; omega
  let i' : Fin 9 := ⟨i.val, hi⟩
  have hc : i'.castSucc = i := Fin.ext rfl
  have h1 := mul_mem_Lambda_succ (F := F) a i' (one_mem_Lambda a i'.castSucc)
  rw [one_mul, hc] at h1
  refine Lambda_mono a ?_ h1
  rw [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val, Fin.val_succ]
  have := Fin.lt_def.mp h
  show i.val + 1 ≤ j.val
  omega

theorem Lambda_le_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (a : Fin 10 → K)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ K4 B hB) (j : Fin 10) : Lambda F a j ≤ K4F B hB := by
  rw [Lambda, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
  show R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j ∈ K4 B hB
  unfold R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix
  refine prod_mem (fun i _ => ?_)
  split_ifs
  · unfold bitFactor
    split_ifs
    · exact ha i
    · exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem (K4 B hB).one_mem (ha i)
  · exact (K4 B hB).one_mem

/-- One `Λ` step: `T ≤ Λ_j ⇒ T + a_j·T ≤ Λ_{j+1}`. -/
theorem stepT_le_Lambda (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) {T : Submodule F K}
    (hT : T ≤ Lambda F a j.castSucc) : stepT T (a j.castSucc) ≤ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  refine sup_le (hT.trans (Lambda_le_succ a j)) ?_
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro y hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_comm]
  exact mul_mem_Lambda_succ a j (hT hy)

/-! ### `Good₃` and `Λ₄ = K₄` -/

/-- `Good₃` as proposed in design §1.2 and kept by LOG D21.3/D23.3:
`Good`, every semantic challenge in `K₄`, and at least three of `α₀..α₃`
outside `K₂`. -/
def Good3 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  R0Z.Shift.Good ch ∧ (∀ i : Fin 25, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) ∧
    ∃ s : Finset (Fin 4), 3 ≤ s.card ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, alpha ch ⟨i.val, lt_trans i.isLt (by norm_num)⟩ ∉ K2 B hB

/-- Design lemma lambda4_eq_K4: on `Good₃`, `Λ_j = K₄` for every `j ≥ 4`. -/
theorem lambda4_eq_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hG : Good3 B hB ch) (j : Fin 10) (hj : 4 ≤ j.val) :
    Lambda F (alpha ch) j = K4F B hB := by
  obtain ⟨-, hsem, s, hs3, hs⟩ := hG
  have hα (k : Fin 10) : alpha ch k ∈ K4 B hB := hsem _
  apply le_antisymm (Lambda_le_K4F B hB _ hα j)
  -- count of α₀..α₃ outside K₂
  have hcount : 3 ≤ notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 0) + notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 1) +
      notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 2) + notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 3) := by
    have hsum : s.card ≤ ∑ i : Fin 4,
        notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch ⟨i.val, lt_trans i.isLt (by norm_num)⟩) := by
      calc s.card = ∑ _i ∈ s, (1 : ℕ) := by simp
        _ = ∑ i ∈ s,
            notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch ⟨i.val, lt_trans i.isLt (by norm_num)⟩) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => (notIn_of_not_mem (hs i hi)).symm)
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ s)
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hsum
    exact hs3.trans hsum
  -- the chain T₀ ≤ … ≤ T₄
  let T0 : Submodule F K := Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K)
  have hT0K : T0 ≤ K4F B hB := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact (K4 B hB).one_mem
  have hT01 : (1 : K) ∈ T0 := Submodule.subset_span rfl
  have hT0G : Grow B hB T0 1 := Or.inr (finrank_span_singleton one_ne_zero).ge
  have hT0L : T0 ≤ Lambda F (alpha ch) 0 := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact one_mem_Lambda _ _
  obtain ⟨hT1K, hT11, hT1G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT0K hT01 (hα 0) hT0G
  have hT1L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 0 hT0L
  obtain ⟨hT2K, hT21, hT2G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT1K hT11 (hα 1) hT1G
  have hT2L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 1 hT1L
  obtain ⟨hT3K, hT31, hT3G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT2K hT21 (hα 2) hT2G
  have hT3L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 2 hT2L
  obtain ⟨hT4K, -, hT4G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT3K hT31 (hα 3) hT3G
  have hT4L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 3 hT3L
  have hG4 := grow_mono B hB (m := 4) (by omega) hT4G
  have hK4 : K4F B hB ≤ Lambda F (alpha ch) ((3 : Fin 9).succ) := by
    rcases hG4 with h | h
    · exact h.trans hT4L
    · have he := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hT4K (by rw [finrank_K4F]; exact h)
      rw [← he]
      exact hT4L
  exact hK4.trans (Lambda_mono _ (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.2 (show 4 ≤ j.val from hj)))

end Lambda
