R0Z.HvzkV.text:
import R0Z.HonestValid

/-! J0c (LOG D40.3, route (a)): HVZK with a per-challenge valid-instance set,
and the abort composition with a witness-dependent bad event.

* `simV`: the simulator that, at each challenge, runs the honest view of SOME
  instance valid at that challenge (falling back to the plain simulator when
  none exists).  `HVZK_onV P h V` compares it with every instance valid at the
  challenge.
* `MaskImageOnV P h V`: both mask-image clauses on the per-challenge valid
  set; `hvzk_on_of_V` derives `HVZK_onV` from it through `hvzk_on_of` applied
  to the single-challenge restricted prover `h.restrict (V ch)`.
* The retrying honest prover accepts attempt coins with `P ∧ V(·, w)`
  (a pole fails the attempt); the simulator retries on the public `P` only.
  The two loops agree off `poleBad`: some attempt has `P ∧ ¬V(·, w)`
  (identical until bad).  `eventMass_exists_le`: that mass is at most
  `N · q` when one attempt's mass is at most `q`.
* `zkfs_of_hvzk_onV` and `zkfs_of_hvzk_onV_terms`: ZK_FS (with the
  per-challenge simulator) with error `ε_real + ε_ideal + ε_pole`, resp.
  `ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog + ε_pole`; the reduction bounds, the couplings and
  the per-attempt bad mass are hypotheses.

Generic in the batched layer and in `V`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.HvzkV
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Generic counting -/

theorem mean_sum {R ι : Type} [Fintype R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R → ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => ∑ k ∈ s, f k r) = ∑ k ∈ s, mean (f k) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_div]

theorem eventMass_mono {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) (h : ∀ s, E s → E' s) :
    eventMass E ≤ eventMass E' := by
  unfold eventMass
  apply mean_le_mean
  intro s
  by_cases hE : E s
  · rw [if_pos hE, if_pos (h s hE)]
  · rw [if_neg hE]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-- Union bound over the attempts of an independent tuple. -/
theorem eventMass_exists_le {C : Type} [Fintype C] [Nonempty C] {N : Nat} (E : C → Prop) (q : ℚ)
    (hq : eventMass E ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun c : Fin N → C => ∃ k, E (c k)) ≤ N * q := by
  unfold eventMass at hq ⊢
  refine (mean_le_mean _ (fun c : Fin N → C => ∑ k : Fin N, if E (c k) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
    (fun c => ?_)).trans ?_
  · split_ifs with h
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
      have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun j : Fin N => if E (c j) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ k)
      simpa only [if_pos hk] using hle
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  rw [mean_sum Finset.univ (fun k (c : Fin N → C) => if E (c k) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)]
  have he : ∀ k : Fin N, mean (fun c : Fin N → C => if E (c k) then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      mean (fun c : C => if E c then (1 : ℚ) else 0) :=
    fun k => mean_eval k (fun c : C => if E c then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  simp only [he, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (Nat.cast_nonneg N)

/-- An event of the first factor has its own mass on a product with a
nonempty second factor. -/
theorem eventMass_fst {C T : Type} [Fintype C] [Fintype T] [Nonempty T] (E : C → Prop) :
    eventMass (fun ct : C × T => E ct.1) = eventMass E := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product]
  apply congrArg mean
  funext c
  show mean (fun _ : T => if E c then (1 : ℚ) else 0) = _
  exact mean_const _

/-- `firstGood` depends only on the predicate along the tuple. -/
theorem firstGood_congr {C : Type} (Pd₁ Pd₂ : C → Prop) {N : Nat} (c : Fin N → C)
    (h : ∀ k, Pd₁ (c k) ↔ Pd₂ (c k)) : firstGood Pd₁ c = firstGood Pd₂ c := by
  rcases h1 : firstGood Pd₁ c with _ | k₁ <;> rcases h2 : firstGood Pd₂ c with _ | k₂
  · rfl
  · exact absurd ((h k₂).2 (firstGood_spec Pd₂ c k₂ h2)) (firstGood_none Pd₁ c h1 k₂)
  · exact absurd ((h k₁).1 (firstGood_spec Pd₁ c k₁ h1)) (firstGood_none Pd₂ c h2 k₁)
  · have a := firstGood_least Pd₁ c k₁ h1 k₂ ((h k₂).2 (firstGood_spec Pd₂ c k₂ h2))
    have b := firstGood_least Pd₂ c k₂ h2 k₁ ((h k₁).1 (firstGood_spec Pd₁ c k₁ h1))
    rw [le_antisymm a b]

/-! ### HVZK on a per-challenge valid set -/

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-- The per-challenge simulator: the honest view of an instance valid at `ch`. -/
def simV (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  if hch : ∃ w, V ch w ∧ h.public w = x.1 then view h B outputs x (Classical.choose hch) ch
  else simulator h B outputs x hx ch

/-- Perfect HVZK on `P` for the instances valid at each challenge. -/
def HVZK_onV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K), P ch → V ch w → h.public w = x.1 →
    EqualLaws (view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simV h B outputs x hx V ch)

/-- Both mask-image clauses on the per-challenge valid set. -/
def MaskImageOnV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  (∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w n, V ch w → h.public w = x.1 →
    sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((D12.A h.transport B ch).comp Partition.inlM)) ∧
  (∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w w', V ch w → V ch w' → h.public w = x.1 → h.public w' = x.1 →
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∈ LinearMap.range (D12.A h.transport B ch))

theorem maskImageOnV_mono (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V V' : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hVV : ∀ ch w, P ch → V ch w → V' ch w) :
    MaskImageOnV (Bat := Bat) P h V' B x → MaskImageOnV (Bat := Bat) P h V B x :=
  fun hm => ⟨fun ch hP w n hv hw => hm.1 ch hP w n (hVV ch w hP hv) hw,
    fun ch hP w w' hv hv' hw hw' => hm.2 ch hP w w' (hVV ch w hP hv) (hVV ch w' hP hv') hw hw'⟩

/-- At one challenge, the per-challenge clauses are `MaskImageOn` of the
restricted prover `h.restrict (V ch)`. -/
theorem maskImageOn_point (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hm : MaskImageOnV (Bat := Bat) P h V B x) (ch : Challenges K) (hP : P ch) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) (fun c => c = ch) (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h (V ch)) B x :=
  (R0Z.HonestValid.maskImageOn_restrict_iff h (V ch) (fun c => c = ch) B x).2
    ⟨fun c (hc : c = ch) w n hv hw => by subst hc; exact hm.1 c hP w n hv hw,
      fun c (hc : c = ch) w w' hv hv' hw hw' => by subst hc; exact hm.2 c hP w w' hv hv' hw hw'⟩

theorem view_restrict (h : HonestProver K) (V : h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    view (Bat := Bat) (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs x w ch =
      view h B outputs x w.1 ch := rfl

/-- `MaskImageOnV ⇒ HVZK_onV`. -/
theorem hvzk_on_of_V [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    MaskImageOnV (Bat := Bat) P h V B x → HVZK_onV (Bat := Bat) P h V B outputs x := by
  intro hm hx w ch hP hV hw
  have hch : ∃ w, V ch w ∧ h.public w = x.1 := ⟨w, hV, hw⟩
  have hH := hvzk_on_of (Bat := Bat) (fun c => c = ch) (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h (V ch))
    B outputs x (maskImageOn_point P h V B x hm ch hP)
  have hw' := Classical.choose_spec hch
  have hx' : InLanguage (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h (V ch)) x := ⟨⟨w, hV⟩, hw⟩
  have e1 := hH hx' ⟨w, hV⟩ ch rfl hw
  have e2 := hH hx' ⟨Classical.choose hch, hw'.1⟩ ch rfl hw'.2
  rw [view_restrict] at e1 e2
  unfold simV
  rw [dif_pos hch]
  intro v
  exact (e1 v).trans (e2 v).symm

/-! ### The retrying games with a witness-dependent failure -/

/-- The honest retrying prover: an attempt is accepted when `P` holds and the
instance is valid at the drawn challenge. -/
def middleRealAbortV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) :
    (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) → ℚ :=
  retryTest ab.N (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin) ∧ V (ab.draw adv x coin) w)
    (fun coin t => view h B outputs x w (ab.draw adv x coin) t)
    (fun c k v => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)))
    (fun c => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)))

/-- Hybrid: the honest acceptance rule, the per-challenge simulator. -/
def hybridAbortV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance) :
    (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) → ℚ :=
  retryTest ab.N (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin) ∧ V (ab.draw adv x coin) w)
    (fun coin t => simV h B outputs x hx V (ab.draw adv x coin) t)
    (fun c k v => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)))
    (fun c => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)))

/-- The simulator's retrying game: acceptance on the public `P` only. -/
def middleIdealAbortV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) :
    (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) → ℚ :=
  retryTest ab.N (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin))
    (fun coin t => simV h B outputs x hx V (ab.draw adv x coin) t)
    (fun c k v => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)))
    (fun c => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)))

/-- The witness-dependent bad event: some attempt has `P` but not validity. -/
def poleBad (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    {Adv : Type} (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat Adv) (adv : Adv)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (c : Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) : Prop :=
  ∃ k, P (ab.draw adv x (c k)) ∧ ¬ V (ab.draw adv x (c k)) w

/-- One attempt's bad event. -/
def attemptBad (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    {Adv : Type} (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat Adv) (adv : Adv)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (coin : ab.Coins) : Prop :=
  P (ab.draw adv x coin) ∧ ¬ V (ab.draw adv x coin) w

/-- The ideal test with the per-challenge simulator. -/
def idealTestV (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) : fs.IdealRand → ℚ :=
  fun r => bit (fs.observe adv (fs.ideal (simV h B outputs x hx V) adv x r))

/-- ZK_FS with the per-challenge simulator. -/
def ZK_FSV (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) - mean (idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ ε

section Games
variable (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
  (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
  (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle)

theorem real_hybrid_eq (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance) (hw : h.public w = x.1)
    (hh : HVZK_onV (Bat := Bat) P h V B outputs x) :
    mean (middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w) =
      mean (hybridAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx w) := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  exact retry_means_eq ab.N _ _ _ _ _
    (fun coin hc => hh hx w (ab.draw adv x coin) hc.1 hc.2 hw)

theorem hybrid_ideal_le (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance) :
    |mean (hybridAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx w) -
      mean (middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx)| ≤
      eventMass (fun ct : (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) =>
        poleBad P h V ab adv x w ct.1) := by
  have hbit : ∀ c k v, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ _ _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  have hfail : ∀ c, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  refine until_bad _ _ (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
    (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _) _ ?_
  intro ct hnb
  have hiff : ∀ k, (P (ab.draw adv x (ct.1 k)) ∧ V (ab.draw adv x (ct.1 k)) w) ↔
      P (ab.draw adv x (ct.1 k)) := by
    intro k
    refine ⟨fun hk => hk.1, fun hk => ⟨hk, ?_⟩⟩
    by_contra hv
    exact hnb ⟨k, hk, hv⟩
  have hfg := firstGood_congr (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin) ∧ V (ab.draw adv x coin) w)
    (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin)) ct.1 hiff
  simp only [hybridAbortV, middleIdealAbortV, retryTest, hfg]

/-- The bad mass over the attempts: at most `N` times one attempt's mass. -/
theorem poleBad_mass_le (w : h.Instance) (q : ℚ)
    (hq : eventMass (attemptBad P h V ab adv x w) ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun ct : (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) =>
      poleBad P h V ab adv x w ct.1) ≤ ab.N * q := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  rw [eventMass_fst (fun c : Fin ab.N → ab.Coins => poleBad P h V ab adv x w c)]
  exact eventMass_exists_le (attemptBad P h V ab adv x w) q hq

/-- The reduction certificate for the per-challenge games. -/
def AbortReductionV [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand] (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ ε_real ∧ 0 ≤ ε_ideal ∧
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) -
      mean (middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w)| ≤ ε_real ∧
    |mean (middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx) -
      mean (idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ ε_ideal

end Games

/-- Theorem A with the pole term. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_onV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_onV (Bat := Bat) P h V B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal ε_pole : ℚ)
    (hr : AbortReductionV P h V B outputs fs ab x ε_real ε_ideal)
    (hpole : ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      eventMass (fun ct : (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) =>
        poleBad P h V ab adv x w ct.1) ≤ ε_pole) :
    ZK_FSV h V B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal + ε_pole) := by
  intro hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨_, _, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hreal, hideal⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  have hmid := real_hybrid_eq P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx w hw hh
  have hbad := (hybrid_ideal_le P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx w).trans (hpole adv w hw)
  rw [hmid] at hreal
  have t1 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (hybridAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx w))
    (mean (middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx))
  have t2 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx))
    (mean (idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx))
  linarith

/-! ### The named oracle-programming terms -/

def RealAbortCouplingV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_hit ε_coll : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.RealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (Hit Coll : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ Hit s → ¬ Coll s →
        realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s) =
          middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s)) ∧
      eventMass Hit ≤ ε_hit ∧ eventMass Coll ≤ ε_coll

def IdealAbortCouplingV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_prog : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (Prog : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ Prog s →
        middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s) =
          idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s)) ∧
      eventMass Prog ≤ ε_prog

theorem abortReductionV_of_couplings (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog : ℚ)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ε_hit) (h1 : 0 ≤ ε_coll) (h2 : 0 ≤ ε_prog)
    (hreal : RealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ε_hit ε_coll)
    (hideal : IdealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ε_prog) :
    AbortReductionV P h V B outputs fs ab x (ε_hit + ε_coll) ε_prog := by
  refine ⟨by linarith, h2, ?_⟩
  intro hx adv w hw
  have hbit : ∀ c k v, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ _ _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  have hfail : ∀ c, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨cp, Hit, Coll, hag, hH, hC⟩ := hreal adv w hw
    rw [← cp.meanR (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w),
      ← cp.meanM (middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w)]
    have hb := until_bad (fun s => realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s))
      (fun s => middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s))
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
      (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
      (fun s => Hit s ∨ Coll s)
      (fun s hs => hag s (fun hh => hs (Or.inl hh)) (fun hh => hs (Or.inr hh)))
    have ho := eventMass_or_le Hit Coll
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨cp, Prog, hag, hP⟩ := hideal hx adv
    rw [← cp.meanR (idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx),
      ← cp.meanM (middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx)]
    have hb := until_bad (fun s => middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s))
      (fun s => idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s))
      (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
      Prog hag
    linarith

/-- Theorem B with the pole term: error `ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog + N·q`. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_onV_terms (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_onV (Bat := Bat) P h V B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog q : ℚ)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ε_hit) (h1 : 0 ≤ ε_coll) (h2 : 0 ≤ ε_prog)
    (hreal : RealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ε_hit ε_coll)
    (hideal : IdealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ε_prog)
    (hq : ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      eventMass (attemptBad P h V ab adv x w) ≤ q) :
    ZK_FSV h V B outputs fs x (ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog + ab.N * q) :=
  zkfs_of_hvzk_onV P h V B outputs fs x hh ab (ε_hit + ε_coll) ε_prog (ab.N * q)
    (abortReductionV_of_couplings P h V B outputs fs ab x ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog h0 h1 h2 hreal hideal)
    (fun adv w hw => poleBad_mass_le P h V fs ab adv x w q (hq adv w hw))

#print axioms eventMass_fst

#print axioms simV

R0Z.HvzkS.text:
import R0Z.HvzkV

/-! ZF2 (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §5.2): the J0c abort composition with
the simulator as a parameter.

`HvzkV` fixes the ideal side to the choice simulator `simV`.  Here the
simulator is any function `sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View`; its law is
compared with the honest view on `P ∧ V` (`HVZK_onS`), and ZK_FS is stated for
`fs.ideal sim` (`ZK_FSS`).  The real side (`middleRealAbortV`,
`RealAbortCouplingV`, `poleBad`, `attemptBad`) does not mention the simulator
and is reused from `HvzkV` unchanged.  The proofs are those of `HvzkV`
(`real_hybrid_eq`, `hybrid_ideal_le`, `abortReductionV_of_couplings`) with
`simV …` replaced by `sim`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.HvzkS
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-- Perfect HVZK on `P` for the instances valid at each challenge, against a
given simulator. -/
def HVZK_onS (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K), P ch → V ch w → h.public w = x.1 →
    EqualLaws (view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (sim ch)

/-- Hybrid: the honest acceptance rule, the given simulator. -/
def hybridAbortS (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) (w : h.Instance) :
    (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) → ℚ :=
  retryTest ab.N (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin) ∧ V (ab.draw adv x coin) w)
    (fun coin t => sim (ab.draw adv x coin) t)
    (fun c k v => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)))
    (fun c => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)))

/-- The simulator's retrying game: acceptance on the public `P` only. -/
def middleIdealAbortS (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) :
    (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) → ℚ :=
  retryTest ab.N (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin))
    (fun coin t => sim (ab.draw adv x coin) t)
    (fun c k v => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)))
    (fun c => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)))

/-- The ideal test with the given simulator. -/
def idealTestS (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) : fs.IdealRand → ℚ :=
  fun r => bit (fs.observe adv (fs.ideal sim adv x r))

/-- ZK_FS with the given simulator. -/
def ZK_FSS (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) (ε : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) - mean (idealTestS fs adv x sim)| ≤ ε

section Games
variable (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
  (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
  (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat)

theorem real_hybrid_eqS (w : h.Instance) (hw : h.public w = x.1)
    (hh : HVZK_onS P h V B outputs x sim) :
    mean (middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w) =
      mean (hybridAbortS P h V fs ab adv x sim w) := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  exact retry_means_eq ab.N _ _ _ _ _
    (fun coin hc => hh w (ab.draw adv x coin) hc.1 hc.2 hw)

theorem hybrid_ideal_leS (w : h.Instance) :
    |mean (hybridAbortS P h V fs ab adv x sim w) -
      mean (middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim)| ≤
      eventMass (fun ct : (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) =>
        poleBad P h V ab adv x w ct.1) := by
  have hbit : ∀ c k v, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ _ _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  have hfail : ∀ c, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  refine until_bad _ _ (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
    (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _) _ ?_
  intro ct hnb
  have hiff : ∀ k, (P (ab.draw adv x (ct.1 k)) ∧ V (ab.draw adv x (ct.1 k)) w) ↔
      P (ab.draw adv x (ct.1 k)) := by
    intro k
    refine ⟨fun hk => hk.1, fun hk => ⟨hk, ?_⟩⟩
    by_contra hv
    exact hnb ⟨k, hk, hv⟩
  have hfg := firstGood_congr (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin) ∧ V (ab.draw adv x coin) w)
    (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin)) ct.1 hiff
  simp only [hybridAbortS, middleIdealAbortS, retryTest, hfg]

end Games

/-- The ideal coupling for the given simulator (`IdealAbortCouplingV` with
`simV` replaced by `sim`). -/
def IdealAbortCouplingS (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) (ε_prog : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (Prog : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ Prog s →
        middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim (cp.toM s) = idealTestS fs adv x sim (cp.toR s)) ∧
      eventMass Prog ≤ ε_prog

/-- Theorem B with the pole term, for a given simulator:
error `ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog + N·q`. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_onS_terms (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat)
    (hh : HVZK_onS P h V B outputs x sim)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog q : ℚ)
    (hreal : RealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ε_hit ε_coll)
    (hideal : IdealAbortCouplingS P fs ab x sim ε_prog)
    (hq : ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      eventMass (attemptBad P h V ab adv x w) ≤ q) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs fs x sim (ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog + ab.N * q) := by
  intro adv w hw
  have hbit : ∀ c k v, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ _ _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  have hfail : ∀ c, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  -- real side
  have hR : |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) -
      mean (middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w)| ≤ ε_hit + ε_coll := by
    obtain ⟨cp, Hit, Coll, hag, hH, hC⟩ := hreal adv w hw
    rw [← cp.meanR (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w),
      ← cp.meanM (middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w)]
    have hb := until_bad (fun s => realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s))
      (fun s => middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s))
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
      (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
      (fun s => Hit s ∨ Coll s)
      (fun s hs => hag s (fun hh => hs (Or.inl hh)) (fun hh => hs (Or.inr hh)))
    have ho := eventMass_or_le Hit Coll
    linarith
  -- ideal side
  have hI : |mean (middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim) - mean (idealTestS fs adv x sim)| ≤ ε_prog := by
    obtain ⟨cp, Prog, hag, hP⟩ := hideal adv
    rw [← cp.meanR (idealTestS fs adv x sim), ← cp.meanM (middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim)]
    have hb := until_bad (fun s => middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim (cp.toM s))
      (fun s => idealTestS fs adv x sim (cp.toR s))
      (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
      Prog hag
    linarith
  have hmid := real_hybrid_eqS P h V B outputs fs ab adv x sim w hw hh
  have hbad := (hybrid_ideal_leS P h V fs ab adv x sim w).trans
    (poleBad_mass_le P h V fs ab adv x w q (hq adv w hw))
  rw [hmid] at hR
  have t1 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (hybridAbortS P h V fs ab adv x sim w))
    (mean (middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim))
  have t2 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim))
    (mean (idealTestS fs adv x sim))
  linarith

#print axioms HVZK_onS
#print axioms hybridAbortS
#print axioms middleIdealAbortS
#print axioms idealTestS
#print axioms ZK_FSS
#print axioms real_hybrid_eqS
#print axioms hybrid_ideal_leS
#print axioms IdealAbortCouplingS
#print axioms zkfs_of_hvzk_onS_terms
end R0Z.HvzkS

R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal.text:
import QueryScanExhaustion
import R0Z.HvzkS

/-! QueryScan's independent-word counting bound, sharpened before taking the
union over eight real and eight simulator attempts. Source/history transport
is deliberately a field of ScanCoupling, not inferred from classical ROM. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
open R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev scanProbability : ℚ := AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.probability (2^18) 64 21

theorem scan_probability_le : scanProbability ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
  have h := AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.probability_le
    (N := 2^18) (n := 64) (k := 21) (by positivity)
  have h21 : (21 : ℚ)^4 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^18 := by norm_num
  have hn : ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * (21 : ℚ)^64 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^666 := by
    calc _ = ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * ((21 : ℚ)^4)^16 := by rw [← pow_mul (21 : ℚ) 4 16]
         _ ≤ ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * ((2 : ℚ)^18)^16 := by gcongr
         _ = (2 : ℚ)^666 := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have hc : ((2^18 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)^18 := by norm_cast
  rw [hc] at h
  calc _ ≤ (2 : ℚ)^666 / ((2 : ℚ)^18)^64 :=
          h.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hn (by positivity))
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
          rw [← pow_mul, show 18*64 = 666+486 from rfl, pow_add]
          field_simp

/-- Each scan event is charged on a common finite coupling space. The mass
premise must hold for the actual reached histories, including repeated reads.
Agreement names the whole observation, so includes retry/failure publication.
No independence among the eight events is required. -/
structure ScanCoupling {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (source : R → ℚ) (model : M → ℚ) where
  cp : Coupling R M
  queryScan : Fin 8 → cp.S → Prop
  R_rom_query_word_history : ∀ i, eventMass (queryScan i) ≤ scanProbability
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, queryScan i s) →
    source (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)

theorem scan_coupling_le {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (f : R → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) (c : ScanCoupling f g)
    (hf : ∀ r, 0 ≤ f r ∧ f r ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ r, 0 ≤ g r ∧ g r ≤ 1) :
    |mean f - mean g| ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
  have hu : eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, c.queryScan i s) ≤
      ∑ i : Fin 8, eventMass (c.queryScan i) := by
    unfold eventMass
    rw [← mean_sum Finset.univ]
    apply mean_le_mean
    intro s
    by_cases he : ∃ i, c.queryScan i s
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := he
      rw [if_pos ⟨i, hi⟩]
      have h := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun j : Fin 8 => if c.queryScan j s then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simpa only [if_pos hi] using h
    · rw [if_neg he]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  have hs : (∑ i : Fin 8, eventMass (c.queryScan i)) ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 8, 1 / (2 : ℚ)^486 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => (c.R_rom_query_word_history i).trans scan_probability_le)
         _ = _ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [← c.cp.meanR f, ← c.cp.meanM g]
  exact (until_bad _ _ (fun s => hf _) (fun s => hg _) _
    c.R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan).trans (hu.trans hs)

/-- Both source handoffs together: 8 real + 8 ideal scans. -/
theorem query_error_le : (16 / (2 : ℚ)^486) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 := by
  rw [show (486 : ℕ) = 32 + 454 from rfl, pow_add]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
  have h : (16 : ℚ) ≤ 2^32 := by norm_num
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (by positivity : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 2^454)

#print axioms scan_probability_le
#print axioms scan_coupling_le
#print axioms query_error_le
end R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal

R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal

/-! Exact separation of the existing handoff. Removing the mass field alone
is unsound: arbitrary all-True exceptions erase the execution agreement.
A usable execution-only join must instead name fixed model events. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
open R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Literally ScanCoupling with only its probability field removed. -/
structure ScanExecution {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (source : R → ℚ) (model : M → ℚ) where
  cp : Coupling R M
  queryScan : Fin 8 → cp.S → Prop
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, queryScan i s) →
    source (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)

def ScanExecution.ProbabilityContent {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} (e : ScanExecution f g) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, eventMass (e.queryScan i) ≤ scanProbability

def forget {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} (c : ScanCoupling f g) : ScanExecution f g :=
  ⟨c.cp, c.queryScan, c.R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan⟩

def complete {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} (e : ScanExecution f g)
    (p : e.ProbabilityContent) : ScanCoupling f g :=
  ⟨e.cp, e.queryScan, p, e.R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan⟩

theorem exact_split {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (f : R → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) :
    Nonempty (ScanCoupling f g) ↔ ∃ e : ScanExecution f g, e.ProbabilityContent := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c⟩
    exact ⟨forget c, c.R_rom_query_word_history⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, p⟩
    exact ⟨complete e p⟩

/-- Every pair of observations admits an unbounded execution join whenever
its randomness carriers already admit a coupling. -/
def vacuousExecution {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (f : R → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) (cp : Coupling R M) : ScanExecution f g where
  cp := cp
  queryScan := fun _ _ => True
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan := by
    intro s hn
    exact False.elim (hn ⟨0, trivial⟩)

def unitCoupling : Coupling Unit Unit where
  S := Unit
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := id
  toM := id
  meanR := fun _ => rfl
  meanM := fun _ => rfl

theorem scanProbability_lt_one : scanProbability < 1 := by
  have h : (1 : ℚ) / 2^486 < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr
    exact one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  exact scan_probability_le.trans_lt h

/-- A compiled Boolean-observation counterexample, not just a bad event
chosen for an otherwise correct coupling. No bounded coupling can exist. -/
theorem zero_one_no_scanCoupling :
    ¬ Nonempty (ScanCoupling (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ))) := by
  rintro ⟨c⟩
  have h := scan_coupling_le _ _ c (fun _ => by norm_num) (fun _ => by norm_num)
  rw [mean_const, mean_const] at h
  have hsmall : (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr
    have hh : (8 : ℚ) < 2^4 := by norm_num
    exact hh.trans_le (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 4 ≤ 486))
  norm_num only [zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_one] at h
  linarith

theorem probability_not_execution_content :
    (∃ e : ScanExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)),
      ¬ e.ProbabilityContent) ∧
    ¬ (∀ e : ScanExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)),
      e.ProbabilityContent) := by
  have hn : ∀ e : ScanExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)),
      ¬ e.ProbabilityContent := by
    intro e hp
    exact zero_one_no_scanCoupling ⟨complete e hp⟩
  let e := vacuousExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)) unitCoupling
  exact ⟨⟨e, hn e⟩, fun hp => hn e (hp e)⟩

/-- The repair: exceptions are fixed model events, not arbitrary predicates
chosen by the source execution join. This structure has no mass fields. -/
structure ModelExecutionJoin {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (source : R → ℚ) (model : M → ℚ) (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop) where
  cp : Coupling R M
  agreement : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, bad i (cp.toM s)) → source (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)

def ModelExecutionJoin.toScanCoupling {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} {bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop}
    (e : ModelExecutionJoin f g bad)
    (modelLaw : ∀ i, eventMass (bad i) ≤ scanProbability) : ScanCoupling f g where
  cp := e.cp
  queryScan := fun i s => bad i (e.cp.toM s)
  R_rom_query_word_history := by
    intro i
    have ht := e.cp.meanM (fun m => if bad i m then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
    exact ht.le.trans (modelLaw i)
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan := e.agreement

#print axioms exact_split
#print axioms scanProbability_lt_one
#print axioms zero_one_no_scanCoupling
#print axioms probability_not_execution_content
#print axioms ModelExecutionJoin.toScanCoupling
end R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit

R0Z.FsAbortBounds.text:
import R0Z.LawTransport

/-! ZF1a/b (DESIGN-ZF1-COUPLINGS-R1 §5, §7): generic event-mass bounds for the
abort couplings. Everything here is over an arbitrary finite uniform space
`S`; nothing refers to the payload, the transcript or a concrete oracle.

* `mass` is the uniform mass of an event (the body of `FsAbort.eventMass`).
* union bounds over finite index sets (`mass_exists_le_card`);
* the conditioning step (`mass_cond_le`): if `S ≃ R × X`, an event `D` depends
  on `R` only and, for every `r` with `D`, the `X`-mass of `E` is at most `δ`,
  then `mass (D ∧ E) ≤ mass D * δ`;
* the first-read step (`hit_le`, `hitFresh_mass`): a read whose address does
  not move when a coordinate `u` moves, compared with an address that
  determines `u` (a designated field), agrees with probability `≤ 1/|U|`;
* the pair step (`pair_le`, `pairFresh_mass`) for prover-address collisions;
* the assembled events `HitEv` (charged reads hit by the adversary) and
  `CollEv` (address repetition among positions, at least one private), with
  `hitEv_mass_le : ≤ M*q/Umin` and `collEv_mass_le : ≤ M*M/Umin`.

The concrete facts (which coordinate is the designated field of which read,
and that the adversary's reads do not depend on it) are the hypotheses
`HitFresh` / `PairFresh`; they are source-correspondence facts about the R1
byte layout, not proved here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsAbortBounds
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Uniform means -/

theorem mean_equiv' {R S : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype S] (e : R ≃ S) (f : R → ℚ) :
    mean f = mean (fun s => f (e.symm s)) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv e f (fun s => f (e.symm s)) (fun r => by simp)

theorem mean_mono' {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, f r ≤ g r) :
    mean f ≤ mean g :=
  div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => h r)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_sum' {R ι : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype ι] (f : ι → R → ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => ∑ i, f i r) = ∑ i, mean (f i) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_div]

theorem mean_add'' {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => f r + g r) = mean f + mean g := by
  simp only [mean, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div]

theorem mean_mul_const {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) (c : ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => f r * c) = mean f * c := by
  unfold mean
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

theorem mean_const' {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] (c : ℚ) :
    mean (fun _ : R => c) = c := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have h : (Fintype.card R : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

/-! ### Event mass -/

/-- Uniform mass of an event; the same body as `FsAbort.eventMass`. -/
def mass {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun s => if E s then (1 : ℚ) else 0)

theorem ind_nonneg (p : Prop) : 0 ≤ (if p then (1 : ℚ) else 0) := by
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem ind_le_one (p : Prop) : (if p then (1 : ℚ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem mass_nonneg {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) : 0 ≤ mass E :=
  div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun s _ => ind_nonneg (E s))) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mass_le_one {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) : mass E ≤ 1 := by
  unfold mass mean
  apply div_le_one_of_le₀ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Finset.univ (fun s => if E s then (1 : ℚ) else 0) 1
    (fun s _ => ind_le_one (E s))
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hs

theorem mass_mono {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) (h : ∀ s, E s → E' s) :
    mass E ≤ mass E' := by
  apply mean_mono'
  intro s
  by_cases h1 : E s
  · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos (h s h1)]
  · rw [if_neg h1]
    exact ind_nonneg (E' s)

theorem mass_congr {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) (h : ∀ s, E s ↔ E' s) :
    mass E = mass E' :=
  le_antisymm (mass_mono E E' (fun s => (h s).mp)) (mass_mono E' E (fun s => (h s).mpr))

theorem mass_false {S : Type} [Fintype S] : mass (fun _ : S => False) = 0 := by
  simp [mass, mean]

theorem mass_true {S : Type} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S] : mass (fun _ : S => True) = 1 := by
  unfold mass
  simp only [if_true]
  exact mean_const' 1

theorem mass_or_le {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) :
    mass (fun s => E s ∨ E' s) ≤ mass E + mass E' := by
  unfold mass
  rw [← mean_add'']
  apply mean_mono'
  intro s
  by_cases h1 : E s <;> by_cases h2 : E' s <;> simp [h1, h2]

theorem mass_exists_le {S ι : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype ι] (E : ι → S → Prop) :
    mass (fun s => ∃ i, E i s) ≤ ∑ i, mass (E i) := by
  unfold mass
  rw [← mean_sum']
  apply mean_mono'
  intro s
  by_cases h : ∃ i, E i s
  · rw [if_pos h]
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    have hle : (if E i s then (1 : ℚ) else 0) ≤ ∑ j, (if E j s then (1 : ℚ) else 0) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => if E j s then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun j _ => ind_nonneg (E j s)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [if_pos hi] at hle
    exact hle
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => ind_nonneg (E j s))

/-- Union bound with a uniform per-index bound. -/
theorem mass_exists_le_card {S ι : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype ι] (E : ι → S → Prop) (δ : ℚ)
    (h : ∀ i, mass (E i) ≤ δ) :
    mass (fun s => ∃ i, E i s) ≤ Fintype.card ι * δ := by
  refine (mass_exists_le E).trans ?_
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Finset.univ (fun i => mass (E i)) δ (fun i _ => h i)
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] using hs

theorem mass_equiv {S T : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (e : S ≃ T) (E : S → Prop) :
    mass E = mass (fun t => E (e.symm t)) :=
  mean_equiv' e _

theorem mass_prod {R X : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype X] (E : R × X → Prop) :
    mass E = mean (fun r => mass (fun x => E (r, x))) :=
  LawTransport.mean_product _

/-- A single point of a finite uniform coordinate. -/
theorem mass_point {U : Type} [Fintype U] (u₀ : U) :
    mass (fun u => u = u₀) = 1 / Fintype.card U := by
  simp [mass, mean]

/-! ### Conditioning on the other coordinates -/

/-- If `S ≃ R × X`, `D` depends only on `R`, and on every `r` with `D` the
`X`-mass of `E` is at most `δ`, then `mass (D ∧ E) ≤ mass D * δ`. -/
theorem mass_cond_le {S R X : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype R] [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (e : S ≃ R × X) (D E : S → Prop) (δ : ℚ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hD : ∀ r x x', D (e.symm (r, x)) → D (e.symm (r, x')))
    (hE : ∀ r x₀, D (e.symm (r, x₀)) → mass (fun x => E (e.symm (r, x))) ≤ δ) :
    mass (fun s => D s ∧ E s) ≤ mass D * δ := by
  have hl : mass (fun s => D s ∧ E s) =
      mean (fun r => mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x)))) := by
    rw [mass_equiv e, mass_prod]
  have hr : mass D = mean (fun r => mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)))) := by
    rw [mass_equiv e, mass_prod]
  rw [hl, hr, ← mean_mul_const]
  apply mean_mono'
  intro r
  by_cases h : ∃ x₀, D (e.symm (r, x₀))
  · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := h
    have hall : ∀ x, D (e.symm (r, x)) := fun x => hD r x₀ x hx₀
    have h1 : mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x))) = 1 := by
      rw [mass_congr (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x))) (fun _ => True)
        (fun x => ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => hall x⟩)]
      exact mass_true
    have h2 : mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x))) =
        mass (fun x => E (e.symm (r, x))) :=
      mass_congr _ _ (fun x => ⟨fun hx => hx.2, fun hx => ⟨hall x, hx⟩⟩)
    rw [h1, h2, one_mul]
    exact hE r x₀ hx₀
  · have h0 : mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x))) = 0 := by
      rw [mass_congr (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x))) (fun _ => False)
        (fun x => ⟨fun hx => h ⟨x, hx.1⟩, fun hx => hx.elim⟩)]
      exact mass_false
    rw [h0]
    exact mul_nonneg (mass_nonneg _) hδ

/-! ### First read against a designated field -/

/-- On `D`, the read `qa` does not move with the coordinate `u`; the address
`ga` determines `u` (its designated field). Then they agree on `D` with mass
at most `mass D / |U|`. -/
theorem hit_le {S R U A : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype R] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (e : S ≃ R × U) (D : S → Prop) (qa ga : S → A) (π : R → A → U)
    (hD : ∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → D (e.symm (r, u')))
    (hq : ∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → qa (e.symm (r, u)) = qa (e.symm (r, u')))
    (hf : ∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a) :
    mass (fun s => D s ∧ qa s = ga s) ≤ mass D * (1 / Fintype.card U) := by
  apply mass_cond_le e D (fun s => qa s = ga s) (1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) (by positivity) hD
  intro r u₀ hu₀
  calc mass (fun u => qa (e.symm (r, u)) = ga (e.symm (r, u)))
      ≤ mass (fun u => u = π r (qa (e.symm (r, u₀)))) := by
        apply mass_mono
        intro u hu
        exact hf r u _ (hu.symm.trans (hq r u₀ u hu₀).symm)
    _ = 1 / Fintype.card U := mass_point _

/-- Collision of an address that does not move with `u` and one whose designated
field is `u`. -/
theorem pair_le {S R U A : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype R] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (e : S ≃ R × U) (fa ga : S → A) (π : R → A → U)
    (hfa : ∀ r u u', fa (e.symm (r, u)) = fa (e.symm (r, u')))
    (hf : ∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a) :
    mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Fintype.card U := by
  have h := hit_le e (fun _ => True) fa ga π (fun _ _ _ _ => trivial)
    (fun r u u' _ => hfa r u u') hf
  calc mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) = mass (fun s => True ∧ fa s = ga s) :=
        mass_congr _ _ (fun s => ⟨fun hs => ⟨trivial, hs⟩, fun hs => hs.2⟩)
    _ ≤ mass (fun _ : S => True) * (1 / Fintype.card U) := h
    _ ≤ 1 * (1 / Fintype.card U) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mass_le_one _) (by positivity)
    _ = 1 / Fintype.card U := one_mul _

/-! ### The named freshness hypotheses -/

/-- Hit freshness of a charged read: there is a coordinate `u` of the coupling
space, of at least `Umin` values, that is the designated field of `ga`, while
the charging event `D` and the adversary read `qa` (on `D`) do not depend on it. -/
def HitFresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (D : S → Prop) (qa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (R U : Type) (_ : Fintype R) (_ : Fintype U) (_ : Nonempty U) (e : S ≃ R × U)
    (π : R → A → U),
    Umin ≤ Fintype.card U ∧
    (∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → D (e.symm (r, u'))) ∧
    (∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → qa (e.symm (r, u)) = qa (e.symm (r, u'))) ∧
    (∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a)

/-- Pair freshness: the two addresses never coincide (structurally distinct), or
the second has a designated field on which the first does not depend. -/
def PairFresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (fa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ s, fa s ≠ ga s) ∨
  ∃ (R U : Type) (_ : Fintype R) (_ : Fintype U) (_ : Nonempty U) (e : S ≃ R × U)
    (π : R → A → U),
    Umin ≤ Fintype.card U ∧
    (∀ r u u', fa (e.symm (r, u)) = fa (e.symm (r, u'))) ∧
    (∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a)

theorem one_div_card_le {U : Type} [Fintype U] (Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hc : Umin ≤ Fintype.card U) : (1 : ℚ) / Fintype.card U ≤ 1 / Umin :=
  one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hU) (by exact_mod_cast hc)

theorem hitFresh_mass {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (D : S → Prop) (qa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < Umin) (hF : HitFresh D qa ga Umin) :
    mass (fun s => D s ∧ qa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Umin := by
  obtain ⟨R, U, iR, iU, hne, e, π, hcard, hD, hq, hf⟩ := hF
  calc mass (fun s => D s ∧ qa s = ga s) ≤ mass D * (1 / Fintype.card U) :=
        hit_le e D qa ga π hD hq hf
    _ ≤ 1 * (1 / Fintype.card U) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mass_le_one D) (by positivity)
    _ = 1 / Fintype.card U := one_mul _
    _ ≤ 1 / Umin := one_div_card_le Umin hU hcard

theorem pairFresh_mass_one {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (fa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < Umin) (hF : PairFresh fa ga Umin) :
    mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Umin := by
  rcases hF with hne | ⟨R, U, iR, iU, hn, e, π, hcard, hfa, hf⟩
  · calc mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ mass (fun _ : S => False) :=
          mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => hne s hs)
      _ = 0 := mass_false
      _ ≤ 1 / Umin := by positivity
  · exact (pair_le e fa ga π hfa hf).trans (one_div_card_le Umin hU hcard)

theorem pairFresh_mass {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (fa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < Umin) (hF : PairFresh fa ga Umin ∨ PairFresh ga fa Umin) :
    mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Umin := by
  rcases hF with h | h
  · exact pairFresh_mass_one fa ga Umin hU h
  · rw [mass_congr (fun s => fa s = ga s) (fun s => ga s = fa s) (fun s => eq_comm)]
    exact pairFresh_mass_one ga fa Umin hU h

/-! ### The assembled events -/

/-- Some charged prover position (a discarded attempt's read, or an unpublished
read of the accepted attempt) is read by the adversary. -/
def HitEv {S A : Type} (M q : ℕ) (charged : Fin M → S → Prop) (qry : Fin q → S → A)
    (addr : Fin M → S → A) (s : S) : Prop :=
  ∃ j i, charged j s ∧ qry i s = addr j s

/-- Two prover positions, at least one private, have the same address. -/
def CollEv {S A : Type} (M : ℕ) (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → S → A) (s : S) : Prop :=
  ∃ j j', j < j' ∧ (priv j ∨ priv j') ∧ addr j s = addr j' s

/-- First-read union bound: `M` positions, `q` adversary reads. -/
theorem hitEv_mass_le {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M q : ℕ) (charged : Fin M → S → Prop)
    (qry : Fin q → S → A) (addr : Fin M → S → A) (δ : ℚ)
    (h : ∀ j i, mass (fun s => charged j s ∧ qry i s = addr j s) ≤ δ) :
    mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr) ≤ M * q * δ := by
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card (ι := Fin M × Fin q)
    (fun p s => charged p.1 s ∧ qry p.2 s = addr p.1 s) δ (fun p => h p.1 p.2)
  calc mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr)
      ≤ mass (fun s => ∃ p : Fin M × Fin q, charged p.1 s ∧ qry p.2 s = addr p.1 s) :=
        mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => by
          obtain ⟨j, i, hji⟩ := hs
          exact ⟨(j, i), hji⟩)
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (Fin M × Fin q) * δ := hu
    _ = M * q * δ := by
        rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
        push_cast
        ring

/-- Pair union bound over the ordered pairs of `M` positions. -/
theorem collEv_mass_le {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M : ℕ) (priv : Fin M → Prop)
    (addr : Fin M → S → A) (δ : ℚ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h : ∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') → mass (fun s => addr j s = addr j' s) ≤ δ) :
    mass (CollEv M priv addr) ≤ M * M * δ := by
  have hp : ∀ p : Fin M × Fin M,
      mass (fun s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) ≤ δ := by
    intro p
    by_cases hc : p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2)
    · calc mass (fun s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s)
          ≤ mass (fun s => addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) := mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => hs.2.2)
        _ ≤ δ := h p.1 p.2 hc.1 hc.2
    · calc mass (fun s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s)
          ≤ mass (fun _ : S => False) := mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => hc ⟨hs.1, hs.2.1⟩)
        _ = 0 := mass_false
        _ ≤ δ := hδ
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card (ι := Fin M × Fin M)
    (fun p s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) δ hp
  calc mass (CollEv M priv addr)
      ≤ mass (fun s => ∃ p : Fin M × Fin M,
          p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) :=
        mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => by
          obtain ⟨j, j', hjj⟩ := hs
          exact ⟨(j, j'), hjj⟩)
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (Fin M × Fin M) * δ := hu
    _ = M * M * δ := by
        rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
        push_cast
        ring

/-- `HitEv` under per-read hit freshness. -/
theorem hitEv_mass_fresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M q Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (charged : Fin M → S → Prop) (qry : Fin q → S → A) (addr : Fin M → S → A)
    (hF : ∀ j i, HitFresh (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin) :
    mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr) ≤ M * q / Umin := by
  have h := hitEv_mass_le M q charged qry addr (1 / Umin)
    (fun j i => hitFresh_mass (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin hU (hF j i))
  calc mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr) ≤ M * q * (1 / Umin) := h
    _ = M * q / Umin := by ring

/-- `CollEv` under pair freshness of every private-involving pair. -/
theorem collEv_mass_fresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → S → A)
    (hF : ∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
      PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨ PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin) :
    mass (CollEv M priv addr) ≤ M * M / Umin := by
  have h := collEv_mass_le M priv addr (1 / Umin) (by positivity)
    (fun j j' hj hp => pairFresh_mass (addr j) (addr j') Umin hU (hF j j' hj hp))
  calc mass (CollEv M priv addr) ≤ M * M * (1 / Umin) := h
    _ = M * M / Umin := by ring

#print axioms mean_equiv'
#print axioms mean_sum'
#print axioms mean_mul_const
#print axioms mass_nonneg
#print axioms mass_le_one
