R0Z.FsAbortR1.text:
import R0Z.FsAbort
import R0Z.FsAbortBounds

/-! ZF1a/b on R1 (DESIGN-ZF1-COUPLINGS-R1 §3–§8). The abort couplings of
`FsAbort` (`RealAbortCoupling`, `IdealAbortCoupling`) for the retrying R1
prover, with the charged events made concrete as address events over the
coupling space:

* `Hit`  := `HitEv`: some charged prover read (any read of a discarded
  attempt, or an unpublished read of the accepted attempt) is read by the
  adversary;
* `Coll` := `CollEv ∨ exh`: two prover reads, at least one private, have the
  same address, or a mask limb exhausted its 16 rejection tries;
* `Prog` := `CollEv` on the ideal coupling space (two programmed reads with
  the same address).

`R1RealModel` / `R1IdealModel` bundle the named hypotheses: the couplings
themselves (the lazy-programming law), agreement of the games outside the
events (protocol refinement of the Rust prover to the Lean view), the
per-read freshness facts `HitFresh` / `PairFresh` (the designated fields of
the R1 byte layout), and the exhaustion mass. From them the event masses are
PROVED (`FsAbortBounds`), giving ZK_FS with error
`M*q/Umin + (M*M/Umin + εexh) + Mi*Mi/Umin`, and `≤ 2^-166` at N = 8
(`M = Mi = 8 * 2^21` positions), `q = 2^64`, `Umin = 2^255`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsAbortR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- `FsAbort.eventMass` and `FsAbortBounds.mass` are the same constant body. -/
theorem eventMass_eq_mass {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) :
    eventMass E = FsAbortBounds.mass E := rfl

/-! ### R1 read counts (design §1.1, §1.5; source counts, not instrumented) -/

/-- init + rows 0..26 (absorb, squeeze, advance) + reseed + rows 27..30 +
row 31 (absorb and eight squeeze/advance pairs) + row 32. -/
def r1TranscriptReads : ℕ := 1 + 27 * 3 + 1 + 4 * 3 + (1 + 16) + 3

theorem r1TranscriptReads_eq : r1TranscriptReads = 115 := by
  norm_num [r1TranscriptReads]

/-- Per-attempt reads: salts, leaves, 8-ary nodes (C1, C2, folded), expander
blocks (worst case), transcript, seeds/binding/context. -/
def r1AttemptReadBound : ℕ :=
  (2 * 2 ^ 18 + 2 ^ 16) + (2 * 2 ^ 18 + 2 ^ 16) + (2 * 2 ^ 18 / 7 + 2 ^ 16) + 2 ^ 18 +
    r1TranscriptReads + 64

theorem r1AttemptReadBound_le : r1AttemptReadBound ≤ 2 ^ 21 := by
  norm_num [r1AttemptReadBound, r1TranscriptReads]

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### The real coupling (Hit, Coll) -/

/-- Named hypotheses of the R1 real coupling, for every adversary and witness:
a coupling `cp` of the real randomness with the abort-middle coins (HYP:
lazy-programming law); `M` prover positions with addresses `addr`, a static
`priv` flag and a charging event; `q` adversary reads `qry`; agreement of
`realTest` and `middleRealAbort` outside `HitEv ∨ (CollEv ∨ exh)` (HYP:
refinement); `HitFresh` for every charged position and read, `PairFresh` for
every private-involving pair (HYP: R1 byte layout, design §1.4); and the
exhaustion mass. -/
def R1RealModel (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.RealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (charged : Fin M → cp.S → Prop) (priv : Fin M → Prop)
      (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes) (qry : Fin q → cp.S → Bytes) (exh : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr s →
          ¬ (FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s) →
        realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s) =
          middleRealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s)) ∧
      (∀ j i, FsAbortBounds.HitFresh (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin) ∧
      FsAbortBounds.mass exh ≤ εexh

omit [DecidableEq K] in
theorem realAbortCoupling_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1RealModel P h B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh) :
    RealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin)
      ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) := by
  intro adv w hw
  obtain ⟨cp, charged, priv, addr, qry, exh, hag, hhit, hpair, hexh⟩ := hm adv w hw
  refine ⟨cp, FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr,
    fun s => FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s, hag, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [eventMass_eq_mass]
    exact FsAbortBounds.hitEv_mass_fresh M q Umin hU charged qry addr hhit
  · rw [eventMass_eq_mass]
    calc FsAbortBounds.mass (fun s => FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s)
        ≤ FsAbortBounds.mass (FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr) + FsAbortBounds.mass exh :=
          FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _
      _ ≤ (M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh :=
          add_le_add (FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair) hexh

/-! ### The ideal coupling (Prog) -/

/-- Named hypotheses of the R1 ideal coupling: a coupling of the ideal
randomness with the abort-middle coins (HYP), `M` programmed positions,
agreement outside `CollEv` (HYP), and `PairFresh` for private-involving pairs. -/
def R1IdealModel (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes),
      (∀ s, ¬ FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s →
        middleIdealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s) =
          idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s)) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin)

omit [DecidableEq K] in
theorem idealAbortCoupling_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1IdealModel P h B outputs fs ab x M Umin) :
    IdealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin) := by
  intro hx adv
  obtain ⟨cp, priv, addr, hag, hpair⟩ := hm hx adv
  refine ⟨cp, FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr, hag, ?_⟩
  rw [eventMass_eq_mass]
  exact FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair

/-! ### Composition and the numbers -/

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] in
theorem zkfs_mono (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε ε' : ℚ)
    (hz : ZK_FS h B outputs fs x ε) (hle : ε ≤ ε') : ZK_FS h B outputs fs x ε' :=
  fun hx adv w hw => (hz hx adv w hw).trans hle

/-- ZK_FS for the retrying R1 prover from HVZK on `P` and the two R1 models. -/
theorem zkfs_R1_abort (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (M Mi q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin) (he : 0 ≤ εexh)
    (hr : R1RealModel P h B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh)
    (hi : R1IdealModel P h B outputs fs ab x Mi Umin) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x
      ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin + ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) + (Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin) :=
  zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort_terms P h B outputs fs x hh ab
    ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin) ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) ((Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin)
    (by positivity) (add_nonneg (by positivity) he) (by positivity)
    (realAbortCoupling_of_R1 P h B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh hU hr)
    (idealAbortCoupling_of_R1 P h B outputs fs ab x Mi Umin hU hi)

/-- N = 8 attempts of at most 2^21 reads, q = 2^64 adversary reads, designated
fields of at least 2^255 values; the exhaustion slot is 2^-250, a loose upper
bound of 8 · 2^17 limbs · 2^-496 (design §5.4). -/
theorem r1_error_N8 :
    ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((2 ^ 64 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (1 / 2 ^ 250 : ℚ)) +
      ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
    1 / 2 ^ 166 := by
  norm_num

theorem zkfs_R1_abort_N8 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (hr : R1RealModel P h B outputs fs ab x (8 * 2 ^ 21) (2 ^ 64) (2 ^ 255)
      (1 / 2 ^ 250))
    (hi : R1IdealModel P h B outputs fs ab x (8 * 2 ^ 21) (2 ^ 255)) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (1 / 2 ^ 166) :=
  zkfs_mono h B outputs fs x _ _
    (zkfs_R1_abort P h B outputs fs x hh ab (8 * 2 ^ 21) (8 * 2 ^ 21) (2 ^ 64) (2 ^ 255)
      (1 / 2 ^ 250) (by positivity) (by positivity) hr hi)
    r1_error_N8

#print axioms eventMass_eq_mass
#print axioms r1TranscriptReads_eq
#print axioms r1AttemptReadBound_le
#print axioms R1RealModel
#print axioms realAbortCoupling_of_R1
#print axioms R1IdealModel
#print axioms idealAbortCoupling_of_R1
#print axioms zkfs_mono
#print axioms zkfs_R1_abort
#print axioms r1_error_N8
#print axioms zkfs_R1_abort_N8
end R0Z.FsAbortR1

R1.RepeatedLift.text:
import Wide.FinalEncoder
import Wide.MatchedInstances
import AspisFormal.CircleNaturalBasisEval
import AspisFormal.V5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity
import AspisFormal.V5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability
import AspisFormal.V5FriExactLineDomains
import AspisFormal.V5FriReleasedLineGeometry
import AspisFormal.V5FriBitReverse
import AspisFormal.V5FriNaturalBasisRadix4
import AspisFormal.V7ExactOneFoldDomains

/-! L1: repeated-lift encoder identities for the second fold.
The natural-basis lift retains precisely the coefficient indices divisible
by four. All line-domain and support arguments remain symbolic. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.RepeatedLift
open Polynomial Polynomial.Chebyshev
open AspisCircleGroupOrder (g g_pow_2_31)
open AspisCircleTensorBinding
open AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity
open AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation
open AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability
open AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4
open AspisV5FriBitReverse AspisV5FriReleasedLineGeometry
open AspisV5FriExactLineDomains AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains
open AspisV6OneFoldCandidateExtraction AspisWide.FinalEncoder

/-- Multiplying the basis index by four shifts its selected bits by two. -/
theorem naturalLinePoly_four_mul {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (d : ℕ) :
    naturalLinePoly K (4 * d) = (naturalLinePoly K d).comp (T K 4) := by
  simp only [naturalLinePoly, show 4 * d = 2 ^ 2 * d by omega,
    Nat.bitIndices_two_pow_mul]
  rw [Polynomial.prod_comp]
  rw [show (d.bitIndices.map (fun bit => bit + 2)).toFinset =
      d.bitIndices.toFinset.image (fun bit => bit + 2) by
        ext bit
        simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_image]]
  rw [Finset.prod_image]
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro bit _
    simpa [pow_add] using (T_mul K (2 ^ bit : ℤ) 4)
  · intro left _ right _ equal
    exact Nat.add_right_cancel equal

abbrev SecondCoefficients (K : Type*) := Fin 64 → K
abbrev SecondWord (K : Type*) := Fin 65536 → K

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- Place the second-fold coefficients in slots divisible by four. -/
def liftCoefficients : SecondCoefficients K →ₗ[K] FinalCoefficients K where
  toFun m k := if 4 ∣ k.val then m (parentIndex k) else 0
  map_add' := by
    intro m n
    funext k
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  map_smul' := by
    intro c m
    funext k
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp

/-- Retain the coefficient slots divisible by four. -/
def projectCoefficients : FinalCoefficients K →ₗ[K] FinalCoefficients K where
  toFun a k := if 4 ∣ k.val then a k else 0
  map_add' := by
    intro a b
    funext k
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  map_smul' := by
    intro c a
    funext k
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp

/-- Evaluate 64 natural coefficients on the stored log-16 line domain. -/
def secondLinear : SecondCoefficients K →ₗ[K] SecondWord K where
  toFun m v := (naturalCoefficientPolynomial m).eval
    (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedLine16X v))
  map_add' := by
    intro m n
    funext v
    change (naturalCoefficientPolynomial (m + n)).eval _ =
      (naturalCoefficientPolynomial m).eval _ + (naturalCoefficientPolynomial n).eval _
    rw [naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by norm_num),
      naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by norm_num),
      naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by norm_num)]
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  map_smul' := by
    intro c m
    funext v
    change (naturalCoefficientPolynomial (c • m)).eval _ =
      c * (naturalCoefficientPolynomial m).eval _
    rw [naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by norm_num),
      naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by norm_num)]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

/-- Repeat a parent value on its four stored children. -/
def repeatWord (word : SecondWord K) : FinalWord K :=
  fun k => word (parentIndex k)

/-- Average the four stored children of each parent. -/
def quartetAverage (word : FinalWord K) : SecondWord K :=
  fun v => (∑ s : Fin 4, word (childIndex v s)) / 4

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
@[simp] theorem liftCoefficients_child (m : SecondCoefficients K) (d : Fin 64)
    (s : Fin 4) :
    liftCoefficients m (childIndex d s) = if s = 0 then m d else 0 := by
  have hd : 4 ∣ (childIndex d s).val ↔ s = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
    simp only [childIndex_val]
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_zero]
      omega
    · intro h
      subst s
      simp
  change (if 4 ∣ (childIndex d s).val then m (parentIndex (childIndex d s)) else 0) = _
  simp only [hd, parentIndex_childIndex]

/-- The coefficient lift is composition by the fourth Chebyshev polynomial. -/
theorem naturalCoefficientPolynomial_lift (m : SecondCoefficients K) :
    naturalCoefficientPolynomial (liftCoefficients m) =
      (naturalCoefficientPolynomial m).comp (T K 4) := by
  rw [naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eq_basisSum (by norm_num),
    naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eq_basisSum (by norm_num)]
  rw [← (fibreIndexEquiv 64).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [fibreIndexEquiv_apply, liftCoefficients_child]
  rw [Polynomial.sum_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  simp only [ite_true, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceEq, ite_false,
    map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, childIndex_val, add_zero,
    Polynomial.mul_comp, Polynomial.C_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.C (m d) * p) (naturalLinePoly_four_mul (K := K) d.val)

/-- The two reversed slot bits contribute a quarter-turn exponent. -/
theorem line18Point_child_exp (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) :
    line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v s)) =
      g ^ ((2048 + 8192 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) +
        (2 : ℤ) ^ 29 * (reverseBits 2 s.val : ℤ)) := by
  unfold line18Point reverseFin
  simp only [childIndex_val]
  rw [show reverseBits 18 (4 * v.val + s.val) =
      reverseBits 16 v.val + 65536 * reverseBits 2 s.val by
    simpa using reverseBits_childIndex 16 v.val s]
  apply congrArg (fun exponent : ℤ => g ^ exponent)
  push_cast
  ring

/-- The fourth power of each stored child point is its stored log-16 parent. -/
theorem line18Point_child_pow_four (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) :
    line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v s)) ^ 4 =
      line16Point (reverseFin 16 v) := by
  rw [line18Point_child_exp, line16Point, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
  change g ^ (((2048 + 8192 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) +
      (2 : ℤ) ^ 29 * (reverseBits 2 s.val : ℤ)) * 4) =
    g ^ (8192 + 32768 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ))
  rw [show ((2048 + 8192 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) +
      (2 : ℤ) ^ 29 * (reverseBits 2 s.val : ℤ)) * 4 =
      (8192 + 32768 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) +
        ((2 ^ 31 : ℕ) : ℤ) * (reverseBits 2 s.val : ℤ) by norm_num; ring]
  have horder : g ^ ((2 ^ 31 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1 := by
    rw [zpow_natCast]
    exact g_pow_2_31
  rw [zpow_add, zpow_mul, horder, one_zpow, mul_one]

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] in
/-- Two coordinate doublings identify the embedded parent node. -/
theorem storedFirstLineX18_child_T4 (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) :
    doubledFactor
        (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v s))) 2 =
      algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedLine16X v) := by
  have hx := congrArg AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (line18Point_child_pow_four v s)
  rw [X_pow_four] at hx
  have hm := congrArg (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K) hx
  simpa only [doubledFactor, storedFirstLineX18, line18X,
    storedLine16X, storedLine16Point, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_ofNat, map_one] using hm

/-- The lifted 256-coefficient encoding repeats the 64-coefficient encoding. -/
theorem exactFinalLinear_lift (m : SecondCoefficients K) (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) :
    exactFinalLinear (liftCoefficients m) (childIndex v s) = secondLinear m v := by
  have hcheb : doubledFactor
      (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v s))) 2 =
      (T K 4).eval
        (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v s))) := by
    simpa using doubledFactor_eq_chebyshev
      (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v s))) 2
  rw [exactFinalLinear_apply, naturalCoefficientPolynomial_lift, Polynomial.eval_comp,
    ← hcheb, storedFirstLineX18_child_T4]
  rfl

/-- Stored slots zero and one differ by the generator's half-turn. -/
theorem storedFirstLineX18_slot1 (v : Fin 65536) :
    storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v 1) = -storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v 0) := by
  change AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v 1))) =
    -AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v 0)))
  rw [line18Point_child_exp, line18Point_child_exp]
  rw [show reverseBits 2 (1 : Fin 4).val = 2 by rfl,
    show reverseBits 2 (0 : Fin 4).val = 0 by rfl]
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rw [show (2 : ℤ) ^ 29 * 2 = (2 : ℤ) ^ 30 by norm_num]
  exact X_zpow_add_halfTurn _

/-- Stored slots two and three differ by the same half-turn. -/
theorem storedFirstLineX18_slot3 (v : Fin 65536) :
    storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v 3) = -storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v 2) := by
  change AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v 3))) =
    -AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v 2)))
  rw [line18Point_child_exp, line18Point_child_exp]
  rw [show reverseBits 2 (3 : Fin 4).val = 3 by rfl,
    show reverseBits 2 (2 : Fin 4).val = 1 by rfl]
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
  rw [show (2048 + 8192 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) + (2 : ℤ) ^ 29 * 3 =
      ((2048 + 8192 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) + (2 : ℤ) ^ 29) +
        (2 : ℤ) ^ 30 by ring]
  exact X_zpow_add_halfTurn _

/-- Symbolic coordinate doubling, before specializing any concrete generator. -/
theorem doubledFactor_X_sq (p : AspisCircleGroupOrder.C) :
    doubledFactor (AspisCircleGroupOrder.X p) 1 = AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (p ^ 2) :=
  (X_sq p).symm

/-- Squaring the quarter-turn becomes a half-turn, negating the first doubling. -/
theorem storedFirstLineX18_slot2_T2 (v : Fin 65536) :
    doubledFactor (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v 2)) 1 =
      -doubledFactor (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v 0)) 1 := by
  change doubledFactor (AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v 2)))) 1 =
    -doubledFactor (AspisCircleGroupOrder.X (line18Point (reverseFin 18 (childIndex v 0)))) 1
  rw [doubledFactor_X_sq, doubledFactor_X_sq, line18Point_child_exp, line18Point_child_exp]
  rw [show reverseBits 2 (2 : Fin 4).val = 1 by rfl,
    show reverseBits 2 (0 : Fin 4).val = 0 by rfl]
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hsquare (e : ℤ) : (g ^ e) ^ 2 = g ^ (e * 2) := by
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
    rfl
  rw [hsquare, hsquare]
  rw [show ((2048 + 8192 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) + (2 : ℤ) ^ 29) * 2 =
      (2048 + 8192 * (reverseBits 16 v.val : ℤ)) * 2 + (2 : ℤ) ^ 30 by ring]
  exact X_zpow_add_halfTurn _

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
/-- Projection is the lift of the zero coefficient lane. -/
theorem projectCoefficients_eq_lift (a : FinalCoefficients K) :
    projectCoefficients a = liftCoefficients (coefficientLane 64 0 a) := by
  funext k
  change (if 4 ∣ k.val then a k else 0) =
    (if 4 ∣ k.val then coefficientLane 64 0 a (parentIndex k) else 0)
  by_cases h : 4 ∣ k.val
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h]
    change a k = a (childIndex (parentIndex (n := 64) k) 0)
    apply congrArg a
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [childIndex_val, parentIndex, Fin.val_zero, add_zero]
    exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' h).symm
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]

/-- Ring maps preserve the symbolic doubling recurrence. -/
theorem doubledFactor_map {L M : Type*} [CommRing L] [CommRing M]
    (f : L →+* M) (x : L) (b : ℕ) :
    f (doubledFactor x b) = doubledFactor (f x) b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ b ih =>
    simp only [doubledFactor, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_pow, map_one, ih]

/-- Cancellation of the three nonconstant low factors is a generic ring identity. -/
theorem quartet_low_sum_generic {L : Type*} [CommRing L]
    (x c : Fin 4 → L) (h1 : x 1 = -x 0) (h3 : x 3 = -x 2)
    (h2 : doubledFactor (x 2) 1 = -doubledFactor (x 0) 1) :
    (∑ s : Fin 4, (c 0 + x s * c 1 + doubledFactor (x s) 1 * c 2 +
      x s * doubledFactor (x s) 1 * c 3)) = 4 * c 0 := by
  have hneg (z : L) : doubledFactor (-z) 1 = doubledFactor z 1 := by
    simp only [doubledFactor, neg_sq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  rw [h1, h3, hneg, hneg, h2]
  ring

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] in
/-- The four low natural-basis factors average to the constant lane. -/
theorem quartet_low_sum (v : Fin 65536) (c : Fin 4 → K) :
    (∑ s : Fin 4,
      let x := algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v s))
      c 0 + x * c 1 + doubledFactor x 1 * c 2 + x * doubledFactor x 1 * c 3) = 4 * c 0 := by
  apply quartet_low_sum_generic
    (fun s => algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v s))) c
  · rw [storedFirstLineX18_slot1, map_neg]
  · rw [storedFirstLineX18_slot3, map_neg]
  · rw [← doubledFactor_map, ← doubledFactor_map, storedFirstLineX18_slot2_T2, map_neg]

/-- The existing radix-four natural-basis expansion at the actual stored children. -/
theorem exactFinalLinear_child_split (a : FinalCoefficients K) (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) :
    exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v s) =
      let x := algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (storedFirstLineX18 (childIndex v s))
      let c := fun t : Fin 4 => secondLinear (coefficientLane 64 t a) v
      c 0 + x * c 1 + doubledFactor x 1 * c 2 + x * doubledFactor x 1 * c 3 := by
  rw [exactFinalLinear_apply, naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_radix4 (by norm_num : 0 < 64),
    storedFirstLineX18_child_T4]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_four, Matrix.cons_val_zero, one_mul]
  rfl

/-- Averaging an encoded quartet is exactly the projection onto slots divisible by four. -/
theorem exactFinalLinear_project (a : FinalCoefficients K) (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) :
    exactFinalLinear (projectCoefficients a) (childIndex v s) =
      quartetAverage (exactFinalLinear a) v := by
  rw [projectCoefficients_eq_lift, exactFinalLinear_lift]
  unfold quartetAverage
  simp_rw [exactFinalLinear_child_split]
  rw [quartet_low_sum v (fun t => secondLinear (coefficientLane 64 t a) v)]
  have h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [show (2 : K) * 2 = 4 by ring] using
      mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne (2 : K)) (NeZero.ne (2 : K))
  exact (mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h4).symm

/-- Complete quartets above 64 parents exceed the distinct-message overlap cap. -/
theorem exactFinalLinear_descent (a : FinalCoefficients K) (S : Finset (Fin 65536))
    (hconst : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ s t : Fin 4,
      exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v s) = exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v t))
    (hS : 64 ≤ S.card) :
    a = projectCoefficients a := by
  let support : Finset (Fin 262144) :=
    (S.product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))).map (fibreIndexEquiv 65536).toEmbedding
  have hcard : support.card = 4 * S.card := by
    simp only [support, Finset.card_map, Finset.product_eq_sprod, Finset.card_product,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact Nat.mul_comm _ _
  have h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [show (2 : K) * 2 = 4 by ring] using
      mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne (2 : K)) (NeZero.ne (2 : K))
  have hsubset : support ⊆ AspisV5FriCoherentCandidateExtraction.agreementSet
      (exactFinalEncoder a) (exactFinalEncoder (projectCoefficients a)) := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨⟨v, s⟩, hp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hk
    have hv : v ∈ S := (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).1
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    change exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v s) =
      exactFinalLinear (projectCoefficients a) (childIndex v s)
    rw [exactFinalLinear_project]
    unfold quartetAverage
    have hsum : (∑ t : Fin 4, exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v t)) =
        (4 : K) * exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v s) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ t : Fin 4, exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v s) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => hconst v hv t s)
        _ = _ := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
            nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [hsum]
    exact (mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h4).symm
  by_contra hne
  have hcap := exactFinalEncoder_overlap_cap a (projectCoefficients a) hne
  have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  rw [hcard] at hle
  omega

/-- Descent identifies the surviving 64 natural coefficients explicitly. -/
theorem exactFinalLinear_descent_lift (a : FinalCoefficients K) (S : Finset (Fin 65536))
    (hconst : ∀ v ∈ S, ∀ s t : Fin 4,
      exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v s) = exactFinalLinear a (childIndex v t))
    (hS : 64 ≤ S.card) :
    ∃ m : SecondCoefficients K, a = liftCoefficients m := by
  refine ⟨coefficientLane 64 0 a, ?_⟩
  exact (exactFinalLinear_descent a S hconst hS).trans (projectCoefficients_eq_lift a)

@[simp] theorem repeatWord_child {L : Type} (word : SecondWord L)
    (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) :
    repeatWord word (childIndex v s) = word v := by
  simp only [repeatWord, parentIndex_childIndex]

#print axioms exactFinalLinear_descent
#print axioms exactFinalLinear_descent_lift

#print axioms exactFinalLinear_project

#print axioms line18Point_child_pow_four
#print axioms storedFirstLineX18_child_T4
#print axioms exactFinalLinear_lift

#print axioms naturalLinePoly_four_mul
#print axioms naturalCoefficientPolynomial_lift
end AspisR1.RepeatedLift

R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.text:
import R1FoldCoefficientBridge
import R1.RepeatedLift

/-! J4-R1(a): payload-free algebra of the R1 batched opening block
(DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §4, LOG D30).

Five identities, each over an arbitrary message/weight vector and every
challenge value:
* `s2b_identity`  round-1 boundary = quarter · round-0 polynomial at α₀;
* `s1_identity`   round-1 polynomial at α₁ = Σ_e final_e · w2_e;
* `s2a_identity`  round-0 boundary = quarter · Σ_k κ^k ℓ_k(q);
* `circ_identity` folded symbol u = coefficient fold of the four circle channels;
* `line_identity` the line-domain fold of the four stored children of v equals
  the 64-coefficient encoding of the α₁-folded message at v
  (`line_layer_identity`: the whole 2^18 → 2^16 layer).

No payload, transcript, or challenge distribution appears.  The line inverse
table `lineInverse` is stated through the stored line-18 nodes; its equality
with the Rust `QueryGeometry` table is a refinement item, not proved here. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.BatchedAlgebra

open scoped BigOperators

/-! ## The two `childIndex` definitions -/

/-- `AspisR1.childIndex` (spend-path NaturalProjection) and the AspisFormal
`childIndex` are the same flat index `4 i + s`. -/
theorem childIndex_bridge {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) (s : Fin 4) :
    AspisR1.childIndex i s = AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex i s :=
  rfl

section Generic

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ## Round relations (S2b, S1, S2a) -/

/-- S2b: the boundary of the second round polynomial is a quarter of the
first round polynomial evaluated at α₀.  `q` is any 1024-coefficient batched
vector, `w` any weight vector. -/
theorem s2b_identity (alpha0 : K) (q w : Fin (4 * 256) → K) :
    (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64)
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 256 alpha0 q)
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 256) alpha0 w)).coeff 0 +
      (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64)
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 256 alpha0 q)
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 256) alpha0 w)).coeff 4 =
      AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter *
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) q w).eval alpha0 := by
  rw [AspisR1.RoundPairing.round_boundary, AspisR1.RoundPairing.round_eval,
    AspisR1.FoldCoefficientBridge.coefficientFoldLayer_eq_primalFold]
  try rfl

/-- S1: the second round polynomial at α₁ is the pairing of the final
coefficients with the twice-folded weights. -/
theorem s1_identity (alpha1 : K) (q1 w1 : Fin (4 * 64) → K) :
    (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64) q1 w1).eval alpha1 =
      ∑ e : Fin 64,
        AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 alpha1 q1 e *
          AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 64) alpha1 w1 e := by
  rw [AspisR1.RoundPairing.round_eval,
    AspisR1.FoldCoefficientBridge.coefficientFoldLayer_eq_primalFold]
  try rfl

/-- The κ-batched weight vector of seven linear functionals:
`w j = Σ_k κ^k ℓ_k(e_j)`. -/
def weightsOf {N : Nat} (kappa : K) (ell : Fin 7 → ((Fin N → K) →ₗ[K] K)) :
    Fin N → K :=
  fun j => ∑ k : Fin 7, kappa ^ k.val * ell k (Pi.single j 1)

/-- Pairing with the batched weights is the κ-batch of the functionals. -/
theorem dot_weightsOf {N : Nat} (kappa : K)
    (ell : Fin 7 → ((Fin N → K) →ₗ[K] K)) (q : Fin N → K) :
    AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot q (weightsOf kappa ell) =
      ∑ k : Fin 7, kappa ^ k.val * ell k q := by
  have hq : q = ∑ j : Fin N, q j • (Pi.single j (1 : K) : Fin N → K) := by
    funext i
    simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have key (k : Fin 7) : ell k q = ∑ j : Fin N, q j * ell k (Pi.single j 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hq]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot, weightsOf, key, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

/-- S2a: the boundary of the first round polynomial is a quarter of the
κ-batched claim `Σ_k κ^k ℓ_k(q)`. -/
theorem s2a_identity (kappa : K)
    (ell : Fin 7 → ((Fin (4 * 256) → K) →ₗ[K] K)) (q : Fin (4 * 256) → K) :
    (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) q (weightsOf kappa ell)).coeff 0 +
      (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) q (weightsOf kappa ell)).coeff 4 =
      AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter * ∑ k : Fin 7, kappa ^ k.val * ell k q := by
  rw [AspisR1.RoundPairing.round_boundary, dot_weightsOf]

/-! ## Line-fold algebra on one quartet -/

/-- Field identity behind the line fold: for four nodes `x, -x, w, -w` whose
first doublings are `z, z, -z, -z`, the nested butterfly with inverse table
`(2x)⁻¹, -(2(-w))⁻¹, (2z)⁻¹` applied to the four natural-basis values
`c₀ + x c₁ + T₂(x) c₂ + x T₂(x) c₃` returns `Σ_t α^t c_t`. -/
theorem lineFold_quartet (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (alpha : K) (x c : Fin 4 → K)
    (h1 : x 1 = -x 0) (h3 : x 3 = -x 2)
    (hT : AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x 2) 1 =
      -AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x 0) 1)
    (hx0 : x 0 ≠ 0) (hx2 : x 2 ≠ 0)
    (hz : AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x 0) 1 ≠ 0)
    (i0 i1 i2 : K) (hi0 : i0 = (2 * x 0)⁻¹) (hi1 : i1 = -(2 * x 3)⁻¹)
    (hi2 : i2 = (2 * AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x 0) 1)⁻¹) :
    AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldValue alpha i0 i1 i2
        (fun s => c 0 + x s * c 1 +
          AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x s) 1 * c 2 +
          x s * AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (x s) 1 * c 3) =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue alpha c := by
  have hneg (z : K) : AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (-z) 1 =
      AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor z 1 := by
    simp only [AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor, neg_sq]
  have hi1' : i1 = (2 * x 2)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hi1, h3, mul_neg, inv_neg, neg_neg]
  subst hi0 hi2
  rw [hi1']
  simp only [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldValue,
    AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.pairFoldValue,
    AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue]
  rw [h1, h3, hneg (x 0), hneg (x 2), hT]
  field_simp
  ring

end Generic

/-! ## Circle fold (C_u) and line fold (L_u) on the exact encoders -/

section Encoders

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- C_u: the exact log-18 encoding of the α₀-folded message at `u` is the
coefficient fold of the four circle channels of the initial encoding at `u`. -/
theorem circ_identity (alpha0 : K) (q : Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fin 262144) :
    AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 256 alpha0 q) u =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue alpha0
        (fun s => AspisR1.FirstFold.channels
          (AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder q) s u) :=
  (congrFun (AspisR1.FirstFold.fold_encoded alpha0 q) u).symm

/-- Own-silent form of C_u: a zero opened fibre gives a zero folded value. -/
theorem circ_zero_of_fibre_zero (alpha0 : K) (q : Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fin 262144)
    (hz : AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre (AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder q) u = 0) :
    AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 256 alpha0 q) u = 0 := by
  rw [circ_identity]
  have h0 (s : Fin 4) :
      AspisR1.FirstFold.channels (AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder q) s u = 0 := by
    simp only [AspisR1.FirstFold.channels, hz]
    fin_cases s <;>
      simp [AspisR1.FirstFold.fibreTransform,
        AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.radix4Decode]
  simp [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue, h0]

/-- Public M31 inverse table of the line fold at parent `v`:
`(2x)⁻¹, -(2y)⁻¹, (2z)⁻¹` with `x` the stored node of child 0, `y` that of
child 3 and `z = 2x² - 1` (Rust `line_fold`: x = node(4v), y = node(4v+3)). -/
def lineInverse (v : Fin 65536) : Fin 3 → ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P :=
  ![(2 * AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0))⁻¹,
    -(2 * AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 3))⁻¹,
    (2 * (2 * AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0) ^ 2 - 1))⁻¹]

/-- The embedded stored line-18 node of child `s` of parent `v`. -/
def lineNode (v : Fin 65536) (s : Fin 4) : K :=
  algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K
    (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18
      (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v s))

/-- The log-16 encoding at `v` of coefficient lane `t` of a 256-vector. -/
def laneValue (m : Fin 256 → K) (v : Fin 65536) (t : Fin 4) : K :=
  AspisR1.RepeatedLift.secondLinear
    (AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane 64 t m) v

/-- Encoding the α-folded 64 coefficients is the α-fold of the four lane
encodings (linearity of `secondLinear`). -/
theorem secondLinear_coefficientFold (alpha : K) (m : Fin 256 → K) (v : Fin 65536) :
    AspisR1.RepeatedLift.secondLinear
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 alpha m) v =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue alpha (laneValue m v) := by
  have hm : AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 alpha m =
      AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane 64 0 m +
        alpha • AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane 64 1 m +
        alpha ^ 2 • AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane 64 2 m +
        alpha ^ 3 • AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane 64 3 m := by
    funext d
    simp only [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer_apply,
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue, Pi.add_apply,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderCommutation.coefficientLane_apply]
  rw [hm]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldValue, laneValue]

theorem lineNode_one (v : Fin 65536) : lineNode (K := K) v 1 = -lineNode v 0 := by
  unfold lineNode
  rw [AspisR1.RepeatedLift.storedFirstLineX18_slot1 v, map_neg]

theorem lineNode_three (v : Fin 65536) : lineNode (K := K) v 3 = -lineNode v 2 := by
  unfold lineNode
  rw [AspisR1.RepeatedLift.storedFirstLineX18_slot3 v, map_neg]

theorem lineNode_T2 (v : Fin 65536) :
    AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (lineNode (K := K) v 2) 1 =
      -AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (lineNode (K := K) v 0) 1 := by
  have h := congrArg (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K)
    (AspisR1.RepeatedLift.storedFirstLineX18_slot2_T2 v)
  rw [AspisR1.RepeatedLift.doubledFactor_map, map_neg,
    AspisR1.RepeatedLift.doubledFactor_map] at h
  exact h

/-- Distinct children of one parent have distinct embedded nodes
(injectivity of the stored line-18 domain). -/
theorem lineNode_injective (v : Fin 65536) {s t : Fin 4}
    (h : lineNode (K := K) v s = lineNode v t) : s = t := by
  unfold lineNode at h
  have h1 := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K h
  have h2 := AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18_injective h1
  have h3 := congrArg Fin.val h2
  simp only [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex_val] at h3
  exact Fin.ext (by omega)

theorem lineNode_zero_ne (v : Fin 65536) : lineNode (K := K) v 0 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h0
  have h : lineNode (K := K) v 1 = lineNode v 0 := by
    rw [lineNode_one, h0, neg_zero]
  exact absurd (lineNode_injective v h) (by decide)

theorem lineNode_two_ne (v : Fin 65536) : lineNode (K := K) v 2 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h0
  have h : lineNode (K := K) v 3 = lineNode v 2 := by
    rw [lineNode_three, h0, neg_zero]
  exact absurd (lineNode_injective v h) (by decide)

theorem lineNode_T2_ne (v : Fin 65536) :
    AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (lineNode (K := K) v 0) 1 ≠ 0 := by
  intro hD
  have hD2 : AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (lineNode (K := K) v 2) 1 = 0 := by
    rw [lineNode_T2, hD, neg_zero]
  have e0 : 2 * lineNode (K := K) v 0 ^ 2 - 1 = 0 := hD
  have e2 : 2 * lineNode (K := K) v 2 ^ 2 - 1 = 0 := hD2
  have e : (lineNode (K := K) v 0 - lineNode v 2) * (lineNode v 0 + lineNode v 2) * 2 =
      (2 * lineNode (K := K) v 0 ^ 2 - 1) - (2 * lineNode v 2 ^ 2 - 1) := by ring
  rw [e0, e2, sub_zero] at e
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp e with h | h
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h' | h'
    · exact absurd (lineNode_injective v (sub_eq_zero.mp h')) (by decide)
    · have h12 : lineNode (K := K) v 1 = lineNode v 2 := by
        rw [lineNode_one, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h', neg_neg]
      exact absurd (lineNode_injective v h12) (by decide)
  · exact AspisWide.InitialEncoder.two_ne_zero h

/-! The three table entries, embedded.  Proved by explicit rewriting
(`two_mul`, ring-hom laws); no numeral of `ZMod P` is evaluated. -/

theorem lineInverse_zero_map (v : Fin 65536) :
    algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (lineInverse v 0) =
      (2 * lineNode (K := K) v 0)⁻¹ := by
  change algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K ((2 * AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0))⁻¹) = _
  rw [map_inv₀, two_mul (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0)), map_add,
    ← two_mul (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0)))]
  rfl

theorem lineInverse_one_map (v : Fin 65536) :
    algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (lineInverse v 1) =
      -(2 * lineNode (K := K) v 3)⁻¹ := by
  change algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (-(2 * AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 3))⁻¹) = _
  rw [map_neg, map_inv₀, two_mul (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 3)), map_add,
    ← two_mul (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 3)))]
  rfl

theorem lineInverse_two_map (v : Fin 65536) :
    algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (lineInverse v 2) =
      (2 * AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (lineNode (K := K) v 0) 1)⁻¹ := by
  change algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K ((2 * (2 * AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0) ^ 2 - 1))⁻¹) = _
  rw [map_inv₀, two_mul (2 * AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0) ^ 2 - 1), map_add, map_sub, map_one,
    two_mul (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0) ^ 2), map_add, map_pow,
    ← two_mul (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0)) ^ 2),
    ← two_mul (2 * algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (AspisV7ExactOneFoldDomains.storedFirstLineX18 (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v 0)) ^ 2 - 1)]
  rfl

/-- L_u (one parent): the line fold of the four stored children of `v`, with
the public inverse table, equals the log-16 encoding at `v` of the α₁-folded
256-coefficient message.  Holds for every `m` and every `α₁`. -/
theorem line_identity (alpha1 : K) (m : Fin 256 → K) (v : Fin 65536) :
    AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldValue alpha1
        (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (lineInverse v 0))
        (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (lineInverse v 1))
        (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (lineInverse v 2))
        (fun s => AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear m
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v s)) =
      AspisR1.RepeatedLift.secondLinear
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 alpha1 m) v := by
  have hsplit (s : Fin 4) :
      AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear m
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex v s) =
        laneValue m v 0 + lineNode v s * laneValue m v 1 +
          AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (lineNode v s) 1 * laneValue m v 2 +
          lineNode v s * AspisCircleTensorBinding.doubledFactor (lineNode v s) 1 *
            laneValue m v 3 :=
    AspisR1.RepeatedLift.exactFinalLinear_child_split m v s
  simp only [hsplit]
  rw [secondLinear_coefficientFold]
  exact lineFold_quartet AspisWide.InitialEncoder.two_ne_zero alpha1 (lineNode v)
    (laneValue m v) (lineNode_one v) (lineNode_three v) (lineNode_T2 v)
    (lineNode_zero_ne v) (lineNode_two_ne v) (lineNode_T2_ne v) _ _ _
    (lineInverse_zero_map v) (lineInverse_one_map v) (lineInverse_two_map v)

/-- L_u for the whole layer: the 2^18 → 2^16 line fold of the folded word
equals the log-16 encoding of the final 64 coefficients. -/
theorem line_layer_identity (alpha1 : K) (m : Fin 256 → K) :
    AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldLayer 65536 alpha1 lineInverse
        (AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear m) =
      AspisR1.RepeatedLift.secondLinear
        (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 alpha1 m) := by
  funext v
  rw [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldLayer_apply]
  exact line_identity alpha1 m v

end Encoders

#print axioms childIndex_bridge
#print axioms s2b_identity
#print axioms s1_identity
#print axioms dot_weightsOf
#print axioms s2a_identity
#print axioms lineFold_quartet
#print axioms circ_identity
#print axioms circ_zero_of_fibre_zero
#print axioms secondLinear_coefficientFold
#print axioms lineNode_injective
#print axioms lineNode_T2_ne
#print axioms line_identity
#print axioms line_layer_identity

end R1Z.BatchedAlgebra

R1Z.Batched.text:
import R0Z.PayloadSplit
import R1Z.BatchedAlgebra

/-! R1-2 (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §2.3, §4; LOG D30, D32, D33): the R1 batched
opening block as an instance of `HonestView.BatchedLayer`.

R1 batches the 29 transported coefficient words with powers of γ (no chord
quotient), pairs the batch with the κ-batched weights of seven functionals
(inactive rows, three claim points, Libra, two OOD points), and folds twice
(α₀ on the 1024-coefficient vector, α₁ on the 256-coefficient one).  The
disclosed cells are the two round polynomials (7 coefficients each), the
query-gated folded word (`FoldedOpen`) and the 64 final coefficients.

All sums over rows are symbolic; the π reindexing is `Equiv.sum_comp`. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.Batched

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

/-! ## The cell type -/

/-- R1's batched cells: two round polynomials, the folded word, the final
coefficients. -/
inductive R1Bat
  | round0 (i : Fin 7)
  | round1 (i : Fin 7)
  | folded (p : Fin 262144)
  | final (e : Fin 64)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- `R1Bat` as a sum of finite types (used only for `Fintype`). -/
def R1Bat.equivSum : R1Bat ≃ (Fin 7 ⊕ Fin 7) ⊕ (Fin 262144 ⊕ Fin 64) where
  toFun
    | .round0 i => .inl (.inl i)
    | .round1 i => .inl (.inr i)
    | .folded p => .inr (.inl p)
    | .final e => .inr (.inr e)
  invFun
    | .inl (.inl i) => .round0 i
    | .inl (.inr i) => .round1 i
    | .inr (.inl p) => .folded p
    | .inr (.inr e) => .final e
  left_inv b := by cases b <;> rfl
  right_inv x := by rcases x with (i | i) | (p | e) <;> rfl

instance : Fintype R1Bat := Fintype.ofEquiv _ R1Bat.equivSum.symm

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-! ## Challenge names (transcript rows 27–30) -/

abbrev gamma (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 0
abbrev kappa (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 1
abbrev alpha0 (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 2
abbrev alpha1 (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 3

/-! ## Batch and weights -/

/-- γ-batch of the 29 transported coefficient words (no quotient). -/
def batchR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Trace K →ₗ[K] InitialMessage K :=
  ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val • (coeffsLinear π).comp (LinearMap.proj c)

/-- Any functional of the batch is the γ-batch of the functional of each word. -/
theorem map_batchR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K)
    (f : InitialMessage K →ₗ[K] K) (t : Trace K) :
    f (batchR1 π ch t) = ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * f (coeffsLinear π (t c)) := by
  simp only [batchR1, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

theorem dotLinear_apply {n : Nat} (w x : Fin n → K) :
    dotLinear w x = ∑ i : Fin n, w i * x i := by
  simp only [dotLinear, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]

/-- Row weights read through π: `Equiv.sum_comp`, no enumeration of rows. -/
theorem dot_reindex (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (w x : InitialMessage K) :
    dotLinear (fun j => w (π.symm j)) (coeffsLinear π x) = dotLinear w x := by
  simp only [dotLinear_apply, coeffsLinear_apply]
  exact Equiv.sum_comp π.symm (fun r => w r * x r)

/- From here on `dotLinear` (a sum over 1024 rows) is never unfolded by
definitional checks. -/
attribute [local irreducible] dotLinear

/-- The seven coefficient functionals (weights.rs kinds: inactive rows, the
three claim points, Libra, the two OOD points). -/
def ell (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 7 → (InitialMessage K →ₗ[K] K) :=
  ![dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 0) (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 1) (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 2) (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (libraWeight (alpha ch)),
    oodLinear (ch.circle 0),
    oodLinear (ch.circle 1)]

theorem ell_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 0 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_one (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 1 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 0) (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_two (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 2 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 1) (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_three (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 3 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 2) (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_four (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 4 =
    dotLinear (libraWeight (alpha ch)) := rfl
theorem ell_five (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 5 =
    oodLinear (ch.circle 0) := rfl
theorem ell_six (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 6 =
    oodLinear (ch.circle 1) := rfl

/-! ### `ell_batchR1`: each functional of the batch is the γ-batched own value -/

theorem ell_batch_inactive (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 0 (batchR1 π ch t) = ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val *
      dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows) (t c) := by
  rw [ell_zero, map_batchR1]
  simp only [dot_reindex]

private theorem eq_batch (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (p : Fin 10 → K)
    (t : Trace K) :
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight p (π.symm j)) (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight p) (t c) := by
  rw [map_batchR1]
  simp only [dot_reindex]

theorem ell_batch_claim0 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 1 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * claimsLinear (alpha ch) 0 c t := by
  rw [ell_one, eq_batch]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_claim1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 2 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * claimsLinear (alpha ch) 1 c t := by
  rw [ell_two, eq_batch]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_claim2 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 3 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * claimsLinear (alpha ch) 2 c t := by
  rw [ell_three, eq_batch]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_extra (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 4 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * extraLinear π (alpha ch) c t := by
  rw [ell_four, map_batchR1]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_ood0 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 5 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * oodLinear (ch.circle 0) (coeffsLinear π (t c)) := by
  rw [ell_five, map_batchR1]

theorem ell_batch_ood1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 6 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * oodLinear (ch.circle 1) (coeffsLinear π (t c)) := by
  rw [ell_six, map_batchR1]

/-- κ-batched weights `w j = Σ_k κ^k ℓ_k(e_j)`. -/
def weightsR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : InitialMessage K :=
  R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.weightsOf (ch.opening 1) (ell π ch)

theorem dot_weightsR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (q : InitialMessage K) :
    AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot q (weightsR1 π ch) =
      ∑ k : Fin 7, ch.opening 1 ^ k.val * ell π ch k q :=
  R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.dot_weightsOf (ch.opening 1) (ell π ch) q

/-! ## The two fold layers -/

/-- The α₀-folded 256 coefficients. -/
def q1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Trace K →ₗ[K] (Fin 256 → K) :=
  (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 256 (ch.opening 2)).comp
    (batchR1 π ch)

def w1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 256 → K :=
  AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 256) (ch.opening 2) (weightsR1 π ch)

def w2 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 64 → K :=
  AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 64) (ch.opening 3) (w1 π ch)

/-- A folded symbol is disclosed iff its parent fibre holds a query. -/
def FoldedOpen (ch : Challenges K) (p : Fin 262144) : Prop :=
  ∃ u ∈ ch.queries, u.val / 4 = p.val / 4

/-- The round polynomial as a K-linear map of the message, for fixed weights. -/
def roundPolynomialLinear {n : Nat} (w : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    (Fin (4 * n) → K) →ₗ[K] Polynomial K :=
  ∑ d : Fin n, ∑ s : Fin 4, ∑ u : Fin 4,
    (LinearMap.proj (AspisR1.childIndex d s)).smulRight
      (Polynomial.monomial (s.val + (4 - u.val) % 4)
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter * w (AspisR1.childIndex d u)))

theorem roundPolynomialLinear_apply {n : Nat} (w q : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    roundPolynomialLinear w q = AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial q w := by
  simp only [roundPolynomialLinear, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, Polynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul,
    AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u _
  congr 1
  ring

/-! ## The read and the instance -/

/-- The R1 read of the batched block (prover.rs prove_from_semantics). -/
def r1Read (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Trace K →ₗ[K] (R1Bat → K) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun b => match b with
  | .round0 i => (Polynomial.lcoeff K i.val).comp
      ((roundPolynomialLinear (n := 256) (weightsR1 π ch)).comp (batchR1 π ch))
  | .round1 i => (Polynomial.lcoeff K i.val).comp
      ((roundPolynomialLinear (n := 64) (w1 π ch)).comp (q1 π ch))
  | .folded p => if FoldedOpen ch p then
      (LinearMap.proj p).comp (AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear.comp (q1 π ch)) else 0
  | .final e => (LinearMap.proj e).comp
      ((AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 (ch.opening 3)).comp
        (q1 π ch))

instance instBatchedLayer : BatchedLayer K R1Bat where
  read := r1Read

/-- R1 payload cells. -/
abbrev R1Payload (K : Type) := Payload K R1Bat

attribute [local irreducible] batchR1 weightsR1 w1 q1 roundPolynomialLinear

/-! ## `batRead_L`: the four cell formulas -/

theorem read_round0 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.round0 i) =
      (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) (batchR1 π ch t) (weightsR1 π ch)).coeff
        i.val := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.round0 i) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Polynomial.lcoeff_apply,
    roundPolynomialLinear_apply]

theorem read_round1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.round1 i) =
      (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64) (q1 π ch t) (w1 π ch)).coeff i.val := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.round1 i) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Polynomial.lcoeff_apply,
    roundPolynomialLinear_apply]

theorem read_folded (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K)
    (p : Fin 262144) (h : FoldedOpen ch p) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.folded p) =
      AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear (q1 π ch t) p := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.folded p) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_pos h, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]

theorem folded_unqueried_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K)
    (p : Fin 262144) (h : ¬ FoldedOpen ch p) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.folded p) = 0 := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.folded p) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_neg h, LinearMap.zero_apply]

theorem read_final (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (e : Fin 64) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.final e) =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 (ch.opening 3)
        (q1 π ch t) e := rfl

/-- The payload's batched cells are the R1 read (no other cell is touched). -/
theorem L_bat {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (b : R1Bat) :
    R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch t (.bat b) =
      BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t b := rfl

#print axioms R1Bat.equivSum
#print axioms map_batchR1
#print axioms dot_reindex
#print axioms ell_batch_inactive
#print axioms ell_batch_claim0
#print axioms ell_batch_claim1
#print axioms ell_batch_claim2
#print axioms ell_batch_extra
#print axioms ell_batch_ood0
#print axioms ell_batch_ood1
#print axioms dot_weightsR1
#print axioms roundPolynomialLinear_apply
#print axioms read_round0
#print axioms read_round1
#print axioms read_folded
#print axioms folded_unqueried_zero
#print axioms read_final
#print axioms L_bat

end R1Z.Batched
