import R0Z.HvzkV
import R0Z.FsAbortR1
import R1Z.Batched

/-! J0c (LOG D41): the ZF1 R1 models for the pole-aware retry games.  The
fields are those of `R0Z.FsAbortR1.R1RealModel` / `R1IdealModel`; only the
agreement field names `middleRealAbortV` (attempts accepted on `P ∧ V`) and
the per-challenge simulator games.  The coupling bounds are proved from
`FsAbortBounds` exactly as in `FsAbortR1`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.ModelsVR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The ZF1 R1 models for the pole-aware games -/

/-- `R1RealModel` (LOG D41) with the agreement field naming `middleRealAbortV`. -/
def R1RealModelV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.RealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (charged : Fin M → cp.S → Prop) (priv : Fin M → Prop)
      (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes) (qry : Fin q → cp.S → Bytes) (exh : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr s →
          ¬ (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s) →
        realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s) =
          middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s)) ∧
      (∀ j i, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.HitFresh (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin) ∧
      R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass exh ≤ εexh

/-- `R1IdealModel` (LOG D41) with the agreement field naming the per-challenge
simulator games. -/
def R1IdealModelV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes),
      (∀ s, ¬ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s →
        middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s) =
          idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s)) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin)

theorem realAbortCouplingV_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1RealModelV P h V B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh) :
    RealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin)
      ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) := by
  intro adv w hw
  obtain ⟨cp, charged, priv, addr, qry, exh, hag, hhit, hpair, hexh⟩ := hm adv w hw
  refine ⟨cp, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr,
    fun s => R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s, hag, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
    exact R0Z.FsAbortBounds.hitEv_mass_fresh M q Umin hU charged qry addr hhit
  · rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
    calc R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass (fun s => R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s)
        ≤ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr) +
            R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass exh :=
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _
      _ ≤ (M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh :=
          add_le_add (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair) hexh

theorem idealAbortCouplingV_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1IdealModelV P h V B outputs fs ab x M Umin) :
    IdealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin) := by
  intro hx adv
  obtain ⟨cp, priv, addr, hag, hpair⟩ := hm hx adv
  refine ⟨cp, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr, hag, ?_⟩
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
  exact R0Z.FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair

#print axioms R1RealModelV
#print axioms R1IdealModelV
#print axioms realAbortCouplingV_of_R1
#print axioms idealAbortCouplingV_of_R1
end R1Z.ModelsVR1

R1Z.LensR1.text:
import R0Z.FsAbortBounds
import Mathlib.Data.FinEnum

/-! R1 games (zf1/DESIGN-R1-GAMES §2): lawful lenses as coordinate splits.
`HitFresh` / `PairFresh` (FsAbortBounds) ask for an equivalence `S ≃ R × U`
in which the designated field of an address is the `U` coordinate.  A lawful
lens `S → U` gives one (`R` = the lens fibre over a fixed point), so the
freshness facts reduce to three checkable properties: the lens leaves the
event and the other address unchanged, and the designated field of the
address is the lens value.  Also: 32-byte answers, their byte encoding and
the fixed-offset / trailing field readers (the `fixed 0` and `trailing`
readers of the spend-path RawByteCollisionTargets, restated here). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LensR1
open R0Z.FsAbortBounds
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
abbrev Ans := Fin 32 → UInt8

/-! ### Lawful lenses -/

structure Lens (S U : Type) where
  get : S → U
  set : S → U → S
  get_set : ∀ s u, get (set s u) = u
  set_get : ∀ s, set s (get s) = s
  set_set : ∀ s u u', set (set s u) u' = set s u'

/-- The fibre of a lens over `u₀` times the lens value. -/
def Lens.equiv {S U : Type} (L : Lens S U) (u₀ : U) : S ≃ {s : S // L.get s = u₀} × U where
  toFun s := (⟨L.set s u₀, L.get_set s u₀⟩, L.get s)
  invFun p := L.set p.1.1 p.2
  left_inv s := by
    show L.set (L.set s u₀) (L.get s) = s
    rw [L.set_set, L.set_get]
  right_inv p := by
    obtain ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, u⟩ := p
    have h1 : L.set (L.set r u) u₀ = r := by
      rw [L.set_set, ← hr, L.set_get]
    have h2 : L.get (L.set r u) = u := L.get_set r u
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext h1) h2

theorem Lens.equiv_symm {S U : Type} (L : Lens S U) (u₀ : U) (r : {s : S // L.get s = u₀})
    (u : U) : (L.equiv u₀).symm (r, u) = L.set r.1 u := rfl

/-- Hit freshness from a lens: the event and (on the event) the adversary read
are unchanged by the lens, and the designated field of the address is the
lens value. -/
theorem hitFresh_of_lens {S U A : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (D : S → Prop) (qa ga : S → A) (fld : A → U) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hcard : Umin ≤ Fintype.card U)
    (hD : ∀ s u, D s → D (L.set s u))
    (hq : ∀ s u, D s → qa (L.set s u) = qa s)
    (hf : ∀ s u, fld (ga (L.set s u)) = u) :
    HitFresh D qa ga Umin := by
  let u₀ : U := Classical.arbitrary U
  refine ⟨{s : S // L.get s = u₀}, U, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    L.equiv u₀, fun _ a => fld a, hcard, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r u u' h
    rw [Lens.equiv_symm] at h ⊢
    have := hD _ u' h
    rwa [L.set_set] at this
  · intro r u u' h
    rw [Lens.equiv_symm] at h ⊢
    rw [Lens.equiv_symm, ← L.set_set r.1 u u', hq _ u' h]
  · intro r u a h
    rw [Lens.equiv_symm] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact (hf r.1 u).symm

/-- Pair freshness from a lens: the first address is unchanged by the lens and
the designated field of the second is the lens value. -/
theorem pairFresh_of_lens {S U A : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (fa ga : S → A) (fld : A → U) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hcard : Umin ≤ Fintype.card U)
    (hfa : ∀ s u, fa (L.set s u) = fa s)
    (hf : ∀ s u, fld (ga (L.set s u)) = u) :
    PairFresh fa ga Umin := by
  let u₀ : U := Classical.arbitrary U
  refine Or.inr ⟨{s : S // L.get s = u₀}, U, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    L.equiv u₀, fun _ a => fld a, hcard, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r u u'
    rw [Lens.equiv_symm, Lens.equiv_symm, hfa, hfa]
  · intro r u a h
    rw [Lens.equiv_symm] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact (hf r.1 u).symm

theorem pairFresh_of_ne {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (fa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ s, fa s ≠ ga s) : PairFresh fa ga Umin := Or.inl h

/-! ### Lens constructions -/

/-- A lens on one coordinate of a family of attempts, with an untouched factor. -/
def Lens.pi {N : ℕ} {C T U : Type} (k : Fin N) (L : Lens C U) :
    Lens ((Fin N → C) × T) U where
  get ct := L.get (ct.1 k)
  set ct u := (Function.update ct.1 k (L.set (ct.1 k) u), ct.2)
  get_set ct u := by
    show L.get (Function.update ct.1 k (L.set (ct.1 k) u) k) = u
    simp [L.get_set]
  set_get ct := by
    obtain ⟨c, t⟩ := ct
    show (Function.update c k (L.set (c k) (L.get (c k))), t) = (c, t)
    rw [L.set_get, Function.update_eq_self]
  set_set ct u u' := by
    obtain ⟨c, t⟩ := ct
    show (Function.update (Function.update c k (L.set (c k) u)) k
        (L.set (Function.update c k (L.set (c k) u) k) u'), t) =
      (Function.update c k (L.set (c k) u'), t)
    simp [L.set_set]

theorem Lens.pi_set_fst_ne {N : ℕ} {C T U : Type} (k : Fin N) (L : Lens C U)
    (ct : (Fin N → C) × T) (u : U) (j : Fin N) (hj : j ≠ k) :
    ((Lens.pi (T := T) k L).set ct u).1 j = ct.1 j := by
  simp [Lens.pi, Function.update_of_ne hj]

theorem Lens.pi_set_fst_eq {N : ℕ} {C T U : Type} (k : Fin N) (L : Lens C U)
    (ct : (Fin N → C) × T) (u : U) :
    ((Lens.pi (T := T) k L).set ct u).1 k = L.set (ct.1 k) u := by
  simp [Lens.pi]

theorem Lens.pi_set_snd {N : ℕ} {C T U : Type} (k : Fin N) (L : Lens C U)
    (ct : (Fin N → C) × T) (u : U) :
    ((Lens.pi (T := T) k L).set ct u).2 = ct.2 := rfl

/-! ### 32-byte answers -/

def ans (u : Ans) : Bytes := List.ofFn u

theorem length_ans (u : Ans) : (ans u).length = 32 := List.length_ofFn

/-- The 32-byte field at offset 0 (spend-path `fixed 0`). -/
def fixed0 (a : Bytes) : Ans := fun i => a.getD i.val 0

/-- The trailing 32-byte field (spend-path `trailing`). -/
def trailing (a : Bytes) : Ans := fun i => a.getD (a.length - 32 + i.val) 0

theorem getD_ans (u : Ans) (i : Fin 32) : ((ans u)[i.val]?).getD 0 = u i := by
  have h : i.val < (List.ofFn u).length := by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact i.isLt
  rw [ans, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h, Option.getD_some, List.getElem_ofFn]

theorem fixed0_ans_append (u : Ans) (t : Bytes) : fixed0 (ans u ++ t) = u := by
  funext i
  have hi : i.val < (ans u).length := by rw [length_ans]; exact i.isLt
  simp only [fixed0, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left hi]
  exact getD_ans u i

theorem trailing_append_ans (p : Bytes) (u : Ans) : trailing (p ++ ans u) = u := by
  funext i
  have hl : (p ++ ans u).length - 32 + i.val = p.length + i.val := by
    simp only [List.length_append, length_ans]
    omega
  simp only [trailing, hl, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact getD_ans u i

/-! ### The answer space has 2^256 points -/

def uint8Equiv : UInt8 ≃ Fin UInt8.size where
  toFun := UInt8.toFin
  invFun := UInt8.ofFin
  left_inv x := UInt8.ofFin_toFin x
  right_inv x := UInt8.toFin_ofFin x

theorem card_ans : Fintype.card Ans = 2 ^ 256 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_congr uint8Equiv, Fintype.card_fin]
  norm_num [UInt8.size]

theorem umin_le_card_ans : 2 ^ 255 ≤ Fintype.card Ans := by
  rw [card_ans]
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

#print axioms Lens.equiv
#print axioms hitFresh_of_lens
#print axioms pairFresh_of_lens
#print axioms pairFresh_of_ne
#print axioms Lens.pi
#print axioms Lens.pi_set_fst_ne
#print axioms Lens.pi_set_fst_eq
#print axioms fixed0_ans_append
#print axioms trailing_append_ans
#print axioms card_ans
#print axioms umin_le_card_ans
end R1Z.LensR1

R1Z.TranscriptR1.text:
import R1Z.LensR1

/-! R1 games (zf1/DESIGN-R1-GAMES §2): the byte layout of one attempt's
Fiat-Shamir transcript, 115 oracle reads (SOURCE: r1_wire.rs
SemanticTranscript, transcript.rs Transcript, verifier.rs Prepared::new,
r0_transcript.rs queries_from_pairs; variant S2, two folds, 33 rows):

* `init` = H(DOMAIN ‖ 0 ‖ le32 |pub| ‖ pub ‖ c1_root);
* rows 0..26: `absS i` = H(state ‖ 0 ‖ 0xa0+i ‖ framed_i), `sqS i` =
  H(absorbed ‖ 1) (challenge block), `advS i` = H(absorbed ‖ 2) (next state);
* `reseed` = H(DOMAIN2 ‖ variant ‖ state_26);
* rows 27..30: `absO i` = H(state ‖ 0 ‖ 0xa0+27+i ‖ le32 |payload| ‖ payload),
  `sqO i`, `advO i`;
* row 31: `absQ` (final message), eight pairs `qb k` = H(st_k ‖ 1),
  `qa k` = H(st_k ‖ 2) with st_0 = absorbed, st_{k+1} = answer of `qa k`;
* row 32: `absR` = H(a_{k*} ‖ 0 ‖ 0xc0 ‖ le32 0), `sqR`, `advR`, where k* is
  the QueryScan completion index (a function of the `qb` answers only).

Every address carries one DESIGNATED FIELD (`fc`): a 32-byte coordinate at
offset 0 (or trailing, for `init` and `reseed`) that is the C1 root, the
answer of an earlier read, or (for `absR`) the answer of `qa k*` (`sel`).
The rest of the address (`Rest`) is public data and the prover's messages.
A record `Rec` collects the coordinates; `setC` moves one of them.

PROVED here: `card_TRead` (115 reads; 40 squeeze blocks), the field readers
(`extract_addrWith`), invariance of every address under every coordinate it
does not read (`addr_setC_of_not_dep`), and the pair table `table`: two
distinct reads either have a coordinate one of them does not read, or their
addresses differ for every record (suffix byte 1 vs 2; length 38 vs 33).
Lifted to any space with per-attempt lenses (`TranscriptFrame`), this gives
`PairFresh` for every pair of transcript positions of all attempts and
`HitFresh` for every transcript position whose charging event and adversary
read are lens-invariant. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.TranscriptR1
open R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.LensR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### The 115 reads -/

inductive TRead
  | init
  | absS (i : Fin 27) | sqS (i : Fin 27) | advS (i : Fin 27)
  | reseed
  | absO (i : Fin 4) | sqO (i : Fin 4) | advO (i : Fin 4)
  | absQ
  | qb (k : Fin 8) | qa (k : Fin 8)
  | absR | sqR | advR
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev TSum := Unit ⊕ Fin 27 ⊕ Fin 27 ⊕ Fin 27 ⊕ Unit ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 4 ⊕ Unit ⊕ Fin 8 ⊕ Fin 8 ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit

def TRead.toSum : TRead → TSum
  | .init => .inl ()
  | .absS x => .inr (.inl x)
  | .sqS x => .inr (.inr (.inl x))
  | .advS x => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x)))
  | .reseed => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl ()))))
  | .absO x => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x)))))
  | .sqO x => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x))))))
  | .advO x => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x)))))))
  | .absQ => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl ()))))))))
  | .qb x => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x)))))))))
  | .qa x => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x))))))))))
  | .absR => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl ())))))))))))
  | .sqR => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl ()))))))))))))
  | .advR => .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (())))))))))))))

def TRead.ofSum : TSum → TRead
  | .inl _ => .init
  | .inr (.inl x) => .absS x
  | .inr (.inr (.inl x)) => .sqS x
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x))) => .advS x
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _)))) => .reseed
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x))))) => .absO x
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x)))))) => .sqO x
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x))))))) => .advO x
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _)))))))) => .absQ
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x))))))))) => .qb x
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl x)))))))))) => .qa x
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _))))))))))) => .absR
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _)))))))))))) => .sqR
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (_))))))))))))) => .advR

def TRead.equivSum : TRead ≃ TSum where
  toFun := TRead.toSum
  invFun := TRead.ofSum
  left_inv j := by cases j <;> rfl
  right_inv x := by
    rcases x with _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ <;> rfl

instance : Fintype TRead := Fintype.ofEquiv TSum TRead.equivSum.symm

/-- The read count of one attempt's transcript (design §2.1). -/
theorem card_TRead : Fintype.card TRead = 115 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_congr TRead.equivSum]
  simp [TSum, Fintype.card_sum]

/-- Squeeze reads: their answers are the challenge blocks (40 of them). -/
def IsSq : TRead → Prop
  | .sqS _ => True
  | .sqO _ => True
  | .qb _ => True
  | .sqR => True
  | _ => False

/-- The verifier's (and honest prover's) read order. -/
def schedule : List TRead :=
  [.init] ++ (List.finRange 27).flatMap (fun i => [.absS i, .sqS i, .advS i]) ++ [.reseed] ++
    (List.finRange 4).flatMap (fun i => [.absO i, .sqO i, .advO i]) ++ [.absQ] ++
    (List.finRange 8).flatMap (fun k => [.qb k, .qa k]) ++ [.absR, .sqR, .advR]

theorem mem_schedule (j : TRead) : j ∈ schedule := by
  cases j <;> simp [schedule]

/-! ### Coordinates and designated fields -/

inductive Coord
  | root
  | sel
  | ans (j : TRead)
  deriving DecidableEq

def fc : TRead → Coord
  | .init => .root
  | .absS ⟨0, _⟩ => .ans .init
  | .absS ⟨i + 1, h⟩ => .ans (.advS ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  | .sqS i => .ans (.absS i)
  | .advS i => .ans (.absS i)
  | .reseed => .ans (.advS ⟨26, by omega⟩)
  | .absO ⟨0, _⟩ => .ans .reseed
  | .absO ⟨i + 1, h⟩ => .ans (.advO ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  | .sqO i => .ans (.absO i)
  | .advO i => .ans (.absO i)
  | .absQ => .ans (.advO ⟨3, by omega⟩)
  | .qb ⟨0, _⟩ => .ans .absQ
  | .qb ⟨k + 1, h⟩ => .ans (.qa ⟨k, by omega⟩)
  | .qa ⟨0, _⟩ => .ans .absQ
  | .qa ⟨k + 1, h⟩ => .ans (.qa ⟨k, by omega⟩)
  | .absR => .sel
  | .sqR => .ans .absR
  | .advR => .ans .absR

/-! ### Records and addresses -/

/-- Public data and the prover's messages of one attempt. -/
structure Rest where
  framed : Fin 27 → Bytes
  payload : Fin 4 → Bytes
  final : Bytes
  pubB : Bytes
  vtag : UInt8

/-- One attempt's coordinates: every read's answer, the C1 root, k*. -/
structure Rec where
  tr : TRead → Ans
  c1 : Ans
  kstar : Fin 8
  rest : Rest

def fieldVal : Coord → Rec → Ans
  | .root, ρ => ρ.c1
  | .sel, ρ => ρ.tr (.qa ρ.kstar)
  | .ans j, ρ => ρ.tr j

/-- "UNPROVED:R1:PRIVATE-SALTED:SEMANTIC:P3" (r1_wire.rs DOMAIN, P3 build). -/
def semDomain : Bytes := "UNPROVED:R1:PRIVATE-SALTED:SEMANTIC:P3".toUTF8.toList

/-- "UNPROVED:R1:PRIVATE-SALTED:P3" (transcript.rs Transcript::new, P3 build). -/
def openDomain : Bytes := "UNPROVED:R1:PRIVATE-SALTED:P3".toUTF8.toList

def le32 (n : ℕ) : Bytes :=
  [(n % 256).toUInt8, (n / 256 % 256).toUInt8, (n / 65536 % 256).toUInt8,
    (n / 16777216 % 256).toUInt8]

/-- The address of read `j` with designated-field value `f`. -/
def addrWith : TRead → Ans → Rest → Bytes
  | .init, f, r => semDomain ++ [0] ++ le32 r.pubB.length ++ r.pubB ++ ans f
  | .absS i, f, r => ans f ++ ([0, 0xa0 + i.val.toUInt8] ++ r.framed i)
  | .sqS _, f, _ => ans f ++ [1]
  | .advS _, f, _ => ans f ++ [2]
  | .reseed, f, r => openDomain ++ [r.vtag] ++ ans f
  | .absO i, f, r =>
      ans f ++ ([0, 0xa0 + (27 + i.val).toUInt8] ++ le32 (r.payload i).length ++ r.payload i)
  | .sqO _, f, _ => ans f ++ [1]
  | .advO _, f, _ => ans f ++ [2]
  | .absQ, f, r => ans f ++ ([0, 0xa0 + 31] ++ le32 r.final.length ++ r.final)
  | .qb _, f, _ => ans f ++ [1]
  | .qa _, f, _ => ans f ++ [2]
  | .absR, f, _ => ans f ++ ([0, 0xa0 + 32] ++ le32 0)
  | .sqR, f, _ => ans f ++ [1]
  | .advR, f, _ => ans f ++ [2]

def addr (j : TRead) (ρ : Rec) : Bytes := addrWith j (fieldVal (fc j) ρ) ρ.rest

/-- The designated-field reader of read `j`. -/
def extract : TRead → Bytes → Ans
  | .init => trailing
  | .reseed => trailing
  | _ => fixed0

theorem extract_addrWith (j : TRead) (f : Ans) (r : Rest) : extract j (addrWith j f r) = f := by
  cases j <;> first | exact fixed0_ans_append _ _ | exact trailing_append_ans _ _

/-! ### Moving one coordinate -/

def setC : Coord → Rec → Ans → Rec
  | .root, ρ, u => { ρ with c1 := u }
  | .sel, ρ, u => { ρ with tr := Function.update ρ.tr (.qa ρ.kstar) u }
  | .ans j, ρ, u => { ρ with tr := Function.update ρ.tr j u }

theorem fieldVal_setC (c : Coord) (ρ : Rec) (u : Ans) : fieldVal c (setC c ρ u) = u := by
  cases c <;> simp [fieldVal, setC]

theorem rest_setC (c : Coord) (ρ : Rec) (u : Ans) : (setC c ρ u).rest = ρ.rest := by
  cases c <;> rfl

theorem kstar_setC (c : Coord) (ρ : Rec) (u : Ans) : (setC c ρ u).kstar = ρ.kstar := by
  cases c <;> rfl

theorem extract_addr_setC (j : TRead) (ρ : Rec) (u : Ans) :
    extract j (addr j (setC (fc j) ρ u)) = u := by
  unfold addr
  rw [rest_setC, fieldVal_setC]
  exact extract_addrWith _ _ _

/-- `c` reads `c'`: equal, or one is `sel` and the other a `qa` answer
(`sel` is the answer of `qa k*`). -/
def Dep (c c' : Coord) : Prop :=
  c = c' ∨ (c = .sel ∧ ∃ k, c' = .ans (.qa k)) ∨ (c' = .sel ∧ ∃ k, c = .ans (.qa k))

theorem fieldVal_setC_of_not_dep : ∀ (c c' : Coord) (ρ : Rec) (u : Ans), ¬ Dep c c' →
    fieldVal c (setC c' ρ u) = fieldVal c ρ
  | .root, .root, _, _, h => (h (Or.inl rfl)).elim
  | .root, .sel, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .root, .ans _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .sel, .root, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .sel, .sel, _, _, h => (h (Or.inl rfl)).elim
  | .sel, .ans j, ρ, u, h => by
      have hj : TRead.qa ρ.kstar ≠ j := fun e => h (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, ρ.kstar, by rw [e]⟩))
      show Function.update ρ.tr j u (.qa ρ.kstar) = ρ.tr (.qa ρ.kstar)
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _
  | .ans _, .root, _, _, _ => rfl
  | .ans j, .sel, ρ, u, h => by
      have hj : j ≠ TRead.qa ρ.kstar := fun e => h (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, ρ.kstar, by rw [e]⟩))
      show Function.update ρ.tr (.qa ρ.kstar) u j = ρ.tr j
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _
  | .ans j, .ans j', ρ, u, h => by
      have hj : j ≠ j' := fun e => h (Or.inl (by rw [e]))
      show Function.update ρ.tr j' u j = ρ.tr j
      exact Function.update_of_ne hj _ _

theorem addr_setC_of_not_dep (j : TRead) (c : Coord) (ρ : Rec) (u : Ans)
    (h : ¬ Dep (fc j) c) : addr j (setC c ρ u) = addr j ρ := by
  unfold addr
  rw [rest_setC, fieldVal_setC_of_not_dep _ _ _ _ h]

/-! ### The pair table -/

def rep : TRead → TRead
  | .advS i => .sqS i
  | .advO i => .sqO i
  | .qa k => .qb k
  | .advR => .sqR
  | j => j

def back : Coord → TRead
  | .root => .init
  | .sel => .absR
  | .ans .init => .absS 0
  | .ans (.absS i) => .sqS i
  | .ans (.advS i) => if h : i.val + 1 < 27 then .absS ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ else .reseed
  | .ans .reseed => .absO 0
  | .ans (.absO i) => .sqO i
  | .ans (.advO i) => if h : i.val + 1 < 4 then .absO ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ else .absQ
  | .ans .absQ => .qb 0
  | .ans (.qa k) => if h : k.val + 1 < 8 then .qb ⟨k.val + 1, h⟩ else .init
  | .ans .absR => .sqR
  | .ans _ => .init

theorem back_fc : ∀ j : TRead, back (fc j) = rep j
  | .init => rfl
  | .absS ⟨0, _⟩ => rfl
  | .absS ⟨i + 1, h⟩ => by
      show (if h' : i + 1 < 27 then TRead.absS ⟨i + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.reseed) = TRead.absS ⟨i + 1, h⟩
      rw [dif_pos h]
  | .sqS _ => rfl
  | .advS _ => rfl
  | .reseed => by
      show (if h' : 26 + 1 < 27 then TRead.absS ⟨26 + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.reseed) = TRead.reseed
      rw [dif_neg (by omega)]
  | .absO ⟨0, _⟩ => rfl
  | .absO ⟨i + 1, h⟩ => by
      show (if h' : i + 1 < 4 then TRead.absO ⟨i + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.absQ) = TRead.absO ⟨i + 1, h⟩
      rw [dif_pos h]
  | .sqO _ => rfl
  | .advO _ => rfl
  | .absQ => by
      show (if h' : 3 + 1 < 4 then TRead.absO ⟨3 + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.absQ) = TRead.absQ
      rw [dif_neg (by omega)]
  | .qb ⟨0, _⟩ => rfl
  | .qb ⟨k + 1, h⟩ => by
      show (if h' : k + 1 < 8 then TRead.qb ⟨k + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.init) = TRead.qb ⟨k + 1, h⟩
      rw [dif_pos h]
  | .qa ⟨0, _⟩ => rfl
  | .qa ⟨k + 1, h⟩ => by
      show (if h' : k + 1 < 8 then TRead.qb ⟨k + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.init) = TRead.qb ⟨k + 1, h⟩
      rw [dif_pos h]
  | .absR => rfl
  | .sqR => rfl
  | .advR => rfl

/-- Sibling squeeze/advance reads of one state. -/
def Sib (j j' : TRead) : Prop :=
  (∃ i, j = .sqS i ∧ j' = .advS i) ∨ (∃ i, j = .advS i ∧ j' = .sqS i) ∨
  (∃ i, j = .sqO i ∧ j' = .advO i) ∨ (∃ i, j = .advO i ∧ j' = .sqO i) ∨
  (∃ k, j = .qb k ∧ j' = .qa k) ∨ (∃ k, j = .qa k ∧ j' = .qb k) ∨
  (j = .sqR ∧ j' = .advR) ∨ (j = .advR ∧ j' = .sqR)

theorem rep_cases (j j' : TRead) (h : rep j = rep j') : j = j' ∨ Sib j j' := by
  cases j <;> cases j' <;> simp_all [rep, Sib]

theorem ne_suffix (f f' : Ans) : ans f ++ [1] ≠ ans f' ++ [2] := by
  intro h
  have h2 := (List.append_inj h (by rw [length_ans, length_ans])).2
  exact absurd h2 (by decide)

theorem sib_addr_ne (j j' : TRead) (h : Sib j j') (f f' : Ans) (r r' : Rest) :
    addrWith j f r ≠ addrWith j' f' r' := by
  rcases h with ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  all_goals first
    | exact ne_suffix f f'
    | exact fun e => ne_suffix f' f e.symm

theorem fc_eq_sel (j : TRead) (h : fc j = .sel) : j = .absR := by
  have hb := back_fc j
  rw [h] at hb
  rcases rep_cases j .absR hb.symm with e | e
  · exact e
  · simp [Sib] at e

theorem fc_eq_qa (j : TRead) (k : Fin 8) (h : fc j = .ans (.qa k)) :
    (∃ m, j = .qb m) ∨ (∃ m, j = .qa m) := by
  have hb := back_fc j
  rw [h] at hb
  by_cases hk : k.val + 1 < 8
  · have hb' : rep j = rep (.qb ⟨k.val + 1, hk⟩) := by
      rw [← hb]
      show (if h' : k.val + 1 < 8 then TRead.qb ⟨k.val + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.init) =
        TRead.qb ⟨k.val + 1, hk⟩
      rw [dif_pos hk]
    rcases rep_cases j _ hb' with e | e
    · exact Or.inl ⟨_, e⟩
    · simp [Sib] at e
      exact Or.inr ⟨_, e⟩
  · have hb' : rep j = rep .init := by
      rw [← hb]
      show (if h' : k.val + 1 < 8 then TRead.qb ⟨k.val + 1, h'⟩ else TRead.init) = TRead.init
      rw [dif_neg hk]
    rcases rep_cases j _ hb' with e | e
    · subst e
      simp [fc] at h
    · simp [Sib] at e

theorem len_absR (f : Ans) (r : Rest) : (addrWith .absR f r).length = 38 := by
  simp [addrWith, length_ans, le32]

theorem len_qbqa (j : TRead) (hj : (∃ m, j = .qb m) ∨ (∃ m, j = .qa m)) (f : Ans) (r : Rest) :
    (addrWith j f r).length = 33 := by
  rcases hj with ⟨m, rfl⟩ | ⟨m, rfl⟩ <;> simp [addrWith, length_ans]

/-- The pair table: two distinct reads of one attempt either have a
designated field that the other does not read, or never share an address. -/
theorem table (j j' : TRead) (hne : j ≠ j') :
    ¬ Dep (fc j) (fc j') ∨ ∀ ρ : Rec, addr j ρ ≠ addr j' ρ := by
  by_cases hd : Dep (fc j) (fc j')
  · right
    intro ρ
    rcases hd with he | ⟨hs, k, hk⟩ | ⟨hs, k, hk⟩
    · have hr : rep j = rep j' := by rw [← back_fc, ← back_fc, he]
      rcases rep_cases j j' hr with e | e
      · exact absurd e hne
      · exact sib_addr_ne j j' e _ _ _ _
    · have h1 := fc_eq_sel j hs
      subst h1
      intro e
      have hl := congrArg List.length e
      unfold addr at hl
      rw [len_absR, len_qbqa j' (fc_eq_qa j' k hk)] at hl
      omega
    · have h1 := fc_eq_sel j' hs
      subst h1
      intro e
      have hl := congrArg List.length e
      unfold addr at hl
      rw [len_absR, len_qbqa j (fc_eq_qa j k hk)] at hl
      omega
  · exact Or.inl hd

/-- No designated field is a squeeze answer: squeeze answers feed the
decoders only (design §2.2). -/
theorem fc_not_sq (j j' : TRead) (h : fc j = .ans j') : ¬ IsSq j' := by
  intro hs
  have hb := back_fc j
  rw [h] at hb
  have hi : back (.ans j') = .init := by
    cases j' <;> first | rfl | exact False.elim hs
  rw [hi] at hb
  rcases rep_cases j .init hb.symm with e | e
  · subst e
    simp [fc] at h
  · simp [Sib] at e

/-- A chain coordinate: the C1 root, `sel`, or the answer of a non-squeeze
read.  Every designated field is one (`chain_fc`); moving a chain coordinate
leaves the challenges and the prover's messages unchanged. -/
def ChainC (c : Coord) : Prop := ∀ j, c = .ans j → ¬ IsSq j

theorem chain_fc (j : TRead) : ChainC (fc j) := fun j' h => fc_not_sq j j' h

/-! ### Lifting to a space of attempts -/

/-- Per-attempt records on a finite space `S`, with a lawful lens for every
chain coordinate of every attempt: moving chain coordinate `c` of attempt `k`
moves that coordinate of `k`'s record and leaves every other attempt's record
alone. -/
structure TranscriptFrame (S : Type) (N : ℕ) where
  att : Fin N → S → Rec
  lens : Fin N → Coord → Lens S Ans
  rec_same : ∀ k c s u, ChainC c → att k ((lens k c).set s u) = setC c (att k s) u
  rec_other : ∀ k k' c s u, k' ≠ k → att k' ((lens k c).set s u) = att k' s

variable {S : Type} [Fintype S] {N : ℕ}

def taddr (Fr : TranscriptFrame S N) (k : Fin N) (j : TRead) (s : S) : Bytes :=
  addr j (Fr.att k s)

theorem taddr_extract (Fr : TranscriptFrame S N) (k : Fin N) (j : TRead) (s : S) (u : Ans) :
    extract j (taddr Fr k j ((Fr.lens k (fc j)).set s u)) = u := by
  unfold taddr
  rw [Fr.rec_same _ _ _ _ (chain_fc j)]
  exact extract_addr_setC _ _ _

/-- `PairFresh` for every pair of distinct transcript positions, over all
attempts, with designated fields of `2^256 ≥ 2^255` values. -/
theorem pairFresh_transcript (Fr : TranscriptFrame S N) (p p' : Fin N × TRead) (hne : p ≠ p') :
    PairFresh (taddr Fr p.1 p.2) (taddr Fr p'.1 p'.2) (2 ^ 255) ∨
      PairFresh (taddr Fr p'.1 p'.2) (taddr Fr p.1 p.2) (2 ^ 255) := by
  obtain ⟨k, j⟩ := p
  obtain ⟨k', j'⟩ := p'
  by_cases hk : k = k'
  · subst hk
    have hj : j ≠ j' := fun e => hne (by rw [e])
    rcases table j j' hj with hd | hd
    · refine Or.inl (pairFresh_of_lens (Fr.lens k (fc j')) _ _ (extract j') _
        umin_le_card_ans ?_ (taddr_extract Fr k j'))
      intro s u
      unfold taddr
      rw [Fr.rec_same _ _ _ _ (chain_fc j')]
      exact addr_setC_of_not_dep j _ _ _ hd
    · exact Or.inl (pairFresh_of_ne _ _ _ (fun s => hd (Fr.att k s)))
  · refine Or.inl (pairFresh_of_lens (Fr.lens k' (fc j')) _ _ (extract j') _
      umin_le_card_ans ?_ (taddr_extract Fr k' j'))
    intro s u
    unfold taddr
    rw [Fr.rec_other k' k _ _ _ hk]

/-- `HitFresh` for a transcript position whose charging event and adversary
read do not move with the position's designated field. -/
theorem hitFresh_transcript (Fr : TranscriptFrame S N) (k : Fin N) (j : TRead)
    (D : S → Prop) (qa : S → Bytes)
    (hD : ∀ s u, D s → D ((Fr.lens k (fc j)).set s u))
    (hq : ∀ s u, D s → qa ((Fr.lens k (fc j)).set s u) = qa s) :
    HitFresh D qa (taddr Fr k j) (2 ^ 255) :=
  hitFresh_of_lens _ D qa _ (extract j) _ umin_le_card_ans hD hq (taddr_extract Fr k j)

/-- Transcript positions of `N` attempts: `N · 115`. -/
theorem card_positions : Fintype.card (Fin N × TRead) = N * 115 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, card_TRead]

#print axioms TRead.equivSum
#print axioms card_TRead
#print axioms mem_schedule
#print axioms fc_not_sq
#print axioms chain_fc
#print axioms extract_addrWith
#print axioms fieldVal_setC
#print axioms extract_addr_setC
#print axioms fieldVal_setC_of_not_dep
#print axioms addr_setC_of_not_dep
#print axioms back_fc
#print axioms rep_cases
#print axioms sib_addr_ne
#print axioms fc_eq_sel
#print axioms fc_eq_qa
#print axioms table
#print axioms taddr_extract
#print axioms pairFresh_transcript
#print axioms hitFresh_transcript

end R1Z.TranscriptR1

R1Z.GamesR1.text:
import R0Z.HvzkS
import R1Z.ModelsVR1
import R1Z.TranscriptR1

/-! R1 games (zf1/DESIGN-R1-GAMES §3–§6).  Concrete `FSExperiments` and
`AbortBridge` for the retrying R1 prover, over the 115-read transcript layout
of `TranscriptR1`, and the R1 models discharged from them.

* Attempt coins `R1Coins`: every transcript read's answer, the three
  commitment roots (C1, C2, folded), the commitment answers `Cm` (salts,
  leaves, nodes; abstract) and the shared table `Tab`.
* `abR1`: `draw` decodes the 40 squeeze answers; `extend` publishes the view
  together with the VERIFIER LOG (the 115 transcript reads and the
  commitment-opening reads, G-root) and runs the adversary against the
  table programmed at the published addresses; `fail` publishes nothing.
* `fsR1.real`: the honest prover retries up to `N` attempts with fresh
  secrets and accepts on `P ∧ V ∧ ¬ exhausted`; the transcript is computed
  adaptively against the oracle `look tab`.
* `fsR1.ideal`: the same loop on `P` with the simulator's view and the
  middle game's programmed table (witness-free given the simulator).

PROVED: `idealModel_R1` (every field of `R1IdealModelV`: identity coupling,
agreement, freshness), and `realModel_R1`: `R1RealModelV` with
`M = N · (115 + Mc)` positions, where the transcript `HitFresh` /
`PairFresh` facts and the transcript–commitment cross pairs are theorems,
from `R1RealData`: the coupling with a coordinate-projection `toM` (G-prog),
agreement outside the events (G-ref), the commitment-read layout
(`CmLayout`, H-layout for salts/leaves/nodes) and the exhaustion mass. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.GamesR1
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS
  R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.Batched R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Adversaries: adaptive oracle programs -/

inductive OProg
  | done
  | query (a : List UInt8) (k : OracleAnswer → OProg)

/-- The adversary's query/answer log against oracle `O`, at most `n` reads. -/
def runLog : OProg → (List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) → ℕ → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)
  | .done, _, _ => []
  | .query _ _, _, 0 => []
  | .query a k, O, n + 1 => (a, O a) :: runLog (k (O a)) O n

/-- A post-proof adversary: a query program on the published data and a
decision on its whole view (published data and its own log). -/
structure R1Adv (K CommitHandle Aux : Type) [Field K] where
  prog : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg
  decide : ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat → Bool

/-! ### Attempt coins and the wire data -/

/-- Transcript answers, roots (C1, C2, folded), commitment answers, table. -/
abbrev R1Coins (Cm Tab : Type) :=
  (TRead → OracleAnswer) × (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) × Cm × Tab

/-- The R1 wire data (REF: r1_wire.rs / verifier.rs / sampler.rs). -/
structure R1Wire (K CommitHandle Aux : Type) [Field K] where
  Cm : Type
  finCm : Fintype Cm
  neCm : Nonempty Cm
  Tab : Type
  finTab : Fintype Tab
  neTab : Nonempty Tab
  /-- the shared table read as an oracle -/
  look : Tab → List UInt8 → OracleAnswer
  /-- framed records of rows 0..26; row 2 carries the C2 root -/
  frame : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat → OracleAnswer → Fin 27 → List UInt8
  /-- payloads of rows 27..30; row 30 carries the folded root -/
  payload : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat → OracleAnswer → Fin 4 → List UInt8
  /-- row 31's final message -/
  final : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat → List UInt8
  pubBytes : Statement K CommitHandle → List UInt8
  vtag : UInt8
  /-- the decoders of the 27 semantic, 4 opening, 8 query and the ρ blocks -/
  dec : (Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) → (Fin 4 → OracleAnswer) → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) →
    OracleAnswer → Challenges K
  /-- the QueryScan completion index -/
  kstarOf : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Fin 8
  /-- the verifier's reads on the opened paths (leaves with opened salts, nodes) -/
  comLog : Cm → (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat → Challenges K →
    List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)
  failView : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat
  qmax : ℕ

attribute [instance] R1Wire.finCm R1Wire.neCm R1Wire.finTab R1Wire.neTab

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

section Wire
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)

def chOf (tr : TRead → OracleAnswer) : Challenges K :=
  W.dec (fun i => tr (.sqS i)) (fun i => tr (.sqO i)) (fun k => tr (.qb k)) (tr .sqR)

def drawW (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) : Challenges K := chOf W c.1

/-- The record of an attempt whose published view is `V`. -/
def recP (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (V : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (tr : TRead → OracleAnswer) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) : Rec :=
  ⟨tr, roots 0, W.kstarOf (fun k => tr (.qb k)),
    ⟨W.frame V (roots 1), W.payload V (roots 2), W.final V, W.pubBytes x, W.vtag⟩⟩

/-- The verifier's transcript reads, in schedule order. -/
def tLog (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (V : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) :=
  TranscriptR1.schedule.map (fun j => (addr j (recP W x V c.1 c.2.1), c.1 j))

/-- The verifier log (G-root): transcript reads, then the opening reads. -/
def verLog (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (V : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) :=
  tLog W x V c ++ W.comLog c.2.2.1 c.2.1 V (drawW W c)

/-- The table programmed at the published addresses. -/
def progOracle (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (V : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (tab : W.Tab) : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer := fun a =>
  match List.lookup a (verLog W x V c) with
  | some v => v
  | none => W.look tab a

/-- The R1 abort bridge; the shared table is attempt 0's table coordinate. -/
def abR1 (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat (R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) where
  Coins := R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab
  finiteCoins := inferInstance
  nonemptyCoins := inferInstance
  N := N
  draw := fun _ _ c => drawW W c
  extend := fun adv x c k V =>
    ⟨V, verLog W x V (c k) ++
      runLog (adv.prog V (verLog W x V (c k))) (progOracle W x V (c k) (c ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax⟩
  fail := fun adv _ c =>
    ⟨W.failView, runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) (W.look (c ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax⟩

end Wire

/-! ### The generic retry output -/

def retryOut {C T V O : Type} (N : ℕ) (Pd : C → Prop) (pub : C → T → V)
    (ext : (Fin N → C) → Fin N → V → O) (fail : (Fin N → C) → O)
    (ct : (Fin N → C) × (Fin N → T)) : O :=
  match firstGood Pd ct.1 with
  | none => fail ct.1
  | some k => ext ct.1 k (pub (ct.1 k) (ct.2 k))

theorem retryOut_bit {C T V O : Type} (N : ℕ) (Pd : C → Prop) (pub : C → T → V)
    (ext : (Fin N → C) → Fin N → V → O) (fail : (Fin N → C) → O) (obs : O → ℚ)
    (ct : (Fin N → C) × (Fin N → T)) :
    obs (retryOut N Pd pub ext fail ct) =
      retryTest N Pd pub (fun c k v => obs (ext c k v)) (fun c => obs (fail c)) ct := by
  unfold retryOut retryTest
  cases firstGood Pd ct.1 <;> rfl

/-! ### The honest retrying prover -/

/-- The commitment phase (REF: prover.rs, host_commitment.rs, state_only_entropy.rs):
from the oracle, one attempt's fresh secrets and the instance, the mask tape
(rejection decode of the expander answers), the three roots, the opening
reads as a function of the challenges, and the exhaustion flag. -/
structure R1Prover (K CommitHandle Aux : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K)
    (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) where
  Secrets : Type
  finSec : Fintype Secrets
  neSec : Nonempty Secrets
  commit : (h : HonestProver K) → (List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) → Secrets → h.Instance →
    Tape K F × (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) × (Challenges K → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) × Bool

attribute [instance] R1Prover.finSec R1Prover.neSec

structure AttemptOut (K CommitHandle Aux : Type) [Field K] where
  ch : Challenges K
  view : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat
  log : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)
  exh : Bool

section Prover
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)

/-- One honest attempt.  The transcript is run in schedule order; each read's
address uses the answers so far and the messages of the view at the challenges
decoded so far (unanswered blocks read as 0).  The published log is the
verifier's recomputation from the final view. -/
def realAttempt (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (sec : Pr.Secrets) : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux :=
  let cm := Pr.commit h H sec w
  let step : (TRead → OracleAnswer) → TRead → (TRead → OracleAnswer) := fun tr j =>
    Function.update tr j
      (H (addr j (recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr) cm.1) tr cm.2.1)))
  let trF := TranscriptR1.schedule.foldl step (fun _ _ => 0)
  let V := view h B outputs x w (chOf W trF) cm.1
  ⟨chOf W trF, V,
    TranscriptR1.schedule.map (fun j => (addr j (recP W x V trF cm.2.1), H (addr j (recP W x V trF cm.2.1)))) ++
      cm.2.2.1 (chOf W trF),
    cm.2.2.2⟩

/-- The real game: `N` attempts with independent secrets against one oracle;
the first attempt with `P ∧ V ∧ ¬ exhausted` is published with its verifier
log, nothing of the others; the failure exit publishes nothing. -/
def realGame (N : ℕ) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → Pr.Secrets)) :
    ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat :=
  let H := W.look r.1
  let out : Fin N → AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux := fun k =>
    realAttempt W Pr h B outputs x w H (r.2 k)
  match firstGood (fun o : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux => P o.ch ∧ Vp h o.ch w ∧ o.exh = false) out with
  | none => ⟨W.failView, runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) H W.qmax⟩
  | some k => ⟨(out k).view, (out k).log ++ runLog (adv.prog (out k).view (out k).log) H W.qmax⟩

/-- The R1 Fiat-Shamir experiments. -/
def fsR1 (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F where
  Adversary := R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux
  RealRand := W.Tab × (Fin N → Pr.Secrets)
  IdealRand := (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)
  real := fun h B outputs adv x w r => realGame W Pr N P Vp h B outputs adv x w r
  ideal := fun sim adv x r =>
    retryOut N (fun c => P (drawW W c)) (fun c t => sim (drawW W c) t)
      (fun c k v => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x c k v) (fun c => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x c) r
  observe := fun adv rv => adv.decide rv

instance instRealFin (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Fintype (fsR1 (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (W.Tab × (Fin N → Pr.Secrets)))

instance instRealNe (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Nonempty (fsR1 (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Nonempty (W.Tab × (Fin N → Pr.Secrets)))

instance instIdealFin (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Fintype (fsR1 (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).IdealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype ((Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)))

instance instIdealNe (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Nonempty (fsR1 (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).IdealRand := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  exact inferInstanceAs (Nonempty ((Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)))

end Prover

/-! ### The ideal model: every field proved -/

/-- The identity coupling of a finite uniform type. -/
def idCoupling (R : Type) [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] : Coupling R R where
  S := R
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := id
  toM := id
  meanR _ := rfl
  meanM _ := rfl

theorem idealModel_R1 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (M Umin : ℕ) :
    R1IdealModelV P h V B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1 W N hN) x M Umin := by
  intro hx adv
  refine ⟨idCoupling _, fun _ => False, fun _ _ => [], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s _
    exact (retryOut_bit N (fun c => P (drawW W c))
      (fun c t => simV h B outputs x hx V (drawW W c) t)
      (fun c k v => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x c k v) (fun c => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x c)
      (fun o => bit (adv.decide o)) s).symm
  · intro j j' _ hp
    rcases hp with hp | hp <;> exact False.elim hp

/-- ZF2 form (primary, LOG D44): for ANY simulator, in particular `simE`, the
simulator game of `fsR1` is the abort-middle game, pointwise.  This is the
agreement field of `R1Z.SimulatorR1.R1IdealModelS`. -/
theorem ideal_agree_S (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (s : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)) :
    middleIdealAbortS P (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1 W N hN) adv x sim s =
      idealTestS (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) adv x sim s :=
  (retryOut_bit N (fun c => P (drawW W c)) (fun c t => sim (drawW W c) t)
    (fun c k v => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x c k v) (fun c => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x c)
    (fun o => bit (adv.decide o)) s).symm

/-- The body of `R1IdealModelS` for `fsR1` / `abR1` and any simulator: the
identity coupling, agreement everywhere, no private position. -/
theorem idealModelS_body (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (M Umin : ℕ) (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) :
    ∃ (cp : Coupling (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp).IdealRand
        ((Fin (abR1 W N hN).N → (abR1 W N hN).Coins) × (Fin (abR1 W N hN).N → Tape K F)))
      (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → cp.S → List UInt8),
      (∀ s, ¬ CollEv M priv addr s →
        middleIdealAbortS P (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1 W N hN) adv x sim (cp.toM s) =
          idealTestS (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) adv x sim (cp.toR s)) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨ PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin) := by
  refine ⟨idCoupling _, fun _ => False, fun _ _ => [], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s _
    exact ideal_agree_S W Pr N hN P Vp x sim adv s
  · intro j j' _ hp
    rcases hp with hp | hp <;> exact False.elim hp

/-! ### Coordinate lenses on the attempt coins -/

section Lenses
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)

def ksC (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) : Fin 8 := W.kstarOf (fun k => c.1 (.qb k))

theorem ksC_congr (c c' : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (h : ∀ k, c.1 (.qb k) = c'.1 (.qb k)) :
    ksC W c = ksC W c' := by
  unfold ksC
  rw [show (fun k => c.1 (.qb k)) = (fun k => c'.1 (.qb k)) from funext h]

theorem chOf_congr (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (h : ∀ j, IsSq j → tr j = tr' j) :
    chOf (K := K) W tr = chOf W tr' := by
  unfold chOf
  rw [show (fun i => tr (.sqS i)) = (fun i => tr' (.sqS i)) from funext fun i => h _ trivial,
    show (fun i => tr (.sqO i)) = (fun i => tr' (.sqO i)) from funext fun i => h _ trivial,
    show (fun k => tr (.qb k)) = (fun k => tr' (.qb k)) from funext fun k => h _ trivial,
    h .sqR trivial]

theorem ksC_update_qa (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (m : Fin 8) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    ksC W (Function.update c.1 (.qa m) u, c.2) = ksC W c :=
  ksC_congr W _ _ (fun k => Function.update_of_ne (show TRead.qb k ≠ TRead.qa m by simp) u c.1)

def coinLens : Coord → Lens (R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) OracleAnswer
  | .root =>
    { get := fun c => c.2.1 0
      set := fun c u => (c.1, Function.update c.2.1 0 u, c.2.2)
      get_set := fun c u => by simp
      set_get := fun c => by simp
      set_set := fun c u u' => by simp }
  | .ans j =>
    { get := fun c => c.1 j
      set := fun c u => (Function.update c.1 j u, c.2)
      get_set := fun c u => by simp
      set_get := fun c => by simp
      set_set := fun c u u' => by simp }
  | .sel =>
    { get := fun c => c.1 (.qa (ksC W c))
      set := fun c u => (Function.update c.1 (.qa (ksC W c)) u, c.2)
      get_set := fun c u => by
        show Function.update c.1 (.qa (ksC W c)) u
          (.qa (ksC W (Function.update c.1 (.qa (ksC W c)) u, c.2))) = u
        rw [ksC_update_qa]
        simp
      set_get := fun c => by simp
      set_set := fun c u u' => by
        show (Function.update (Function.update c.1 (.qa (ksC W c)) u)
            (.qa (ksC W (Function.update c.1 (.qa (ksC W c)) u, c.2))) u', c.2) =
          (Function.update c.1 (.qa (ksC W c)) u', c.2)
        rw [ksC_update_qa]
        simp }

/-- A chain lens leaves every squeeze answer, the commitment answers and the
table unchanged. -/
theorem coinLens_sq (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c) (cc : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (u : OracleAnswer)
    (j : TRead) (hj : IsSq j) : ((coinLens W c).set cc u).1 j = cc.1 j := by
  cases c with
  | root => rfl
  | sel =>
      show Function.update cc.1 (.qa (ksC W cc)) u j = cc.1 j
      refine Function.update_of_ne ?_ _ _
      rintro rfl
      exact hj
  | ans j0 =>
      show Function.update cc.1 j0 u j = cc.1 j
      refine Function.update_of_ne ?_ _ _
      rintro rfl
      exact hc _ rfl hj

theorem coinLens_tail (c : Coord) (cc : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    ((coinLens W c).set cc u).2.2 = cc.2.2 := by
  cases c <;> rfl

theorem drawW_coinLens (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c) (cc : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    drawW (K := K) W ((coinLens W c).set cc u) = drawW W cc :=
  chOf_congr W _ _ (fun j hj => coinLens_sq W c hc cc u j hj)

/-- The lens of coordinate `c` of attempt `k` on the abort-middle coins. -/
abbrev midLens (N : ℕ) (k : Fin N) (c : Coord) :
    Lens ((Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)) OracleAnswer :=
  Lens.pi k (coinLens W c)

/-- The record of attempt `k` in the middle game. -/
def attR (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) {N : ℕ} (ct : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F))
    (k : Fin N) : Rec :=
  recP W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k)) (ct.2 k)) (ct.1 k).1 (ct.1 k).2.1

theorem attR_same (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) {N : ℕ} (k : Fin N) (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c)
    (ct : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    attR W h B outputs x w ((midLens W N k c).set ct u) k = setC c (attR W h B outputs x w ct k) u := by
  unfold attR
  rw [Lens.pi_set_fst_eq, Lens.pi_set_snd, drawW_coinLens W c hc]
  cases c with
  | root =>
      show recP W x _ (ct.1 k).1 (Function.update (ct.1 k).2.1 0 u) = _
      simp only [recP, setC]
      rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0),
        Function.update_of_ne (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)]
      all_goals rfl
  | sel =>
      show recP W x _ (Function.update (ct.1 k).1 (.qa (ksC W (ct.1 k))) u) (ct.1 k).2.1 = _
      simp only [recP, setC]
      have hk : W.kstarOf (fun m => Function.update (ct.1 k).1 (.qa (ksC W (ct.1 k))) u (.qb m)) =
          W.kstarOf (fun m => (ct.1 k).1 (.qb m)) :=
        ksC_update_qa W (ct.1 k) (ksC W (ct.1 k)) u
      rw [hk]
      all_goals rfl
  | ans j =>
      show recP W x _ (Function.update (ct.1 k).1 j u) (ct.1 k).2.1 = _
      simp only [recP, setC]
      have hk : W.kstarOf (fun m => Function.update (ct.1 k).1 j u (.qb m)) =
          W.kstarOf (fun m => (ct.1 k).1 (.qb m)) :=
        ksC_congr W (Function.update (ct.1 k).1 j u, (ct.1 k).2) (ct.1 k)
          (fun m => coinLens_sq W (.ans j) hc (ct.1 k) u (.qb m) trivial)
      rw [hk]
      all_goals rfl

theorem attR_other (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) {N : ℕ} (k k' : Fin N) (c : Coord)
    (ct : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)) (u : OracleAnswer) (hk : k' ≠ k) :
    attR W h B outputs x w ((midLens W N k c).set ct u) k' = attR W h B outputs x w ct k' := by
  unfold attR
  rw [Lens.pi_set_fst_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk, Lens.pi_set_snd]

end Lenses

/-! ### The real model -/

section Real
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)

abbrev Mid := (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)

/-- The accepted attempt of the middle game (`P ∧ V` on the drawn challenges). -/
def accR (w : h.Instance) (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) : Option (Fin N) :=
  firstGood (fun c => P (drawW W c) ∧ V (drawW W c) w) ct.1

/-- Attempt `k` was run and discarded. -/
def discR (w : h.Instance) (k : Fin N) (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) : Prop :=
  match accR W N P h V w ct with
  | none => True
  | some k₀ => k < k₀

/-- The adversary's own log in the middle game (as in `extend` / `fail`). -/
def advLogR (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) :
    List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) :=
  match accR W N P h V w ct with
  | none => runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) (W.look (ct.1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax
  | some k₀ =>
      runLog (adv.prog (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k₀)) (ct.2 k₀))
          (verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k₀)) (ct.2 k₀)) (ct.1 k₀)))
        (progOracle W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k₀)) (ct.2 k₀)) (ct.1 k₀)
          (ct.1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax

def qryR (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (i : Fin W.qmax)
    (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) : List UInt8 :=
  ((advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv ct).getD i.val ([], fun _ => 0)).1

theorem accR_midLens (w : h.Instance) (k : Fin N) (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c)
    (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    accR W N P h V w ((midLens W N k c).set ct u) = accR W N P h V w ct := by
  unfold accR
  have e1 : firstGood (fun c => P (drawW W c) ∧ V (drawW W c) w) ((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 =
      firstGood (fun j => P (drawW W (((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 j)) ∧
        V (drawW W (((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 j)) w) id := rfl
  have e2 : firstGood (fun c => P (drawW W c) ∧ V (drawW W c) w) ct.1 =
      firstGood (fun j => P (drawW W (ct.1 j)) ∧ V (drawW W (ct.1 j)) w) id := rfl
  rw [e1, e2]
  apply firstGood_congr
  intro j
  dsimp only [id]
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, show ((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 k = (coinLens W c).set (ct.1 k) u from
      Lens.pi_set_fst_eq _ _ _ _, drawW_coinLens W c hc]
  · rw [show ((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 j = ct.1 j from Lens.pi_set_fst_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

theorem tab0_midLens (k : Fin N) (c : Coord) (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) (u : OracleAnswer)
    (j : Fin N) : (((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 j).2.2.2 = (ct.1 j).2.2.2 := by
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, show ((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 k = (coinLens W c).set (ct.1 k) u from
      Lens.pi_set_fst_eq _ _ _ _, coinLens_tail]
  · rw [show ((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 j = ct.1 j from Lens.pi_set_fst_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

/-- On a discarded attempt, the adversary's reads do not see its coordinates. -/
theorem advLogR_midLens (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (k : Fin N) (c : Coord)
    (hc : ChainC c) (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) (u : OracleAnswer) (hd : discR W N P h V w k ct) :
    advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv ((midLens W N k c).set ct u) =
      advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv ct := by
  unfold advLogR
  rw [accR_midLens W N P h V w k c hc ct u]
  rcases ha : accR W N P h V w ct with _ | k₀
  · simp only [tab0_midLens]
  · have hd' : k < k₀ := by
      unfold discR at hd
      rw [ha] at hd
      exact hd
    have hne : k₀ ≠ k := fun e => by subst e; exact lt_irrefl _ hd'
    simp only [tab0_midLens,
      show ((midLens W N k c).set ct u).1 k₀ = ct.1 k₀ from Lens.pi_set_fst_ne _ _ _ _ _ hne,
      show ((midLens W N k c).set ct u).2 = ct.2 from rfl]

theorem discR_midLens (w : h.Instance) (k k' : Fin N) (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c)
    (ct : Mid (F := F) W N) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    discR W N P h V w k' ((midLens W N k c).set ct u) = discR W N P h V w k' ct := by
  unfold discR
  rw [accR_midLens W N P h V w k c hc ct u]

/-- The commitment-read layout (H-layout for salts, leaves, nodes, expander
and seed reads; design §6.3), on the real coupling space. -/
structure CmLayout (S : Type) [Fintype S] (q Mc : ℕ) (qry : Fin q → S → List UInt8)
    (Lc : Fin N → Coord → Lens S OracleAnswer) where
  charged : Fin N → Fin Mc → S → Prop
  priv : Fin N → Fin Mc → Prop
  caddr : Fin N → Fin Mc → S → List UInt8
  hit : ∀ k c i, HitFresh (charged k c) (qry i) (caddr k c) (2 ^ 255)
  pair : ∀ p p' : Fin N × Fin Mc, p ≠ p' → (priv p.1 p.2 ∨ priv p'.1 p'.2) →
    PairFresh (caddr p.1 p.2) (caddr p'.1 p'.2) (2 ^ 255) ∨
      PairFresh (caddr p'.1 p'.2) (caddr p.1 p.2) (2 ^ 255)
  cross : ∀ k c k' coord s u, ChainC coord → caddr k c ((Lc k' coord).set s u) = caddr k c s

/-- The data of the real coupling for one adversary and witness: the coupling
(G-prog: lazy programming, with `toM` a coordinate projection — `hLc`), the
commitment layout, and the exhaustion event. -/
structure R1RealData (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance) (Mc : ℕ) where
  cp : Coupling (fsR1 (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand (Mid (F := F) W N)
  Lc : Fin N → Coord → Lens cp.S OracleAnswer
  hLc : ∀ k c s u, cp.toM ((Lc k c).set s u) = (midLens W N k c).set (cp.toM s) u
  cm : CmLayout N cp.S W.qmax Mc
    (fun i s => qryR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i (cp.toM s)) Lc
  exh : cp.S → Prop

variable {W Pr N hN P Vp h V B outputs x}

def R1RealData.frame {adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux} {w : h.Instance} {Mc : ℕ}
    (d : R1RealData W Pr N hN P Vp h V B outputs x adv w Mc) : TranscriptFrame d.cp.S N where
  att k s := attR W h B outputs x w (d.cp.toM s) k
  lens := d.Lc
  rec_same k c s u hc := by
    show attR W h B outputs x w (d.cp.toM ((d.Lc k c).set s u)) k = _
    rw [d.hLc]
    exact attR_same W h B outputs x w k c hc _ u
  rec_other k k' c s u hk := by
    show attR W h B outputs x w (d.cp.toM ((d.Lc k c).set s u)) k' = _
    rw [d.hLc]
    exact attR_other W h B outputs x w k k' c _ u hk

abbrev Pos (N Mc : ℕ) := Fin N × (TRead ⊕ Fin Mc)

theorem card_pos (Mc : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Pos N Mc) = N * (115 + Mc) := by
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_sum, card_TRead, Fintype.card_fin]

def posEquiv (Mc : ℕ) : Fin (N * (115 + Mc)) ≃ Pos N Mc :=
  (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (card_pos (N := N) Mc)).symm

section Events
variable {adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux} {w : h.Instance} {Mc : ℕ}
  (d : R1RealData W Pr N hN P Vp h V B outputs x adv w Mc)

def R1RealData.chargedP (p : Pos N Mc) : d.cp.S → Prop :=
  Sum.elim (fun _ s => discR W N P h V w p.1 (d.cp.toM s)) (fun c => d.cm.charged p.1 c) p.2

def R1RealData.privP (p : Pos N Mc) : Prop :=
  Sum.elim (fun _ => True) (fun c => d.cm.priv p.1 c) p.2

def R1RealData.addrP (p : Pos N Mc) : d.cp.S → List UInt8 :=
  Sum.elim (fun j => taddr d.frame p.1 j) (fun c => d.cm.caddr p.1 c) p.2

def R1RealData.qryS (i : Fin W.qmax) (s : d.cp.S) : List UInt8 :=
  qryR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i (d.cp.toM s)

/-- Agreement of the real game with the middle game outside the events
(G-ref: the Rust prover refines `realAttempt`, and the real oracle equals the
programmed table off the charged reads). -/
def R1RealData.Agree : Prop :=
  ∀ s, ¬ HitEv (N * (115 + Mc)) W.qmax (fun i => d.chargedP (posEquiv Mc i)) d.qryS
      (fun i => d.addrP (posEquiv Mc i)) s →
    ¬ (CollEv (N * (115 + Mc)) (fun i => d.privP (posEquiv Mc i))
        (fun i => d.addrP (posEquiv Mc i)) s ∨ d.exh s) →
    realTest h B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) adv x w (d.cp.toR s) =
      middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1 W N hN) adv x w (d.cp.toM s)

theorem R1RealData.hit (p : Pos N Mc) (i : Fin W.qmax) :
    HitFresh (d.chargedP p) (d.qryS i) (d.addrP p) (2 ^ 255) := by
  obtain ⟨k, j | c⟩ := p
  · refine hitFresh_transcript d.frame k j _ _ ?_ ?_
    · intro s u hs
      show discR W N P h V w k (d.cp.toM ((d.Lc k (fc j)).set s u))
      rw [d.hLc, discR_midLens W N P h V w k k (fc j) (chain_fc j)]
      exact hs
    · intro s u hs
      show ((advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv (d.cp.toM ((d.Lc k (fc j)).set s u))).getD
          i.val ([], fun _ => 0)).1 =
        ((advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv (d.cp.toM s)).getD i.val ([], fun _ => 0)).1
      rw [d.hLc, advLogR_midLens W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv k (fc j) (chain_fc j) _ u hs]
  · exact d.cm.hit k c i

theorem R1RealData.pair (p p' : Pos N Mc) (hne : p ≠ p') (hpr : d.privP p ∨ d.privP p') :
    PairFresh (d.addrP p) (d.addrP p') (2 ^ 255) ∨ PairFresh (d.addrP p') (d.addrP p) (2 ^ 255) := by
  obtain ⟨k, j | c⟩ := p <;> obtain ⟨k', j' | c'⟩ := p'
  · have hne' : (k, j) ≠ (k', j') := fun e => hne (by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj e
      rfl)
    exact pairFresh_transcript d.frame (k, j) (k', j') hne'
  · refine Or.inr (pairFresh_of_lens (d.Lc k (fc j)) _ _ (extract j) _ umin_le_card_ans ?_
      (taddr_extract d.frame k j))
    intro s u
    exact d.cm.cross k' c' k (fc j) s u (chain_fc j)
  · refine Or.inl (pairFresh_of_lens (d.Lc k' (fc j')) _ _ (extract j') _ umin_le_card_ans ?_
      (taddr_extract d.frame k' j'))
    intro s u
    exact d.cm.cross k c k' (fc j') s u (chain_fc j')
  · have hne' : (k, c) ≠ (k', c') := fun e => hne (by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj e
      rfl)
    exact d.cm.pair (k, c) (k', c') hne' hpr

end Events

/-- The real model from the R1 games: the transcript freshness tables, the
cross pairs and the position count are proved; the coupling, agreement,
commitment layout and exhaustion mass are the `R1RealData` hypotheses. -/
theorem realModel_R1 (Mc : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      ∃ d : R1RealData W Pr N hN P Vp h V B outputs x adv w Mc,
        d.Agree ∧ mass d.exh ≤ εexh) :
    R1RealModelV P h V B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1 W N hN) x
      (N * (115 + Mc)) W.qmax (2 ^ 255) εexh := by
  intro adv w hw
  obtain ⟨d, hag, hex⟩ := hd adv w hw
  refine ⟨d.cp, fun i => d.chargedP (posEquiv Mc i), fun i => d.privP (posEquiv Mc i),
    fun i => d.addrP (posEquiv Mc i), d.qryS, d.exh, hag, ?_, ?_, hex⟩
  · intro j i
    exact d.hit (posEquiv Mc j) i
  · intro j j' hj hp
    exact d.pair (posEquiv Mc j) (posEquiv Mc j')
      (fun e => (ne_of_lt hj) ((posEquiv Mc).injective e)) hp

end Real

R1Z.LazyTable.text:
import R0Z.FsAbortBounds

/-! G-prog, generic part (DESIGN-ZF1-COUPLINGS-R1 §3.1): the lazy-programming
law for a uniform random table over a finite address set.

Setting: a finite address type `A`, a finite answer type `U`, a table
`t : A → U` and `m` reads whose addresses `a i u` are CAUSAL — read `i`'s
address depends only on the answers `u j` with `j < i`.

* `prog a t u` reprograms `t` at the read addresses with the answers `u`,
  first write wins (an address read twice keeps its first answer).
* `sum_prog` / `mean_prog` (meanR): if `t` and `u` are uniform and
  independent, `prog a t u` is a uniform table.  Proof: peel the last read;
  for fixed earlier answers, `(t, v) ↦ update t x v` is `|U|`-to-one onto
  the tables (`sum_update`).
* `prog_first` / `prog_off`: the programmed table answers every
  first-occurrence read address with its coordinate and is `t` elsewhere.
* `run_unique` / `run_eq`: an adaptive run against `prog a t u` (the real
  oracle) whose addresses are pairwise distinct has exactly the answers `u`
  (the middle game's coins).  This is the agreement half of G-prog.

Everything is symbolic: no table, address set or answer type is
enumerated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LazyTable
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbortBounds
variable {A U : Type}

/-! ### Splitting a table at one address -/

def splitAt [DecidableEq A] (x : A) : (A → U) ≃ U × ({j // j ≠ x} → U) where
  toFun t := (t x, fun j => t j.1)
  invFun p j := if h : j = x then p.1 else p.2 ⟨j, h⟩
  left_inv t := by
    funext j
    by_cases h : j = x
    · subst h
      simp
    · simp [h]
  right_inv p := by
    obtain ⟨w, r⟩ := p
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · funext j
      simp [j.2]

theorem update_splitAt_symm [DecidableEq A] (x : A) (w v : U) (r : {j // j ≠ x} → U) :
    Function.update ((splitAt x).symm (w, r)) x v = (splitAt x).symm (v, r) := by
  funext j
  by_cases h : j = x
  · subst h
    simp [splitAt]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h]
    simp [splitAt, h]

/-- `(t, v) ↦ update t x v` is `|U|`-to-one onto the tables. -/
theorem sum_update [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A] [Fintype U] (x : A) (G : (A → U) → ℚ) :
    ∑ t : A → U, ∑ v : U, G (Function.update t x v) = (Fintype.card U : ℚ) * ∑ t, G t := by
  have e1 : ∑ t : A → U, ∑ v : U, G (Function.update t x v) =
      ∑ p : U × ({j // j ≠ x} → U), ∑ v : U, G (Function.update ((splitAt x).symm p) x v) :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (splitAt x) _ _ (fun t => by simp)
  have e2 : ∑ t : A → U, G t = ∑ p : U × ({j // j ≠ x} → U), G ((splitAt x).symm p) :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (splitAt x) _ _ (fun t => by simp)
  rw [e1, e2, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [update_splitAt_symm]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_comm]

/-! ### Programming, first write wins -/

variable [DecidableEq A]

/-- Program `t` at the addresses `b` with the answers `u`; the earliest
index wins (the last read is written first, then overwritten by earlier
ones). -/
def progV : (m : ℕ) → (Fin m → A) → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → (A → U)
  | 0, _, _, t => t
  | m + 1, b, u, t =>
      progV m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) (Function.update t (b (Fin.last m)) (u (Fin.last m)))

/-- Read `i`'s address depends only on the answers of the reads before it. -/
def Causal {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A) : Prop :=
  ∀ i u u', (∀ j, j < i → u j = u' j) → a i u = a i u'

/-- The programmed table of the adaptive reads `a` with answers `u`. -/
def prog {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A) (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) : A → U :=
  progV m (fun i => a i u) u t

theorem progV_off : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → A) (u : Fin m → U) (t : A → U) (y : A),
    (∀ i, b i ≠ y) → progV m b u t y = t y
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, b, u, t, y, hb => by
      show progV m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ y = t y
      rw [progV_off m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ y (fun i => hb _)]
      exact Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm (hb _)) _ _

/-- A first-occurrence address is answered by its own coordinate. -/
theorem progV_first : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → A) (u : Fin m → U) (t : A → U) (i : Fin m),
    (∀ j, j < i → b j ≠ b i) → progV m b u t (b i) = u i
  | 0, _, _, _, i, _ => i.elim0
  | m + 1, b, u, t, i, hb => by
      show progV m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ (b i) = u i
      by_cases hi : i = Fin.last m
      · subst hi
        rw [progV_off m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ _ (fun j => hb _ (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j))]
        exact Function.update_self _ _ _
      · obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi
        exact progV_first m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ i'
          (fun j hj => hb _ (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mpr hj))

theorem prog_off {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A) (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) (y : A)
    (hy : ∀ i, a i u ≠ y) : prog a t u y = t y :=
  progV_off m _ u t y hy

theorem prog_first {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A) (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) (i : Fin m)
    (hi : ∀ j, j < i → a j u ≠ a i u) : prog a t u (a i u) = u i :=
  progV_first m _ u t i hi

/-! ### The lazy-programming law -/

section Law
variable [Fintype A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

theorem causal_tail {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → A) (ha : Causal a)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (u : Fin m → U) (v v' : U) (hi : i = Fin.last m ∨ ∃ i', i = Fin.castSucc i') :
    a i (Fin.snoc u v) = a i (Fin.snoc u v') := by
  refine ha i _ _ (fun j hj => ?_)
  have hj' : j ≠ Fin.last m := by
    rcases hi with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
    · exact ne_of_lt hj
    · exact ne_of_lt (lt_trans hj (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i'))
  obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hj'
  simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]

/-- The read program of the first `m` reads, with the last answer fixed to `v₀`. -/
def headProg {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → A) (v₀ : U) :
    Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A :=
  fun i u => a (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.snoc u v₀)

theorem headProg_causal {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → A) (ha : Causal a) (v₀ : U) :
    Causal (headProg a v₀) := by
  intro i u u' h
  refine ha _ _ _ (fun j hj => ?_)
  have hj' : j ≠ Fin.last m := ne_of_lt (lt_trans hj (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i))
  obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hj'
  simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  exact h j' (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mp hj)

theorem prog_snoc {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → A) (ha : Causal a) (v₀ : U)
    (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) (v : U) :
    prog a t (Fin.snoc u v) =
      prog (headProg a v₀) (Function.update t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀)) v) u := by
  show progV m (Fin.init (fun i => a i (Fin.snoc u v))) (Fin.init (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => U) u v))
      (Function.update t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v)) (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => U) u v (Fin.last m))) =
    progV m (fun i => headProg a v₀ i u) u (Function.update t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀)) v)
  rw [Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last, causal_tail a ha (Fin.last m) u v v₀ (Or.inl rfl)]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact causal_tail a ha (Fin.castSucc i) u v v₀ (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)

/-- Sum form of the lazy-programming law. -/
theorem sum_prog : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A), Causal a → ∀ (F : (A → U) → ℚ),
    ∑ t : A → U, ∑ u : Fin m → U, F (prog a t u) =
      (Fintype.card U : ℚ) ^ m * ∑ t, F t
  | 0, a, _, F => by
      have hu : ∀ t : A → U, ∑ u : Fin 0 → U, F (prog a t u) = F t := by
        intro t
        rw [Fintype.sum_unique]
        rfl
      simp only [hu, pow_zero, one_mul]
  | m + 1, a, ha, F => by
      let v₀ : U := Classical.arbitrary U
      have hsplit : ∀ t : A → U, ∑ u : Fin (m + 1) → U, F (prog a t u) =
          ∑ u : Fin m → U, ∑ v : U,
            F (prog (headProg a v₀) (Function.update t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀)) v) u) := by
        intro t
        rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ => U)) (fun p => F (prog a t (Fin.snoc p.2 p.1)))
          (fun u => F (prog a t u)) (fun p => rfl), Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_))
        show F (prog a t (Fin.snoc u v)) = _
        rw [prog_snoc a ha v₀]
      simp only [hsplit]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have hin : ∀ u : Fin m → U, ∑ t : A → U, ∑ v : U,
          F (prog (headProg a v₀) (Function.update t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀)) v) u) =
            (Fintype.card U : ℚ) * ∑ t, F (prog (headProg a v₀) t u) :=
        fun u => sum_update (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀)) (fun t => F (prog (headProg a v₀) t u))
      simp only [hin]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm, sum_prog m (headProg a v₀) (headProg_causal a ha v₀) F]
      ring

/-- The lazy-programming law (meanR of the real coupling): a uniform table
reprogrammed at causal adaptive addresses with independent uniform answers
is a uniform table. -/
theorem mean_prog {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A) (ha : Causal a) (F : (A → U) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : (A → U) × (Fin m → U) => F (prog a p.1 p.2)) = mean F := by
  unfold mean
  have hc : Fintype.card (Fin m → U) = Fintype.card U ^ m := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, sum_prog m a ha F, Fintype.card_prod, hc]
  have hU : (Fintype.card U : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hA : (Fintype.card (A → U) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  push_cast
  rw [mul_comm ((Fintype.card (A → U) : ℕ) : ℚ)]
  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero _ hU)

end Law

/-! ### Adaptive runs against the programmed table -/

/-- Two adaptive runs against the same oracle agree (causal addresses). -/
theorem run_unique {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A) (ha : Causal a) (H : A → U)
    (v w : Fin m → U) (hv : ∀ i, v i = H (a i v)) (hw : ∀ i, w i = H (a i w)) : v = w := by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin m, i.val < n → v i = w i := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro i hi; exact absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    | succ n ih =>
        intro i hi
        rw [hv i, hw i, ha i v w (fun j hj => ih j (lt_of_lt_of_le (Fin.lt_def.mp hj) (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi)))]
  funext i
  exact key (i.val + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

/-- The real run against `prog a t u` reads exactly the middle answers `u`
when the read addresses are pairwise distinct (no collision). -/
theorem run_eq {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → A) (ha : Causal a) (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U)
    (hd : ∀ i j, j < i → a j u ≠ a i u) (v : Fin m → U)
    (hv : ∀ i, v i = prog a t u (a i v)) : v = u :=
  run_unique a ha (prog a t u) v u hv (fun i => (prog_first a t u i (hd i)).symm)
