R1Z.LazyFrozen.text:
import R1Z.LazyTable

/-! G-prog with a frozen part of the table (DESIGN-R1-REAL §2).

The R1 prover reads one address of the table that is never programmed: the
statement digest `H(public_bytes)` (a public address, read by every attempt
and by the adversary).  Its value enters the prover's private addresses.  So
the read addresses may depend on the table, but only on a fixed finite
FROZEN set `Fr` of addresses, and programming skips writes into `Fr`.

* `progF`: first-write-wins programming that never writes into `Fr`;
* `mean_progF`: with uniform independent `t` and `u` the programmed table is
  uniform (exact; the frozen values are never moved);
* `progF_frozen`, `progF_first`, `progF_off`;
* `runC` / `runC_spec`: the honest in-order evaluation of a causal read
  program against an oracle, with unread answers defaulted (partial
  vectors), is a fixpoint;
* `run_eqF`: off collisions and off `Fr`, the honest run against the
  programmed table has exactly the lazy answers `u`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LazyFrozen
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.LazyTable

variable {A U : Type} [DecidableEq A]

/-! ### Programming that skips the frozen set -/

def progFV (Fr : Finset A) : (m : ℕ) → (Fin m → A) → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → (A → U)
  | 0, _, _, t => t
  | m + 1, b, u, t =>
      progFV Fr m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u)
        (if b (Fin.last m) ∈ Fr then t else Function.update t (b (Fin.last m)) (u (Fin.last m)))

/-- Read `i`'s address depends on the answers before `i` and on the table
only through the frozen set. -/
def CausalF (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A) : Prop :=
  ∀ i u u' t t', (∀ j, j < i → u j = u' j) → (∀ y ∈ Fr, t y = t' y) → a i u t = a i u' t'

def progF (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A) (t : A → U)
    (u : Fin m → U) : A → U :=
  progFV Fr m (fun i => a i u t) u t

theorem progFV_frozen (Fr : Finset A) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → A) (u : Fin m → U) (t : A → U)
    (y : A), y ∈ Fr → progFV Fr m b u t y = t y
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, b, u, t, y, hy => by
      show progFV Fr m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ y = t y
      rw [progFV_frozen Fr m _ _ _ y hy]
      by_cases hb : b (Fin.last m) ∈ Fr
      · rw [if_pos hb]
      · rw [if_neg hb]
        exact Function.update_of_ne (fun e => hb (by rw [← e]; exact hy)) _ _

theorem progFV_off (Fr : Finset A) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → A) (u : Fin m → U) (t : A → U)
    (y : A), (∀ i, b i ≠ y) → progFV Fr m b u t y = t y
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, b, u, t, y, hb => by
      show progFV Fr m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ y = t y
      rw [progFV_off Fr m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ y (fun i => hb _)]
      by_cases hl : b (Fin.last m) ∈ Fr
      · rw [if_pos hl]
      · rw [if_neg hl]
        exact Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm (hb _)) _ _

theorem progFV_first (Fr : Finset A) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (b : Fin m → A) (u : Fin m → U) (t : A → U)
    (i : Fin m), b i ∉ Fr → (∀ j, j < i → b j ≠ b i) → progFV Fr m b u t (b i) = u i
  | 0, _, _, _, i, _, _ => i.elim0
  | m + 1, b, u, t, i, hf, hb => by
      show progFV Fr m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ (b i) = u i
      by_cases hi : i = Fin.last m
      · subst hi
        rw [progFV_off Fr m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ _ (fun j => hb _ (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j)),
          if_neg hf]
        exact Function.update_self _ _ _
      · obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi
        exact progFV_first Fr m (Fin.init b) (Fin.init u) _ i' hf
          (fun j hj => hb _ (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mpr hj))

theorem progF_frozen (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) (y : A) (hy : y ∈ Fr) : progF Fr a t u y = t y :=
  progFV_frozen Fr m _ u t y hy

theorem progF_off (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) (y : A) (hy : ∀ i, a i u t ≠ y) : progF Fr a t u y = t y :=
  progFV_off Fr m _ u t y hy

theorem progF_first (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) (i : Fin m) (hf : a i u t ∉ Fr)
    (hi : ∀ j, j < i → a j u t ≠ a i u t) : progF Fr a t u (a i u t) = u i :=
  progFV_first Fr m _ u t i hf hi

/-! ### The frozen update is `|U|`-to-one -/

/-- One frozen-aware write. -/
def upd (Fr : Finset A) (t : A → U) (x : A) (v : U) : A → U :=
  if x ∈ Fr then t else Function.update t x v

theorem upd_frozen (Fr : Finset A) (t : A → U) (x : A) (v : U) (y : A) (hy : y ∈ Fr) :
    upd Fr t x v y = t y := by
  unfold upd
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Fr
  · rw [if_pos hx]
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    exact Function.update_of_ne (fun e => hx (by rw [← e]; exact hy)) _ _

def splitFr (Fr : Finset A) : (A → U) ≃ ({a // a ∈ Fr} → U) × ({a // a ∉ Fr} → U) where
  toFun t := (fun a => t a.1, fun a => t a.1)
  invFun p a := if h : a ∈ Fr then p.1 ⟨a, h⟩ else p.2 ⟨a, h⟩
  left_inv t := by
    funext a
    by_cases h : a ∈ Fr <;> simp [h]
  right_inv p := by
    obtain ⟨f, r⟩ := p
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · funext a
      simp [a.2]
    · funext a
      simp [a.2]

theorem splitFr_symm_frozen (Fr : Finset A) (f : {a // a ∈ Fr} → U) (r r' : {a // a ∉ Fr} → U)
    (y : A) (hy : y ∈ Fr) : (splitFr Fr).symm (f, r) y = (splitFr Fr).symm (f, r') y := by
  simp [splitFr, hy]

theorem update_splitFr_symm (Fr : Finset A) (f : {a // a ∈ Fr} → U) (r : {a // a ∉ Fr} → U)
    (x : A) (hx : x ∉ Fr) (v : U) :
    Function.update ((splitFr Fr).symm (f, r)) x v = (splitFr Fr).symm (f, Function.update r ⟨x, hx⟩ v) := by
  funext a
  by_cases ha : a ∈ Fr
  · have hne : a ≠ x := fun e => hx (e ▸ ha)
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
    simp [splitFr, ha]
  · by_cases hax : a = x
    · subst hax
      simp [splitFr, ha]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hax]
      have hne : (⟨a, ha⟩ : {a // a ∉ Fr}) ≠ ⟨x, hx⟩ := fun e => hax (congrArg Subtype.val e)
      simp [splitFr, ha, Function.update_of_ne hne]

theorem sum_updF (Fr : Finset A) [Fintype A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] (x : (A → U) → A)
    (hx : ∀ t t', (∀ y ∈ Fr, t y = t' y) → x t = x t') (G : (A → U) → ℚ) :
    ∑ t : A → U, ∑ v : U, G (upd Fr t (x t) v) = (Fintype.card U : ℚ) * ∑ t, G t := by
  have e1 : ∑ t : A → U, ∑ v : U, G (upd Fr t (x t) v) =
      ∑ p : ({a // a ∈ Fr} → U) × ({a // a ∉ Fr} → U), ∑ v : U,
        G (upd Fr ((splitFr Fr).symm p) (x ((splitFr Fr).symm p)) v) :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (splitFr Fr) _ _ (fun t => by simp)
  have e2 : ∑ t : A → U, G t = ∑ p : ({a // a ∈ Fr} → U) × ({a // a ∉ Fr} → U),
      G ((splitFr Fr).symm p) :=
    Fintype.sum_equiv (splitFr Fr) _ _ (fun t => by simp)
  rw [e1, e2, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun f _ => ?_)
  let r₀ : {a // a ∉ Fr} → U := fun a => (splitFr Fr).symm (f, fun _ => Classical.arbitrary U) a.1
  have hX : ∀ r, x ((splitFr Fr).symm (f, r)) = x ((splitFr Fr).symm (f, r₀)) :=
    fun r => hx _ _ (fun y hy => splitFr_symm_frozen Fr f r r₀ y hy)
  simp only [hX]
  by_cases hm : x ((splitFr Fr).symm (f, r₀)) ∈ Fr
  · simp only [upd, if_pos hm, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  · simp only [upd, if_neg hm]
    simp only [update_splitFr_symm Fr f _ _ hm]
    exact sum_update (⟨_, hm⟩ : {a // a ∉ Fr}) (fun r => G ((splitFr Fr).symm (f, r)))

/-! ### The frozen lazy-programming law -/

section Law
variable [Fintype A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

def headF {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → (A → U) → A) (v₀ : U) :
    Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A :=
  fun i u t => a (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t

omit [Fintype A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] in
theorem snoc_agree {m : ℕ} (u : Fin m → U) (v v' : U)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) (hj : j ≠ Fin.last m) :
    Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => U) u v j = Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => U) u v' j := by
  obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hj
  simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]

theorem causalF_tail (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (ha : CausalF Fr a) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (u : Fin m → U) (v v' : U) (t t' : A → U)
    (ht : ∀ y ∈ Fr, t y = t' y) :
    a i (Fin.snoc u v) t = a i (Fin.snoc u v') t' ∨ i = Fin.last m := by
  by_cases hi : i = Fin.last m
  · exact Or.inr hi
  · left
    refine ha i _ _ t t' (fun j hj => ?_) ht
    have hj' : j ≠ Fin.last m := by
      obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi
      exact ne_of_lt (lt_trans hj (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i'))
    exact snoc_agree u v v' j hj'

theorem causalF_last (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (ha : CausalF Fr a) (u : Fin m → U) (v v' : U) (t t' : A → U) (ht : ∀ y ∈ Fr, t y = t' y) :
    a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v) t = a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v') t' :=
  ha _ _ _ t t' (fun j hj => snoc_agree u v v' j (ne_of_lt hj)) ht

theorem headF_causal (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (ha : CausalF Fr a) (v₀ : U) : CausalF Fr (headF a v₀) := by
  intro i u u' t t' h ht
  refine ha _ _ _ t t' (fun j hj => ?_) ht
  have hj' : j ≠ Fin.last m := ne_of_lt (lt_trans hj (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i))
  obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hj'
  simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  exact h j' (Fin.castSucc_lt_castSucc_iff.mp hj)

theorem progF_snoc (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin (m + 1) → (Fin (m + 1) → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (ha : CausalF Fr a) (v₀ : U) (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U) (v : U) :
    progF Fr a t (Fin.snoc u v) =
      progF Fr (headF a v₀) (upd Fr t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t) v) u := by
  show progFV Fr m (Fin.init (fun i => a i (Fin.snoc u v) t)) (Fin.init (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => U) u v))
      (if a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v) t ∈ Fr then t else
        Function.update t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v) t) (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => U) u v (Fin.last m))) =
    progFV Fr m (fun i => headF a v₀ i u (upd Fr t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t) v)) u
      (upd Fr t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t) v)
  rw [Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last, causalF_last Fr a ha u v v₀ t t (fun _ _ => rfl)]
  congr 1
  funext i
  show a (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.snoc u v) t =
    a (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.snoc u v₀) (upd Fr t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t) v)
  rcases causalF_tail Fr a ha (Fin.castSucc i) u v v₀ t _
      (fun y hy => (upd_frozen Fr t _ v y hy).symm) with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h (ne_of_lt (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i))

theorem sum_progF (Fr : Finset A) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A),
    CausalF Fr a → ∀ (F : (A → U) → ℚ),
    ∑ t : A → U, ∑ u : Fin m → U, F (progF Fr a t u) = (Fintype.card U : ℚ) ^ m * ∑ t, F t
  | 0, a, _, F => by
      have hu : ∀ t : A → U, ∑ u : Fin 0 → U, F (progF Fr a t u) = F t := by
        intro t
        rw [Fintype.sum_unique]
        rfl
      simp only [hu, pow_zero, one_mul]
  | m + 1, a, ha, F => by
      let v₀ : U := Classical.arbitrary U
      have hsplit : ∀ t : A → U, ∑ u : Fin (m + 1) → U, F (progF Fr a t u) =
          ∑ u : Fin m → U, ∑ v : U,
            F (progF Fr (headF a v₀) (upd Fr t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t) v) u) := by
        intro t
        rw [← Fintype.sum_equiv (Fin.snocEquiv (fun _ => U))
          (fun p => F (progF Fr a t (Fin.snoc p.2 p.1))) (fun u => F (progF Fr a t u)) (fun p => rfl),
          Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun u _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ?_))
        show F (progF Fr a t (Fin.snoc u v)) = _
        rw [progF_snoc Fr a ha v₀]
      simp only [hsplit]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have hin : ∀ u : Fin m → U, ∑ t : A → U, ∑ v : U,
          F (progF Fr (headF a v₀) (upd Fr t (a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t) v) u) =
            (Fintype.card U : ℚ) * ∑ t, F (progF Fr (headF a v₀) t u) :=
        fun u => sum_updF Fr (fun t => a (Fin.last m) (Fin.snoc u v₀) t)
          (fun t t' ht => causalF_last Fr a ha u v₀ v₀ t t' ht)
          (fun t => F (progF Fr (headF a v₀) t u))
      simp only [hin]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_comm,
        sum_progF Fr m (headF a v₀) (headF_causal Fr a ha v₀) F]
      ring

/-- The frozen lazy-programming law. -/
theorem mean_progF (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (ha : CausalF Fr a) (F : (A → U) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : (A → U) × (Fin m → U) => F (progF Fr a p.1 p.2)) = mean F := by
  unfold mean
  have hc : Fintype.card (Fin m → U) = Fintype.card U ^ m := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, sum_progF Fr m a ha F, Fintype.card_prod, hc]
  have hU : (Fintype.card U : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  push_cast
  rw [mul_comm ((Fintype.card (A → U) : ℕ) : ℚ)]
  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero _ hU)

end Law

/-! ### The honest in-order run -/

section Run
variable {B : Type}

/-- Evaluate reads `0 … n−1` in order; read `i`'s address is computed on the
answers so far (later answers read as `d₀`). -/
def runN {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → B) (H : B → U) (d₀ : U) : ℕ → (Fin m → U)
  | 0 => fun _ => d₀
  | n + 1 => if h : n < m then Function.update (runN a H d₀ n) ⟨n, h⟩ (H (a ⟨n, h⟩ (runN a H d₀ n)))
      else runN a H d₀ n

theorem runN_succ {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → B) (H : B → U) (d₀ : U) (n : ℕ) :
    runN a H d₀ (n + 1) = if h : n < m then Function.update (runN a H d₀ n) ⟨n, h⟩
      (H (a ⟨n, h⟩ (runN a H d₀ n))) else runN a H d₀ n := rfl

def runC {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → B) (H : B → U) (d₀ : U) : Fin m → U :=
  runN a H d₀ m

theorem runN_stable {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → B) (H : B → U) (d₀ : U) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : i.val < n) : ∀ k, runN a H d₀ (n + k) i = runN a H d₀ n i
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
      show runN a H d₀ (n + k + 1) i = _
      rw [runN_succ]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (fun e => by
          have := congrArg Fin.val e
          simp at this
          omega)]
        exact runN_stable a H d₀ n i hi k
      · exact runN_stable a H d₀ n i hi k

theorem runN_le {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → B) (H : B → U) (d₀ : U) (n n' : ℕ)
    (hn : n ≤ n') (i : Fin m) (hi : i.val < n) : runN a H d₀ n' i = runN a H d₀ n i := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  exact runN_stable a H d₀ n i hi k

theorem runN_at {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → B) (H : B → U) (d₀ : U) (i : Fin m) :
    runN a H d₀ (i.val + 1) i = H (a i (runN a H d₀ i.val)) := by
  show (if h : i.val < m then Function.update (runN a H d₀ i.val) ⟨i.val, h⟩
      (H (a ⟨i.val, h⟩ (runN a H d₀ i.val))) else runN a H d₀ i.val) i = _
  rw [dif_pos i.isLt]
  simp

/-- The honest run is a fixpoint of its causal read program. -/
theorem runC_spec {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → B) (H : B → U) (d₀ : U)
    (hc : ∀ i v v', (∀ j, j < i → v j = v' j) → a i v = a i v') (i : Fin m) :
    runC a H d₀ i = H (a i (runC a H d₀)) := by
  unfold runC
  rw [runN_le a H d₀ (i.val + 1) m i.isLt i (Nat.lt_succ_self _), runN_at]
  congr 1
  refine hc i _ _ (fun j hj => ?_)
  exact (runN_le a H d₀ i.val m (le_of_lt i.isLt) j (Fin.lt_def.mp hj)).symm

end Run

/-- Off `Fr` and off collisions, a run against the programmed table reads
exactly the lazy answers. -/
theorem run_eqF (Fr : Finset A) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → (Fin m → U) → (A → U) → A)
    (ha : CausalF Fr a) (t : A → U) (u : Fin m → U)
    (hf : ∀ i, a i u t ∉ Fr) (hd : ∀ i j, j < i → a j u t ≠ a i u t) (v : Fin m → U)
    (hv : ∀ i, v i = progF Fr a t u (a i v (progF Fr a t u))) : v = u := by
  have hfz : ∀ y ∈ Fr, progF Fr a t u y = t y := fun y hy => progF_frozen Fr a t u y hy
  have hc : R1Z.LazyTable.Causal (fun i (w : Fin m → U) => a i w t) :=
    fun i w w' h => ha i w w' t t h (fun _ _ => rfl)
  refine R1Z.LazyTable.run_unique (fun i (w : Fin m → U) => a i w t) hc (progF Fr a t u) v u
    (fun i => ?_) (fun i => (progF_first Fr a t u i (hf i) (hd i)).symm)
  rw [hv i, ha i v v _ t (fun _ _ => rfl) hfz]

#print axioms progFV_frozen

import R1Z.GamesR1
import R1Z.LazyFrozen

/-! Phase-indexed R1 games over the BINARY commitment trees (LOG D76; the
eight-way original is `R1Z.GamesR1P`, unchanged).  Only `NodeIdx` differs.

Phase-indexed R1 games (LOG D48.3, DESIGN-R1-REAL §1).

The landed `R1Prover.commit` returns all three roots before the transcript;
in Rust the C2 root depends on rows 0–1 (h1 = helper(λ, χ)) and the folded
root on rows ≤ 29 (fold(q, α0)).  Here the honest attempt is one CAUSAL READ
PROGRAM over `Pos1 = TRead ⊕ CPos`: the 115 transcript reads and the
commitment reads (three roots, the two expander streams, and `RIdx`: the two
binding reads, the three seed reads, the salts, leaves and non-root binary
nodes of the three trees), evaluated in the prover's order `ord` against the
oracle with partial answer vectors (`LazyFrozen.runC`).  Every address —
transcript or commitment — is computed from the answers read so far, so the
roots, the challenges `chOf W tr` and the tape are evaluated at the PARTIAL
vector; the C2 and folded roots therefore depend on the challenges before
them exactly as in Rust (R-causal, `RCausal`, makes this a fixpoint).

* `R1ProverP`: the commitment address map `caddr` (REF R-commit; its byte
  grammar is the named premise `RCommitBytes`, LayoutR1P), the leaf values,
  the mask decode `tapeOf` of the two expander streams (none = exhausted),
  the opened fibres, the verifier's opening list and the read order `ord`.
* `realGameP`: N attempts with independent secrets (nonce, field-mask
  entropy, leaf-salt seed, each a nonzero 32-byte value) against one oracle;
  the statement digest `H(public_bytes)` is read first; accept the first
  attempt with `P ∧ V ∧ ¬exhausted`; publish its view with the verifier log
  (115 transcript reads and the opening reads, answers `H(address)`), then
  the adversary's log; nothing of the other attempts.
* `fsR1P`: real = `realGameP`, ideal = the landed simulator game of `fsR1`;
  `abR1P = abR1` (the middle game and the ideal side are unchanged: the roots
  there are coins). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.GamesR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS
  R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.Batched R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.LazyFrozen
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Commitment read index sets -/

/-- Fibres of one tree: `FIBRE_COUNT = 2^18` (aspis-core r0/mod.rs). -/
abbrev Fib := Fin (2 ^ 18)

/-- Non-root binary nodes (format adopted in LOG D76): level `d+1` (`d < 17`)
has `2^(17−d)` nodes; the root (level 18) is a separate position, so with the
three roots each tree has `2^18 − 1` parents (`CommitReadsR1.card_nodes`). -/
abbrev NodeIdx := Σ d : Fin 17, Fin (2 ^ (17 - d.val))

/-- The private commitment reads other than roots and expander blocks:
binding reads (0: precommit binding of prover.rs, 1: pool-v1 attempt binding),
seed reads (0: mask seed, 1: source-mask seed, 2: D seed), and per tree
(0: C1, 1: C2, 2: folded) the salts, leaves and non-root nodes. -/
abbrev RIdx := Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fib) ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fib) ⊕ (Fin 3 × NodeIdx)

/-- Commitment positions: the three roots, the two expander streams, `RIdx`. -/
abbrev CPos (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) := Fin 3 ⊕ (Fin E₁ ⊕ Fin E₂) ⊕ RIdx

/-- All reads of one attempt. -/
abbrev Pos1 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) := TRead ⊕ CPos E₁ E₂

/-- Count levels, not concrete nodes: the sum has only seventeen terms. -/
theorem card_NodeIdx : Fintype.card NodeIdx = 262142 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => 2 ^ (17 - i)) 17]
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ]

/-- Includes both binding reads, which `CommitReadsR1.McR1` omits. -/
theorem card_Pos1 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂) = 2359413 + E₁ + E₂ := by
  simp only [Pos1, CPos, RIdx, Fib, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_prod,
    Fintype.card_fin, card_NodeIdx, card_TRead]
  norm_num <;> omega

/-- A nonzero 32-byte secret. -/
abbrev NZ := {v : OracleAnswer // v ≠ 0}

/-- Attempt secrets (StateOnlyAttemptSecrets): 0 the mask nonce, 1 the
field-mask entropy, 2 the leaf-salt seed.  None is published. -/
abbrev SecP := Fin 3 → NZ

instance : Nonempty NZ := ⟨⟨fun _ => 1, fun h => by
  have := congrFun h 0
  exact absurd this (by decide)⟩⟩

/-! ### The phase-indexed prover -/

structure R1ProverP (K CommitHandle Aux : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K)
    (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) where
  E₁ : ℕ
  E₂ : ℕ
  /-- commitment-read addresses (REF R-commit) from the instance, the
  statement, the attempt secrets, the statement digest, the mask tape, the
  `RIdx` answers and the challenges -/
  caddr : (h : HonestProver K) → h.Instance → Statement K CommitHandle → SecP → OracleAnswer →
    Tape K F → (RIdx → OracleAnswer) → Challenges K → CPos E₁ E₂ → List UInt8
  /-- the committed column values at fibre `u` of tree `T` -/
  leafVal : (h : HonestProver K) → h.Instance → Statement K CommitHandle → Tape K F →
    Challenges K → Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8
  /-- the mask decode of the two expander streams (none: MaskSampleExhausted) -/
  tapeOf : (Fin E₁ → OracleAnswer) → (Fin E₂ → OracleAnswer) → Option (Tape K F)
  /-- the opened fibres of each tree (QueryScan; folded tree `u / 4`) -/
  openFib : Challenges K → Fin 3 → Finset Fib
  /-- the verifier's opening reads, in its order -/
  openList : Challenges K → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)
  /-- the prover's read order of one attempt -/
  ord : Fin (Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂)) ≃ Pos1 E₁ E₂

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

def tape0 : Tape K F := (0, 0)

section Attempt
variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

def trOf (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : TRead → OracleAnswer := fun j => v (.inl j)
def rootsOf (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer := fun i => v (.inr (.inl i))
def e₁Of (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Fin E₁ → OracleAnswer :=
  fun c => v (.inr (.inr (.inl (.inl c))))
def e₂Of (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Fin E₂ → OracleAnswer :=
  fun c => v (.inr (.inr (.inl (.inr c))))
def restOf (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : RIdx → OracleAnswer := fun q => v (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))

/-- An opening position as a commitment position. -/
def cposOf : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx → CPos E₁ E₂
  | .inl i => .inl i
  | .inr q => .inr (.inr q)

end Attempt

section Game
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
include W Pr

/-- The mask tape decoded from an attempt's answers (default on exhaustion). -/
def tapeR (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Tape K F :=
  (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of v) (e₂Of v)).getD tape0

/-- The address of each read of one attempt, from its (partial) answer
vector `v`: transcript reads use the view at the challenges `chOf W (trOf v)`
and the roots `rootsOf v`; commitment reads use `caddr`. -/
def attAddr (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → List UInt8
  | .inl j => addr j (recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf v)) (tapeR W Pr v)) (trOf v) (rootsOf v))
  | .inr c => Pr.caddr h w x sec d (tapeR W Pr v) (restOf v) (chOf W (trOf v)) c

abbrev n1 : ℕ := Fintype.card (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂)

/-- Attempt `k`'s answers inside the global answer vector. -/
def attVec {N : ℕ} (V : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin N) :
    Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer :=
  fun p => V (finProdFinEquiv (k, Pr.ord.symm p))

/-- The global read program of `N` attempts (attempt-major, each in `ord`). -/
def gAddr (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) {N : ℕ} (sec : Fin N → SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (g : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) (V : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 :=
  attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (sec (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1) d
    (attVec W Pr V (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1) (Pr.ord (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2)

/-- One attempt's published data from its answers (verifier recomputation). -/
def attOut (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux :=
  let ch := chOf W (trOf v)
  let τ := tapeR W Pr v
  let Vw := view h B outputs x w ch τ
  ⟨ch, Vw,
    schedule.map (fun j => (addr j (recP W x Vw (trOf v) (rootsOf v)),
      H (addr j (recP W x Vw (trOf v) (rootsOf v))))) ++
    (Pr.openList ch).map (fun c => (Pr.caddr h w x sec d τ (restOf v) ch (cposOf c),
      H (Pr.caddr h w x sec d τ (restOf v) ch (cposOf c)))),
    (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of v) (e₂Of v)).isNone⟩

/-- The honest prover's attempts: the digest read, then the global read
program run in order against `H` (`runC`), then each attempt's output. -/
def realOut (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) {N : ℕ} (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (sec : Fin N → SecP) (k : Fin N) : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux :=
  attOut W Pr h B outputs x w H (sec k) (H (W.pubBytes x))
    (attVec W Pr (runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec (H (W.pubBytes x))) H 0) k)

/-- The real game: accept the first attempt with `P ∧ V ∧ ¬ exhausted`. -/
def realGameP (N : ℕ) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) :
    ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat :=
  let H := W.look r.1
  let out := realOut W Pr h B outputs x w H r.2
  match firstGood (fun o : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux => P o.ch ∧ Vp h o.ch w ∧ o.exh = false) out with
  | none => ⟨W.failView, runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) H W.qmax⟩
  | some k => ⟨(out k).view, (out k).log ++ runLog (adv.prog (out k).view (out k).log) H W.qmax⟩

def fsR1P (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F where
  Adversary := R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux
  RealRand := W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)
  IdealRand := (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)
  real := fun h B outputs adv x w r => realGameP W Pr N P Vp h B outputs adv x w r
  ideal := fun sim adv x r =>
    retryOut N (fun c => P (drawW W c)) (fun c t => sim (drawW W c) t)
      (fun c k v => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x c k v) (fun c => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x c) r
  observe := fun adv rv => adv.decide rv

instance instRealFinP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Fintype (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)))

instance instRealNeP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Nonempty (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Nonempty (W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)))

instance instIdealFinP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Fintype (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).IdealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype ((Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)))

instance instIdealNeP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Nonempty (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).IdealRand := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  exact inferInstanceAs (Nonempty ((Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)))

/-- The abort bridge of the phase-indexed games is the landed `abR1`. -/
abbrev abR1P (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) := abR1 W N hN

end Game

#print axioms attAddr
#print axioms gAddr
#print axioms attOut
#print axioms realOut
#print axioms realGameP
#print axioms fsR1P
#print axioms card_NodeIdx
#print axioms card_Pos1
end R1Z.GamesR1PBin

import R1Z.GamesR1PBin

/-! BINARY format (LOG D76; crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/multiproof.rs
`binary_parent`: node `0x12 ‖ left ‖ right`, eighteen levels, leaves unchanged).
The eight-way original is `R1Z.LayoutR1P`, unchanged; here only the node
index algebra (`child_bound*`, `childQ`, `rootChild`), `nodeBytes` and the
designated child of a node (the right child, `1`) differ.

The commitment-phase byte layout of R1 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §3), from the Rust
source (read with `git show origin/codex/100bit-spend-path-20261013:…`):
prover.rs (precommit binding, three salted trees), state_only_entropy.rs
(attempt binding, source / D seeds, leaf salts, Profile21 expander),
state_only_hiding.rs (mask seed, SeedExpander), aspis-core state_only_hiding.rs
(`StateOnlyHidingContext::encode`), multiproof.rs (binary node `0x12 ‖ 2
children`), state_only_private_merkle.rs (leaf `0x10 ‖ tag ‖ value ‖ salt`).
Every Rust hash is `SHA256` of the concatenation of its slices.

* `gram`: the address of every commitment read (named premise
  `RCommitBytes Pr`: `Pr.caddr` is `gram`).
* `src`: the DESIGNATED FIELD of each read — an attempt secret (nonce,
  entropy, leaf-salt seed) or the answer of an earlier `RIdx` read — and
  `fld`: its reader (trailing 32 bytes, or a fixed offset).  `fld_gram`.
* `depS`: which secrets / `RIdx` answers each address reads; `gram` is
  unchanged by every other coordinate (`gram_rest_update`, `gram_sec_update`).
* `fresh_or_sep`: for two distinct reads, one does not read the other's
  designated field, or (seeds 0/1, two salts, two blocks of one expander
  stream) their addresses differ for every input.
* `openedQ`: the opened reads (roots, leaves at the opened fibres and their
  ancestors); `hidden`: the designated field of an unopened read is neither
  read by nor the answer of any opened read. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin

/-! ### Byte constants -/

/-- "UNPROVED:R1:P3:PRIVATE-ATTEMPT" (prover.rs prove_masked_attempt binding), 30 bytes. -/

/-- "profile=pool-v1-tag73;generators=H26,G27,D28;factorD=0;rows=1024;c1=16;selected=28;theta=29;queries=16;first-cap=203" (state_only_entropy.rs POOL_V1_PRIVATE_WIRE_DESCRIPTOR), 116 bytes. -/

/-- "aspis:state-only:private-mask-seed:v1" (state_only_hiding.rs MASK_SEED_DOMAIN), 37 bytes. -/

/-- "aspis:state-only:pool-v1:zero-factor-d-seed:v1" (state_only_entropy.rs POOL_V1_D_SEED_DOMAIN), 46 bytes. -/
def dDSeed : List UInt8 := [97, 115, 112, 105, 115, 58, 115, 116, 97, 116, 101, 45, 111, 110, 108, 121, 58, 112, 111, 111, 108, 45, 118, 49, 58, 122, 101, 114, 111, 45, 102, 97, 99, 116, 111, 114, 45, 100, 45, 115, 101, 101, 100, 58, 118, 49]

/-- "aspis:state-only:private-leaf-salt:v1" (state_only_entropy.rs LEAF_SALT_DOMAIN), 37 bytes. -/
def dLeafSalt : List UInt8 := [97, 115, 112, 105, 115, 58, 115, 116, 97, 116, 101, 45, 111, 110, 108, 121, 58, 112, 114, 105, 118, 97, 116, 101, 45, 108, 101, 97, 102, 45, 115, 97, 108, 116, 58, 118, 49]

/-- "aspis:state-only:private-mask-expand:v1" (state_only_hiding.rs MASK_EXPAND_DOMAIN), 39 bytes. -/
def dExp1 : List UInt8 := [97, 115, 112, 105, 115, 58, 115, 116, 97, 116, 101, 45, 111, 110, 108, 121, 58, 112, 114, 105, 118, 97, 116, 101, 45, 109, 97, 115, 107, 45, 101, 120, 112, 97, 110, 100, 58, 118, 49]

/-- "aspis:state-only:profile21:source-expand:v1" (state_only_entropy.rs PROFILE21_SOURCE_EXPAND_DOMAIN), 43 bytes. -/
def dExp2 : List UInt8 := [97, 115, 112, 105, 115, 58, 115, 116, 97, 116, 101, 45, 111, 110, 108, 121, 58, 112, 114, 111, 102, 105, 108, 101, 50, 49, 58, 115, 111, 117, 114, 99, 101, 45, 101, 120, 112, 97, 110, 100, 58, 118, 49]
/-- Little-endian u64 (Rust `u64::to_le_bytes`). -/
def le64 (n : ℕ) : List UInt8 :=
  [(n % 256).toUInt8, (n / 256 % 256).toUInt8, (n / 65536 % 256).toUInt8,
    (n / 16777216 % 256).toUInt8, (n / 4294967296 % 256).toUInt8,
    (n / 1099511627776 % 256).toUInt8, (n / 281474976710656 % 256).toUInt8,
    (n / 72057594037927936 % 256).toUInt8]

/-- PINNED_POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_RELATION_FREE_MASK_FINGERPRINT_V1. -/
def fpMask : ℕ := 0xf9daf3d54f4285d1
/-- PINNED_POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_HIDING_LAYOUT_FACTOR_FINGERPRINT_V1. -/
def fpFactor : ℕ := 0x698bcdedff44a4db

/-- `StateOnlyHidingContext::encode` (81 bytes): version 1, statement digest,
mask nonce, the two fingerprints. -/
def ctxEnc (d nonce : OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 :=
  [1] ++ ans d ++ ans nonce ++ le64 fpMask ++ le64 fpFactor

/-- Tree tags: C1 `0x71`, C2 `0xf1` (r0/merkle.rs), folded `0x72` (prover.rs). -/
def treeTag (T : Fin 3) : UInt8 := if T.val = 0 then 0x71 else if T.val = 1 then 0xf1 else 0x72

/-! ### Index helpers -/

def qBind (b : Fin 2) : RIdx := .inl b
def qSeed (i : Fin 3) : RIdx := .inr (.inl i)
def qSalt (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) : RIdx := .inr (.inr (.inl (T, u)))
def qLeaf (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) : RIdx := .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, u))))
def qNode (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) : RIdx := .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T, n))))

theorem child_bound0 (i : Fin (2 ^ (17 - 0))) (j : Fin 2) : 2 * i.val + j.val < 2 ^ 18 := by
  have hi : i.val < 131072 := by simpa using i.isLt
  have hj := j.isLt
  have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 18 = 262144 := by norm_num
  omega

theorem child_bound (d : ℕ) (hd : d + 1 < 17) (i : Fin (2 ^ (17 - (d + 1)))) (j : Fin 2) :
    2 * i.val + j.val < 2 ^ (17 - d) := by
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hj := j.isLt
  rw [show 17 - d = (17 - (d + 1)) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
  generalize 2 ^ (17 - (d + 1)) = X at *
  omega

/-- The `j`-th child of a non-root node: a leaf (level 1) or a node one level down. -/
def childQ (T : Fin 3) : NodeIdx → Fin 2 → RIdx
  | ⟨⟨0, _⟩, i⟩, j => qLeaf T ⟨2 * i.val + j.val, child_bound0 i j⟩
  | ⟨⟨d + 1, hd⟩, i⟩, j => qNode T ⟨⟨d, by omega⟩, ⟨2 * i.val + j.val, child_bound d hd i j⟩⟩

/-- The `j`-th child of the root of tree `T`: level-17 node `j`. -/
def rootChild (T : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) : RIdx :=
  qNode T ⟨⟨16, by norm_num⟩, ⟨j.val, lt_of_lt_of_eq j.isLt (by norm_num)⟩⟩

/-- The binary node tag (multiproof.rs `BINARY_NODE_TAG`). -/
def binTag : UInt8 := 0x12

/-- `0x12 ‖ left ‖ right` (multiproof.rs `binary_parent`). -/
def nodeBytes (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx) : List UInt8 :=
  [binTag] ++ ans (rest (ch 0)) ++ ans (rest (ch 1))

/-! ### The address grammar -/

section Gram
variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

/-- The Rust address of every commitment read of one attempt. -/
def gram (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) : CPos E₁ E₂ → List UInt8
  | .inl T => nodeBytes rest (rootChild T)
  | .inr (.inl (.inl c)) => dExp1 ++ ans (rest (qSeed 0)) ++ le64 c.val
  | .inr (.inl (.inr c)) => dExp2 ++ ans (rest (qSeed 2)) ++ le64 c.val
  | .inr (.inr (.inl b)) =>
      if b.val = 0 then dBind0 ++ pub ++ [vtag] ++ ctxEnc d (sec 0).1
      else dBind1 ++ ans (rest (qBind 0)) ++ ctxEnc d (sec 0).1 ++ descr
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl i))) =>
      if i.val = 0 then dMaskSeed ++ ans (rest (qBind 0)) ++ ctxEnc d (sec 0).1 ++ ans (sec 1).1
      else if i.val = 1 then dSourceSeed ++ ans (rest (qBind 0)) ++ ctxEnc d (sec 0).1 ++ ans (sec 1).1
      else dDSeed ++ ans (rest (qBind 1)) ++ ans (rest (qSeed 1))
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, u))))) =>
      dLeafSalt ++ ans (rest (qBind 1)) ++ ans (sec 0).1 ++ [treeTag T] ++ le32 u.val ++ ans (sec 2).1
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, u)))))) =>
      [0x10, treeTag T] ++ lv T u ++ ans (rest (qSalt T u))
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T, n)))))) => nodeBytes rest (childQ T n)

/-- Designated-field coordinates: an attempt secret slot or an `RIdx` answer. -/
abbrev Src := Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx

def src : CPos E₁ E₂ → Src
  | .inl T => .inr (rootChild T 1)
  | .inr (.inl (.inl _)) => .inr (qSeed 0)
  | .inr (.inl (.inr _)) => .inr (qSeed 2)
  | .inr (.inr (.inl b)) => if b.val = 0 then .inl 0 else .inr (qBind 0)
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl i))) => if i.val = 2 then .inr (qSeed 1) else .inl 1
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _)))) => .inl 2
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, u)))))) => .inr (qSalt T u)
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T, n)))))) => .inr (childQ T n 1)

/-- The secrets / `RIdx` answers an address reads (the tape, the challenges
and the leaf values are read by leaves only and are not designated fields). -/
def depS : CPos E₁ E₂ → Src → Prop
  | .inl T, s => ∃ j, s = .inr (rootChild T j)
  | .inr (.inl (.inl _)), s => s = .inr (qSeed 0)
  | .inr (.inl (.inr _)), s => s = .inr (qSeed 2)
  | .inr (.inr (.inl b)), s => if b.val = 0 then s = .inl 0 else (s = .inl 0 ∨ s = .inr (qBind 0))
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl i))), s =>
      if i.val = 2 then (s = .inr (qBind 1) ∨ s = .inr (qSeed 1))
      else (s = .inl 0 ∨ s = .inl 1 ∨ s = .inr (qBind 0))
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _)))), s => s = .inl 0 ∨ s = .inl 2 ∨ s = .inr (qBind 1)
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, u)))))), s => s = .inr (qSalt T u)
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T, n)))))), s => ∃ j, s = .inr (childQ T n j)

/-- The value of a designated-field coordinate. -/
def srcVal (sec : SecP) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) : Src → OracleAnswer
  | .inl i => (sec i).1
  | .inr q => rest q

/-- The 32 bytes at offset `n`. -/
def slice (n : ℕ) (a : List UInt8) : OracleAnswer := fun i => a.getD (n + i.val) 0

/-- The designated-field reader of each read (`publen` = |public bytes|). -/
def fld (publen : ℕ) : CPos E₁ E₂ → List UInt8 → OracleAnswer
  | .inr (.inl (.inl _)) => slice dExp1.length
  | .inr (.inl (.inr _)) => slice dExp2.length
  | .inr (.inr (.inl b)) => if b.val = 0 then slice (dBind0.length + publen + 1 + 1 + 32) else slice dBind1.length
  | _ => trailing


/-! ### Designated fields -/

theorem slice_mid (p : List UInt8) (u : OracleAnswer) (q : List UInt8) :
    slice p.length (p ++ ans u ++ q) = u := by
  funext i
  have h1 : p.length + i.val < (p ++ ans u).length := by
    simp only [List.length_append, length_ans]
    omega
  simp only [slice, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left h1]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact getD_ans u i

theorem fld_gram (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (c : CPos E₁ E₂) :
    fld pub.length c (gram pub vtag lv sec d rest c) = srcVal sec rest (src c) := by
  rcases c with T | (c | c) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · exact trailing_append_ans _ _
  · exact slice_mid _ _ _
  · exact slice_mid _ _ _
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [fld, gram, src, hb, if_true, srcVal]
      have e : dBind0 ++ pub ++ [vtag] ++ ctxEnc d (sec 0).1 =
          (dBind0 ++ pub ++ [vtag] ++ [1] ++ ans d) ++ ans (sec 0).1 ++ (le64 fpMask ++ le64 fpFactor) := by
        simp only [ctxEnc, List.append_assoc]
      have hl : dBind0.length + pub.length + 1 + 1 + 32 = (dBind0 ++ pub ++ [vtag] ++ [1] ++ ans d).length := by
        simp only [List.length_append, length_ans, List.length_singleton]
      rw [e, hl]
      exact slice_mid _ _ _
    · simp only [fld, gram, src, hb, if_false, srcVal]
      have e : dBind1 ++ ans (rest (qBind 0)) ++ ctxEnc d (sec 0).1 ++ descr =
          dBind1 ++ ans (rest (qBind 0)) ++ (ctxEnc d (sec 0).1 ++ descr) := by
        simp only [List.append_assoc]
      rw [e]
      exact slice_mid _ _ _
  · by_cases h0 : i.val = 0
    · simp only [fld, gram, src, h0, if_true, srcVal, show ¬ (0 = 2) from by decide, if_false]
      exact trailing_append_ans _ _
    · by_cases h1 : i.val = 1
      · simp only [fld, gram, src, h0, h1, if_true, if_false, srcVal, show ¬ (1 = 2) from by decide]
        exact trailing_append_ans _ _
      · have h2 : i.val = 2 := by omega
        simp only [fld, gram, src, h0, h1, h2, if_true, if_false, srcVal]
        exact trailing_append_ans _ _
  · exact trailing_append_ans _ _
  · exact trailing_append_ans _ _
  · exact trailing_append_ans _ _

/-! ### Dependency soundness -/

theorem nodeBytes_update (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx) (q : RIdx)
    (u : OracleAnswer) (h : ∀ j, ch j ≠ q) :
    nodeBytes (Function.update rest q u) ch = nodeBytes rest ch := by
  simp only [nodeBytes, Function.update_of_ne (h _)]

theorem gram_rest_update (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8)
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (q : RIdx) (u : OracleAnswer)
    (c : CPos E₁ E₂) (h : ¬ depS c (.inr q)) :
    gram pub vtag lv sec d (Function.update rest q u) c = gram pub vtag lv sec d rest c := by
  have ne : ∀ r : RIdx, (Sum.inr q : Src) ≠ .inr r → r ≠ q := fun r hr e => hr (by rw [e])
  rcases c with T | (c | c) | (b | i | ⟨T, v⟩ | ⟨T, v⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · exact nodeBytes_update _ _ _ _ (fun j => ne _ (fun e => h ⟨j, e⟩))
  · simp only [gram, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h)]
  · simp only [gram, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h)]
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [gram, hb, if_true]
    · simp only [depS, hb, if_false, not_or] at h
      simp only [gram, hb, if_false, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2)]
  · by_cases h2 : i.val = 2
    · simp only [depS, h2, if_true, not_or] at h
      have h0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by omega
      have h1 : i.val ≠ 1 := by omega
      simp only [gram, h0, h1, if_false, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.1), Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2)]
    · simp only [depS, h2, if_false, not_or] at h
      by_cases h0 : i.val = 0
      · simp only [gram, h0, if_true, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2.2)]
      · have h1 : i.val = 1 := by omega
        simp only [gram, h0, h1, if_true, if_false, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2.2)]
  · simp only [depS, not_or] at h
    simp only [gram, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2.2)]
  · simp only [gram, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h)]
  · exact nodeBytes_update _ _ _ _ (fun j => ne _ (fun e => h ⟨j, e⟩))

theorem gram_sec_update (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8)
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 3) (z : NZ)
    (c : CPos E₁ E₂) (h : ¬ depS c (.inl i)) :
    gram pub vtag lv (Function.update sec i z) d rest c = gram pub vtag lv sec d rest c := by
  have ne : ∀ r : Fin 3, (Sum.inl i : Src) ≠ .inl r → r ≠ i := fun r hr e => hr (by rw [e])
  rcases c with T | (c | c) | (b | k | ⟨T, v⟩ | ⟨T, v⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [depS, hb, if_true] at h
      simp only [gram, hb, if_true, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h)]
    · simp only [depS, hb, if_false, not_or] at h
      simp only [gram, hb, if_false, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.1)]
  · by_cases h2 : k.val = 2
    · have h0 : k.val ≠ 0 := by omega
      have h1 : k.val ≠ 1 := by omega
      simp only [gram, h0, h1, if_false]
    · simp only [depS, h2, if_false, not_or] at h
      by_cases h0 : k.val = 0
      · simp only [gram, h0, if_true, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.1), Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2.1)]
      · have h1 : k.val = 1 := by omega
        simp only [gram, h0, h1, if_true, if_false, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.1),
          Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2.1)]
  · simp only [depS, not_or] at h
    simp only [gram, Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.1), Function.update_of_ne (ne _ h.2.1)]
  · rfl
  · rfl

end Gram

#print axioms gram
#print axioms slice_mid
#print axioms fld_gram
#print axioms gram_rest_update
#print axioms gram_sec_update
#print axioms child_bound0
#print axioms child_bound
#print axioms nodeBytes_update
end R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

R1Z.LayoutTagR1PBin.text:
import R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-! Binary-node separation. Commitment records have disjoint leading tags.
Duplex addresses begin with an arbitrary digest: their separation requires
record lengths, not a claim that every transcript address has a fixed tag. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1

variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

def nodePosition : CPos E₁ E₂ → Prop
  | .inl _ => True
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr _))))) => True
  | _ => False

theorem nodeBytes_length (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx) :
    (nodeBytes rest ch).length = 65 := by simp [nodeBytes, length_ans]

theorem nodeBytes_ne_tag (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (tag : UInt8) (tail : List UInt8) (ht : tag ≠ binTag) :
    nodeBytes rest ch ≠ tag :: tail := by
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (fun l : List UInt8 => l[0]?) h
  simp [nodeBytes] at hh
  exact ht hh.symm

/-- All other commitment classes: bindings, seeds, salts, leaves, expanders. -/
theorem nodeBytes_ne_other_commit (rest₀ : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (c : CPos E₁ E₂)
    (hn : ¬ nodePosition c) : nodeBytes rest₀ ch ≠ gram pub vtag lv sec d rest c := by
  rcases c with T | (c | c) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · exact False.elim (hn trivial)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [gram, hb, if_true]
      exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
    · simp only [gram, hb, if_false]
      exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · by_cases h0 : i.val = 0
    · simp only [gram, h0, if_true]
      exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
    · by_cases h1 : i.val = 1
      · simp only [gram, h1, if_true]
        exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
      · simp only [gram, h0, h1, if_false]
        exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact False.elim (hn trivial)

/-- Includes separation from the retained eight-way node format. -/
theorem nodeBytes_ne_eightway (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (tail : List UInt8) : nodeBytes rest ch ≠ (0x18 : UInt8) :: tail :=
  nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)

/-- Avoid unfolding a byte-array traversal for each literal domain. -/
theorem byteArray_toList_length (bs : ByteArray) : bs.toList.length = bs.size := by
  have aux : ∀ n i acc, bs.size - i = n →
      (ByteArray.toList.loop bs i acc).length = acc.length + n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro i acc hn
      rw [ByteArray.toList.loop]
      split
      · rename_i hi
        rw [ih (bs.size - (i + 1)) (by omega) (i + 1) (bs.get! i :: acc) rfl]
        simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega
      · simp only [List.length_reverse]
        omega
  simpa only [ByteArray.toList, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add] using
    (aux bs.size 0 [] (by omega))

/-- Named wire-length condition: `Rest` otherwise permits arbitrary bytes.
The wire/source refinement must establish this for actual message encodings. -/
def TranscriptNodeLengths (r : Rest) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, (r.framed i).length ≠ 31) ∧
  (∀ i, (r.payload i).length ≠ 27) ∧ r.final.length ≠ 27

theorem nodeBytes_ne_transcript (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (j : TRead) (f : OracleAnswer) (r : Rest) (hr : TranscriptNodeLengths r) :
    nodeBytes rest ch ≠ addrWith j f r := by
  intro h
  have hl := congrArg List.length h
  rw [nodeBytes_length] at hl
  cases j with
  | init =>
      have hs : semDomain.length = 38 := by
        rw [semDomain, byteArray_toList_length]; rfl
      simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, length_ans] at hl
      simp only [le32, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hl
      rw [hs] at hl
      omega
  | reseed =>
      have hs : openDomain.length = 29 := by
        rw [openDomain, byteArray_toList_length]; rfl
      simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, length_ans] at hl
      rw [hs] at hl
      omega
  | absS i =>
      have hi := hr.1 i
      simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, length_ans, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil] at hl
      omega
  | absO i =>
      have hi := hr.2.1 i
      simp [addrWith, length_ans, le32] at hl
      omega
  | absQ =>
      have hi := hr.2.2
      simp [addrWith, length_ans, le32] at hl
      omega
  | absR => simp [addrWith, length_ans, le32] at hl
  | sqS _ | advS _ | sqO _ | advO _ | qb _ | qa _ | sqR | advR =>
      simp [addrWith, length_ans] at hl

#print axioms byteArray_toList_length
#print axioms nodeBytes_length
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_tag
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_other_commit
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_eightway
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_transcript
end R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin.text:
import R1Z.LayoutTagR1PBin

/-! Concrete logical R1/S2 byte-shape carrier. Fixed-size vectors describe
payload slices, without assuming field canonicality. Compact stored fields
are expanded to these logical widths before transcript hashing.
This is the wire grammar; identification with a Rust execution remains R-wire. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

def semanticSize (i : Fin 27) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 2 ∨ i.val = 14 then 32
  else if 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then 896
  else if i.val = 25 then 3712
  else if i.val = 26 then 928 else 0

def semanticTag (i : Fin 27) : UInt8 :=
  if i.val = 2 then 1 else if i.val = 14 then 3
  else if 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then 2
  else if i.val = 25 then 4 else if i.val = 26 then 5 else 0

def openingSize (i : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 0 then 928 else if i.val = 1 then 32 else if i.val = 2 then 224 else 256

structure Wire where
  semantic : (i : Fin 27) → Vector UInt8 (semanticSize i)
  opening : (i : Fin 4) → Vector UInt8 (openingSize i)
  final : Vector UInt8 2048
  publicBytes : List UInt8
  tag : UInt8

def framed (w : Wire) (i : Fin 27) : List UInt8 :=
  [semanticTag i] ++ le32 (semanticSize i) ++ (w.semantic i).toList

def rest (w : Wire) : Rest where
  framed := framed w
  payload := fun i => (w.opening i).toList
  final := w.final.toList
  pubB := w.publicBytes
  vtag := w.tag

theorem framed_length (w : Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    (framed w i).length = 5 + semanticSize i := by
  simp [framed, le32]
  omega

theorem framed_safe (w : Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    (framed w i).length ≠ 31 ∧ (framed w i).length ≠ 65 := by
  rw [framed_length]
  unfold semanticSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem opening_safe (w : Wire) (i : Fin 4) :
    ((rest w).payload i).length ≠ 27 := by
  change (w.opening i).toList.length ≠ 27
  simp only [Vector.length_toList]
  unfold openingSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem transcriptNodeLengths (w : Wire) : TranscriptNodeLengths (rest w) := by
  refine ⟨fun i => (framed_safe w i).1, opening_safe w, ?_⟩
  change w.final.toList.length ≠ 27
  simp

theorem node_ne_concrete_transcript (w : Wire) (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx) (j : TRead) (f : OracleAnswer) :
    nodeBytes answers ch ≠ addrWith j f (rest w) :=
  nodeBytes_ne_transcript answers ch j f (rest w) (transcriptNodeLengths w)

#print axioms framed_length
#print axioms framed_safe
#print axioms opening_safe
#print axioms transcriptNodeLengths
#print axioms node_ne_concrete_transcript
end R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin

R1Z.WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.text:
import WireBindingRecordCodec
import R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin

/-! D79 extension to all three checkpoint-binding digest classes. The codec
is shared verbatim with soundness; the existing transcript and privacy roots
are unchanged. Executed tx1 membership remains the R-wire refinement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.WireBindingLengthsR1PBin
open AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-- The checksum constructor fixes the actual input width, not a supplied
length inequality. All possible payload byte contents are covered. -/
theorem binding_fixed_length (r : BindingRecord) :
    r.bytes.length = 57607 ∨ r.bytes.length = 1880 ∨ r.bytes.length = 1758 := by
  rw [binding_length]
  cases r <;> simp [BindingRecord.kind, BindingClass.size, proof_bytes_eq, asf8_size_eq]

theorem node_ne_binding (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx) (r : BindingRecord) :
    nodeBytes answers ch ≠ r.bytes := by
  intro he
  have hl := congrArg List.length he
  rw [nodeBytes_length] at hl
  exact (binding_safe r).1 hl.symm

theorem binding_ne_framed31 (r : BindingRecord) (frame : List UInt8)
    (hf : frame.length = 31) : r.bytes ≠ frame := by
  intro he
  exact (binding_safe r).2 ((congrArg List.length he).trans hf)

/-- Extension of the D79 concrete transcript carrier with checkpoint reads.
These inputs are additional verifier reads, not duplex transcript rows. -/
inductive ExtendedRead where
  | transcript (j : TRead) (answer : OracleAnswer)
  | binding (r : BindingRecord)

def ExtendedRead.bytes (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) : ExtendedRead → List UInt8
  | .transcript j f => addrWith j f (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest w)
  | .binding r => r.bytes

theorem node_ne_extended_read (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire)
    (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx)
    (read : ExtendedRead) : nodeBytes answers ch ≠ read.bytes w := by
  cases read with
  | transcript j f => exact WireLengthsR1PBin.node_ne_concrete_transcript w answers ch j f
  | binding r => exact node_ne_binding answers ch r

/-- Covers the entire tx1 site class table, including salted leaves. Node
reads are included in the table but cannot be separated from themselves. -/
theorem node_ne_classified_read (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx) (c : Tx1Class) (hn : c ≠ .binaryNode)
    (bs : List UInt8) (hclass : bs.length = c.size) : nodeBytes answers ch ≠ bs := by
  intro he
  have hl := congrArg List.length he
  rw [nodeBytes_length, hclass] at hl
  exact (tx1_class_safe c hn).1 hl.symm

#print axioms binding_fixed_length
#print axioms node_ne_binding
#print axioms binding_ne_framed31
#print axioms node_ne_extended_read
#print axioms node_ne_classified_read
end R1Z.WireBindingLengthsR1PBin

import SharedBinaryRecordGrammar
import R1Z.WireBindingLengthsR1PBin

/-! Equality bridge for the frozen privacy definitions; length/separation
proofs below are transported from the existing privacy theorems. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1
open GamesR1PBin LayoutR1PBin

theorem node_eq (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx) :
    nodeBytes rest ch = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => rest (ch j)) := rfl

theorem treeTag_eq : treeTag = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.treeTag := rfl

theorem leaf_eq (tag : UInt8) (packed : List UInt8) (salt : OracleAnswer) :
    [0x10, tag] ++ packed ++ ans salt = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.leafInput tag packed (ans salt) := by
  simp only [AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.leafInput, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]

theorem semanticSize_eq : WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticSize = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.semanticSize := rfl
theorem semanticTag_eq : WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticTag = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.semanticTag := rfl
theorem openingSize_eq : WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.openingSize := rfl

def toShared (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire :=
  ⟨w.semantic, w.opening, w.final, w.publicBytes, w.tag⟩
def fromShared (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire :=
  ⟨w.semantic, w.opening, w.final, w.publicBytes, w.tag⟩

theorem wire_roundtrip (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) : fromShared (toShared w) = w := rfl
theorem shared_roundtrip (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) : toShared (fromShared w) = w := rfl

theorem framed_eq (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    WireLengthsR1PBin.framed w i = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.framed (toShared w) i := rfl

theorem class_eq (c : AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec.Tx1Class) :
    c.size = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.classSize c := rfl

theorem shared_framed_safe (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    (AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.framed w i).length ≠ 31 ∧ (AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.framed w i).length ≠ 65 :=
  WireLengthsR1PBin.framed_safe (fromShared w) i

theorem shared_node_ne_binding (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (r : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.BindingRecord) : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => rest (ch j)) ≠ AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.bindingBytes r := by
  rw [← node_eq]
  exact WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.node_ne_binding rest ch r

#print axioms node_eq
#print axioms treeTag_eq
#print axioms leaf_eq
#print axioms semanticSize_eq
#print axioms semanticTag_eq
#print axioms openingSize_eq

#print axioms shared_roundtrip
