R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin.text:
import R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin

/-! Symbolic bottom-up ranks for the binary grammar. No leaf/node universe
is enumerated. These facts are independent of the missing phase interfaces. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin
open R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-- A dependency-layer rank, not a total enumeration of hash calls. -/
def layer : RIdx → ℕ
  | .inl b => b.val
  | .inr (.inl i) => 2 + i.val
  | .inr (.inr (.inl _)) => 5
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _))) => 6
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (_, n)))) => 7 + n.1.val

theorem child_before_parent (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) :
    layer (childQ T n j) < layer (qNode T n) := by
  rcases n with ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, i⟩
  cases d with
  | zero => simp [childQ, layer, qLeaf, qNode]
  | succ d => simp [childQ, layer, qNode]

theorem child_before_root (T : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) :
    layer (rootChild T j) < 24 := by
  simp [rootChild, layer, qNode]

theorem salt_before_leaf (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) :
    layer (qSalt T u) < layer (qLeaf T u) := by
  simp [layer, qSalt, qLeaf]

/-- The ranked parent uses precisely the shared binary node bytes. -/
theorem shared_parent (rest : RIdx → R0Z.FsStatement.OracleAnswer)
    (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) :
    nodeBytes rest (childQ T n) =
      AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => rest (childQ T n j)) :=
  R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin.node_eq rest (childQ T n)

#print axioms child_before_parent
#print axioms child_before_root
#print axioms salt_before_leaf
#print axioms shared_parent
end R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin

R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin.text:
import R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sort

/-! Symbolic phase schedule. The finite-order isomorphism is used only through
its order laws: no concrete list of positions or tree recurrence is reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
open R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1

def treeBase (T : Fin 3) : ℕ := if T.val = 0 then 1 else if T.val = 1 then 27 else 131

def transcriptStage : TRead → ℕ
  | .init => 26
  | .absS i => if i.val < 2 then 27 + 3 * i.val else 52 + 3 * (i.val - 2)
  | .sqS i => if i.val < 2 then 28 + 3 * i.val else 53 + 3 * (i.val - 2)
  | .advS i => if i.val < 2 then 29 + 3 * i.val else 54 + 3 * (i.val - 2)
  | .reseed => 127
  | .absO i => if i.val < 3 then 128 + 3 * i.val else 156
  | .sqO i => if i.val < 3 then 129 + 3 * i.val else 157
  | .advO i => if i.val < 3 then 130 + 3 * i.val else 158
  | .absQ => 159
  | .qb k => 160 + 2 * k.val
  | .qa k => 161 + 2 * k.val
  | .absR => 176
  | .sqR => 177
  | .advR => 178

def restStage : RIdx → ℕ
  | .inl b => b.val
  | .inr (.inl i) => 2 + i.val
  | .inr (.inr (.inl _)) => 6
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, _)))) => treeBase T + 6
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T, n)))) => treeBase T + 7 + n.1.val

def stage {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → ℕ
  | .inl j => transcriptStage j
  | .inr (.inl T) => treeBase T + 24
  | .inr (.inr (.inl _)) => 5
  | .inr (.inr (.inr q)) => restStage q

/-- Separate type prevents the schedule order leaking into other interfaces. -/
def Scheduled (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) := Pos1 E₁ E₂
instance (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fintype (Scheduled E₁ E₂) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Pos1 E₁ E₂))

def key {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (p : Scheduled E₁ E₂) : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ :=
  toLex (stage p, (Fintype.equivFin (Pos1 E₁ E₂) p).val)

theorem key_injective {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} : Function.Injective (@key E₁ E₂) := by
  intro p q h
  apply (Fintype.equivFin (Pos1 E₁ E₂)).injective
  apply Fin.ext
  exact congrArg (fun x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ => (ofLex x).2) h

instance (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : LinearOrder (Scheduled E₁ E₂) :=
  LinearOrder.lift' key key_injective

def orderIso (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fin (Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂)) ≃o Scheduled E₁ E₂ :=
  Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq (Scheduled E₁ E₂) rfl

def ord (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fin (Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂)) ≃ Pos1 E₁ E₂ :=
  (orderIso E₁ E₂).toEquiv

theorem stage_before {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (p q : Pos1 E₁ E₂) (h : stage p < stage q) :
    (ord E₁ E₂).symm p < (ord E₁ E₂).symm q := by
  apply (orderIso E₁ E₂).symm.strictMono
  show key p < key q
  exact Prod.Lex.left _ _ h

theorem child_before_parent (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) :
    restStage (childQ T n j) < restStage (qNode T n) := by
  have h := CausalTreeOrderBin.child_before_parent T n j
  rcases n with ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, i⟩
  cases d with
  | zero => simp [childQ, restStage, qLeaf, qNode]
  | succ d => simp [childQ, restStage, qNode]

theorem root_children (T : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) :
    restStage (rootChild T j) < treeBase T + 24 := by
  simp [rootChild, restStage, qNode]

#print axioms key_injective
#print axioms stage_before
#print axioms child_before_parent
#print axioms root_children
end R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin

R0Z.FsAbortTape.text:
import R0Z.FsAbortBounds

/-! ZF1a/b on R1 (DESIGN-ZF1-COUPLINGS-R1 §3.1, §5.2): two generic facts used
by the tape factor of the real coupling.

* `mean_decodeOrSpare`: a rejection decoder `dec : B → Option T` whose fibres
  over `some t` all have the same size, completed by an independent uniform
  spare on `none`, is measure-preserving onto uniform `T`. This is the
  `meanM` half of the tape coupling once the R1 mask sampler's equal-fibre
  property is given (HYP; by symmetry of the accepted word values).
* `mass_fst`: an event of the first factor of a product has its own mass
  (used to read the tape factor off the coupling space).
The per-limb exhaustion mass `(2/2^32)^16` of §5.2 is not formalised here
(HYP H-exh). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsAbortTape
open R0Z.FsAbortBounds
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Rejection with a uniform spare -/

theorem sum_fibres {B T : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype T] (dec : B → Option T) (g : Option T → ℚ) :
    ∑ b, g (dec b) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = none)).card : ℚ) * g none +
        ∑ t, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = some t)).card : ℚ) * g (some t) := by
  have hc : ∀ o : Option T, ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o), g (dec b) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o)).card : ℚ) * g o := by
    intro o
    calc ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o), g (dec b)
        = ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o), g o :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b hb => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2])
      _ = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o)).card : ℚ) * g o := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ dec (fun b => g (dec b)), Fintype.sum_option, hc none]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => hc (some t))

theorem mean_decodeOrSpare {B T : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype T] [Nonempty B] [Nonempty T]
    (dec : B → Option T) (c : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ t, (Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = some t)).card = c) (f : T → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : B × T => f ((dec p.1).getD p.2)) = mean f := by
  set n0 : ℚ := ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = none)).card : ℚ) with hn0
  set F : ℚ := ∑ t, f t with hF
  have hT : (Fintype.card T : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hB : (Fintype.card B : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  let w : Option T → ℚ := fun o => match o with
    | none => F
    | some t => (Fintype.card T : ℚ) * f t
  have hinner : ∀ b, ∑ t', f ((dec b).getD t') = w (dec b) := by
    intro b
    cases hb : dec b with
    | none => simp [w, hF]
    | some t => simp [w, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hnum : ∑ p : B × T, f ((dec p.1).getD p.2) =
      (n0 + c * Fintype.card T) * F := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [hinner]
    rw [sum_fibres dec w]
    simp only [hfib, w]
    rw [← hn0, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hF]
    ring
  have hcard : (Fintype.card B : ℚ) = n0 + c * Fintype.card T := by
    have h1 := sum_fibres dec (fun _ => (1 : ℚ))
    simp only [mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, hfib] at h1
    rw [← hn0] at h1
    rw [h1]
    ring
  unfold mean
  rw [hnum, Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul, ← hcard, hF]
  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ hB

/-! ### Product marginal -/

/-- An event of the first factor of a product has its own mass. -/
theorem mass_fst {R X : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (Q : R → Prop) :
    mass (fun t : R × X => Q t.1) = mass Q := by
  rw [mass_prod]
  show mean _ = mean _
  congr 1
  funext r
  by_cases hq : Q r
  · rw [if_pos hq, mass_congr (fun x : X => Q (r, x).1) (fun _ => True)
      (fun _ => ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => hq⟩)]
    exact mass_true
  · rw [if_neg hq, mass_congr (fun x : X => Q (r, x).1) (fun _ => False)
      (fun _ => ⟨fun h => hq h, fun h => h.elim⟩)]
    exact mass_false

#print axioms sum_fibres
#print axioms mean_decodeOrSpare
#print axioms mass_fst
end R0Z.FsAbortTape

R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.text:
import R1Z.GamesR1PBin
import R0Z.FsAbortTape

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.CouplingR1P` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! The real coupling of the phase-indexed games (DESIGN-R1-REAL §4).

Coupling space `SP = Fin N → AttS`, one block per attempt:
`AttS = SecP × (Pos1 → Ans) × Tape × Tab` — the attempt secrets, an
independent uniform answer for every read of the attempt (transcript and
commitment), a spare tape and a spare table (attempt 0's table is the base
table of the oracle).

* `toMP` (to the middle game of `abR1`): attempt `k`'s coins are its
  transcript answers, its three root answers, its `RIdx` answers (as the
  `Cm` coin through `eCm`) and its table; its tape is the mask decode of its
  expander answers, or the spare tape on exhaustion.  `meanM_P`: uniform,
  from the decoder's equal fibres (`mean_decodeOrSpare`).
* `toRP` (to the real game): the base table reprogrammed at every read
  address of every attempt with the lazy answers (frozen digest address,
  `LazyFrozen.progF`), and the secrets.  `meanR_P`: uniform, from the frozen
  lazy-programming law and the causality premise `RCausal`.

Premises named here: `RomModel` (R-rom: the random oracle is a uniform table
on a finite domain of byte strings; `look` is evaluation, 0 off the domain),
`RAddrIn` (every prover address is in that domain), `RCausal` (R-causal: an
address depends only on the answers of earlier reads in `ord`). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Measure-preserving maps -/

def MP {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (g : X → Y) : Prop :=
  ∀ f : Y → ℚ, mean (fun x => f (g x)) = mean f

theorem mp_comp {X Y Z : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype Z] {g : X → Y} {g' : Y → Z}
    (h : MP g) (h' : MP g') : MP (fun x => g' (g x)) :=
  fun f => (h (fun y => f (g' y))).trans (h' f)

theorem mp_equiv {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (e : X ≃ Y) : MP e := by
  intro f
  rw [mean_equiv' e (fun x => f (e x))]
  simp

theorem mean_comm {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (F : X → Y → ℚ) :
    mean (fun x => mean (fun y => F x y)) = mean (fun y => mean (fun x => F x y)) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.sum_div, div_div, mul_comm]

theorem mp_fst {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Nonempty Y] : MP (Prod.fst : X × Y → X) := by
  intro f
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product]
  simp only [mean_const']

theorem mp_snd {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Nonempty X] : MP (Prod.snd : X × Y → Y) := by
  intro f
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product, mean_comm]
  simp only [mean_const']

theorem mp_prodMap {X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ : Type} [Fintype X₁] [Fintype X₂] [Fintype Y₁] [Fintype Y₂]
    {g₁ : X₁ → Y₁} {g₂ : X₂ → Y₂} (h₁ : MP g₁) (h₂ : MP g₂) :
    MP (fun p : X₁ × X₂ => (g₁ p.1, g₂ p.2)) := by
  intro f
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product, LawTransport.mean_product (f := f)]
  simp only []
  have e1 : ∀ x₁, mean (fun x₂ => f (g₁ x₁, g₂ x₂)) = mean (fun y₂ => f (g₁ x₁, y₂)) :=
    fun x₁ => h₂ (fun y₂ => f (g₁ x₁, y₂))
  simp only [e1]
  rw [mean_comm, mean_comm (fun y₁ y₂ => f (y₁, y₂))]
  congr 1
  funext y₂
  exact h₁ (fun y₁ => f (y₁, y₂))

theorem mp_pi {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Nonempty Y] {g : X → Y} (h : MP g) :
    ∀ N : ℕ, MP (fun (x : Fin N → X) (k : Fin N) => g (x k))
  | 0 => by
      intro f
      have hu : ∀ x : Fin 0 → X, (fun k => g (x k)) = (default : Fin 0 → Y) :=
        fun x => Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [hu, mean_const']
      unfold mean
      rw [Fintype.sum_unique, Fintype.card_unique]
      simp
  | N + 1 => by
      have hc := mp_comp (mp_comp (mp_equiv (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ => X)).symm)
        (mp_prodMap h (mp_pi h N))) (mp_equiv (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ => Y)))
      intro f
      have e : (fun x : Fin (N + 1) → X => f (fun k => g (x k))) =
          (fun x => f ((Fin.consEquiv (fun _ => Y))
            (g ((Fin.consEquiv (fun _ => X)).symm x).1,
              fun k => g (((Fin.consEquiv (fun _ => X)).symm x).2 k)))) := by
        funext x
        congr 1
        funext k
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) k
        · rfl
        · rfl
      rw [e]
      exact hc f

/-! ### The random-oracle model and the premises -/

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- R-rom: the oracle is a uniform table on a finite domain `A` of byte
strings (every hash input of the protocol has bounded length); `look` is
evaluation, and 0 off the domain. -/
structure RomModel (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) where
  A : Type
  finA : Fintype A
  deqA : DecidableEq A
  neA : Nonempty A
  dec : List UInt8 → Option A
  enc : A → List UInt8
  dec_enc : ∀ a, dec (enc a) = some a
  enc_of_dec : ∀ b a, dec b = some a → enc a = b
  eTab : W.Tab ≃ (A → OracleAnswer)
  look_eq : ∀ tab b, W.look tab b = match dec b with
    | some a => eTab tab a
    | none => 0

attribute [instance] RomModel.finA RomModel.deqA RomModel.neA

section Model
variable {W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux} (R : RomModel W)

def lookA (T : R.A → OracleAnswer) (b : List UInt8) : OracleAnswer :=
  match R.dec b with
  | some a => T a
  | none => 0

theorem look_eqA (tab : W.Tab) (b : List UInt8) : W.look tab b = lookA R (R.eTab tab) b := by
  rw [R.look_eq]
  unfold lookA
  cases R.dec b <;> rfl

/-- The frozen addresses: the statement digest's input `public_bytes`. -/
def Frz (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Finset R.A :=
  match R.dec (W.pubBytes x) with
  | some a => {a}
  | none => ∅

theorem lookA_frozen (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (T T' : R.A → OracleAnswer)
    (h : ∀ y ∈ Frz R x, T y = T' y) : lookA R T (W.pubBytes x) = lookA R T' (W.pubBytes x) := by
  unfold lookA
  unfold Frz at h
  split
  · next a ha =>
      rw [ha] at h
      exact h a (Finset.mem_singleton_self a)
  · rfl

end Model

section Coupling
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer))
  (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

/-- Every prover read address lies in the oracle's domain. -/
def RAddrIn : Prop :=
  ∀ (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (p : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂),
    (R.dec (attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v p)).isSome

/-- R-causal: in the prover's order `ord`, every read's address (transcript
or commitment; roots, challenges and tape evaluated on the answers so far)
depends only on the answers of the earlier reads. -/
def RCausal : Prop :=
  ∀ (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin (n1 W Pr)) (v v' : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer),
    (∀ j, j < i → v (Pr.ord j) = v' (Pr.ord j)) →
      attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v (Pr.ord i) = attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v' (Pr.ord i)

abbrev AttS := SecP × (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) × Tape K F × W.Tab

/-- The lazy answers of all attempts as one vector (attempt-major, `ord`). -/
def uVec {N : ℕ} (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer :=
  fun g => (s (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1).2.1 (Pr.ord (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2)

theorem attVec_uVec {N : ℕ} (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N) :
    attVec W Pr (uVec W Pr s) k = (s k).2.1 := by
  funext p
  simp [attVec, uVec]

/-- The global read program with addresses in the oracle domain. -/
def aA {N : ℕ} (sec : Fin N → SecP) (g : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) (V : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer)
    (T : R.A → OracleAnswer) : R.A :=
  (R.dec (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec (lookA R T (W.pubBytes x)) g V)).getD
    (Classical.arbitrary R.A)

theorem enc_aA (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) {N : ℕ} (sec : Fin N → SecP)
    (g : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) (V : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) (T : R.A → OracleAnswer) :
    R.enc (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w sec g V T) =
      gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec (lookA R T (W.pubBytes x)) g V := by
  unfold aA
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (hin _ _ _ _)
  unfold gAddr
  rw [ha]
  exact R.enc_of_dec _ _ ha

theorem fPF_lt {N n : ℕ} (k : Fin N) (j i : Fin n) (h : j < i) :
    finProdFinEquiv (k, j) < finProdFinEquiv (k, i) := by
  show j.val + n * k.val < i.val + n * k.val
  have := Fin.lt_def.mp h
  omega

theorem causalF_aA (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) {N : ℕ} (sec : Fin N → SecP) :
    CausalF (Frz R x) (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w sec) := by
  intro g V V' T T' hV hT
  unfold aA gAddr
  rw [lookA_frozen R x T T' hT]
  congr 2
  refine hc _ _ _ _ _ (fun j hj => ?_)
  unfold attVec
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  refine hV _ ?_
  have hg : finProdFinEquiv ((finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1, (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2) = g :=
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  conv_rhs => rw [← hg]
  exact fPF_lt _ _ _ hj

/-! ### The two maps -/

def toRP {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP) :=
  (R.eTab.symm (progF (Frz R x) (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1))
    (R.eTab (s ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) (uVec W Pr s)), fun k => (s k).1)

/-- One attempt's middle coins and tape. -/
def gM (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab × Tape K F :=
  ((trOf a.2.1, rootsOf a.2.1, eCm.symm (restOf a.2.1), a.2.2.2),
    (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of a.2.1) (e₂Of a.2.1)).getD a.2.2.1)

def toMP {N : ℕ} (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) :
    (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F) :=
  (fun k => (gM W Pr eCm (s k)).1, fun k => (gM W Pr eCm (s k)).2)

end Coupling

#print axioms mp_pi
#print axioms mp_prodMap
#print axioms enc_aA
#print axioms causalF_aA
#print axioms mp_comp
#print axioms mp_equiv
#print axioms mean_comm
#print axioms mp_fst
#print axioms mp_snd
#print axioms look_eqA
#print axioms lookA_frozen
#print axioms attVec_uVec
#print axioms fPF_lt
end R1Z.CouplingR1PBin

R1Z.CouplingR1P2Bin.text:
import R1Z.CouplingR1PBin

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.CouplingR1P2` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! The real coupling, part 2 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §4): `meanM_P` (the middle
coins and tapes are uniform) and `meanR_P` (the reprogrammed table and the
secrets are uniform), assembled into `cpP : Coupling`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

instance instPos1Fin {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} : Fintype (Pos1 E₁ E₂) := inferInstance
instance instPos1Deq {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} : DecidableEq (Pos1 E₁ E₂) := inferInstance
instance instPos1Fun {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} : Fintype (Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) :=
  @Pi.instFintype _ _ instPos1Deq instPos1Fin (fun _ => inferInstance)
instance instAttSFin (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) :
    Fintype (AttS (F := F) W Pr) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (SecP × (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) × Tape K F × W.Tab))

section Means
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer))

instance : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩

/-- An attempt's answers split by read kind. -/
def eV : (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) ≃ (TRead → OracleAnswer) × (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) ×
    (((Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) × (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) where
  toFun v := (trOf v, rootsOf v, ((e₁Of v, e₂Of v), restOf v))
  invFun q p := match p with
    | .inl j => q.1 j
    | .inr (.inl i) => q.2.1 i
    | .inr (.inr (.inl (.inl c))) => q.2.2.1.1 c
    | .inr (.inr (.inl (.inr c))) => q.2.2.1.2 c
    | .inr (.inr (.inr r)) => q.2.2.2 r
  left_inv v := by
    funext p
    rcases p with j | i | (c | c) | r <;> rfl
  right_inv q := rfl

/-- Regroup: the coin part and the (expander answers, spare tape) part. -/
def rearr {A₁ A₂ E A₄ T B : Type} : ((A₁ × A₂ × (E × A₄)) × (T × B)) ≃ ((A₁ × A₂ × A₄ × B) × (E × T)) where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1, p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2.2, p.2.2), (p.1.2.2.1, p.2.1))
  invFun q := ((q.1.1, q.1.2.1, (q.2.1, q.1.2.2.1)), (q.2.2, q.1.2.2.2))
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

def eC : ((TRead → OracleAnswer) × (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) × (RIdx → OracleAnswer) × W.Tab) ≃
    R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab where
  toFun q := (q.1, q.2.1, eCm.symm q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2)
  invFun c := (c.1, c.2.1, eCm c.2.2.1, c.2.2.2)
  left_inv q := by simp
  right_inv c := by simp

theorem mp_gM (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF) :
    MP (gM W Pr eCm) := by
  have hd : MP (fun p : ((Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) × Tape K F =>
      (Pr.tapeOf p.1.1 p.1.2).getD p.2) :=
    fun f => R0Z.FsAbortTape.mean_decodeOrSpare
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) cF
      (fun τ => by convert hfib τ) f
  have h1 : MP (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => a.2) := mp_snd
  have h2 : MP (fun p : (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) × (Tape K F × W.Tab) =>
      (eV W Pr p.1, (Equiv.refl (Tape K F × W.Tab)) p.2)) :=
    mp_prodMap (mp_equiv (eV W Pr)) (mp_equiv (Equiv.refl _))
  have h3 := mp_equiv (rearr (A₁ := TRead → OracleAnswer) (A₂ := Fin 3 → OracleAnswer)
    (E := (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) (A₄ := RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (T := Tape K F) (B := W.Tab))
  have h4 := mp_prodMap (mp_equiv (eC W eCm)) hd
  have hc := mp_comp (mp_comp (mp_comp h1 h2) h3) h4
  intro f
  exact hc f

theorem meanM_P (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF) (N : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr => f (toMP W Pr eCm s)) = mean f := by
  have hp := mp_pi (mp_gM W Pr eCm cF hfib) N
  have he := mp_equiv (Equiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow (Fin N) (fun _ => R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab)
    (fun _ => Tape K F))
  exact (mp_comp hp he) f

end Means

section RealMean
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)

abbrev QP := (Fin N → SecP) × (Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) × W.Tab
abbrev ExP := (Fin N → Tape K F) × ({j : Fin N // j ≠ ⟨0, hN⟩} → W.Tab)

def eS : (Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) ≃ QP W Pr N × ExP (K := K) (F := F) W N hN where
  toFun s := ((fun k => (s k).1, uVec W Pr s, (s ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2),
    (fun k => (s k).2.2.1, fun j => (s j.1).2.2.2))
  invFun q k := (q.1.1 k, fun p => q.1.2.1 (finProdFinEquiv (k, Pr.ord.symm p)), q.2.1 k,
    if hk : k = ⟨0, hN⟩ then q.1.2.2 else q.2.2 ⟨k, hk⟩)
  left_inv s := by
    funext k
    refine Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext rfl ?_))
    · funext p
      simp [uVec]
    · show (if hk : k = ⟨0, hN⟩ then (s ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2 else (s k).2.2.2) = (s k).2.2.2
      by_cases hk : k = ⟨0, hN⟩
      · subst hk
        simp
      · simp [hk]
  right_inv q := by
    refine Prod.ext (Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)) (Prod.ext rfl ?_)
    · funext g
      show q.1.2.1 (finProdFinEquiv ((finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1,
        Pr.ord.symm (Pr.ord (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2))) = q.1.2.1 g
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact congrArg _ (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)
    · show (if hk : (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin N) = ⟨0, hN⟩ then q.1.2.2 else q.2.2 ⟨⟨0, hN⟩, hk⟩) = q.1.2.2
      simp
    · funext j
      show (if hk : j.1 = ⟨0, hN⟩ then q.1.2.2 else q.2.2 ⟨j.1, hk⟩) = q.2.2 j
      simp [j.2]

/-- The real side of the coupling as a function of the lazy coordinates. -/
def PhiP (q : QP W Pr N) : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP) :=
  (R.eTab.symm (progF (Frz R x) (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w q.1) (R.eTab q.2.2) q.2.1), q.1)

theorem mp_PhiP (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) : MP (PhiP W Pr R h B outputs x w N) := by
  intro f
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product]
  have inner : ∀ sec : Fin N → SecP,
      mean (fun r : (Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) × W.Tab =>
        f (PhiP W Pr R h B outputs x w N (sec, r))) = mean (fun tab : W.Tab => f (tab, sec)) := by
    intro sec
    have hl : MP (fun p : (R.A → OracleAnswer) × (Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) =>
        progF (Frz R x) (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w sec) p.1 p.2) :=
      fun F => mean_progF (Frz R x) _ (causalF_aA W Pr R h B outputs x w hc sec) F
    have hs : MP (fun r : (Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) × W.Tab => (R.eTab r.2, r.1)) :=
      mp_equiv ((Equiv.prodComm _ _).trans (Equiv.prodCongr R.eTab (Equiv.refl _)))
    have hall := mp_comp (mp_comp hs hl) (mp_equiv R.eTab.symm)
    exact hall (fun tab => f (tab, sec))
  simp only [inner]
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product (f := f), mean_comm]

theorem meanR_P (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (f : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr => f (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) = mean f := by
  have h1 := mp_comp (mp_equiv (eS W Pr N hN))
    (mp_fst (X := QP W Pr N) (Y := ExP (K := K) (F := F) W N hN))
  exact (mp_comp h1 (mp_PhiP W Pr R h B outputs x w N hc)) f

end RealMean

/-- The real coupling of the phase-indexed games. -/
def cpP (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF) :
    Coupling (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand
      ((Fin (abR1P W N hN).N → (abR1P W N hN).Coins) × (Fin (abR1P W N hN).N → Tape K F)) where
  S := Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN
  toM := toMP W Pr eCm
  meanR := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
  meanM := meanM_P W Pr eCm cF hfib N

#print axioms eV
#print axioms mp_gM
#print axioms meanM_P
#print axioms eS
#print axioms mp_PhiP
#print axioms meanR_P
#print axioms cpP
end R1Z.CouplingR1PBin

R1Z.LayoutR1P2Bin.text:
import R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-! BINARY format (copy of `LayoutR1P2` over `Fin 2` children). The commitment layout, part 2 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §3): the Merkle index
algebra (children are unique, levels separate leaves, nodes and roots), the
pair table `fresh_or_sep`, and the opened reads with `hidden`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin

/-! ### Index algebra -/

theorem nodeIdx_ext {n n' : NodeIdx} : n = n' ↔ n.1 = n'.1 ∧ n.2.val = n'.2.val := by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨d, i⟩ := n
    obtain ⟨d', i'⟩ := n'
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    simp only at h1 h2
    subst h1
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
    exact Fin.ext h2

theorem qNode_inj {T T' : Fin 3} {n n' : NodeIdx} : qNode T n = qNode T' n' ↔ T = T' ∧ n = n' := by
  simp [qNode]

theorem childQ_cases (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) :
    (n.1.val = 0 ∧ ∃ u : Fib, u.val = 2 * n.2.val + j.val ∧ childQ T n j = qLeaf T u) ∨
    (∃ n' : NodeIdx, n.1.val = n'.1.val + 1 ∧ n'.2.val = 2 * n.2.val + j.val ∧
      childQ T n j = qNode T n') := by
  obtain ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, i⟩ := n
  cases d with
  | zero => exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, _, rfl, rfl⟩
  | succ d => exact Or.inr ⟨_, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem childQ_ne_bind (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) (b : Fin 2) : childQ T n j ≠ qBind b := by
  rcases childQ_cases T n j with ⟨_, u, _, h⟩ | ⟨n', _, _, h⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> simp [qLeaf, qNode, qBind]

theorem childQ_ne_seed (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) (i : Fin 3) : childQ T n j ≠ qSeed i := by
  rcases childQ_cases T n j with ⟨_, u, _, h⟩ | ⟨n', _, _, h⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> simp [qLeaf, qNode, qSeed]

theorem childQ_ne_salt (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) (T' : Fin 3) (u : Fib) :
    childQ T n j ≠ qSalt T' u := by
  rcases childQ_cases T n j with ⟨_, v, _, h⟩ | ⟨n', _, _, h⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> simp [qLeaf, qNode, qSalt]

theorem childQ_eq_leaf (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) (T' : Fin 3) (u : Fib)
    (h : childQ T n j = qLeaf T' u) : T = T' ∧ n.1.val = 0 ∧ u.val = 2 * n.2.val + j.val := by
  rcases childQ_cases T n j with ⟨h0, v, hv, e⟩ | ⟨n', _, _, e⟩
  · rw [e] at h
    simp only [qLeaf, Sum.inr.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨rfl, h0, hv⟩
  · rw [e] at h
    simp [qLeaf, qNode] at h

theorem childQ_eq_node (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) (T' : Fin 3) (m : NodeIdx)
    (h : childQ T n j = qNode T' m) :
    T = T' ∧ n.1.val = m.1.val + 1 ∧ m.2.val = 2 * n.2.val + j.val := by
  rcases childQ_cases T n j with ⟨_, v, _, e⟩ | ⟨n', h1, h2, e⟩
  · rw [e] at h
    simp [qLeaf, qNode] at h
  · rw [e, qNode_inj] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨rfl, h1, h2⟩

theorem childQ_inj (T T' : Fin 3) (n n' : NodeIdx) (j j' : Fin 2)
    (h : childQ T n j = childQ T' n' j') : T = T' ∧ n = n' ∧ j = j' := by
  rcases childQ_cases T' n' j' with ⟨h0, u, hu, e⟩ | ⟨m, h1, h2, e⟩
  · rw [e] at h
    obtain ⟨hT, hn0, hu'⟩ := childQ_eq_leaf T n j T' u h
    refine ⟨hT, nodeIdx_ext.mpr ⟨Fin.ext (by omega), by omega⟩, Fin.ext (by have := j.isLt; have := j'.isLt; omega)⟩
  · rw [e] at h
    obtain ⟨hT, hn1, hm⟩ := childQ_eq_node T n j T' m h
    refine ⟨hT, nodeIdx_ext.mpr ⟨Fin.ext (by omega), by have := j.isLt; have := j'.isLt; omega⟩,
      Fin.ext (by have := j.isLt; have := j'.isLt; omega)⟩

theorem childQ_ne_rootChild (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) (T' : Fin 3) (j' : Fin 2) :
    childQ T n j ≠ rootChild T' j' := by
  intro h
  unfold rootChild at h
  obtain ⟨_, h1, _⟩ := childQ_eq_node T n j T' _ h
  have := n.1.isLt
  simp only at h1
  omega

theorem rootChild_inj (T T' : Fin 3) (j j' : Fin 2) (h : rootChild T j = rootChild T' j') :
    T = T' ∧ j = j' := by
  unfold rootChild at h
  rw [qNode_inj, nodeIdx_ext] at h
  exact ⟨h.1, Fin.ext h.2.2⟩

/-! ### Byte separation -/

theorem le32_inj (a b : ℕ) (ha : a < 2 ^ 32) (hb : b < 2 ^ 32) (h : le32 a = le32 b) : a = b := by
  simp only [le32, List.cons.injEq, and_true] at h
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  have e0 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h0
  have e1 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h1
  have e2 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h2
  have e3 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h3
  simp only [Nat.toUInt8, UInt8.toNat_ofNat] at e0 e1 e2 e3
  norm_num at ha hb e0 e1 e2 e3
  omega

theorem le64_inj (a b : ℕ) (ha : a < 2 ^ 64) (hb : b < 2 ^ 64) (h : le64 a = le64 b) : a = b := by
  simp only [le64, List.cons.injEq, and_true] at h
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7⟩ := h
  have e0 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h0
  have e1 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h1
  have e2 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h2
  have e3 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h3
  have e4 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h4
  have e5 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h5
  have e6 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h6
  have e7 := congrArg UInt8.toNat h7
  simp only [Nat.toUInt8, UInt8.toNat_ofNat] at e0 e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 e6 e7
  norm_num at ha hb e0 e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 e6 e7
  omega

theorem treeTag_inj (T T' : Fin 3) (h : treeTag T = treeTag T') : T = T' := by
  revert h
  revert T T'
  decide

theorem cancel_mid (p x x' y y' : List UInt8) (hl : x.length = x'.length)
    (h : p ++ x ++ y = p ++ x' ++ y') : x = x' := by
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc] at h
  exact (List.append_inj (List.append_cancel_left h) hl).1

section Sep
variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

theorem sep_seed (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) :
    gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inr (qSeed 0))) ≠
      gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inr (qSeed 1))) := by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg (fun l : List UInt8 => l[18]?) h
  simp only [gram, qSeed, show (0 : Fin 3).val = 0 from rfl, show (1 : Fin 3).val = 1 from rfl,
    if_true, show ¬ ((1 : ℕ) = 0) from by decide, if_false, List.append_assoc] at h'
  rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by decide), List.getElem?_append_left (by decide)] at h'
  exact absurd h' (by decide)

theorem sep_salt (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (T T' : Fin 3) (u u' : Fib)
    (hne : (T, u) ≠ (T', u')) :
    gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inr (qSalt T u))) ≠
      gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inr (qSalt T' u'))) := by
  intro h
  simp only [gram, qSalt] at h
  have e : ∀ (TT : Fin 3) (uu : Fib), dLeafSalt ++ ans (rest (qBind 1)) ++ ans (sec 0).1 ++ [treeTag TT] ++
      le32 uu.val ++ ans (sec 2).1 =
      (dLeafSalt ++ ans (rest (qBind 1)) ++ ans (sec 0).1) ++ ([treeTag TT] ++ le32 uu.val) ++ ans (sec 2).1 := by
    intro TT uu
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
  rw [e, e] at h
  have hm := cancel_mid _ _ _ _ _ (by simp [le32]) h
  simp only [List.singleton_append, List.cons.injEq] at hm
  have hT := treeTag_inj T T' hm.1
  have hu := le32_inj u.val u'.val (lt_of_lt_of_le u.isLt (by norm_num))
    (lt_of_lt_of_le u'.isLt (by norm_num)) hm.2
  exact hne (by rw [hT, Fin.ext hu])

theorem sep_exp1 (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (hE : E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (c c' : Fin E₁) (hne : c ≠ c') :
    gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inl (.inl c))) ≠
      gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inl (.inl c'))) := by
  intro h
  simp only [gram] at h
  exact hne (Fin.ext (le64_inj _ _ (lt_of_lt_of_le c.isLt hE) (lt_of_lt_of_le c'.isLt hE)
    (List.append_cancel_left h)))

theorem sep_exp2 (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (hE : E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (c c' : Fin E₂) (hne : c ≠ c') :
    gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inl (.inr c))) ≠
      gram (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) pub vtag lv sec d rest (.inr (.inl (.inr c'))) := by
  intro h
  simp only [gram] at h
  exact hne (Fin.ext (le64_inj _ _ (lt_of_lt_of_le c.isLt hE) (lt_of_lt_of_le c'.isLt hE)
    (List.append_cancel_left h)))

end Sep

R1Z.LayoutR1P3Bin.text:
import R1Z.LayoutR1P2Bin

/-! BINARY format (copy of `LayoutR1P3`: designated child 1, `openedQ` with `u / 2^(level+1)`). The commitment layout, part 3 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §3): who reads each
designated field (`rd_*`), the pair table `fresh_or_sep`, the opened reads
and `hidden`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin

section Readers
variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

theorem rd_rootChild (c' : CPos E₁ E₂) (T : Fin 3) (j₀ : Fin 2) (h : depS c' (.inr (rootChild T j₀))) :
    c' = .inl T := by
  rcases c' with T' | (c1 | c1) | (b | i | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', n⟩)
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    rw [(rootChild_inj _ _ _ _ (Sum.inr.inj e)).1]
  · simp [depS, rootChild, qNode, qSeed] at h
  · simp [depS, rootChild, qNode, qSeed] at h
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0 <;> simp [depS, hb, rootChild, qNode, qBind] at h
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2 <;> simp [depS, hi, rootChild, qNode, qBind, qSeed] at h
  · simp [depS, rootChild, qNode, qBind] at h
  · simp [depS, rootChild, qNode, qSalt] at h
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj e).symm (childQ_ne_rootChild _ _ _ _ _)

theorem rd_childQ (c' : CPos E₁ E₂) (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j₀ : Fin 2)
    (h : depS c' (.inr (childQ T n j₀))) : c' = .inr (.inr (qNode T n)) := by
  rcases c' with T' | (c1 | c1) | (b | i | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', n'⟩)
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj e) (childQ_ne_rootChild _ _ _ _ _)
  · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj (show _ = _ from h)) (childQ_ne_seed _ _ _ _)
  · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj (show _ = _ from h)) (childQ_ne_seed _ _ _ _)
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp [depS, hb] at h
    · simp only [depS, hb, if_false] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj h) (childQ_ne_bind _ _ _ _)
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2
    · simp only [depS, hi, if_true] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj h) (childQ_ne_bind _ _ _ _)
      · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj h) (childQ_ne_seed _ _ _ _)
    · simp only [depS, hi, if_false] at h
      rcases h with h | h | h
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · exact absurd h (by simp)
      · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj h) (childQ_ne_bind _ _ _ _)
  · simp only [depS] at h
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · exact absurd h (by simp)
    · exact absurd h (by simp)
    · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj h) (childQ_ne_bind _ _ _ _)
  · exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj (show _ = _ from h)) (childQ_ne_salt _ _ _ _ _)
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨hT, hn, _⟩ := childQ_inj _ _ _ _ _ _ (Sum.inr.inj e)
    rw [hT, hn]
    rfl

theorem rd_salt (c' : CPos E₁ E₂) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) (h : depS c' (.inr (qSalt T u))) :
    c' = .inr (.inr (qLeaf T u)) := by
  rcases c' with T' | (c1 | c1) | (b | i | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', n⟩)
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    simp [rootChild, qNode, qSalt] at e
  · simp [depS, qSalt, qSeed] at h
  · simp [depS, qSalt, qSeed] at h
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0 <;> simp [depS, hb, qSalt, qBind] at h
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2 <;> simp [depS, hi, qSalt, qBind, qSeed] at h
  · simp [depS, qSalt, qBind] at h
  · simp only [depS, qSalt, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj e).symm (childQ_ne_salt _ _ _ _ _)

theorem rd_seed (c' : CPos E₁ E₂) (k : Fin 3) (h : depS c' (.inr (qSeed k))) :
    (k.val = 0 ∧ ∃ c1, c' = .inr (.inl (.inl c1))) ∨ (k.val = 2 ∧ ∃ c1, c' = .inr (.inl (.inr c1))) ∨
      (k.val = 1 ∧ ∃ i : Fin 3, i.val = 2 ∧ c' = .inr (.inr (qSeed i))) := by
  rcases c' with T' | (c1 | c1) | (b | i | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', n⟩)
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    simp [rootChild, qNode, qSeed] at e
  · simp only [depS, qSeed, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq] at h
    exact Or.inl ⟨by simp [h], c1, rfl⟩
  · simp only [depS, qSeed, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq] at h
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨by simp [h], c1, rfl⟩)
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0 <;> simp [depS, hb, qSeed, qBind] at h
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2
    · simp only [depS, hi, if_true] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · simp [qSeed, qBind] at h
      · simp only [qSeed, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq] at h
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by rw [h]; rfl, i, hi, rfl⟩)
    · simp [depS, hi, qSeed, qBind] at h
  · simp [depS, qSeed, qBind] at h
  · simp [depS, qSeed, qSalt] at h
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj e).symm (childQ_ne_seed _ _ _ _)

theorem rd_bind0 (c' : CPos E₁ E₂) (h : depS c' (.inr (qBind 0))) :
    (∃ b : Fin 2, b.val ≠ 0 ∧ c' = .inr (.inr (qBind b))) ∨
      (∃ i : Fin 3, i.val ≠ 2 ∧ c' = .inr (.inr (qSeed i))) := by
  rcases c' with T' | (c1 | c1) | (b | i | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', n⟩)
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    simp [rootChild, qNode, qBind] at e
  · simp [depS, qSeed, qBind] at h
  · simp [depS, qSeed, qBind] at h
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp [depS, hb] at h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2
    · simp only [depS, hi, if_true] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · simp only [qBind, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq] at h
        exact absurd h (by decide)
      · simp [qSeed, qBind] at h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  · simp only [depS] at h
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · simp at h
    · simp at h
    · simp only [qBind, Sum.inr.injEq, Sum.inl.injEq] at h
      exact absurd h (by decide)
  · simp [depS, qSalt, qBind] at h
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    exact absurd (Sum.inr.inj e).symm (childQ_ne_bind _ _ _ _)

theorem rd_sec (c' : CPos E₁ E₂) (k : Fin 3) (h : depS c' (.inl k)) :
    (k.val = 0 ∧ ∃ b : Fin 2, c' = .inr (.inr (qBind b))) ∨
      (k.val ≠ 2 ∧ ∃ i : Fin 3, i.val ≠ 2 ∧ c' = .inr (.inr (qSeed i))) ∨
      (k.val ≠ 1 ∧ ∃ T u, c' = .inr (.inr (qSalt T u))) := by
  rcases c' with T' | (c1 | c1) | (b | i | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', n⟩)
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    simp at e
  · simp [depS] at h
  · simp [depS] at h
  · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, b, rfl⟩
    by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [depS, hb, if_true, Sum.inl.injEq] at h
      rw [h]; rfl
    · simp only [depS, hb, if_false] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · rw [Sum.inl.inj h]; rfl
      · simp at h
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2
    · simp [depS, hi] at h
    · simp only [depS, hi, if_false] at h
      refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨?_, i, hi, rfl⟩)
      rcases h with h | h | h
      · rw [Sum.inl.inj h]; decide
      · rw [Sum.inl.inj h]; decide
      · simp at h
  · simp only [depS] at h
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨?_, T', v, rfl⟩)
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · rw [Sum.inl.inj h]; decide
    · rw [Sum.inl.inj h]; decide
    · simp at h
  · simp [depS] at h
  · obtain ⟨j, e⟩ := h
    simp at e

end Readers

/-! ### The pair table -/

section Pairs
variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

/-- Two distinct commitment reads: one does not read the other's designated
field, or their addresses differ for every input. -/
theorem fresh_or_sep (hE₁ : E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (c c' : CPos E₁ E₂) (hne : c ≠ c') :
    ¬ depS c' (src c) ∨ ¬ depS c (src c') ∨
      ∀ pub vtag lv sec d rest, gram pub vtag lv sec d rest c ≠ gram pub vtag lv sec d rest c' := by
  rcases c with T | (c0 | c0) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (fun h => hne (rd_rootChild c' T 1 h).symm)
  · by_cases h : depS c' (.inr (qSeed 0))
    · rcases rd_seed c' 0 h with ⟨_, c1, rfl⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩
      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (fun pub vtag lv sec d rest => sep_exp1 pub vtag lv sec d rest hE₁ c0 c1
          (fun e => hne (by rw [e]))))
      · exact absurd h2 (by decide)
      · exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact Or.inl h
  · by_cases h : depS c' (.inr (qSeed 2))
    · rcases rd_seed c' 2 h with ⟨h0, _⟩ | ⟨_, c1, rfl⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩
      · exact absurd h0 (by decide)
      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (fun pub vtag lv sec d rest => sep_exp2 pub vtag lv sec d rest hE₂ c0 c1
          (fun e => hne (by rw [e]))))
      · exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    · exact Or.inl h
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · -- src = nonce; the precommit binding reads only the nonce
      refine Or.inr (Or.inl (fun h => ?_))
      simp only [depS, hb, if_true] at h
      rcases c' with T' | (c1 | c1) | (b' | i' | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', v⟩ | ⟨T', n'⟩)
      · simp [src] at h
      · simp [src] at h
      · simp [src] at h
      · by_cases hb' : b'.val = 0
        · exact hne (by rw [show b = b' from Fin.ext (by rw [hb, hb'])])
        · simp [src, hb'] at h
      · by_cases hi' : i'.val = 2 <;> simp [src, hi'] at h
      · simp [src] at h
      · simp [src] at h
      · simp [src] at h
    · -- src = precommit-binding answer, read by the attempt binding and seeds 0/1
      by_cases h : depS c' (src (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) (.inr (.inr (.inl b))))
      · have h' : depS c' (.inr (qBind 0)) := by simpa [src, hb] using h
        rcases rd_bind0 c' h' with ⟨b', hb', rfl⟩ | ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩
        · exact absurd (show b = b' from Fin.ext (by omega)) (fun e => hne (by rw [e]; rfl))
        · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
          simp only [depS, hb, if_false, src, qSeed, hi']
          simp
      · exact Or.inl h
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2
    · refine Or.inl (fun h => ?_)
      have h' : depS c' (.inr (qSeed 1)) := by simpa [src, hi] using h
      rcases rd_seed c' 1 h' with ⟨h0, _⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨_, i', hi', rfl⟩
      · exact absurd h0 (by decide)
      · exact absurd h2 (by decide)
      · exact hne (by rw [show i = i' from Fin.ext (by omega)]; rfl)
    · by_cases h : depS c' (src (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl i)))))
      · have h' : depS c' (.inl 1) := by simpa [src, hi] using h
        rcases rd_sec c' 1 h' with ⟨h0, _⟩ | ⟨_, i', hi', rfl⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩
        · exact absurd h0 (by decide)
        · have hii : i ≠ i' := fun e => hne (by rw [e]; rfl)
          refine Or.inr (Or.inr (fun pub vtag lv sec d rest => ?_))
          have hv : (i.val = 0 ∧ i'.val = 1) ∨ (i.val = 1 ∧ i'.val = 0) := by
            have := fun e => hii (Fin.ext e)
            omega
          rcases hv with ⟨h0, h1⟩ | ⟨h1, h0⟩
          · rw [show i = 0 from Fin.ext h0, show i' = 1 from Fin.ext h1]
            exact sep_seed pub vtag lv sec d rest
          · rw [show i = 1 from Fin.ext h1, show i' = 0 from Fin.ext h0]
            exact fun e => sep_seed pub vtag lv sec d rest e.symm
        · exact absurd h1 (by decide)
      · exact Or.inl h
  · by_cases h : depS c' (.inl 2)
    · rcases rd_sec c' 2 h with ⟨h0, _⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨_, T', u', rfl⟩
      · exact absurd h0 (by decide)
      · exact absurd h2 (by decide)
      · refine Or.inr (Or.inr (fun pub vtag lv sec d rest => sep_salt pub vtag lv sec d rest T T' u u'
          (fun e => hne (by rw [e]; rfl))))
    · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inl (fun h => hne (rd_salt c' T u h).symm)
  · exact Or.inl (fun h => hne (rd_childQ c' T n 1 h).symm)

end Pairs

/-! ### Opened reads -/

/-- The opened reads for opened fibres `fib`: the three roots, the opened
leaves and every node on their paths. -/
def openedQ (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx → Prop
  | .inl _ => True
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, u))))) => u ∈ fib T
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T, n))))) => ∃ u ∈ fib T, u.val / 2 ^ (n.1.val + 1) = n.2.val
  | _ => False

section Opened
variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

def openedC (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) : CPos E₁ E₂ → Prop
  | .inl _ => True
  | .inr (.inl _) => False
  | .inr (.inr q) => openedQ fib (.inr q)

theorem openedC_cposOf (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :
    openedC (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) fib (cposOf c) ↔ openedQ fib c := by
  rcases c with _ | _ <;> rfl

theorem div_pow_succ (u e : ℕ) : u / 2 ^ (e + 1 + 1) = u / 2 ^ (e + 1) / 2 := by
  rw [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, pow_succ]

/-- The designated field of an unopened read is neither read by nor the
answer of any opened read. -/
theorem hidden (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) (hc : openedQ fib c)
    (p : CPos E₁ E₂) (hp : ¬ openedC fib p) (q : RIdx) (hq : src p = .inr q) :
    ¬ depS (cposOf (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) c) (.inr q) ∧ c ≠ .inr q := by
  have hcC : openedC (E₁ := E₁) (E₂ := E₂) fib (cposOf c) := (openedC_cposOf fib c).mpr hc
  rcases p with T | (c0 | c0) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · exact absurd trivial hp
  · simp only [src, Sum.inr.injEq] at hq
    subst hq
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun e => by rw [e] at hc; simp [openedQ, qSeed] at hc⟩
    rcases rd_seed _ 0 h with ⟨_, c1, e⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩
    · rw [e] at hcC
      exact hcC
    · exact absurd h2 (by decide)
    · exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · simp only [src, Sum.inr.injEq] at hq
    subst hq
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun e => by rw [e] at hc; simp [openedQ, qSeed] at hc⟩
    rcases rd_seed _ 2 h with ⟨h0, _⟩ | ⟨_, c1, e⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩
    · exact absurd h0 (by decide)
    · rw [e] at hcC
      exact hcC
    · exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp [src, hb] at hq
    · simp only [src, hb, if_false, Sum.inr.injEq] at hq
      subst hq
      refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun e => by rw [e] at hc; simp [openedQ, qBind] at hc⟩
      rcases rd_bind0 _ h with ⟨b', _, e⟩ | ⟨i', _, e⟩
      · rw [e] at hcC
        simp [openedC, openedQ, qBind] at hcC
      · rw [e] at hcC
        simp [openedC, openedQ, qSeed] at hcC
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 2
    · simp only [src, hi, if_true, Sum.inr.injEq] at hq
      subst hq
      refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun e => by rw [e] at hc; simp [openedQ, qSeed] at hc⟩
      rcases rd_seed _ 1 h with ⟨h0, _⟩ | ⟨h2, _⟩ | ⟨_, i', _, e⟩
      · exact absurd h0 (by decide)
      · exact absurd h2 (by decide)
      · rw [e] at hcC
        simp [openedC, openedQ, qSeed] at hcC
    · simp [src, hi] at hq
  · simp [src] at hq
  · simp only [src, Sum.inr.injEq] at hq
    subst hq
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun e => by rw [e] at hc; simp [openedQ, qSalt] at hc⟩
    have e := rd_salt _ T u h
    rw [e] at hcC
    exact hp hcC
  · simp only [src, Sum.inr.injEq] at hq
    subst hq
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun e => ?_⟩
    · have e := rd_childQ _ T n 1 h
      rw [e] at hcC
      exact hp hcC
    · rw [e] at hc
      apply hp
      show ∃ u ∈ fib T, u.val / 2 ^ (n.1.val + 1) = n.2.val
      rcases childQ_cases T n 1 with ⟨h0, v, hv, ec⟩ | ⟨m, h1, h2, ec⟩
      · rw [ec] at hc
        simp only [openedQ, qLeaf] at hc
        refine ⟨v, hc, ?_⟩
        have e8 : (2 : ℕ) ^ (n.1.val + 1) = 2 := by rw [h0]; norm_num
        rw [e8, hv]
        omega
      · rw [ec] at hc
        simp only [openedQ, qNode] at hc
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hwm⟩ := hc
        refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
        have e8 : (2 : ℕ) ^ (n.1.val + 1) = 2 ^ (m.1.val + 1 + 1) := by rw [h1]
        rw [e8, div_pow_succ, hwm, h2]
        omega

end Opened

import R1Z.CouplingR1P2Bin
import R1Z.LayoutR1P3Bin

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.EventsR1P` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! The events of the real coupling and their freshness (DESIGN-R1-REAL §3,
§5): positions `Fin N × Pos1` (every read of every attempt), addresses
`addrP` (the run's addresses on the lazy answers), charging (a read is
charged unless it is published: a transcript read of the accepted attempt,
or an opened commitment read of it), the adversary's reads `qryP` in the
middle game, and the designated-field lenses on the coupling space.

PROVED: `HitFresh` and `PairFresh` (`hitP`, `pairP`) for every position,
from the transcript frame (`TranscriptR1`) and the commitment layout
(`LayoutR1P*`), under the named premises
* `RCommitBytes` (R-commit: `Pr.caddr` is the Rust byte grammar `gram`),
* `ROpen` (R-wire: the verifier's opening list is the opened set of the
  opened fibres), `RComLog` (R-wire: the verifier's opening reads are the
  prover's reads at the opened positions, answered by their coins),
* `E₁, E₂ ≤ 2^64` (the expander counters are u64). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.EventsR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### Named premises -/

/-- R-commit: the prover's commitment addresses are the Rust byte grammar. -/
def RCommitBytes (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : HonestProver K) (w : h.Instance) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (τ : Tape K F) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Challenges K)
    (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂),
    Pr.caddr h w x sec d τ rest ch c = gram (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest c

/-- The read set of one multiproof batch: roots and the union of binary
paths. Supplied sibling digests are bytes, not additional oracle reads.
Deterministic slot padding is also bytes, not an oracle position. -/
def batchReadSet (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) : Finset (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (openedQ fib)

theorem mem_batchReadSet (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :
    c ∈ batchReadSet fib ↔ openedQ fib c := by simp [batchReadSet]

/-- R-wire for the two transaction batches. A node may occur in both batches,
but occurs at most once within each. The aggregate covers the opened fibres.
These remain source-refinement premises, not assertions about arbitrary lists. -/
structure ROpen {W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux}
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) : Prop where
  covers : ∀ (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx),
    c ∈ Pr.openList ch ↔ openedQ (Pr.openFib ch) c
  batches : ∃ (fib : Challenges K → Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Finset Fib)
      (reads : Challenges K → Fin 2 → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)),
    (∀ ch, Pr.openList ch = reads ch 0 ++ reads ch 1) ∧
    (∀ ch b, (reads ch b).Nodup) ∧
    (∀ ch b c, c ∈ reads ch b ↔ openedQ (fib ch b) c) ∧
    (∀ ch T, Pr.openFib ch T = fib ch 0 T ∪ fib ch 1 T)

/-- Deduplication turns the verifier's per-batch log into exactly the path union. -/
theorem batch_toFinset (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (reads : List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx))
    (hc : ∀ c, c ∈ reads ↔ openedQ fib c) : reads.toFinset = batchReadSet fib := by
  ext c
  simp only [List.mem_toFinset, mem_batchReadSet, hc]

/-- Each distinct node (and leaf/root) is read once in a batch. -/
theorem batch_length (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (reads : List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx))
    (hn : reads.Nodup) (hc : ∀ c, c ∈ reads ↔ openedQ fib c) :
    reads.length = (batchReadSet fib).card := by
  rw [← batch_toFinset fib reads hc, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn]

/-- A symbolic bound: no enumeration of the 2^18-leaf universe. -/
theorem batchReadSet_card_le (fib : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) :
    (batchReadSet fib).card ≤ 2359298 := by
  have h := Finset.card_le_univ (batchReadSet fib)
  simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin, RIdx, Fib, Fintype.card_prod,
    card_NodeIdx] at h
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h

/-- Mapping the opening list (in particular the RComLog address/answer map)
preserves the two deduplicated batches and their exact set cardinalities. -/
theorem map_openList_batches {W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux}
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (hop : ROpen Pr) (ch : Challenges K)
    {β : Type} (f : (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) → β) :
    ∃ (fib : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (reads : Fin 2 → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)),
      (Pr.openList ch).map f = (reads 0).map f ++ (reads 1).map f ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).Nodup) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).toFinset = batchReadSet (fib b)) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).length = (batchReadSet (fib b)).card) := by
  obtain ⟨fib, reads, hcat, hn, hc, _⟩ := hop.batches
  refine ⟨fib ch, reads ch, ?_, hn ch, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcat ch, List.map_append]
  · intro b
    exact batch_toFinset _ _ (hc ch b)
  · intro b
    exact batch_length _ _ (hn ch b) (hc ch b)

/-- The answer of an opening position from the coins. -/
def ansC (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx → OracleAnswer
  | .inl i => roots i
  | .inr q => rest q

/-- R-wire: the verifier's opening reads (`W.comLog`) are the prover's reads at
the opened positions, with the coins as answers. -/
def RComLog (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (τ : Tape K F) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer)
    (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Challenges K),
    W.comLog (eCm.symm rest) roots (view h B outputs x w ch τ) ch =
      (Pr.openList ch).map (fun c => (Pr.caddr h w x sec d τ rest ch (cposOf c), ansC roots rest c))

/-! ### Lenses on the coupling space -/

def Lens.fnAt {N : ℕ} {C U : Type} (k : Fin N) (L : Lens C U) : Lens (Fin N → C) U where
  get s := L.get (s k)
  set s u := Function.update s k (L.set (s k) u)
  get_set s u := by simp [L.get_set]
  set_get s := by
    funext k'
    by_cases hk : k' = k
    · subst hk
      simp [L.set_get]
    · simp [Function.update_of_ne hk]
  set_set s u u' := by simp [L.set_set]

theorem Lens.fnAt_set_ne {N : ℕ} {C U : Type} (k : Fin N) (L : Lens C U) (s : Fin N → C) (u : U)
    (k' : Fin N) (hk : k' ≠ k) : ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) k' = s k' := by
  simp [Lens.fnAt, Function.update_of_ne hk]

theorem Lens.fnAt_set_eq {N : ℕ} {C U : Type} (k : Fin N) (L : Lens C U) (s : Fin N → C) (u : U) :
    ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) k = L.set (s k) u := by
  simp [Lens.fnAt]

section Lenses
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)

/-- The answer coordinate `p` of an attempt block. -/
def vL (p : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) OracleAnswer where
  get a := a.2.1 p
  set a u := (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 p u, a.2.2)
  get_set a u := by simp
  set_get a := by simp
  set_set a u u' := by simp

/-- The secret slot `i` of an attempt block. -/
def secL (i : Fin 3) : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) NZ where
  get a := a.1 i
  set a z := (Function.update a.1 i z, a.2)
  get_set a z := by simp
  set_get a := by simp
  set_set a z z' := by simp

def ksV (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Fin 8 := W.kstarOf (fun m => v (.inl (.qb m)))

theorem ksV_update_qa (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (m : Fin 8) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    ksV W Pr (Function.update v (.inl (.qa m)) u) = ksV W Pr v := by
  unfold ksV
  congr 1

/-- `sel`: the answer of `qa k*`. -/
def selL : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) OracleAnswer where
  get a := a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1)))
  set a u := (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u, a.2.2)
  get_set a u := by
    show Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u
      (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr (Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u)))) = u
    rw [ksV_update_qa]
    simp
  set_get a := by simp
  set_set a u u' := by
    show (a.1, Function.update (Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u)
        (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr (Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u)))) u', a.2.2) =
      (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u', a.2.2)
    rw [ksV_update_qa]
    simp

def chainL : Coord → Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) OracleAnswer
  | .root => vL W Pr (.inr (.inl 0))
  | .sel => selL W Pr
  | .ans j => vL W Pr (.inl j)

end Lenses

/-! ### The transcript frame -/

section Frame
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

/-- The transcript record of an attempt block. -/
def recA (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Rec :=
  recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf a.2.1)) (tapeR W Pr a.2.1)) (trOf a.2.1) (rootsOf a.2.1)

theorem tapeR_update_tr (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (j : TRead) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    tapeR W Pr (Function.update v (.inl j) u) = tapeR W Pr v := by
  unfold tapeR e₁Of e₂Of
  congr 3 <;> funext c <;> exact Function.update_of_ne (by simp) _ _

theorem tapeR_update_root (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 3) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    tapeR W Pr (Function.update v (.inr (.inl i)) u) = tapeR W Pr v := by
  unfold tapeR e₁Of e₂Of
  congr 3 <;> funext c <;> exact Function.update_of_ne (by simp) _ _

theorem trOf_update_root (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 3) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    trOf (Function.update v (.inr (.inl i)) u) = trOf v := by
  funext j
  exact Function.update_of_ne (by simp) _ _

theorem trOf_update_tr (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (j : TRead) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    trOf (Function.update v (.inl j) u) = Function.update (trOf v) j u := by
  funext j'
  by_cases hj : j' = j
  · subst hj
    simp [trOf]
  · simp [trOf, Function.update_of_ne hj, Function.update_of_ne (show (Sum.inl j' : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) ≠ .inl j by simpa using hj)]

theorem rootsOf_update_tr (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (j : TRead) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    rootsOf (Function.update v (.inl j) u) = rootsOf v := by
  funext i
  exact Function.update_of_ne (by simp) _ _

theorem rootsOf_update_root (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 3) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    rootsOf (Function.update v (.inr (.inl i)) u) = Function.update (rootsOf v) i u := by
  funext i'
  by_cases hi : i' = i
  · subst hi
    simp [rootsOf]
  · simp [rootsOf, Function.update_of_ne hi,
      Function.update_of_ne (show (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i') : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) ≠ .inr (.inl i) by simpa using hi)]

theorem chOf_update_tr (tr : TRead → OracleAnswer) (j : TRead) (hj : ¬ IsSq j) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    chOf (K := K) W (Function.update tr j u) = chOf W tr :=
  chOf_congr W _ _ (fun j' hj' => Function.update_of_ne (fun e => hj (by rw [← e]; exact hj')) _ _)

theorem kstar_update_tr (tr : TRead → OracleAnswer) (j : TRead) (hj : ¬ IsSq j) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    W.kstarOf (fun m => Function.update tr j u (.qb m)) = W.kstarOf (fun m => tr (.qb m)) := by
  congr 1
  funext m
  exact Function.update_of_ne (fun e => hj (by rw [← e]; trivial)) _ _

theorem recA_chain (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    recA W Pr h B outputs x w ((chainL W Pr c).set a u) = setC c (recA W Pr h B outputs x w a) u := by
  cases c with
  | root =>
      show recA W Pr h B outputs x w (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 (.inr (.inl 0)) u, a.2.2) = _
      simp only [recA, recP, setC, trOf_update_root, tapeR_update_root, rootsOf_update_root,
        Function.update_self]
      rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0),
        Function.update_of_ne (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)]
  | sel =>
      show recA W Pr h B outputs x w
        (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u, a.2.2) = _
      have hq : ¬ IsSq (TRead.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1)) := fun h => h
      simp only [recA, recP, setC, trOf_update_tr, tapeR_update_tr, rootsOf_update_tr,
        chOf_update_tr W _ _ hq, kstar_update_tr W _ _ hq]
      rfl
  | ans j =>
      have hq : ¬ IsSq j := hc j rfl
      show recA W Pr h B outputs x w (a.1, Function.update a.2.1 (.inl j) u, a.2.2) = _
      simp only [recA, recP, setC, trOf_update_tr, tapeR_update_tr, rootsOf_update_tr,
        chOf_update_tr W _ _ hq, kstar_update_tr W _ _ hq]

/-- The transcript frame on the coupling space. -/
def frameP (N : ℕ) : TranscriptFrame (Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) N where
  att k s := recA W Pr h B outputs x w (s k)
  lens k c := Lens.fnAt k (chainL W Pr c)
  rec_same k c s u hc := by
    show recA W Pr h B outputs x w (((Lens.fnAt k (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k) = _
    rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
    exact recA_chain W Pr h B outputs x w c hc (s k) u
  rec_other k k' c s u hk := by
    show recA W Pr h B outputs x w (((Lens.fnAt k (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k') = _
    rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk]

end Frame
