import R1Z.EventsR1PBin
import R1Z.WireBindingLengthsR1PBin

/-! Exact privacy-interface reductions. These do not import, copy, or assert
soundness-tree source refinements. In particular a recovered word at a
collision-free cut is not causality on arbitrary answer vectors. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PremisesR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- One constructor-specific source address equation, with exactly the
quantifiers in `RCommitBytes`. The leaf bytes remain `Pr.leafVal`. -/
def AddressAt (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : HonestProver K) (w : h.Instance) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (τ : Tape K F) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (ch : Challenges K),
    Pr.caddr h w x sec d τ rest ch c =
      gram (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest c

/-- Eight independently checkable source families: roots, mask/source
expansion, binding, seed, salt, leaf, and internal binary nodes. -/
theorem commit_bytes_iff (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) :
    RCommitBytes W Pr ↔
      (∀ T, AddressAt W Pr (.inl T)) ∧
      (∀ c, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inl (.inl c)))) ∧
      (∀ c, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inl (.inr c)))) ∧
      (∀ b, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qBind b)))) ∧
      (∀ i, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qSeed i)))) ∧
      (∀ T u, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qSalt T u)))) ∧
      (∀ T u, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qLeaf T u)))) ∧
      (∀ T n, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qNode T n)))) := by
  constructor
  · intro H
    have H' : ∀ c, AddressAt W Pr c := fun c h w x sec d τ rest ch =>
      H h w x sec d τ rest ch c
    exact ⟨fun _ => H' _, fun _ => H' _, fun _ => H' _, fun _ => H' _,
      fun _ => H' _, fun _ _ => H' _, fun _ _ => H' _, fun _ _ => H' _⟩
  · rintro ⟨hr, he₁, he₂, hb, hs, hsa, hl, hn⟩ h w x sec d τ rest ch c
    have H' : AddressAt W Pr c := by
      rcases c with T | (e | e) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
      · exact hr T
      · exact he₁ e
      · exact he₂ e
      · exact hb b
      · exact hs i
      · exact hsa T u
      · exact hl T u
      · exact hn T n
    exact H' h w x sec d τ rest ch

/-- Once the commitment grammar is supplied, the remaining RComLog fact is
an ordered equality of complete byte/answer lists, with exactly the original
universal quantifiers. Set equality is insufficient. -/
theorem com_log_iff (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (hc : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x ↔
      ∀ (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (τ : Tape K F)
        (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Challenges K),
      W.comLog (eCm.symm rest) roots (view h B outputs x w ch τ) ch =
        (Pr.openList ch).map (fun c =>
          (gram (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest (cposOf (E₁ := Pr.E₁) (E₂ := Pr.E₂) c),
            ansC roots rest c)) := by
  constructor
  · intro H w sec d τ roots rest ch
    simpa only [hc h w x sec d τ rest ch] using H w sec d τ roots rest ch
  · intro H w sec d τ roots rest ch
    simpa only [hc h w x sec d τ rest ch] using H w sec d τ roots rest ch

/-- The inverse law required of the coordinate equivalence. This is not a
construction of an equivalence for the arbitrary finite carrier `W.Cm`. -/
theorem cm_coordinate (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (q : RIdx) :
    eCm (eCm.symm rest) q = rest q := by rw [eCm.apply_symm_apply]

/-- A root address depends on exactly its two child answers once its grammar
is supplied. Applies to C1, C2, and folded roots, even on inconsistent vectors. -/
theorem root_address_congr (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (hc : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (v v' : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (T : Fin 3)
    (he : ∀ j : Fin 2, restOf v (rootChild T j) = restOf v' (rootChild T j)) :
    attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v (.inr (.inl T)) =
      attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v' (.inr (.inl T)) := by
  change Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ = Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  rw [hc, hc]
  change nodeBytes (restOf v) (rootChild T) = nodeBytes (restOf v') (rootChild T)
  simp only [nodeBytes, he]

/-- Two distinct query indices can select the same folded leaf. The raw
pre-dedup leaf-call position list is then not the Nodup batch of ROpen. -/
theorem repeated_folded_leaf_not_nodup :
    ¬ ([Sum.inr (qLeaf 2 ⟨0 / 4, by decide⟩),
        Sum.inr (qLeaf 2 ⟨1 / 4, by decide⟩)] : List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)).Nodup := by
  simp

/-- D79, including all three addendum classes, supplies separation only after
the caller supplies membership in the concrete extended wire carrier. -/
theorem classified_separation (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire)
    (answers : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (children : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (bs : List UInt8)
    (member : ∃ read : WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.ExtendedRead, bs = read.bytes w) :
    nodeBytes answers children ≠ bs := by
  obtain ⟨read, rfl⟩ := member
  exact WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.node_ne_extended_read w answers children read

#print axioms commit_bytes_iff
#print axioms com_log_iff
#print axioms cm_coordinate
#print axioms root_address_congr
#print axioms repeated_folded_leaf_not_nodup
#print axioms classified_separation
end R1Z.PremisesR1PBin

R1Z.CausalPremisesR1PBin.text:
import R1Z.PremisesR1PBin

/-! Remaining causal and batch obligations, stated on the actual privacy
positions. No collision exclusion, successful-run restriction, or recovered
word is substituted for the universal RCausal condition. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PremisesR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Agreement on positions preceding `p` in the supplied prover order. -/
def Earlier (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (p : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (v v' : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, Pr.ord.symm q < Pr.ord.symm p → v q = v' q

/-- An exact position-indexed restatement of RCausal; no source assumption
is discharged by this change of index. -/
theorem causal_iff (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) :
    RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w ↔
      ∀ sec d p v v', Earlier W Pr p v v' →
        attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v p =
          attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v' p := by
  constructor
  · intro H sec d p v v' he
    have hp := H sec d (Pr.ord.symm p) v v' (fun j hj =>
      he (Pr.ord j) (by simpa using hj))
    simpa using hp
  · intro H sec d i v v' he
    apply H sec d (Pr.ord i) v v'
    intro q hq
    have hq' : Pr.ord.symm q < i := by simpa using hq
    simpa using he (Pr.ord.symm q) hq'

/-- The root component of RCausal reduces to two strict predecessor facts
once its own AddressAt equation holds. Specialize T=1 for C2 and T=2 for folded. The
source's chronological cut alone does not supply these `Pr.ord` facts. -/
theorem root_causal_of_predecessors (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (T : Fin 3)
    (hr : AddressAt W Pr (.inl T))
    (prior : ∀ j : Fin 2,
      Pr.ord.symm (.inr (.inr (.inr (rootChild T j)))) <
        Pr.ord.symm (.inr (.inl T)))
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (v v' : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)
    (he : Earlier W Pr (.inr (.inl T)) v v') :
    attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v (.inr (.inl T)) =
      attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v' (.inr (.inl T)) := by
  change Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ = Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  rw [hr, hr]
  change nodeBytes (restOf v) (rootChild T) = nodeBytes (restOf v') (rootChild T)
  have hj (j : Fin 2) : restOf v (rootChild T j) = restOf v' (rootChild T j) :=
    he _ (prior j)
  simp only [nodeBytes, hj]

/-- Open-path membership distributes over the two transaction fibre sets. -/
theorem opened_union (a b : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :
    openedQ (fun T => a T ∪ b T) c ↔ openedQ a c ∨ openedQ b c := by
  rcases c with T | (i | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  all_goals simp [openedQ, or_and_right, exists_or]

/-- Minimal batch facts suffice: the separate `covers` field is redundant.
The reads here must be normalized position lists, not raw repeated calls. -/
theorem open_of_batches (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (fib : Challenges K → Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Finset Fib)
    (reads : Challenges K → Fin 2 → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx))
    (cat : ∀ ch, Pr.openList ch = reads ch 0 ++ reads ch 1)
    (nodup : ∀ ch b, (reads ch b).Nodup)
    (cover : ∀ ch b c, c ∈ reads ch b ↔ openedQ (fib ch b) c)
    (union : ∀ ch T, Pr.openFib ch T = fib ch 0 T ∪ fib ch 1 T) : ROpen Pr := by
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨fib, reads, cat, nodup, cover, union⟩⟩
  intro ch c
  have hf : Pr.openFib ch = fun T => fib ch 0 T ∪ fib ch 1 T := funext (union ch)
  rw [cat, List.mem_append, cover, cover, hf, opened_union]

#print axioms causal_iff
#print axioms root_causal_of_predecessors
#print axioms opened_union
#print axioms open_of_batches
end R1Z.PremisesR1PBin

R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
import R1Z.CausalPremisesR1PBin

/-! Dependency contracts on the *evaluated* protocol messages. These quantify
over all answer vectors, including unsuccessful/exhausted attempts. They are
not certificates that the shipped encoding satisfies the contracts. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin

def SqAgree (cut : ℕ) (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, IsSq j → transcriptStage j < cut → tr j = tr' j

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Componentwise squeeze-row dependencies, without a sampling-law assumption. -/
structure DecodeLocal (dec : (Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) → (Fin 4 → OracleAnswer) →
    (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → OracleAnswer → Challenges K) : Prop where
  sem : ∀ s s' o o' q q' r r' (i : Fin 25),
    s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = s' ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ →
    (dec s o q r).sem i = (dec s' o' q' r').sem i
  circle : ∀ s s' o o' q q' r r' (i : Fin 2),
    s ⟨25 + i.val, by omega⟩ = s' ⟨25 + i.val, by omega⟩ →
    (dec s o q r).circle i = (dec s' o' q' r').circle i
  opening : ∀ s s' o o' q q' r r' i, o i = o' i →
    (dec s o q r).opening i = (dec s' o' q' r').opening i
  queries : ∀ s s' o o' q r r', (dec s o q r).queries = (dec s' o' q r').queries

/-- The original wire together with phase-local message contracts at the
specified experiment. In particular arbitrary auxiliary outputs cannot leak
future challenges through the encoding. -/
structure R1PhaseWire (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) where
  toWire : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux
  decode_local : DecodeLocal toWire.dec
  frame_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr' r r' i,
    SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absS i)) tr tr' → (i.val = 2 → r = r') →
    toWire.frame (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr) τ) r i =
      toWire.frame (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr') τ) r' i
  payload_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr' r r' i,
    SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absO i)) tr tr' → (i.val = 3 → r = r') →
    toWire.payload (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr) τ) r i =
      toWire.payload (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr') τ) r' i
  final_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr', SqAgree (transcriptStage .absQ) tr tr' →
    toWire.final (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr) τ) =
      toWire.final (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr') τ)

/-- A refinement of a prover's data: caddr and ord are constructed, rather
than accepted as arbitrary functions. The C1 cutoff admits no squeeze, C2
admits only semantic rows 0 and 1, folded admits rows through 29. -/
structure R1PhaseProver (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x) where
  data : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire
  leaf_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr' T u,
    SqAgree (treeBase T + 6) tr tr' →
    data.leafVal h w x τ (chOf W.toWire tr) T u =
      data.leafVal h w x τ (chOf W.toWire tr') T u

abbrev R1PhaseProver.toProver {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
    {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux}
    {x : Statement K CommitHandle} {W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x}
    (P : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W) : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire :=
  { P.data with
    caddr := fun h w x sec d τ rest ch =>
      gram (W.toWire.pubBytes x) W.toWire.vtag (P.data.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest
    ord := PhaseScheduleBin.ord P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂ }

/-- Pointwise block decoding: the semantic/circle/opening components cannot
read any other squeeze, and query decoding cannot read semantic or opening
answers. The rho argument is absent from Challenges and is ignored. -/
def phaseDecode
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K) (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (queries : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (s : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (_rho : OracleAnswer) : Challenges K where
  sem := fun i => scalar (s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)
  circle := fun i => circle i (s ⟨25 + i.val, by omega⟩)
  opening := fun i => scalar (o i)
  queries := queries q

theorem phaseDecode_sem (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (queries : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (s s' : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o o' : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (rho rho' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 25)
    (he : s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = s' ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) :
    (phaseDecode scalar circle queries s o q rho).sem i =
      (phaseDecode scalar circle queries s' o' q' rho').sem i := congrArg scalar he

theorem phaseDecode_local (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (queries : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib) :
    DecodeLocal (phaseDecode scalar circle queries) where
  sem := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar he
  circle := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i he => congrArg (circle i) he
  opening := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar he
  queries := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

#print axioms phaseDecode_local
#print axioms R1PhaseProver.toProver
#print axioms phaseDecode
#print axioms phaseDecode_sem
end R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

/-! An eight-block first-completion scan. Readiness and query decoding get
only the observed observed and its endpoint. The concrete word parser and
22-distinct readiness predicate are source parameters, not silently assumed
to have been identified with Rust. Only the eight block indices are finite. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def PrefixAgree (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, j ≤ k → q j = q' j

def observed (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer :=
  fun j => if j ≤ k then q j else 0

theorem prefix_eq (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' k) : observed q k = observed q' k := by
  funext j
  unfold observed
  split
  · exact he j (by assumption)
  · rfl

def candidates (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset (Fin 8) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun k => done k (observed q k) ∨ k = 7)

theorem candidates_nonempty (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : (candidates done q).Nonempty := by
  exact ⟨7, by simp [candidates]⟩

def stop (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Fin 8 :=
  (candidates done q).min' (candidates_nonempty done q)

theorem stop_mem (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : stop done q ∈ candidates done q :=
  Finset.min'_mem _ _

theorem stop_le (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) (hk : k ∈ candidates done q) :
    stop done q ≤ k := Finset.min'_le _ k hk

theorem candidates_agree (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k b : Fin 8)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' b) (hk : k ≤ b) :
    k ∈ candidates done q ↔ k ∈ candidates done q' := by
  have hp : observed q k = observed q' k := prefix_eq q q' k (fun j hj => he j (hj.trans hk))
  simp only [candidates, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hp]

/-- Selection cannot inspect a block after its own stopping point, including
the exhaustion/default case k=7. -/
theorem stop_local (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (he : PrefixAgree q q' (stop done q)) :
    stop done q = stop done q' := by
  have hb : stop done q' ≤ stop done q := stop_le done q' _
    ((candidates_agree done q q' _ _ he le_rfl).mp (stop_mem done q))
  have ha : stop done q ≤ stop done q' := stop_le done q _
    ((candidates_agree done q q' _ _ he hb).mpr (stop_mem done q'))
  exact le_antisymm ha hb

def queries (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset Fib :=
  decode (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q))

theorem queries_local (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (he : PrefixAgree q q' (stop done q)) :
    queries done decode q = queries done decode q' := by
  have hs := stop_local done q q' he
  have hp := prefix_eq q q' (stop done q) he
  unfold queries
  rw [← hs, hp]

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- Install the constructed block decoder and first-completion scan in a
wire's remaining data. Message locality must still be proved for this wire. -/
def wireData (W : R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib) :
    R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  { W with
    dec := R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.phaseDecode scalar circle (queries done decode)
    kstarOf := stop done }

theorem wireData_decoder_local (W : R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib) :
    R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.DecodeLocal (wireData W scalar circle done decode).dec :=
  R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.phaseDecode_local scalar circle (queries done decode)

theorem wireData_scan_local (W : R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' ((wireData W scalar circle done decode).kstarOf q)) :
    (wireData W scalar circle done decode).kstarOf q =
      (wireData W scalar circle done decode).kstarOf q' ∧
    queries done decode q = queries done decode q' :=
  ⟨stop_local done q q' he, queries_local done decode q q' he⟩

#print axioms wireData_decoder_local
#print axioms wireData_scan_local
#print axioms prefix_eq
#print axioms candidates_nonempty
#print axioms stop_mem
#print axioms stop_le
#print axioms candidates_agree
#print axioms stop_local
#print axioms queries_local
end R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin

R1Z.PoleN8.text:
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Field.Rat
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

/-! J0c numeral (LOG D40.3, D42.1): the pole term of `privacy_R1` at the cap
N = 8, `N · (4096 / Q) ≤ 2^-108` whenever `Q ≥ 2^123`, and `p⁴ ≥ 2^123` for
the M31 prime `p = 2^31 − 1` (`AspisCircleGroupOrder.P` is the abbreviation
`2 ^ 31 - 1`), so for `Q = p⁴ = |QM31|` the pole term is at most 2^-108.
No large numeral is evaluated: `p⁴ ≥ 2^123` is the polynomial inequality
`8·(4+y)⁴ ≤ (2y+7)⁴` at `2^30 = 4 + y`, and the ℚ bound is a monotonicity step
plus `2^123 = 2^15 · 2^108`.  This module imports only the tactics it uses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.PoleN8

/-- `p⁴ ≥ 2^123` for `p = 2^31 − 1`. -/
theorem m31_pow4 : 2 ^ 123 ≤ (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 := by
  have h31 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 31 = 2 * 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  have h123 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 123 = 2 ^ 3 * (2 ^ 30) ^ 4 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have h4 : (4 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  rw [h31, h123]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h4
  rw [hy, show 2 * (4 + y) - 1 = 2 * y + 7 by omega,
    show (2 * y + 7) ^ 4 = 2 ^ 3 * (4 + y) ^ 4 +
      (8 * y ^ 4 + 96 * y ^ 3 + 408 * y ^ 2 + 696 * y + 353) by ring]
  exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

/-- The pole term of `privacy_R1` at N = 8 for any `Q ≥ 2^123`. -/
theorem pole_N8 (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 2 ^ 123 ≤ Q) :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 108 := by
  have hQ' : (2 : ℚ) ^ 123 ≤ Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ 123 := by positivity
  have h1 : ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q) = 2 ^ 15 / Q := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h1]
  calc (2 : ℚ) ^ 15 / Q ≤ 2 ^ 15 / 2 ^ 123 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hpos hQ'
    _ = 1 / 2 ^ 108 := by
      rw [show (123 : ℕ) = 15 + 108 from rfl, pow_add, div_mul_eq_div_div,
        div_self (by positivity)]

/-- The instantiation `Q = p⁴`, `p = 2^31 − 1`: `8 · 4096 / p⁴ ≤ 2^-108`. -/
theorem pole_N8_M31 :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 108 :=
  pole_N8 _ m31_pow4

#print axioms m31_pow4
#print axioms pole_N8
#print axioms pole_N8_M31
end R1Z.PoleN8

R1Z.SamplerLawR1.text:
import R1Z.LensR1
import R1Z.PoleN8

/-! Sem1Uniform (LOG D42.3) discharge, generic part.  The R1 χ sampler is
`qm31_sample` on the row-1 squeeze answer: the 32-byte block is ranked as a
256-bit integer (a bijection), reduced mod p⁴ (four base-p digits) and the
digits are packed injectively into QM31.  Restated from the spend path
(`ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total`, `SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value`,
`SourceSamplerByteRank.rank`, `ModuloField.blockRank`; SHAs in
zf1/sem1-uniform-evidence.json) as the hypothesis shape
`s1 b = emb ((rank b) % q)` with `rank` a bijection and `emb` injective
below `q`.

* `residue_card_le`: at most `n / q + 1` points of `Fin n` per residue mod q;
* `fibre_card_le`: hence every fibre of `s1` has at most `n / q + 1` points;
* `lens_mem_mass_le`: if a lens coordinate `u` feeds `s1` and the family
  index `lam` does not move with `u`, a family of `m` values is hit with mass
  at most `m · f / |U|` (f = fibre bound);
* `lens_qm31_mass_le`: for q = p⁴, n = 2^256 this is at most `m / (p⁴ − 1)`
  (exact: `m · (⌊2^256/p⁴⌋ + 1) / 2^256`), from the symbolic
  `(q − 1)(⌊n/q⌋ + 1) ≤ n` when `q² ≤ n`.
No concrete Finset over the 2^256 answers is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.SamplerLawR1
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.LensR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Counting -/

/-- At most `n / q + 1` ranks below `n` have a given residue mod `q`. -/
theorem residue_card_le {U : Type} [Fintype U] {n : ℕ} (rank : U ≃ Fin n) (q t : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)).card ≤ n / q + 1 := by
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun u => (rank u).val / q)
      (↑(Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)) : Set U)
      (↑(Finset.range (n / q + 1)) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro u _
    show (rank u).val / q ∈ Finset.range (n / q + 1)
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.div_le_div_right (rank u).isLt.le)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun u => (rank u).val / q)
      (↑(Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)) : Set U) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    have hmu : (rank u).val % q = t := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hu)).2
    have hmv : (rank v).val % q = t := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hv)).2
    have huv' : (rank u).val / q = (rank v).val / q := huv
    have hval : (rank u).val = (rank v).val :=
      calc (rank u).val = q * ((rank u).val / q) + (rank u).val % q := (Nat.div_add_mod _ _).symm
        _ = q * ((rank v).val / q) + (rank v).val % q := by rw [huv', hmu, hmv]
        _ = (rank v).val := Nat.div_add_mod _ _
    exact rank.injective (Fin.ext hval)
  calc (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)).card
      ≤ (Finset.range (n / q + 1)).card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
    _ = n / q + 1 := Finset.card_range _

/-- The fibres of `b ↦ emb (rank b mod q)` have at most `n / q + 1` points. -/
theorem fibre_card_le {U K : Type} [Fintype U] {n : ℕ} (rank : U ≃ Fin n) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (emb : ℕ → K) (hemb : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < q → y < q → emb x = emb y → x = y)
    (s1 : U → K) (hs : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % q)) (y : K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ n / q + 1 := by
  by_cases h : ∃ u₀, s1 u₀ = y
  · obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := h
    refine (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (residue_card_le rank q ((rank u₀).val % q) hq)
    intro u hu
    have hu2 : s1 u = y := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2
    refine Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    apply hemb _ _ (Nat.mod_lt _ hq) (Nat.mod_lt _ hq)
    rw [← hs, ← hs, hu2, hu₀]
  · have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.2
      intro u _ hu
      exact h ⟨u, hu⟩
    rw [he, Finset.card_empty]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

/-- A family of `m` values is hit by `s1` on at most `m · f` points. -/
theorem mem_card_le {U K : Type} [Fintype U] (s1 : U → K) (T0 : Finset K) (m f : ℕ)
    (hT : T0.card ≤ m) (hfib : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ f) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)).card ≤ m * f := by
  have h := Finset.card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to (f := s1)
    (s := Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)) (t := T0)
    (fun u hu => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2) f
    (fun y _ => (Finset.card_le_card (fun u hu => Finset.mem_filter.2
      ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2⟩)).trans (hfib y))
  calc _ ≤ f * T0.card := h
    _ ≤ f * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_left f hT
    _ = m * f := Nat.mul_comm _ _

/-- Uniform mass form of `mem_card_le`. -/
theorem mass_mem_le {U K : Type} [Fintype U] (s1 : U → K) (T0 : Finset K) (m f : ℕ)
    (hT : T0.card ≤ m) (hfib : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ f) :
    mass (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by
  have h' : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)).card : ℚ) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast mem_card_le s1 T0 m f hT hfib
  have hsum : (∑ u, if s1 u ∈ T0 then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)).card : ℚ) := by
    first
      | exact Finset.sum_boole _ _
      | simp only [Finset.sum_boole]
      | rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      | simp
  have key : (∑ u, if s1 u ∈ T0 then (1 : ℚ) else 0) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) ≤
      ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h' (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  unfold mass mean
  convert key using 3 with x _
  by_cases hx : s1 x ∈ T0 <;> simp [hx]

/-! ### The lens step -/

/-- If the lens coordinate `u` feeds `s1` and the family index `lam` does not
move with `u`, the event `s1 u ∈ T (lam s)` has mass at most `m · f / |U|`. -/
theorem lens_mem_mass_le {S U K : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (lam : S → K) (s1 : U → K) (T : K → Finset K) (m f : ℕ)
    (hlam : ∀ s u, lam (L.set s u) = lam s) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m)
    (hfib : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ f) :
    mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by
  have hδ : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by positivity
  have h := mass_cond_le (L.equiv (Classical.arbitrary U)) (fun _ => True)
    (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) _ hδ (fun _ _ _ _ => trivial) (by
      intro r x₀ _
      have hc : ∀ x, s1 (L.get ((L.equiv (Classical.arbitrary U)).symm (r, x))) ∈
          T (lam ((L.equiv (Classical.arbitrary U)).symm (r, x))) ↔ s1 x ∈ T (lam r.1) := by
        intro x
        rw [Lens.equiv_symm, L.get_set, hlam]
      rw [mass_congr _ _ hc]
      exact mass_mem_le s1 (T (lam r.1)) m f (hT _) hfib)
  calc mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s))
      = mass (fun s => True ∧ s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) :=
        mass_congr _ _ (fun s => ⟨fun hs => ⟨trivial, hs⟩, fun hs => hs.2⟩)
    _ ≤ mass (fun _ : S => True) * (((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U) := h
    _ ≤ 1 * (((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mass_le_one _) hδ
    _ = ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := one_mul _

/-- The lens step with the rank-mod-q sampler: mass at most `m (n/q + 1) / n`. -/
theorem lens_sampler_mass_le {S U K : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (lam : S → K) (s1 : U → K) (T : K → Finset K) (m n q : ℕ)
    (rank : U ≃ Fin n) (hq : 0 < q) (emb : ℕ → K)
    (hemb : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < q → y < q → emb x = emb y → x = y)
    (hs : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % q))
    (hlam : ∀ s u, lam (L.set s u) = lam s) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m) :
    mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) ≤ ((m * (n / q + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) / n := by
  have hc : Fintype.card U = n := by rw [Fintype.card_congr rank, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h := lens_mem_mass_le L lam s1 T m (n / q + 1) hlam hT
    (fibre_card_le rank q hq emb hemb s1 hs)
  rwa [hc] at h

/-! ### Arithmetic: from the exact bound to `m / (q − 1)` -/

/-- `(q − 1)(⌊n/q⌋ + 1) ≤ n` whenever `q² ≤ n`. -/
theorem pred_mul_div_succ_le (q n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hqq : q * q ≤ n) :
    (q - 1) * (n / q + 1) ≤ n := by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, q = r + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have hf : r + 1 ≤ n / (r + 1) := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hq).2 hqq
  have hr : r ≤ n / (r + 1) := Nat.le_of_succ_le hf
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  calc r * (n / (r + 1) + 1) = r * (n / (r + 1)) + r := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
    _ ≤ r * (n / (r + 1)) + n / (r + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left hr _
    _ = (r + 1) * (n / (r + 1)) := (add_one_mul r (n / (r + 1))).symm
    _ ≤ n := Nat.mul_div_le n (r + 1)

theorem mul_div_le_div (m g n Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hn : 0 < n) (h : Q * g ≤ n) :
    ((m * g : ℕ) : ℚ) / n ≤ (m : ℚ) / Q := by
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn) (by exact_mod_cast hQ)]
  have hm : m * g * Q ≤ m * n :=
    calc m * g * Q = m * (Q * g) := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm g Q]
      _ ≤ m * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m h
  exact_mod_cast hm

/-! ### The M31 numerals (symbolic) -/

/-- `p⁴ · p⁴ ≤ 2^256` for `p = 2^31 − 1`. -/
theorem m31_q_sq_le : (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 * (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 ≤ 2 ^ 256 := by
  have h : (2 ^ 31 - 1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ 31 := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have h4 : ((2 : ℕ) ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 ≤ (2 ^ 31) ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h 4
  calc ((2 : ℕ) ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 * (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 ≤ (2 ^ 31) ^ 4 * (2 ^ 31) ^ 4 :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul h4 h4
    _ ≤ 2 ^ 256 := by
        rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
        exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

/-- `p⁴ − 1 ≥ 2^123` for `p = 2^31 − 1` (as `PoleN8.m31_pow4`, with the slack). -/
theorem m31_pow4_pred : 2 ^ 123 ≤ (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 := by
  have h31 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 31 = 2 * 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  have h123 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 123 = 2 ^ 3 * (2 ^ 30) ^ 4 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have h4 : (4 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  rw [h31, h123]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h4
  rw [hy, show 2 * (4 + y) - 1 = 2 * y + 7 by omega,
    show (2 * y + 7) ^ 4 = 2 ^ 3 * (4 + y) ^ 4 +
      (8 * y ^ 4 + 96 * y ^ 3 + 408 * y ^ 2 + 696 * y + 353) by ring]
  exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (by positivity))

theorem m31_q_pos : 0 < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (m31_pow4_pred.trans (Nat.sub_le _ _))

theorem m31_qpred_pos : 0 < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) m31_pow4_pred

/-- `(p⁴ − 1)(⌊2^256/p⁴⌋ + 1) ≤ 2^256`. -/
theorem m31_pred_mul_le :
    ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) * (2 ^ 256 / (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 + 1) ≤ 2 ^ 256 :=
  pred_mul_div_succ_le _ _ m31_q_pos m31_q_sq_le

/-- The QM31 sampler on a lens coordinate of 2^256 points: a family of `m`
values is hit with mass at most `m / (p⁴ − 1)`. -/
theorem lens_qm31_mass_le {S U K : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (lam : S → K) (s1 : U → K) (T : K → Finset K) (m : ℕ)
    (rank : U ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256)) (emb : ℕ → K)
    (hemb : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → emb x = emb y → x = y)
    (hs : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4))
    (hlam : ∀ s u, lam (L.set s u) = lam s) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m) :
    mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) ≤ (m : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
  (lens_sampler_mass_le L lam s1 T m (2 ^ 256) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) rank m31_q_pos emb hemb hs
    hlam hT).trans
    (mul_div_le_div m _ _ _ m31_qpred_pos (by positivity) m31_pred_mul_le)

/-- The pole term at N = 8 with `Q = p⁴ − 1`: still `≤ 2^-108`. -/
theorem pole_N8_M31_pred :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 108 :=
  R1Z.PoleN8.pole_N8 _ m31_pow4_pred

#print axioms residue_card_le
#print axioms fibre_card_le
#print axioms mem_card_le
#print axioms mass_mem_le
#print axioms lens_mem_mass_le
#print axioms lens_sampler_mass_le
#print axioms pred_mul_div_succ_le
#print axioms mul_div_le_div
#print axioms m31_q_sq_le
#print axioms m31_pow4_pred
#print axioms m31_q_pos
#print axioms m31_qpred_pos
#print axioms m31_pred_mul_le
#print axioms lens_qm31_mass_le
#print axioms pole_N8_M31_pred
end R1Z.SamplerLawR1

R0Z.K4Values.text:
import R0Z.SilentReduction

/-! J2 / J2-R1 (DESIGN-T2b-2b §5 J2; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §4 J2-R1):
`sRem ∈ Chain0K4`, stated once for every batched layer `Bat` (R0 and R1).

The remainder `sRem` is supported on the ten round arrays; its cells are the
coefficient differences `g` of the original-terminal round polynomials of two
actual traces, minus a multiple of the direction `X − ½`.  This module proves:

* `interpolate_mem`: Lagrange interpolation on the nodes `0, …, 27` with values
  in a subfield `S` has every coefficient in `S`;
* `actual_mem`: every cell of an actual (masked, prepared) trace lies in `K₄`
  when the instance is base-typed and `λ, χ ∈ K₄` (the H1 helper column
  included, `helper_mem`);
* `honestClaims_mem`, `roundPoint_mem`, `originalRounds_mem`, `g_mem`;
* `sRem_mem_K4` and `sRem_mem_chain0K4`.

One closure fact about the R0P terminal is NOT proved here and enters as the
named premise `TerminalClosed S pub B ch`: the terminal value
`terminalValue pub λ χ θ μ zc B y a` lies in `S` whenever the claims `y` and
the point `a` do.  It is a pure field-closure property of the ported
constraint families (`laneAt`: Poseidon, schedule, occupancy, path, value,
digest, asset, copy), given the challenges in `S` and the public statement in
the base field. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.K4Values

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
  R0Z.K4 Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ## Polynomials with coefficients in a subfield -/

/-- Polynomials all of whose coefficients lie in `S`. -/
def coeffRing (S : Subfield K) : Subring K[X] where
  carrier := {p | ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ S}
  mul_mem' := by
    intro p q hp hq n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul]
    exact sum_mem fun x _ => S.mul_mem (hp _) (hq _)
  one_mem' := by
    intro n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_one]
    split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  add_mem' := by
    intro p q hp hq n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_add]
    exact S.add_mem (hp n) (hq n)
  zero_mem' := by
    intro n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  neg_mem' := by
    intro p hp n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_neg]
    exact S.neg_mem (hp n)

theorem C_mem_coeffRing (S : Subfield K) {c : K} (hc : c ∈ S) : C c ∈ coeffRing S := by
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C]
  split_ifs
  · exact hc
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem X_mem_coeffRing (S : Subfield K) : (X : K[X]) ∈ coeffRing S := by
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_X]
  split_ifs
  · exact S.one_mem
  · exact S.zero_mem

/-- Interpolation on the 28 natural nodes keeps coefficients in `S`. -/
theorem interpolate_mem (S : Subfield K) (v : Fin 28 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) :
    Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i : Fin 28 => (i.val : K)) v ∈ coeffRing S := by
  rw [Lagrange.interpolate_apply]
  refine sum_mem fun i _ => (coeffRing S).mul_mem (C_mem_coeffRing S (hv i)) ?_
  unfold Lagrange.basis
  refine prod_mem fun j _ => ?_
  unfold Lagrange.basisDivisor
  exact (coeffRing S).mul_mem
    (C_mem_coeffRing S (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem (natCast_mem S _) (natCast_mem S _))))
    ((coeffRing S).sub_mem (X_mem_coeffRing S) (C_mem_coeffRing S (natCast_mem S _)))

theorem interpolate_coeff_mem (S : Subfield K) (v : Fin 28 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (d : ℕ) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i : Fin 28 => (i.val : K)) v).coeff d ∈ S :=
  interpolate_mem S v hv d

/-! ## Points and claims -/

theorem alpha_mem (S : Subfield K) (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S)
    (i : Fin 10) : alpha ch i ∈ S := hsem _

theorem roundPoint_mem (S : Subfield K) (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S)
    (j : Fin 10) (k : ℕ) (tail : Fin (9 - j.val) → Bool) (i : Fin 10) :
    roundPoint ch j (k : K) tail i ∈ S := by
  unfold roundPoint
  split_ifs
  · exact alpha_mem S ch hsem i
  · exact natCast_mem S k
  · exact S.one_mem
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem eqWeight_mem (S : Subfield K) (p : Fin 10 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ S) (r : Fin 1024) :
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight p r ∈ S := by
  unfold AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight
  refine prod_mem fun b _ => ?_
  split_ifs
  · exact S.sub_mem S.one_mem (hp b)
  · exact hp b

theorem succCarry_mem (S : Subfield K) (p : Fin 10 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ S) :
    ∀ k, succCarry p k ∈ S
  | 0 => S.one_mem
  | k + 1 => by
    unfold succCarry
    refine S.mul_mem ?_ (succCarry_mem S p hp k)
    split_ifs
    · exact hp _
    · exact S.zero_mem

theorem openingPoints_mem (S : Subfield K) (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S)
    (j : Fin 3) (i : Fin 10) : openingPoints a j i ∈ S := by
  match j with
  | 0 => exact ha _
  | 1 =>
    show successorPoint a ⟨9 - i.val, by omega⟩ ∈ S
    unfold successorPoint
    have hc := succCarry_mem S a ha (9 - (9 - i.val))
    exact S.sub_mem (S.add_mem (ha _) hc)
      (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (ha _) hc) (S.mul_mem (ha _) hc))
  | 2 =>
    show xor12Point a ⟨9 - i.val, by omega⟩ ∈ S
    unfold xor12Point
    split_ifs
    · exact S.sub_mem S.one_mem (ha _)
    · exact ha _

theorem honestClaims_mem (S : Subfield K) (t : Trace K) (ht : ∀ c r, t c r ∈ S)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    honestClaims t a j c ∈ S := by
  unfold honestClaims AspisR0.LinearDual.dot
  exact sum_mem fun r _ =>
    S.mul_mem (eqWeight_mem S _ (openingPoints_mem S a ha j) r) (ht c r)

/-! ## The H1 helper column -/

theorem copyLinkWeight_mem (S : Subfield K) (link : CopyLink) (n : ℕ) (v : Variant) :
    copyLinkWeight (K := K) link n v ∈ S := by
  unfold copyLinkWeight
  split
  · exact S.one_mem
  · split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  · split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  · exact natCast_mem S _
  · exact natCast_mem S _

theorem copyTupleValue_mem (S : Subfield K) (t : Trace K)
    (ht : ∀ c r, c.val < 16 → t c r ∈ S) (lam : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (tag : ℕ)
    (ep : CopyEndpoint) : copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t tag ep) ∈ S := by
  unfold copyTupleValue copyEndpointTuple copyPatternTuple
  refine S.add_mem (natCast_mem S tag) (sum_mem fun i _ => S.mul_mem (S.pow_mem hlam _) ?_)
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact S.add_mem (ht _ _ (by simp only [Fin.val_castLE]; exact Fin.isLt _)) (natCast_mem S _)
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem copyRowValues_mem (S : Subfield K) (t : Trace K)
    (ht : ∀ c r, c.val < 16 → t c r ∈ S) (lam : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (b : Fin 1024)
    (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (slot : Fin 2) :
    copyRowValues t lam b endpoint slot ∈ S := by
  unfold copyRowValues
  refine list_sum_mem fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨link, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact copyTupleValue_mem S t ht lam hlam _ _
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem copyRowWeights_mem (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (b : Fin 1024)
    (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (slot : Fin 2) :
    copyRowWeights pub b endpoint slot ∈ S := by
  unfold copyRowWeights
  refine list_sum_mem fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨link, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact copyLinkWeight_mem S _ _ _
  · exact S.zero_mem

/-- The H1 helper (logup reciprocals) stays in `S`. -/
theorem helper_mem (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (ht : ∀ c r, c.val < 16 → t c r ∈ S) (lam chi : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S)
    (r : Fin 1024) : helper pub t lam chi r ∈ S := by
  unfold helper
  try dsimp only
  refine S.sub_mem (sum_mem fun s _ => S.mul_mem (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem hchi ?_)) ?_)
    (sum_mem fun s _ => S.mul_mem (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem hchi ?_)) ?_)
  · exact copyRowValues_mem S t ht lam hlam r _ s
  · exact copyRowWeights_mem S pub r _ s
  · exact copyRowValues_mem S t ht lam hlam r _ s
  · exact copyRowWeights_mem S pub r _ s

/-! ## The actual trace -/

theorem balance_mem (S : Subfield K) (dep : Fin 1024) (word : Fin 1024 → K)
    (hw : ∀ s, word s ∈ S) (r : Fin 1024) : balance dep word r ∈ S := by
  unfold balance
  split_ifs
  · exact S.neg_mem (sum_mem fun s _ => hw s)
  · exact hw r

/-- Every cell of an actual trace lies in `K₄`: base-typed semantic lanes and
F-valued noise, K₄-packed G/H1/D limbs, and the helper column. -/
theorem actual_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hF : BaseTyped F t) (hlam : ch.sem 0 ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hchi : ch.sem 1 ∈ K4 B hB) (r : T K F) (c : Fin 29) (s : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch r c s ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have hFK : ∀ x : F, (x : K) ∈ K4 B hB := fun x => F_le_K4 B hB x.2
  have hE : ∀ (c' : Fin 29) (s' : Fin 1024), c'.val < 16 →
      applyEligible t r.2.2 c' s' ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro c' s' hc'
    unfold applyEligible
    rw [if_pos hc']
    refine balance_mem _ 1023 _ (fun s'' => ?_) s'
    try dsimp only
    refine (K4 B hB).add_mem (F_le_K4 B hB (hF c' (by omega) s'')) ?_
    unfold semanticNoise
    split_ifs
    · exact hFK _
    · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  have hext : ∀ (lane : Fin 3) (q : Fin 1024),
      extensionRaw B (Sum.elim (0 : EligibleNoise K F) (aff r)) lane q ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro lane q
    exact pack4_mem_K4 B hB _ (fun j => Subtype.mem _)
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual applyAff
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3 h4
  · unfold prepare
    rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    exact hE c s h1
  · unfold maskOnlyColumns
    exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hFK _) s
  · refine (K4 B hB).add_mem ?_ ?_
    · unfold prepare
      rw [if_pos h3]
      exact helper_mem _ pub _ hE _ _ hlam hchi s
    · unfold h1Padding
      refine balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => ?_) s
      try dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
      · exact hext 1 q
  · exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hext 0 q) s
  · unfold dWord
    exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hext 2 q) s

/-! ## Original round polynomials and the remainder -/

/-- The missing field-closure fact about the R0P terminal (see the header). -/
def TerminalClosed (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K) (a : Fin 10 → K), (∀ j c, y j c ∈ S) → (∀ i, a i ∈ S) →
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B y a ∈ S

theorem originalRounds_mem (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S) (hT : TerminalClosed S pub B ch)
    (t : Trace K) (ht : ∀ c r, t c r ∈ S) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch t j i ∈ S := by
  unfold PayloadSplit.originalRounds
  rw [PayloadSplit.rounds_apply]
  refine interpolate_coeff_mem S _ (fun k => sum_mem fun tail _ => ?_) i.val
  refine S.mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j' c => ?_) (roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail))
  exact honestClaims_mem S t ht _ (roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail) j' c

theorem g_mem (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    g h B x w ch n j i ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have hact := fun r => actual_mem B hB x.1 (h.build w) ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) r
  exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT _ (hact _) j i)
    (originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT _ (hact _) j i)

theorem dirCoeff_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  split_ifs
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    refine (K4 B hB).sub_mem ?_ ?_
    · split_ifs
      · exact (K4 B hB).one_mem
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
    · split_ifs
      · exact half_mem_K4 B hB
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem

/-- J2: every cell of `sRem` lies in `K₄`. -/
theorem sRem_mem_K4 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) :
    ∀ cell, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n cell ∈ K4 B hB := by
  set S := K4 B hB with hS
  let p := g h B x w ch n
  let coef : K := Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) * (alpha ch 9 - 1 / 2)⁻¹
  have hcell : ∀ cell, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n cell =
      PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p cell - coef * dir (K := K) (Bat := Bat) cell :=
    fun cell => rfl
  have hphi : Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) ∈ S := by
    have e : Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) =
        evalRound9 ch (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p) :=
      Phi0_roundInclusion B ch p
    rw [e, evalRound9_roundInclusion, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Polynomial.eval_monomial]
    exact S.mul_mem (g_mem h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT 9 i)
      (S.pow_mem (alpha_mem S ch hsem 9) _)
  have hcoef : coef ∈ S :=
    S.mul_mem hphi (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem (alpha_mem S ch hsem 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB)))
  intro cell
  rw [hcell]
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i =>
    show p j i - coef * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) ∈ S
    exact S.sub_mem (g_mem h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT j i)
      (S.mul_mem hcoef (dirCoeff_mem B hB j i))
  | maskSum =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | pointClaim j c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | extraClaim c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | ood j c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | inactiveSum =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | opened q s c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | bat b =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem

/-- J2 / J2-R1: `sRem ∈ Chain0₄` for every batched layer (R0 and R1), given
`SemK4`, a base-typed instance, `α₉ ≠ ½`, and `TerminalClosed`. -/
theorem sRem_mem_chain0K4 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1 / 2) :
    sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.Chain0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch :=
  (R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_chain0K4_iff B hB ch _).2
    ⟨R0Z.Chain.sRem_mem_chain0 h B x w ch n hhalf, sRem_mem_K4 h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT⟩

/-! J15 (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.3–2.4; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §4 J15-R1), the

  16..25, 27, 28.
* `cTilde_eq`, `Phi0_cTilde` (R4): `cTilde = L u + O u − k • dir` with
  `k = fOrig u(α)·(α₉ − ½)⁻¹`, and `Φ₀(cTilde) = 0` when `α₉ ≠ ½`.
* `ChainEqs` (R6): the nine boundary-chain equalities as a K-submodule; it
  contains every `L τ`, every original-round inclusion, `dir`, all of `A`
  and every `cTilde`.  `roundProjection_mem_chainT0` turns it, with the
  terminal equation, into `ChainT0`.
* `maskLinear_mem`, `L_round_mem` (R7): the round cells of `L τ` lie in any
  subfield containing `B.i`, `B.u`, the challenges and the trace values.
* `mask_lift_of` (§2.4, generic linear algebra): a payload with zero own and
  inactive cells, zero initial-sum defect, `Chain_T0₄` round part and batched
  part in a subspace `B0` is a mask-tape image, given (Q′), `bat(ker own) ≤ B0`

namespace R0Z.IIPrimeResidual
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0P.SemDegree R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift R0Z.K4 Polynomial

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Lanes of the payload trace -/

/-- Row-1023 lemma (LOG D36.4): the lanes of the payload trace equal those of
the prepared instance, for every `λ, χ`.  Row 1023 is read by `rowOpenings`
(at rows 1023, 1022 and 1011), but no lane value changes under the
rebalancing (`lanes_eligible`; copy endpoints are `Protected`, row ≠ 1023). -/
theorem laneOf_actual_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (lam chi : K) :
    laneOf (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0) pub lam chi B = laneOf (prepare pub t ch) pub lam chi B := by
  have h0 : (Sum.elim 0 (aff (0 : T K F)) : MaskTape K F) = 0 := by
    rw [map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F))]
    funext z
    cases z <;> rfl
  funext i bits
  rw [laneOf_eq_laneAt, laneOf_eq_laneAt]
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual
  rw [R0Z.TerminalEligible.openings_applyAff, R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1_applyAff, h0,
    R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1Padding_zero, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero,
    R0Z.TerminalEligible.prepare_eligible, R0Z.TerminalEligible.lanes_eligible]

/-- The semantic lanes of the payload trace of a base-typed instance are F-valued. -/
theorem actual_sem_mem (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hF : BaseTyped F t) (l : Fin 29) (hl : l.val < 16) (s : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l s ∈ F := by
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual applyAff
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hl]
  unfold prepare
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  unfold applyEligible
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hl]
  refine R0Z.K4Values.balance_mem F 1023 _ (fun s' => ?_) s
  refine F.add_mem (hF l (by omega) s') ?_
  unfold semanticNoise
  split_ifs
  · exact Subtype.mem _
  · exact F.zero_mem

/-- Lanes 16..25, 27, 28 of the payload trace are zero. -/
theorem actual_other_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (hl : ¬ (l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26)) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l = 0 := by
  have he : PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 =
      traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) + traceLinear B (aff (0 : T K F)) :=
    applyAff_eq_base_add B (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) (aff (0 : T K F))
  rw [he, map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F)), map_zero (traceLinear B), add_zero]
  funext s
  simp only [traceBase, hl, ↓reduceIte, Pi.zero_apply]

/-! ### `cTilde` and Φ₀ (R4) -/

/-- The direction coefficient `k = fOrig u(α)·(α₉ − ½)⁻¹`. -/
def kOf (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) (alpha ch) * (alpha ch 9 - 1/2)⁻¹

theorem cTilde_eq (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch =
      PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) +
        PayloadSplit.roundInclusion
          (PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0)) -
        kOf h B x w ch • dir := by
  unfold cTilde kOf
  rw [originalOf_c]
  rw [show (c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = _ from R0Z.HonestValid.c_eq h B x w ch]
  all_goals rfl

/-- (R4): `Φ₀(cTilde) = 0` off `α₉ = ½`. -/
theorem Phi0_cTilde (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1/2) :
    Phi0 B ch (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = 0 := by
  rw [cTilde_eq, map_sub, map_add, Phi0_L, Phi0_roundInclusion, evalRound9_originalRounds,
    map_smul, Phi0_dir, smul_eq_mul, zero_add]
  unfold kOf
  have hne : alpha ch 9 - 1/2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hhalf
  rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, mul_one, sub_self]

/-! ### The chain equalities (R6) -/

/-- The nine boundary-chain equalities of the ten rounds. -/
def ChainEqs (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule K (Payload K Bat) :=
  ⨅ j : Fin 9, LinearMap.ker
    (Chain.evalRound j.succ 0 + Chain.evalRound j.succ 1 - Chain.evalRound j.castSucc (alpha ch j.castSucc))

theorem mem_chainEqs_iff (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) :
    v ∈ ChainEqs ch ↔ ∀ j : Fin 9, (Chain.roundPoly j.succ v).eval 0 + (Chain.roundPoly j.succ v).eval 1 =
      (Chain.roundPoly j.castSucc v).eval (alpha ch j.castSucc) := by
  simp only [ChainEqs, Submodule.mem_iInf, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, Chain.evalRound_apply, sub_eq_zero]

theorem initialChain0_le (ch : Challenges K) :
    Chain.InitialChain0 (Bat := Bat) ch ≤ ChainEqs ch := inf_le_right

theorem L_mem_chainEqs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  rw [PureRounds.roundPoly_L, PureRounds.roundPoly_L]
  exact Chain.rounds_chain ch _ (maskLinear_vdeg π B τ) j

theorem originalRounds_mem_chainEqs (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch t) ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  rw [Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds, Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds]
  exact Chain.rounds_chain ch _ (vdeg_fOrig pub B ch t) j

theorem dir_mem_chainEqs (ch : Challenges K) : (dir : Payload K Bat) ∈ ChainEqs ch :=
  initialChain0_le ch (Chain.dir_mem_initialChain0 ch)

theorem A_mem_chainEqs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : T K F) :
    A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t = PayloadSplit.L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]
  exact L_mem_chainEqs π B ch _

theorem cTilde_mem_chainEqs (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [cTilde_eq]
  exact (ChainEqs ch).sub_mem
    ((ChainEqs ch).add_mem (L_mem_chainEqs _ B ch _) (originalRounds_mem_chainEqs x.1 B ch _))
    ((ChainEqs ch).smul_mem _ (dir_mem_chainEqs ch))

theorem roundPoly_roundProjection (v : Payload K Bat) (j : Fin 10) :
    Chain.roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat)
      (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) v)) = Chain.roundPoly j v :=
  (Chain.roundPoly_roundInclusion j _).trans (Chain.roundPoly_apply j v).symm

/-- The chain equalities and the terminal equation give `ChainT0`. -/
theorem roundProjection_mem_chainT0 (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) (hv : v ∈ ChainEqs ch)
    (h9 : (Chain.roundPoly 9 v).eval (alpha ch 9) = 0) :
    R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) v ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0 (Bat := Bat) ch := by
  rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_chainT0_iff]
  simp only [roundPoly_roundProjection]
  exact ⟨(mem_chainEqs_iff ch v).1 hv, h9⟩

/-! ### Round cells in a subfield (R7) -/

theorem maskLinear_mem (S : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S) (τ : Trace K)
    (hτ : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ S) : PayloadSplit.maskLinear π B a τ ∈ S := by
  rw [PayloadSplit.maskLinear_apply]
  have hcl := fun j c => R0Z.K4Values.honestClaims_mem S τ hτ a ha j c
  have hml : ∀ fam : ℕ, R0P.Mask.maskLinear fam a ∈ S :=
    fun fam => sum_mem fun j _ => S.mul_mem (natCast_mem S _) (ha j)
  have htb : ∀ j, R0P.Mask.towerBasis B j ∈ S := by
    intro j
    unfold R0P.Mask.towerBasis
    split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact hi
    · exact hu
    · exact S.mul_mem hi hu
  refine S.add_mem ?_ ?_
  · unfold R0P.Mask.maskValue
    refine S.add_mem (S.add_mem (sum_mem fun c _ => S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))
      (S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))) (sum_mem fun c _ => S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))
    · show R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis B _ _ ∈ S
      exact S.mul_mem (htb _) (S.pow_mem (hml 0) _)
    · show 1 + R0P.Mask.maskLinear 16 a ^ 26 ∈ S
      exact S.add_mem S.one_mem (S.pow_mem (hml 16) _)
    · show R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis B _ _ ∈ S
      exact S.mul_mem (htb _) (S.pow_mem (hml 0) _)
  · unfold R0P.Mask.honestExtra AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
    refine sum_mem fun j _ => S.mul_mem ?_ ?_
    · unfold R0P.Mask.libraWeight R0P.SemSource.libraWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact S.pow_mem (ha 8) _
      · exact S.pow_mem (ha 9) _
      · exact S.zero_mem
    · unfold coeffsOf
      exact hτ _ _

theorem L_round_mem (S : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S)
    (τ : Trace K) (hτ : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ S) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ S := by
  rw [PayloadSplit.L_round, PayloadSplit.rounds_apply]
  exact R0Z.K4Values.interpolate_coeff_mem S _ (fun k => sum_mem fun tail _ =>
    maskLinear_mem S π B hi hu _ (R0Z.K4Values.roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail) τ hτ) i.val

/-! ### Round-only payloads -/

/-- A difference of round inclusions and a multiple of `dir` vanishes off the
round cells. -/
theorem roundOnly_cell (p p' : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) (k : K) (cell : PayloadCell Bat)
    (hc : ∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) :
    (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p - PayloadSplit.roundInclusion p' - k • dir :
      Payload K Bat) cell = 0 := by
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact absurd rfl (hc j i)
  | maskSum => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | pointClaim j c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | extraClaim c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | ood j c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | inactiveSum => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | opened q s c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | bat b => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring

/-! ### The mask lift (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.4) -/

theorem nonRound_pointClaim (v : Payload K Bat) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    nonRound (F := F) v (.pointClaim j c) = v (.pointClaim j c) := rfl

theorem nonRound_inactiveSum (v : Payload K Bat) :
    nonRound (F := F) v .inactiveSum = v .inactiveSum := rfl

theorem nonRound_extraClaim (v : Payload K Bat) (c : Fin 29) :
    nonRound (F := F) v (.extraClaim c) = v (.extraClaim c) := rfl

/-- `mask_lift`, generic in the batched block and in the relation space `B0`. -/
theorem mask_lift_of (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (ch : Challenges K) (B0 : Submodule F (Bat → K))
    (hQ : R0Z.SilentReduction.QPrime (Bat := Bat) π B hB ch)
    (hown : (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map
      (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) ≤ B0)
    (hR : B0 ≤ (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) ⊓
      LinearMap.ker (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map
        (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch))
    (Y : Payload K Bat)
    (hclaim : ∀ j c, Y (.pointClaim j c) = 0) (hextra : ∀ c, Y (.extraClaim c) = 0)
    (hood : ∀ j c, Y (.ood j c) = 0) (hopen : ∀ q s c, Y (.opened q s c) = 0)
    (hia : Y .inactiveSum = 0) (hinit : R0Z.HonestValid.iota Y = 0)
    (hT : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch)
    (hb : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y ∈ B0) :
    Y ∈ LinearMap.range ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM) := by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hRx0⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (hQ hT)
  have hbx0 : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch x0 ∈ B0 :=
    hown (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx0)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hby⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (hR (B0.sub_mem hb hbx0))
  obtain ⟨hyo, hyR⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hy
  have hown_m : R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hx0, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyo, add_zero]
  have hR_m : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) =
      R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y := by
    rw [map_add, hRx0, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyR, add_zero]
  have hbat_m : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) =
      R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y := by
    rw [map_add, hby]
    abel
  have hproj : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y)) =
      R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y := hR_m
  refine ⟨x0 + y, ?_⟩
  apply R0Z.SilentReduction.payload_ext (F := F)
  · funext cell
    cases cell with
    | semanticCoeff j i => rfl
    | maskSum =>
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) .maskSum = Y .maskSum
      rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.ms_pure_eq_initial,
        R0Z.SilentReduction.roundPoly_eq_of_roundProjection hproj 0]
      have hi := hinit
      rw [R0Z.HonestValid.iota_apply] at hi
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hi
    | pointClaim j c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.pointClaim j c)
      rw [nonRound_pointClaim, nonRound_pointClaim, h1, hclaim j c]
    | extraClaim c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.extraClaim c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.extraClaim c)
      rw [nonRound_extraClaim, nonRound_extraClaim, h1, hextra c]
    | ood j c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.ood j c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.ood j c)
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.ood j c) = Y (.ood j c)
      rw [h1, hood j c]
    | inactiveSum =>
      rw [nonRound_inactiveSum, nonRound_inactiveSum,
        R0Z.SilentReduction.ia_pure_zero (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y), hia]
    | opened q s c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.opened q s c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.opened q s c)
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.opened q s c) = Y (.opened q s c)
      rw [h1, hopen q s c]
    | bat b =>
      exact congrFun hbat_m b
  · exact hproj
