R0Z.HonestValidity.text:
import R0Z.IIPrimeResidual

/-! J0b (DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5, §4 J0b; LOG D36.4, D39.2): honest builds and
`HonestValid`.

Through the row-1023 lemma `laneOf_actual_zero`, `HonestValid pub B t ch` is a
statement about the prepared instance `prepare pub t ch` (lane 26 = the
literal helper of `t`):

* lanes 0..27 of `prepare pub t ch` are those of `t` (`laneOf_prepare_lt`);
* lane 28 (Copy) of `prepare pub t ch` vanishes at every active row whose four
  LogUp denominators `χ − value` are nonzero, for EVERY trace
  (`copyHolds_prepare`): the helper is then exactly the fraction sum;
* the two helper sums of `actual pub B t ch 0` are those of `helper pub t`
  (`actual_26`).

So `honestValid_of` derives `HonestValid` from the named builder properties
`HonestBuilderSound` (base typing, the 28 non-copy production lanes, the two
helper sums) and the challenge condition `NoPole`.

The pole is a genuine obstruction (`not_honestValid_of_pole`): at an active
row where `χ` equals a producer value, the Copy lane is
`−(χ−c₀)(χ−c₁)·pw₀·(χ−p₁)` whatever the helper, so `HonestValid` fails.  The
condition depends on the witness's tuple values, so `ValidOn P` (validity for
every `P`-challenge) cannot be derived for honest builds from builder
properties alone (`validOn_of_noPole` needs `NoPole` at every `P`-challenge).
Nothing here is assumed beyond the stated hypotheses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.HonestValidity
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The prepared instance -/

theorem prepare_sem (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 16) (r : Fin 1024) :
    prepare pub t ch (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) r = t (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) r := by
  have hc : c.val ≠ 26 := by have := c.isLt; omega
  simp only [prepare, Fin.val_castLE, hc, ↓reduceIte]

theorem rowOpenings_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 1024) :
    rowOpenings (prepare pub t ch) b = rowOpenings t b := by
  simp only [rowOpenings, prepare_sem]

theorem copyEndpointTuple_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (tag : Nat)
    (ep : CopyEndpoint) :
    copyEndpointTuple (prepare pub t ch) tag ep = copyEndpointTuple t tag ep := by
  simp only [copyEndpointTuple, prepare_sem]

theorem copyRowValues_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (lam : K)
    (b : Fin 1024) (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (slot : Fin 2) :
    copyRowValues (prepare pub t ch) lam b endpoint slot = copyRowValues t lam b endpoint slot := by
  simp only [copyRowValues, copyEndpointTuple_prepare]

theorem prepare_26 (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 1024) :
    prepare pub t ch 26 b = helper pub t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) b := by
  unfold prepare
  exact if_pos rfl

/-- Lanes 0..27 (Poseidon and the packed semantic families) read only the
semantic openings, so preparing H1 changes none of them. -/
theorem laneOf_prepare_lt (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (lam chi : K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (i : Fin 29) (bits : Fin 10 → Bool) (hi : i.val < 28) :
    laneOf (prepare pub t ch) pub lam chi B i bits = laneOf t pub lam chi B i bits := by
  unfold laneOf
  by_cases h4 : i.val < 4
  · simp only [dif_pos h4, rowOpenings_prepare]
  · simp only [dif_neg h4, dif_pos hi, semanticPackedLane, scalarLaneRow, rowOpenings_prepare]

/-- Lane 28 is the single Copy residual. -/
theorem laneOf_copy (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (lam chi : K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (bits : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    laneOf t pub lam chi B 28 bits =
      (copyFamily.residuals pub lam chi (rowOpenings t (rowOf bits)) (t 26 (rowOf bits))
        (rowSel (rowOf bits))).getD 0 0 := rfl

/-- H1 of the payload trace is the literal helper of the instance. -/
theorem actual_26 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (r : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 26 r = helper pub t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) r := by
  have h0 : (Sum.elim 0 (aff (0 : T K F)) : MaskTape K F) = 0 := by
    rw [map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F))]
    funext z
    cases z <;> rfl
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual
  rw [R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1_applyAff, h0, R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1Padding_zero, Pi.zero_apply,
    add_zero, prepare_26]
  exact R0Z.HelperInvariant.helper_eligible pub t _ _ _ r

/-! ### The Copy lane away from poles -/

/-- No LogUp denominator of an active row vanishes at `χ`. -/
def NoPole (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Fin 1024, CopyActiveRow b → ∀ s : Fin 2,
    chi ≠ copyRowValues t lam b CopyLink.producer s ∧ chi ≠ copyRowValues t lam b CopyLink.consumer s

/-- Away from poles the Copy family holds on the prepared instance of EVERY trace. -/
theorem copyHolds_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hnp : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)) :
    CHolds copyFamily pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) := by
  rw [copy_holds_iff]
  intro b hb
  dsimp only
  simp only [copyRowValues_prepare, prepare_26]
  obtain ⟨hp0, hc0⟩ := hnp b hb 0
  obtain ⟨hp1, hc1⟩ := hnp b hb 1
  have dp0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hp0
  have dp1 := sub_ne_zero.2 hp1
  have dc0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hc0
  have dc1 := sub_ne_zero.2 hc1
  simp only [helper, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  field_simp
  ring

/-! ### The builder properties and HonestValid -/

/-- J0b: the properties of an honest build that `HonestValid` needs, stated on
the raw instance trace.  `lanes` is ProductionHolds without the Copy family
(lanes 0..27 do not read λ, χ or H1); `helperSum` and `helperInactive` are the
two helper sums of the source terminal (Pair-forest terminal:1307–1308). -/
structure HonestBuilderSound (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) :
    Prop where
  baseTyped : BaseTyped F t
  lanes : ∀ (lam chi : K) (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 → laneOf t pub lam chi B i b = 0
  helperSum : ∀ lam chi : K, ∑ r, helper pub t lam chi r = 0
  helperInactive : ∀ lam chi : K, ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, helper pub t lam chi r = 0

/-- J0b: an honest build is valid at every pole-free challenge. -/
theorem honestValid_of (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hs : HonestBuilderSound F pub B t) (hnp : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)) :
    R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t ch := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i b
    rw [R0Z.IIPrimeResidual.laneOf_actual_zero]
    by_cases hi : i.val < 28
    · rw [laneOf_prepare_lt pub t ch _ _ B i b hi]
      exact hs.lanes _ _ i b hi
    · obtain rfl : i = 28 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; omega)
      rw [laneOf_copy]
      exact copyHolds_prepare pub t ch hnp (rowOf b) _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)
  · simp only [actual_26]
    exact hs.helperSum _ _
  · simp only [actual_26]
    exact hs.helperInactive _ _

/-- The prover-level form: honest instances of the statement. -/
def BuilderSoundOn (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → HonestBuilderSound F x.1 B (h.build w)

theorem baseTyped_of (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hs : BuilderSoundOn h B x) : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w) :=
  fun w hw => (hs w hw).baseTyped

/-- `ValidOn P` for an honest instance needs `NoPole` at every `P`-challenge. -/
theorem validOn_of_noPole (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hs : BuilderSoundOn h B x) (w : h.Instance)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1)
    (hnp : ∀ ch, P ch → NoPole (h.build w) (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)) :
    R0Z.HonestValid.ValidOn P h B x w :=
  fun ch hP => honestValid_of x.1 B (h.build w) ch (hs w hw) (hnp ch hP)

/-! ### The pole obstruction -/

/-- At an active row with `χ` equal to producer value 0, `HonestValid` fails
unless `(χ−c₀)(χ−c₁)·pw₀·(χ−p₁) = 0`; the helper value plays no role. -/
theorem not_honestValid_of_pole (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (b : Fin 1024) (hb : CopyActiveRow b)
    (hχ : ch.sem 1 = copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.producer 0)
    (hne : ((ch.sem 1 - copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.consumer 0) *
        (ch.sem 1 - copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.consumer 1)) *
      (copyRowWeights pub b CopyLink.producer 0 *
        (ch.sem 1 - copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.producer 1)) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t ch := by
  intro hv
  have hC : CHolds copyFamily pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) := by
    intro b' r hr
    rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr]
    have h1 := hv.1 28 (rowBits b')
    rw [R0Z.IIPrimeResidual.laneOf_actual_zero, laneOf_copy, rowOf_rowBits] at h1
    exact h1
  have he := (copy_holds_iff pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch)).1 hC b hb
  dsimp only at he
  simp only [copyRowValues_prepare] at he
  rw [← hχ] at he
  simp only [sub_self, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] at he
  exact hne he.symm

#print axioms prepare_sem
#print axioms rowOpenings_prepare
#print axioms copyEndpointTuple_prepare
#print axioms copyRowValues_prepare
#print axioms prepare_26
#print axioms laneOf_prepare_lt
#print axioms laneOf_copy
#print axioms actual_26
#print axioms NoPole
#print axioms copyHolds_prepare
#print axioms HonestBuilderSound
#print axioms honestValid_of
#print axioms BuilderSoundOn
#print axioms baseTyped_of
#print axioms validOn_of_noPole
#print axioms not_honestValid_of_pole
end R0Z.HonestValidity

R1Z.PoleMassR1.text:
import R0Z.HonestValidity
import R0Z.HvzkV

/-! J0c (LOG D40.3): the LogUp pole mass of one attempt.  `¬ NoPole t λ χ`
puts `χ` in `poleSet t λ`, at most 4·|active rows| ≤ 4096 values; under the
named sampler premise `Sem1Uniform draw Q` (χ = sem 1 uniform on Q values
given λ = sem 0; for R1, K₄ = QM31 and Q = p⁴) one attempt's pole mass is at
most 4096 / Q.  No Lean lemma fixes the law of the FS challenge draw
(FsGood.lean header: the alpha-row law "is not chosen here"; R0P MaskD2.lean
`uniform_point_mass` is for an abstract uniform type), so the premise is a
named hypothesis. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.PoleMassR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The pole mass -/

/-- The copy-active rows (kept opaque: never evaluated). -/
@[irreducible] def activeRows : Finset (Fin 1024) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Fin 1024 => CopyActiveRow b)

theorem mem_activeRows (b : Fin 1024) (hb : CopyActiveRow b) : b ∈ activeRows := by
  unfold activeRows
  exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hb⟩

theorem activeRows_card_le : activeRows.card ≤ 1024 := by
  unfold activeRows
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin])

/-- The four LogUp values of one active row and slot (producer or consumer). -/
def poleValue (t : Trace K) (lam : K) (p : Fin 1024 × Fin 2 × Bool) : K :=
  cond p.2.2 (copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.producer p.2.1)
    (copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.consumer p.2.1)

/-- All producer and consumer LogUp values of the active rows. -/
@[irreducible] def poleSet (t : Trace K) (lam : K) : Finset K :=
  (activeRows ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 × Bool))).image (poleValue t lam)

theorem poleValue_mem (t : Trace K) (lam : K) (p : Fin 1024 × Fin 2 × Bool)
    (hp : CopyActiveRow p.1) : poleValue t lam p ∈ poleSet t lam := by
  unfold poleSet
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem (poleValue t lam)
    (Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨mem_activeRows p.1 hp, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)

theorem mem_poleSet_of_not_noPole (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (hn : ¬ R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole t lam chi) : chi ∈ poleSet t lam := by
  by_contra hc
  apply hn
  intro b hb s
  constructor
  · intro he
    apply hc
    have hm := poleValue_mem t lam (b, s, true) hb
    have hv : poleValue t lam (b, s, true) = chi := he.symm
    rw [hv] at hm
    exact hm
  · intro he
    apply hc
    have hm := poleValue_mem t lam (b, s, false) hb
    have hv : poleValue t lam (b, s, false) = chi := he.symm
    rw [hv] at hm
    exact hm

theorem poleSet_card_le (t : Trace K) (lam : K) :
    (poleSet t lam).card ≤ 4 * activeRows.card := by
  unfold poleSet
  -- Memory (J0d probes 3879/3880): the former `rw [...]; omega` closing of this
  -- lemma alone cost ≈440 MB over the import baseline; every step here closes
  -- syntactically, so nothing is asked to reduce `activeRows.card`.
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 × Bool)).card = 4 := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool]
  calc _ ≤ (activeRows ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 × Bool))).card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = activeRows.card * 4 := by rw [Finset.card_product, hu]
    _ = 4 * activeRows.card := Nat.mul_comm _ _

theorem poleSet_card_le_4096 (t : Trace K) (lam : K) : (poleSet t lam).card ≤ 4096 :=
  (poleSet_card_le t lam).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 activeRows_card_le)

/-- Sampler premise (HYP): `χ = sem 1` is uniform on a set of `Q` values given
`λ = sem 0` (for R1: K₄ = QM31, `Q = p⁴`), in the upper-bound form used here:
for any `λ`-indexed family of at most `m` values, the draw hits it with mass at
most `m / Q`. -/
def Sem1Uniform {Coins : Type} [Fintype Coins] (draw : Coins → Challenges K) (Q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : K → Finset K) (m : ℕ), (∀ l, (S l).card ≤ m) →
    eventMass (fun c => (draw c).sem 1 ∈ S ((draw c).sem 0)) ≤ (m : ℚ) / Q

/-- One attempt's pole mass for a fixed trace. -/
theorem pole_mass_le {Coins : Type} [Fintype Coins] (draw : Coins → Challenges K) (Q : ℕ)
    (hU : Sem1Uniform draw Q) (t : Trace K) :
    eventMass (fun c => ¬ R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole t ((draw c).sem 0) ((draw c).sem 1)) ≤
      (4096 : ℚ) / Q := by
  have h := hU (poleSet t) 4096 (fun l => poleSet_card_le_4096 t l)
  refine (eventMass_mono (fun c => ¬ R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole t ((draw c).sem 0) ((draw c).sem 1))
    (fun c => (draw c).sem 1 ∈ poleSet t ((draw c).sem 0))
    (fun c hc => mem_poleSet_of_not_noPole t _ _ hc)).trans ?_
  exact_mod_cast h

#print axioms activeRows
#print axioms mem_activeRows
#print axioms activeRows_card_le
#print axioms poleValue
#print axioms poleSet
#print axioms poleValue_mem
#print axioms mem_poleSet_of_not_noPole
#print axioms poleSet_card_le
#print axioms poleSet_card_le_4096
#print axioms Sem1Uniform
#print axioms pole_mass_le
end R1Z.PoleMassR1

R1Z.Sem1UniformR1.text:
import R1Z.SamplerLawR1
import R1Z.PoleMassR1
import R1Z.GamesR1

/-! Sem1Uniform (LOG D42.3) for the concrete R1 games.  In `abR1` the attempt
coins carry every transcript read's answer as an independent uniform
coordinate; the draw is `W.dec` of the squeeze answers.  Two named premises
on the wire data, both R-wire refinement facts (LOG D45.5):

* `SemRows01 W`: `sem 1` (χ) is `s1` of the row-1 squeeze answer `sqS 1`, and
  `sem 0` (λ) does not read `sqS 1` (r1_wire.rs `begin`: λ from row 0, whose
  absorb carries C1, χ from row 1; the C1 absorb enters the address, not the
  answer, so it does not touch the coin coordinate);
* `QM31SamplerLaw s1`: `s1 b = emb (rank b mod p⁴)` with `rank` a bijection
  onto `Fin 2^256` and `emb` injective below `p⁴` (sampler.rs `qm31_sample`;
  restated from the spend path's `ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total`
  + `SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value` + `SourceSamplerByteRank.rank` =
  `ModuloField.blockRank ∘ decodeState`, an `Equiv`; the K-side carrier map
  `emb` and its injectivity are the `sampled_decode_eq_iff` content).

Result: `Sem1Uniform (drawW W) (p⁴ − 1)` for every wire satisfying them, so
`Sem1Uniform ((abR1 W N hN).draw adv x) (p⁴ − 1)` for every adversary and
statement; exact form `m·(⌊2^256/p⁴⌋+1)/2^256`.  No additive term.  ROM
address repeats do not arise here: `abR1`'s answers are independent coin
coordinates; repeats belong to the real↔middle coupling (ε_coll). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.Sem1UniformR1
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.LensR1
  R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.SamplerLawR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- R-wire (HYP): the decoder's rows 0 and 1.  `sem 1 = s1 (row-1 answer)`;
`sem 0` does not read the row-1 answer. -/
structure SemRows01 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) where
  s1 : OracleAnswer → K
  sem1 : ∀ (a : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer) (qb : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (r : OracleAnswer), (W.dec a o qb r).sem 1 = s1 (a 1)
  sem0 : ∀ (a a' : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer) (qb : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (r : OracleAnswer), (∀ i : Fin 27, i ≠ 1 → a i = a' i) →
      (W.dec a o qb r).sem 0 = (W.dec a' o qb r).sem 0

/-- The QM31 sampler law (restated from the spend path, HYP for the K carrier):
rank the 32 bytes bijectively into `Fin 2^256`, reduce mod `p⁴`, embed
injectively. -/
structure QM31SamplerLaw (s1 : OracleAnswer → K) where
  rank : OracleAnswer ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256)
  emb : ℕ → K
  emb_inj : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → emb x = emb y → x = y
  sample : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4)

section
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)

/-- The row-1 coin lens of one attempt. -/
abbrev row1Lens : Lens (R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) OracleAnswer := coinLens W (.ans (.sqS 1))

theorem row1Lens_set (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    (row1Lens W).set c u = (Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u, c.2) := rfl

theorem row1Lens_get (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) : (row1Lens W).get c = c.1 (.sqS 1) := rfl

theorem draw_sem1 (D : SemRows01 W) (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) :
    (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 1 = D.s1 ((row1Lens W).get c) :=
  D.sem1 _ _ _ _

theorem draw_sem0_set (D : SemRows01 W) (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    (drawW (K := K) W ((row1Lens W).set c u)).sem 0 = (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0 := by
  rw [row1Lens_set]
  show (W.dec (fun i => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.sqS i))
      (fun i => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.sqO i))
      (fun k => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.qb k))
      (Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u .sqR)).sem 0 =
    (W.dec (fun i => c.1 (.sqS i)) (fun i => c.1 (.sqO i)) (fun k => c.1 (.qb k))
      (c.1 .sqR)).sem 0
  have ho : (fun i => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.sqO i)) = (fun i => c.1 (.sqO i)) :=
    funext fun i => Function.update_of_ne (by intro h; cases h) _ _
  have hq : (fun k => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.qb k)) = (fun k => c.1 (.qb k)) :=
    funext fun k => Function.update_of_ne (by intro h; cases h) _ _
  have hr : Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u .sqR = c.1 .sqR :=
    Function.update_of_ne (by intro h; cases h) _ _
  rw [ho, hq, hr]
  exact D.sem0 _ _ _ _ _ (fun i hi => Function.update_of_ne (fun h => hi (TRead.sqS.inj h)) _ _)

/-- Exact form: a `λ`-indexed family of at most `m` values is hit by `χ` with
mass at most `m · (⌊2^256/p⁴⌋ + 1) / 2^256`. -/
theorem sem1_mass_le_exact (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1)
    (T : K → Finset K) (m : ℕ) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m) :
    eventMass (fun c => (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 1 ∈ T ((drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0)) ≤
      ((m * (2 ^ 256 / (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass,
    mass_congr _ (fun c => D.s1 ((row1Lens W).get c) ∈ T ((drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0))
      (fun c => by rw [draw_sem1 W D c])]
  exact lens_sampler_mass_le (row1Lens W) (fun c => (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0) D.s1 T m
    (2 ^ 256) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) L.rank m31_q_pos L.emb L.emb_inj L.sample
    (draw_sem0_set W D) hT

/-- `Sem1Uniform` for the R1 draw with `Q = p⁴ − 1`. -/
theorem sem1Uniform_drawW (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1) :
    Sem1Uniform (drawW (K := K) W) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) := by
  intro T m hT
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass,
    mass_congr _ (fun c => D.s1 ((row1Lens W).get c) ∈ T ((drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0))
      (fun c => by rw [draw_sem1 W D c])]
  exact lens_qm31_mass_le (row1Lens W) (fun c => (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0) D.s1 T m
    L.rank L.emb L.emb_inj L.sample (draw_sem0_set W D) hT

/-- `Sem1Uniform` for the abort bridge's draw, every adversary and statement. -/
theorem sem1Uniform_abR1 (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    Sem1Uniform ((abR1 W N hN).draw adv x) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) :=
  sem1Uniform_drawW W D L

end

#print axioms SemRows01
#print axioms QM31SamplerLaw
#print axioms row1Lens_set
#print axioms draw_sem1
#print axioms draw_sem0_set
#print axioms sem1_mass_le_exact
#print axioms sem1Uniform_drawW
#print axioms sem1Uniform_abR1
end R1Z.Sem1UniformR1

R0Z.TerminalClosed.text:
import R0Z.K4Values

/-! J2b (LOG D35): `TerminalClosed` from `SemK4 ∧ PublicBase`.

The R0P terminal `terminalValue pub λ χ θ μ zc B y α` reads only its
arguments: the public statement `pub`, the four challenges, `zc`, the packing
basis `B`, the claims `y` and the point `α` (its type takes no trace and no
other state).  Every constraint family it evaluates (Poseidon packed,
schedule, occupancy, path, value, digest, asset, copy) is built from these
by ring operations, inverses-free products, numerals, finite folds and
branches on public/static data.  Hence, for any subfield `S` containing `F`,
`B.i`, `B.u` and all those inputs, the terminal lies in `S`
(`terminalValue_mem`).  Specialised to `S = K₄` this is `terminalClosed`.

Proof style follows R0P/LaneMap's Boolean-row closure lemmas, generalised to
arbitrary openings and selector vectors with entries in `S`.  No table is
evaluated: numerals are discharged by `natCast_mem`, vectors by `Fin.cases`. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.TerminalClosed

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0P.SemSource

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] (S : Subfield K)

/-! ## Generic tools -/

theorem foldl_mem {α : Type} (f : K → α → K) (l : List α) (init : K) (hinit : init ∈ S)
    (hf : ∀ acc, acc ∈ S → ∀ x ∈ l, f acc x ∈ S) : l.foldl f init ∈ S := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => exact hinit
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih _ (hf init hinit x (List.mem_cons_self ..))
      (fun acc hacc y hy => hf acc hacc y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy))

theorem getD_mem (l : List K) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ S) (i : ℕ) : l.getD i 0 ∈ S := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simpa using S.zero_mem
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simpa using h x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    | succ i =>
      simpa using ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)) i

theorem vec_cons_mem {n : Nat} (head : K) (tail : Fin n → K) (hh : head ∈ S)
    (ht : ∀ i, tail i ∈ S) : ∀ i, Matrix.vecCons head tail i ∈ S := by
  intro i; exact Fin.cases hh ht i

theorem vec_cons_fun {α : Type} {n : Nat} (P : α → Prop)
    (head : α) (tail : Fin n → α) (hh : P head) (ht : ∀ i, P (tail i)) :
    ∀ i, P (Matrix.vecCons head tail i) := by
  intro i; exact Fin.cases hh ht i

theorem vec_nil_fun {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) : ∀ i, P (Matrix.vecEmpty (α := α) i) := by
  intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i

/-! ## Selector adapters -/

section Sel

variable {S} (sel : Sel K) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
include hsel

theorem g2High_mem (h : Fin 64) : g2High sel h ∈ S :=
  sum_mem fun l _ => hsel _

theorem g2Low_mem (l : Fin 16) : g2Low sel l ∈ S :=
  sum_mem fun h _ => hsel _

theorem g2SumHigh_mem (start count : Nat) (bound : start + count ≤ 64) :
    g2SumHigh sel start count bound ∈ S := by
  unfold g2SumHigh
  refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => ?_)
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hx
  exact S.add_mem hacc (g2High_mem sel hsel _)

theorem scheduleNodes_mem : scheduleNodes sel ∈ S := by
  unfold scheduleNodes
  refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => S.add_mem hacc ?_)
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hx
    exact g2High_mem sel hsel _
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hx
    exact g2High_mem sel hsel _

end Sel

/- The selector adapters and the copy registries are never unfolded by
definitional checks below. -/
attribute [local irreducible] g2High g2Low g2SumHigh scheduleNodes copyLinks copyPatterns
  copyActiveRowMasks copyLinksBeforePositivity copyLinksAfterPositivity

/- The closure tactic on goals `x ∈ S` (after unfolding): hypotheses of the
fixed names `hz hs hx hsel hhigh hlow`, ring operations, finite sums and
products, branches, and finally numerals.  No hypothesis is applied with an
unconstrained conclusion. -/
set_option hygiene false in
macro "sclose" : tactic => `(tactic| repeat' first
  | assumption
  | exact hhigh _
  | exact hlow _
  | exact hz _
  | exact hs _
  | exact hx _
  | exact hsel _
  | exact zero_mem _
  | exact one_mem _
  | constructor
  | (intro _)
  | apply add_mem
  | apply sub_mem
  | apply mul_mem
  | apply neg_mem
  | apply pow_mem
  | (apply sum_mem; intro _ _)
  | (apply prod_mem; intro _ _)
  | split_ifs
  | split
  | exact natCast_mem _ _)

/- A narrower closure for the schedule arithmetic (no list, branch or
big-operator alternatives). -/
set_option hygiene false in
macro "rclose" : tactic => `(tactic| repeat' first
  | assumption
  | exact hhigh _
  | exact hlow _
  | exact hz _
  | exact hsel _
  | exact zero_mem _
  | exact one_mem _
  | exact natCast_mem _ _
  | apply add_mem
  | apply sub_mem
  | apply mul_mem)

/-! ## Families at arbitrary openings and selectors -/

section Families

variable {S} (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K)

theorem scheduleInitial_mem_pt (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleInitial .privateTransfer o sel lane ∈ S := by
  have hhigh := g2High_mem sel hsel
  have hlow := g2Low_mem sel hsel
  have hnodes := scheduleNodes_mem sel hsel
  unfold scheduleInitial scheduleVariantSelectors
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs <;> rclose

theorem scheduleInitial_mem_wd (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleInitial .withdrawal o sel lane ∈ S := by
  have hhigh := g2High_mem sel hsel
  have hlow := g2Low_mem sel hsel
  have hnodes := scheduleNodes_mem sel hsel
  unfold scheduleInitial scheduleVariantSelectors
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs <;> rclose

theorem scheduleInitial_mem (v : Variant) (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleInitial v o sel lane ∈ S := by
  cases v
  · exact scheduleInitial_mem_pt o sel hz hsel lane
  · exact scheduleInitial_mem_wd o sel hz hsel lane

theorem scheduleAbsorption_mem (v : Variant) (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleAbsorption v o sel lane ∈ S := by
  have hhigh := g2High_mem sel hsel
  have hlow := g2Low_mem sel hsel
  have hnodes := scheduleNodes_mem sel hsel
  cases v <;>
    (unfold scheduleAbsorption scheduleAbsorptionLiteral scheduleVariantSelectors; try dsimp only) <;>
    sclose

theorem schedule_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) :
    ∀ r ∈ scheduleFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  simp only [scheduleFamily, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  exact ⟨scheduleInitial_mem o sel _ hz hsel, scheduleAbsorption_mem o sel _ hz hsel⟩

theorem occupancy_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) :
    ∀ r ∈ occupancyFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have he : occupancyExpected (K := K) pub.variant ∈ S := by
    cases pub.variant
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  simp only [occupancyFamily, occupancyLanesLiteral, List.forall_mem_append,
    List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true,
    and_true, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  sclose

theorem path_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) :
    ∀ r ∈ pathFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have hq : pathSelector sel ∈ S := by
    unfold pathSelector
    exact S.mul_mem (g2SumHigh_mem sel hsel _ _ _)
      (S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.add_mem (g2Low_mem sel hsel _) (g2Low_mem sel hsel _))
        (g2Low_mem sel hsel _)) (g2Low_mem sel hsel _))
  simp only [pathFamily, pathLanes, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_cons,
    List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true, and_true, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  sclose

theorem value_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hx : ∀ i, o.xor12 i ∈ S)
    (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) : ∀ r ∈ valueFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have hrz : valueReconstruct10 o.z ∈ S := by
    rw [value_reconstruct10_eq]; sclose
  have hrs : valueReconstruct10 o.succ ∈ S := by
    rw [value_reconstruct10_eq]; sclose
  have hrx : valueReconstruct10 o.xor12 ∈ S := by
    rw [value_reconstruct10_eq]; sclose
  have hrange : ∀ r ∈ valueRange o, r ∈ S := by
    simp only [valueRange, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff,
      List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true, and_true]
    sclose
  simp only [valueFamily, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_map, List.forall_mem_cons,
    List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true, and_true]
  constructor
  · intro r hr
    refine S.mul_mem ?_ (hrange r hr)
    clear hrange
    sclose
  · clear hrange
    sclose

theorem emptyRoot_mem (level : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) : emptyRootRightTarget (K := K) level i ∈ S := by
  unfold emptyRootRightTarget
  split_ifs <;> exact natCast_mem S _

theorem digestTarget_mem {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (hpub : PublicBase F pub)
    (key : DigestKey) (i : Fin 8) : digestTarget pub key i ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hn, _, hr, hc, _, hsf, hroot, hnext⟩ := hpub
  cases key with
  | anchor => exact hFS _ (ha i)
  | nullifier => exact hFS _ (hn i)
  | recipient =>
      cases he : pub.recipient with
      | none => simp only [digestTarget, he, Option.getD_none]; exact S.zero_mem
      | some r =>
          simp only [digestTarget, he, Option.getD_some]
          exact hFS _ (hr r he i)
  | change => exact hFS _ (hc i)
  | frontier level =>
      simp only [digestTarget]
      split_ifs
      · exact emptyRoot_mem level i
      · exact hFS _ (hsf level i)
  | nextRoot => exact hFS _ (hroot i)
  | carry =>
      simp only [digestTarget]
      split_ifs
      · exact hFS _ (hnext _ i)
      · exact S.zero_mem

theorem digest_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) :
    ∀ r ∈ digestFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  simp only [digestFamily, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  intro i
  unfold publicDigestLanes
  rw [digest_fold_eq]
  apply S.add_mem S.zero_mem
  apply list_sum_mem
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨key, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  exact S.mul_mem (hsel _) (S.sub_mem (hz _) (digestTarget_mem pub hFS hpub key i))

theorem asset_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) :
    ∀ r ∈ assetFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have hasset : pub.assetId ∈ S := hFS _ hpub.2.2.1
  have hamount : pub.withdrawalAmount.getD 0 ∈ S := by
    cases he : pub.withdrawalAmount with
    | none => simp only [Option.getD_none]; exact S.zero_mem
    | some a =>
        simp only [Option.getD_some]
        exact hFS _ (hpub.2.2.2.2.2.1 a he)
  cases hv : pub.variant <;> cases hw : pub.withdrawalAmount.isSome
  all_goals
    simp only [assetFamily, assetScalarLanes, hv, hw, Bool.false_eq_true,
      ite_false, ite_true, List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
      false_implies, implies_true, and_true]
    sclose

end Families

section Poseidon

variable {S}

theorem poseidon_initial_mem : ∀ r lane, poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r lane ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonExternalInitial
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_nil_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | exact natCast_mem S _

theorem poseidon_final_mem : ∀ r lane, poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r lane ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonExternalFinal
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_nil_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | exact natCast_mem S _

theorem poseidon_internal_constants_mem : ∀ r, poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonInternalConstants
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | exact natCast_mem S _

theorem poseidon_pow5_mem (x : K) (hx : x ∈ S) : poseidonPow5 x ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonPow5
  exact S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem hx hx) (S.mul_mem hx hx)) hx

theorem poseidon_mat4_mem (v : Fin 4 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) : ∀ i, poseidonMat4 v i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonMat4
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | apply S.add_mem
    | exact hv _

theorem poseidon_external_mem (v : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonExternalLinear v i ∈ S := by
  intro i
  unfold poseidonExternalLinear
  repeat' first
    | apply S.add_mem
    | exact S.zero_mem
    | apply poseidon_mat4_mem
    | intro j
    | exact hv _

theorem poseidon_internal_mem (v : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonInternalLinear v i ∈ S := by
  have hsum : (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 15 => v i.succ)).foldl (· + ·) 0 ∈ S := by
    refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => S.add_mem hacc ?_)
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
    exact hv i.succ
  intro i
  unfold poseidonInternalLinear
  split_ifs
  · exact S.sub_mem hsum (hv 0)
  · exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem hsum (hv 0)) (S.mul_mem (hv i) (natCast_mem S _))

theorem poseidon_full_round_mem (v c : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonFullRound v c i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonFullRound
  apply poseidon_external_mem
  intro i
  exact poseidon_pow5_mem _ (S.add_mem (hv i) (hc i))

theorem poseidon_internal_round_mem (v : Fin 16 → K) (c : K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (hc : c ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonInternalRound v c i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonInternalRound
  apply poseidon_internal_mem
  intro i
  split_ifs
  · exact poseidon_pow5_mem _ (S.add_mem (hv 0) hc)
  · exact hv i

theorem poseidon_leading_mem (v a : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonLeadingPair v a i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonLeadingPair
  try dsimp only
  apply poseidon_full_round_mem
  · apply poseidon_full_round_mem
    · apply poseidon_external_mem
      intro i; split_ifs
      · exact S.add_mem (hv i) (ha i)
      · exact hv i
    · exact poseidon_initial_mem 0
  · exact poseidon_initial_mem 1

theorem poseidon_scalarResidual_mem (o : Openings K) (block : K) (low : Fin 16 → K)
    (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hx : ∀ i, o.xor12 i ∈ S)
    (hblock : block ∈ S) (hlow : ∀ i, low i ∈ S) (lane : Fin 16) :
    poseidonScalarResidual o block low lane ∈ S := by
  have hfull : ∀ i, poseidonInterpolatedFullPair o.z low i ∈ S := by
    unfold poseidonInterpolatedFullPair
    try dsimp only
    apply poseidon_full_round_mem
    · apply poseidon_full_round_mem _ _ hz
      intro i
      exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_initial_mem _ _))
        (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))) (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))
    · intro i
      exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_initial_mem _ _))
        (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))) (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))
  have hfoldc : ∀ (f : Fin 7 → K), (∀ i, f i ∈ S) → (List.ofFn f).foldl (· + ·) 0 ∈ S := by
    intro f hf
    refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => S.add_mem hacc ?_)
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
    exact hf i
  have hinternal : ∀ i, poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair o.z low i ∈ S := by
    unfold poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair
    try dsimp only
    apply poseidon_internal_round_mem
    · apply poseidon_internal_round_mem _ _ hz
      exact hfoldc _ (fun i => S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_internal_constants_mem _))
    · exact hfoldc _ (fun i => S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_internal_constants_mem _))
  have hleading := poseidon_leading_mem o.z o.xor12 hz hx
  have hfullLow : ([1, 9, 10] : List (Fin 16)).foldl (fun sum row => sum + low row) 0 ∈ S :=
    foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x _ => S.add_mem hacc (hlow x))
  have hinternalLow : (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 7 => low ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩)).foldl (· + ·) 0 ∈ S :=
    hfoldc _ (fun i => hlow _)
  unfold poseidonScalarResidual
  try dsimp only
  exact S.mul_mem hblock (S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.add_mem S.zero_mem
    (S.mul_mem (hlow 0) (S.sub_mem (hs lane) (hleading lane))))
    (S.mul_mem hfullLow (S.sub_mem (hs lane) (hfull lane))))
    (S.mul_mem hinternalLow (S.sub_mem (hs lane) (hinternal lane))))

theorem pack4_mem {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S)
    (v : Fin 4 → K) (hv : ∀ j, v j ∈ S) : pack4 B v ∈ S := by
  unfold pack4
  exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.add_mem (hv 0) (S.mul_mem hi (hv 1))) (S.mul_mem hu (hv 2)))
    (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem hi hu) (hv 3))

theorem poseidonPacked_mem {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S)
    (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K)
    (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hx : ∀ i, o.xor12 i ∈ S)
    (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) : ∀ r ∈ (poseidonPackedFamily B).residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  simp only [poseidonPackedFamily, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  intro group
  exact pack4_mem B hi hu _ (fun j => poseidon_scalarResidual_mem o _ _ hz hs hx
    (g2SumHigh_mem sel hsel _ _ _) (g2Low_mem sel hsel) _)

end Poseidon

section Copy

theorem copySelectorRow_mem (s : CopySelectors K) (hh : ∀ i, s.high i ∈ S)
    (hl : ∀ i, s.low i ∈ S) (r : Fin 1024) : copySelectorRow s r ∈ S :=
  S.mul_mem (hh _) (hl _)

theorem copyMaskSum_mem (values : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, values i ∈ S) (mask : Nat) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 values mask ∈ S := by
  unfold copySelectorMaskSum16
  try dsimp only
  refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ ?_ (fun acc hacc x _ => ?_)
  · split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  · try dsimp only
    split_ifs
    · exact S.sub_mem hacc (hv x)
    · exact S.add_mem hacc (hv x)

theorem copyActive_mem (s : CopySelectors K) (hh : ∀ i, s.high i ∈ S)

  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact S.add_mem hacc (S.mul_mem (hh x) (copyMaskSum_mem _ hl _))
  · exact hacc

theorem copyPowers_mem (lam : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (i : Fin 16) : copyPowers lam i ∈ S := by

theorem copyPatternValues_mem (openings : Fin 16 → K) (ho : ∀ i, openings i ∈ S)

  try dsimp only
  refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x _ => ?_)
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact S.add_mem hacc (S.mul_mem (copyPowers_mem lam hlam x)
      (S.add_mem (ho _) (natCast_mem S _)))
  · exact hacc

/-- Every field of a copy row extension in `S`. -/
def RowIn (row : CopyRowExtension K) : Prop :=
  (∀ s, row.producerValues s ∈ S) ∧ (∀ s, row.producerWeights s ∈ S) ∧
    (∀ s, row.consumerValues s ∈ S) ∧ (∀ s, row.consumerWeights s ∈ S)

theorem update_mem (f : Fin 2 → K) (hf : ∀ s, f s ∈ S) (slot : Fin 2) (x : K) (hx : x ∈ S) :
    ∀ s, Function.update f slot x s ∈ S := by
  intro s
  rw [Function.update_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact hx
  · exact hf s

theorem copyAccumulate_mem (values weights : Fin 2 → K) (hv : ∀ s, values s ∈ S)
    (hw : ∀ s, weights s ∈ S) (ep : CopyEndpoint) (tag : Nat) (weight : K) (hwt : weight ∈ S)
    (patterns : Fin 14 → K) (hp : ∀ i, patterns i ∈ S) (sels : CopySelectors K)
    (hh : ∀ i, sels.high i ∈ S) (hl : ∀ i, sels.low i ∈ S) :
    (∀ s, (copyAccumulateEndpoint values weights ep tag weight patterns sels).1 s ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ s, (copyAccumulateEndpoint values weights ep tag weight patterns sels).2 s ∈ S) := by
  unfold copyAccumulateEndpoint
  try dsimp only
  have hsr := copySelectorRow_mem sels hh hl ep.row
  exact ⟨update_mem _ hv _ _ (S.add_mem (hv _) (S.mul_mem hsr
      (S.add_mem (natCast_mem S _) (hp _)))),
    update_mem _ hw _ _ (S.add_mem (hw _) (S.mul_mem hsr hwt))⟩

theorem copyResidual_mem (row : CopyRowExtension K) (hrow : RowIn (S := S) row)
    (helper chi : K) (hh : helper ∈ S) (hc : chi ∈ S) : copyResidual row helper chi ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ := hrow
  have d : ∀ i, (![chi - row.producerValues 0, chi - row.producerValues 1,
      chi - row.consumerValues 0, chi - row.consumerValues 1] : Fin 4 → K) i ∈ S := by
    repeat' first
      | apply vec_cons_mem
      | apply vec_nil_fun
      | exact S.sub_mem hc (r1 _)
      | exact S.sub_mem hc (r3 _)
  unfold copyResidual
  exact S.sub_mem (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (d 0) (d 1))
      (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem hh (S.mul_mem (d 2) (d 3)))
        (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (r4 0) (d 3)) (S.mul_mem (r4 1) (d 2)))))
    (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (d 2) (d 3))
      (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (r2 0) (d 1)) (S.mul_mem (r2 1) (d 0))))

theorem copyEvaluate_mem (openings : Fin 16 → K) (ho : ∀ i, openings i ∈ S) (h1 : K)
    (hh1 : h1 ∈ S) (sels : CopySelectors K) (hh : ∀ i, sels.high i ∈ S)
    (hl : ∀ i, sels.low i ∈ S) (lam chi : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S)
    (n : Nat) (v : Variant) :
    (copyEvaluateWithSelectors openings h1 sels lam chi n v).1 ∈ S := by
  unfold copyEvaluateWithSelectors
  try dsimp only
  have hp := copyPatternValues_mem openings ho lam hlam
  have hrow : ∀ (l : List CopyLink) (init : CopyRowExtension K), RowIn (S := S) init →
      RowIn (S := S) (l.foldl (fun row link =>
        let weight := copyLinkWeight link n v
        let producer := copyAccumulateEndpoint row.producerValues row.producerWeights
          link.producer link.tag weight (copyPatternValuesLiteral openings lam) sels
        let consumer := copyAccumulateEndpoint row.consumerValues row.consumerWeights
          link.consumer link.tag weight (copyPatternValuesLiteral openings lam) sels
        (⟨producer.1, producer.2, consumer.1, consumer.2⟩ : CopyRowExtension K)) init) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro init h; exact h
    | cons link xs ih =>
      intro init h
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih
      obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3', h4'⟩ := h
      have hwt := R0Z.K4Values.copyLinkWeight_mem S link n v
      have hP := copyAccumulate_mem _ _ h1' h2' link.producer link.tag _ hwt _ hp sels hh hl
      have hC := copyAccumulate_mem _ _ h3' h4' link.consumer link.tag _ hwt _ hp sels hh hl
      exact ⟨hP.1, hP.2, hC.1, hC.2⟩
  have hinit : RowIn (S := S) (⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0⟩ : CopyRowExtension K) :=
    ⟨fun _ => S.zero_mem, fun _ => S.zero_mem, fun _ => S.zero_mem, fun _ => S.zero_mem⟩
  obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ := hrow copyLinks _ hinit
  exact S.mul_mem (copyActive_mem sels hh hl) (copyResidual_mem _ ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ h1 chi hh1 hchi)

theorem copy_mem (pub : Public K) (lam chi : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S)
    (o : Openings K) (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (h1 : K) (hh1 : h1 ∈ S) (sel : Sel K)
    (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) : ∀ r ∈ copyFamily.residuals pub lam chi o h1 sel, r ∈ S := by
  simp only [copyFamily, List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, false_implies,
    implies_true, and_true]
  exact copyEvaluate_mem o.z hz h1 hh1 (copySelectors sel) (g2High_mem sel hsel)
    (g2Low_mem sel hsel) lam chi hlam hchi _ _

end Copy

theorem scalarLaneAt_mem {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (pub : Public K)
    (hpub : PublicBase F pub) (o : Openings K)
    (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hx : ∀ i, o.xor12 i ∈ S)
    (sel : Sel K) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) (i : Nat) : scalarLaneAt pub o sel i ∈ S := by
  have hsch := getD_mem S _ (schedule_mem pub o sel hz hsel)
  have hocc := getD_mem S _ (occupancy_mem pub o sel hz hsel)
  have hpath := getD_mem S _ (path_mem pub o sel hz hs hsel)
  have hval := getD_mem S _ (value_mem pub o sel hz hs hx hsel)
  have hdig := getD_mem S _ (digest_mem pub o sel hz hsel hFS hpub)
  have hass := getD_mem S _ (asset_mem pub o sel hz hsel hFS hpub)
  unfold scalarLaneAt
  split_ifs
  · exact S.add_mem (hsch _) (hocc _)
  · exact hsch _
  · exact hpath _
  · exact hval _
  · exact hdig _
  · exact hass _
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem laneAt_mem {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (pub : Public K) (hpub : PublicBase F pub)
    (lam chi : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S) (o : Openings K)
    (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hx : ∀ i, o.xor12 i ∈ S)
    (h1 : K) (hh1 : h1 ∈ S) (sel : Sel K) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) (i : Fin 29) :
    laneAt pub lam chi B o h1 sel i ∈ S := by
  unfold laneAt
  split_ifs
  · exact getD_mem S _ (poseidonPacked_mem B hi hu pub o sel hz hs hx hsel) _
  · exact pack4_mem B hi hu _ (fun j => scalarLaneAt_mem S hFS pub hpub o hz hs hx sel hsel _)
  · exact getD_mem S _ (copy_mem pub lam chi hlam hchi o hz h1 hh1 sel hsel) _

/-- The terminal lies in any subfield containing `F`, `B.i`, `B.u`, the
challenges, `zc`, the claims and the point. -/
theorem terminalValue_mem {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (pub : Public K) (hpub : PublicBase F pub)
    (lam chi θ μ : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S) (hθ : θ ∈ S) (hμ : μ ∈ S)
    (zc : Fin 10 → K) (hzc : ∀ i, zc i ∈ S) (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K) (hy : ∀ j c, y j c ∈ S)
    (α : Fin 10 → K) (hα : ∀ i, α i ∈ S) :
    terminalValue pub lam chi θ μ zc B y α ∈ S := by
  have hsel : ∀ k, selAt α k ∈ S := fun k =>
    R0Z.K4Values.eqWeight_mem S _ (fun b => hα _) k
  have hlane := laneAt_mem S hFS B hi hu pub hpub lam chi hlam hchi
    ⟨fun c => y 0 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c), fun c => y 1 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c),
      fun c => y 2 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)⟩
    (fun _ => hy _ _) (fun _ => hy _ _) (fun _ => hy _ _) (y 0 26) (hy _ _) (selAt α) hsel
  have heq : eqValue zc α ∈ S := by
    unfold eqValue
    exact prod_mem fun c _ => S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.sub_mem (S.sub_mem S.one_mem (hzc c)) (hα c))
      (S.mul_mem (hzc c) (hα c))) (S.mul_mem (hzc c) (hα c))
  have hact : activeAt α ∈ S :=
    copyActive_mem (copySelectors (selAt α)) (g2High_mem _ hsel) (g2Low_mem _ hsel)
  unfold terminalValue
  try dsimp only
  exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem heq (sum_mem fun i _ => S.mul_mem (S.pow_mem hθ _) (hlane i)))
    (S.mul_mem hμ (hy _ _))) (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem hμ hμ) (S.mul_mem (S.sub_mem S.one_mem hact) (hy _ _)))

/-- J2b: `TerminalClosed` on `K₄` from `SemK4` and `PublicBase`. -/
theorem terminalClosed {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (pub : Public K) (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ R0Z.K4.K4 B hB) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) :
    R0Z.K4Values.TerminalClosed (R0Z.K4.K4 B hB) pub B ch := by
  intro y a hy ha
  exact terminalValue_mem _ (fun x hx => R0Z.K4.F_le_K4 B hB hx) B (R0Z.K4.i_mem_K4 B hB)
    (R0Z.K4.u_mem_K4 B hB) pub hpub _ _ _ _ (hsem 0) (hsem 1) (hsem 2) (hsem 13)
    (R0Z.HonestView.zc ch) (fun i => hsem _) y hy a ha

/-! J4-R1(b) (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §2.4, §4; LOG D30, D33): the 47 batched
verifier relations of R1 (S2a, S2b, S1, and C_u, L_u per query) as one linear
map `relR1` on the batched cells, its kernel `B0R1`, and

* `bat_L_mem_B0R1`: for EVERY trace τ (J4′ form) whose own cells and inactive
  sum vanish, the batched cells of `L τ` satisfy every relation;
* `bat_ker_own_le_B0R1`: the batched image of own-silent mask tapes lies in
  `B0R1`.

S2b, S1 and L_u hold for every trace; S2a and C_u are the own-silent forms.
The line relation uses the inverse table `lineInverse` of BatchedAlgebra
(the normalisation Z9b found independently).  No challenge restriction. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
