R1Z.IIPrimeR1.text:
import R0Z.IIPrimeResidual
import R0Z.TerminalClosed
import R1Z.NoiseLiftR1

/-! J15-R1 (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.1–2.5; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.3–3.6, §4):
clause (ii′) on R1 for valid witnesses.

For `ch` with `P_R1`, two base-typed `HonestValid` witnesses `w, w′` of the
same public statement (with `PublicBase`):

* `delta_sem_mem`, `delta_h1_mem`: `δ = u_w − u_w′` has F-valued, inactive-
  balanced semantic lanes (`Wsem`) and a K₄-valued, inactive-balanced H1 lane
  (`Wh1`, clause 3 of `HonestValid`); its other lanes are zero.
* Step N (`noise_lift_R1`) gives a noise tape `n`; the residual
  `Y = cTilde w − cTilde w′ − A(inrN n)` has zero own cells, zero inactive sum,
  zero initial-sum defect, `Φ₀ = 0`, the chain equalities, K₄ round cells
  (`TerminalClosed` from `terminalClosed`) and batched cells in `B0R1′`
  (`bat_L_mem_B0R1` and `folded_unqueried_zero`).
* Step M (`mask_lift_of` with `QPrime_R1`, `bat_ker_own_le_B0R1′`,
  `BReach_R1`) writes `Y` as a mask-tape image.

Hence `cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1` and `iiPrime_R1 : IIPrimeValid (P_R1 …) h B x`.
Every challenge condition is a conjunct of `P_R1`; nothing else is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.IIPrimeR1
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
  R0Z.K4 R1Z.Batched R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1 R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.NoiseLiftR1
  R0Z.IIPrimeResidual Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The lane word spaces -/

theorem batRead_apply (v : Payload K R1Bat) (b : R1Bat) :
    R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) v b = v (.bat b) := rfl

theorem mem_baseF {x : K} (hx : x ∈ F) : x ∈ baseF (F := F) := ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩

theorem mem_Wsem_iff (v : Fin 1024 → K) :
    v ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F) ↔ (∀ r, v r ∈ baseF (F := F)) ∧ ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, v r = 0 := by
  simp only [Wsem, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker, inactiveSumF, LinearMap.sum_apply]

theorem mem_Wh1_iff (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (v : Fin 1024 → K) :
    v ∈ Wh1 B hB ↔ (∀ r, v r ∈ K4 B hB) ∧ ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, v r = 0 := by
  simp only [Wh1, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker, inactiveSumF, LinearMap.sum_apply, mem_K4F]

/-- The semantic lanes of `δ` lie in `Wsem`. -/
theorem delta_sem_mem (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t t' : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hF : BaseTyped F t) (hF' : BaseTyped F t') (c : Fin 16) :
    (R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 - R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t' ch 0) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)
      ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F) := by
  rw [mem_Wsem_iff]
  refine ⟨fun r => mem_baseF (F.sub_mem (actual_sem_mem pub B t ch hF (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) c.isLt r)
    (actual_sem_mem pub B t' ch hF' (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) c.isLt r)), ?_⟩
  have hne : (Fin.castLE (by omega) c : Fin 29).val ≠ 26 := by
    have := c.isLt
    simp only [Fin.val_castLE]
    omega
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, R0Z.HonestValid.actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ _ hne,
    R0Z.HonestValid.actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ _ hne, sub_zero]

/-- The H1 lane of `δ` lies in `Wh1` (clause 3 of `HonestValid` for both). -/
theorem delta_h1_mem (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (t t' : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hF : BaseTyped F t) (hF' : BaseTyped F t')
    (hlam : ch.sem 0 ∈ K4 B hB) (hchi : ch.sem 1 ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hv : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t ch) (hv' : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t' ch) :
    (R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 - R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t' ch 0) 26 ∈ Wh1 B hB := by
  rw [mem_Wh1_iff]
  refine ⟨fun r => (K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB pub t ch hF hlam hchi 0 26 r)
    (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB pub t' ch hF' hlam hchi 0 26 r), ?_⟩
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hv.2.2, hv'.2.2, sub_zero]

/-! ### Clause (ii′) on R1 -/

theorem cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch) (w w' : h.Instance)
    (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w)) (hF' : BaseTyped F (h.build w'))
    (hv : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch)
    (hv' : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w') ch) :
    cTilde (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch) := by
  have hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB := hP.semK4
  have hT : R0Z.K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch :=
    R0Z.TerminalClosed.terminalClosed B hB x.1 ch hsem hpub
  have hi : B.i ∈ K4 B hB := i_mem_K4 B hB
  have hu : B.u ∈ K4 B hB := u_mem_K4 B hB
  -- the two payload traces
  obtain ⟨u, hu_def⟩ : ∃ u, u = R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u', hu'_def⟩ : ∃ u', u' = R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w') ch 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hu4 : ∀ c r, u c r ∈ K4 B hB := fun c r => by
    rw [hu_def]; exact R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r
  have hu4' : ∀ c r, u' c r ∈ K4 B hB := fun c r => by
    rw [hu'_def]; exact R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF' (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r
  -- Step N
  have hδ : ∀ c : Fin 16, (u - u') (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F) := by
    intro c
    rw [hu_def, hu'_def]
    exact delta_sem_mem x.1 B _ _ ch hF hF' c
  have hδ26 : (u - u') 26 ∈ Wh1 B hB := by
    rw [hu_def, hu'_def]
    exact delta_h1_mem x.1 B hB _ _ ch hF hF' (hsem 0) (hsem 1) hv hv'
  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ := noise_lift_R1 h.transport B hB ch hP (u - u') hδ hδ26
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ_def⟩ : ∃ τ, τ = u - u' - R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAn : A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch (inrN n) =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n)) := rfl
  have hLτ : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (u - u') - A h.transport B ch (inrN n) := by
    rw [hτ_def, map_sub, hAn]
  -- own cells of L τ
  have hown : ∀ l : Fin 29,
      ownRead (Bat := R1Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch τ) = 0 := by
    intro l
    rw [hLτ, map_sub (ownRead (Bat := R1Bat) (F := F) l)]
    by_cases hl : l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26
    · rw [hn1 l hl, sub_self]
    · have hz : (u - u') l = 0 := by
        rw [Pi.sub_apply, hu_def, hu'_def, actual_other_zero _ _ _ _ l hl,
          actual_other_zero _ _ _ _ l hl, sub_zero]
      rw [hn2 l hl, own_L_eq_obs, hz, map_zero, sub_zero]
  have hcl : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := by
    intro j c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.claim j)
  have hex : ∀ c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.extraClaim c) = 0 := by
    intro c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) .extra
  have hoo : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.ood j c) = 0 := by
    intro j c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.ood j)
  have hop : ∀ q s c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.opened q s c) = 0 := by
    intro q s c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.opened q s)
  -- the residual
  obtain ⟨Y, hY_def⟩ : ∃ Y : Payload K R1Bat,
      Y = cTilde (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch - A h.transport B ch (inrN n) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hY : Y = R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch τ +
      (R0Z.PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := R1Bat) (R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u) -
        R0Z.PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u') -
        (kOf h B x w ch - kOf h B x w' ch) • dir) := by
    rw [hY_def, cTilde_eq, cTilde_eq, hLτ, ← hu_def, ← hu'_def, map_sub, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hYcell : ∀ cell : PayloadCell R1Bat, (∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) →
      Y cell = R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch τ cell := by
    intro cell hc
    rw [hY, Pi.add_apply, roundOnly_cell _ _ _ cell hc, add_zero]
  have hYcl : ∀ j c, Y (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := fun j c => by
    rw [hYcell (.pointClaim j c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc)]; exact hcl j c
  have hYex : ∀ c, Y (.extraClaim c) = 0 := fun c => by
    rw [hYcell (.extraClaim c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc)]; exact hex c
  have hYoo : ∀ j c, Y (.ood j c) = 0 := fun j c => by
    rw [hYcell (.ood j c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc)]; exact hoo j c
  have hYop : ∀ q s c, Y (.opened q s c) = 0 := fun q s c => by
    rw [hYcell (.opened q s c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc)]; exact hop q s c
  have hdiff := R0Z.HonestValid.iota_inactive_diff_zero (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w w' ch hv hv'
  have hYia : Y .inactiveSum = 0 := by
    rw [hY_def, Pi.sub_apply, hdiff.2, R0Z.HonestValid.inactive_A, sub_zero]
  have hYiota : R0Z.HonestValid.iota Y = 0 := by
    rw [hY_def, map_sub, hdiff.1, R0Z.HonestValid.iota_A, sub_zero]
  have hLia : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ .inactiveSum = 0 := by
    rw [← hYcell .inactiveSum (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc)]
    exact hYia
  -- batched cells in B0R1′
  have hYb : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y ∈ B0R1' (F := F) h.transport ch := by
    have e : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y =
        R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ) := by
      funext b
      rw [batRead_apply, batRead_apply]
      exact hYcell (.bat b) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc)
    rw [e]
    refine Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨bat_L_mem_B0R1 h.transport B ch τ hcl hex hoo hop hLia, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    rw [batRead_apply]
    exact folded_unqueried_zero h.transport ch τ p hp
  -- the round part
  have hYchain : Y ∈ ChainEqs (Bat := R1Bat) ch := by
    rw [hY_def]
    exact (ChainEqs (Bat := R1Bat) ch).sub_mem ((ChainEqs (Bat := R1Bat) ch).sub_mem
      (cTilde_mem_chainEqs h B x w ch) (cTilde_mem_chainEqs h B x w' ch))
      (A_mem_chainEqs h.transport B ch _)
  have hYphi : Phi0 B ch Y = 0 := by
    rw [hY_def, map_sub, map_sub, Phi0_cTilde h B x w ch hP.halfOK,
      Phi0_cTilde h B x w' ch hP.halfOK, Phi0_A, sub_zero, sub_zero]
  have hYmask : claimMask B (alpha ch) Y = 0 := by
    simp only [claimMask, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      proj_apply, hYcl, hYex, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  have hY9 : (R0Z.Chain.roundPoly 9 Y).eval (alpha ch 9) = 0 := by
    have e : evalRound9 ch Y = Phi0 B ch Y + claimMask B (alpha ch) Y := by
      simp only [Phi0, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_add_cancel]
    rw [hYphi, hYmask, add_zero] at e
    rw [R0Z.Chain.roundPoly_nine]
    exact e
  have hτ4 : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro c r
    have htape : R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n) c r =
        R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (inrN n) c r -
          R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 c r := by
      rw [R0Z.JointTrace.actual_affine x.1 B (h.build w) ch (inrN n), Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply,
        add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [hτ_def]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [htape]
    exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (hu4 c r) (hu4' c r))
      ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
        (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) _ c r)
        (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r))
  have hk4 : ∀ (v : h.Instance), BaseTyped F (h.build v) → kOf h B x v ch ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro v hFv
    have hv4 : ∀ c r, R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build v) ch 0 c r ∈ K4 B hB :=
      fun c r => R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hFv (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r
    have ha : ∀ i, alpha ch i ∈ K4 B hB := R0Z.K4Values.alpha_mem _ ch hsem
    unfold kOf fOrig
    refine (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j c =>
      R0Z.K4Values.honestClaims_mem _ _ hv4 _ ha j c) ha)) ?_
    exact (K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (ha 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB))
  have hYK4 : ∀ j i, Y (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro j i
    rw [hY, Pi.add_apply]
    refine (K4 B hB).add_mem (L_round_mem _ h.transport B hi hu ch hsem τ hτ4 j i) ?_
    show R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u j i - R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u' j i -
        (kOf h B x w ch - kOf h B x w' ch) * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0)
      ∈ K4 B hB
    exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
      (R0Z.K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT u hu4 j i)
      (R0Z.K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT u' hu4' j i))
      ((K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (hk4 w hF) (hk4 w' hF'))
        (R0Z.K4Values.dirCoeff_mem B hB j i))
  have hYT : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y ∈
      R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0K4 (Bat := R1Bat) B hB ch := by
    refine Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨?_, (R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_K4Round_iff B hB _).2 hYK4⟩
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem]
    exact roundProjection_mem_chainT0 ch Y hYchain hY9
  -- Step M
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := mask_lift_of h.transport B hB ch (B0R1' h.transport ch) hP.qprime
    (bat_ker_own_le_B0R1' h.transport B ch) hP.breach Y hYcl hYex hYoo hYop hYia hYiota hYT hYb
  refine ⟨inlM m + inrN n, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch) inlM m, hm, hY_def,
    sub_add_cancel]

/-- Clause (ii′) on R1 for valid, base-typed witnesses (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.6 c). -/
theorem iiPrime_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hF : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w)) :
    R0Z.HonestValid.IIPrimeValid (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h B x :=
  fun ch hP w w' hw hw' hv hv' =>
    cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1 h B hB x hpub ch hP w w' (hF w hw) (hF w' hw') hv hv'

#print axioms batRead_apply
#print axioms mem_baseF
#print axioms mem_Wsem_iff
#print axioms mem_Wh1_iff
#print axioms delta_sem_mem
#print axioms delta_h1_mem
#print axioms cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1
#print axioms iiPrime_R1
end R1Z.IIPrimeR1

R0Z.RefPayload.text:
import R0Z.IIPrimeResidual

/-! ZF2 (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §3.2, §5.1): the public reference
payload and the explicit simulator, generic in the batched layer.

* `refPayload pub B ch`: `cTilde`'s formula (`cTilde_eq`) at the zero payload
  trace (`L 0 = 0`), plus `S₀ = Σ_b fOrig(0)(b)` in the `.maskSum` cell.  It is
  a function of `(pub, B, ch)` only.
* Its silent values: `ι = 0`, `.inactiveSum = 0`, `Φ₀ = 0` (α₉ ≠ ½), the chain
  equalities, round cells in `K₄` (under `TerminalClosed`), zero on every cell
  other than the round cells and `.maskSum`.
* `simE π B outputs x ch t = (metadata, Ψ_ch (refPayload + A_ch (equiv⁻¹ t)))`:
  no instance, no choice.
* `equalLaws_simE_of`: given clause (i′) for `w` and
  `cTilde w − refPayload ∈ range A_ch`, the honest view of `w` at `ch` and
  `simE … ch` have equal laws (the proof of `hvzk_on_of` with the chosen
  witness replaced by `refPayload`).

No challenge predicate is asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.RefPayload
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
  R0Z.Shift R0Z.K4 Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### The reference payload -/

/-- The payload with `s` at `.maskSum` and `0` elsewhere. -/
def msCell (s : K) : Payload K Bat := fun cell => match cell with
  | .maskSum => s
  | _ => 0

theorem msCell_maskSum (s : K) : msCell (Bat := Bat) s .maskSum = s := rfl
theorem msCell_semanticCoeff (s : K) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.semanticCoeff j i) = 0 := rfl
theorem msCell_pointClaim (s : K) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := rfl
theorem msCell_extraClaim (s : K) (c : Fin 29) : msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.extraClaim c) = 0 := rfl

/-- The direction coefficient of the zero payload trace. -/
def k0 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  fOrig pub B ch 0 (alpha ch) * (alpha ch 9 - 1/2)⁻¹

/-- The Boolean sum of the original terminal at the zero payload trace. -/
def S0 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch 0 (ofBool b))

/-- The public reference payload (design §3.2). -/
def refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Payload K Bat :=
  PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch 0) - k0 pub B ch • dir +
    msCell (S0 pub B ch)

/-! ### Silent values -/

theorem roundPoly_msCell (j : Fin 10) (s : K) : Chain.roundPoly j (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
  rw [Chain.roundPoly_apply]
  simp only [msCell_semanticCoeff, monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem iota_msCell (s : K) : HonestValid.iota (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = -s := by
  simp only [HonestValid.iota_apply, roundPoly_msCell, msCell_maskSum, eval_zero, zero_add,
    zero_sub]

theorem iota_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    HonestValid.iota (refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch) = 0 := by
  rw [refPayload, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, HonestValid.iota_originalRounds, HonestValid.iota_dir,
    iota_msCell, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  unfold S0
  ring

/-- Every cell other than the round cells and `.maskSum` is zero. -/
theorem refPayload_cell (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (cell : PayloadCell Bat) (hc : ∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) (hm : cell ≠ .maskSum) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch cell = 0 := by
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact absurd rfl (hc j i)
  | maskSum => exact absurd rfl hm
  | pointClaim j c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | extraClaim c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | ood j c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | inactiveSum => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | opened q s c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | bat b => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring

theorem inactive_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch .inactiveSum = 0 :=
  refPayload_cell pub B ch .inactiveSum (by intro _ _ h; cases h) (by intro h; cases h)

theorem Phi0_msCell (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (s : K) :
    Phi0 B ch (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
  have hr : round9Poly (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
    rw [round9Poly_apply]
    simp only [msCell_semanticCoeff, monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hc : claimMask B (alpha ch) (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
    simp only [claimMask, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      proj_apply, msCell_pointClaim, msCell_extraClaim, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  simp only [Phi0, LinearMap.sub_apply, evalRound9_apply, hr, hc, eval_zero, sub_zero]

theorem Phi0_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1/2) : Phi0 B ch (refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch) = 0 := by
  rw [refPayload, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, Phi0_roundInclusion, evalRound9_originalRounds,
    Phi0_dir, Phi0_msCell, smul_eq_mul, add_zero]
  unfold k0
  have hne : alpha ch 9 - 1/2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hhalf
  rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, mul_one, sub_self]

theorem msCell_mem_chainEqs (ch : Challenges K) (s : K) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s ∈ IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [IIPrimeResidual.mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  simp only [roundPoly_msCell, eval_zero, add_zero]

theorem refPayload_mem_chainEqs (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch ∈ IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch :=
  (IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).add_mem
    ((IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).sub_mem
      (IIPrimeResidual.originalRounds_mem_chainEqs pub B ch 0)
      ((IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).smul_mem _ (IIPrimeResidual.dir_mem_chainEqs ch)))
    (msCell_mem_chainEqs ch _)

/-- `k₀ ∈ K₄` from `TerminalClosed` (the zero trace has zero claims). -/
theorem k0_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hT : K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) pub B ch) :
    k0 pub B ch ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have ha : ∀ i, alpha ch i ∈ K4 B hB := K4Values.alpha_mem _ ch hsem
  have h0 : ∀ c r, (0 : Trace K) c r ∈ K4 B hB := fun _ _ => (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  unfold k0 fOrig
  refine (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j c =>
    K4Values.honestClaims_mem _ _ h0 _ ha j c) ha)) ?_
  exact (K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (ha 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB))

/-- The round cells of `refPayload` lie in `K₄`. -/
theorem refPayload_round_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hT : K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) pub B ch) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  show PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch 0 j i -
      k0 pub B ch * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) + 0 ∈ K4 B hB
  exact (K4 B hB).add_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ pub B ch hsem hT 0 (fun _ _ => (K4 B hB).zero_mem) j i)
    ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (k0_mem B hB pub ch hsem hT) (K4Values.dirCoeff_mem B hB j i)))
    (K4 B hB).zero_mem

/-! ### The explicit simulator -/

/-- ZF2's simulator: the shifted reference coset at a uniform tape.  Its
arguments are public; there is no instance and no choice. -/
def simE (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (ch : Challenges K) (t : JointView.Tape K F) :
    JointView.View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  (ZkStatement.metadata outputs x ch,
    shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A π B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t)))

attribute [local irreducible] JointView.payload A g

/-- Clause (i′) for `w` and the reference coset give equal laws of the honest
view and `simE`. -/
theorem equalLaws_simE_of [Fintype Bat] (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hi : ∀ n, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((A h.transport B ch).comp inlM))
    (hz : cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - refPayload x.1 B ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch)) :
    EqualLaws (JointView.view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simE h.transport B outputs x ch) := by
  have hlaw := payload_law_on h B x w ch hi
  have hlinear := AffineLaw.equal_laws_of_mask_image (A h.transport B ch) (A h.transport B ch)
    (cTilde h B x w ch) (refPayload x.1 B ch) rfl hz
  have hshift := equalLaws_comp (shift x.1 B ch) hlinear
  have hpart : EqualLaws (D12.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
      (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch t)) := by
    intro v
    exact (hlaw v).trans (hshift v)
  have hold : EqualLaws (JointView.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
      (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t))) := by
    refine AbsorptionLaw.equal_laws_of_equiv Partition.equiv.toEquiv _ _ ?_
    have hg : ∀ r : T K F, Partition.equiv.symm (Partition.equiv.toEquiv r) = r :=
      fun r => Partition.equiv.symm_apply_apply r
    simp only [hg]
    unfold R0Z.D12.payload at hpart
    exact hpart
  have hp := AffineLaw.equal_laws_const_pair (JointView.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
    (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t)))
    (ZkStatement.metadata outputs x ch) hold
  unfold JointView.view simE
  exact hp

#print axioms msCell
#print axioms k0
#print axioms S0
#print axioms refPayload
#print axioms roundPoly_msCell
#print axioms iota_msCell
#print axioms iota_refPayload
#print axioms refPayload_cell
#print axioms inactive_refPayload
#print axioms Phi0_msCell
#print axioms Phi0_refPayload
#print axioms msCell_mem_chainEqs
#print axioms refPayload_mem_chainEqs
#print axioms k0_mem
#print axioms refPayload_round_mem
#print axioms simE
#print axioms equalLaws_simE_of
end R0Z.RefPayload

R1Z.RefCosetR1.text:
import R1Z.IIPrimeR1
import R0Z.RefPayload

/-! ZF2 Claim Z (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §3.2, §5.3): on `P_R1`, the
normalised honest offset `cTilde w` of every valid, base-typed instance lies
in the public coset `refPayload x.1 B ch + range A_ch`.

The proof is `cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1` (R1Z/IIPrimeR1) with the second
instance replaced by the zero payload trace: `δ = u_w − 0` satisfies the
noise-lift hypotheses by validity of `w` alone, and the `.maskSum` patch of
`refPayload` restores `ι = 0`.  Every challenge condition is a conjunct of
`P_R1`; nothing else is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.RefCosetR1
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
  R0Z.K4 R1Z.Batched R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1 R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.NoiseLiftR1
  R0Z.IIPrimeResidual R1Z.IIPrimeR1 R0Z.RefPayload Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

theorem msCell_ne (s : K) (cell : PayloadCell R1Bat) (hc : cell ≠ .maskSum) :
    msCell (Bat := R1Bat) s cell = 0 := by
  cases cell <;> first | rfl | exact absurd rfl hc

/-- Claim Z. -/
theorem cTilde_sub_ref_mem_range_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch) (w : h.Instance)
    (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hv : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) :
    cTilde (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch - refPayload x.1 B ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch) := by
  have hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB := hP.semK4
  have hT : R0Z.K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch :=
    R0Z.TerminalClosed.terminalClosed B hB x.1 ch hsem hpub
  have hi : B.i ∈ K4 B hB := i_mem_K4 B hB
  have hu : B.u ∈ K4 B hB := u_mem_K4 B hB
  obtain ⟨u, hu_def⟩ : ∃ u, u = R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hu4 : ∀ c r, u c r ∈ K4 B hB := fun c r => by
    rw [hu_def]; exact R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r
  -- Step N, with δ = u − 0
  have hδ : ∀ c : Fin 16, u (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F) := by
    intro c
    rw [hu_def, mem_Wsem_iff]
    refine ⟨fun r => mem_baseF (R0Z.IIPrimeResidual.actual_sem_mem x.1 B _ ch hF
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) c.isLt r), ?_⟩
    have hne : (Fin.castLE (by omega) c : Fin 29).val ≠ 26 := by
      have := c.isLt
      simp only [Fin.val_castLE]
      omega
    exact R0Z.HonestValid.actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ _ hne
  have hδ26 : u 26 ∈ Wh1 B hB := by
    rw [hu_def, mem_Wh1_iff]
    exact ⟨fun r => R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 26 r, hv.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ := noise_lift_R1 h.transport B hB ch hP u hδ hδ26
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ_def⟩ : ∃ τ, τ = u - R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAn : A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch (inrN n) =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n)) := rfl
  have hLτ : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch u - A h.transport B ch (inrN n) := by
    rw [hτ_def, map_sub, hAn]
  have hown : ∀ l : Fin 29,
      ownRead (Bat := R1Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch τ) = 0 := by
    intro l
    rw [hLτ, map_sub (ownRead (Bat := R1Bat) (F := F) l)]
    by_cases hl : l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26
    · rw [hn1 l hl, sub_self]
    · have hz : u l = 0 := by
        rw [hu_def]
        exact actual_other_zero _ _ _ _ l hl
      rw [hn2 l hl, own_L_eq_obs, hz, map_zero, sub_zero]
  have hcl : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := by
    intro j c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.claim j)
  have hex : ∀ c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.extraClaim c) = 0 := by
    intro c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) .extra
  have hoo : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.ood j c) = 0 := by
    intro j c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.ood j)
  have hop : ∀ q s c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.opened q s c) = 0 := by
    intro q s c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.opened q s)
  -- the residual
  obtain ⟨Y, hY_def⟩ : ∃ Y : Payload K R1Bat,
      Y = cTilde (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch - refPayload x.1 B ch - A h.transport B ch (inrN n) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hY : Y = R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch τ +
      (R0Z.PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := R1Bat) (R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u) -
        R0Z.PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch 0) -
        (kOf h B x w ch - k0 x.1 B ch) • dir) - msCell (S0 x.1 B ch) := by
    rw [hY_def, cTilde_eq, refPayload, hLτ, ← hu_def, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hYcell : ∀ cell : PayloadCell R1Bat, (∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) →
      cell ≠ .maskSum → Y cell = R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch τ cell := by
    intro cell hc hm
    rw [hY, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, roundOnly_cell _ _ _ cell hc, msCell_ne _ cell hm,
      add_zero, sub_zero]
  have hYcl : ∀ j c, Y (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := fun j c => by
    rw [hYcell (.pointClaim j c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc) (by intro hc; cases hc)]; exact hcl j c
  have hYex : ∀ c, Y (.extraClaim c) = 0 := fun c => by
    rw [hYcell (.extraClaim c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc) (by intro hc; cases hc)]; exact hex c
  have hYoo : ∀ j c, Y (.ood j c) = 0 := fun j c => by
    rw [hYcell (.ood j c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc) (by intro hc; cases hc)]; exact hoo j c
  have hYop : ∀ q s c, Y (.opened q s c) = 0 := fun q s c => by
    rw [hYcell (.opened q s c) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc) (by intro hc; cases hc)]; exact hop q s c
  have hYia : Y .inactiveSum = 0 := by
    rw [hY_def, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, R0Z.HonestValid.inactive_cTilde_zero h B x w ch hv,
      inactive_refPayload, R0Z.HonestValid.inactive_A, sub_zero, sub_zero]
  have hYiota : R0Z.HonestValid.iota Y = 0 := by
    rw [hY_def, map_sub, map_sub, R0Z.HonestValid.iota_cTilde_zero h B x w ch hv, iota_refPayload,
      R0Z.HonestValid.iota_A, sub_zero, sub_zero]
  have hLia : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ .inactiveSum = 0 := by
    rw [← hYcell .inactiveSum (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc) (by intro hc; cases hc)]
    exact hYia
  -- batched cells in B0R1′
  have hYb : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y ∈ B0R1' (F := F) h.transport ch := by
    have e : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y =
        R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ) := by
      funext b
      rw [batRead_apply, batRead_apply]
      exact hYcell (.bat b) (by intro _ _ hc; cases hc) (by intro hc; cases hc)
    rw [e]
    refine Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨bat_L_mem_B0R1 h.transport B ch τ hcl hex hoo hop hLia, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    rw [batRead_apply]
    exact folded_unqueried_zero h.transport ch τ p hp
  -- the round part
  have hYchain : Y ∈ ChainEqs (Bat := R1Bat) ch := by
    rw [hY_def]
    exact (ChainEqs (Bat := R1Bat) ch).sub_mem ((ChainEqs (Bat := R1Bat) ch).sub_mem
      (cTilde_mem_chainEqs h B x w ch) (refPayload_mem_chainEqs x.1 B ch))
      (A_mem_chainEqs h.transport B ch _)
  have hYphi : Phi0 B ch Y = 0 := by
    rw [hY_def, map_sub, map_sub, Phi0_cTilde h B x w ch hP.halfOK,
      Phi0_refPayload x.1 B ch hP.halfOK, Phi0_A, sub_zero, sub_zero]
  have hYmask : claimMask B (alpha ch) Y = 0 := by
    simp only [claimMask, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      proj_apply, hYcl, hYex, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  have hY9 : (R0Z.Chain.roundPoly 9 Y).eval (alpha ch 9) = 0 := by
    have e : evalRound9 ch Y = Phi0 B ch Y + claimMask B (alpha ch) Y := by
      simp only [Phi0, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_add_cancel]
    rw [hYphi, hYmask, add_zero] at e
    rw [R0Z.Chain.roundPoly_nine]
    exact e
  have hτ4 : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro c r
    have htape : R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n) c r =
        R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (inrN n) c r -
          R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 c r := by
      rw [R0Z.JointTrace.actual_affine x.1 B (h.build w) ch (inrN n), Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply,
        add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [hτ_def]
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [htape]
    exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem (hu4 c r)
      ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
        (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) _ c r)
        (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r))
  have hk4 : kOf h B x w ch ∈ K4 B hB := by
    have ha : ∀ i, alpha ch i ∈ K4 B hB := R0Z.K4Values.alpha_mem _ ch hsem
    unfold kOf fOrig
    refine (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j c =>
      R0Z.K4Values.honestClaims_mem _ _ (fun c r => R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF
        (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r) _ ha j c) ha)) ?_
    exact (K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (ha 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB))
  have hYK4 : ∀ j i, Y (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro j i
    rw [hY, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, msCell_semanticCoeff, sub_zero]
    refine (K4 B hB).add_mem (L_round_mem _ h.transport B hi hu ch hsem τ hτ4 j i) ?_
    show R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u j i -
        R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch 0 j i -
        (kOf h B x w ch - k0 x.1 B ch) * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0)
      ∈ K4 B hB
    exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
      (R0Z.K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT u hu4 j i)
      (R0Z.K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT 0 (fun _ _ => (K4 B hB).zero_mem) j i))
      ((K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem hk4 (k0_mem B hB x.1 ch hsem hT))
        (R0Z.K4Values.dirCoeff_mem B hB j i))
  have hYT : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y ∈
      R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0K4 (Bat := R1Bat) B hB ch := by
    refine Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨?_, (R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_K4Round_iff B hB _).2 hYK4⟩
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem]
    exact roundProjection_mem_chainT0 ch Y hYchain hY9
  -- Step M
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := mask_lift_of h.transport B hB ch (B0R1' h.transport ch) hP.qprime
    (bat_ker_own_le_B0R1' h.transport B ch) hP.breach Y hYcl hYex hYoo hYop hYia hYiota hYT hYb
  refine ⟨inlM m + inrN n, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch) inlM m, hm, hY_def,
    sub_add_cancel]

#print axioms msCell_ne
#print axioms cTilde_sub_ref_mem_range_R1
end R1Z.RefCosetR1

R1Z.ClauseIR1.text:
import R1Z.PredicateR1
import R0Z.TerminalClosed

/-! Clause (i′) on R1 (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.6 b; LOG D30.3, D35):
under `P_R1`, the remainder `sRem` of every instance with the given public
statement is the payload of a mask tape.  Inputs: J2/J2-R1
(`sRem_mem_chain0K4`), J2b (`terminalClosed`), R1-3 (`chain0K4_le_silent_R1`,
which uses `BCondG_R1` through `bcond_of_G`).  This is the first half of
`MaskImageOn P_R1`; clause (ii′) is separate. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.ClauseIR1

open R0P R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
open R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Clause (i′) at one challenge. -/
theorem clause_i_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hF : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (ch : Challenges K) (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch) (w : h.Instance) (n : N K F)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1) :
    sRem (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch n ∈
      LinearMap.range ((A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch).comp inlM) := by
  have hK := R0Z.K4Values.sRem_mem_chain0K4 (Bat := R1Bat) h B hB x w ch n hP.2.1 (hF w hw)
    (R0Z.TerminalClosed.terminalClosed B hB x.1 ch hP.2.1 hpub) hP.1
  obtain ⟨m, _, hm⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (chain0K4_le_silent_R1 hP hK)
  exact ⟨m, hm⟩

/-- Clause (i′) in the form of the first conjunct of `MaskImageOn P_R1`. -/
theorem clause_i_R1_all (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hF : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w)) :
    ∀ ch, P_R1 h.transport B hB ch → ∀ w n, h.public w = x.1 →
      sRem (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch n ∈
        LinearMap.range ((A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch).comp inlM) :=
  fun ch hP w n hw => clause_i_R1 h B hB x hpub hF ch hP w n hw

#print axioms clause_i_R1
#print axioms clause_i_R1_all

end R1Z.ClauseIR1

end

R1Z.MaskImageVR1.text:
import R1Z.IIPrimeR1
import R1Z.ClauseIR1
import R0Z.HonestValidity
import R0Z.HvzkV

/-! J0c item 1 (LOG D40.3): `MaskImageOn P_R1` on the per-challenge valid sets.
`maskImageOnV_R1_valid` on `{w | HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch}`;
`maskImageOnV_R1` on the pole-free set `VR1` (the prover's attempt acceptance)
for builder-sound instances; `hvzk_R1V : HVZK_onV P_R1 h VR1`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.MaskImageVR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The per-challenge valid sets -/

/-- Validity at the challenge, for instances of the statement. -/
def VValid (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop :=
  fun ch w => h.public w = x.1 → R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch

/-- The prover's attempt acceptance beyond `P_R1`: no LogUp pole. -/
def VR1 (h : HonestProver K) : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop :=
  fun ch w => R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole (h.build w) (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)

theorem maskImageOnV_R1_valid (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hF : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w)) :
    MaskImageOnV (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VValid h B x) B x :=
  ⟨fun ch hP w n _ hw => R1Z.ClauseIR1.clause_i_R1_all h B hB x hpub hF ch hP w n hw,
    fun ch hP w w' hv hv' hw hw' => R1Z.IIPrimeR1.cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1 h B hB x hpub ch hP w w'
      (hF w hw) (hF w' hw') (hv hw) (hv' hw')⟩

theorem maskImageOnV_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) :
    MaskImageOnV (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B x :=
  maskImageOnV_mono _ h (VR1 h) (VValid h B x) B x
    (fun ch w _ hv hw => R0Z.HonestValidity.honestValid_of x.1 B (h.build w) ch (hs w hw) hv)
    (maskImageOnV_R1_valid h B hB x hpub (R0Z.HonestValidity.baseTyped_of h B x hs))

theorem hvzk_R1V (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) :
    HVZK_onV (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs x :=
  hvzk_on_of_V _ h _ B outputs x (maskImageOnV_R1 h B hB x hpub hs)

#print axioms VValid
#print axioms VR1
#print axioms maskImageOnV_R1_valid
#print axioms maskImageOnV_R1
#print axioms hvzk_R1V
end R1Z.MaskImageVR1

R1Z.SimulatorR1.text:
import R1Z.RefCosetR1
import R1Z.MaskImageVR1
import R1Z.PoleMassR1
import R1Z.ModelsVR1
import R0Z.HvzkS

/-! ZF2 (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §5.3): the R1 privacy theorem with the
explicit simulator `simE` in place of the choice simulator `simV`.

* `hvzk_R1S`: on `P_R1` and the pole-free valid set `VR1`, every honest view
  has the law of `simE h.transport B outputs x ch` (clause (i′), Claim Z,
  `equalLaws_simE_of`).
* `R1IdealModelS`: `R1IdealModelV` with the agreement field naming the games
  of the given simulator; `idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1` as in ModelsVR1.
* `privacy_R1_eff`: ZK_FS against `simE`, with the error terms of
  `privacy_R1`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.SimulatorR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS
  R0Z.RefPayload R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1
  R1Z.RefCosetR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- HVZK on `P_R1` and the pole-free valid set against the explicit simulator. -/
theorem hvzk_R1S (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) :
    HVZK_onS (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x) := by
  intro w ch hP hV hw
  have hF := R0Z.HonestValidity.baseTyped_of h B x hs
  have hval : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch :=
    R0Z.HonestValidity.honestValid_of x.1 B (h.build w) ch (hs w hw) hV
  exact equalLaws_simE_of h B outputs x w ch
    (fun n => R1Z.ClauseIR1.clause_i_R1_all h B hB x hpub hF ch hP w n hw)
    (cTilde_sub_ref_mem_range_R1 h B hB x hpub ch hP w (hF w hw) hval)

/-- `R1IdealModelV` (LOG D41, D42.2) for a given simulator. -/
def R1IdealModelS (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes),
      (∀ s, ¬ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s →
        middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim (cp.toM s) = idealTestS fs adv x sim (cp.toR s)) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin)

theorem idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (hm : R1IdealModelS P fs ab x M Umin sim) :
    IdealAbortCouplingS P fs ab x sim ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin) := by
  intro adv
  obtain ⟨cp, priv, addr, hag, hpair⟩ := hm adv
  refine ⟨cp, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr, hag, ?_⟩
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
  exact R0Z.FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair

/-- ZF2: ZK_FS for the retrying R1 prover against the explicit simulator
`simE`, error `ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog + N · 4096 / Q` (as `privacy_R1`). -/
theorem privacy_R1_eff (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (M Mi q Umin Q : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hr : R1RealModelV (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh)
    (hi : R1IdealModelS (P_R1 h.transport B hB) fs ab x Mi Umin (simE h.transport B outputs x))
    (hdraw : ∀ adv : fs.Adversary, Sem1Uniform (ab.draw adv x) Q) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs fs x (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin + ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) + (Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin +
        ab.N * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q)) :=
  zkfs_of_hvzk_onS_terms (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs fs x
    (simE h.transport B outputs x) (hvzk_R1S h B hB outputs x hpub hs) ab
    ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin) ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) ((Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin) ((4096 : ℚ) / Q)
    (realAbortCouplingV_of_R1 _ h _ B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh hU hr)
    (idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1 _ fs ab x Mi Umin hU _ hi)
    (fun adv w _ => (eventMass_mono _ _ (fun c hc => hc.2)).trans
      (pole_mass_le (ab.draw adv x) Q (hdraw adv) (h.build w)))

#print axioms hvzk_R1S
#print axioms R1IdealModelS
#print axioms idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1
#print axioms privacy_R1_eff
end R1Z.SimulatorR1

R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1.text:
import R1Z.SimulatorR1
import R1Z.GamesR1

/-! R1 games (zf1/DESIGN-R1-GAMES §6): `privacy_R1_eff` (LOG D44) instantiated
with the concrete R1 experiments `fsR1` and bridge `abR1`.  The ideal model
`R1IdealModelS … simE` is a theorem (`idealModelS_R1`, with no private
position, so the programming term is 0); the real model comes from
`realModel_R1`, whose remaining inputs are the `R1RealData` hypotheses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- `R1IdealModelS` for the R1 games and any simulator (in particular `simE`). -/
theorem idealModelS_R1 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (M Umin : ℕ) (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    R1IdealModelS P (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1 W N hN) x M Umin sim :=
  fun adv => idealModelS_body W Pr N hN P Vp x M Umin sim adv

/-- The R1 privacy theorem for the concrete games against the explicit
simulator `simE`: error `N(115+Mc)·q/2^255 + (N(115+Mc))²/2^255 + εexh +
N·4096/Q`; the ideal (programming) term is 0. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) (Mc Q : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      ∃ d : R1RealData W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x
          adv w Mc,
        d.Agree ∧ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass d.exh ≤ εexh)
    (hdraw : Sem1Uniform (drawW (K := K) W) Q) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1 W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q)) :=
  privacy_R1_eff h B hB outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
    hpub hs (abR1 W N hN) (N * (115 + Mc)) 0 W.qmax (2 ^ 255) Q εexh (by positivity)
    (realModel_R1 Mc εexh hd)
    (idealModelS_R1 W Pr N hN _ _ x 0 (2 ^ 255) (simE h.transport B outputs x))
    (fun _ => hdraw)

#print axioms idealModelS_R1
#print axioms privacy_R1_games
end R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1

R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1.text:
import R1Z.Sem1UniformR1
import R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1

/-! `privacy_R1_games` with its `Sem1Uniform` hypothesis discharged by
`sem1Uniform_drawW`: the `hdraw` premise is replaced by the wire facts
`SemRows01 W` and `QM31SamplerLaw`, and `Q = p⁴ − 1`.  The landed theorem is
unchanged; this is a new corollary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The R1 privacy theorem for the concrete games against `simE`, with the
sampler premise discharged: error `N(115+Mc)·q/2^255 + (N(115+Mc))²/2^255 +
εexh + N·4096/(p⁴ − 1)`. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games_sampler (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) (Mc : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      ∃ d : R1RealData W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x
          adv w Mc,
        d.Agree ∧ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass d.exh ≤ εexh)
    (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1 W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) :=
  privacy_R1_games W Pr N hN h B hB outputs x hpub hs Mc ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) εexh hd
    (sem1Uniform_drawW W D L)

#print axioms privacy_R1_games_sampler
end R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1

R1Z.SamplerLawIface.text:
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Defs

/-! Statement-only interface for the D47.2 sampler premise (DESIGN-BUILD-INTEGRATION §4 (c)).

The four fields of `R1Z.Sem1UniformR1.QM31SamplerLaw`, over the same carrier
`Fin 32 → UInt8` (= `R0Z.FsStatement.OracleAnswer`), with no typeclass on `K`.  The import
closure is Mathlib's `Equiv` only, so this module's object is the same on the privacy base and
on the spend-path base; a joint module on either base can produce a value of it, and
`Sem1UniformR1.QM31SamplerLaw` is obtained from it field by field. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.SamplerLawIface

/-- Rank the 32 bytes bijectively into `Fin 2^256`, reduce mod `p⁴`, embed injectively. -/
structure QM31SamplerLaw {K : Type} (s1 : (Fin 32 → UInt8) → K) where
  rank : (Fin 32 → UInt8) ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256)
  emb : Nat → K
  emb_inj : ∀ x y : Nat, x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → emb x = emb y → x = y
  sample : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4)

end R1Z.SamplerLawIface

#print axioms R1Z.SamplerLawIface.QM31SamplerLaw

R1Z.SamplerLawBridge.text:
import R1Z.Sem1UniformR1
import R1Z.SamplerLawIface

/-! The interface law (`R1Z.SamplerLawIface`, produced on the spend-path base by
`R1J.SamplerLawSpend.qm31SamplerLaw_spend`) is the D47.2 premise `QM31SamplerLaw` of
`Sem1UniformR1`, field by field.  Privacy base only; the composition with the spend-path
producer needs one base for both (DESIGN-BUILD-INTEGRATION §4 (f)). -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.SamplerLawBridge

open R1Z.Sem1UniformR1

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

def toSem1 {s1 : R0Z.FsStatement.OracleAnswer → K}
    (L : R1Z.SamplerLawIface.QM31SamplerLaw s1) : QM31SamplerLaw s1 where
  rank := L.rank
  emb := L.emb
  emb_inj := L.emb_inj
  sample := L.sample

end R1Z.SamplerLawBridge

#print axioms R1Z.SamplerLawBridge.toSem1

R1J.SamplerLawSpend.text:
import R1Z.SamplerLawIface
import ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect

/-! The D47.2 premise `QM31SamplerLaw` from the spend path's proved sampler facts
(DESIGN-BUILD-INTEGRATION §4 (c)).  Joint module: compiled on the spend-path sampler base
(pinned overlay qm31-index-sampler-correct-432-20261016, correct-c).

* carrier transport `arrEquiv : (Fin 32 → UInt8) ≃ Array U8 32#usize`, through the byte state
  `Fin 32 → Fin 256` and the spend path's `encodeState`/`decodeState` round trips;
* `s1Spend ι`: the extracted `qm31_sample` on the transported block, read through the current
  carrier `decode ∘ toCurrent` into `QM31Exact`, then through any injective `ι : QM31Exact → K`
  (the QM31 ↔ K transport);
* `rankE`: `SourceSamplerByteRank.rank ∘ arrEquiv` as an equivalence onto `Fin 2^256`;
* `qm31SamplerLaw_spend`: the interface law, from `ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total`,
  `SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value` and the digit canonicality, with no premise besides `ι`
  injective.  `SemRows01` (which decoder rows feed χ and λ) is a property of the wire, not of
  the sampler, and is not addressed here. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1J.SamplerLawSpend

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

abbrev Ans := Fin 32 → UInt8
abbrev QF := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.QM31Exact
abbrev MF := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.M31Exact
abbrev Pm : ℕ := AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P

/-! ## Carrier transport -/

def stateEquiv : Ans ≃ (Fin 32 → Fin 256) where
  toFun a := fun i => (a i).toFin
  invFun s := fun i => UInt8.ofFin (s i)
  left_inv a := by funext i; exact UInt8.ofFin_toFin (a i)
  right_inv s := by funext i; exact UInt8.toFin_ofFin (s i)

def stateArrEquiv : (Fin 32 → Fin 256) ≃ Array U8 32#usize where
  toFun := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeState
  invFun := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState
  left_inv := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.state_roundtrip
  right_inv := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.array_roundtrip

def arrEquiv : Ans ≃ Array U8 32#usize := stateEquiv.trans stateArrEquiv

theorem pow_eq : (256 : ℕ) ^ 32 = 2 ^ 256 := by norm_num

def rankE : Ans ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256) :=
  (stateEquiv.trans R0C.ModuloField.blockRank).trans (finCongr pow_eq)

theorem rankE_val (a : Ans) :
    (rankE a).val = AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank (arrEquiv a) := by
  show (R0C.ModuloField.blockRank (stateEquiv a)).val =
    (R0C.ModuloField.blockRank (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState
      (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeState (stateEquiv a)))).val
  rw [AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.state_roundtrip]

/-! ## The sampled value -/

/-- The actual extracted sampler on the transported block, through the current carrier. -/
def s1Spend {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (a : Ans) : K :=
  match AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_sample (arrEquiv a) with
  | .ok q => ι (AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q))
  | _ => ι 0

theorem s1Spend_ok {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (a : Ans) :
    ∃ q, AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_sample (arrEquiv a) = .ok q ∧
      s1Spend ι a = ι (AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
        (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q)) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, -⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total (arrEquiv a)
  exact ⟨q, hq, by simp only [s1Spend, hq]⟩

/-! ## Digits -/

/-- The four low base-`p` digits read into the exact tower, c0.a/c0.b/c1.a/c1.b order. -/
def digitsQ (x : ℕ) : QF :=
  ⟨⟨((x % Pm : ℕ) : MF), ((x / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF)⟩,
    ⟨((x / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF), ((x / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF)⟩⟩

def emb {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (x : ℕ) : K := ι (digitsQ x)

theorem lowDigits_mod (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ n x, AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n (x % p ^ n) =
      AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n x
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, x => by
    show x % p ^ (n + 1) % p :: AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n (x % p ^ (n + 1) / p) =
      x % p :: AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n (x / p)
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd x (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)), pow_succ',
      Nat.mod_mul_right_div_self, lowDigits_mod p n (x / p)]

theorem qm31Digits_mod (x : ℕ) :
    AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits (x % Pm ^ 4) = AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits x :=
  lowDigits_mod Pm 4 x

theorem qm31Digits_eq (x : ℕ) :
    AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits x =
      [x % Pm, x / Pm % Pm, x / Pm / Pm % Pm, x / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm] := rfl

theorem Pm_eq : Pm = 2147483647 := by norm_num [Pm, AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P]

theorem Pm_pos : 0 < Pm := by rw [Pm_eq]; norm_num

theorem cast_digit_inj {u v : ℕ} (hu : u < Pm) (hv : v < Pm)
    (h : ((u : ℕ) : MF) = ((v : ℕ) : MF)) : u = v := by
  have h' : u % 2147483647 = v % 2147483647 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' u v 2147483647).mp h
  rw [Pm_eq] at hu hv
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hu, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hv] at h'

theorem digitsQ_inj (x y : ℕ) (h : digitsQ x = digitsQ y) :
    AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits x = AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits y := by
  have h0 : ((x % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y % Pm : ℕ) : MF) := congrArg (fun q : QF => q.re.re) h
  have h1 : ((x / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) :=
    congrArg (fun q : QF => q.re.im) h
  have h2 : ((x / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) :=
    congrArg (fun q : QF => q.im.re) h
  have h3 : ((x / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) :=
    congrArg (fun q : QF => q.im.im) h
  rw [qm31Digits_eq, qm31Digits_eq,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h0,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h1,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h2,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h3]

theorem digitsQ_mod (x : ℕ) : digitsQ (x % Pm ^ 4) = digitsQ x := by
  have hm := qm31Digits_mod x
  rw [qm31Digits_eq, qm31Digits_eq] at hm
  simp only [List.cons.injEq] at hm
  obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2, e3, -⟩ := hm
  simp only [digitsQ, e0, e1, e2, e3]

theorem emb_inj {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (x y : ℕ)
    (hx : x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) (hy : y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) (h : emb ι x = emb ι y) :
    x = y := by
  have hd := digitsQ_inj x y (hι h)
  have hv := congrArg (AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P) hd
  rw [AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value, AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value] at hv
  have hP : AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P = 2 ^ 31 - 1 := rfl
  rw [hP] at hv
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hy] at hv

theorem decode_sample (q : AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.SamplerQM) (r : ℕ)
    (hv : AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.coordinates q =
      AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits r) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q) = digitsQ r := by
  rw [qm31Digits_eq] at hv
  simp only [AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.coordinates, List.cons.injEq] at hv
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := hv
  show (⟨⟨((q.c0.a.val : ℕ) : MF), ((q.c0.b.val : ℕ) : MF)⟩,
    ⟨((q.c1.a.val : ℕ) : MF), ((q.c1.b.val : ℕ) : MF)⟩⟩ : QF) = digitsQ r
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
  rfl

theorem sample {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (a : Ans) :
    s1Spend ι a = emb ι ((rankE a).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hv⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total (arrEquiv a)
  have hs : s1Spend ι a = ι (AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q)) := by simp only [s1Spend, hq]
  have hP : (2 ^ 31 - 1 : ℕ) = Pm := rfl
  rw [hs, decode_sample q _ hv, emb, hP, digitsQ_mod, rankE_val]

/-- The D47.2 sampler law, from the spend path's sampler theorems. -/
def qm31SamplerLaw_spend {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι) :
    R1Z.SamplerLawIface.QM31SamplerLaw (s1Spend ι) where
  rank := rankE
  emb := emb ι
  emb_inj := emb_inj ι hι
  sample := sample ι

end R1J.SamplerLawSpend

#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.arrEquiv
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.rankE_val
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend_ok
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.lowDigits_mod
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.digitsQ_inj
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.digitsQ_mod
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.decode_sample
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.emb_inj
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.sample
#print axioms R1J.SamplerLawSpend.qm31SamplerLaw_spend

import R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1
import R1Z.SamplerLawBridge
import R1J.SamplerLawSpend

/-! (c) end to end on the unified base (LOG D65 follow-up): the `QM31SamplerLaw` premise of
`privacy_R1_games_sampler` discharged in one closure by the spend path's extracted sampler,
`R1J.SamplerLawSpend.qm31SamplerLaw_spend` → `R1Z.SamplerLawBridge.toSem1`.

What remains a premise: `SemRows01 W` (the wire decoder reads χ = sem 1 from row 1 through
`s1`, and λ = sem 0 not from row 1), here with its `s1` fixed to `s1Spend ι` for an injective
`ι : QM31Exact → K` (the QM31 ↔ K carrier map), and the hypotheses of `privacy_R1_games`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1 R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The sampler law for the wire's row-1 map, when that map is the spend path's extracted
`qm31_sample` read through an injective carrier map. -/
def samplerLaw_of_spend (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι) : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1 := by
  rw [hD]
  exact R1Z.SamplerLawBridge.toSem1 (R1J.SamplerLawSpend.qm31SamplerLaw_spend ι hι)

/-- `privacy_R1_games_sampler` with `QM31SamplerLaw` discharged by the extracted sampler. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games_spendSampler (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) (Mc : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      ∃ d : R1RealData W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x
          adv w Mc,
        d.Agree ∧ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass d.exh ≤ εexh)
    (D : SemRows01 W) (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1 W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) :=
  privacy_R1_games_sampler W Pr N hN h B hB outputs x hpub hs Mc εexh hd D
    (samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι hD)

end R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend

#print axioms R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend
#print axioms R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.privacy_R1_games_spendSampler
