import QueryScanModelFailure

/-! Ordered, stable dedup and block/word recurrence correspondence for the
retained Q22 model. Source-library and extraction correspondence are separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel
open AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan

 theorem keep_prefix (xs : List Nat) (x : Nat) : xs <+: keep xs x := by
  by_cases h : x ∈ xs
  · simp [keep, h]
  · exact ⟨[x], by simp [keep, h]⟩

 theorem fold_keep_prefix (xs ys : List Nat) : xs <+: ys.foldl keep xs := by
  induction ys generalizing xs with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp [scan]⟩
  | cons y ys ih => exact (keep_prefix xs y).trans (ih (keep xs y))

 /-- The accepted output is a prefix of stable first-occurrence deduplication.
 It is never sorted or reordered by the Q22 recurrence. -/
 theorem scan_order_prefix (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat) :
    (scan s xs).1.accepted <+: xs.foldl keep s.accepted := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp [scan]⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simp only [scan, if_pos hs, List.foldl_cons]
      exact (keep_prefix _ _).trans (fold_keep_prefix _ _)
    · simpa only [scan, if_neg hs, List.foldl_cons] using
        ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩

 theorem keep_nodup (xs : List Nat) (x : Nat) (h : xs.Nodup) :
    (keep xs x).Nodup := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
  · simpa [keep, hx] using h
  · simpa [keep, hx] using h.concat hx

 theorem scan_nodup (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat) (h : s.accepted.Nodup) :
    (scan s xs).1.accepted.Nodup := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simpa only [scan, if_pos hs] using h
    · simpa only [scan, if_neg hs] using
        ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩ (keep_nodup _ _ h)

 theorem scan_stop_state (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat)
    (hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64) : (scan s xs).1 = s := by
  cases xs <;> simp [scan, hs]

 theorem scan_append_state (s : ScanState) (xs ys : List Nat) :
    (scan s (xs ++ ys)).1 = (scan (scan s xs).1 ys).1 := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simp only [List.cons_append, scan, if_pos hs]
      exact (scan_stop_state s ys hs).symm
    · simpa only [List.cons_append, scan, if_neg hs] using
        ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩

 theorem scan_true_stopped (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat)
    (h : (scan s xs).2 = true) :
    (scan s xs).1.accepted.length = 22 ∨ (scan s xs).1.draws = 64 := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [scan] at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simpa only [scan, if_pos hs] using hs
    · simp only [scan, if_neg hs] at h ⊢
      exact ih _ h

 /-- Number of consumed blocks. The stop test is inside scan, before a word,
 so a completed eighth word is detected in the following nonempty block. -/
 def blockRun (s : ScanState) : List (List Nat) → ScanState × Nat
  | [] => (s, 0)
  | b :: bs =>
    let r := scan s b
    if r.2 then (r.1, 1)
    else let tail := blockRun r.1 bs; (tail.1, tail.2+1)

 theorem blocks_flatten (s : ScanState) (bs : List (List Nat)) :
    (blockRun s bs).1 = (scan s bs.flatten).1 := by
  induction bs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [blockRun, List.flatten_cons]
    by_cases hs : (scan s b).2 = true
    · simp only [hs, if_true]
      rw [scan_append_state]
      exact (scan_stop_state _ _ (scan_true_stopped s b hs)).symm
    · simp only [hs, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      rw [ih, scan_append_state]

 theorem block_count_le (s : ScanState) (bs : List (List Nat)) :
    (blockRun s bs).2 ≤ bs.length := by
  induction bs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [blockRun]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [blockRun]
    split
    · simp
    · have h := ih (scan s b).1
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega

 /-- Successful finish exposes exactly 22 distinct indices in stable scan order. -/
 theorem successful_output (s : ScanState) (xs out : List Nat)
    (hn : s.accepted.Nodup) (h : finish (scan s xs).1 = .ok out) :
    out.length = 22 ∧ out.Nodup ∧ out <+: xs.foldl keep s.accepted := by
  unfold finish at h
  split at h
  · have he : (scan s xs).1.accepted = out := Except.ok.inj h
    exact ⟨he ▸ ‹_›, he ▸ scan_nodup s xs hn, he ▸ scan_order_prefix s xs⟩
  · cases h

/-- The successful array order corresponds to the first 22 stable distinct
values of the candidate-word stream, including partial final blocks. -/
 theorem successful_first22 (s : ScanState) (xs out : List Nat)
    (hn : s.accepted.Nodup) (h : finish (scan s xs).1 = .ok out) :
    out = (xs.foldl keep s.accepted).take 22 := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, _, tail, htail⟩ := successful_output s xs out hn h
  rw [← htail]
  exact (List.take_left' hlen).symm

 theorem block_failure_smallRange {N : Nat} (w : Fin 64 → Fin N)
    (bs : List (List Nat)) (hwords : bs.flatten = QueryScanModelFailure.words w)
    (count : Nat)
    (hfail : finish (blockRun QueryScanModelFailure.initial bs).1 = .error count) :
    QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21 := by
  apply QueryScanModelFailure.failure_smallRange w
  unfold QueryScanModelFailure.fails
  rw [blocks_flatten, hwords] at hfail
  intro he
  simp only [finish, he, if_true] at hfail
  cases hfail

#print axioms keep_prefix
#print axioms fold_keep_prefix
#print axioms scan_order_prefix
#print axioms keep_nodup
#print axioms scan_nodup
#print axioms scan_stop_state
#print axioms scan_append_state
#print axioms scan_true_stopped
#print axioms blocks_flatten
#print axioms block_count_le
#print axioms successful_output
#print axioms successful_first22
#print axioms block_failure_smallRange
end AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel

R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin
import R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend
import R1Z.PhaseCircleBlocksBin
import QueryScanOrderedModel

/-! Concrete block samplers and retained word-parser/first-22 policy.
The scan tests completion before the next word, as Q22WordScan actually does;
completion on a block's eighth word can therefore consume the next block.
These are Lean-model identities. Rust execution/history correspondence remains
a separate source join, including the rejected/exhausted outcome. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin
  R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact

def state (b : OracleAnswer) : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State :=
  R1J.SamplerLawSpend.stateEquiv b

def scalar (b : OracleAnswer) : K :=
  R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend
    (algebraMap R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF K) b

/-- The small block-circle adapter keeps concrete tower typeclass reduction
out of the combined sampler/ROM import closure. -/
abbrev circle := PhaseCircleBlocksBin.select

def openingScalar (i : Fin 4) (b : OracleAnswer) : K :=
  if i = 0 then (R0C.ModuloField.gammaNZ (state b)).val
  else R0C.ModuloField.ordinary (state b)

/-- Eight little-endian words, masked to 18 bits, in their source order. -/
def blockWords (b : OracleAnswer) : List ℕ := AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words 18 (state b)

def parsedWords (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) : List ℕ :=
  ((List.ofFn q).take (k.val + 1)).flatMap blockWords

theorem parsed_observed (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    parsedWords (observed q k) k = parsedWords q k := by
  unfold parsedWords
  apply congrArg (fun blocks : List OracleAnswer => blocks.flatMap blockWords)
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_take, List.length_ofFn]
  · intro n hn hn'
    have hn0 := hn
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_ofFn] at hn0
    simp only [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_ofFn]
    unfold observed
    exact if_pos (by change n ≤ k.val; omega)

theorem parsedWords_bounded (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ parsedWords q k) : n < 262144 := by
  obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hn
  exact AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words_bounded 18 (state b) n hb

def scanned (k : Fin 8) (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : ScanState × Bool :=
  scan AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q k)

def done (k : Fin 8) (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Prop := (scanned k q).2 = true

def fibre (n : ℕ) : Fib := ⟨n % 262144, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

def decoded (k : Fin 8) (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset Fib :=
  ((scanned k q).1.accepted.map fibre).toFinset

def querySet (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset Fib := queries done decoded q

def decode (s : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (_rho : OracleAnswer) : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K where
  sem := fun i => scalar (s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)
  circle := fun i => circle i (s ⟨25+i.val, by omega⟩)
  opening := fun i => openingScalar i (o i)
  queries := querySet q

theorem decode_local : DecodeLocal decode where
  sem := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar he
  circle := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i he => congrArg (circle i) he
  opening := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i he => congrArg (openingScalar i) he
  queries := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

theorem gamma_nonzero (b : OracleAnswer) : openingScalar 0 b ≠ 0 :=
  (R0C.ModuloField.gammaNZ (state b)).property

theorem blockWords_length (b : OracleAnswer) : (blockWords b).length = 8 :=
  AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words_length 18 (state b)

theorem blockWords_bounded (b : OracleAnswer) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ blockWords b) :
    n < 262144 := AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words_bounded 18 (state b) n hn

/-- A successful prefix gives exactly the source model's first 22 distinct
words, in stable order; no sorting of the accepted list is introduced. -/
theorem parsed_first22 (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) (out : List ℕ)
    (he : finish (scanned k q).1 = .ok out) :
    out = ((parsedWords q k).foldl keep []).take 22 :=
  AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel.successful_first22
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q k) out (by simp [AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial]) he

theorem decoded_success (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) (out : List ℕ)
    (he : finish (scanned k q).1 = .ok out) :
    decoded k q = (out.map fibre).toFinset := by
  unfold finish at he
  split at he
  · have hs := Except.ok.inj he
    unfold decoded
    rw [hs]
  · cases he

theorem query_success (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (out : List ℕ)
    (he : finish (scanned (stop done q) q).1 = .ok out) :
    querySet q = (out.map fibre).toFinset ∧
      out = ((parsedWords q (stop done q)).foldl keep []).take 22 := by
  have hp : scanned (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q)) = scanned (stop done q) q := by
    unfold scanned
    rw [parsed_observed]
  constructor
  · exact decoded_success (observed q (stop done q)) (stop done q) out (by rw [hp]; exact he)
  · exact parsed_first22 q (stop done q) out he

theorem no_earlier_completion (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8)
    (hk : k < stop done q) : ¬ done k (observed q k) := by
  intro hd
  have hl := stop_le done q k (by
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Or.inl hd⟩)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hl) hk

theorem query_prefix (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' (stop done q)) :
    stop done q = stop done q' ∧ querySet q = querySet q' :=
  ⟨stop_local done q q' he, queries_local done decoded q q' he⟩

/-- The eighth block is the explicit fallback endpoint even if readiness
never occurs. Failure remains visible in finish; it is not a successful Q22. -/
theorem exhausted_endpoint (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (he : ∀ k, ¬ done k (observed q k)) : stop done q = 7 := by
  have hm := stop_mem done q
  have hd : done (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q)) ∨ stop done q = 7 :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
  exact hd.resolve_left (he _)

def wireData {CommitHandle Aux : Type} (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux := { base with dec := decode, kstarOf := stop done }

def rows01 {CommitHandle Aux : Type} (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    R1Z.Sem1UniformR1.SemRows01 (wireData base) where
  s1 := scalar
  sem1 := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
  sem0 := fun _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar (he 0 (by decide))

theorem rows01_source {CommitHandle Aux : Type} (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    (rows01 base).s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend (algebraMap R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF K) := rfl

#print axioms parsedWords_bounded
#print axioms no_earlier_completion
#print axioms parsed_observed
#print axioms query_success
#print axioms decode_local
#print axioms gamma_nonzero
#print axioms blockWords_length
#print axioms blockWords_bounded
#print axioms parsed_first22
#print axioms decoded_success
#print axioms query_prefix
#print axioms exhausted_endpoint
#print axioms rows01
#print axioms rows01_source
end R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin

R1Z.RomFiniteBin.text:
import R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! A classical finite byte-string ROM. No concrete address space or table
is enumerated by the kernel. The address bound is a model parameter. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.RomFiniteBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- All strings of at most `bound` bytes, via finite vectors. -/
def domain (bound : ℕ) : Finset (List UInt8) :=
  Finset.univ.image (fun p : (Σ n : Fin (bound + 1), Fin n.val → UInt8) => List.ofFn p.2)

theorem mem_domain (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) :
    bs ∈ domain bound ↔ bs.length ≤ bound := by
  constructor
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨⟨n, v⟩, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using Nat.le_of_lt_succ n.isLt
  · intro hb
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨⟨bs.length, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hb⟩, bs.get⟩,
      Finset.mem_univ _, List.ofFn_get bs⟩

abbrev Address (bound : ℕ) := {bs : List UInt8 // bs ∈ domain bound}

instance address_nonempty (bound : ℕ) : Nonempty (Address bound) :=
  ⟨⟨[], (mem_domain bound []).mpr (Nat.zero_le _)⟩⟩

def decode (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Address bound) :=
  if hb : bs ∈ domain bound then some ⟨bs, hb⟩ else none

theorem decode_encode (bound : ℕ) (a : Address bound) : decode bound a.val = some a := by
  simp only [decode, dif_pos a.property]

theorem encode_decode (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) (a : Address bound)
    (ha : decode bound bs = some a) : a.val = bs := by
  unfold decode at ha
  split at ha
  · cases Option.some.inj ha
    rfl
  · contradiction

theorem decode_isSome (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) :
    (decode bound bs).isSome ↔ bs.length ≤ bound := by
  by_cases hb : bs ∈ domain bound
  · simp only [decode, dif_pos hb, Option.isSome_some, Bool.true_eq, true_iff]
    exact (mem_domain bound bs).mp hb
  · simp only [decode, dif_neg hb, Option.isSome_none, Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    exact fun hl => hb ((mem_domain bound bs).mpr hl)

def lookup (bound : ℕ) (tab : Address bound → OracleAnswer) (bs : List UInt8) : OracleAnswer :=
  match decode bound bs with
  | some a => tab a
  | none => 0

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K]

/-- Choose the table model and the claimed adversary class. All protocol
encodings/decoders are retained from `base`; its old table and cap are unused. -/
def wire (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  { base with
    Tab := Address bound → OracleAnswer
    finTab := inferInstance
    neTab := inferInstance
    look := lookup bound
    qmax := 2^64 }

variable [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

def rom (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) : RomModel (wire base bound) where
  A := Address bound
  finA := inferInstance
  deqA := inferInstance
  neA := inferInstance
  dec := decode bound
  enc := Subtype.val
  dec_enc := decode_encode bound
  enc_of_dec := encode_decode bound
  eTab := Equiv.refl _
  look_eq := by
    intro tab bs
    change lookup bound tab bs = _
    unfold lookup
    cases decode bound bs <;> rfl

theorem lookup_law (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (tab : (wire base bound).Tab) (a : Address bound) :
    (wire base bound).look tab a.val = tab a := by
  change lookup bound tab a.val = tab a
  unfold lookup
  rw [decode_encode]

theorem adversary_budget (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) :
    (wire base bound).qmax ≤ 2^64 := Nat.le_refl _

/-- Uniform tables are transported by the full table equivalence. -/
theorem table_uniform (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) :
    MP (rom base bound).eTab := mp_equiv _

#print axioms mem_domain
#print axioms decode_encode
#print axioms encode_decode
#print axioms decode_isSome
#print axioms rom
#print axioms lookup_law
#print axioms adversary_budget
#print axioms table_uniform
end R1Z.RomFiniteBin

R1Z.RomObserverBin.text:
import R1Z.RomFiniteBin

/-! The classical observer map keeps the entire decision function. Only
its adaptive query program is supplied by the source operational handoff. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.RomObserverBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.RomFiniteBin R1Z.LazyFrozen
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- No bound on the size of the table is computed by reduction. The existing
frozen lazy programming law applies to the concrete finite byte carrier. -/
theorem lazy_table_uniform (bound : ℕ) (frozen : Finset (Address bound)) {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → (Address bound → OracleAnswer) → Address bound)
    (causal : CausalF frozen a) (f : (Address bound → OracleAnswer) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : (Address bound → OracleAnswer) × (Fin m → OracleAnswer) =>
      f (progF frozen a p.1 p.2)) = mean f := mean_progF frozen a causal f

/-- The cap counts query calls, including repeats, on every branch. -/
theorem runLog_length (program : OProg) (oracle : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (fuel : ℕ) :
    (runLog program oracle fuel).length ≤ fuel := by
  induction fuel generalizing program with
  | zero => cases program <;> simp only [runLog, List.length_nil, Nat.le_refl]
  | succ n ih =>
      cases program with
      | done => simp only [runLog, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_le]
      | query a k =>
          simpa only [runLog, List.length_cons] using Nat.succ_le_succ (ih (k (oracle a)))

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}

def observerMap (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    (program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg) (adv : source.Adversary) :
    R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux :=
  ⟨program adv, source.observe adv⟩

theorem observer_preserved (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    (program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg) (adv : source.Adversary)
    (rv : ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    (observerMap source program adv).decide rv = source.observe adv rv := rfl

theorem capped_queries (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (program : OProg) (tab : (wire base bound).Tab) :
    (runLog program ((wire base bound).look tab) (wire base bound).qmax).length ≤ 2^64 :=
  runLog_length program _ _

variable [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

theorem model_observer_preserved (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base bound)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (P : Challenges K → Prop) (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    (program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg) (adv : source.Adversary)
    (rv : ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    (fsR1P (wire base bound) Pr N hN P Vp).observe (observerMap source program adv) rv =
      source.observe adv rv := rfl

#print axioms lazy_table_uniform
#print axioms runLog_length
#print axioms observer_preserved
#print axioms capped_queries
#print axioms model_observer_preserved
end R1Z.RomObserverBin

R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
import R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
import R1Z.RomObserverBin

/-! A legal shared-ROM query-state self-loop. Re-reading a known address
is deterministic even though the unconditioned table is uniform. The scan
argument is symbolic in its words, prefix length and scan state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LensR1
  R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
  R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Query read addresses are exactly the existing transcript grammar. -/
def squeezeAddress (s : OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 := ans s ++ [1]
def advanceAddress (s : OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 := ans s ++ [2]

def queryState (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer) : ℕ → OracleAnswer
  | 0 => s
  | n+1 => H (advanceAddress (queryState H s n))

def queryBlocks (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer) : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer :=
  fun k => H (squeezeAddress (queryState H s k.val))

theorem queryState_self_loop (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer)
    (loop : H (advanceAddress s) = s) (n : ℕ) : queryState H s n = s := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa only [queryState, ih] using loop

theorem queryBlocks_self_loop (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer)
    (loop : H (advanceAddress s) = s) : queryBlocks H s = fun _ => H (squeezeAddress s) := by
  funext k
  unfold queryBlocks
  rw [queryState_self_loop H s loop]

/-- Both addresses use the retained model grammar, including its LE bytes;
there is no invented query-counter domain separation in this example. -/
theorem transcript_query_addresses (rest : R1Z.TranscriptR1.Rest)
    (s : OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    R1Z.TranscriptR1.addrWith (.qb k) s rest = squeezeAddress s ∧
    R1Z.TranscriptR1.addrWith (.qa k) s rest = advanceAddress s := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The zero-answer history is actually reachable in the in-order evaluator
for every address program. This induction never unfolds the read count. -/
theorem zero_oracle_runN {A : Type} {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → A) (n : ℕ) :
    R1Z.LazyFrozen.runN a (fun _ => 0) 0 n = fun _ => 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [R1Z.LazyFrozen.runN_succ, ih]
      split
      · funext i
        simp only [Function.update_apply]
        split <;> rfl
      · rfl

theorem zero_oracle_runC {A : Type} {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → A) :
    R1Z.LazyFrozen.runC a (fun _ => 0) 0 = fun _ => 0 := zero_oracle_runN a m

theorem zero_table_lookup (bound : ℕ) :
    R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (fun _ => 0) = fun _ => 0 := by
  funext bs
  unfold R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup
  cases R1Z.RomFiniteBin.decode bound bs <;> rfl

/-- The exhibited zero-answer history is reachable in the finite ROM used
by the endpoint, for its actual bound and any prover address program. -/
theorem finite_rom_zero_history (bound : ℕ) {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8) :
    R1Z.LazyFrozen.runC a (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (fun _ => 0)) 0 = fun _ => 0 := by
  rw [zero_table_lookup]
  exact zero_oracle_runC a

/-- Scanning never invents a candidate. This induction also covers the stop
branches and the empty-list branch without reducing a 64-word recurrence. -/
theorem scan_alphabet (alphabet : Finset ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) (s : ScanState)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s.accepted, x ∈ alphabet) (hx : ∀ x ∈ xs, x ∈ alphabet) :
    ∀ x ∈ (scan s xs).1.accepted, x ∈ alphabet := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons x xs ih =>
      by_cases stop : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
      · simpa only [scan, if_pos stop] using hs
      · simp only [scan, if_neg stop]
        apply ih
        · intro y hy
          rcases (AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.keep_mem _ _ _).mp hy with hy | rfl
          · exact hs y hy
          · exact hx y (List.mem_cons_self)
        · intro y hy
          exact hx y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)

theorem repeated_block_scan_bound (b : OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1.accepted.length ≤ 8 := by
  let alphabet := (blockWords b).toFinset
  have hm : ∀ x ∈ parsedWords (fun _ => b) k, x ∈ alphabet := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨bb, hbb, hxb⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hx
    have hbb' : bb ∈ List.ofFn (fun _ : Fin 8 => b) := List.mem_of_mem_take hbb
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hbb'
    have he : bb = b := hj.symm
    rw [he] at hxb
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hxb
  have hs := scan_alphabet alphabet (parsedWords (fun _ => b) k)
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (by simp [AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial]) hm
  have hsub : (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1.accepted.toFinset ⊆ alphabet := by
    intro x hx
    exact hs x (List.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
  have hn := AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel.scan_nodup
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords (fun _ => b) k)
    (by simp [AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial])
  calc _ = (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1.accepted.toFinset.card :=
          (List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn).symm
       _ ≤ alphabet.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
       _ ≤ (blockWords b).length := List.toFinset_card_le _
       _ = 8 := blockWords_length b

theorem repeated_block_finish_fails (b : OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    ∃ count, finish (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1 = .error count := by
  have h := repeated_block_scan_bound b k
  exact ⟨_, finish_error_count _ (by omega)⟩

/-- Failure at the constructed parser's own selected first-stop endpoint,
not at a separately chosen or enumerated block index. -/
theorem shared_loop_finish_fails (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer)
    (loop : H (advanceAddress s) = s) :
    ∃ count, finish (scanned (stop done (queryBlocks H s)) (queryBlocks H s)).1 = .error count := by
  rw [queryBlocks_self_loop H s loop]
  exact repeated_block_finish_fails _ _

/-- With the release-sized domain, both self-loop read addresses are valid;
the example does not rely on the lookup fallback outside the finite ROM. -/
theorem loop_addresses_in_domain (bound : ℕ) (hbound : 33 ≤ bound) (s : OracleAnswer) :
    squeezeAddress s ∈ R1Z.RomFiniteBin.domain bound ∧
    advanceAddress s ∈ R1Z.RomFiniteBin.domain bound := by
  constructor <;> apply (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.mem_domain _ _).mpr <;>
    simpa only [squeezeAddress, advanceAddress, List.length_append, length_ans,
      List.length_singleton] using hbound

/-- This history is inhabited in the existing finite byte-string ROM. The
only condition is a previously seen advance answer, not a source assumption. -/
abbrev LoopHistory (bound : ℕ) :=
  {tab : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer //
    R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab (advanceAddress 0) = 0}

instance loopHistory_nonempty (bound : ℕ) : Nonempty (LoopHistory bound) := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun _ => 0, ?_⟩⟩
  unfold R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup
  cases R1Z.RomFiniteBin.decode bound (advanceAddress 0) <;> rfl

/-- Conditioning on this retained advance answer leaves mass-one failure.
The claim holds for every bound, including the release ROM bound. -/
theorem reached_shared_history_failure_mass (bound : ℕ) :
    eventMass (fun tab : LoopHistory bound =>
      ∃ count, finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0)).1 = .error count) = 1 := by
  have hh : ∀ tab : LoopHistory bound,
      ∃ count, finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0)).1 = .error count :=
    fun tab => shared_loop_finish_fails _ _ tab.property
  unfold eventMass
  simp only [hh, if_true]
  exact mean_const 1

theorem reached_shared_history_not_bounded (bound : ℕ) :
    ¬ eventMass (fun tab : LoopHistory bound =>
      ∃ count, finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0)).1 = .error count) ≤ scanProbability := by
  rw [reached_shared_history_failure_mass]
  exact not_le_of_gt scanProbability_lt_one

#print axioms queryState_self_loop
#print axioms queryBlocks_self_loop

R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
import R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
import AspisV8R19.R406SamplerWordDistribution

/-! Symbolic law for independent block coins. Reached-history restrictions
are subevents, not conditioning on already revealed future query answers.
This is not a claim that repeated shared-ROM answers are fresh coins. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
  AspisV8R19.R406SamplerWordDistribution
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Word := Fin (2^18)

def block (b : OracleAnswer) : Fin 8 → Word := (splitBlockEquiv (state b)).2

theorem block_le_words (b : OracleAnswer) :
    blockWords b = List.ofFn (fun j => (block b j).val) := words_value (state b)

theorem block_uniform : MP block := by
  intro f
  have h := mp_equiv (R1J.SamplerLawSpend.stateEquiv.trans splitBlockEquiv)
    (fun p => f p.2)
  have h2 := mp_snd (X := Fin 8 → Fin (2^14)) (Y := Fin 8 → Word) f
  exact h.trans h2

def flatten : (Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Word) ≃ (Fin 64 → Word) where
  toFun q i := q ((finProdFinEquiv (m := 8) (n := 8)).symm i).1 ((finProdFinEquiv (m := 8) (n := 8)).symm i).2
  invFun w k j := w (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))
  left_inv q := by funext k j; simp
  right_inv w := by funext i; simp

def words64 (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Fin 64 → Word := flatten (fun k => block (q k))

theorem words64_uniform : MP words64 := by
  intro f
  exact (mp_pi block_uniform 8 (fun q => f (flatten q))).trans (mp_equiv flatten f)

theorem smallRange_mass :
    eventMass (fun w : Fin 64 → Word => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21) =
      scanProbability := by
  have hc {A : Type} [Fintype A] (E : A → Prop) :
      (Fintype.card {a // E a} : ℚ) = ∑ a : A, if E a then (1 : ℚ) else 0 := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.sum_boole]
  have hd : (Fintype.card (Fin 64 → Word) : ℚ) = ((2^18 : ℕ) : ℚ)^64 := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow]
  exact congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℚ => a / b)
    (hc (A := Fin 64 → Word) (fun w => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21)).symm hd

/-- A history-dependent reachability condition may only reduce the mass of
failure on independent coins. No independence of the reachability event is
needed, and the statement is intentionally not a conditional probability. -/
theorem reached_failure_le (reached : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop) :
    eventMass (fun q => reached q ∧ AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 q)) ≤
      scanProbability := by
  apply (eventMass_mono _ (fun q => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange (words64 q) 21)
    (fun q h => AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.failure_smallRange _ h.2)).trans
  have hu := words64_uniform
    (fun w => if AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21 then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  exact hu.le.trans smallRange_mass.le

/-- Eight attempt coordinates are enough, with no concrete enumeration of
blocks, word arrays or histories. -/
theorem eight_reached_failures_le
    (reached : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop) (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (fun q : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → OracleAnswer =>
      reached i q ∧ AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 (q i))) ≤ scanProbability := by
  apply (eventMass_mono _ (fun q => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange (words64 (q i)) 21)
    (fun q h => AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.failure_smallRange _ h.2)).trans
  have he := mean_eval i
    (fun q => if AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange (words64 q) 21 then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hu := words64_uniform
    (fun w => if AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21 then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  exact he.le.trans (hu.le.trans smallRange_mass.le)

#print axioms block_le_words
#print axioms block_uniform
#print axioms words64_uniform
#print axioms smallRange_mass
#print axioms reached_failure_le
#print axioms eight_reached_failures_le
end R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory

R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory

/-! Connect the independent-word event to the constructed parser's actual
first-stop failure. No scan recurrence or word universe is enumerated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin
  R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem parsed_length (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    (parsedWords q k).length = 8 * (k.val + 1) := by
  have hlen (bs : List OracleAnswer) : (bs.flatMap blockWords).length = 8 * bs.length := by
    induction bs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b bs ih => simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, blockWords_length,
        ih, List.length_cons]; omega
  unfold parsedWords
  rw [hlen, List.length_take, List.length_ofFn, Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)]

theorem parsed_full_words64 (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) :
    parsedWords q 7 = AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.words (words64 q) := by
  unfold parsedWords AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.words
  rw [show (7 : Fin 8).val + 1 = 8 from rfl,
    List.take_of_length_le (by rw [List.length_ofFn])]
  rw [List.ofFn_mul' (m := 8) (n := 8)]
  have he (bs : List OracleAnswer) : bs.flatMap blockWords = (bs.map blockWords).flatten := by
    induction bs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b bs ih =>
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons]
        exact congrArg (fun t => blockWords b ++ t) ih
  rw [he, List.map_ofFn]
  apply congrArg List.flatten
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext k
  change blockWords (q k) = List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 8 =>
    (words64 q ⟨8*k.val+j.val, by omega⟩).val)
  rw [block_le_words]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext j
  have hi : (⟨8*k.val+j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 64) = finProdFinEquiv (k,j) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change 8*k.val+j.val = j.val+8*k.val
    omega
  simp only [hi, words64, flatten, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- Read-count bound valid on stopped and non-stopped branches alike. -/
theorem scan_draws_le (s : ScanState) (xs : List ℕ) :
    (scan s xs).1.draws ≤ s.draws + xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp only [scan, List.length_nil, Nat.add_zero, le_refl]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
      · simp only [scan, if_pos hs, List.length_cons]; omega
      · simp only [scan, if_neg hs, List.length_cons]
        have hh := ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩
        dsimp only at hh
        omega

theorem selected_failure_at_last (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (count : ℕ)
    (hf : finish (scanned (stop done q) q).1 = .error count) : stop done q = 7 := by
  have hn : (scanned (stop done q) q).1.accepted.length ≠ 22 := by
    intro hh
    simp only [finish, hh, if_true] at hf
    cases hf
  have hm := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (stop_mem done q)).2
  rcases hm with hd | he
  · have heq : scanned (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q)) = scanned (stop done q) q := by
      unfold scanned
      rw [parsed_observed]
    change (scanned (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q))).2 = true at hd
    rw [heq] at hd
    have hst := AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel.scan_true_stopped
      AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q (stop done q)) hd
    rcases hst with hlen | hdraw
    · exact False.elim (hn hlen)
    · change (scanned (stop done q) q).1.draws = 64 at hdraw
      have hh := scan_draws_le AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q (stop done q))
      rw [parsed_length] at hh
      change (scanned (stop done q) q).1.draws ≤ 0 + 8 * ((stop done q).val+1) at hh
      have hk := (stop done q).isLt
      apply Fin.ext
      change (stop done q).val = 7
      omega
  · exact he

theorem selected_failure_implies_words_failure (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (count : ℕ)
    (hf : finish (scanned (stop done q) q).1 = .error count) :
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 q) := by
  rw [selected_failure_at_last q count hf] at hf
  unfold AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails
  rw [← parsed_full_words64]
  intro hlen
  simp only [scanned, finish, hlen, if_true] at hf
  cases hf

#print axioms parsed_length
#print axioms parsed_full_words64
#print axioms scan_draws_le
#print axioms selected_failure_at_last
#print axioms selected_failure_implies_words_failure
end R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory

R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

/-! Dependency facts for the existing honest-view preparation and R1 folded
coefficient map. These are actual model functions, not replacement messages.
The byte encoder/leaf selection correspondence remains a source obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.TranscriptR1

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

theorem prepare_local (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch ch' : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K)
    (hl : ch.sem 0 = ch'.sem 0) (hc : ch.sem 1 = ch'.sem 1) :
    prepare pub t ch = prepare pub t ch' := by
  funext c r
  change (if c.val = 26 then helper pub t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) r else t c r) =
    (if c.val = 26 then helper pub t (ch'.sem 0) (ch'.sem 1) r else t c r)
  rw [hl, hc]

/-- Source C1 column selection: 0..25 and 28 (host_commitment.rs). -/
def c1Column (c : Fin 27) : Fin 29 :=
  if h : c.val < 26 then ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ else 28

theorem c1Column_not_helper (c : Fin 27) : (c1Column c).val ≠ 26 := by
  unfold c1Column
  split <;> simp_all <;> omega

/-- All 27 source C1 columns, including the mask columns, do not use even
lambda/chi. The helper column 26 belongs to C2. -/
theorem c1_challenge_free (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (τ : Tape K F) (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (c : Fin 27) :
    applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) ch) τ.1
        (c1Column c) =
      applyAff B (applyEligible t τ.2) τ.1 (c1Column c) := by
  funext r
  simp only [applyAff, prepare, if_neg (c1Column_not_helper c)]

/-- The entire prepared/masked trace depends on rows 0 and 1 only. -/
theorem prepared_at_c2 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (B : PackBasis F) (τ : Tape K F)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (he : SqAgree 33 tr tr') :
    applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr)) τ.1 =
      applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr')) τ.1 := by
  congr 1
  apply prepare_local
  · exact hd.sem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 (he (.sqS 0) trivial (by decide))
  · exact hd.sem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 1 (he (.sqS 1) trivial (by decide))

/-- The coefficient fold q1 uses gamma and alpha0, never alpha1 or queries. -/
theorem q1_local (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (ha : ch.opening 2 = ch'.opening 2) :
    q1 π ch = q1 π ch' := by
  simp only [q1, batchR1, hg, ha]

/-- The existing folded map on the existing prepared trace is available
after row 29, even if all subsequent answers differ. -/
theorem folded_at_29 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (τ : Tape K F) (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer)
    (he : SqAgree 137 tr tr') :
    q1 π (chOf W tr) (applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr)) τ.1) =
      q1 π (chOf W tr') (applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr')) τ.1) := by
  have hp := prepared_at_c2 W hd pub t B τ tr tr'
    (fun j hj hlt => he j hj (lt_trans hlt (by decide)))
  have hq : q1 π (chOf W tr) = q1 π (chOf W tr') := by
    apply q1_local
    · exact hd.opening _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 (he (.sqO 0) trivial (by decide))
    · exact hd.opening _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 2 (he (.sqO 2) trivial (by decide))
  rw [hp, hq]

#print axioms prepare_local
#print axioms c1Column_not_helper
#print axioms c1_challenge_free
#print axioms prepared_at_c2
#print axioms q1_local
#print axioms folded_at_29
end R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin

R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
  R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

def CoordBefore (c : Coord) (cut : ℕ) : Prop :=
  match c with
  | .root => 25 < cut
  | .sel => ∀ k : Fin 8, transcriptStage (.qa k) < cut
  | .ans j => transcriptStage j < cut

theorem chain_before (j : TRead) : CoordBefore (fc j) (transcriptStage j) := by
  cases j with
  | init => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | absS i =>
    rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
    | succ i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> split <;> omega
  | sqS i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | advS i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | reseed => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | absO i =>
    rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
    | succ i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> split <;> omega
  | sqO i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | advO i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | absQ => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | qb k =>
    rcases k with ⟨k, hk⟩
    cases k <;> simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage] <;> omega
  | qa k =>
    rcases k with ⟨k, hk⟩
    cases k <;> simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage] <;> omega
  | absR => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; intro k; have := k.isLt; omega
  | sqR => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | advR => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]

theorem transcript_after_tape (j : TRead) : 5 < transcriptStage j := by
  cases j <;> simp only [transcriptStage] <;> (try split) <;> omega

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
  {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux}
  {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
  (P : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W)

abbrev Vectors := Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂ → OracleAnswer

def StageAgree (p : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, stage q < stage p → v q = v' q

theorem tape_eq (p : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P)
    (he : StageAgree W P p v v') (hp : 5 < stage p) :
    tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v = tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v' := by
  have h₁ : e₁Of v = e₁Of v' := funext (fun c => he _ hp)
  have h₂ : e₂Of v = e₂Of v' := funext (fun c => he _ hp)
  simp only [tapeR, R1PhaseProver.toProver, h₁, h₂]

theorem transcript_causal (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (j : TRead) (v v' : Vectors W P) (he : StageAgree W P (.inl j) v v') :
    attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v (.inl j) =
      attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' (.inl j) := by
  have ht := tape_eq W P (.inl j) v v' he (transcript_after_tape j)
  have hs : SqAgree (transcriptStage j) (trOf v) (trOf v') :=
    fun q _ hq => he (.inl q) hq
  have hc : fieldVal (fc j) (recP W.toWire x
      (view h B outputs x w (chOf W.toWire (trOf v)) (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v))
      (trOf v) (rootsOf v)) =
      fieldVal (fc j) (recP W.toWire x
      (view h B outputs x w (chOf W.toWire (trOf v')) (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v'))
      (trOf v') (rootsOf v')) := by
    have hb := chain_before j
    cases hf : fc j with
    | root => exact he (.inr (.inl 0)) (by simpa [hf, CoordBefore, stage, treeBase] using hb)
    | ans q => exact he (.inl q) (by simpa only [hf, CoordBefore, stage] using hb)
    | sel =>
      have hb : ∀ k : Fin 8, transcriptStage (.qa k) < transcriptStage j := by
        simpa [hf, CoordBefore] using hb
      have hq : (fun k => trOf v (.qb k)) = (fun k => trOf v' (.qb k)) := by
        funext k
        apply he (.inl (.qb k))
        have hk := k.isLt
        change 160 + 2 * k.val < transcriptStage j
        have hb' : 161 + 2 * k.val < transcriptStage j := by
          simpa [hf, CoordBefore, transcriptStage] using hb k
        omega
      change trOf v (.qa (W.toWire.kstarOf (fun k => trOf v (.qb k)))) =
        trOf v' (.qa (W.toWire.kstarOf (fun k => trOf v' (.qb k))))
      rw [hq]
      apply he (.inl _)
      simpa only [hf, CoordBefore, stage] using hb (W.toWire.kstarOf (fun k => trOf v' (.qb k)))
  change addrWith j _ _ = addrWith j _ _
  rw [hc]
  cases j with
  | absS i =>
    have hm := W.frame_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v')
      (rootsOf v 1) (rootsOf v' 1) i hs (by
        intro hi; apply he (.inr (.inl 1)); simp [stage, treeBase, transcriptStage, hi])
    simpa only [addrWith, recP, ht] using congrArg
      (fun m => R1Z.LensR1.ans (fieldVal (fc (.absS i)) (recP W.toWire x
        (view h B outputs x w (chOf W.toWire (trOf v')) (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v'))
        (trOf v') (rootsOf v'))) ++ ([0, 0xa0 + i.val.toUInt8] ++ m)) hm
  | absO i =>
    have hm := W.payload_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v')
      (rootsOf v 2) (rootsOf v' 2) i hs (by
        intro hi; apply he (.inr (.inl 2)); simp [stage, treeBase, transcriptStage, hi])
    simp only [addrWith, recP, ht, hm]
  | absQ =>
    have hm := W.final_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v') hs
    simp only [addrWith, recP, ht, hm]
  | _ => rfl

#print axioms chain_before
#print axioms transcript_after_tape
#print axioms tape_eq
#print axioms transcript_causal
end R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin

R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
  R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.PremisesR1PBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
  {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux}
  {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
  (P : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W)

theorem commitment_causal (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (c : CPos P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P)
    (he : StageAgree W P (.inr c) v v') :
    attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v (.inr c) =
      attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' (.inr c) := by
  have hr (q : RIdx) (hq : restStage q < stage (.inr c)) : restOf v q = restOf v' q :=
    he (.inr (.inr (.inr q))) hq
  change gram _ _ _ sec d (restOf v) c = gram _ _ _ sec d (restOf v') c
  rcases c with T | (b | b) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · have hj (j : Fin 2) := hr (rootChild T j) (root_children T j)
    simp only [gram, nodeBytes, hj]
  · have hs := hr (qSeed 0) (by simp [restStage, qSeed, stage])
    simp only [gram, hs]
  · have hs := hr (qSeed 2) (by simp [restStage, qSeed, stage])
    simp only [gram, hs]
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [gram, hb, if_pos]
    · have h0 : b.val = 1 := by have := b.isLt; omega
      have hs := hr (qBind 0) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, h0])
      simp only [gram, hb, if_false, hs]
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 0
    · have hs := hr (qBind 0) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, hi])
      simp only [gram, hi, if_true, hs]
    · by_cases hi1 : i.val = 1
      · have hs := hr (qBind 0) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, hi1])
        simp only [gram, hi, hi1, if_false, if_true, hs]
      · have hi2 : i.val = 2 := by have := i.isLt; omega
        have h0 := hr (qBind 1) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, hi2])
        have h1 := hr (qSeed 1) (by simp [qSeed, restStage, stage, hi2])
        simp only [gram, hi, hi1, if_false, h0, h1]
  · have hs := hr (qBind 1) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage])
    simp only [gram, hs]
  · have ht : 5 < stage (.inr (.inr (.inr (qLeaf T u))) : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) := by
      simp [stage, qLeaf, restStage, treeBase]
    have htape := tape_eq W P _ v v' he ht
    have hs := hr (qSalt T u) (by
      change 6 < treeBase T + 6
      simp [treeBase]; split <;> (try split) <;> omega)
    have hl := P.leaf_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v') T u
      (fun j _ hj => he (.inl j) hj)
    simp only [gram, htape, hl, hs, R1PhaseProver.toProver]
  · have hj (j : Fin 2) := hr (childQ T n j) (PhaseScheduleBin.child_before_parent T n j)
    simp only [gram, nodeBytes, hj]

/-- Every phase-refined instance is causal at every answer vector. The only
assumptions are the explicit message/leaf dependency contracts; chronology
and commitment bytes are constructed by toProver. -/
theorem phase_causal (w : h.Instance) : RCausal W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w := by
  apply (causal_iff W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w).mpr
  intro sec d p v v' he
  have hs : StageAgree W P p v v' := fun q hq => he q (stage_before q p hq)
  cases p with
  | inl j => exact transcript_causal W P w sec d j v v' hs
  | inr c => exact commitment_causal W P w sec d c v v' hs

/-- The exact D80 endpoint premise for the constructed prover, without an
execution-order hypothesis. Identifying the shipped encoding with W/P is
a separate, currently unconstructed source certificate. -/
theorem R_causal_D80 (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (p : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P)
    (he : Earlier W.toWire P.toProver p v v') :
    attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v p =
      attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' p :=
  (causal_iff W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w).mp (phase_causal W P w) sec d p v v' he

#print axioms commitment_causal
#print axioms phase_causal
#print axioms R_causal_D80
end R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin

R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin
import R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin

/-! Constructed leaf functions from the existing masked trace and q1 map.
Encoders are parameters because the privacy tree has no sourced field-to-byte
encoder. Source equality for these parameters is not asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.TranscriptR1
  R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

structure LeafEncoding (K : Type) where
  c1 : (Fin 27 → Fin 1024 → K) → Fib → List UInt8
  c2 : (Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → K) → Fib → List UInt8
  folded : (Fin 256 → K) → Fib → List UInt8

def leafVal (enc : LeafEncoding K) (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K)
    (w : h.Instance) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  if T.val = 0 then
    enc.c1 (fun c => applyAff B (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) τ.1 (c1Column c)) u
  else if T.val = 1 then
    enc.c2 (fun c => applyAff B (prepare x.1 (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) ch) τ.1
      ⟨26 + c.val, by omega⟩) u
  else
    enc.folded (q1 h.transport ch
      (applyAff B (prepare x.1 (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) ch) τ.1)) u

theorem leaf_local (enc : LeafEncoding K) (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K)
    (w : h.Instance) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F)
    (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib)
    (he : SqAgree (treeBase T + 6) tr tr') :
    leafVal enc B h w x τ (chOf W tr) T u = leafVal enc B h w x τ (chOf W tr') T u := by
  unfold leafVal
  by_cases h0 : T.val = 0
  · simp only [h0, if_true]
  · by_cases h1 : T.val = 1
    · have hp := prepared_at_c2 W hd x.1 (h.build w) B τ tr tr'
        (by simpa [treeBase, h0, h1] using he)
      simp only [h0, h1, if_false, if_true, hp]
    · have hf := folded_at_29 W hd h.transport x.1 (h.build w) B τ tr tr'
        (by simpa [treeBase, h0, h1] using he)
      simp only [h0, h1, if_false, hf]

/-- Retain tape decoding and opening data; construct the leaves, commitment
grammar and order. Message-locality evidence is still required in W. -/
def prover (enc : LeafEncoding K) {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
    {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K → Aux}
    {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
    (data : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire) : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W where
  data := { data with leafVal := leafVal enc B }
  leaf_local := fun w τ tr tr' T u he =>
    leaf_local enc B h w x τ W.toWire W.decode_local tr tr' T u he

theorem constructed_causal (enc : LeafEncoding K) {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
    {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K → Aux}
    {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
    (data : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire) (w : h.Instance) :
    R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.RCausal W.toWire (prover enc W data).toProver h B outputs x w :=
  phase_causal W (prover enc W data) w

#print axioms leafVal
#print axioms leaf_local
#print axioms prover
#print axioms constructed_causal
end R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin

R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin

/-! Symbolic message-prefix facts about the existing honest-view model.
No Boolean-tail sum, interpolation table or coefficient universe is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.HonestView R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.Batched
  R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

def SemPrefix (n : ℕ) (ch ch' : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 25, i.val < n → ch.sem i = ch'.sem i

theorem roundPoint_prefix (ch ch' : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10)
    (he : SemPrefix (15 + j.val) ch ch') (z : K) (tail : Fin (9-j.val) → Bool) :
    roundPoint ch j z tail = roundPoint ch' j z tail := by
  funext i
  unfold roundPoint
  split
  · exact he _ (by dsimp [alpha]; omega)
  · rfl

theorem zc_prefix (ch ch' : Challenges K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 13 ≤ n)
    (he : SemPrefix n ch ch') : zc ch = zc ch' := by
  funext i
  exact he ⟨3 + i.val, by omega⟩ (by dsimp; omega)

/-- Actual semantic coefficient cells use only the preceding semantic rows. -/
theorem semanticCoeff_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28)
    (he : SemPrefix (15 + j.val) ch ch') :
    run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r (.semanticCoeff j i) =
      run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch' r (.semanticCoeff j i) := by
  have h0 := he 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := he 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := he 2 (by omega)
  have h13 := he 13 (by omega)
  have h14 := he 14 (by omega)
  have hz := zc_prefix ch ch' (15 + j.val) (by omega) he
  have hp : ∀ z tail, roundPoint ch j z tail = roundPoint ch' j z tail :=
    roundPoint_prefix ch ch' j he
  simp only [run, prepare_local pub t ch ch' h0 h1, hp, h0, h1, h2, h13, h14, hz]

/-- The same prefix fact for the semantic polynomial, before coefficient reads. -/
theorem roundPoly_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10)
    (he : SemPrefix (15 + j.val) ch ch') :
    roundPoly π pub B t ch j r = roundPoly π pub B t ch' j r := by
  rw [roundPoly_apply, roundPoly_apply]
  have hz := zc_prefix ch ch' (15 + j.val) (by omega) he
  simp only [roundPoint_prefix ch ch' j he, he 0 (by omega), he 1 (by omega),
    he 2 (by omega), he 13 (by omega), he 14 (by omega), hz]

theorem batch_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) : batchR1 π ch = batchR1 π ch' := by
  simp only [batchR1, hg]

theorem weights_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (hk : ch.opening 1 = ch'.opening 1) : weightsR1 π ch = weightsR1 π ch' := by
  have ha : R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch = R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch' := by
    unfold R0Z.HonestView.alpha
    rw [hs]
  unfold weightsR1 ell
  rw [hk, ha, hc]

theorem round0_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (hk : ch.opening 1 = ch'.opening 1) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (.round0 i : R1Bat) =
      BatchedLayer.read π ch' t (.round0 i : R1Bat) := by
  rw [read_round0, read_round0, batch_prefix π ch ch' hg, weights_prefix π ch ch' hs hc hk]

theorem round1_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (hk : ch.opening 1 = ch'.opening 1)
    (ha : ch.opening 2 = ch'.opening 2) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (.round1 i : R1Bat) =
      BatchedLayer.read π ch' t (.round1 i : R1Bat) := by
  rw [read_round1, read_round1, q1_local π ch ch' hg ha]
  have hw : w1 π ch = w1 π ch' := by
    unfold w1
    rw [ha, weights_prefix π ch ch' hs hc hk]
  rw [hw]

/-- The final word needs neither kappa, the circle answers, nor queries. -/
theorem final_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 64)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (ha : ch.opening 2 = ch'.opening 2)
    (hb : ch.opening 3 = ch'.opening 3) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (.final i : R1Bat) =
      BatchedLayer.read π ch' t (.final i : R1Bat) := by
  rw [read_final, read_final, q1_local π ch ch' hg ha, hb]

#print axioms roundPoint_prefix
#print axioms zc_prefix
#print axioms semanticCoeff_prefix
#print axioms roundPoly_prefix
#print axioms batch_prefix
#print axioms weights_prefix
#print axioms round0_prefix
#print axioms round1_prefix
#print axioms final_prefix
end R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin

R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin
import R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin
import R1RecordFrameCodec
import R1FoldedLeafCodec

/-! Logical protocol messages selected from the existing honest view. The
field codec is explicit; `wideBytes` specializes it to the existing exact-wide
codec. Auxiliary metadata is never passed to a field encoder. This constructs
a protocol model; identity with an arbitrary R1Wire base is not asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.HonestView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.FsStatement
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
  R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

def wideBytes (x : AspisWideTower.WideExact) : List UInt8 :=
  (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeWide x).map UInt8.ofFin

def encoded (enc : K → List UInt8) {n : ℕ} (values : Fin n → K) : List UInt8 :=
  AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.encode enc values

/-- Existing tagged length framing, transported between the two byte carriers. -/
def framed (tag : UInt8) (payload : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  (AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec.frame tag.toFin (payload.map UInt8.toFin)).map UInt8.ofFin

def semantic (enc : K → List UInt8) (p : Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27) : List UInt8 :=
  if i.val = 2 then R1Z.LensR1.ans root
  else if i.val = 14 then enc (p .maskSum)
  else if hi : 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then
    encoded enc (fun c : Fin 28 => p (.semanticCoeff ⟨i.val-15, by omega⟩ c))
  else if i.val = 25 then
    (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 3 => encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.pointClaim j c)))).flatten ++
      encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.extraClaim c))
  else if i.val = 26 then encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.ood 0 c))
  else []

def frame (enc : K → List UInt8) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27) : List UInt8 :=
  framed (WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticTag i) (semantic enc v.2 root i)

def opening (enc : K → List UInt8) (p : Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4) : List UInt8 :=
  if i.val = 0 then encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.ood 1 c))
  else if i.val = 1 then enc (p .inactiveSum)
  else if i.val = 2 then encoded enc (fun c : Fin 7 => p (.bat (.round0 c)))
  else R1Z.LensR1.ans root ++ encoded enc (fun c : Fin 7 => p (.bat (.round1 c)))

def payload (enc : K → List UInt8) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4) : List UInt8 := opening enc v.2 root i

def final (enc : K → List UInt8) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) : List UInt8 :=
  encoded enc (fun c : Fin 64 => v.2 (.bat (.final c)))

/-- The entire encoded transcript is independent of arbitrary auxiliary output. -/
theorem auxiliary_irrelevant (enc : K → List UInt8)
    (m m' : ZkStatement.Meta K CommitHandle Aux) (p : Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) :
    frame enc (m,p) root = frame enc (m',p) root ∧
    payload enc (m,p) root = payload enc (m',p) root ∧
    final enc (m,p) = final enc (m',p) := ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem prepared_prefix (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (r : AffTape K F) (ch ch' : Challenges K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (he : SemPrefix n ch ch') :
    applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r = applyAff B (prepare pub t ch') r := by
  rw [prepare_local pub t ch ch' (he 0 (by omega)) (he 1 (by omega))]

theorem alpha_prefix (ch ch' : Challenges K) (he : SemPrefix 25 ch ch') :
    R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch = R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch' := by
  funext i
  exact he ⟨15+i.val, by omega⟩ (by dsimp; omega)

attribute [local irreducible] encoded framed

theorem semantic_prefix (enc : K → List UInt8) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27)
    (he : SemPrefix i.val ch ch') (hr : i.val = 2 → root = root')
    (hc : i.val = 26 → ch.circle 0 = ch'.circle 0) :
    semantic enc (run π pub B t ch r) root i =
      semantic enc (run π pub B t ch' r) root' i := by
  unfold semantic
  split
  · rw [hr (by assumption)]
  · split
    · have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' i.val (by omega) he
      simp only [run, hp]
    · split
      · apply congrArg (encoded enc)
        funext c
        apply semanticCoeff_prefix
        intro j hj
        apply he
        dsimp at hj ⊢
        omega
      · split
        · have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' i.val (by omega) he
          have ha := alpha_prefix ch ch' (by simpa only [‹i.val = 25›] using he)
          simp only [run, hp, ha]
        · split
          · have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' i.val (by omega) he
            simp only [run, hp, hc (by assumption)]
          · rfl

theorem opening_prefix (enc : K → List UInt8) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4)
    (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (ho : ∀ j : Fin 4, j.val < i.val → ch.opening j = ch'.opening j)
    (hr : i.val = 3 → root = root') :
    opening enc (run π pub B t ch r) root i =
      opening enc (run π pub B t ch' r) root' i := by
  have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' 25 (by omega) (fun _ _ => congrFun hs _)
  unfold opening
  split
  · simp only [run, hp, hc]
  · split
    · simp only [run, hp, ho 0 (by omega)]
    · split
      · apply congrArg (encoded enc)
        funext c
        simp only [run, hp]
        apply round0_prefix π ch ch' _ c hs hc (ho 0 (by omega)) (ho 1 (by omega))
      · rw [hr (by omega)]
        apply congrArg (fun bs => R1Z.LensR1.ans root' ++ bs)
        apply congrArg (encoded enc)
        funext c
        simp only [run, hp]
        apply round1_prefix π ch ch' _ c hs hc
          (ho 0 (by omega)) (ho 1 (by omega)) (ho 2 (by omega))

theorem final_prefix (enc : K → List UInt8) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (hs : SemPrefix 2 ch ch')
    (ho : ∀ j : Fin 4, ch.opening j = ch'.opening j) :
    encoded enc (fun c : Fin 64 => run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r (.bat (.final c))) =
      encoded enc (fun c : Fin 64 => run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch' r (.bat (.final c))) := by
  have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' 2 (by omega) hs
  apply congrArg (encoded enc)
  funext c
  simp only [run, hp]
  exact PhaseMessageDependenciesBin.final_prefix π ch ch' _ c (ho 0) (ho 2) (ho 3)

/-- Locality of semantic challenge values, directly from preceding squeezes. -/
theorem semantic_before (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27)
    (he : SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absS i)) tr tr') :
    SemPrefix i.val (chOf W tr) (chOf W tr') := by
  intro j hj
  apply hd.sem
  apply he (.sqS ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
  simp only [transcriptStage]
  split <;> split <;> omega

theorem frame_local (enc : K → List UInt8) (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec) (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (τ : JointView.Tape K F)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27)
    (he : SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absS i)) tr tr') (hr : i.val = 2 → root = root') :
    frame enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr) τ) root i =
      frame enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr') τ) root' i := by
  unfold frame
  apply congrArg (framed (WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticTag i))
  apply semantic_prefix enc h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) τ.1
    (chOf W tr) (chOf W tr') root root' i (semantic_before W hd tr tr' i he) hr
  intro hi
  apply hd.circle
  apply he (.sqS 25) trivial
  simp only [transcriptStage, hi]
  decide

/-- Install the actual message selectors in a wire's other data. -/
def wireData (enc : K → List UInt8) (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  { base with frame := frame enc, payload := payload enc, final := final enc }

theorem payload_local (enc : K → List UInt8) (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec) (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (τ : JointView.Tape K F)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4)
    (he : SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absO i)) tr tr') (hr : i.val = 3 → root = root') :
    payload enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr) τ) root i =
      payload enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr') τ) root' i := by
  apply opening_prefix enc h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) τ.1
    (chOf W tr) (chOf W tr') root root' i
  · funext j
    apply hd.sem
    apply he (.sqS ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> split <;> omega
  · funext j
    apply hd.circle
    apply he (.sqS ⟨25+j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> split <;> omega
  · intro j hj
    apply hd.opening
    apply he (.sqO j) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> split <;> omega
  · exact hr

theorem final_local (enc : K → List UInt8) (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec) (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (τ : JointView.Tape K F)

    apply he (.sqS ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> omega
  · intro j
    apply hd.opening
    apply he (.sqO j) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> omega

    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x where

  payload_local := payload_local enc base hd h B outputs x
  final_local := final_local enc base hd h B outputs x
