import R0P.Poseidon
import R0P.EmptyRoots

/-! A Lean model of the honest pair-forest builder (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §3).

The model follows the Rust stages (design §1):
* Stage B: 57 Poseidon blocks.  A block is its pre-absorption state and its
  absorption (`BlockIn`); local rows 1..11 are the canonical two-round
  transitions `poseidonTransition` (R0P), row 12 is the absorption, rows
  13..15 are zero (write_permutation / write_sponge, pair_trace.rs:268-354).
* Stage A: the forest path aux rows (pair_forest_trace.rs:142-159, rows
  912..1007), the value aux rows 1008..1016/1020/1022 and the occupancy rows
  1017/1018 (pair_trace.rs:401-468, relocated +48 by pair_forest_trace.rs:225).
* Stage M: the bank merge is the placement of blocks 34..53 (rows 544..863).
* Stage W: `cellsOf pub w` computes every block and aux record from a
  Wspend-shaped witness `ModelWitness` and the public input.
Columns 16..28 are zero (mask-only C1 and the extension columns are not read
by NonCopyHolds or CopyLinkBalance).

The witness relation is NOT fixed here; per-family theorems take named
premises (BuilderModelAux, BuilderModelHash). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### Stage B: Poseidon blocks -/

/-- One permutation block: local row 0 and local row 12. -/
structure BlockIn (K : Type) where
  pre : Fin 16 → K
  absorb : Fin 16 → K

/-- Local rows 0..11 of a block: row 0 is the pre-state, row n+1 is the
canonical transition of row n with the absorption (R0P Poseidon.lean:315). -/
def blockIter (b : BlockIn K) : Nat → Fin 16 → K
  | 0 => b.pre
  | n + 1 => if h : n < 11 then poseidonTransition ⟨n, h⟩ (blockIter b n) b.absorb
      else blockIter b n

/-- The final state (local row 11). -/
def blockOut (b : BlockIn K) : Fin 16 → K := blockIter b 11

/-- The returned digest: the first eight lanes of the final state. -/
def blockDigest (b : BlockIn K) : Digest K := fun i => blockOut b (i.castAdd 8)

/-- The cell of a block at local row `l`, lane `c`. -/
def blockCell (b : BlockIn K) (l : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if l < 12 then blockIter b l c else if l = 12 then b.absorb c else 0

/-- A digest in lanes 0..7, zero in lanes 8..15. -/
def lo8 (d : Digest K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l => if h : l.val < 8 then d ⟨l.val, h⟩ else 0

/-- hash_fields_with_trace (poseidon2.rs:511-529): state[8] = domain,
state[9] = input length, everything else zero. -/
def spongeInit (dom len : K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l =>
  if l.val = 8 then dom else if l.val = 9 then len else 0

/-- write_node (pair_trace.rs:356-366): pre = [0^8, right, right[7] + tweak],
absorption = left. -/
def nodeIn (left right : Digest K) : BlockIn K :=
  ⟨fun l => if l.val < 8 then 0 else if l.val = 15 then right 7 + (0x4153_1005 : K)
      else right ⟨l.val - 8, by have := l.isLt; omega⟩, lo8 left⟩

/-- pair_trace.rs:368-375. -/
def ordered (cur sib : Digest K) (bit : Bool) : Digest K × Digest K :=
  if bit then (sib, cur) else (cur, sib)

/-- The 0/1 direction cell. -/
def dirK (b : Bool) : K := if b then 1 else 0

/-! ### Stage A: auxiliary records and their cells -/

structure PathAux (K : Type) where
  bit : K
  current : Digest K
  left : Digest K
  right : Digest K

structure OccAux (K : Type) where
  occupied : K
  inverse : K
  commitment : Digest K
  selected : K

/-- The builder's cell content before placement. -/
structure Cells (K : Type) where
  blocks : Fin 57 → BlockIn K
  path : Fin 24 → PathAux K
  values : Fin 3 → Nat
  inOcc : OccAux K
  outOcc : OccAux K

/-- Bit `i` of `n` as a field cell.  `bitK_eq_shift` is the Rust form
`M31((raw >> bit) & 1)` (pair_trace.rs:404-412). -/
def bitK (n i : Nat) : K := ((n / 2 ^ i % 2 : Nat) : K)

/-- Value base row (1008 + 2j): bits 0..9 of v, raw v in column 10. -/
def valueBaseCell (v : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val < 10 then bitK v c.val else if c.val = 10 then (v : K) else 0

/-- Value successor row (1009 + 2j): bits 10..19. -/
def valueMidCell (v : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val < 10 then bitK (v / 1024) c.val else 0

/-- Value xor-12 row (1020, 1022, 1016): bits 20..29. -/
def valueHiCell (v : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val < 10 then bitK (v / 1048576) c.val else 0

/-- write_occupancy (pair_trace.rs:439-468). -/
def occCell (o : OccAux K) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val = 0 then o.occupied else if c.val = 1 then o.inverse
  else if h : c.val < 10 then o.commitment ⟨c.val - 2, by omega⟩
  else if c.val = 10 then o.selected else 0

/-- write_forest_path_aux base row (pair_forest_trace.rs:152-154). -/
def pathBaseCell (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val = 0 then p.bit else if h : c.val < 9 then p.current ⟨c.val - 1, by omega⟩ else 0

/-- write_forest_path_aux successor row (pair_forest_trace.rs:155-156). -/
def pathSuccCell (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if h : c.val < 8 then p.left ⟨c.val, h⟩ else p.right ⟨c.val - 8, by have := c.isLt; omega⟩

/-- Rows 912..1023 (blocks 57..63). -/
def auxCell (C : Cells K) (r : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if h : 912 ≤ r ∧ r < 1008 then
    if r % 16 % 4 = 1 then
      pathBaseCell (C.path ⟨4 * ((r - 912) / 16) + r % 16 / 4, by omega⟩) c
    else if r % 16 % 4 = 2 then
      pathSuccCell (C.path ⟨4 * ((r - 912) / 16) + r % 16 / 4, by omega⟩) c
    else 0
  else if r = 1008 then valueBaseCell (C.values 0) c
  else if r = 1009 then valueMidCell (C.values 0) c
  else if r = 1010 then valueBaseCell (C.values 1) c
  else if r = 1011 then valueMidCell (C.values 1) c
  else if r = 1012 then valueBaseCell (C.values 2) c
  else if r = 1013 then valueMidCell (C.values 2) c
  else if r = 1014 then
    (if c.val = 0 then (C.values 0 : K) else if c.val = 1 then (C.values 1 : K)
      else if c.val = 2 then (C.values 0 : K) - (C.values 1 : K) else 0)
  else if r = 1015 then
    (if c.val = 0 then (C.values 0 : K) - (C.values 1 : K)
      else if c.val = 1 then (C.values 2 : K) else 0)
  else if r = 1016 then valueHiCell (C.values 2) c
  else if r = 1017 then occCell C.inOcc c
  else if r = 1018 then occCell C.outOcc c
  else if r = 1020 then valueHiCell (C.values 0) c
  else if r = 1022 then valueHiCell (C.values 1) c
  else 0

/-! ### Placement (stages B, A, M) -/

/-- The 29-column trace: blocks 0..56 in rows 0..911, aux rows above,
columns 16..28 zero. -/
def layout (C : Cells K) : Trace K := fun c r =>
  if hc : c.val < 16 then
    if hb : r.val / 16 < 57 then blockCell (C.blocks ⟨r.val / 16, hb⟩) (r.val % 16) ⟨c.val, hc⟩
    else auxCell C r.val ⟨c.val, hc⟩
  else 0

theorem layout_aux (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) (hc : c.val < 16)
    (hr : 57 ≤ r.val / 16) : layout C c r = auxCell C r.val ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
  unfold layout
  rw [dif_pos hc, dif_neg (by omega)]

theorem layout_block (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) (hc : c.val < 16)
    (h : Fin 57) (hr : r.val / 16 = h.val) :
    layout C c r = blockCell (C.blocks h) (r.val % 16) ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
  have h57 := h.isLt
  unfold layout
  rw [dif_pos hc, dif_pos (by omega)]
  have he : (⟨r.val / 16, by omega⟩ : Fin 57) = h := Fin.ext hr
  rw [he]

theorem layout_high (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) (hc : 16 ≤ c.val) :
    layout C c r = 0 := by
  unfold layout
  rw [dif_neg (by omega)]

/-- Openings of a row whose row, successor and xor-12 rows are all aux rows. -/
theorem rowOpenings_aux (C : Cells K) (b : Fin 1024) (hb : 57 ≤ b.val / 16)
    (hs : 57 ≤ (succRow b).val / 16) (hx : 57 ≤ (xor12Row b).val / 16) :
    rowOpenings (layout C) b =
      ⟨auxCell C b.val, auxCell C (succRow b).val, auxCell C (xor12Row b).val⟩ := by
  unfold rowOpenings
  congr 1 <;> funext c <;> exact layout_aux C _ _ c.isLt (by assumption)

/-! ### Bits -/

theorem nat_bits (k n : Nat) : n % 2 ^ k = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, n / 2 ^ i % 2 * 2 ^ i := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [Nat.mod_one]
  | succ k ih => rw [Nat.mod_pow_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]; ring

theorem bitK_01 (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) n i = 0 ∨ bitK (K := K) n i = 1 := by
  unfold bitK
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (n / 2 ^ i) with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> simp

/-- Rust form of the bit cells (pair_trace.rs:404-412, `(raw >> bit) & 1`). -/
theorem bitK_eq_shift (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) n i = ((n >>> i &&& 1 : Nat) : K) := by
  unfold bitK
  rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, Nat.and_one_is_mod]

theorem bitK_mid (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) (n / 1024) i = bitK (K := K) n (10 + i) := by
  unfold bitK
  rw [Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]

theorem bitK_hi (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) (n / 1048576) i = bitK (K := K) n (20 + i) := by
  unfold bitK
  rw [Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]

/-- Ten-bit reconstruction in the literal order of R0P `valueReconstruct10`. -/
theorem chunk10 (n : Nat) : ((n % 1024 : Nat) : K) =
    bitK n 0 + 2 * bitK n 1 + 4 * bitK n 2 + 8 * bitK n 3 + 16 * bitK n 4 +
      32 * bitK n 5 + 64 * bitK n 6 + 128 * bitK n 7 + 256 * bitK n 8 + 512 * bitK n 9 := by
  have h : n % 1024 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 10, n / 2 ^ i % 2 * 2 ^ i := nat_bits 10 n
  rw [h]
  push_cast
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, bitK]
  ring

/-! ### Stage W: the witness and the computed cells -/

/-- Wspend-shaped witness (SpendRelation.lean:15 on the spend path), with the
pair leaf unfolded into its four fields. -/
structure ModelWitness (K : Type) where
  inputValue : Fin (2 ^ 30)
  outputValue : Fin (2 ^ 30)
  changeValue : Fin (2 ^ 30)
  sk : Digest K
  salt : Digest K
  path : Fin 24 → Bool × Digest K
  pairFirst : Digest K
  pairOccupied : K
  pairSecond : Digest K
  pairInverse : K
  recipientOwner : Digest K
  recipientSalt : Digest K
  changeOwner : Digest K
  changeSalt : Digest K

/-- Note chunk 1 (note_input[8..16)): value, asset, salt[0..6). -/
def noteC2 (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l =>
  if l.val = 0 then value else if l.val = 1 then asset
  else if h : l.val < 8 then salt ⟨l.val - 2, by omega⟩ else 0

/-- Note chunk 2 (note_input[16..18)): salt[6], salt[7]. -/
def noteC3 (salt : Digest K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l =>
  if l.val = 0 then salt 6 else if l.val = 1 then salt 7 else 0

def noteB0 (owner : Digest K) : BlockIn K := ⟨spongeInit 0x4153_0003 18, lo8 owner⟩
def noteB1 (owner : Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : BlockIn K :=
  ⟨blockOut (noteB0 owner), noteC2 value asset salt⟩
def noteB2 (owner : Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : BlockIn K :=
  ⟨blockOut (noteB1 owner value asset salt), noteC3 salt⟩
def noteDigest (owner : Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : Digest K :=
  blockDigest (noteB2 owner value asset salt)

variable (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)

def ownerB : BlockIn K := ⟨spongeInit 0x4153_0001 8, lo8 w.sk⟩
def ownerDigest : Digest K := blockDigest (ownerB w)
def nulB0 : BlockIn K := ⟨spongeInit 0x4153_0002 16, lo8 w.sk⟩
def nulB1 : BlockIn K := ⟨blockOut (nulB0 w), lo8 w.salt⟩
def nullifierDigest : Digest K := blockDigest (nulB1 w)

def inputLeaf : Digest K :=
  noteDigest (ownerDigest w) (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt

/-- Membership node at level l (blocks 4..24 and 54..56). -/
def treeNode (cur : Digest K) (l : Fin 24) : BlockIn K :=
  nodeIn (ordered cur (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).1 (ordered cur (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).2

/-- The running membership digest: level 0 is the input leaf. -/
def treeCur (leaf : Digest K) : Nat → Digest K
  | 0 => leaf
  | n + 1 => if h : n < 24 then blockDigest (treeNode w (treeCur leaf n) ⟨n, h⟩)
      else treeCur leaf n

/-- build_late_append (pair_trace.rs:579-586): the append bit. -/
def appBit (l : Nat) : Bool := decide (((pub.nextPairIndex >>> l) &&& 1) ≠ 0)

def emptyRootK (l : Fin 20) : Digest K := fun i => ((emptyRootsNat l.castSucc i : Nat) : K)

def appSib (l : Fin 20) : Digest K :=
  if appBit pub l.val then pub.snapshotFrontier l else emptyRootK l

def appNode (cur : Digest K) (l : Fin 20) : BlockIn K :=
  nodeIn (ordered cur (appSib pub l) (appBit pub l.val)).1
    (ordered cur (appSib pub l) (appBit pub l.val)).2

def appCur (start : Digest K) : Nat → Digest K
  | 0 => start
  | n + 1 => if h : n < 20 then blockDigest (appNode pub (appCur start n) ⟨n, h⟩)
      else appCur start n

/-- Blocks 27..29: the recipient note, or three zero permutations
(pair_trace.rs:741-743) for a withdrawal. -/
def recipB (j : Nat) : BlockIn K :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer =>
      if j = 0 then noteB0 w.recipientOwner
      else if j = 1 then noteB1 w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt
      else noteB2 w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt
  | .withdrawal => ⟨0, 0⟩

def recipientDigest : Digest K := blockDigest (recipB pub w 2)

def changeDigest : Digest K :=
  noteDigest w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt

def outPairB : BlockIn K :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => nodeIn (recipientDigest pub w) (changeDigest pub w)
  | .withdrawal => nodeIn (changeDigest pub w) 0

def outPair : Digest K := blockDigest (outPairB pub w)

/-- The 57 blocks in the forest layout (pair_tree_profile.rs:326-349 roles,
blocks 54..56 from pair_forest_trace.rs:229-240). -/
def blocksOf (h : Fin 57) : BlockIn K :=
  if h.val = 0 then ownerB w
  else if h.val = 1 then noteB0 (ownerDigest w)
  else if h.val = 2 then noteB1 (ownerDigest w) (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt
  else if h.val = 3 then noteB2 (ownerDigest w) (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt
  else if h4 : h.val ≤ 24 then
    treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) (h.val - 4)) ⟨h.val - 4, by omega⟩
  else if h.val = 25 then nulB0 w
  else if h.val = 26 then nulB1 w
  else if h.val ≤ 29 then recipB pub w (h.val - 27)
  else if h.val = 30 then noteB0 w.changeOwner
  else if h.val = 31 then noteB1 w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt
  else if h.val = 32 then noteB2 w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt
  else if h.val = 33 then outPairB pub w
  else if h53 : h.val ≤ 53 then
    appNode pub (appCur pub (outPair pub w) (h.val - 34)) ⟨h.val - 34, by omega⟩
  else treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) (h.val - 33))
    ⟨h.val - 33, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩

/-- Path aux record at level l: the same current/sibling/bit as the node. -/
def pathAuxOf (l : Fin 24) : PathAux K :=
  ⟨dirK (w.path l).1, treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val,
    (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).1,
    (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).2⟩

def valuesOf : Fin 3 → Nat := ![w.inputValue.val, w.outputValue.val, w.changeValue.val]

def inOccOf : OccAux K := ⟨w.pairOccupied, w.pairInverse, w.pairSecond, dirK (w.path 0).1⟩

/-- two_outputs / single_output (pair_tree_profile.rs:193-226). -/
def outOccOf : OccAux K :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => ⟨1, (changeDigest pub w 7)⁻¹, changeDigest pub w, 0⟩
  | .withdrawal => ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩

def cellsOf : Cells K :=
  ⟨blocksOf pub w, pathAuxOf pub w, valuesOf w, inOccOf w, outOccOf pub w⟩

/-- The model builder. -/
def buildModel : Trace K := layout (cellsOf pub w)

#print axioms blockIter
#print axioms layout
#print axioms layout_aux
#print axioms layout_block
#print axioms layout_high
#print axioms rowOpenings_aux
#print axioms nat_bits
#print axioms bitK_01
#print axioms bitK_eq_shift
#print axioms bitK_mid
#print axioms bitK_hi
#print axioms chunk10
#print axioms cellsOf
#print axioms buildModel
end R0Z.BuilderModel

R0Z.BuilderModelAux.text:
import R0Z.BuilderModel
import R0P.Value
import R0P.Occupancy
import R0P.Asset

/-! Builder model, auxiliary families (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4):
value, occupancy, asset and path hold on `layout C` from local invariants of
the aux records, and on `buildModel pub w` from named witness premises.

Premises are witness facts that the Rust builder checks before it writes the
trace (design §2): conservation (pair_trace.rs:621-628/724-729), pair-leaf
validity and spendability (pair_tree_profile.rs:124-191), the withdrawal
amount, and a non-zero change sentinel for a transfer (two_outputs,
pair_tree_profile.rs:206-226; design §5). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### Value -/

theorem base_poly (v : Nat) :
    valueBaseCell (K := K) v 0 + 2 * valueBaseCell v 1 + 4 * valueBaseCell v 2 +
      8 * valueBaseCell v 3 + 16 * valueBaseCell v 4 + 32 * valueBaseCell v 5 +
      64 * valueBaseCell v 6 + 128 * valueBaseCell v 7 + 256 * valueBaseCell v 8 +
      512 * valueBaseCell v 9 = ((v % 1024 : Nat) : K) :=
  (chunk10 v).symm

theorem mid_poly (v : Nat) :
    valueMidCell (K := K) v 0 + 2 * valueMidCell v 1 + 4 * valueMidCell v 2 +
      8 * valueMidCell v 3 + 16 * valueMidCell v 4 + 32 * valueMidCell v 5 +
      64 * valueMidCell v 6 + 128 * valueMidCell v 7 + 256 * valueMidCell v 8 +
      512 * valueMidCell v 9 = ((v / 1024 % 1024 : Nat) : K) :=
  (chunk10 (v / 1024)).symm

theorem hi_poly (v : Nat) :
    valueHiCell (K := K) v 0 + 2 * valueHiCell v 1 + 4 * valueHiCell v 2 +
      8 * valueHiCell v 3 + 16 * valueHiCell v 4 + 32 * valueHiCell v 5 +
      64 * valueHiCell v 6 + 128 * valueHiCell v 7 + 256 * valueHiCell v 8 +
      512 * valueHiCell v 9 = ((v / 1048576 % 1024 : Nat) : K) :=
  (chunk10 (v / 1048576)).symm

theorem value_recon (v : Nat) (hv : v < 2 ^ 30) :
    valueBaseCell (K := K) v 10 =
      ((valueBaseCell v 0 + 2 * valueBaseCell v 1 + 4 * valueBaseCell v 2 +
        8 * valueBaseCell v 3 + 16 * valueBaseCell v 4 + 32 * valueBaseCell v 5 +
        64 * valueBaseCell v 6 + 128 * valueBaseCell v 7 + 256 * valueBaseCell v 8 +
        512 * valueBaseCell v 9) +
       (valueMidCell v 0 + 2 * valueMidCell v 1 + 4 * valueMidCell v 2 +
        8 * valueMidCell v 3 + 16 * valueMidCell v 4 + 32 * valueMidCell v 5 +
        64 * valueMidCell v 6 + 128 * valueMidCell v 7 + 256 * valueMidCell v 8 +
        512 * valueMidCell v 9) * 1024) +
       (valueHiCell v 0 + 2 * valueHiCell v 1 + 4 * valueHiCell v 2 +
        8 * valueHiCell v 3 + 16 * valueHiCell v 4 + 32 * valueHiCell v 5 +
        64 * valueHiCell v 6 + 128 * valueHiCell v 7 + 256 * valueHiCell v 8 +
        512 * valueHiCell v 9) * 1048576 := by
  rw [base_poly, mid_poly, hi_poly]
  have hv' : v < 1073741824 := hv
  have hn : v = v % 1024 + v / 1024 % 1024 * 1024 + v / 1048576 % 1024 * 1048576 := by omega
  show ((v : Nat) : K) = _
  conv_lhs => rw [hn]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem value_model_range (v : Nat) (hv : v < 2 ^ 30) :
    ∀ r ∈ valueRange (⟨valueBaseCell v, valueMidCell v, valueHiCell v⟩ : Openings K), r = 0 := by
  rw [value_range_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_, value_recon v hv, rfl, rfl⟩
  · show valueBaseCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 0 ∨ valueBaseCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 1
    unfold valueBaseCell
    rw [if_pos (show (i.castAdd 6).val < 10 from i.isLt)]
    exact bitK_01 _ _
  · show valueMidCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 0 ∨ valueMidCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 1
    unfold valueMidCell
    rw [if_pos (show (i.castAdd 6).val < 10 from i.isLt)]
    exact bitK_01 _ _
  · show valueHiCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 0 ∨ valueHiCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 1
    unfold valueHiCell
    rw [if_pos (show (i.castAdd 6).val < 10 from i.isLt)]
    exact bitK_01 _ _

theorem aux_1008 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1008 = valueBaseCell (C.values 0) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1009 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1009 = valueMidCell (C.values 0) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1010 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1010 = valueBaseCell (C.values 1) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1011 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1011 = valueMidCell (C.values 1) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1012 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1012 = valueBaseCell (C.values 2) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1013 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1013 = valueMidCell (C.values 2) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1016 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1016 = valueHiCell (C.values 2) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1020 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1020 = valueHiCell (C.values 0) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1022 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1022 = valueHiCell (C.values 1) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1017 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1017 = occCell C.inOcc := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1018 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1018 = occCell C.outOcc := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]

/-- Value family on the layout: every value below 2^30 and v0 = v1 + v2. -/
theorem value_layout (pub : Public K) (C : Cells K) (hv : ∀ j, C.values j < 2 ^ 30)
    (hcons : C.values 0 = C.values 1 + C.values 2) : Holds valueFamily pub (layout C) := by
  rw [value_holds_rows_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [rowOpenings_aux C _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
        show (succRow (1008 : Fin 1024)).val = 1009 from rfl,
        show (xor12Row (1008 : Fin 1024)).val = 1020 by decide,
        show (1008 : Fin 1024).val = 1008 from rfl, aux_1008, aux_1009, aux_1020]
      exact value_model_range _ (hv 0)
    · rw [rowOpenings_aux C _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
        show (succRow (1010 : Fin 1024)).val = 1011 from rfl,
        show (xor12Row (1010 : Fin 1024)).val = 1022 by decide,
        show (1010 : Fin 1024).val = 1010 from rfl, aux_1010, aux_1011, aux_1022]
      exact value_model_range _ (hv 1)
    · rw [rowOpenings_aux C _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
        show (succRow (1012 : Fin 1024)).val = 1013 from rfl,
        show (xor12Row (1012 : Fin 1024)).val = 1016 by decide,
        show (1012 : Fin 1024).val = 1012 from rfl, aux_1012, aux_1013, aux_1016]
      exact value_model_range _ (hv 2)
  · rw [layout_aux C 0 1014 (by decide) (by decide), layout_aux C 1 1014 (by decide) (by decide),
      layout_aux C 2 1014 (by decide) (by decide)]
    simp [auxCell]
  · rw [layout_aux C 0 1015 (by decide) (by decide), layout_aux C 1 1015 (by decide) (by decide)]
    simp only [auxCell, Fin.isValue]
    simp only [show ¬ (912 ≤ (1015 : Fin 1024).val ∧ (1015 : Fin 1024).val < 1008) by decide,
      show (1015 : Fin 1024).val = 1015 from rfl, dite_false]
    norm_num
    rw [hcons]
    push_cast
    ring

/-! ### Occupancy -/

/-- The row-local occupancy equations (PairLeaf.Valid, V7PairLeafOccupancy.lean:44). -/
def OccValid (o : OccAux K) : Prop :=
  o.occupied * (o.occupied - 1) = 0 ∧ o.commitment 7 * o.inverse - o.occupied = 0 ∧
    (1 - o.occupied) * o.inverse = 0 ∧ ∀ lane : Fin 8, (1 - o.occupied) * o.commitment lane = 0

theorem occCell_lane (o : OccAux K) (lane : Fin 8) (h : 2 + lane.val < 16) :
    occCell o ⟨2 + lane.val, h⟩ = o.commitment lane := by
  unfold occCell
  rw [if_neg (by simp), if_neg (by simp; omega), dif_pos (by simp; omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp)

theorem occ_rows (C : Cells K) (b : Fin 1024) (o : OccAux K) (hb : auxCell C b.val = occCell o)
    (hb57 : 57 ≤ b.val / 16) (ho : OccValid o) :
    layout C 0 b * (layout C 0 b - 1) = 0 ∧
      layout C 9 b * layout C 1 b - layout C 0 b = 0 ∧
      (1 - layout C 0 b) * layout C 1 b = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane : Fin 8, (1 - layout C 0 b) * layout C ⟨2 + lane.val, by omega⟩ b = 0 := by
  have e : ∀ (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16), layout C c b = occCell o ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
    intro c hc
    rw [layout_aux C c b hc hb57, hb]
  rw [e 0 (by decide), e 9 (by decide), e 1 (by decide)]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ho
  refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, fun lane => ?_⟩
  rw [e _ (by simp; omega)]
  have hl := occCell_lane o lane (by omega)
  simp only at hl ⊢
  rw [hl]
  exact h4 lane

theorem occupancy_layout (pub : Public K) (C : Cells K) (hin : OccValid C.inOcc)
    (hout : OccValid C.outOcc) (hsel : C.inOcc.selected * (1 - C.inOcc.occupied) = 0)
    (hvar : C.outOcc.occupied = occupancyExpected pub.variant) :
    Holds occupancyFamily pub (layout C) := by
  rw [occupancy_holds_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact occ_rows C 1017 C.inOcc (aux_1017 C) (by decide) hin
    · exact occ_rows C 1018 C.outOcc (aux_1018 C) (by decide) hout
  · rw [layout_aux C 10 1017 (by decide) (by decide), layout_aux C 0 1017 (by decide) (by decide),
      show (1017 : Fin 1024).val = 1017 from rfl, aux_1017]
    exact hsel
  · rw [layout_aux C 0 1018 (by decide) (by decide), show (1018 : Fin 1024).val = 1018 from rfl,
      aux_1018]
    show C.outOcc.occupied = _
    rw [hvar]
    cases pub.variant <;> rfl

/-! ### Path -/

/-- The row-local path equations (path_holds_iff, Path.lean). -/
def PathValid (p : PathAux K) : Prop :=
  p.bit * (p.bit - 1) = 0 ∧ (∀ i : Fin 8, (1 - p.bit) * (p.left i - p.current i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 8, p.bit * (p.right i - p.current i) = 0)

theorem pathBaseCell_cur (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) (i : Fin 8) (hc : c.val = i.val + 1) :
    pathBaseCell p c = p.current i := by
  unfold pathBaseCell
  rw [if_neg (by omega), dif_pos (by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

theorem pathSuccCell_left (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) (i : Fin 8) (hc : c.val = i.val) :
    pathSuccCell p c = p.left i := by
  unfold pathSuccCell
  rw [dif_pos (by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

theorem pathSuccCell_right (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) (i : Fin 8) (hc : c.val = 8 + i.val) :
    pathSuccCell p c = p.right i := by
  unfold pathSuccCell
  rw [dif_neg (by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

theorem path_layout (pub : Public K) (C : Cells K) (hp : ∀ l, PathValid (C.path l)) :
    Holds pathFamily pub (layout C) := by
  rw [path_holds_iff]
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi, hloc⟩ := hb
  have hb1 : 912 ≤ b.val ∧ b.val < 1008 := by omega
  have hsv : (succRow b).val = b.val + 1 := by
    show (b.val + 1) % 1024 = b.val + 1
    omega
  let l : Fin 24 := ⟨4 * ((b.val - 912) / 16) + b.val % 16 / 4, by omega⟩
  have eb : ∀ (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16),
      layout C c b = pathBaseCell (C.path l) ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
    intro c hc
    rw [layout_aux C c b hc (by omega)]
    unfold auxCell
    rw [dif_pos hb1, if_pos (by omega)]
  have es : ∀ (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16),
      layout C c (succRow b) = pathSuccCell (C.path l) ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
    intro c hc
    rw [layout_aux C c (succRow b) hc (by omega), hsv]
    unfold auxCell
    rw [dif_pos (show 912 ≤ b.val + 1 ∧ b.val + 1 < 1008 by omega),
      if_neg (show ¬ ((b.val + 1) % 16 % 4 = 1) by omega),
      if_pos (show (b.val + 1) % 16 % 4 = 2 by omega)]
    exact congrArg (fun p : Fin 24 => pathSuccCell (C.path p) ⟨c.val, hc⟩)
      (Fin.ext (show 4 * ((b.val + 1 - 912) / 16) + (b.val + 1) % 16 / 4 =
        4 * ((b.val - 912) / 16) + b.val % 16 / 4 by omega))
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hp l
  have e0 : layout C 0 b = (C.path l).bit := by rw [eb 0 (by decide)]; rfl
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [e0]; exact h1
  · rw [e0, es _ (by simp; omega), eb _ (by simp; omega),
      pathSuccCell_left _ _ i (by simp), pathBaseCell_cur _ _ i (by simp)]
    exact h2 i
  · rw [e0, es _ (by simp; omega), eb _ (by simp; omega),
      pathSuccCell_right _ _ i (by simp <;> omega), pathBaseCell_cur _ _ i (by simp)]
    exact h3 i

/-! ### The model's aux records satisfy the local invariants -/

theorem pathAuxOf_valid (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (l : Fin 24) :
    PathValid (pathAuxOf pub w l) := by
  unfold PathValid pathAuxOf
  cases (w.path l).1 <;> simp [dirK, ordered]

/-- The witness-side premises of the aux families. -/
structure AuxPremises (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) : Prop where
  conservation : w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val
  pairValid : OccValid (inOccOf w)
  spendable : dirK (w.path 0).1 * (1 - w.pairOccupied) = 0
  changeSentinel : pub.variant = .privateTransfer → changeDigest pub w 7 ≠ 0
  amount : pub.variant = .withdrawal → ∀ a, pub.withdrawalAmount = some a →
    a = (w.outputValue.val : K)

theorem outOccOf_valid (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hs : pub.variant = .privateTransfer → changeDigest pub w 7 ≠ 0) :
    OccValid (outOccOf pub w) := by
  unfold OccValid outOccOf
  cases hv : pub.variant
  · have h7 := hs hv
    simp only
    refine ⟨by ring, by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ h7]; ring, by ring, fun lane => by ring⟩
  · simp

theorem value_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hc : w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val) :
    Holds valueFamily pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  value_layout pub _ (fun j => by
    show valuesOf w j < 2 ^ 30
    fin_cases j
    · exact w.inputValue.isLt
    · exact w.outputValue.isLt
    · exact w.changeValue.isLt) hc

theorem occupancy_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (hP : AuxPremises pub w) :
    Holds occupancyFamily pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  occupancy_layout pub _ hP.pairValid (outOccOf_valid pub w hP.changeSentinel) hP.spendable
    (by show (outOccOf pub w).occupied = _
        unfold outOccOf occupancyExpected
        cases pub.variant <;> rfl)

theorem path_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    Holds pathFamily pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  path_layout pub _ (pathAuxOf_valid pub w)

theorem asset_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (ha : pub.variant = .withdrawal → ∀ a, pub.withdrawalAmount = some a →
      a = (w.outputValue.val : K)) :
    Holds assetFamily pub (buildModel pub w) := by
  rw [asset_holds_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun hv => ?_, fun hv a hwa => ?_⟩
  · rw [buildModel, layout_block _ 1 44 (by decide) 2 (by decide)]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, layout_block _ 1 508 (by decide) 31 (by decide)]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, layout_block _ 1 460 (by decide) 28 (by decide)]
    show (recipB pub w 1).absorb ⟨1, by decide⟩ = pub.assetId
    unfold recipB
    rw [hv]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, layout_aux _ 10 1010 (by decide) (by decide),
      show (1010 : Fin 1024).val = 1010 from rfl, aux_1010]
    rw [ha hv a hwa]
    rfl

#print axioms base_poly
#print axioms value_recon
#print axioms value_model_range
#print axioms value_layout
#print axioms occCell_lane
#print axioms occ_rows
#print axioms occupancy_layout
#print axioms pathBaseCell_cur
#print axioms pathSuccCell_left
#print axioms pathSuccCell_right
#print axioms path_layout
#print axioms pathAuxOf_valid
#print axioms outOccOf_valid
#print axioms value_model
#print axioms occupancy_model
#print axioms path_model
#print axioms asset_model
end R0Z.BuilderModel

import R0Z.WritersExtracted
import Aeneas.Tactic.Solver.ScalarTac
import R0Z.BuilderModelAux

/-! Refinement of the extracted occupancy writer (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9).

`R0WriterCopies.write_occupancy_row` is the Aeneas b59d5188 extraction of the
extraction-friendly copy of pair_trace.rs:439-468 `write_occupancy`
(refine/writers/src/lib.rs; native differential test refine/diffharness).
We prove: on in-bounds rows it returns `ok`, writes exactly the 16 cells of the
row (11 of them nonzero-capable), and the lifted cells equal the model's
`occCell` whenever the record's fields lift to the model's `OccAux`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

/-! ### Aeneas plumbing lemmas -/

theorem update_ok {n : Usize} (v : Array U32 n) (i : Usize) (x : U32) (h : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.update v i x = ok (v.set i x) := by
  unfold Array.update
  have hl : i.val < v.val.length := by rw [v.property]; exact h
  rw [Array.getElem?_Usize_eq, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hl]
  rfl

theorem index_ok {n : Usize} (v : Array U32 n) (i : Usize) (h : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize v i = ok (v.val[i.val]!) := by
  unfold Array.index_usize
  have hl : i.val < v.val.length := by rw [v.property]; exact h
  rw [Array.getElem?_Usize_eq, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hl, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem hl]
  rfl

theorem usize_size_ge : 2 ^ 32 ≤ UScalar.size .Usize := by
  rw [UScalar.size_def]
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) System.Platform.le_numBits

theorem uadd (x y : Usize) (h : x.val + y.val < 2 ^ 32) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add x y).val = x.val + y.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le h usize_size_ge)

theorem umul (x y : Usize) (h : x.val * y.val < 2 ^ 32) :
    (Usize.wrapping_mul x y).val = x.val * y.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le h usize_size_ge)

theorem getElem!_set_list (l : List U32) (i k : Nat) (x : U32) (hi : i < l.length) :
    (l.set i x)[k]! = if k = i then x else l[k]! := by
  by_cases hk : k = i
  · subst hk
    rw [if_pos rfl, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_set_self hi]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hk, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm hk)]

theorem set_get (v : Array U32 256#usize) (i : Usize) (x : U32) (hi : i.val < 256) (k : Nat) :
    (v.set i x).val[k]! = if k = i.val then x else v.val[k]! := by
  rw [Array.set_val_eq]
  exact getElem!_set_list _ _ _ _ (by rw [v.property]; exact hi)

/-! ### The lane loop -/

theorem occ_loop (a : Array U32 8#usize) (base : Usize) (hb : base.val + 10 ≤ 256) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (lane : Usize) (block : Array U32 256#usize), lane.val + n = 8 →
      ∃ b', write_occupancy_row_loop a block base lane = ok b' ∧
        ∀ k, b'.val[k]! = if base.val + 2 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 10
          then a.val[k - base.val - 2]! else block.val[k]!
  | 0, lane, block, h => by
      refine ⟨block, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_occupancy_row_loop]
        rw [if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
      · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  | n + 1, lane, block, h => by
      have hlt : lane < 8#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hl8 : lane.val < 8 := by omega
      have h2 : (Usize.wrapping_add base 2#usize).val = base.val + 2 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hix : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 2#usize) lane).val =
          base.val + 2 + lane.val := by rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac), h2]
      have hl1 : (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val = lane.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hspec⟩ := occ_loop a base hb n (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize)
        (block.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 2#usize) lane) (a.val[lane.val]!))
        (by rw [hl1]; omega)
      refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_occupancy_row_loop, if_pos hlt]
        rw [index_ok a lane (show lane.val < (8#usize).val by simpa using hl8)]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok block _ _ (show _ < (256#usize).val by rw [hix]; simpa using (by omega : base.val + 2 + lane.val < 256))]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hb'
      · rw [hspec k, hl1, set_get _ _ _ (by rw [hix]; omega), hix]
        by_cases hk : k = base.val + 2 + lane.val
        · subst hk
          rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl, if_pos (by omega)]
          congr 2
          omega
        · rw [if_neg hk]
          by_cases hr : base.val + 2 + (lane.val + 1) ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 10
          · rw [if_pos hr, if_pos (by omega)]
          · rw [if_neg hr, if_neg (by omega)]

#print axioms update_ok
#print axioms index_ok
#print axioms uadd
#print axioms set_get
#print axioms occ_loop
end R0Z.WriterRefine

import R1Z.BuilderTransportExtracted
import R0Z.WriterRefineOcc
import D18Transport

/-! P6's Kani certificate connects shipped S2 to this extracted arithmetic
reference. The theorems below are kernel proofs about the extracted reference;
Kani soundness is not introduced as a Lean axiom. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderTransport
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

/-- The extracted machine-word reference returns D18 without wrapping. -/
theorem reference_row (j : Usize) :
    ∃ out, AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic j = ok out ∧
      out.val = AspisR1.rowNat j.val := by
  obtain ⟨d0, hd0, vd0⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec j (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, vq1⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 4#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d1, hd1, vd1⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q1 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, vq2⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 16#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d2, hd2, vd2⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q2 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q3, hq3, vq3⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 64#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d3, hd3, vd3⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q3 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q4, hq4, vq4⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 256#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d4, hd4, vd4⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q4 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  have v0 : d0.val = j.val % 4 := by simpa using vd0
  have v1 : d1.val = (j.val / 4) % 4 := by simpa using vd1.trans (by simp [vq1])
  have v2 : d2.val = (j.val / 16) % 4 := by simpa using vd2.trans (by simp [vq2])
  have v3 : d3.val = (j.val / 64) % 4 := by simpa using vd3.trans (by simp [vq3])
  have v4 : d4.val = (j.val / 256) % 4 := by simpa using vd4.trans (by simp [vq4])
  rw [AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic, hd0]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq1]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd1]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq2]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd2]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq3]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd3]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq4]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd4]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  let m0 := Usize.wrapping_mul 64#usize d0
  have vm0 : m0.val = 64 * d0.val := by
    dsimp [m0]
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
  let m1 := Usize.wrapping_mul 256#usize d1
  have vm1 : m1.val = 256 * d1.val := by
    dsimp [m1]
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
  let m2 := Usize.wrapping_mul 16#usize d2
  have vm2 : m2.val = 16 * d2.val := by
    dsimp [m2]
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
  let m4 := Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize d4
  have vm4 : m4.val = 4 * d4.val := by
    dsimp [m4]
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
  let a1 := Usize.wrapping_add m0 m1
  have va1 : a1.val = 64 * d0.val + 256 * d1.val := by
    dsimp [a1]
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vm0, vm1]; omega), vm0, vm1]
  let a2 := Usize.wrapping_add a1 m2
  have va2 : a2.val = 64 * d0.val + 256 * d1.val + 16 * d2.val := by
    dsimp [a2]
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [va1, vm2]; omega), va1, vm2]
  let a3 := Usize.wrapping_add a2 d3
  have va3 : a3.val = 64 * d0.val + 256 * d1.val + 16 * d2.val + d3.val := by
    dsimp [a3]
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [va2]; omega), va2]
  change (Usize.wrapping_add a3 m4).val = AspisR1.rowNat j.val
  rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [va3, vm4]; omega), va3, vm4]
  simp only [v0, v1, v2, v3, v4, AspisR1.rowNat]

/-- Its coefficient index is precisely the existing D18 transport. -/
theorem reference_row_fin (j : Usize) (hj : j.val < 1024) :
    ∃ out, AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic j = ok out ∧
      out.val = (AspisR1.row ⟨j.val, hj⟩).val := by
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hv⟩ := reference_row j
  exact ⟨out, ho, hv⟩

#print axioms reference_row
#print axioms reference_row_fin
end R1Z.BuilderTransport

import R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin
import R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin
import R1Z.BuilderTransport

/-! Exact-wide Lean-model leaf encoding: D18/S2 row transport, the existing
circle/line domain evaluators, fibre-major lane selection, retained byte
serialization, and folded-tree zero padding. No FFT/Rust execution identity
or low-subfield guard is inferred from these mathematical definitions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseLeafEncodingBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.HonestView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.JointView
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin
  R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

abbrev K := AspisWideTower.WideExact

/-- The original model reads coefficients through pi.symm. D18 is involutive. -/
def coefficients (m : Fin 1024 → K) : Fin 1024 → K := coeffsLinear AspisR1.rowEquiv m

theorem s2_coefficient (m : Fin 1024 → K) (j : Fin 1024) :
    coefficients m j = m (AspisR1.row j) := rfl

/-- Connect the selected coefficient index to the extracted S2 reference. -/
theorem extracted_s2_index (j : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (hj : j.val < 1024) :
    ∃ out : Aeneas.Std.Usize, ∃ hout : out.val < 1024,
      AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic j = .ok out ∧
      ∀ m : Fin 1024 → K, coefficients m ⟨j.val, hj⟩ = m ⟨out.val, hout⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hv⟩ := R1Z.BuilderTransport.reference_row_fin j hj
  have hout : out.val < 1024 := by
    rw [hv]
    exact (AspisR1.row ⟨j.val, hj⟩).isLt
  refine ⟨out, hout, ho, ?_⟩
  intro m
  rw [s2_coefficient]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext hv.symm

/-- Both commitments store four successive domain symbols, slot then lane. -/
def initialSymbol (m : Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fib) (s : Fin 4) : K :=
  AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder (coefficients m) (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex u s)

def c1Leaf (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 =>
      (wideBytes (initialSymbol (t (c1Column c)) u s)).take
        (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten)).flatten

def c2Leaf (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 2 =>
      (wideBytes (initialSymbol (t ⟨26+c.val, by omega⟩) u s)).take 16)).flatten)).flatten

/-- The final evaluator has 2^18 symbols, hence 2^16 four-symbol data leaves.
The commitment still has 2^18 leaves; the remaining ones are 128 zero bytes. -/
def foldedLeaf (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  if hu : u.val < 65536 then
    (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded (fun s : Fin 4 =>
      AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear m ⟨4*u.val+s.val, by omega⟩)).map UInt8.ofFin
  else List.replicate 128 0

/-- All three encoder parameters are now instantiated. -/
def encoding : PhaseLeafConstructionBin.LeafEncoding K where
  c1 := fun m u =>
    (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
      (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 =>
        (wideBytes (initialSymbol (m c) u s)).take
          (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten)).flatten
  c2 := fun m u =>
    (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
      (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 2 =>
        (wideBytes (initialSymbol (m c) u s)).take 16)).flatten)).flatten
  folded := foldedLeaf

attribute [local irreducible] initialSymbol wideBytes
  c1Leaf c2Leaf foldedLeaf

theorem encoding_c1 (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) :
    encoding.c1 (fun c => t (c1Column c)) u = c1Leaf t u := by
  unfold encoding c1Leaf
  rfl

theorem encoding_c2 (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) :
    encoding.c2 (fun c => t ⟨26+c.val, by omega⟩) u = c2Leaf t u := by
  unfold encoding c2Leaf
  rfl

theorem folded_padding (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) (hu : 65536 ≤ u.val) :
    encoding.folded m u = List.replicate 128 0 := by
  unfold encoding foldedLeaf
  exact dif_neg (by omega)

theorem folded_data (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) (hu : u.val < 65536) :
    encoding.folded m u =
      (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded (fun s : Fin 4 =>
        AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear m ⟨4*u.val+s.val, by omega⟩)).map UInt8.ofFin := by
  unfold encoding foldedLeaf
  exact dif_pos hu

/-- Equality with the three independently named model leaves on the same
prepared, masked honest trace. C1's preparation is removed by its dependency
lemma; C2 selects 26/27; folded consumes the existing Batched.q1 word. -/
theorem honest_leaves {CommitHandle : Type} {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K) (w : h.Instance)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F) (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) :
    PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal encoding B h w x τ ch T u =
      let t := applyAff B (prepare x.1 (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) ch) τ.1
      if T.val = 0 then c1Leaf t u
      else if T.val = 1 then c2Leaf t u
      else foldedLeaf (q1 h.transport ch t) u := by
  dsimp only
  unfold PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal
  split
  · change encoding.c1 _ u = c1Leaf _ u
    rw [← encoding_c1]
    apply congrArg (fun cols => encoding.c1 cols u)
    funext c
    exact (c1_challenge_free x.1 (h.build w) B τ ch c).symm
  · split
    · exact encoding_c2 _ u
    · rfl

/-- Serialized source lanes read from the existing query-gated view. -/
def openedC1 (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 =>
      (wideBytes (p (.opened u s (c1Column c)))).take
        (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten)).flatten

def openedC2 (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 2 =>
      (wideBytes (p (.opened u s ⟨26+c.val, by omega⟩))).take 16)).flatten)).flatten

theorem initialSymbol_run (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (hπ : π = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    {F : Subfield K} (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (r : AffTape K F) (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries)
    (slot : Fin 4) (c : Fin 29) :
    initialSymbol (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r c) u slot =
      run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r (.opened u slot c) := by
  subst hπ
  simp only [initialSymbol, run, if_pos hu]
  rfl

/-- On queried fibres the instantiated C1/C2 leaves equal the actual disclosed
HonestView cells, with the source's slot/lane order and byte widths. -/
theorem c1_view {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (hπ : π = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries) :
    c1Leaf (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) u =
      openedC1 (run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r) u := by
  unfold c1Leaf openedC1
  simp only [initialSymbol_run π hπ pub B t r ch u hu]

theorem c2_view {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (hπ : π = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries) :
    c2Leaf (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) u =
      openedC2 (run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r) u := by
  unfold c2Leaf openedC2
  simp only [initialSymbol_run π hπ pub B t r ch u hu]

theorem folded_view {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u.val < 65536)
    (hq : ∀ slot : Fin 4, FoldedOpen ch ⟨4*u.val+slot.val, by omega⟩) :
    foldedLeaf (q1 π ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r)) u =
      (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded (fun slot : Fin 4 =>
        run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r
          (.bat (.folded ⟨4*u.val+slot.val, by omega⟩)))).map UInt8.ofFin := by
  unfold foldedLeaf
  rw [dif_pos hu]
  apply congrArg (fun values => (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded values).map UInt8.ofFin)
  funext slot
  simp only [run]
  exact (read_folded π ch _ _ (hq slot)).symm

#print axioms folded_view
#print axioms initialSymbol_run
#print axioms c1_view
#print axioms c2_view
#print axioms s2_coefficient
#print axioms extracted_s2_index
#print axioms encoding_c1
#print axioms encoding_c2
#print axioms folded_padding
#print axioms folded_data
#print axioms honest_leaves
end R1Z.PhaseLeafEncodingBin

R1Z.RomGrammarBin.text:
import R1Z.RomFiniteBin
import R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin

/-! Membership of the actual binary encodings, including private-only reads
and D79 checkpoint classes. Coverage is the source handoff, at every answer
vector; it is not inferred from a successful trace or opening-only comLog. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.RomGrammarBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.RomFiniteBin
open AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Room for all fixed records plus the public statement and init domains. -/
def bound (publicWidth : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  57607 + publicWidth + semDomain.length + openDomain.length

theorem class_size_le (c : Tx1Class) : c.size ≤ 57607 := by
  cases c <;> simp only [Tx1Class.size]
  all_goals first
    | omega
    | (rename_i k; cases k <;>
        simp only [BindingClass.size, proof_bytes_eq, asf8_size_eq] <;> omega)

theorem semantic_size_le (i : Fin 27) :
    AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.semanticSize i ≤ 3712 := by
  unfold AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.semanticSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem opening_size_le (i : Fin 4) :
    AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.openingSize i ≤ 928 := by
  unfold AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.openingSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem transcript_length (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) (hp : w.publicBytes.length ≤ publicWidth)
    (j : TRead) (a : OracleAnswer) :
    (addrWith j a (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared w))).length ≤
      bound publicWidth := by
  have hs : ∀ i, WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticSize i ≤ 3712 := semantic_size_le
  have ho : ∀ i, WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize i ≤ 928 := opening_size_le
  cases j <;>
    simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil,
      length_ans, le32, WireLengthsR1PBin.rest,
      SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared, WireLengthsR1PBin.framed,
      Vector.length_toList]
  all_goals unfold bound
  all_goals first
    | omega
    | (rename_i i; have hi := hs i; change _ ≤ _ at hi; omega)
    | (rename_i i; have hi := ho i; change _ ≤ _ at hi; omega)

theorem commitment_length {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (pub : List UInt8) (hp : pub.length ≤ publicWidth) (tag : UInt8)
    (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (hl : ∀ T u, (lv T u).length ≤ 480)
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (p : CPos E₁ E₂) :
    (gram pub tag lv sec d rest p).length ≤ bound publicWidth := by
  rcases p with T | ((c | c) | (b | (i | (⟨T,u⟩ | (⟨T,u⟩ | ⟨T,n⟩)))))
  all_goals simp only [gram]
  all_goals try split_ifs
  all_goals simp only [nodeBytes, ctxEnc, le32, le64, dExp1, dExp2, dBind0,
    dBind1, dMaskSeed, dSourceSeed, dDSeed, dLeafSalt, descr,
    List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, length_ans]
  all_goals unfold bound
  all_goals first | omega | (have hv := hl T u; omega)

/-- Typed read carrier. Commitment records include roots, all internal
parents, all salted leaves, both bindings, every seed/salt/expander block.
The classified constructor additionally covers D79 checkpoint/resume sites. -/
inductive Record (publicWidth : ℕ) where
  | transcript (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire)
      (hp : w.publicBytes.length ≤ publicWidth) (j : TRead) (a : OracleAnswer)
  | commitment {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (pub : List UInt8) (hp : pub.length ≤ publicWidth)
      (tag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8)
      (hl : ∀ T u, (lv T u).length ≤ 480) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
      (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (p : CPos E₁ E₂)
  | classified (c : Tx1Class) (bs : Vector UInt8 c.size)
  | publicDigest (bs : List UInt8) (hp : bs.length ≤ publicWidth)

def Record.bytes {publicWidth : ℕ} : Record publicWidth → List UInt8
  | .transcript w _ j a =>
      addrWith j a (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared w))
  | .commitment pub _ tag lv _ sec d rest p => gram pub tag lv sec d rest p
  | .classified _ bs => bs.toList
  | .publicDigest bs _ => bs

theorem record_length {publicWidth : ℕ} (r : Record publicWidth) :
    r.bytes.length ≤ bound publicWidth := by
  cases r with
  | transcript w hp j a => exact transcript_length publicWidth w hp j a
  | commitment pub hp tag lv hl sec d rest p =>
      exact commitment_length publicWidth pub hp tag lv hl sec d rest p
  | classified c bs =>
      simp only [Record.bytes, Vector.length_toList]
      have hc := class_size_le c
      unfold bound
      omega
  | publicDigest bs hp =>
      change bs.length ≤ bound publicWidth
      unfold bound
      omega

theorem record_in_domain {publicWidth : ℕ} (r : Record publicWidth) :
    (decode (bound publicWidth) r.bytes).isSome :=
  (decode_isSome _ _).mpr (record_length r)

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- R10/R-wire handoff. All counterfactual answers, not just successful runs.
The source inventory must separately identify any extra operational hashes;
no claim that Pos1 enumerates such additional source calls is made here. -/
structure ReadCoverage (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop where
  public_bytes : (W.pubBytes x).length ≤ publicWidth
  reads : ∀ (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (p : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂),
    ∃ r : Record publicWidth, r.bytes = attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v p

theorem address_domain (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base (bound publicWidth)))
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (coverage : ReadCoverage (wire base (bound publicWidth)) Pr publicWidth h B outputs x)
    (w : h.Instance) :
    RAddrIn (wire base (bound publicWidth)) Pr (rom base (bound publicWidth)) h B outputs x w := by
  intro sec d v p
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := coverage.reads w sec d v p
  change (decode (bound publicWidth) _).isSome
  rw [← hr]
  exact record_in_domain r

/-- The frozen statement-digest address is included as well. -/
theorem public_digest_domain (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base (bound publicWidth)))
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (coverage : ReadCoverage (wire base (bound publicWidth)) Pr publicWidth h B outputs x) :
    ((rom base (bound publicWidth)).dec ((wire base (bound publicWidth)).pubBytes x)).isSome :=
  record_in_domain (.publicDigest _ coverage.public_bytes)

#print axioms class_size_le
#print axioms semantic_size_le
#print axioms opening_size_le
#print axioms transcript_length
#print axioms commitment_length
#print axioms record_length
#print axioms record_in_domain
#print axioms address_domain
#print axioms public_digest_domain
end R1Z.RomGrammarBin

R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
import R1Z.PhaseLeafEncodingBin
import R1Z.RomGrammarBin

/-! Composed logical protocol instance. The ROM backend and residual prover
coins/opening data remain parameters; messages, block decoding, query scan,
leaves, grammar and order are constructed. This is not a restatement of
PrivacyR1Final over its arbitrary base, and no source execution identity is
silently inferred. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.PremisesR1PBin
local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact

variable {CommitHandle Aux : Type} {F : Subfield K}

def wire (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x :=
  PhaseMessageEncodingBin.phaseWire PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wideBytes
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.wireData (RomFiniteBin.wire base (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth)))
    PhaseSamplerParserBin.decode_local h B outputs x

/-- The concrete message/sampler model passed as base to the final endpoint. -/
def baseWire (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wireData PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wideBytes
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.wireData base)

section Instance
variable (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
local notation "W" => wire base publicWidth h B outputs x
abbrev prover (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (W).toWire) :
    R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W :=
  PhaseLeafConstructionBin.prover PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding W seed

/-- Causality is unconditional for the composed model, including inconsistent
answer vectors. No execution-order premise is needed for this model fact. -/
theorem causal_premise (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (W).toWire) : ∀ (w : h.Instance) sec d p v v',
    Earlier (W).toWire (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver p v v' →
      attAddr (W).toWire (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver h B outputs x w sec d v p =
        attAddr (W).toWire (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' p := by
  intro w sec d p v v' he
  exact PhaseCausalityBin.R_causal_D80 (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x)
    (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed) w sec d p v v' he

def rows01 : Sem1UniformR1.SemRows01 (W).toWire where
  s1 := PhaseSamplerParserBin.scalar
  sem1 := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
  sem0 := fun _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg PhaseSamplerParserBin.scalar (he 0 (by decide))

theorem sampler_source : (rows01 base publicWidth h B outputs x).s1 =
    R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend (algebraMap R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF K) := rfl

/-- This model can be used at exactly the endpoint's ROM wrapper by choosing
its base explicitly; the generic final theorem does not make this choice. -/
theorem endpoint_wire : (W).toWire =
    RomFiniteBin.wire (baseWire base) (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth) := rfl

#print axioms endpoint_wire
/-- The selected model does not inherit the base wire's message functions. -/
theorem frame_selected : (W).toWire.frame =
    PhaseMessageEncodingBin.frame PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wideBytes := rfl

theorem decoder_selected : (W).toWire.dec = PhaseSamplerParserBin.decode := rfl

#print axioms causal_premise
#print axioms rows01
#print axioms sampler_source
#print axioms frame_selected
#print axioms decoder_selected
end Instance
#print axioms wire
end R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin

R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory
import R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin

/-! The constructed ideal experiment has independent transcript-answer coins.
This proves the scan mass on that exact randomness carrier, including any
attempt reachability restriction. It does not assert a source coupling. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Split out any injectively indexed set of independent coordinates. -/
def splitCoordinates {I J U : Type} (j : I → J) (hj : Function.Injective j) :
    (J → U) ≃ (I → U) × ({x : J // ¬ ∃ i, j i = x} → U) where
  toFun v := (fun i => v (j i), fun x => v x.val)
  invFun p x := if hx : ∃ i, j i = x then p.1 (Classical.choose hx) else p.2 ⟨x, hx⟩
  left_inv v := by
    funext x
    dsimp only
    split
    · next hx => exact congrArg v (Classical.choose_spec hx)
    · rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i
      dsimp only
      rw [dif_pos (show ∃ k, j k = j i from ⟨i, rfl⟩)]
      exact congrArg p.1 (hj (Classical.choose_spec (show ∃ k, j k = j i from ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
    · funext x
      dsimp only
      rw [dif_neg x.property]

/-- This mean law is generic in all carrier sizes. -/
theorem coordinates_uniform {I J U : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] (j : I → J) (hj : Function.Injective j) :
    MP (fun v : J → U => fun i => v (j i)) := by
  intro f
  have he := mp_equiv (splitCoordinates (U := U) j hj) (fun p => f p.1)
  exact he.trans (mp_fst f)

/-- Transport across extensionally equal finite universes without reducing
the byte-carrier enumeration hidden in an inferred Fintype instance. -/
theorem mean_fintype_transport {A : Type} (fin1 fin2 : Fintype A) (f : A → ℚ) :
    @mean A fin1 f = @mean A fin2 f := by
  have he : @Finset.univ A fin1 = @Finset.univ A fin2 := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ]
  unfold mean Fintype.card
  rw [he]

def queryCoins {Cm Tab : Type} (c : R1Coins Cm Tab) : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer :=
  fun k => c.1 (.qb k)

theorem queryCoins_uniform {Cm Tab : Type} [Fintype Cm] [Nonempty Cm]
    [Fintype Tab] [Nonempty Tab] : MP (queryCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab)) := by
  change MP (fun c : (TRead → OracleAnswer) × ((Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) × Cm × Tab) =>
    fun k => c.1 (.qb k))
  intro f
  have hc := coordinates_uniform (U := OracleAnswer) TRead.qb
    (by intro a b hab; cases hab; rfl) f
  have hp := mp_fst (X := TRead → OracleAnswer)
    (Y := (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) × Cm × Tab) (fun tr => f (fun k => tr (.qb k)))
  trans mean (fun tr : TRead → OracleAnswer => f (fun k => tr (.qb k)))
  · exact hp
  · convert hc using 1 <;> apply mean_fintype_transport

variable {Cm Tab Tape : Type} [Fintype Cm] [Nonempty Cm] [Fintype Tab] [Nonempty Tab]
  [Fintype Tape] [Nonempty Tape]

/-- These are exactly fsR1P.IdealRand's outer product and retry coordinates. -/
abbrev IdealCoins := (Fin 8 → R1Coins Cm Tab) × (Fin 8 → Tape)

def bad (i : Fin 8) (r : IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape)) : Prop :=
  AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 (queryCoins (r.1 i)))

theorem ideal_bad_mass (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (bad (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) i) ≤ scanProbability := by
  have hm := mp_comp
    (mp_fst (X := Fin 8 → R1Coins Cm Tab) (Y := Fin 8 → Tape))
    (mp_pi (queryCoins_uniform (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab)) 8)
  have he := hm (fun q => if AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 (q i)) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hb := eight_reached_failures_le (fun _ _ => True) i
  simp only [true_and] at hb
  exact he.le.trans hb

theorem reached_ideal_bad_mass
    (reached : Fin 8 → IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) → Prop) (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (fun r => reached i r ∧ bad i r) ≤ scanProbability :=
  (eventMass_mono _ _ (fun _ h => h.2)).trans (ideal_bad_mass i)

/-- The bad event at the parser's selected endpoint, including fallback and
failure. This is fixed by the model, not selected by a source coupling. -/
def selectedBad (i : Fin 8) (r : IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape)) : Prop :=
  let q := queryCoins (r.1 i)
  ∃ count, AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.finish
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.scanned (PhaseQueryScanBin.stop PhaseSamplerParserBin.done q) q).1 =
      .error count

theorem selected_bad_mass (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (selectedBad (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) i) ≤ scanProbability := by
  apply (eventMass_mono _ (bad i) ?_).trans (ideal_bad_mass i)
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨count, hf⟩ := hr
  exact QueryScanFirstStopHistory.selected_failure_implies_words_failure _ count hf

theorem reached_selected_bad_mass
    (reached : Fin 8 → IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) → Prop) (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (fun r => reached i r ∧ selectedBad i r) ≤ scanProbability :=
  (eventMass_mono _ _ (fun _ h => h.2)).trans (selected_bad_mass i)

#print axioms mean_fintype_transport
#print axioms coordinates_uniform
#print axioms queryCoins_uniform
#print axioms ideal_bad_mass
#print axioms reached_ideal_bad_mass
#print axioms selected_bad_mass
#print axioms reached_selected_bad_mass
end R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory

R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction
import R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory

/-! Even unconditioned, a uniform shared-ROM scan from a fixed input state
has a self-loop contribution. This is a scan-subrun result, not a lower bound
on the complete release game's differently distributed starting state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
  R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem eval_uniform {A U : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (a : A) : MP (fun t : A → U => t a) := by
  intro f
  have he := mp_equiv (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt (U := U) a) (fun p => f p.1)
  exact he.trans (mp_fst f)

theorem point_mass {U : Type} [Fintype U] (u : U) :
    eventMass (fun v : U => v = u) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold eventMass mean
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

import AspisR1SimulatorCoin18.Funs
/-! One owned simulator coin transition. The P6 source equality is the
sim::simcoin18::coin_transition Kani receipt. This module does not identify
HOST_HASH with uniform coins, prove the nonzero loop, or model programming. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Bytes32 := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Hash := Slice (Slice U8) → Result Bytes32

def domain : Slice U8 := Array.to_slice (Array.make 20#usize
  [85#u8, 78#u8, 80#u8, 82#u8, 79#u8, 86#u8, 69#u8, 68#u8, 58#u8, 82#u8,
   49#u8, 58#u8, 83#u8, 73#u8, 77#u8, 58#u8, 67#u8, 79#u8, 73#u8, 78#u8])

def frame (seed : Bytes32) (attempt : U32) (stream : U8) (counter : U64) :
    Slice (Slice U8) :=
  Array.to_slice (Array.make 5#usize [domain, Array.to_slice seed,
    Array.to_slice (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes attempt),
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [stream]),
    Array.to_slice (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes counter)])

/-- Exact extracted hash request and release-mode wrapping counter update.
There is exactly one callback, and no fresh coin is silently introduced. -/
theorem extracted_step (hash : Hash) (seed : Bytes32) (attempt : U32)
    (stream : U8) (counter : U64) :
    AspisR1SimulatorCoin18.sim.coin_owned18 hash seed attempt stream counter =
      (do let answer ← hash (frame seed attempt stream counter)
          ok (answer, U64.wrapping_add counter 1#u64)) := by
  rfl

/-- Failed/diverging callback evaluation remains failed/diverging. In the
successful case the only changed source field is the counter. -/
theorem successful_step (hash : Hash) (seed answer : Bytes32) (attempt : U32)
    (stream : U8) (counter : U64)
    (answered : hash (frame seed attempt stream counter) = ok answer) :
    AspisR1SimulatorCoin18.sim.coin_owned18 hash seed attempt stream counter =
      ok (answer, U64.wrapping_add counter 1#u64) := by
  rw [extracted_step, answered]
  rfl

#print axioms extracted_step
#print axioms successful_step
end R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18

      host_commitment.PrivateSalts (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
      residual

end AspisR1ProverCommit
