import AspisR1ProverCommit.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSaltSource
open AspisR1ProverCommit
abbrev Reserved := aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ReservedStateOnlyAttemptSecrets
abbrev Context := aspis_core.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyHidingContext
abbrev Bytes32 := Aeneas.Std.Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Hash := Slice (Slice U8) → Result Bytes32

def saltSlices (binding nonce secret : Bytes32) (tag : U8) (index : U32) : Slice (Slice U8) :=
  Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 6#usize [
    aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.LEAF_SALT_DOMAIN,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice binding,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice nonce,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 1#usize [tag]),
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes index),
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice secret])

/-- Exact callback slices of the extracted per-leaf method, conditional only
on the separately named successful validation and binding computations.
The hash is arbitrary; no concrete hash evaluation is used. -/
theorem salt_source (self : Reserved) (hash : Hash) (context : Context)
    (tag : U8) (index : U32) (binding : Bytes32)
    (valid : aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ReservedStateOnlyAttemptSecrets.validate_pool_v1_context self context = ok (.Ok ()))
    (bound : aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.pool_v1_private_attempt_binding
      hash self.precommit_binding context = ok binding) :
    aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ReservedStateOnlyAttemptSecrets.derive_pool_v1_leaf_salt self hash context tag index = (do
      let answer ← hash (saltSlices binding self.mask_nonce self.leaf_salt_seed tag index)
      ok (.Ok answer)) := by
  simp [aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ReservedStateOnlyAttemptSecrets.derive_pool_v1_leaf_salt, valid, bound, saltSlices,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreConvertAsRef.as_ref,
    Array.Insts.CoreConvertAsRefSlice.as_ref, lift]
  rfl

#print axioms salt_source
end R1Z.ProverCommitSaltSource

R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSaltSource
import R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes
open R1Z.ProverCommitSaltSource

def byte (x : U8) : UInt8 := x.val.toUInt8

theorem shift_byte (n : ℕ) (x : BitVec (n+8)) :
    ((x >>> 8).setWidth n).toNat = x.toNat / 256 := by
  have h : (x >>> 8).toNat < 2^n := by
    simpa using BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight_lt x 8 (by omega)
  rw [BitVec.toNat_setWidth, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h]
  simp only [BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

theorem le32_source (index : U32) :
    (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes index).val.map byte = R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 index.val := by
  let b0 := index.bv
  let b1 := (b0 >>> 8).setWidth 24
  let b2 := (b1 >>> 8).setWidth 16
  let b3 := (b2 >>> 8).setWidth 8
  unfold core.num.U32.to_le_bytes
  change (index.bv.toLEBytes.map (@UScalar.mk .U8)).map byte = _
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  change [((b0.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b1.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b2.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b3.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8] = _
  have h1 : b1.toNat = b0.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 24 b0
  have h2 : b2.toNat = b1.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 16 b1
  have h3 : b3.toNat = b2.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 8 b2
  rw [BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b0, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b1,
    BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b2, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b3]
  rw [h3, h2, h1]
  simp only [TranscriptR1.le32, UScalar.val, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
  norm_num only
  rfl

theorem le64_source (counter : U64) :
    (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes counter).val.map byte = LayoutR1PBin.le64 counter.val := by
  let b0 := counter.bv
  let b1 := (b0 >>> 8).setWidth 56
  let b2 := (b1 >>> 8).setWidth 48
  let b3 := (b2 >>> 8).setWidth 40
  let b4 := (b3 >>> 8).setWidth 32
  let b5 := (b4 >>> 8).setWidth 24
  let b6 := (b5 >>> 8).setWidth 16
  let b7 := (b6 >>> 8).setWidth 8
  unfold core.num.U64.to_le_bytes
  change (counter.bv.toLEBytes.map (@UScalar.mk .U8)).map byte = _
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
  norm_num only
  change [((b0.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b1.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b2.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b3.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b4.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b5.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b6.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8,
    ((b7.setWidth 8).toNat).toUInt8] = _
  have h1 : b1.toNat = b0.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 56 b0
  have h2 : b2.toNat = b1.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 48 b1
  have h3 : b3.toNat = b2.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 40 b2
  have h4 : b4.toNat = b3.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 32 b3
  have h5 : b5.toNat = b4.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 24 b4
  have h6 : b6.toNat = b5.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 16 b5
  have h7 : b7.toNat = b6.toNat / 256 := shift_byte 8 b6
  rw [BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b0, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b1, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b2, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b3, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b4, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b5, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b6, BitVec.toNat_setWidth 8 b7]
  rw [h7, h6, h5, h4, h3, h2, h1]
  simp only [LayoutR1PBin.le64, UScalar.val, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
  norm_num only
  rfl

def wireBytes (s : Slice (Slice U8)) : List UInt8 :=
  (s.val.flatMap (fun x => x.val)).map byte

theorem salt_bytes (binding nonce secret : Bytes32) (tag : U8) (index : U32) :
    wireBytes (saltSlices binding nonce secret tag index) =
      LayoutR1PBin.dLeafSalt ++ binding.val.map byte ++ nonce.val.map byte ++
        [byte tag] ++ TranscriptR1.le32 index.val ++ secret.val.map byte := by
  simp [wireBytes, saltSlices, Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice, Aeneas.Std.Array.make,
    List.map_append, List.append_assoc,
    AspisR1ProverCommit.aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.LEAF_SALT_DOMAIN,
    le32_source, byte, LayoutR1PBin.dLeafSalt]

#print axioms shift_byte
#print axioms le32_source
#print axioms salt_bytes
#print axioms le64_source
end R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes

R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18
import R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes
import R1Z.LayoutR1P2Bin
import R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory
import R1Z.RomFiniteBin
/-! Exact simulator coin addresses and finite-ROM coordinate transport.
This does not substitute a deterministic HOST_HASH for a random oracle or
assert that the runtime programs the table according to this model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
open R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18
open R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes (byte)
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- The five source slices are concatenated by HOST_HASH. Slice boundaries
are not part of the address, so injectivity below is on these actual bytes. -/
def address (seed : List UInt8) (attempt : Nat) (stream : UInt8) (counter : Nat) : List UInt8 :=
  domain.val.map byte ++ seed ++ R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 attempt ++ [stream] ++
    R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 counter

theorem source_frame (seed : Bytes32) (attempt : Aeneas.Std.U32)
    (stream : Aeneas.Std.U8) (counter : Aeneas.Std.U64) :
    ((frame seed attempt stream counter).val.flatMap (fun part => part.val.map byte)) =
      address (seed.val.map byte) attempt.val (byte stream) counter.val := by
  change domain.val.map byte ++ (seed.val.map byte ++
    ((Aeneas.Std.core.num.U32.to_le_bytes attempt).val.map byte ++
    ([byte stream] ++ ((Aeneas.Std.core.num.U64.to_le_bytes counter).val.map byte ++ [])))) = _
  rw [R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes.le32_source, R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes.le64_source]
  simp only [address, List.append_nil, List.append_assoc]

abbrev Index (count : Nat) := Fin 8 × Fin 4 × Fin count

def indexedAddress {count : Nat} (seed : OracleAnswer) (i : Index count) : List UInt8 :=
  address (List.ofFn seed) i.1.val (UInt8.ofNat i.2.1.val) i.2.2.val

theorem indexed_length {count : Nat} (seed : OracleAnswer) (i : Index count) :
    (indexedAddress seed i).length = 65 := by
  simp only [indexedAddress, address, List.length_append, List.length_map,
    List.length_ofFn, List.length_singleton]
  rfl

/-- Attempt, stream and counter remain distinct after byte concatenation,
provided the counter has not wrapped. No concrete address universe is read. -/
theorem indexed_injective {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64) (seed : OracleAnswer) :
    Function.Injective (indexedAddress (count := count) seed) := by
  intro i j same
  have body : R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 i.1.val ++
      [UInt8.ofNat i.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 i.2.2.val =
      R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 j.1.val ++
      [UInt8.ofNat j.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 j.2.2.val := by
    unfold indexedAddress address at same
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using List.append_cancel_left
      (List.append_cancel_left (show domain.val.map byte ++
        (List.ofFn seed ++ (R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 i.1.val ++
          ([UInt8.ofNat i.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 i.2.2.val))) =
        domain.val.map byte ++
        (List.ofFn seed ++ (R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 j.1.val ++
          ([UInt8.ofNat j.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 j.2.2.val))) from by
        simpa only [List.append_assoc] using same))
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc] at body
  obtain ⟨attempt, tail⟩ := List.append_inj body (by rfl)
  have ha : i.1 = j.1 := Fin.ext (R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le32_inj _ _
    (lt_of_lt_of_le i.1.isLt (by norm_num))
    (lt_of_lt_of_le j.1.isLt (by norm_num)) attempt)
  have parts := List.cons.inj tail
  have stream := congrArg UInt8.toNat parts.1
  change i.2.1.val % 256 = j.2.1.val % 256 at stream
  have hi : i.2.1.val < 256 := lt_of_lt_of_le i.2.1.isLt (by norm_num)
  have hj : j.2.1.val < 256 := lt_of_lt_of_le j.2.1.isLt (by norm_num)
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj] at stream
  have hs : i.2.1 = j.2.1 := Fin.ext stream
  have hc : i.2.2 = j.2.2 := Fin.ext (R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64_inj _ _
    (lt_of_lt_of_le i.2.2.isLt room) (lt_of_lt_of_le j.2.2.isLt room) parts.2)
  exact Prod.ext ha (Prod.ext hs hc)

def key {count : Nat} (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer)
    (i : Index count) : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound :=
  ⟨indexedAddress seed i, (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.mem_domain bound (indexedAddress seed i)).mpr
    (by simpa only [indexed_length] using fits)⟩

theorem key_injective {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64)
    (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer) :
    Function.Injective (key (count := count) bound fits seed) := by
  intro i j same
  exact indexed_injective room seed (congrArg Subtype.val same)

/-- Under the explicit uniform finite random-oracle table law, these source
coin requests have the independent coordinate law used by the model. The
seed is fixed, not a replacement for the table's randomness. -/
theorem coins_uniform {Answer : Type} [Fintype Answer] [Nonempty Answer]
    {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64)
    (bound : Nat) [finiteAddress : Fintype (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound)]
    (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer) :
    MP (fun table : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → Answer =>
      fun i : Index count => table (key bound fits seed i)) := by
  intro f
  have he := R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory.coordinates_uniform (U := Answer)
    (key bound fits seed) (key_injective room bound fits seed) f
  convert he using 1 <;> apply R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport

#print axioms source_frame
#print axioms indexed_length
#print axioms indexed_injective
#print axioms key_injective
#print axioms coins_uniform
end R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18

R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorSeedGuess18.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
import R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18
/-! One simulator-coin/shared-oracle component, not a final-game attack.
Even a perfectly uniform table gives a seeded hash coin a joint correlation
with a query at a guessed seed. Independent coin marginals do not discharge
this history boundary. Retry/accepted-view projection is not proved here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorSeedGuess18
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {U : Type} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- For fixed attempt/stream/counter, the source coin frames are also
injective in the seed. The shared-table seed-guess experiment below therefore
uses the same address relation, rather than a leaking invented experiment. -/
theorem seed_addresses_injective (attempt : Nat) (stream : UInt8) (counter : Nat) :
    Function.Injective (fun seed : R0Z.FsStatement.OracleAnswer =>
      ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.address (List.ofFn seed) attempt stream counter) := by
  intro seed other same
  unfold ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.address at same
  have h1 := List.append_cancel_right same
  have h2 := List.append_cancel_right h1
  have h3 := List.append_cancel_right h2
  have seeds := List.append_cancel_left h3
  simpa only [List.ofFn_inj] using seeds

/-- Two different entries of one uniform table coincide with mass 1/|U|. -/
theorem table_collision (a b : U) (different : a ≠ b) :
    eventMass (fun table : U → U => table a = table b) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [R0Z.FsAbort.mean_equiv (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt b)]
  have left (p : U × ({x : U // x ≠ b} → U)) :
      (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt b).symm p a = p.2 ⟨a, different⟩ := by
    change (if h : a = b then p.1 else p.2 ⟨a, h⟩) = _
    rw [dif_neg different]
  have right (p : U × ({x : U // x ≠ b} → U)) :
      (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt b).symm p b = p.1 := by
    change (if h : b = b then p.1 else p.2 ⟨b, h⟩) = _
    rw [dif_pos rfl]
  simp_rw [left, right]
  rw [mean_product]
  have inner (v : U) :
      mean (fun rest : {x : U // x ≠ b} → U =>
        if rest ⟨a, different⟩ = v then (1 : ℚ) else 0) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) :=
    by simpa only [eventMass] using
      (eval_point_mass (A := {x : U // x ≠ b}) (U := U) ⟨a, different⟩ v)
  simp_rw [inner]
  exact mean_const _

/-- A source coin is H(seed), and one observer answer is H(guess).
Both use the same table, as HOST_HASH and programmed_hash's fallback do. -/
def observation (guess : U) (randomness : U × (U → U)) : U × U :=
  (randomness.2 randomness.1, randomness.2 guess)

def equalTest (pair : U × U) : ℚ := if pair.1 = pair.2 then 1 else 0

theorem independent_probability :
    mean (equalTest (U := U)) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold equalTest
  rw [mean_product]
  have inner (v : U) : mean (fun w : U => if v = w then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [eventMass, eq_comm (a := v)] using (point_mass v)
  simp_rw [inner]
  exact mean_const _

theorem seeded_probability (guess : U) :
    mean (fun r => equalTest (observation guess r)) =
      1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) +
        (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold observation equalTest
  rw [mean_product]
  let q : ℚ := 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)
  have inner (seed : U) :
      mean (fun table : U → U => if table seed = table guess then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
        if seed = guess then 1 else q := by
    by_cases same : seed = guess
    · subst seed
      simp only [if_pos rfl]
      exact mean_const 1
    · rw [if_neg same]
      simpa only [eventMass, q] using table_collision seed guess same
  simp_rw [inner]
  have decompose (seed : U) : (if seed = guess then (1 : ℚ) else q) =
      q + (if seed = guess then 1-q else 0) := by
    split <;> ring
  simp_rw [decompose]
  rw [mean_add', mean_const]
  congr 1
  simp only [mean, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  rfl

/-- For 256-bit seeds/answers the one-query correlation exceeds the entire
8 × 2^-486 query-scan allowance. This is a component loss, not a 100-bit
privacy break and not a statement about the accepted final proof view. -/
theorem numerical_gap :
    (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 < (1 - 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  have two_le : (2 : ℚ) ≤ 2^256 := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≤ 2) (by omega : 1 ≤ 256)
    simpa only [pow_one] using h
  have qhalf : (1 : ℚ) / 2^256 ≤ 1/2 :=
    one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) two_le
  have lower : (1 : ℚ) / 2^257 ≤ (1 - 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
    calc
      _ = (1/2 : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
        rw [show 257 = 256+1 from rfl, pow_succ]
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have eight : (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^483 := by
    rw [show 486 = 483+3 from rfl, pow_add, show (2 : ℚ)^3 = 8 by norm_num]
    ring
  rw [eight]
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ lower
  apply one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity)
  exact pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 257 < 483)

/-- No coupling of this precise coin/one-query component can give full
observation equality outside an event with only the query-scan budget. -/
theorem no_query_scan_only_join (size : Fintype.card U = 2^256) (guess : U) :
    ¬ ∃ (cp : Coupling (U × (U → U)) (U × U)) (bad : U × U → Prop),
      eventMass bad ≤ (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 ∧
      (∀ s, ¬ bad (cp.toM s) → observation guess (cp.toR s) = cp.toM s) := by
  rintro ⟨cp, bad, mass, agrees⟩
  have bounded (pair : U × U) : 0 ≤ equalTest pair ∧ equalTest pair ≤ 1 := by
    unfold equalTest
    split <;> norm_num
  have comparison := until_bad
    (fun s => equalTest (observation guess (cp.toR s)))
    (fun s => equalTest (cp.toM s))
    (fun s => bounded _) (fun s => bounded _)
    (fun s => bad (cp.toM s)) (fun s hn => congrArg equalTest (agrees s hn))
  have hm : eventMass (fun s => bad (cp.toM s)) = eventMass bad :=
    cp.meanM (fun m => if bad m then 1 else 0)
  have hr := cp.meanR (fun r => equalTest (observation guess r))
  have hi := cp.meanM (equalTest (U := U))
  rw [hr, hi, hm, seeded_probability, independent_probability] at comparison
  have gap : (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 <
      (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [size, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using numerical_gap
  have positive : 0 < (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) :=
    lt_trans (by positivity) gap
  have cancel (a b : ℚ) : a+b-a = b := by ring
  rw [cancel, abs_of_pos positive] at comparison
  exact (not_le_of_gt gap) (comparison.trans mass)

#print axioms seed_addresses_injective
#print axioms table_collision
#print axioms independent_probability
#print axioms seeded_probability
#print axioms numerical_gap
#print axioms no_query_scan_only_join
end R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorSeedGuess18

R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin.text:
import R1Z.SimulatorR1

/-! Finite-law support transport, used to carry the binary R-wire log from
honest views to ZF2's explicit simulator without an additional wire axiom. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin
open R0Z

/-- Every output of an equal-law finite sampler is an output of the other.
This transports existence only; it does not change the simulator algorithm. -/
theorem equalLaws_output {R T V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype T]
    (f : R → V) (g : T → V) (h : EqualLaws f g) (t : T) :
    ∃ r, f r = g t := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  have hf : ∀ r, f r ≠ g t := by simpa using hn
  have hz : law f (g t) = 0 := by
    simp [law, mean, hf]
  haveI : Nonempty T := ⟨t⟩
  have hp : 0 < law g (g t) := by
    unfold law mean
    apply div_pos _ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
    have hb : (1 : ℚ) ≤ ∑ s : T, if g s = g t then (1 : ℚ) else 0 := by
      simpa using (Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun s : T => if g s = g t then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun s _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ t))
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hb
  rw [← h (g t), hz] at hp
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hp

#print axioms equalLaws_output
end R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin

R1Z.SimulatorLogR1PBin.text:
import R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin
import R1Z.EventsR1PBin

/-! ZF2's verifier programming uses the binary multiproof read sets. The
payload simulator has no tree geometry: it is `simE` of RefPayload. Geometry
enters through W.comLog and progOracle. RComLog is stated on honest views;
finite-law support transports it to simE on precisely P_R1 ∧ VR1, the domain
of hvzk_R1S. No additional simulator-wire premise is introduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.SimulatorLogR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- On the HVZK domain, every simulated payload has an honest-view preimage.
The witness/tape are used only in this proof, never by simE. -/
theorem simE_honest_preimage (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch)
    (hV : VR1 h ch w) (hw : h.public w = x.1) (t : Tape K F) :
    ∃ τ, view (Bat := R1Bat) h B outputs x w ch τ = simE h.transport B outputs x ch t :=
  SimulatorSupportBin.equalLaws_output _ _
    (hvzk_R1S h B hB outputs x hpub hs w ch hP hV hw) t

/-- The actual comLog at a simulated view is the concatenation of two
binary batches. Each batch reads exactly batchReadSet, without duplicates;
supplied siblings and slot padding add no read positions. -/
theorem simE_comLog_batches (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr)
    (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch)
    (hV : VR1 h ch w) (hw : h.public w = x.1) (t : Tape K F)
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer)
    (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) :
    ∃ (τ : Tape K F) (fib : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Finset Fib)
      (reads : Fin 2 → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)),
      W.comLog (eCm.symm rest) roots (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) ch =
        (reads 0).map (fun c =>
          (gram (E₁ := Pr.E₁) (E₂ := Pr.E₂) (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest (cposOf c),
            ansC roots rest c)) ++
        (reads 1).map (fun c =>
          (gram (E₁ := Pr.E₁) (E₂ := Pr.E₂) (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest (cposOf c),
            ansC roots rest c)) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).Nodup) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).toFinset = batchReadSet (fib b)) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).length = (batchReadSet (fib b)).card) ∧
      (∀ T, Pr.openFib ch T = fib 0 T ∪ fib 1 T) := by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := simE_honest_preimage h B hB outputs x hpub hs w ch hP hV hw t
  obtain ⟨fib, reads, hcat, hn, hc, hu⟩ := hop.batches
  refine ⟨τ, fib ch, reads ch, ?_, hn ch, ?_, ?_, hu ch⟩
  · rw [← hτ, hcom w sec d τ roots rest ch]
    simp_rw [hb h w x sec d τ rest ch]
    rw [hcat ch, List.map_append]
  · intro b
    exact batch_toFinset _ _ (hc ch b)
  · intro b
    exact batch_length _ _ (hn ch b) (hc ch b)

/-- The ideal game's programmed table is exactly its verifier log: transcript
reads followed by comLog at the explicit simulated view, with fallback only
when the address is absent. Duplicate reads across batches use List.lookup. -/
theorem simE_progOracle (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Tape K F)
    (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (tab : W.Tab) (a : List UInt8) :
    progOracle W x (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) c tab a =
      match List.lookup a
        (tLog W x (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) c ++
          W.comLog c.2.2.1 c.2.1 (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) (drawW W c)) with
      | some v => v
      | none => W.look tab a := rfl

#print axioms simE_honest_preimage
#print axioms simE_comLog_batches
#print axioms simE_progOracle
end R1Z.SimulatorLogR1PBin

R1Z.EventsR1P2Bin.text:
import R1Z.EventsR1PBin
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Option
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Option

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.EventsR1P2` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! Events and freshness, part 2 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5): positions, addresses,
charging, adversary reads; the update lemmas for every designated-field lens. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.EventsR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- `card_NZ` for any `Fintype NZ` instance (LOG D68.3): counted through
`Option NZ ≃ OracleAnswer` (`Equiv.optionSubtypeNe 0`) and `card_ans`.  The only
cross-module instance (the one `card_ans` was elaborated with) enters through
`Subsingleton (Fintype _)`, so no two instances are compared by reduction. -/
theorem card_NZ_of (i : Fintype NZ) : 2 ^ 255 ≤ @Fintype.card NZ i := by
  have hA : ∀ j : Fintype OracleAnswer, @Fintype.card OracleAnswer j = 2 ^ 256 := fun j =>
    (congrArg (@Fintype.card OracleAnswer) (Subsingleton.elim j _)).trans card_ans
  have e : Option NZ ≃ OracleAnswer := Equiv.optionSubtypeNe (0 : OracleAnswer)
  have h2 : Fintype.card NZ + 1 = 2 ^ 256 := by
    rw [← Fintype.card_option, Fintype.card_congr e]
    exact hA _
  have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 255 < 2 ^ 256 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  omega

theorem card_NZ : 2 ^ 255 ≤ Fintype.card NZ := card_NZ_of _

def nzOf (a : OracleAnswer) : NZ := if hz : a ≠ 0 then ⟨a, hz⟩ else Classical.arbitrary NZ

theorem nzOf_val (z : NZ) : nzOf z.1 = z := by
  unfold nzOf
  rw [dif_pos z.2]

section Ev
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)

/-- The statement digest on the coupling space (attempt 0's table is the base table). -/
def dS (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : OracleAnswer :=
  lookA R (R.eTab (s ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) (W.pubBytes x)

/-- The address of position `p` on the lazy answers. -/
def addrQ (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) : List UInt8 :=
  attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (s p.1).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (s p.1).2.1 p.2

def accM (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Option (Fin N) := accR W N P h V w (toMP W Pr eCm s)

/-- Commitment position `c` of attempt `k` is opened by the verifier. -/
def pubC (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) : Prop :=
  c ∈ (Pr.openList (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))).map cposOf

/-- Charged: not published by the accepted attempt. -/
def chargedQ (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → Prop
  | (k, .inl _) => accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s ≠ some k
  | (k, .inr c) => ¬ (accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k ∧ pubC W Pr N s k c)

def qryQ (i : Fin W.qmax) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : List UInt8 :=
  qryR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i (toMP W Pr eCm s)

/-! ### Block lenses that leave the table and the tape alone -/

/-- A block lens of attempt `k` that moves neither the spare tape, the table,
nor the expander answers. -/
structure Tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) : Prop where
  tail : ∀ a u, (L.set a u).2.2 = a.2.2
  e₁ : ∀ a u, e₁Of (L.set a u).2.1 = e₁Of a.2.1
  e₂ : ∀ a u, e₂Of (L.set a u).2.1 = e₂Of a.2.1
  ch : ∀ a u, chOf (K := K) W (trOf (L.set a u).2.1) = chOf W (trOf a.2.1)

theorem dS_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) :
    dS W Pr R N hN x ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) = dS W Pr R N hN x s := by
  unfold dS
  by_cases hk : (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin N) = k
  · rw [hk, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.tail]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk]

theorem accM_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) :
    accM W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) = accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s := by
  unfold accM accR
  have e1 : ∀ ct : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F),
      firstGood (fun c => P (drawW W c) ∧ V (drawW W c) w) ct.1 =
        firstGood (fun j => P (drawW W (ct.1 j)) ∧ V (drawW W (ct.1 j)) w) id := fun _ => rfl
  rw [e1, e1]
  apply firstGood_congr
  intro j
  show P (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1)) ∧ V (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1)) w ↔
    P (chOf W (trOf (s j).2.1)) ∧ V (chOf W (trOf (s j).2.1)) w
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.ch]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

theorem pubC_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (k' : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    pubC W Pr N ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) k' c ↔ pubC W Pr N s k' c := by
  unfold pubC
  by_cases hk : k' = k
  · rw [hk, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.ch]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk]

theorem charged_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) p ↔ chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s p := by
  obtain ⟨k', q | c⟩ := p
  · show accM W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) ≠ some k' ↔ _
    rw [accM_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w L hL]
    rfl
  · show ¬ (accM W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) = some k' ∧
      pubC W Pr N ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) k' c) ↔ _
    rw [accM_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w L hL, pubC_tame W Pr N L hL]
    rfl

theorem toMP_tame_tape {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) :
    (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).2 = (toMP W Pr eCm s).2 := by
  funext j
  show (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1) (e₂Of (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1)).getD
      (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.2.1 = _
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.e₁, hL.e₂, hL.tail]
    rfl
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]
    rfl

theorem toMP_tame_other {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (j : Fin N) (hj : j ≠ k) :
    (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 j = (toMP W Pr eCm s).1 j := by
  show (gM W Pr eCm (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j)).1 = (gM W Pr eCm (s j)).1
  rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

theorem toMP_tame_tab {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (j : Fin N) :
    ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 j).2.2.2 = ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 j).2.2.2 := by
  show (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.2.2 = (s j).2.2.2
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.tail]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

theorem toMP_tame_draw {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (j : Fin N) :
    drawW (K := K) W ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 j) = drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 j) := by
  show chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1) = chOf W (trOf (s j).2.1)
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.ch]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

/-- The adversary's middle log depends only on the acceptance, the accepted
attempt's draw, tape and verifier log, and the base table. -/
theorem advLogR_congr (ct ct' : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F))
    (hacc : accR W N P h V w ct' = accR W N P h V w ct)
    (htab : (ct'.1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2 = (ct.1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2)
    (hk : ∀ k₀, accR W N P h V w ct = some k₀ →
      drawW (K := K) W (ct'.1 k₀) = drawW W (ct.1 k₀) ∧ ct'.2 k₀ = ct.2 k₀ ∧
      verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k₀)) (ct.2 k₀)) (ct'.1 k₀) =
        verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k₀)) (ct.2 k₀)) (ct.1 k₀)) :
    advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv ct' = advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv ct := by
  unfold advLogR
  rw [hacc]
  rcases hA : accR W N P h V w ct with _ | k₀
  · simp only [htab]
  · obtain ⟨hd, ht, hv⟩ := hk k₀ hA
    simp only
    rw [hd, ht]
    unfold progOracle
    rw [hv, htab]

/-! ### The chain lenses are tame -/

theorem tame_chain (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c) : Tame W Pr (chainL W Pr c) := by
  cases c with
  | root =>
      refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inr (.inl 0)) u)) = _
        rw [trOf_update_root]
  | sel =>
      refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u)) = _
        rw [trOf_update_tr]
        exact chOf_update_tr W _ (TRead.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1)) (fun h => h) u
  | ans j =>
      refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inl j) u)) = _
        rw [trOf_update_tr]
        exact chOf_update_tr W _ _ (hc j rfl) u

theorem tame_sec (i : Fin 3) : Tame W Pr (secL W Pr i) :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

theorem tame_rest (q : RIdx) : Tame W Pr (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))) := by
  refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
  · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, vL, Function.update_apply]
  · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, vL, Function.update_apply]
  · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inr (.inr (.inr q))) u)) = _
    congr 1

end Ev

#print axioms card_NZ_of
#print axioms card_NZ
#print axioms nzOf_val
#print axioms dS_tame
#print axioms accM_tame
#print axioms charged_tame
#print axioms toMP_tame_tape
#print axioms toMP_tame_other
#print axioms toMP_tame_tab
#print axioms toMP_tame_draw
#print axioms advLogR_congr
#print axioms tame_chain
#print axioms tame_sec
#print axioms tame_rest
#print axioms pubC_tame
end R1Z.EventsR1PBin

R1Z.EventsR1P3Bin.text:
import R1Z.EventsR1P2Bin

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.EventsR1P3` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! Events and freshness, part 3 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5): `HitFresh` for every
position (`hit_tr`, `hit_cm`) and `PairFresh` for every pair of distinct
positions (`pair_all`). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.EventsR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

section Blocks
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)

theorem tapeR_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L)
    (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) : tapeR W Pr (L.set a u).2.1 = tapeR W Pr a.2.1 := by
  unfold tapeR
  rw [hL.e₁, hL.e₂]

theorem restOf_vL_rest (q : RIdx) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    restOf ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set a u).2.1 = Function.update (restOf a.2.1) q u := by
  funext q'
  by_cases hq : q' = q
  · subst hq
    simp [vL, restOf]
  · simp [vL, restOf, Function.update_of_ne hq]

theorem trOf_vL_rest (q : RIdx) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    trOf ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set a u).2.1 = trOf a.2.1 := by
  funext j
  simp [vL, trOf]

theorem rootsOf_vL_rest (q : RIdx) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    rootsOf ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set a u).2.1 = rootsOf a.2.1 := by
  funext i
  simp [vL, rootsOf]

theorem restOf_chain (c : Coord) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    restOf ((chainL W Pr c).set a u).2.1 = restOf a.2.1 := by
  funext q
  cases c <;> simp [chainL, vL, selL, restOf]

theorem sec_chain (c : Coord) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    ((chainL W Pr c).set a u).1 = a.1 := by
  cases c <;> rfl

end Blocks

section Fresh
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)

theorem addrQ_cm (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N)
    (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c) =
      gram (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x (tapeR W Pr (s k).2.1) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)))
        (s k).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (restOf (s k).2.1) c :=
  hb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

theorem addrQ_other {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hk : p.1 ≠ k) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) p =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p := by
  unfold addrQ
  rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk, dS_tame W Pr R N hN x L hL]

theorem addrQ_tr_inv {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L)
    (htr : ∀ a u, trOf (L.set a u).2.1 = trOf a.2.1) (hrt : ∀ a u, rootsOf (L.set a u).2.1 = rootsOf a.2.1)
    (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (k' : Fin N) (j : TRead) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) (k', .inl j) =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k', .inl j) := by
  by_cases hk : k' = k
  · subst hk
    show addr j (recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1))
        (tapeR W Pr (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1)) (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1)
        (rootsOf (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1)) = _
    rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq, htr, hrt, tapeR_tame W Pr L hL]
    rfl
  · exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w L hL k s u _ hk

theorem addrQ_cm_chain (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c) (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (u : OracleAnswer) (k' : Fin N) (c' : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) (k', .inr c') =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k', .inr c') := by
  by_cases hk : k' = k
  · subst hk
    show Pr.caddr h w x (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').1
        (dS W Pr R N hN x ((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u))
        (tapeR W Pr (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').2.1)
        (restOf (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').2.1)
        (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').2.1)) c' = _
    rw [dS_tame W Pr R N hN x _ (tame_chain W Pr c hc), Lens.fnAt_set_eq, sec_chain,
      tapeR_tame W Pr _ (tame_chain W Pr c hc), restOf_chain, (tame_chain W Pr c hc).ch]
    rfl
  · exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w _ (tame_chain W Pr c hc) k s u _ hk

theorem addrQ_sec_inv (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (i : Fin 3) (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (z : NZ) (c' : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hd : ¬ depS c' (.inl i)) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)).set s z) (k, .inr c') =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c') := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb,
    dS_tame W Pr R N hN x _ (tame_sec W Pr i), Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
  exact gram_sec_update _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hd

theorem addrQ_rest_inv (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (q : RIdx) (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (u : OracleAnswer) (c' : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hd : ¬ depS c' (.inr q)) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u) (k, .inr c') =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c') := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb,
    dS_tame W Pr R N hN x _ (tame_rest W Pr q), Lens.fnAt_set_eq,
    tapeR_tame W Pr _ (tame_rest W Pr q), (tame_rest W Pr q).ch, restOf_vL_rest,
    show ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set (s k) u).1 = (s k).1 from rfl]
  convert gram_rest_update (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag
    (Pr.leafVal h w x (tapeR W Pr (s k).2.1) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))) (s k).1
    (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (restOf (s k).2.1) q u c' hd

theorem fld_sec (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (i : Fin 3)
    (hs : src c = .inl i) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (z : NZ) :
    nzOf (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c
      (addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)).set s z) (k, .inr c))) = z := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, fld_gram, hs]
  rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
  show nzOf ((Function.update (s k).1 i z) i).1 = z
  rw [Function.update_self, nzOf_val]

theorem fld_rest (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (q : RIdx)
    (hs : src c = .inr q) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    fld (W.pubBytes x).length c
      (addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u)
        (k, .inr c)) = u := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, fld_gram, hs, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, restOf_vL_rest]
  show Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u q = u
  rw [Function.update_self]

/-- A commitment read's designated field is fresh against every address that
its lens does not move. -/
theorem cm_pf (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂)
    (fa : (Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) → List UInt8)
    (hsec : ∀ i, src c = .inl i → ∀ s z, fa ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)).set s z) = fa s)
    (hrest : ∀ q, src c = .inr q → ∀ s u,
      fa ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u) = fa s) :
    PairFresh fa (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c)) (2 ^ 255) := by
  rcases hsrc : src c with i | q
  · exact pairFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)) fa _
      (fun a => nzOf (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c a)) _ card_NZ (hsec i hsrc)
      (fld_sec W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c i hsrc)
  · exact pairFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))) fa _
      (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c) _ umin_le_card_ans (hrest q hsrc)
      (fld_rest W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c q hsrc)

theorem pub_of_opened (hop : ROpen Pr) (ch : Challenges K) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂)
    (hc : openedC (Pr.openFib ch) c) : c ∈ (Pr.openList ch).map cposOf := by
  rcases c with T | (e | e) | q
  · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨.inl T, (hop.covers ch _).mpr trivial, rfl⟩
  · exact absurd hc id
  · exact absurd hc id
  · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨.inr q, (hop.covers ch _).mpr hc, rfl⟩

/-! ### Pair freshness -/

theorem pair_all (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (p p' : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hne : p ≠ p') :
    PairFresh (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p)
        (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p') (2 ^ 255) ∨
      PairFresh (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p')
        (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p) (2 ^ 255) := by
  have Fr := frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N
  obtain ⟨k, j | c⟩ := p <;> obtain ⟨k', j' | c'⟩ := p'
  · have hne' : (k, j) ≠ (k', j') := fun e => hne (by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj e
      rfl)
    exact pairFresh_transcript (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) (k, j) (k', j') hne'
  · refine Or.inr (pairFresh_of_lens ((frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N).lens k (fc j)) _
      (taddr (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j) (extract j) _ umin_le_card_ans ?_
      (taddr_extract (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j))
    intro s u
    exact addrQ_cm_chain W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w (fc j) (chain_fc j) k s u k' c'
  · refine Or.inl (pairFresh_of_lens ((frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N).lens k' (fc j')) _
      (taddr (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k' j') (extract j') _ umin_le_card_ans ?_
      (taddr_extract (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k' j'))
    intro s u
    exact addrQ_cm_chain W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w (fc j') (chain_fc j') k' s u k c
  · by_cases hk : k = k'
    · subst hk
      have hc : c ≠ c' := fun e => hne (by rw [e])
      rcases fresh_or_sep hE₁ hE₂ c c' hc with h1 | h2 | h3
      · refine Or.inr (cm_pf W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c _ ?_ ?_)
        · intro i hi s z
          exact addrQ_sec_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb i k s z c' (by rw [← hi]; exact h1)
        · intro q hq s u
          exact addrQ_rest_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb q k s u c' (by rw [← hq]; exact h1)
      · refine Or.inl (cm_pf W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c' _ ?_ ?_)
        · intro i hi s z
          exact addrQ_sec_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb i k s z c (by rw [← hi]; exact h2)
        · intro q hq s u
          exact addrQ_rest_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb q k s u c (by rw [← hq]; exact h2)
      · refine Or.inl (pairFresh_of_ne _ _ _ (fun s => ?_))
        show addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c) ≠ addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c')
        rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb]
        exact h3 _ _ _ _ _ _
    · refine Or.inr (cm_pf W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c _ ?_ ?_)
      · intro i _ s z
        exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w _ (tame_sec W Pr i) k s z (k', .inr c')
          (fun e => hk e.symm)
      · intro q _ s u
        exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w _ (tame_rest W Pr q) k s u (k', .inr c')
          (fun e => hk e.symm)

end Fresh

import R1Z.EventsR1P3Bin

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.EventsR1P4` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! Events and freshness, part 4 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5): `HitFresh` for every
position.  A charged read's designated field is invisible to the middle
adversary: for an unaccepted attempt nothing of it is published; for an
unopened read of the accepted attempt, `hidden` + `RComLog` show the
verifier log does not move (`verLog_rest`). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.EventsR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

section Hit
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)

theorem qry_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U)
    (hv : accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k →
      verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
          ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 k) =
        verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
          ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k))
    (i : Fin W.qmax) :
    qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) =
      qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s := by
  unfold qryQ qryR
  rw [advLogR_congr W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv (toMP W Pr eCm s)
    (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)) (accM_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w L hL k s u)
    (toMP_tame_tab W Pr eCm N L hL k s u ⟨0, hN⟩) ?_]
  intro k₀ hk₀
  refine ⟨toMP_tame_draw W Pr eCm N L hL k s u k₀, congrFun (toMP_tame_tape W Pr eCm N L hL k s u) k₀, ?_⟩
  by_cases hkk : k₀ = k
  · subst hkk
    exact hv hk₀
  · rw [toMP_tame_other W Pr eCm N L k s u k₀ hkk]

theorem hit_tr (k : Fin N) (j : TRead) (i : Fin W.qmax) :
    HitFresh (fun s => chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (k, .inl j))
      (qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i)
      (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inl j)) (2 ^ 255) := by
  refine hitFresh_transcript (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j _ _ ?_ ?_
  · intro s u hs
    exact (charged_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w (chainL W Pr (fc j)) (tame_chain W Pr (fc j) (chain_fc j))
      k s u (k, .inl j)).mpr hs
  · intro s u hs
    exact qry_tame W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv _ (tame_chain W Pr (fc j) (chain_fc j)) k s u
      (fun ha => absurd ha hs) i

theorem verLog_rest (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr)
    (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N)
    (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (q : RIdx) (hs : src c = .inr q) (hnp : ¬ pubC W Pr N s k c)
    (u : OracleAnswer) :
    verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u)).1 k) =
      verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k) := by
  have e1 : (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u)).1 k =
      (trOf (s k).2.1, rootsOf (s k).2.1, eCm.symm (Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u),
        (s k).2.2.2) := by
    show (gM W Pr eCm (((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u) k)).1 = _
    rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
    show (trOf _, rootsOf _, eCm.symm (restOf _), _) = _
    rw [trOf_vL_rest, rootsOf_vL_rest, restOf_vL_rest]
    rfl
  rw [e1]
  show tLog W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        (trOf (s k).2.1, rootsOf (s k).2.1, eCm.symm (Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u), (s k).2.2.2) ++
      W.comLog (eCm.symm (Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u)) (rootsOf (s k).2.1)
        (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k)) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) =
    tLog W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        (trOf (s k).2.1, rootsOf (s k).2.1, eCm.symm (restOf (s k).2.1), (s k).2.2.2) ++
      W.comLog (eCm.symm (restOf (s k).2.1)) (rootsOf (s k).2.1)
        (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k)) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))
  rw [hcom w (s k).1 0 ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (rootsOf (s k).2.1) _ _,
    hcom w (s k).1 0 ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (rootsOf (s k).2.1) _ _]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro c0 hc0
  obtain ⟨hdep, hne⟩ := hidden (Pr.openFib (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))) c0
    ((hop.covers _ c0).mp hc0) c (fun ho => hnp (pub_of_opened W Pr hop _ c ho)) q hs
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · show Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ = Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    rw [hb, hb]
    convert gram_rest_update (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag
      (Pr.leafVal h w x ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))) (s k).1
      0 (restOf (s k).2.1) q u (cposOf c0) hdep
  · rcases c0 with i | q'
    · rfl
    · show Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u q' = restOf (s k).2.1 q'
      exact Function.update_of_ne (fun e => hne (by rw [e])) _ _

theorem hit_cm (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (i : Fin W.qmax) :
    HitFresh (fun s => chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (k, .inr c))
      (qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i)
      (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c)) (2 ^ 255) := by
  rcases hsrc : src c with i' | q
  · refine hitFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i')) _ _ _
      (fun a => nzOf (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c a)) _ card_NZ ?_ ?_
      (fld_sec W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c i' hsrc)
    · intro s z hs
      exact (charged_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w _ (tame_sec W Pr i') k s z (k, .inr c)).mpr hs
    · intro s z _
      refine qry_tame W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv _ (tame_sec W Pr i') k s z (fun _ => ?_) i
      have e : (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i')).set s z)).1 k = (toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k := by
        show (gM W Pr eCm (((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i')).set s z) k)).1 = (gM W Pr eCm (s k)).1
        rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
        rfl
      rw [e]
  · refine hitFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))) _ _ _
      (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c) _ umin_le_card_ans ?_ ?_
      (fld_rest W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c q hsrc)
    · intro s u hs
      exact (charged_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w _ (tame_rest W Pr q) k s u (k, .inr c)).mpr hs
    · intro s u hs
      refine qry_tame W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv _ (tame_rest W Pr q) k s u (fun ha => ?_) i
      exact verLog_rest W Pr eCm N h B outputs x w hb hop hcom s k c q hsrc
        (fun hp => hs ⟨ha, hp⟩) u

end Hit

#print axioms qry_tame
#print axioms hit_tr
#print axioms verLog_rest
#print axioms hit_cm
end R1Z.EventsR1PBin
