import R1Z.EventsR1P4Bin

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.AgreeR1P` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! Agreement of the real and middle games, part 1 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5): the
real run on the coupling.  Off collisions and off the digest address, the
honest in-order run against the reprogrammed table reads exactly the lazy
answers (`run_eq_lazy`), every read is answered by its own coordinate
(`ans_eq`), and the table is the base table at every other address
(`lookA_off`).  Generic: `runLog_congr`, lookup lemmas. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.AgreeR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Generic list facts -/

theorem runLog_congr : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : OProg) (O₁ O₂ : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer),
    (∀ e ∈ runLog p O₂ n, O₁ e.1 = O₂ e.1) → runLog p O₁ n = runLog p O₂ n
  | 0, p, _, _, _ => by cases p <;> rfl
  | n + 1, .done, _, _, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, .query a k, O₁, O₂, h => by
      have ha : O₁ a = O₂ a := h (a, O₂ a) List.mem_cons_self
      show (a, O₁ a) :: runLog (k (O₁ a)) O₁ n = (a, O₂ a) :: runLog (k (O₂ a)) O₂ n
      rw [ha, runLog_congr n (k (O₂ a)) O₁ O₂ (fun e he => h e (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he))]

theorem length_runLog : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : OProg) (O : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer),
    (runLog p O n).length ≤ n
  | 0, p, _ => by cases p <;> simp [runLog]
  | n + 1, .done, _ => by simp [runLog]
  | n + 1, .query a k, O => by
      show ((a, O a) :: runLog (k (O a)) O n).length ≤ n + 1
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (length_runLog n _ O)

theorem mem_getD {β : Type} (l : List β) (d : β) (q : ℕ) (hl : l.length ≤ q) (e : β) (he : e ∈ l) :
    ∃ i : Fin q, l.getD i.val d = e := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp he
  exact ⟨⟨i, lt_of_lt_of_le hi hl⟩, by simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hi]⟩

theorem lookup_map_none {ι α β : Type} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (f : ι → α) (g : ι → β) (y : α) :
    ∀ l : List ι, (∀ i ∈ l, f i ≠ y) → List.lookup y (l.map (fun i => (f i, g i))) = none
  | [], _ => rfl
  | i :: l, h => by
      rw [List.map_cons, List.lookup_cons]
      have hb : (y == f i) = false := by
        rw [beq_eq_false_iff_ne]
        exact fun e => h i List.mem_cons_self e.symm
      rw [hb]
      exact lookup_map_none f g y l (fun j hj => h j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj))

theorem lookup_map_some {ι α β : Type} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (f : ι → α) (g : ι → β) (y : α) (b : β) :
    ∀ l : List ι, (∃ i ∈ l, f i = y) → (∀ i ∈ l, f i = y → g i = b) →
      List.lookup y (l.map (fun i => (f i, g i))) = some b
  | [], ⟨_, hi, _⟩, _ => absurd hi List.not_mem_nil
  | i :: l, ⟨i₀, hi₀, he⟩, h => by
      rw [List.map_cons, List.lookup_cons]
      by_cases hyi : f i = y
      · have hb : (y == f i) = true := by rw [beq_iff_eq]; exact hyi.symm
        rw [hb, h i List.mem_cons_self hyi]
      · have hb : (y == f i) = false := by rw [beq_eq_false_iff_ne]; exact fun e => hyi e.symm
        rw [hb]
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hi₀ with rfl | hl
        · exact absurd he hyi
        · exact lookup_map_some f g y b l ⟨i₀, hl, he⟩ (fun j hj => h j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj))

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

section Run
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance)

/-- Global read index ↦ read position. -/
def posE : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) ≃ Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ :=
  finProdFinEquiv.symm.trans (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl _) Pr.ord)

theorem addrQ_posE (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (g : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) =
      gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s) g (uVec W Pr s) := by
  show attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (s (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s)
      (s (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1).2.1 (Pr.ord (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2) =
    attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (s (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s)
      (attVec W Pr (uVec W Pr s) (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1) (Pr.ord (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2)
  rw [attVec_uVec]

theorem gAddr_causal (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (sec : Fin N → SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) :
    ∀ (g : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) (V V' : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer), (∀ j, j < g → V j = V' j) →
      gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d g V = gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d g V' := by
  intro g V V' hV
  unfold gAddr
  refine hc _ _ _ _ _ (fun j hj => ?_)
  unfold attVec
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  refine hV _ ?_
  have hg : finProdFinEquiv ((finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1, (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2) = g :=
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  conv_rhs => rw [← hg]
  exact fPF_lt _ _ _ hj

/-- The base table and the reprogrammed table of the coupling. -/
def tP (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : R.A → OracleAnswer := R.eTab (s ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2

def TP (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : R.A → OracleAnswer :=
  progF (Frz R x) (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1)) (tP W Pr R N hN s) (uVec W Pr s)

theorem look_toRP (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (b : List UInt8) :
    W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 b = lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) b := by
  rw [look_eqA]
  show lookA R (R.eTab (R.eTab.symm _)) b = _
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

theorem TP_pub (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) :
    lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) (W.pubBytes x) = dS W Pr R N hN x s :=
  lookA_frozen R x _ _ (fun y hy => progF_frozen _ _ _ _ y hy)

theorem run_eq_lazy (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hcoll : ∀ g g' : Fin (N * n1 W Pr), g' < g →
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g') ≠ addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g))
    (hpub : ∀ g, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) ≠ W.pubBytes x) :
    runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s := by
  have hencA : ∀ g, R.enc (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) g (uVec W Pr s) (tP W Pr R N hN s)) =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) := by
    intro g
    rw [enc_aA W Pr R h B outputs x w hin, addrQ_posE]
    rfl
  refine run_eqF (Frz R x) (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1))
    (causalF_aA W Pr R h B outputs x w hc _) (tP W Pr R N hN s) (uVec W Pr s) ?_ ?_ _ ?_
  · intro g hg
    unfold Frz at hg
    split at hg
    · next a ha =>
        have e := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hg
        apply hpub g
        rw [← hencA g, e]
        exact R.enc_of_dec _ _ ha
    · exact absurd hg (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  · intro g g' hlt heq
    apply hcoll g g' hlt
    rw [← hencA, ← hencA, heq]
  · intro g
    rw [runC_spec _ _ _ (gAddr_causal W Pr N h B outputs x w hc _ _) g]
    have e : gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s) g
        (runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
          (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0) =
        R.enc (aA W Pr R h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) g
          (runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
            (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0) (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) := by
      rw [enc_aA W Pr R h B outputs x w hin, TP_pub]
    rw [e]
    unfold lookA
    rw [R.dec_enc]
    rfl

theorem ans_eq (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hrun : runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s)
    (k : Fin N) (p : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) (addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, p)) = (s k).2.1 p := by
  have hp : posE W Pr N (finProdFinEquiv (k, Pr.ord.symm p)) = (k, p) := by
    simp [posE]
  have hs := runC_spec _ (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0
    (gAddr_causal W Pr N h B outputs x w hc (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
    (finProdFinEquiv (k, Pr.ord.symm p))
  rw [hrun, ← addrQ_posE, hp] at hs
  rw [← hs]
  simp [uVec]

theorem lookA_off (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (y : List UInt8) (hy : ∀ g, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) ≠ y) :
    lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) y = lookA R (tP W Pr R N hN s) y := by
  unfold lookA
  split
  · next a ha =>
      refine progF_off _ _ _ _ _ (fun g e => hy g ?_)
      rw [← R.enc_of_dec _ _ ha, ← e, enc_aA W Pr R h B outputs x w hin, addrQ_posE]
      rfl
  · rfl

end Run

#print axioms runLog_congr
#print axioms length_runLog
#print axioms mem_getD
#print axioms lookup_map_none
#print axioms lookup_map_some
#print axioms addrQ_posE
#print axioms gAddr_causal
#print axioms look_toRP
#print axioms TP_pub
#print axioms run_eq_lazy
#print axioms ans_eq
#print axioms lookA_off
end R1Z.AgreeR1PBin

R1Z.AgreeR1P2Bin.text:
import R1Z.AgreeR1PBin

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.AgreeR1P2` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! Agreement of the real and middle games, part 2 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5):
`agreeP` — outside the hit event, collisions, exhaustion and digest hits,
the real game on `toRP s` and the middle game of `abR1` on `toMP s` publish
the same ROM view, so their tests agree.  Premises: `RAddrIn`, `RCausal`,
`RComLog`, and `Vp h = V` (the real game accepts on the same no-pole
predicate as the middle game). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.AgreeR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem lookup_none' {ι α β : Type} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (G : ι → α × β) (y : α) :
    ∀ l : List ι, (∀ i ∈ l, (G i).1 ≠ y) → List.lookup y (l.map G) = none
  | [], _ => rfl
  | i :: l, h => by
      rw [List.map_cons]
      rcases hG : G i with ⟨a, b⟩
      rw [List.lookup_cons]
      have hb : (y == a) = false := by
        rw [beq_eq_false_iff_ne]
        intro e
        apply h i List.mem_cons_self
        rw [hG, ← e]
      rw [hb]
      exact lookup_none' G y l (fun j hj => h j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj))

theorem lookup_some' {ι α β : Type} [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (G : ι → α × β) (y : α) (b : β) :
    ∀ l : List ι, (∃ i ∈ l, (G i).1 = y) → (∀ i ∈ l, (G i).1 = y → (G i).2 = b) →
      List.lookup y (l.map G) = some b
  | [], ⟨_, hi, _⟩, _ => absurd hi List.not_mem_nil
  | i :: l, ⟨i₀, hi₀, he⟩, h => by
      rw [List.map_cons]
      rcases hG : G i with ⟨a, v⟩
      rw [List.lookup_cons]
      by_cases hyi : a = y
      · have hb : (y == a) = true := by rw [beq_iff_eq]; exact hyi.symm
        rw [hb]
        have hv : v = b := by
          have := h i List.mem_cons_self (by rw [hG]; exact hyi)
          rw [hG] at this
          exact this
        exact congrArg some hv
      · have hb : (y == a) = false := by rw [beq_eq_false_iff_ne]; exact fun e => hyi e.symm
        rw [hb]
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hi₀ with rfl | hl
        · rw [hG] at he
          exact absurd he hyi
        · exact lookup_some' G y b l ⟨i₀, hl, he⟩ (fun j hj => h j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj))

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

section Agree
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)

/-- The published positions of attempt `k`, in the verifier's order. -/
def Lpos (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N) : List (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :=
  schedule.map Sum.inl ++ (Pr.openList (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))).map (fun c => Sum.inr (cposOf c))

def fL (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N) (p : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) : List UInt8 × OracleAnswer :=
  (addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, p), (s k).2.1 p)

theorem fail_eqP (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (c : Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) :
    (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x c = ⟨W.failView, runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) (W.look (c ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax⟩ :=
  rfl

theorem extend_eqP (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (c : Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (k : Fin N) (v : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x c k v = ⟨v, verLog W x v (c k) ++
      runLog (adv.prog v (verLog W x v (c k))) (progOracle W x v (c k) (c ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax⟩ :=
  rfl

theorem mem_runLog_idx (p : OProg) (O : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (n : ℕ)
    (e : List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) (he : e ∈ runLog p O n) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, (runLog p O n).getD i.val ([], fun _ => 0) = e :=
  mem_getD _ _ n (length_runLog n p O) e he

theorem real_eqP (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) :
    realTest h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) adv x w r =
      bit (adv.decide (realGameP W Pr N P Vp h B outputs adv x w r)) := rfl

theorem middle_eqP (ct : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)) :
    middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) adv x w ct =
      bit (adv.decide (match accR W N P h V w ct with
        | none => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x ct.1
        | some k => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x ct.1 k
            (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k)) (ct.2 k)))) := by
  unfold middleRealAbortV retryTest
  split
  · next heq =>
      rw [show accR W N P h V w ct = none from heq]
      rfl
  · next k heq =>
      rw [show accR W N P h V w ct = some k from heq]
      rfl

theorem tape_eq (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N)
    (hk : Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1) ≠ none) :
    tapeR W Pr (s k).2.1 = (toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k := by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hk
  show (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1)).getD tape0 =
    (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1)).getD (s k).2.2.1
  rw [hτ]
  rfl

theorem attOut_log (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hrun : runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s) (k : Fin N) :
    (attOut W Pr h B outputs x w (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) (s k).1
      (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (s k).2.1).log =
      (Lpos W Pr N s k).map (fL W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s k) := by
  unfold Lpos
  rw [List.map_append, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  show List.map _ schedule ++ List.map _ _ = _
  congr 1
  · apply List.map_congr_left
    intro j _
    refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
    exact ans_eq W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hrun k (.inl j)
  · apply List.map_congr_left
    intro c _
    refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
    exact ans_eq W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hrun k (.inr (cposOf c))

theorem verLog_eq (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N)
    (hk : Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1) ≠ none) :
    verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k) =
      (Lpos W Pr N s k).map (fL W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s k) := by
  have ht := tape_eq W Pr eCm N s k hk
  have e : (toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k = (trOf (s k).2.1, rootsOf (s k).2.1, eCm.symm (restOf (s k).2.1),
      (s k).2.2.2) := rfl
  rw [e]
  unfold verLog drawW
  dsimp only
  rw [hcom w (s k).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (rootsOf (s k).2.1)
    (restOf (s k).2.1) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))]
  unfold tLog Lpos
  dsimp only
  rw [List.map_append, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  refine congrArg₂ (· ++ ·) ?_ ?_
  · apply List.map_congr_left
    intro j _
    refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
    show addr j (recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
      (trOf (s k).2.1) (rootsOf (s k).2.1)) =
      addr j (recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) (tapeR W Pr (s k).2.1))
      (trOf (s k).2.1) (rootsOf (s k).2.1))
    rw [ht]
  · apply List.map_congr_left
    intro c _
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · show Pr.caddr h w x (s k).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (restOf (s k).2.1)
          (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) (cposOf c) =
        Pr.caddr h w x (s k).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (tapeR W Pr (s k).2.1) (restOf (s k).2.1)
          (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) (cposOf c)
      rw [ht]
    · rcases c with i | q <;> rfl

/-- The real game's per-attempt outputs on the coupling. -/
theorem realOut_eq (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hrun : runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s) (k : Fin N) :
    realOut W Pr h B outputs x w (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1)
        (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2 k =
      attOut W Pr h B outputs x w (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) (s k).1
        (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (s k).2.1 := by
  have hH : W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 = lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) :=
    funext (look_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)
  unfold realOut
  rw [hH, TP_pub, show (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2 = fun k => (s k).1 from rfl, hrun,
    attVec_uVec]

/-- The middle oracle agrees with the real oracle on every middle read that is
not a charged prover read. -/
theorem oracle_acc (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hrun : runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s)
    (hcoll : ∀ p p' : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂, p ≠ p' →
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p ≠ addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p')
    (k₀ : Fin N) (hacc : accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k₀)
    (hk : Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k₀).2.1) (e₂Of (s k₀).2.1) ≠ none)
    (y : List UInt8)
    (hy : ∀ p, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p = y → ¬ chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s p) :
    lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) y =
      progOracle W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k₀)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k₀))
        ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k₀) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2 y := by
  unfold progOracle
  rw [verLog_eq W Pr R eCm N hN h B outputs x w hcom s k₀ hk]
  by_cases hex : ∃ p, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p = y
  · obtain ⟨⟨k, pp⟩, hp⟩ := hex
    have hnc := hy _ hp
    have hkk : k = k₀ ∧ pp ∈ Lpos W Pr N s k₀ := by
      rcases pp with j | c
      · have h1 : accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hnc hne
        rw [hacc] at h1
        have e := (Option.some.inj h1).symm
        subst e
        exact ⟨rfl, List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨j, mem_schedule j, rfl⟩)⟩
      · have h1 : accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k ∧ pubC W Pr N s k c := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hnc hne
        rw [hacc] at h1
        have e := (Option.some.inj h1.1).symm
        subst e
        obtain ⟨c0, hc0, hcc⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h1.2
        exact ⟨rfl, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨c0, hc0, by rw [hcc]⟩)⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, hmem⟩ := hkk
    rw [lookup_some' (fL W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s k) y
      ((s k).2.1 pp) (Lpos W Pr N s k) ⟨pp, hmem, hp⟩ (fun p' _ hp' => by
        by_cases e : p' = pp
        · subst e
          rfl
        · exact absurd (hp'.trans hp.symm) (hcoll (k, p') (k, pp) (fun ee => e (Prod.mk.inj ee).2)))]
    rw [← hp]
    exact ans_eq W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hrun k pp
  · push Not at hex
    rw [lookup_none' (fL W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s k₀) y
      (Lpos W Pr N s k₀) (fun p _ => hex (k₀, p))]
    rw [lookA_off W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin s y (fun g => hex _), look_eqA]
    rfl

theorem oracle_none (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hacc : accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = none) (y : List UInt8)
    (hy : ∀ p, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p = y → ¬ chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s p) :
    lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) y = W.look ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2 y := by
  have hex : ∀ p, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p ≠ y := by
    intro p hp
    apply hy p hp
    rcases p with ⟨k, j | c⟩
    · show accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s ≠ some k
      rw [hacc]
      simp
    · show ¬ (accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k ∧ _)
      rw [hacc]
      simp
  rw [lookA_off W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin s y (fun g => hex _), look_eqA]
  rfl

theorem firstGood_eq (hV : ∀ ch, Vp h ch w ↔ V ch w) (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hrun : runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s)
    (hexh : ∀ k, Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1) ≠ none) :
    firstGood (fun o : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux => P o.ch ∧ Vp h o.ch w ∧ o.exh = false)
        (realOut W Pr h B outputs x w (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1)
          (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2) =
      accR W N P h V w (toMP W Pr eCm s) := by
  have e1 : firstGood (fun o : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux => P o.ch ∧ Vp h o.ch w ∧ o.exh = false)
      (realOut W Pr h B outputs x w (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1)
        (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2) =
      firstGood (fun k => P (realOut W Pr h B outputs x w (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1)
          (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2 k).ch ∧
        Vp h (realOut W Pr h B outputs x w (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1)
          (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2 k).ch w ∧
        (realOut W Pr h B outputs x w (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1)
          (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2 k).exh = false) id := rfl
  have e2 : accR W N P h V w (toMP W Pr eCm s) =
      firstGood (fun k => P (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ∧ V (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) w) id := rfl
  rw [e1, e2]
  apply firstGood_congr
  intro k
  simp only [id, realOut_eq W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hrun k]
  show P (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ∧ Vp h (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) w ∧
      (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1)).isNone = false ↔ _
  have hn : (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1)).isNone = false := by
    cases ht : Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1)
    · exact absurd ht (hexh k)
    · rfl
  rw [hn, hV]
  simp

/-- Agreement outside the events. -/
theorem agreeP (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) (hV : ∀ ch, Vp h ch w ↔ V ch w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hhit : ∀ (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (i : Fin W.qmax), chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s p →
      qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s ≠ addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p)
    (hcoll : ∀ p p' : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂, p ≠ p' →
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p ≠ addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p')
    (hexh : ∀ k, Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1) ≠ none)
    (hpub : ∀ p, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p ≠ W.pubBytes x) :
    realTest h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) adv x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) =
      middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) adv x w
        (toMP W Pr eCm s) := by
  have hrun := run_eq_lazy W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s
    (fun g g' hlt => hcoll _ _ (fun e => absurd ((posE W Pr N).injective e) (ne_of_lt hlt)))
    (fun g => hpub _)
  have hH : W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 = lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) :=
    funext (look_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)
  have hfg := firstGood_eq W Pr R eCm N hN P Vp h V B outputs x w hV hin hc s hrun hexh
  -- the middle reads that are prover addresses are uncharged
  have hy : ∀ (i : Fin W.qmax) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂), addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p =
      qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s → ¬ chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s p :=
    fun i p hp hch => hhit p i hch hp.symm
  have key : realGameP W Pr N P Vp h B outputs adv x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) =
      (match accR W N P h V w (toMP W Pr eCm s) with
        | none => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x (toMP W Pr eCm s).1
        | some k => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x (toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k
            (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))) := by
    unfold realGameP
    dsimp only
    rw [hfg]
    rcases hacc : accR W N P h V w (toMP W Pr eCm s) with _ | k₀
    · dsimp only
      rw [fail_eqP W N hN adv x, hH]
      congr 1
      refine runLog_congr _ _ _ _ (fun e he => ?_)
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_runLog_idx _ _ _ e he
      have hq : qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s = e.1 := by
        unfold qryQ qryR advLogR
        rw [hacc]
        dsimp only
        rw [hi]
      exact oracle_none W Pr R eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w hin s (by exact hacc) e.1
        (fun p hp => hy i p (hp.trans hq.symm))
    · dsimp only
      rw [extend_eqP W N hN adv x, realOut_eq W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hrun k₀]
      have hv : (attOut W Pr h B outputs x w (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) (s k₀).1
          (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (s k₀).2.1).view =
          view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k₀)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k₀) := by
        show view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k₀).2.1)) (tapeR W Pr (s k₀).2.1) = _
        rw [tape_eq W Pr eCm N s k₀ (hexh k₀)]
        rfl
      have hlog : (attOut W Pr h B outputs x w (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) (s k₀).1
          (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (s k₀).2.1).log =
          verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k₀)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k₀))
            ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k₀) := by
        rw [attOut_log W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hrun k₀,
          verLog_eq W Pr R eCm N hN h B outputs x w hcom s k₀ (hexh k₀)]
      rw [hv, hlog, hH]
      congr 2
      refine runLog_congr _ _ _ _ (fun e he => ?_)
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_runLog_idx _ _ _ e he
      have hq : qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s = e.1 := by
        unfold qryQ qryR advLogR
        rw [hacc]
        dsimp only
        rw [hi]
      exact oracle_acc W Pr R eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w hin hc hcom s hrun hcoll k₀ (by exact hacc) (hexh k₀) e.1
        (fun p hp => hy i p (hp.trans hq.symm))
  rw [real_eqP W Pr N hN P Vp h B outputs x w adv, middle_eqP W Pr N hN P Vp h V B outputs x w adv, key]
  rfl

end Agree

/-! ### A product mass lemma -/

theorem ind_forall_eq_prod {ι W : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : Finset ι) (Q : W → Bool)
    (ws : ι → W) [Decidable (∀ i ∈ T, Q (ws i) = true)] :
    (if ∀ i ∈ T, Q (ws i) = true then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      ∏ i, (if i ∈ T then (if Q (ws i) = true then (1 : ℚ) else 0) else 1) := by
  by_cases h : ∀ i ∈ T, Q (ws i) = true
  · rw [if_pos h]
    refine (Finset.prod_eq_one (fun i _ => ?_)).symm
    by_cases hi : i ∈ T
    · rw [if_pos hi, if_pos (h i hi)]
    · rw [if_neg hi]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    push Not at h
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hq⟩ := h
    refine (Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) ?_).symm
    rw [if_pos hi, if_neg hq]

/-- On uniform `ws : ι → W`, the event "every coordinate in `T` satisfies `Q`"
has mass `(|Q|/|W|)^|T|`. -/
theorem mass_forall_mem {ι W : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype W] [Nonempty W]
    (T : Finset ι) (Q : W → Bool) :
    mass (fun ws : ι → W => ∀ i ∈ T, Q (ws i) = true) =
      (((Finset.univ.filter (fun x => Q x = true)).card : ℚ) / Fintype.card W) ^ T.card := by
  set c : ℚ := ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x => Q x = true)).card : ℚ) with hc
  have hW : (Fintype.card W : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  unfold mass mean
  simp only [ind_forall_eq_prod T Q]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun i x => if i ∈ T then (if Q x = true then (1 : ℚ) else 0) else 1)]
  have hs : ∀ i, ∑ x : W, (if i ∈ T then (if Q x = true then (1 : ℚ) else 0) else 1) =
      (Fintype.card W : ℚ) * (if i ∈ T then c / Fintype.card W else 1) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ T
    · simp only [if_pos hi]
      rw [Finset.sum_boole, ← hc]
      field_simp
    · simp only [if_neg hi, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  simp only [hs]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun,
    Finset.prod_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, Finset.prod_const]
  push_cast
  have hp : (Fintype.card W : ℚ) ^ Fintype.card ι ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hW
  field_simp

/-- An event of one coordinate of a function space has its own mass. -/
theorem mass_coord {N : ℕ} {X : Type} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (k : Fin N) (E : X → Prop) :
    mass (fun f : Fin N → X => E (f k)) = mass E := by
  rw [mass_equiv (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt k)]
  have h : (fun p : X × ({j // j ≠ k} → X) => E ((R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt k).symm p k)) =
      (fun p => E p.1) := by
    funext p
    simp [R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt]
  rw [h]
  exact R0Z.FsAbortTape.mass_fst E

theorem mass_snd {R X : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype X] [Nonempty R] (E : X → Prop) :
    mass (fun p : R × X => E p.2) = mass E := by
  rw [mass_equiv (Equiv.prodComm R X)]
  exact R0Z.FsAbortTape.mass_fst E

/-! ### The Rust word sampler -/

abbrev Word := Fin (2 ^ 32)

/-- `P = 2^31 − 1` (aspis-core field::P). -/
def P31 : ℕ := 2 ^ 31 - 1

/-- Rust: a word is rejected iff `word & 0x7fff_ffff < P` fails. -/
def rejB (x : Word) : Bool := !decide (x.val &&& 0x7fffffff < P31)

theorem rejB_iff (x : Word) : rejB x = true ↔ x.val % 2 ^ 31 = 2 ^ 31 - 1 := by
  have hm : x.val &&& 0x7fffffff = x.val % 2 ^ 31 := by
    rw [show (0x7fffffff : ℕ) = 2 ^ 31 - 1 from rfl, Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod]
  have hlt : x.val % 2 ^ 31 < 2 ^ 31 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by positivity)
  simp only [rejB, hm, P31, Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_lt]
  omega

/-- Exactly two words are rejected: `2^31 − 1` and `2^32 − 1`. -/
theorem card_rej : (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Word => rejB x = true)).card = 2 := by
  have h : Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Word => rejB x = true) =
      {⟨2 ^ 31 - 1, by norm_num⟩, ⟨2 ^ 32 - 1, by norm_num⟩} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, rejB_iff, Finset.mem_insert,
      Finset.mem_singleton, Fin.ext_iff]
    have := x.isLt
    omega
  rw [h]
  rfl

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- The word at stream position `p` (positions past the stream read 0, an
accepted word; they are never reached under `16 L ≤ n`). -/
def getW (ws : Fin n → Word) (p : ℕ) : Word := if h : p < n then ws ⟨p, h⟩ else 0

/-- One limb: at most `r` words from position `p`; the position after the
accepted word, or `none` (exhausted). -/
def tryLimb (ws : Fin n → Word) : ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ
  | _, 0 => none
  | p, r + 1 => if rejB (getW ws p) = true then tryLimb ws (p + 1) r else some (p + 1)

/-- The stream position after `l` limbs of 16 tries each. -/
def limbPos (ws : Fin n → Word) : ℕ → Option ℕ
  | 0 => some 0
  | l + 1 => (limbPos ws l).bind (fun p => tryLimb ws p 16)

/-- Limb `l`'s value (`word & 0x7fff_ffff` of its accepted word). -/
def limbVal (ws : Fin n → Word) (l : ℕ) : Option ℕ :=
  (limbPos ws (l + 1)).map (fun p => (getW ws (p - 1)).val &&& 0x7fffffff)

/-- `MaskSampleExhausted` within the first `L` limbs. -/
def Exhausted (ws : Fin n → Word) (L : ℕ) : Prop := limbPos ws L = none

theorem tryLimb_none (ws : Fin n → Word) :
    ∀ r p, tryLimb ws p r = none → ∀ k, k < r → rejB (getW ws (p + k)) = true
  | 0, _, _, k, hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | r + 1, p, h, k, hk => by
      unfold tryLimb at h
      by_cases hr : rejB (getW ws p) = true
      · rw [if_pos hr] at h
        rcases k with _ | k
        · simpa using hr
        · have := tryLimb_none ws r (p + 1) h k (by omega)
          rwa [show p + 1 + k = p + (k + 1) by omega] at this
      · rw [if_neg hr] at h
        exact absurd h (by simp)

theorem tryLimb_le (ws : Fin n → Word) :
    ∀ r p p', tryLimb ws p r = some p' → p' ≤ p + r
  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [tryLimb] at h
  | r + 1, p, p', h => by
      unfold tryLimb at h
      by_cases hr : rejB (getW ws p) = true
      · rw [if_pos hr] at h
        have := tryLimb_le ws r (p + 1) p' h
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hr] at h
        have := Option.some.inj h
        omega

theorem limbPos_le (ws : Fin n → Word) : ∀ l p, limbPos ws l = some p → p ≤ 16 * l
  | 0, p, h => by simp [limbPos] at h; omega
  | l + 1, p, h => by
      unfold limbPos at h
      rcases hl : limbPos ws l with _ | q
      · rw [hl] at h
        simp at h
      · rw [hl] at h
        have h1 := limbPos_le ws l q hl
        have h2 := tryLimb_le ws 16 q p h
        omega

/-- Exhaustion leaves 16 consecutive rejected words inside the first `16 L`. -/
theorem exhausted_window (ws : Fin n → Word) :
    ∀ L, Exhausted ws L → ∃ s, s + 16 ≤ 16 * L ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 → rejB (getW ws (s + k)) = true
  | 0, h => by simp [Exhausted, limbPos] at h
  | L + 1, h => by
      unfold Exhausted limbPos at h
      rcases hl : limbPos ws L with _ | q
      · obtain ⟨s, hs, hw⟩ := exhausted_window ws L hl
        exact ⟨s, by omega, hw⟩
      · rw [hl] at h
        have hq := limbPos_le ws L q hl
        exact ⟨q, by omega, tryLimb_none ws 16 q h⟩

/-- The words touched by a successful stream of `L` limbs fill at most `2 L`
blocks of 8 words. -/
theorem blocks_le (ws : Fin n → Word) (L p : ℕ) (h : limbPos ws L = some p) :
    (p + 7) / 8 ≤ 2 * L := by
  have := limbPos_le ws L p h
  omega

/-- The rejection rate `2 / 2^32` of one word. -/
theorem mass_rej_window (s : ℕ) (hs : s + 16 ≤ n) :
    mass (fun ws : Fin n → Word => ∀ k, k < 16 → rejB (getW ws (s + k)) = true) ≤
      ((2 : ℚ) / 2 ^ 32) ^ 16 := by
  let e : Fin 16 ↪ Fin n := ⟨fun k => ⟨s + k.val, by omega⟩, fun a b h => by
    simp only [Fin.mk.injEq, Nat.add_left_cancel_iff] at h
    exact Fin.ext h⟩
  have hm := mass_forall_mem (Finset.univ.map e) rejB
  rw [card_rej, Finset.card_map, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin,
    Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hm
  rw [← hm]
  refine mass_mono _ _ (fun ws hw i hi => ?_)
  obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hi
  have := hw k.val k.isLt
  unfold getW at this
  rw [dif_pos (by omega)] at this
  exact this

/-- The exhaustion mass of one stream of `L` limbs on `n ≥ 16 L` uniform words. -/
theorem mass_exhausted (L : ℕ) (hn : 16 * L ≤ n) :
    mass (fun ws : Fin n → Word => Exhausted ws L) ≤ (16 * L : ℚ) * ((2 : ℚ) / 2 ^ 32) ^ 16 := by
  have hsub : ∀ ws : Fin n → Word, Exhausted ws L →
      ∃ s : Fin (16 * L), s.val + 16 ≤ 16 * L ∧
        ∀ k, k < 16 → rejB (getW ws (s.val + k)) = true := by
    intro ws h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hw⟩ := exhausted_window ws L h
    exact ⟨⟨s, by omega⟩, hs, hw⟩
  refine (mass_mono _ _ hsub).trans ?_
  have hb := mass_exists_le_card
    (fun (s : Fin (16 * L)) (ws : Fin n → Word) => s.val + 16 ≤ 16 * L ∧
      ∀ k, k < 16 → rejB (getW ws (s.val + k)) = true)
    (((2 : ℚ) / 2 ^ 32) ^ 16) (fun s => by
      by_cases hs : s.val + 16 ≤ 16 * L
      · refine (mass_mono _ _ (fun ws h => h.2)).trans (mass_rej_window s.val (by omega))
      · rw [mass_congr _ (fun _ => False) (fun ws => ⟨fun h => hs h.1, False.elim⟩), mass_false]
        positivity)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hb
  push_cast at hb
  exact hb

theorem rej_rate : ((2 : ℚ) / 2 ^ 32) ^ 16 = 1 / 2 ^ 496 := by
  rw [show (2 : ℚ) / 2 ^ 32 = 1 / 2 ^ 31 by norm_num, one_div_pow, ← pow_mul]

/-- `G-exh` for the R1 attempt loop: `N` attempts, each with the two
expander streams (SeedExpander of `L₁` limbs, Profile21 D expander of `L₂`
limbs) on independent uniform words. -/
theorem mass_exh_attempts (N L₁ L₂ n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ n₁) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ n₂) :
    mass (fun ws : Fin N → (Fin n₁ → Word) × (Fin n₂ → Word) =>
        ∃ k, Exhausted (ws k).1 L₁ ∨ Exhausted (ws k).2 L₂) ≤
      (N : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 := by
  have hk : ∀ k : Fin N, mass (fun ws : Fin N → (Fin n₁ → Word) × (Fin n₂ → Word) =>
      Exhausted (ws k).1 L₁ ∨ Exhausted (ws k).2 L₂) ≤ (16 * (L₁ + L₂) : ℚ) / 2 ^ 496 := by
    intro k
    rw [mass_coord k (fun p : (Fin n₁ → Word) × (Fin n₂ → Word) =>
      Exhausted p.1 L₁ ∨ Exhausted p.2 L₂)]
    refine (mass_or_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [R0Z.FsAbortTape.mass_fst (fun ws => Exhausted ws L₁), mass_snd (fun ws => Exhausted ws L₂)]
    have e1 := mass_exhausted L₁ h₁
    have e2 := mass_exhausted L₂ h₂
    rw [rej_rate] at e1 e2
    calc _ ≤ (16 * L₁ : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 496) + (16 * L₂ : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 496) := add_le_add e1 e2
      _ = (16 * (L₁ + L₂) : ℚ) / 2 ^ 496 := by ring
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card _ _ hk
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at hu
  calc _ ≤ (N : ℚ) * ((16 * (L₁ + L₂) : ℚ) / 2 ^ 496) := hu
    _ = (N : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 := by ring

/-! ### The commitment-read count -/

/-- The source limb counts (REF R-commit, counted from state_only_hiding.rs
`build_mask_material_for_layout` and state_only_entropy.rs
`derive_pool_v1_zero_factor_d`): stream 1 draws one M31 per relation-free
C1 mask cell (at most 26·1024), 10·1024 mask-only C1 limbs, 1024 QM31 of
`g` and at most 1024 QM31 of `h1_padding`; stream 2 draws 1024 QM31 of `D`. -/
def RCommitCount (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) : Prop := L₁ ≤ 26 * 1024 + 10 * 1024 + 4 * 1024 + 4 * 1024 ∧ L₂ = 4 * 1024

/-- Per-attempt private commitment reads (binary format): salts and leaves
of the three trees (C1, C2, folded; 2^18 each), binary parents at depths
0..17 (`2^(17−d)` parents at depth `d`, the root last), the three secret
seed reads (mask seed, source-mask seed, D seed), and the expander blocks of
the two streams (budgets `E₁`, `E₂`). -/
abbrev CRead (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) :=
  (Fin 3 × Fin (2 ^ 18)) ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin (2 ^ 18)) ⊕ (Fin 3 × (Σ d : Fin 18, Fin (2 ^ (17 - d.val)))) ⊕
    Fin 3 ⊕ (Fin E₁ ⊕ Fin E₂)

/-- A complete binary tree over 2^18 leaves has `2^18 − 1` parents. -/
theorem card_nodes : Fintype.card (Σ d : Fin 18, Fin (2 ^ (17 - d.val))) = 262143 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  first
    | (rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => 2 ^ (17 - i)) 18]; norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ])
    | norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ]

def McR1 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : ℕ := 2359296 + E₁ + E₂

theorem card_CRead (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fintype.card (CRead E₁ E₂) = McR1 E₁ E₂ := by
  simp only [CRead, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, card_nodes, McR1]
  norm_num <;> omega

/-- With the worst-case block budgets `E_s = 2 L_s` (`blocks_le`) and the
source limb counts, `115 + Mc ≤ 2^22` (the D41 read budget, binary format). -/
theorem mc_le (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) : 115 + McR1 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂) ≤ 2 ^ 22 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
  unfold McR1
  norm_num <;> omega

/-- The earlier budget `2^21` is false for the binary format: at the
worst-case limb counts `115 + Mc = 2 457 715 > 2^21`. -/
theorem mc_gt_2_21 : 2 ^ 21 < 115 + McR1 (2 * (26 * 1024 + 10 * 1024 + 4 * 1024 + 4 * 1024)) (2 * (4 * 1024)) ∧
    RCommitCount (26 * 1024 + 10 * 1024 + 4 * 1024 + 4 * 1024) (4 * 1024) := by
  refine ⟨?_, by unfold RCommitCount; exact ⟨le_rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  unfold McR1
  norm_num

/-! ### The shipped eight-way count (comparison) -/

/-- Eight-way: 8-ary nodes at levels 1..6 (8^(5−d) nodes at level d+1, the root last). -/
abbrev CRead8 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) :=
  (Fin 3 × Fin (2 ^ 18)) ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin (2 ^ 18)) ⊕ (Fin 3 × (Σ d : Fin 6, Fin (8 ^ (5 - d.val)))) ⊕
    Fin 3 ⊕ (Fin E₁ ⊕ Fin E₂)

theorem card_nodes8 : Fintype.card (Σ d : Fin 6, Fin (8 ^ (5 - d.val))) = 37449 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Fin.sum_univ_six]
  norm_num

def McR1_8 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : ℕ := 1685214 + E₁ + E₂

theorem card_CRead8 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fintype.card (CRead8 E₁ E₂) = McR1_8 E₁ E₂ := by
  simp only [CRead8, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, card_nodes8, McR1_8]
  norm_num <;> omega

theorem mc_le8 (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) : 115 + McR1_8 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂) ≤ 2 ^ 21 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
  unfold McR1_8
  norm_num <;> omega

/-- The binary format adds `3 · (2^18 − 1) − 3 · 37449 = 674 082` node reads. -/
theorem McR1_sub (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : McR1 E₁ E₂ = McR1_8 E₁ E₂ + 674082 := by
  unfold McR1 McR1_8
  omega

/-- The R1 exhaustion bound with the source counts: `εexh ≤ N / 2^476`. -/
theorem mass_exh_R1 (N L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) :
    mass (fun ws : Fin N → (Fin (16 * L₁) → Word) × (Fin (16 * L₂) → Word) =>
        ∃ k, Exhausted (ws k).1 L₁ ∨ Exhausted (ws k).2 L₂) ≤ (N : ℚ) / 2 ^ 476 := by
  refine (mass_exh_attempts N L₁ L₂ _ _ le_rfl le_rfl).trans ?_
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
  have hL : (16 * (L₁ + L₂) : ℚ) ≤ 2 ^ 20 := by
    have : 16 * (L₁ + L₂) ≤ 2 ^ 20 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hN : (0 : ℚ) ≤ N := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  calc (N : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 ≤ (N : ℚ) * 2 ^ 20 / 2 ^ 496 := by
        gcongr
    _ = (N : ℚ) / 2 ^ 476 := by
        rw [show (496 : ℕ) = 20 + 476 from rfl, pow_add]
        field_simp

/-! The real model of the phase-indexed games (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5–§6):
`R1RealModelV` for `fsR1P` / `abR1P` with `M = N · |Pos1|` positions,
`q = qmax`, `Umin = 2^255`, and the exhaustion slot

  εexh = N·16(L₁+L₂)/2^496 + N·|Pos1|/2^255

(mask-sampler exhaustion from the Rust word sampler `CommitReadsR1`, plus a
prover read hitting the frozen digest address).

Named premises added here:
* `wordsE`: the little-endian u32 word stream of expander blocks (8 words per
  32-byte block, word `j` = bytes `4j … 4j+3` little-endian;
  `finFunctionFinEquiv` digit order), and `RExh` (R-commit: the Rust decode
  reports `MaskSampleExhausted` only when one of the two 16-try word streams
  is exhausted). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.FinalR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.ModelsVR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Little-endian words of expander blocks -/

abbrev Word := R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word

/-- One 32-byte block as eight little-endian u32 words. -/
def blockW : OracleAnswer ≃ (Fin 8 → Word) :=
  ((Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin 32)) uint8Equiv).trans
    (Equiv.arrowCongr (finProdFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (by norm_num : 8 * 4 = 32))).symm
      (Equiv.refl (Fin UInt8.size)))).trans
  ((Equiv.curry (Fin 8) (Fin 4) (Fin UInt8.size)).trans
    (Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin 8))
      (finFunctionFinEquiv.trans (finCongr (by decide : UInt8.size ^ 4 = 2 ^ 32)))))

/-- The word stream of `E` blocks: word `8c + j` is word `j` of block `c`. -/
def wordsE (E : ℕ) : (Fin E → OracleAnswer) ≃ (Fin (E * 8) → Word) :=
  (Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin E)) blockW).trans
    ((Equiv.curry (Fin E) (Fin 8) Word).symm.trans
      (Equiv.arrowCongr finProdFinEquiv (Equiv.refl Word)))

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- R-commit: exhaustion of the Rust mask decode is exhaustion of one of the two
16-try M31 word streams (SeedExpander: `L₁` limbs; Profile21 D expander: `L₂`). -/
def RExh {W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux} (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ e₁ e₂, Pr.tapeOf e₁ e₂ = none →
    R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (wordsE Pr.E₁ e₁) L₁ ∨ R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (wordsE Pr.E₂ e₂) L₂

section Model
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)

/-- The exhaustion slot: a mask stream is exhausted, or a prover read hits the
frozen digest address. -/
def exhQ (w : h.Instance) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Prop :=
  (∃ k, Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1) = none) ∨
    (∃ p, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p = W.pubBytes x)

def εexhP (L₁ L₂ M : ℕ) : ℚ := (N : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 + (M : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 255)

theorem mp_proj :
    MP (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => (eV W Pr a.2.1).2.2.1) := by
  have h1 : MP (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => a.2) := mp_snd
  have h2 : MP (fun r : (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) × (Tape K F × W.Tab) => r.1) := mp_fst
  have h3 := mp_equiv (eV W Pr)
  have h4 : MP (fun q : (TRead → OracleAnswer) × (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) ×
      (((Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) × (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) => q.2) := mp_snd
  have h5 : MP (fun q : (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) ×
      (((Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) × (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) => q.2) := mp_snd
  have h6 : MP (fun q : ((Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) × (RIdx → OracleAnswer) =>
      q.1) := mp_fst
  exact mp_comp (mp_comp (mp_comp (mp_comp (mp_comp h1 h2) h3) h4) h5) h6

/-- The word space of the two streams of all attempts and its block form. -/
def eWords : (Fin N → (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) ≃
    (Fin N → (Fin (Pr.E₁ * 8) → Word) × (Fin (Pr.E₂ * 8) → Word)) :=
  Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin N)) (Equiv.prodCongr (wordsE Pr.E₁) (wordsE Pr.E₂))

theorem mass_exhaust (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂) (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8) :
    mass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr => ∃ k, Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (s k).2.1) (e₂Of (s k).2.1) = none) ≤
      (N : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 := by
  let Gb : (Fin N → (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) → Prop := fun e =>
    ∃ k, R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (wordsE Pr.E₁ (e k).1) L₁ ∨
      R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (wordsE Pr.E₂ (e k).2) L₂
  have hm : mass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr => Gb (fun k => (eV W Pr (s k).2.1).2.2.1)) = mass Gb := by
    unfold mass
    exact mp_pi (mp_proj W Pr) N (fun e => @ite ℚ (Gb e) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)
  have hw : mass Gb = mass (fun ws : Fin N → (Fin (Pr.E₁ * 8) → Word) × (Fin (Pr.E₂ * 8) → Word) =>
      ∃ k, R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (ws k).1 L₁ ∨ R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (ws k).2 L₂) := by
    rw [mass_equiv (eWords W Pr N) Gb]
    refine mass_congr _ _ (fun ws => ?_)
    simp [Gb, eWords]
  refine (mass_mono _ (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr => Gb (fun k => (eV W Pr (s k).2.1).2.2.1))
    (fun s hs => ?_)).trans ?_
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hs
    exact ⟨k, hex _ _ hk⟩
  · rw [hm, hw]
    exact R1Z.CommitReadsR1.mass_exh_attempts N L₁ L₂ _ _ h₁ h₂

theorem pf_pub (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (w : h.Instance) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    PairFresh (fun _ : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr => W.pubBytes x)
      (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p) (2 ^ 255) := by
  obtain ⟨k, j | c⟩ := p
  · exact pairFresh_of_lens ((frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N).lens k (fc j)) _
      (taddr (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j) (extract j) _ umin_le_card_ans (fun _ _ => rfl)
      (taddr_extract (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j)
  · exact cm_pf W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c _ (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)

theorem card_posP : Fintype.card (Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) = N * n1 W Pr := by
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]

theorem mass_exhQ (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (w : h.Instance) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8) :
    mass (exhQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w) ≤ εexhP N L₁ L₂ (N * n1 W Pr) := by
  refine (mass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (mass_exhaust W Pr N L₁ L₂ hex h₁ h₂) ?_)
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card
    (fun (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) =>
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p = W.pubBytes x)
    (1 / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ)) (fun p => by
      have := pairFresh_mass (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p)
        (fun _ => W.pubBytes x) (2 ^ 255) (by positivity) (Or.inr (pf_pub W Pr R N hN h B outputs x hb w p))
      exact this)
  rw [card_posP W Pr N] at hu
  push_cast at hu ⊢
  exact hu

/-- The real model: every field of `R1RealModelV` for the phase-indexed games. -/
theorem realModel_R1P
    (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (hV : ∀ (w : h.Instance) ch, Vp h ch w ↔ V ch w) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8) :
    R1RealModelV P h V B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) x (N * n1 W Pr) W.qmax
      (2 ^ 255) (εexhP N L₁ L₂ (N * n1 W Pr)) := by
  intro adv w _
  refine ⟨cpP W Pr R eCm N hN P Vp h B outputs x w (hc w) cF hfib,
    fun j s => chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (posE W Pr N j), fun _ => True,
    fun j s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N j),
    fun i s => qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s,
    exhQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w, ?_, ?_, ?_, mass_exhQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x hb w L₁ L₂ hex h₁ h₂⟩
  · intro s hH hCE
    refine agreeP W Pr R eCm N hN P Vp h V B outputs x w adv (hin w) (hc w) hcom (hV w) s ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro p i hch heq
      apply hH
      refine ⟨(posE W Pr N).symm p, i, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact hch
      · show qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s =
          addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact heq
    · intro p p' hne heq
      apply hCE
      left
      rcases lt_trichotomy ((posE W Pr N).symm p) ((posE W Pr N).symm p') with hl | he | hg
      · refine ⟨_, _, hl, Or.inl trivial, ?_⟩
        show addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p)) =
          addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p'))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact heq
      · exact absurd ((posE W Pr N).symm.injective he) hne
      · refine ⟨_, _, hg, Or.inl trivial, ?_⟩
        show addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p')) =
          addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact heq.symm
    · intro k hk
      exact hCE (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨k, hk⟩))
    · intro p hp
      exact hCE (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨p, hp⟩))
  · intro j i
    rcases hp : posE W Pr N j with ⟨k, jj | c⟩
    · simp only [hp]
      exact hit_tr W Pr R eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv k jj i
    · simp only [hp]
      exact hit_cm W Pr R eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv hb hop hcom k c i
  · intro j j' hlt _
    exact pair_all W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂ (posE W Pr N j) (posE W Pr N j')
      (fun e => ne_of_lt hlt ((posE W Pr N).injective e))

end Model

#print axioms eWords

R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.text:
import R1Z.CommitReadsR1

/-! The R1 privacy error at N = 8 under the binary-multiproof read budget
`115 + Mc ≤ 2^22` (`CommitReadsR1.mc_le`; r1p-readbudget/READ-BUDGET-BINARY.md).

The privacy theorems (`privacy_R1`, `privacy_R1_games′` /
`privacy_R1_games_spendSampler`, `privacy_R1P`) are parametric in the read
count (`M`, `Mc`, `N * n1 W Pr`); their statements are unchanged.  This module
evaluates their error expressions at the new constant:

* `r1_error_N8_bin`: the D41 form (`zkfs_R1_abort_N8`, three terms, `M = Mi =
  8 · 2^22`, `q = 2^64`, `Umin = 2^255`, exhaustion slot `2^-250`) is
  `≤ 2^-165` (it was `≤ 2^-166` at `8 · 2^21`).
* `exh_bin_le`: the body of `FinalR1P.εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ M` under `RCommitCount`
  and `M ≤ 8 · 2^22` is `≤ 2^-229`.
* `r1_games_error_le`: the error expression of `privacy_R1_games_spendSampler`
  (D42.1 form with the pole term, `Mi = 0`) at `N = 8`, for every `Mc` with
  `115 + Mc ≤ 2^22`, `qmax ≤ 2^64` and `εexh ≤ 2^-229`, is
  `≤ 2^-109 + 2^-137`: the pole term `8 · 4096 / (p⁴ − 1)` dominates.
* `r1_games_error_RCommitCount`: the same at `Mc = McR1 (2 L₁) (2 L₂)`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ReadBudgetR1
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1

/-- D41 form at the binary budget: `M = Mi = 8 · 2^22`. -/
theorem r1_error_N8_bin :
    ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((2 ^ 64 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (1 / 2 ^ 250 : ℚ)) +
      ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
    1 / 2 ^ 165 := by
  norm_num

/-- The exhaustion slot of `FinalR1P.εexhP` at `N = 8`. -/
theorem exh_bin_le (L₁ L₂ M : ℕ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (hM : M ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22) :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 + (M : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 255) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
  have hL : ((L₁ + L₂ : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 49152 := by
    have : L₁ + L₂ ≤ 49152 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hM' : (M : ℚ) ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22 := by exact_mod_cast hM
  push_cast at hL
  calc ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 + (M : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 255)
      ≤ (8 : ℚ) * (16 * 49152) / 2 ^ 496 + (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 255) := by
        push_cast
        gcongr
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by
        -- `2^496` is past the numeral evaluator's exponent limit (256): split it.
        rw [show (2 : ℚ) ^ 496 = 2 ^ 248 * 2 ^ 248 by rw [← pow_add]]
        norm_num

/-- The pole term at `N = 8`. -/
theorem pole_N8 : (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
    1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 138 + 1 / 2 ^ 160 := by
  norm_num

/-- The error of `privacy_R1_games_spendSampler` at `N = 8` under the binary
read budget. -/
theorem r1_games_error_le (Mc qmax : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hM : 115 + Mc ≤ 2 ^ 22)
    (hq : qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) (he : εexh ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229) :
    ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 := by
  have hA : ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22 := by
    have : 8 * (115 + Mc) ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hA0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hq' : (qmax : ℚ) ≤ 2 ^ 64 := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ qmax := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hU : (0 : ℚ) < ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by positivity
  have h1 : ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 64 / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    gcongr
  have h2 : ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * (8 * 2 ^ 22) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    gcongr
  have hp := pole_N8
  have hz : ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) = 0 := by simp
  rw [hz]
  have hnum : (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 64 / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * (8 * 2 ^ 22) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 / 2 ^ 229) + 0 +
      (1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 138 + 1 / 2 ^ 160) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 := by
    norm_num
  linarith

/-- The same at the source count `Mc = McR1 (2 L₁) (2 L₂)` (`mc_le`). -/
theorem r1_games_error_RCommitCount (L₁ L₂ qmax : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (hq : qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) (he : εexh ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229) :
    ((8 * (115 + McR1 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂)) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((8 * (115 + McR1 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂)) : ℕ) : ℚ) *
            ((8 * (115 + McR1 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂)) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 :=
  r1_games_error_le _ qmax εexh (mc_le L₁ L₂ hc) hq he

end R1Z.ReadBudgetR1

#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.r1_error_N8_bin
#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.exh_bin_le
#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.pole_N8
#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.r1_games_error_le
#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.r1_games_error_RCommitCount

R1Z.LayoutCountR1PBin.text:
import R1Z.GamesR1PBin
import R1Z.ReadBudgetR1

/-! Exact binary attempt size and the existing D76 error bound. The two
binding reads are included, in addition to CommitReadsR1's Mc. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.GamesR1PBin
open R0P R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.CommitReadsR1

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)

theorem n1_eq : n1 W Pr = 115 + (McR1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ + 2) := by
  rw [n1, card_Pos1]
  unfold McR1
  omega

theorem n1_worst_case (h₁ : Pr.E₁ = 90112) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ = 8192) :
    n1 W Pr = 2457717 := by rw [n1_eq, h₁, h₂]; rfl

/-- Source counts plus expander budgets, including both binding reads. -/
theorem n1_le (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (h₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂) : n1 W Pr ≤ 2 ^ 22 := by
  rw [n1_eq]
  obtain ⟨hc₁, hc₂⟩ := hc
  unfold McR1
  norm_num at *
  omega

/-- Exactly the error expression in the binary phase-indexed privacy root.
The existing ReadBudgetR1 theorem is instantiated, not modified. -/
theorem binary_games_error_le (L₁ L₂ qmax : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (h₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (hq : qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) (he : εexh ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229) :
    ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) /
        ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
      ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
        1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 := by
  rw [n1_eq]
  exact R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.r1_games_error_le _ qmax εexh
    (by rw [← n1_eq W Pr]; exact n1_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hc h₁ h₂) hq he

#print axioms n1_eq
#print axioms n1_worst_case
#print axioms n1_le
#print axioms binary_games_error_le
end R1Z.GamesR1PBin

R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin.text:
import R1Z.FinalR1PBin
import R1Z.LayoutTagR1PBin
import R1Z.LayoutCountR1PBin
import R1Z.SimulatorR1
import R1Z.Sem1UniformR1

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.PrivacyR1P` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! `privacy_R1_games'` (LOG D48.3, DESIGN-R1-REAL §6): the R1 privacy theorem
for the phase-indexed games `fsR1P` / `abR1P` against the explicit simulator
`simE`, with every `R1RealData` field discharged.  Its hypotheses are

* PackField, PublicBase, BuilderSoundOn;
* the D47 sampler premises `SemRows01 W`, `QM31SamplerLaw` (R-wire);
* R-rom: `RomModel W` (uniform table on a finite domain) and `RAddrIn`;
* R-causal: `RCausal`;
* R-commit: `RCommitBytes` (address grammar: leaves `0x10 ‖ tag ‖ value ‖
  salt`, nodes `0x12 ‖ 2 children` (binary, LOG D76), salts, seeds, bindings, expander blocks),
  the decoder's equal fibres (`hfib`), `RExh` (exhaustion = a 16-try
  little-endian word stream exhausted), the counter range `E ≤ 2^64` and the
  stream budgets `16 L ≤ 8 E`;
* R-wire: `eCm` (the Cm coin is the `RIdx` answers), `ROpen`, `RComLog`.

Error: `M q/2^255 + (M²/2^255 + εexh) + 0 + N·4096/(p⁴−1)` with
`M = N·|Pos1|`, `εexh = N·16(L₁+L₂)/2^496 + M/2^255`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Every field of `R1IdealModelS` for `fsR1P` and any simulator. -/
theorem idealModelS_R1P (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (M Umin : ℕ) (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    R1IdealModelS P (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) x M Umin sim := by
  intro adv
  refine ⟨idCoupling _, fun _ => False, fun _ _ => [], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s _
    exact (retryOut_bit N (fun c => P (drawW W c)) (fun c t => sim (drawW W c) t)
      (fun c k v => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x c k v) (fun c => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x c)
      (fun o => bit (adv.decide o)) s).symm
  · intro j j' _ hp
    rcases hp with hp | hp <;> exact False.elim hp

/-- The R1 privacy theorem for the phase-indexed games. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games' (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1)
    (R : RomModel W) (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
          εexhP N L₁ L₂ (N * n1 W Pr)) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1P W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) :=
  privacy_R1_eff h B hB outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
    hpub hs (abR1P W N hN) (N * n1 W Pr) 0 W.qmax (2 ^ 255) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1)
    (εexhP N L₁ L₂ (N * n1 W Pr)) (by positivity)
    (realModel_R1P W Pr R eCm N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x
      hin hc hb hop hcom (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl) cF hfib hE₁ hE₂ L₁ L₂ hex h₁ h₂)
    (idealModelS_R1P W Pr N hN _ _ x 0 (2 ^ 255) (simE h.transport B outputs x))
    (fun adv => sem1Uniform_abR1 W N hN D L adv x)

#print axioms idealModelS_R1P
#print axioms privacy_R1_games'
end R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin

R1J.PrivacySamplerSpendBin.text:
import R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin
import R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend

/-! Binary phase-indexed root with the extracted spend sampler law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1J.PrivacySamplerSpendBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload

theorem privacy_R1_games_spendSampler_bin (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι)
    (R : RomModel W) (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
          εexhP N L₁ L₂ (N * n1 W Pr)) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1P W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) :=
  R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin.privacy_R1_games' W Pr N hN h B hB outputs x hpub hs D
    (R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι hD) R hin hc hb cF hfib
    L₁ L₂ hex hE₁ hE₂ h₁ h₂ eCm hop hcom

/-! Counterexample to unconditionally separating binary nodes from abstract
duplex records. Only a 65-byte literal equality is reduced here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1

/-- An abstract semantic absorb can equal a binary-node record. Wire lengths
are essential; first-byte separation cannot hold for arbitrary digests. -/
theorem binary_duplex_overlap :
    ∃ left right f : OracleAnswer, ∃ framed : List UInt8,
      [binTag] ++ ans left ++ ans right = ans f ++ [0, 0xa0] ++ framed := by
  refine ⟨(fun _ => 0), (fun i => if i.val = 0 then 0xa0 else 0),
    (fun i => if i.val = 0 then binTag else 0), List.replicate 31 0, ?_⟩
  decide

#print axioms binary_duplex_overlap

/-! D76 bound for the binary phase-indexed root, including both binding reads. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.CommitReadsR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

theorem binary_exhaustion_le (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ)
    (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (h₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂) :
    εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by
  have hm : ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 2 ^ 25 := by
    have h := n1_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hc h₁ h₂
    have hh : 8 * n1 W Pr ≤ 2 ^ 25 := by norm_num at h ⊢; omega
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hl : (16 * (L₁ + L₂) : ℚ) ≤ 2 ^ 20 := by
    obtain ⟨hL₁, hL₂⟩ := hc
    have hh : 16 * (L₁ + L₂) ≤ 2 ^ 20 := by norm_num at hL₁ hL₂ ⊢; omega
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have he : (8 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 20 / 2 ^ 496 ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 230 := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ 496)
      (by positivity : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ 230)).mpr
    rw [one_mul, show (8 : ℚ) = 2 ^ 3 by norm_num, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hb : (2 : ℚ) ^ 25 * (1 / 2 ^ 255) = 1 / 2 ^ 230 := by
    rw [show (255 : ℕ) = 25 + 230 from rfl, pow_add]
    field_simp
  unfold εexhP
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  calc
    _ ≤ (8 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 20 / 2 ^ 496 + 2 ^ 25 * (1 / 2 ^ 255) :=
      add_le_add
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (by norm_num))
          (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (by positivity))
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 230 + 1 / 2 ^ 230 := add_le_add he (le_of_eq hb)
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by norm_num

#print axioms binary_exhaustion_le

theorem privacy_R1_games_binary_bound (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι)
    (R : RomModel W) (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (hcount : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (hb₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (hb₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (hq : W.qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137) := by
  have hz := R1J.PrivacySamplerSpendBin.privacy_R1_games_spendSampler_bin
    W Pr 8 (by decide) h B hB outputs x hpub hs D ι hι hD R hin hc hb cF hfib
    L₁ L₂ hex hE₁ hE₂ h₁ h₂ eCm hop hcom
  intro adv w hw
  refine (hz adv w hw).trans ?_
  simpa only [abR1P, abR1, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    (binary_games_error_le W Pr L₁ L₂ W.qmax (εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr))
      hcount hb₁ hb₂ hq (binary_exhaustion_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hcount hb₁ hb₂))

#print axioms privacy_R1_games_binary_bound
end R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin

/-! ZF2 release root on the adopted Bin chain. The simulator's log is
characterized in SimulatorLogR1PBin. The existing binary root already applies
SimulatorR1.privacy_R1_eff; this exports its D76 budget with that log bridge
in the dependency cone. R-wire/causality/ROM premises remain explicit. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacySimulatorBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.CommitReadsR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

theorem privacy_R1_eff_binary (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι)
    (R : RomModel W) (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (hcount : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (hb₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (hb₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (hq : W.qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137) := by
  have hz := privacy_R1_eff h B hB outputs
    (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
    hpub hs (abR1P W 8 (by decide)) (8 * n1 W Pr) 0 W.qmax (2 ^ 255)
    ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) (εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr)) (by positivity)
    (realModel_R1P W Pr R eCm 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB)
      (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x hin hc hb hop hcom
      (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl) cF hfib hE₁ hE₂ L₁ L₂ hex h₁ h₂)
    (R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin.idealModelS_R1P W Pr 8 (by decide) _ _ x 0 (2 ^ 255)
      (simE h.transport B outputs x))
    (fun adv => sem1Uniform_abR1 W 8 (by decide) D
      (R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι hD) adv x)
  intro adv w hw
  refine (hz adv w hw).trans ?_
  simpa only [abR1P, abR1, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    (binary_games_error_le W Pr L₁ L₂ W.qmax (εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr))
      hcount hb₁ hb₂ hq
      (R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin.binary_exhaustion_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hcount hb₁ hb₂))

#print axioms privacy_R1_eff_binary
end R1Z.PrivacySimulatorBin
