import R1Z.PrivacyPremisesBin
import R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin
import R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
import R1Z.RomGrammarBin
import R1Z.RomObserverBin

/-! Final conditional privacy statement for the adopted binary format.
The source experiments remain parameters: their operational handoff (including
D46/D51 builder and D75 checker correspondence) is NOT proved by byte grammar.
D80 is consumed at its exact universal quantifiers, including inconsistent
answer vectors. D81 identifies the binary grammar; D79/addendum separation
is exported below on the concrete carrier. See PRIVACY-FINAL-20261020.md. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyR1Final
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.PremisesR1PBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- D80's eight constructor equations, each at the full AddressAt quantifiers. -/
structure RCommitSource (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) : Prop where
  roots : ∀ T, AddressAt W Pr (.inl T)
  mask_expander : ∀ c, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inl (.inl c)))
  source_expander : ∀ c, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inl (.inr c)))
  bindings : ∀ b, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qBind b)))
  seeds : ∀ i, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qSeed i)))
  salts : ∀ T u, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qSalt T u)))
  leaves : ∀ T u, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qLeaf T u)))
  nodes : ∀ T n, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qNode T n)))

theorem commit_source (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (s : RCommitSource W Pr) :
    RCommitBytes W Pr :=
  (commit_bytes_iff W Pr).mpr ⟨s.roots, s.mask_expander, s.source_expander,
    s.bindings, s.seeds, s.salts, s.leaves, s.nodes⟩

/-- Normalized per-transaction batches, never the repeated raw leaf-call list. -/
structure RWireBatches (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) where
  fib : Challenges K → Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Finset Fib
  reads : Challenges K → Fin 2 → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)
  concatenation : ∀ ch, Pr.openList ch = reads ch 0 ++ reads ch 1
  nodup : ∀ ch b, (reads ch b).Nodup
  coverage : ∀ ch b c, c ∈ reads ch b ↔ openedQ (fib ch b) c
  fibre_union : ∀ ch T, Pr.openFib ch T = fib ch 0 T ∪ fib ch 1 T

theorem wire_batches (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (s : RWireBatches W Pr) : ROpen Pr :=
  open_of_batches W Pr s.fib s.reads s.concatenation s.nodup s.coverage s.fibre_union

/-- The shared grammar inherits D79 separation, including all three binding
classes. Execution membership in this concrete carrier is still R-wire. -/
theorem shared_wire_separation (wire : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire)
    (answers : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (children : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (read : WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.ExtendedRead) :
    AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => answers (children j)) ≠
      read.bytes wire := by
  rw [← SharedGrammarBridgeBin.node_eq]
  exact WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.node_ne_extended_read wire answers children read

/-- The exact D52/D77 model error; the ideal programming term is zero. -/
def modelError (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * W.qmax / (2 : ℚ)^255 +
  (((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ)^2 / (2 : ℚ)^255 +
    εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr)) + 0 +
  (8 : ℚ) * (4096 / (((2^31-1)^4-1 : ℕ) : ℚ))

/-- Every numerical slot at the conservative D76 envelope M=2^25,
q=2^64, L1+L2≤49152. Split powers before normalizing. -/
theorem deployed_term_values :
    ((2 : ℚ)^25 * 2^64 / 2^255 = 1 / 2^166) ∧
    (((2 : ℚ)^25)^2 / 2^255 = 1 / 2^205) ∧
    ((8 : ℚ) * (16 * 49152) / 2^496 ≤ 1 / 2^473) ∧
    ((2 : ℚ)^25 / 2^255 = 1 / 2^230) ∧
    ((8 : ℚ) * (4096 / (((2^31-1)^4-1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^138 + 1 / 2^160) ∧
    ((16 : ℚ) / 2^486 ≤ 1 / 2^454) := by
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_, by norm_num,
    R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.pole_N8, query_error_le⟩
  rw [show (496 : ℕ) = 248 + 248 from rfl, pow_add,
    show (473 : ℕ) = 230 + 243 from rfl, pow_add]
  norm_num

/-- Exact D77 worst-case count, rather than the conservative power-of-two
read envelope. This equality displays both components of epsilon_exh. -/
theorem deployed_exact_error (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ = 90112) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ = 8192) (hq : W.qmax = 2^64) :
    modelError W Pr 45056 4096 =
      (19661736 : ℚ) * 2^64 / 2^255 +
      ((19661736 : ℚ)^2 / 2^255 +
        (6291456 / (2 : ℚ)^496 + 19661736 / (2 : ℚ)^255)) + 0 +
      (8 : ℚ) * (4096 / (((2^31-1)^4-1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
  rw [modelError, n1_worst_case W Pr hE₁ hE₂, hq]
  norm_num only [εexhP, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow]

section ChosenROM
variable (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
local notation "W" => RomFiniteBin.wire base (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth)

/-- ONE composed endpoint. The two ScanCoupling hypotheses are the source
handoffs: real includes builder/checker/retry/publication correctness; ideal
includes the Rust sim_e/programmed-oracle correspondence. They permit only
QueryScan disagreement and require its actual reached-history law.
All other Semantic errors must be impossible or agree in those handoffs.
The table backend, query cap and Boolean observer map are constructed here;
the source supplies typed read coverage and its operational query program. -/
theorem privacy_R1_final
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (builder_refinement_D46_D51 : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (R_wire_Sem1Uniform : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι)
    (R_wire_read_coverage : RomGrammarBin.ReadCoverage W Pr publicWidth h B outputs x)
    (R_causal_D80 : ∀ (w : h.Instance) sec d p v v', Earlier W Pr p v v' →
      attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v p = attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v' p)
    (R_commit_D80 : RCommitSource W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (R_commit_equal_fibres : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (R_commit_exhaustion : RExh Pr L₁ L₂)
    (R_commit_counter₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (R_commit_counter₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (R_commit_stream₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (R_commit_stream₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (R_wire_coin_carrier : (W).Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer))
    (R_wire_D80_batches : RWireBatches W Pr)
    (R_wire_D80_ordered_log : ∀ (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
      (τ : Tape K F) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Challenges K),
      (W).comLog (R_wire_coin_carrier.symm rest) roots (view h B outputs x w ch τ) ch =
        (Pr.openList ch).map (fun c =>
          (gram ((W).pubBytes x) (W).vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest
            (cposOf (E₁ := Pr.E₁) (E₂ := Pr.E₂) c), ansC roots rest c)))
    (R_commit_cell_count : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (R_commit_blocks₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (R_commit_blocks₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    [Fintype source.RealRand] [Nonempty source.RealRand]
    [Fintype source.IdealRand] [Nonempty source.IdealRand]
    (observer_program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg)
    (R_wire_builder_checker_D75_retry : ∀ (adv : source.Adversary) (w : h.Instance),
      h.public w = x.1 → ScanCoupling
        (realTest h B outputs source adv x w)
        (realTest h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
          (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x w))
    (G_sim_R_wire : ∀ adv : source.Adversary, ScanCoupling
      (idealTestS source adv x (simE h.transport B outputs x))
      (idealTestS (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h'))
        (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x (simE h.transport B outputs x))) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs source x (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486) ∧
    modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486 ≤
      1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^137 + 1 / 2^454 := by
  let R_rom_classical : RomModel W := RomFiniteBin.rom base (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth)
  have R_rom_address_domain : ∀ w : h.Instance,
      RAddrIn W Pr R_rom_classical h B outputs x w :=
    RomGrammarBin.address_domain base publicWidth Pr h B outputs x R_wire_read_coverage
  have R_rom_adversary_budget : (W).qmax ≤ 2^64 :=
    RomFiniteBin.adversary_budget base (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth)
  have hb := commit_source W Pr R_commit_D80
  have hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w :=
    fun w => (causal_iff W Pr h B outputs x w).mpr (R_causal_D80 w)
  have hop := wire_batches W Pr R_wire_D80_batches
  have hcom := (com_log_iff W Pr hb R_wire_coin_carrier h B outputs x).mpr R_wire_D80_ordered_log
  have hz := R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin.privacy_R1_games' W Pr 8 (by decide) h B hB outputs x
    hpub builder_refinement_D46_D51 D
    (R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι R_wire_Sem1Uniform)
    R_rom_classical R_rom_address_domain hc hb cF R_commit_equal_fibres L₁ L₂
    R_commit_exhaustion R_commit_counter₁ R_commit_counter₂ R_commit_stream₁ R_commit_stream₂
    R_wire_coin_carrier hop hcom
  have hm : ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
      (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x) (modelError W Pr L₁ L₂) := by
    simpa only [modelError, abR1P, abR1, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_div, pow_two] using hz
  constructor
  · intro adv w hw
    have hr := scan_coupling_le _ _ (R_wire_builder_checker_D75_retry adv w hw)
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩) (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
    have hi := scan_coupling_le _ _ (G_sim_R_wire adv)
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩) (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
    have hmid := hm (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) w hw
    have t₁ := abs_sub_le
      (mean (realTest h B outputs source adv x w))
      (mean (realTest h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
        (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x w))
      (mean (idealTestS (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
        (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x
          (simE h.transport B outputs x)))
    have t₂ := abs_sub_le
      (mean (realTest h B outputs source adv x w))
      (mean (idealTestS (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
        (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x
          (simE h.transport B outputs x)))
      (mean (idealTestS source adv x (simE h.transport B outputs x)))
    rw [abs_sub_comm] at hi
    calc _ ≤ (8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 + modelError W Pr L₁ L₂) + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 :=
          t₂.trans (add_le_add (t₁.trans (add_le_add hr hmid)) hi)
         _ = _ := by ring
  · have he := R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin.binary_exhaustion_le W Pr L₁ L₂
      R_commit_cell_count R_commit_blocks₁ R_commit_blocks₂
    have hn := R1Z.GamesR1PBin.binary_games_error_le W Pr L₁ L₂ (W).qmax
      (εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr)) R_commit_cell_count R_commit_blocks₁ R_commit_blocks₂
      R_rom_adversary_budget he
    have hn' : modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ ≤ 1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^137 := by
      simpa only [modelError, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_zero, pow_two, zero_mul, zero_div] using hn
    linarith [query_error_le]

end ChosenROM

R1Z.PhaseProtocolCoverageBin.text:
import R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin

/-! Byte lengths and typed coverage of the constructed protocol, independent
of Rust execution joins. All facts hold on arbitrary counterfactual views. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseProtocolCoverageBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin
  R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin
local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact

/-- Count a fixed-width vector symbolically, without evaluating its cells. -/
theorem flatten_length {n m : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → List UInt8)
    (hf : ∀ i, (xs i).length = m) :
    (List.ofFn xs).flatten.length = n * m := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.flatten_cons, List.length_append, hf 0,
      ih (fun i => xs i.succ) (fun i => hf i.succ)]
    rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    omega

theorem wide_length (a : K) : (wideBytes a).length = 32 := by
  simpa only [wideBytes, List.length_map] using
    AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeWide_length a

theorem encoded_length {n : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → K) :
    (encoded wideBytes xs).length = n * 32 := by
  unfold encoded AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.encode
  simpa only [List.flatMap_def, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using
    (flatten_length (fun i => wideBytes (xs i)) (fun i => wide_length (xs i)))

theorem semantic_length (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27) :
    (semantic wideBytes p root i).length = WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticSize i := by
  unfold semantic WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticSize
  split_ifs
  all_goals try simp only [length_ans, wide_length, encoded_length, List.length_append,
    flatten_length _ (fun _ => encoded_length _), List.length_nil]
  all_goals omega

theorem opening_length (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4) :
    (opening wideBytes p root i).length = WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize i := by
  unfold opening WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split)
  all_goals try simp only [length_ans, wide_length, encoded_length, List.length_append]

theorem final_length {CommitHandle Aux : Type}
    (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    (PhaseMessageEncodingBin.final wideBytes v).length = 2048 := encoded_length _

/-- The first 26 lanes are four bytes and the last is sixteen bytes. -/
theorem c1_slot_length (xs : Fin 27 → K) :
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 => (wideBytes (xs c)).take
      (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten.length = 120 := by
  rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append, List.flatten_append,
    List.flatten_cons, List.flatten_nil, List.append_nil, List.length_append]
  have hl : ∀ c : Fin 26, ((wideBytes (xs c.castSucc)).take
      (if c.castSucc.val < 26 then 4 else 16)).length = 4 := by
    intro c
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
    rw [if_pos c.isLt, List.length_take, wide_length]
    rfl
  rw [flatten_length _ hl]
  simp only [Fin.val_last, Nat.lt_irrefl, if_false, List.length_take, wide_length]
  rfl


theorem c1_length (m : Fin 27 → Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding.c1 m u).length = 480 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding
  exact flatten_length _ (fun _ => c1_slot_length _)

theorem c2_length (m : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding.c2 m u).length = 128 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding
  dsimp only
  apply flatten_length (m := 32)
  intro s
  apply flatten_length (m := 16)
  intro c
  rw [List.length_take, wide_length]
  rfl

theorem folded_length (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding.folded m u).length = 128 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding PhaseLeafEncodingBin.foldedLeaf
  dsimp only
  split <;> simp only [List.length_map, AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded_length,
    List.length_replicate]

theorem leaf_length {CommitHandle : Type} {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K) (w : h.Instance)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F) (ch : Challenges K) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding B h w x τ ch T u).length =
      if T.val = 0 then 480 else 128 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal
  split <;> (try split) <;> simp only [c1_length, c2_length, folded_length]

theorem byte_mod_eq (n : ℕ) :
    UInt8.ofFin ⟨n % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ = (n % 256).toUInt8 := by
  apply UInt8.toNat_inj.mp
  change n % 256 = (n % 256) % 256
  exact (Nat.mod_mod n 256).symm

/-- Byte-carrier transport preserves the existing four little-endian bytes. -/
theorem length_bytes_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.lengthBytes n).map UInt8.ofFin = le32 n := by
  simp only [AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.lengthBytes, List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero,
    List.map_cons, List.map_nil, le32, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
  norm_num only [pow_zero, pow_one, Nat.div_one, Nat.reducePow]
  simp only [byte_mod_eq]

theorem framed_eq (tag : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    PhaseMessageEncodingBin.framed tag bs = [tag] ++ le32 bs.length ++ bs := by
  unfold PhaseMessageEncodingBin.framed AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec.frame
    AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec.header
  simp only [List.length_map, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
    UInt8.ofFin_toFin, length_bytes_eq, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_id bs

/-- A list already proved to have the required width inhabits the typed carrier. -/
def bytesVector {n : ℕ} (bs : List UInt8) (hl : bs.length = n) : Vector UInt8 n :=
  ⟨bs.toArray, by simpa only [List.size_toArray] using hl⟩

theorem bytesVector_list {n : ℕ} (bs : List UInt8) (hl : bs.length = n) :
    (bytesVector bs hl).toList = bs := by
  simp only [bytesVector, Vector.toList, List.toList_toArray]

variable {CommitHandle Aux : Type} {F : Subfield K}

/-- The entire selected transcript is a D79/D81 wire, even off successful runs. -/
def transcriptWire (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8)
    (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) (c2 cf : OracleAnswer) :
    WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire where
  semantic := fun i => bytesVector (semantic wideBytes v.2 c2 i) (semantic_length _ _ i)
  opening := fun i => bytesVector (opening wideBytes v.2 cf i) (opening_length _ _ i)
  final := bytesVector (PhaseMessageEncodingBin.final wideBytes v) (final_length v)
  publicBytes := pub
  tag := tag

theorem transcript_rest (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (tr : TRead → OracleAnswer) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) :
    (recP (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire x v tr roots).rest =
      WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (transcriptWire (base.pubBytes x) base.vtag v (roots 1) (roots 2)) := by
  change Rest.mk _ _ _ _ _ = Rest.mk _ _ _ _ _
  congr 1
  · funext i
    change PhaseMessageEncodingBin.framed _ _ = WireLengthsR1PBin.framed _ i
    rw [framed_eq]
    simp only [WireLengthsR1PBin.framed, transcriptWire, bytesVector_list, semantic_length]

/-- D84 coverage is a model theorem after the public byte width is chosen. -/
theorem read_coverage (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire)
    (hp : (base.pubBytes x).length ≤ publicWidth) :
    RomGrammarBin.ReadCoverage (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
      (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver publicWidth h B outputs x := by
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  intro w sec d v p
  cases p with
  | inl j =>
    let record := recP (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire x
      (view h B outputs x w
        (chOf (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire (trOf v))
        (tapeR (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
          (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver v)) (trOf v) (rootsOf v)
    let tw := transcriptWire (base.pubBytes x) base.vtag
      (view h B outputs x w
        (chOf (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire (trOf v))
        (tapeR (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
          (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver v))
      (rootsOf v 1) (rootsOf v 2)
    refine ⟨.transcript (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.toShared tw) hp j (fieldVal (fc j) record), ?_⟩
    change addrWith j (fieldVal (fc j) record)
      (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.toShared tw))) =
      addr j record
    rw [SharedGrammarBridgeBin.wire_roundtrip]
    unfold addr
    rw [show record.rest = WireLengthsR1PBin.rest tw from transcript_rest _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _]
  | inr c =>
    have hl : ∀ T u,
        ((prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver.leafVal h w x
          (tapeR (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
            (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver v)
          (chOf (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire (trOf v)) T u).length ≤ 480 := by
      intro T u
      change (PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding B h w x _ _ T u).length ≤ 480
      rw [leaf_length]
      split <;> omega
    exact ⟨.commitment (base.pubBytes x) hp base.vtag _ hl sec d (restOf v) c, rfl⟩

#print axioms encoded_length

#print axioms final_length

#print axioms c1_length
#print axioms c2_length
#print axioms folded_length
#print axioms leaf_length
#print axioms byte_mod_eq
#print axioms length_bytes_eq
#print axioms framed_eq

#print axioms read_coverage
end R1Z.PhaseProtocolCoverageBin

import R1Z.PrivacyR1Final
import R1Z.PhaseProtocolCoverageBin

/-! Release privacy endpoint over the constructed phase protocol model.
Source experiments and the residual tape/opening data retain their explicit
handoffs; no Rust execution identification is inferred. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyR1FinalProtocol
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.PremisesR1PBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin R1Z.PrivacyR1Final
local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact
variable {CommitHandle Aux : Type} {F : Subfield K}
variable (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
variable (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire)

/-- The eight address families are selected by the phase prover constructor. -/
theorem commitment_grammar :
    PrivacyR1Final.RCommitSource (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver := by
  constructor <;> intros <;> unfold AddressAt <;> intros <;> rfl

/-- Release specialization with the ROM width chosen as the public byte
length. Sampler, grammar, universal causality and typed read coverage are
constructed. All residual premises keep their original quantifiers. -/
theorem privacy_R1_protocol
    (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F
      (wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire)
    (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (builder_refinement_D46_D51 : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (cF : ℕ)
    (R_commit_equal_fibres : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (R_commit_exhaustion : RExh (prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver L₁ L₂)
    (R_commit_counter₁ : ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₁ ≤ 2^64) (R_commit_counter₂ : ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (R_commit_stream₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₁ * 8) (R_commit_stream₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₂ * 8)
    (R_wire_coin_carrier : ((wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire).Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer))
    (R_wire_D80_batches : RWireBatches (wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire (prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver)
    (R_wire_D80_ordered_log : ∀ (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
      (τ : Tape K F) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Challenges K),
      ((wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire).comLog (R_wire_coin_carrier.symm rest) roots (view h B outputs x w ch τ) ch =
        (((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).openList ch).map (fun c =>
          (gram (((wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire).pubBytes x) ((wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire).vtag (((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest
            (cposOf (E₁ := ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₁) (E₂ := ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₂) c), ansC roots rest c)))
    (R_commit_cell_count : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (R_commit_blocks₁ : ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (R_commit_blocks₂ : ((prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver).E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    [Fintype source.RealRand] [Nonempty source.RealRand]
    [Fintype source.IdealRand] [Nonempty source.IdealRand]
    (observer_program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg)
    (R_wire_builder_checker_D75_retry : ∀ (adv : source.Adversary) (w : h.Instance),
      h.public w = x.1 → ScanCoupling
        (realTest h B outputs source adv x w)
        (realTest h B outputs (fsR1P (wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire (prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver 8 (by decide)
          (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x w))
    (G_sim_R_wire : ∀ adv : source.Adversary, ScanCoupling
      (idealTestS source adv x (simE h.transport B outputs x))
      (idealTestS (fsR1P (wire base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x).toWire (prover base ((base.pubBytes x).length) h B outputs x seed).toProver 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h'))

import R1Z.PrivacyR1FinalProtocolHistory

/-! Exact scan input dependencies and the operational prior-read event.
The finite ROM table is total; freshness refers to the read history, not
membership in its underlying finite address domain. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs
open R0P R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.JointView R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.AgreeR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- The state feeding each pair, in the actual answer-vector grammar. -/
def predecessor : Fin 8 → TRead
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => .absQ
  | ⟨n+1, hn⟩ => .qa ⟨n, by omega⟩

theorem scan_field (k : Fin 8) :
    fc (.qb k) = .ans (predecessor k) ∧
    fc (.qa k) = .ans (predecessor k) := by
  rcases k with ⟨_ | n, hk⟩ <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

theorem scan_addresses (ρ : Rec) (k : Fin 8) :
    addr (.qb k) ρ = ans (ρ.tr (predecessor k)) ++ [1] ∧
    addr (.qa k) ρ = ans (ρ.tr (predecessor k)) ++ [2] := by
  obtain ⟨hb, ha⟩ := scan_field k
  simp only [addr, hb, ha, fieldVal, addrWith]
  exact ⟨trivial, trivial⟩

/-- Scan-specific prior reads of a causal program. The digest is the first
read; only earlier scheduled reads count. Post-proof adversary rereads do not. -/
def FreshFailure {m : ℕ} (scan : Fin m → Prop)
    (digest : List UInt8) (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8)
    (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∃ i, scan i ∧ (a i (runN a H 0 i.val) = digest ∨
    ∃ j : Fin m, j < i ∧
      a j (runN a H 0 j.val) = a i (runN a H 0 i.val))

theorem off_fresh_failure {m : ℕ} (scan : Fin m → Prop)
    (digest : List UInt8) (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8)
    (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (hn : ¬ FreshFailure scan digest a H)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : scan i) :
    a i (runN a H 0 i.val) ≠ digest ∧
    ∀ j : Fin m, j < i →
      a j (runN a H 0 j.val) ≠ a i (runN a H 0 i.val) := by
  exact ⟨fun he => hn ⟨i, hi, Or.inl he⟩,
    fun j hj he => hn ⟨i, hi, Or.inr ⟨j, hj, he⟩⟩⟩

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- No salt, counter, prover secret or message appears directly in a scan
input. Entropy must be established for this preceding oracle answer. -/
theorem real_scan_addresses (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v (.inl (.qb k)) =
      ans (trOf v (predecessor k)) ++ [1] ∧
    attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v (.inl (.qa k)) =
      ans (trOf v (predecessor k)) ++ [2] := by
  exact scan_addresses _ k

#print axioms scan_field
#print axioms scan_addresses
#print axioms off_fresh_failure
#print axioms real_scan_addresses
end R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs

import R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs

/-! A conservative real-model law from the retained lazy coupling. This
charges a single *honest program* collision event; it does not include any
adversary rereads. No claim of the sharper scan-only entropy law is made. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1
  R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

/-- Fixed all-honest-read event on the independent lazy coupling space. -/
def lazyBad (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Prop :=
  CollEv (N * n1 W Pr) (fun _ => True)
    (fun g s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g)) s ∨
  ∃ g, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) = W.pubBytes x

def lazyBudget (M : ℕ) : ℚ := (M : ℚ) * M / 2^255 + (M : ℚ) / 2^255

theorem lazy_bad_mass (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64) :
    mass (lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w) ≤ lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) := by
  apply (mass_or_le _ _).trans
  apply add_le_add
  · exact collEv_mass_fresh _ _ (by positivity) _ _
      (fun i j hij _ => pair_all W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂
        _ _ (fun he => ne_of_lt hij ((posE W Pr N).injective he)))
  · have hp := mass_exists_le_card
      (fun g s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) = W.pubBytes x)
      (1 / ((2^255 : ℕ) : ℚ)) (fun g =>
        pairFresh_mass _ _ _ (by positivity)
          (Or.inr (pf_pub W Pr R N hN h B outputs x hb w (posE W Pr N g))))
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one_div] using hp

theorem off_lazy_bad_run (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hn : ¬ lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) :
    runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s := by
  apply run_eq_lazy W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s
  · intro g j hj he
    exact hn (Or.inl ⟨j, g, hj, Or.inl trivial, he⟩)
  · intro g he
    exact hn (Or.inr ⟨g, he⟩)

/-- Actual vector evaluated by the honest real experiment, before publication. -/
def realVector (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer :=
  runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w r.2 (W.look r.1 (W.pubBytes x))) (W.look r.1) 0

theorem real_vector_toRP (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hn : ¬ lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) :
    realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) =
      uVec W Pr s := by
  unfold realVector
  simp only [look_toRP, TP_pub]
  change runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
    (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1) 0 = _
  rw [show W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 =
    lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) from funext (look_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)]
  exact off_lazy_bad_run W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn

/-- Fixed parser failure at its own selected first-stop block. -/
def parserBad (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∃ count, AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.finish
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.scanned (PhaseQueryScanBin.stop PhaseSamplerParserBin.done q) q).1 =
      .error count

def realBad (k : Fin N) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Prop :=
  parserBad (fun j => attVec W Pr (realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w r) k (.inl (.qb j)))

def lazyScanBad (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Prop :=
  parserBad (fun j => (s k).2.1 (.inl (.qb j)))

theorem parser_bad_mass : eventMass parserBad ≤ scanProbability := by
  have hi : ∀ q, parserBad q → AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails
      (QueryScanIndependentHistory.words64 q) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨count, hcount⟩ := hq
    exact QueryScanFirstStopHistory.selected_failure_implies_words_failure _ count hcount
  exact (eventMass_mono _ _ hi).trans (by
    simpa only [true_and] using
      QueryScanIndependentHistory.reached_failure_le (fun _ => True))

theorem lazy_scan_bad_mass (k : Fin N) :
    eventMass (lazyScanBad W Pr N k) ≤ scanProbability := by
  have h1 : MP (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => a.2) := mp_snd
  have h2 : MP (fun a : (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) × (Tape K F × W.Tab) => a.1) := mp_fst
  have h3 := QueryScanIdealHistory.coordinates_uniform (U := OracleAnswer)
    (fun j : Fin 8 => (Sum.inl (.qb j) : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂))
    (by intro a b he; cases he; rfl)
  have hh1 := (mp_comp h1 h2)
    (fun v => if parserBad (fun j => v (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hh3 := h3 (fun q => if parserBad q then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hh : mean (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      if parserBad (fun j => a.2.1 (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      eventMass parserBad := by
    trans mean (fun v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer =>
      if parserBad (fun j => v (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
    · exact hh1
    · convert hh3 using 1 <;> apply QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport
  have hm := mean_eval k
    (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => if parserBad (fun j => a.2.1 (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  exact hm.le.trans (hh.le.trans parser_bad_mass)

include hN in
/-- A single global lazy collision budget, rather than one copy per attempt. -/
theorem real_bad_union_mass (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64) :
    eventMass (fun r => ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k r) ≤
      lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) + (N : ℚ) * scanProbability := by
  have hm := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
    (fun r => if ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k r then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hm' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) =
      eventMass (fun r => ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k r) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← hm']
  change mass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
    ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) ≤ _
  have hsub : ∀ s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr,
      (∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) →
      lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s ∨ ∃ k, lazyScanBad W Pr N k s := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hn : lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s
    · exact Or.inl hn
    · right
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hs
      refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
      unfold realBad at hk
      rw [real_vector_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn, attVec_uVec] at hk
      exact hk
  exact (mass_mono _ _ hsub).trans ((mass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
      (lazy_bad_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂)
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using (mass_exists_le_card
        (lazyScanBad W Pr N) scanProbability (fun k => lazy_scan_bad_mass W Pr N k)))))

#print axioms real_vector_toRP
#print axioms parser_bad_mass
#print axioms lazy_scan_bad_mass
#print axioms real_bad_union_mass
#print axioms lazy_bad_mass
#print axioms off_lazy_bad_run
end R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound

R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound

/-! The actual scan-specific event is transported from real randomness.
A conservative honest-program collision envelope is sufficient to bound it;
this file does not identify that envelope with E_fresh. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LazyFrozen
  R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem issued_eq_final {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8)
    (hc : ∀ i v v', (∀ j, j < i → v j = v' j) → a i v = a i v')
    (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin m) :
    a i (runN a H 0 i.val) = a i (runC a H 0) := by
  apply hc
  intro j hj
  exact (runN_le a H 0 i.val m (le_of_lt i.isLt) j (Fin.lt_def.mp hj)).symm

def IsScan : TRead → Prop
  | .qb _ | .qa _ => True
  | _ => False

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

def scanPosition (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) : Prop :=
  match (posE W Pr N i).2 with
  | .inl j => IsScan j
  | .inr _ => False

/-- E_fresh on the actual real randomness. The digest is included once. -/
def realFresh (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Prop :=
  FreshFailure (scanPosition W Pr N) (W.pubBytes x)
    (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w r.2 (W.look r.1 (W.pubBytes x))) (W.look r.1)

include hN in
/-- Reusing scan inputs implies a lazy coupling exception. It does not follow
that every honest exception invalidates scan freshness. -/
theorem real_fresh_implies_lazy (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) :
    realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) →
      lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s := by
  intro he
  by_contra hn
  have hvec := real_vector_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn
  have hs (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) :
      gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2
        (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 (W.pubBytes x)) i
        (runN (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2
          (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 (W.pubBytes x)))
          (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1) 0 i.val) =
        addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N i) := by
    rw [issued_eq_final _ (gAddr_causal W Pr N h B outputs x w hc _ _) _ i]
    change gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w _ _ i
      (realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) = _
    rw [hvec, look_toRP, TP_pub]
    exact (addrQ_posE W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s i).symm
  obtain ⟨i, _, hp | ⟨j, hj, heq⟩⟩ := he
  · exact hn (Or.inr ⟨i, (hs i).symm.trans hp⟩)
  · exact hn (Or.inl ⟨j, i, hj, Or.inl trivial, (hs j).symm.trans (heq.trans (hs i))⟩)

include hN in
theorem real_fresh_mass (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64) :
    eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) ≤ lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) := by
  have hm := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
    (fun r => if realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w r then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hm' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) =
      eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← hm']
  exact (eventMass_mono _ _ (real_fresh_implies_lazy W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc)).trans
    (lazy_bad_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂)

#print axioms issued_eq_final
#print axioms real_fresh_implies_lazy
#print axioms real_fresh_mass
end R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass

R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatObstruction.text:
import R1Z.GamesR1PBin
import R1Z.RomFiniteBin

/-! A whole-run event covering every repeated read is not a birthday event.
The retained post-proof adversary may deliberately query one address twice.
The counterexample uses in-domain reads and works for every oracle and every
honest outcome, including failure. No property of the scan is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatObstruction
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Two reads, using the answer-insensitive continuations allowed by OProg. -/
def repeatProgram (a : List UInt8) : OProg :=
  .query a (fun _ => .query a (fun _ => .done))

/-- The concrete fixed log event: some address occurs more than once. -/
def repeatedRead (log : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) : Prop :=
  ¬ (log.map Prod.fst).Nodup

theorem repeatProgram_log (a : List UInt8) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    runLog (repeatProgram a) H q = [(a, H a), (a, H a)] := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hq
  rw [show 2 + n = n + 1 + 1 by omega]
  rfl

theorem prefix_repeat (pre : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer))
    (a : List UInt8) (b : OracleAnswer) :
    repeatedRead (pre ++ [(a, b), (a, b)]) := by
  simp [repeatedRead, List.nodup_append]

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K]

def repeatAdversary (a : List UInt8) : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux where
  prog := fun _ _ => repeatProgram a
  decide := fun _ => false

variable [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Exact retained real game: the repeated reads survive both firstGood branches.
Thus they are also reads of the complete run, not just of an invented subrun. -/
theorem real_game_repeats (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (N : ℕ)
    (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)
    (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) (a : List UInt8) (hq : 2 ≤ W.qmax) :
    repeatedRead (realGameP W Pr N P Vp h B outputs (repeatAdversary a) x w r).observerOracle := by
  unfold realGameP
  dsimp only
  split
  · change repeatedRead (runLog (repeatProgram a) (W.look r.1) W.qmax)
    rw [repeatProgram_log a _ _ hq]
    exact prefix_repeat [] a _
  · change repeatedRead (_ ++ runLog (repeatProgram a) (W.look r.1) W.qmax)
    rw [repeatProgram_log a _ _ hq]
    exact prefix_repeat _ a _

/-- Any excluded event containing this fixed repeated-read event has mass one.
The containment premise has only execution content, with no probability law. -/
theorem covering_event_mass_one {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R]
    (log : R → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) (E : R → Prop)
    (hrep : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r))
    (hcover : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r) → E r) : eventMass E = 1 := by
  have he : ∀ r, E r := fun r => hcover r (hrep r)
  unfold eventMass
  simp only [he, if_true]
  exact mean_const 1

/-- No collision term below one bounds an event covering all repeated reads. -/
theorem no_small_covering_event {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R]
    (log : R → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) (E : R → Prop)
    (hrep : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r))
    (hcover : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r) → E r)
    (κ : ℚ) (hκ : κ < 1) : ¬ eventMass E ≤ κ := by
  rw [covering_event_mass_one log E hrep hcover]
  exact not_le_of_gt hκ

#print axioms repeatProgram_log
#print axioms prefix_repeat
#print axioms real_game_repeats
#print axioms covering_event_mass_one
#print axioms no_small_covering_event
end R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatObstruction

R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatReal.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatObstruction

/-! Specialization to the actual finite-ROM randomness and fixed observer cap.
The counterexample is unconditioned and uses the in-domain address []. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatReal
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatObstruction
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The actual observer cap suffices without evaluating its numeral. -/
theorem observer_cap (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) :
    2 ≤ (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound).qmax := by
  change 2 ≤ (2 : ℕ)^64
  exact le_self_pow₀ (by decide) (by decide)

/-- The counterexample reads are within the finite-ROM domain. -/
theorem repeat_address_in_domain (bound : ℕ) :
    ([] : List UInt8) ∈ RomFiniteBin.domain bound :=
  (RomFiniteBin.mem_domain bound []).mpr (Nat.zero_le _)

/-- No hypotheses about honest success or scan outcomes: mass is exactly one
on the finite table × eight-secret real carrier used by fsR1P. -/
theorem finite_real_repeat_mass
    (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound))
    (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) :
    eventMass (fun r : (fsR1P (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 (by decide) P Vp).RealRand =>
      repeatedRead (realGameP (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 P Vp h B outputs
        (repeatAdversary []) x w r).observerOracle) = 1 := by
  apply covering_event_mass_one
    (fun r => (realGameP (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 P Vp h B outputs
      (repeatAdversary []) x w r).observerOracle)
  · intro r
    exact real_game_repeats _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r [] (observer_cap base bound)
  · intro _ hr
    exact hr

/-- The requested E_coll cannot simultaneously cover whole-run repeats and
have any bound κ < 1, on the retained finite-ROM experiment itself. -/
theorem finite_real_no_small_exclusion
    (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound))
    (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)
    (E_coll : (fsR1P (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 (by decide) P Vp).RealRand → Prop)
    (covers_repeats : ∀ r, repeatedRead (realGameP (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 P Vp
      h B outputs (repeatAdversary []) x w r).observerOracle → E_coll r)
    (κ : ℚ) (hκ : κ < 1) : ¬ eventMass E_coll ≤ κ := by
  exact no_small_covering_event _ E_coll
    (fun r => real_game_repeats _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r [] (observer_cap base bound))
    covers_repeats κ hκ

#print axioms observer_cap
#print axioms repeat_address_in_domain
#print axioms finite_real_repeat_mass
#print axioms finite_real_no_small_exclusion
end R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatReal

R1Z.QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatReal

/-! Independent numerical facts, not an assertion of a real-run collision law
or of a run-budget theorem. Six is the existing five-reader-plus-output
collision coefficient. The run would still have to prove the stated q cap. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics

def kappa (q : ℕ) : ℚ := 6 * (q : ℚ)^2 / (2 : ℚ)^256

theorem kappa_mono {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ r) : kappa q ≤ kappa r := by
  unfold kappa
  gcongr

/-- Closed form only: no evaluation of 2^256 or a recurrence. -/
theorem kappa_pow (b d : ℕ) (h : b * 2 + d = 256) :
    kappa (2^b) = 6 / (2 : ℚ)^d := by
  unfold kappa
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← pow_mul, ← h, pow_add]
  field_simp

/-- Inverse powers decrease with the exponent. -/
theorem dyadic_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^n ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^m := by
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) h)

/-- A candidate envelope q ≤ 2^65 gives exactly c=6 and ample numerical slack.
This is conditional on a budget, not proof that the whole-run event is rare. -/
theorem kappa_budget {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) :
    kappa q ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
  apply (kappa_mono hq).trans
  rw [kappa_pow 65 126 (by omega)]
  have h6 : (6 : ℚ) ≤ 2^17 := calc
    6 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^3 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2^17 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2
  rw [show (126 : ℕ) = 109 + 17 by omega, pow_add, one_mul]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h6
    (le_of_lt (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2) 109))

/-- The requested numerical conclusion follows by monotonicity and exponent
splitting whenever a genuine collision law supplies this small a term. -/
theorem total_lt_target (κ : ℚ) (hκ : κ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 + κ <
      1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := by
  have h137 := dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 137)
  have h454 := dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 454)
  have hsum : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 + κ ≤
      4 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
    have h4 (a : ℚ) : a + a + a + a = 4 * a := by ring
    calc
      _ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 +
          1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add
          (le_refl (1 / (2 : ℚ)^109)) h137) h454) hκ
      _ = 4 * (1 / (2 : ℚ)^109) := h4 _
      _ = 4 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := mul_one_div _ _
  apply hsum.trans_lt
  have he : 4 / (2 : ℚ)^109 = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^107 := by
    rw [show (109 : ℕ) = 107 + 2 by omega, pow_add]
    rw [show (2 : ℚ)^2 = 4 by norm_num]
    field_simp
  rw [he]
  exact one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity)
    (pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 100 < 107))

theorem budget_total_lt_target {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 + kappa q <
      1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := total_lt_target _ (kappa_budget hq)

#print axioms kappa_mono
#print axioms kappa_pow
#print axioms dyadic_mono
#print axioms kappa_budget
#print axioms total_lt_target
#print axioms budget_total_lt_target
end R1Z.QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics

R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
import R1Z.QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin
open R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Aggregate model mass is transported once, with no per-attempt copy of κ. -/
theorem join_le {A M : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype M]
    (f : A → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (e : ModelExecutionJoin f g bad) (κ : ℚ)
    (hb : eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) ≤ κ + 8 * scanProbability)
    (hf : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a ∧ f a ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ m, 0 ≤ g m ∧ g m ≤ 1) :
    |mean f - mean g| ≤ κ + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
  have hm := e.cp.meanM (fun m => if ∃ i, bad i m then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hmass : eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, bad i (e.cp.toM s)) =
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← e.cp.meanR f, ← e.cp.meanM g]
  have ht := until_bad _ _ (fun s => hf _) (fun s => hg _) _ e.agreement
  have h8 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left scan_probability_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 8)
  calc _ ≤ eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, bad i (e.cp.toM s)) := ht
       _ = eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) := hmass
       _ ≤ κ + 8 * scanProbability := hb
       _ ≤ κ + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by simpa only [mul_one_div] using add_le_add (le_refl κ) h8

theorem lazy_budget_mono {M Q : ℕ} (h : M ≤ Q) : lazyBudget M ≤ lazyBudget Q := by
  unfold lazyBudget
  gcongr

/-- Symbolic power splitting at the existing binary read-count envelope. -/
theorem lazy_budget_small {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2^25) :
    lazyBudget M ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
  apply (lazy_budget_mono hM).trans
  have hp : ((2^25 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)^25 := by norm_cast
  unfold lazyBudget
  rw [hp]
  have h25 : (2 : ℚ)^25 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hh : (2 : ℚ)^25 * 2^25 = (2 : ℚ)^50 := by rw [← pow_add]
  rw [hh]
  calc _ ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 + (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 := by gcongr
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := by
         rw [show (255 : ℕ) = 50 + 204 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_add, pow_one]
         field_simp
         <;> ring
       _ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega)

#print axioms join_le
#print axioms lazy_budget_mono
#print axioms lazy_budget_small
end R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin
