import R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
import R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
import R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin

/-! Conservative marginal min-entropy of the actual scan state. This is not
conditional entropy after revealing that state, nor is marginal min-entropy
alone used as a pair-collision hypothesis. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
  R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.PremisesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem lazy_budget_sharp {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2^25) :
    lazyBudget M ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := by
  apply (QueryScanRealLazyJoin.lazy_budget_mono hM).trans
  have hp : ((2^25 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)^25 := by norm_cast
  unfold lazyBudget
  rw [hp]
  have h25 : (2 : ℚ)^25 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hh : (2 : ℚ)^25 * 2^25 = (2 : ℚ)^50 := by rw [← pow_add]
  rw [hh]
  calc _ ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 + (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 := by gcongr
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := by
         rw [show (255 : ℕ) = 50 + 204 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_add, pow_one]
         field_simp
         <;> ring

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

def realState (k : Fin N) (j : Fin 8) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : OracleAnswer :=
  attVec W Pr (realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w r) k (.inl (predecessor j))

/-- Coordinate projection factored over generic carriers to avoid concrete
byte Fintype instance normalization. -/
theorem coordinate_point {J U V S : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
    (k : J) (z : U) :
    eventMass (fun p : S × (J → U) × V => p.2.1 k = z) = 1 / Fintype.card U := by
  have h1 : MP (fun p : S × (J → U) × V => p.2) := mp_snd
  have h2 : MP (fun p : (J → U) × V => p.1) := mp_fst
  have hm := (mp_comp h1 h2) (fun q => if q k = z then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  classical
  have he := QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.eval_point_mass k z
  exact hm.trans he

include hN in
theorem real_state_point (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (k : Fin N) (j : Fin 8) (z : OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun r => realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z) ≤
      lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  have hm := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
    (fun r => if realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hm' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) = z) =
      eventMass (fun r => realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext a <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← hm']
  have hsub : ∀ s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr,
      realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) = z →
      lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s ∨ (s k).2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hn : lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s
    · exact Or.inl hn
    · right
      unfold realState at hs
      rw [real_vector_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn, attVec_uVec] at hs
      exact hs
  apply (eventMass_mono _ _ hsub).trans
  have hp : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      (s k).2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
    have he := mean_eval k
      (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => if a.2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
    have hc' := coordinate_point (S := SecP) (V := Tape K F × W.Tab)
      (.inl (predecessor j) : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) z
    have hz : eventMass (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
        a.2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
      trans 1 / (Fintype.card OracleAnswer : ℚ)
      · convert hc' using 1 <;> unfold eventMass <;> apply QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport
      · rw [QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have he' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
        (s k).2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) =
        eventMass (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => a.2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) := by
      unfold eventMass
      convert he using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext a <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
    exact he'.trans hz
  exact (eventMass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
    (lazy_bad_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂) hp.le)

include hN in
/-- A deliberately conservative, proved 190-bit marginal min-entropy. The
fresh ideal predecessor coordinate has 256 bits; the loss pays all honest
collision histories in this coarse argument. -/
theorem real_state_min_entropy (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (hM : N * n1 W Pr ≤ 2^25) (k : Fin N) (j : Fin 8) (z : OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun r => realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z) ≤
      1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 := by
  apply (real_state_point W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc hb hE₁ hE₂ k j z).trans
  have hsmall := lazy_budget_sharp hM
  have h256 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 204 ≤ 256)
  calc _ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := add_le_add hsmall h256
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^203 := by
         rw [show (204 : ℕ) = 203 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_one]
         field_simp
         <;> ring
       _ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega)

#print axioms lazy_budget_sharp
#print axioms coordinate_point
#print axioms real_state_point
#print axioms real_state_min_entropy
end R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy

R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy

/-! Scan-step/earlier-entry union bound with a conservative 190-bit exponent.
Each pair law is proved using the retained real/lazy coupling, not inferred
from marginal entropy alone. The marginal state entropy is proved separately. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
  R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.LazyFrozen
  R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
  R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def scanRead (j : Fin 8) : Bool → TRead
  | false => .qb j
  | true => .qa j

def freshBudget (q : ℕ) : ℚ := 128 * (q : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^190

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

abbrev ScanStep := Fin N × Fin 8 × Bool

def scanIndex (p : ScanStep N) : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) :=
  (posE W Pr N).symm (p.1, .inl (scanRead p.2.1 p.2.2))

theorem scan_index_coverage (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) (hi : scanPosition W Pr N i) :
    ∃ p, scanIndex W Pr N p = i := by
  rcases hp : posE W Pr N i with ⟨k, j | c⟩
  · cases j with
    | qb j =>
        refine ⟨(k,j,false), ?_⟩
        apply (posE W Pr N).injective
        simpa only [scanIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, scanRead] using hp.symm
    | qa j =>
        refine ⟨(k,j,true), ?_⟩
        apply (posE W Pr N).injective
        simpa only [scanIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, scanRead] using hp.symm
    | _ => simp [scanPosition, hp, IsScan] at hi
  · simp [scanPosition, hp] at hi

def issued (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) : List UInt8 :=
  let a := gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w r.2 (W.look r.1 (W.pubBytes x))
  a i (runN a (W.look r.1) 0 i.val)

def priorHit (p : ScanStep N) (earlier : Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)))
    (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Prop :=
  match earlier with
  | none => issued W Pr N h B outputs x w r (scanIndex W Pr N p) = W.pubBytes x
  | some j => j < scanIndex W Pr N p ∧
      issued W Pr N h B outputs x w r j = issued W Pr N h B outputs x w r (scanIndex W Pr N p)

theorem fresh_iff_prior_hit (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) :
    realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w r ↔
      ∃ p earlier, priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p earlier r := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, he | ⟨j, hj, he⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := scan_index_coverage W Pr N i hi
      exact ⟨p, none, he⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := scan_index_coverage W Pr N i hi
      exact ⟨p, some j, hj, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, earlier, he⟩
    have hi : scanPosition W Pr N (scanIndex W Pr N p) := by
      simp only [scanPosition, scanIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      cases p.2.2 <;> trivial
    refine ⟨scanIndex W Pr N p, hi, ?_⟩
    cases earlier with
    | none => exact Or.inl he
    | some j => exact Or.inr ⟨j, he⟩

include hN in
/-- Individual earlier-entry guessing law, valid on actual real randomness.
A stronger 204-bit envelope pays upstream collisions before this pair. -/
theorem prior_hit_mass (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (hM : N * n1 W Pr ≤ 2^25) (p : ScanStep N)
    (earlier : Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr))) :
    eventMass (priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p earlier) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 := by
  have hs := eventMass_mono (priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p earlier)
    (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w)
    (fun r hr => (fresh_iff_prior_hit W Pr N h B outputs x w r).mpr ⟨p, earlier, hr⟩)
  exact (hs.trans (real_fresh_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc hb hE₁ hE₂)).trans
    ((lazy_budget_sharp hM).trans
      (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 190 ≤ 204)))

include hN in
/-- Union over the 128 scan calls and at most q earlier entries, including
the digest. Total q includes honest calls; the observer runs afterwards. -/
theorem real_fresh_linear (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (hM : N * n1 W Pr ≤ 2^25) (hN8 : N = 8) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : N * n1 W Pr + 1 ≤ q) :
    eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) ≤ freshBudget q := by
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card
    (fun p : ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) =>
      priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p.1 p.2)
    (1 / (2 : ℚ)^190)
    (fun p => prior_hit_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc hb hE₁ hE₂ hM p.1 p.2)
  have he : eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) =
      mass (fun r => ∃ p : ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)),
        priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p.1 p.2 r) := by
    unfold eventMass mass
    congr 1
    funext r
    have hh := fresh_iff_prior_hit W Pr N h B outputs x w r
    have hh' : realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w r ↔
        ∃ p : ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)), priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p.1 p.2 r := by
      simpa only [Prod.exists] using hh
    simp only [hh']
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [he]
  apply hu.trans
  have hcard : Fintype.card (ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr))) =
      128 * (N * n1 W Pr + 1) := by
    simp [ScanStep, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, hN8]
    <;> omega
  rw [hcard]
  unfold freshBudget
  push_cast
  simp only [mul_one_div]
  gcongr
  exact_mod_cast hq

#print axioms scan_index_coverage
#print axioms fresh_iff_prior_hit
#print axioms prior_hit_mass
#print axioms real_fresh_linear
end R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion

R1Z.QueryScanFreshNumerics.text:
import R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFreshNumerics
open R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy

/-- Monotonicity in the total prior-query envelope. -/
theorem fresh_budget_mono {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ r) : freshBudget q ≤ freshBudget r := by
  unfold freshBudget
  gcongr

theorem fresh_budget_pow65 : freshBudget (2^65) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^118 := by
  unfold freshBudget
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, show (190 : ℕ) = 65 + 125 from rfl, pow_add]
  have h128 : (128 : ℚ) = 2^7 := by norm_num
  rw [h128, show (125 : ℕ) = 7 + 118 from rfl, pow_add]
  field_simp

theorem fresh_budget_small {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) :
    freshBudget q ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
  exact (fresh_budget_mono hq).trans (fresh_budget_pow65.le.trans
    (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 118)))

/-- The single conservative coupling budget fits inside the same numerical
freshness allowance. This is an inequality of budgets, not equality of events. -/
theorem lazy_budget_le_fresh {M q : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2^25) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    lazyBudget M ≤ freshBudget q := by
  apply (lazy_budget_sharp hM).trans
  apply (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 190 ≤ 204)).trans
  have h1 : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 ≤ freshBudget 1 := by
    unfold freshBudget
    rw [Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≤ 128) (by positivity)
  exact h1.trans (fresh_budget_mono hq)

theorem fresh_total_lt_target {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 + freshBudget q <
      1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 :=
  QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.total_lt_target _ (fresh_budget_small hq)

/-- Keep the large dyadic denominator opaque to ring preprocessing. -/
theorem amount_identity (a κ d : ℚ) :
    ((κ + 8 / d) + a) + 8 / d = a + 16 / d + κ := by ring

#print axioms fresh_budget_mono
#print axioms fresh_budget_pow65
#print axioms fresh_budget_small
#print axioms lazy_budget_le_fresh
#print axioms fresh_total_lt_target
#print axioms amount_identity
end R1Z.QueryScanFreshNumerics

R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorSeedGuess18
import R1Z.QueryScanFreshNumerics
import R1Z.RomObserverBin
/-! A retained independent seed and a single, global seed-query event.
The event conservatively covers the entire simulator coin namespace: a query
with the exact domain and seed prefix is charged even if its suffix is malformed.
No independence of a source seed from its observed execution is assumed here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18 R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Entry := List UInt8 × OracleAnswer

def seedPoint (a : List UInt8) (seed : OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  a.take ((domain.val.map ProverCommitSaltBytes.byte).length + 32) =
    domain.val.map ProverCommitSaltBytes.byte ++ List.ofFn seed

theorem seedPoint_unique (a : List UInt8) {s t : OracleAnswer}
    (hs : seedPoint a s) (ht : seedPoint a t) : s = t := by
  have he := List.append_cancel_left (hs.symm.trans ht)
  simpa only [List.ofFn_inj] using he

theorem source_point (s : OracleAnswer) (attempt : Nat) (stream : UInt8) (counter : Nat) :
    seedPoint (address (List.ofFn s) attempt stream counter) s := by
  have take_prefix (p t rest : List UInt8) (ht : t.length = 32) :
      (p ++ t ++ rest).take (p.length + 32) = p ++ t := by
    rw [← ht, ← List.length_append, List.take_append_of_le_length (Nat.le_refl _),
      List.take_length]
  unfold seedPoint address
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
    take_prefix (domain.val.map ProverCommitSaltBytes.byte) (List.ofFn s)
      (TranscriptR1.le32 attempt ++ [stream] ++ LayoutR1PBin.le64 counter)
      (by simp only [List.length_ofFn])

def seedGuess (queries : List Entry) (seed : OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∃ entry ∈ queries, seedPoint entry.1 seed

def budget (q : Nat) : ℚ := (q : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^256

theorem point_mass_le (a : List UInt8) :
    eventMass (seedPoint a) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  by_cases exists_seed : ∃ s, seedPoint a s
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_seed
    have hm := eventMass_mono (seedPoint a) (fun t => t = s)
      (fun t ht => seedPoint_unique a ht hs)
    rw [QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass, QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality,
      Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hm
    exact hm
  · have empty : seedPoint a = fun _ => False := by
      funext s
      exact propext ⟨fun hs => exists_seed ⟨s, hs⟩, False.elim⟩
    rw [empty]
    simp only [eventMass, if_false, mean_const]
    positivity

theorem list_mass (queries : List Entry) :
    eventMass (seedGuess queries) ≤ budget queries.length := by
  induction queries with
  | nil => simp only [seedGuess, List.not_mem_nil, false_and, exists_false,
      eventMass, if_false, mean_const, budget, List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, le_refl]
  | cons a tail ih =>
    have eqv : seedGuess (a::tail) = fun s => seedPoint a.1 s ∨ seedGuess tail s := by
      funext s
      simp only [seedGuess, List.mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]
    rw [eqv]
    have h := (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (point_mass_le a.1) ih)
    change eventMass (fun s => seedPoint a.1 s ∨ seedGuess tail s) ≤ _ at h
    apply h.trans
    simp only [budget, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)

theorem budget_mono {q r : Nat} (hq : q ≤ r) : budget q ≤ budget r := by
  unfold budget
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hq) (by positivity)

/-- The list may depend on every model coin and every adaptive answer, but
not on this extra independent seed. Thus one charge covers all attempts. -/
theorem seed_mass {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (queries : M → List Entry) (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2) ≤ budget q := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [mean_product]
  have h := R0Z.FsGood.mean_le_mean
    (fun m => eventMass (seedGuess (queries m))) (fun _ => budget q)
    (fun m => (list_mass (queries m)).trans (budget_mono (bound m)))
  rw [mean_const] at h
  exact h

/-- Only attempt zero carries the global event; it is not charged eight times. -/
def augmented {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry)
    (i : Fin 8) (r : M × OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  old i r.1 ∨ (i = 0 ∧ seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2)

theorem old_contained {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry)
    (i : Fin 8) (r : M × OracleAnswer) (ho : old i r.1) : augmented old queries i r :=
  Or.inl ho

theorem union_mass {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry) (q : Nat)
    (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun r => ∃ i, augmented old queries i r) ≤
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, old i m) + budget q := by
  have sub : ∀ r : M × OracleAnswer, (∃ i, augmented old queries i r) →
      (∃ i, old i r.1) ∨ seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2 := by
    rintro r ⟨i, ho | ⟨_, hs⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨i, ho⟩
    · exact Or.inr hs
  have h := (eventMass_mono _ _ sub).trans (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _)
  have hm : eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => ∃ i, old i r.1) =
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, old i m) := by
    unfold eventMass
    rw [mean_product]
    congr 1
    funext m
    by_cases hm : ∃ i, old i m
    · simp only [if_pos hm, mean_const]
    · simp only [if_neg hm, mean_const]
  change eventMass (fun r => ∃ i, augmented old queries i r) ≤
    eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => ∃ i, old i r.1) +
      eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2) at h
  rw [hm] at h
  exact h.trans (add_le_add (le_refl _) (seed_mass queries q bound))

#print axioms seedPoint_unique
#print axioms source_point
#print axioms point_mass_le
#print axioms list_mass
#print axioms budget_mono
#print axioms seed_mass
#print axioms old_contained
#print axioms union_mass
end R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19

R1Z.ProverCommitSeedJoin19.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
/-! Seed-augmented whole observations and their explicit statistical loss. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSeedJoin19
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

structure RunJoin {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (runtime : R → V) (model : M → V)
    (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry) where
  cp : Coupling R (M × OracleAnswer)
  agreement : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, augmented bad queries i (cp.toM s)) →
    runtime (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s).1

theorem test_bound {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    {runtime : R → V} {model : M → V} {bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop}
    {queries : M → List Entry} (join : RunJoin runtime model bad queries)
    (test : V → ℚ) (bounded : ∀ v, 0 ≤ test v ∧ test v ≤ 1)
    (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    |mean (fun r => test (runtime r)) - mean (fun m => test (model m))| ≤
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) + budget q := by
  have ht := until_bad
    (fun s => test (runtime (join.cp.toR s)))
    (fun s => test (model (join.cp.toM s).1))
    (fun s => bounded _) (fun s => bounded _)
    (fun s => ∃ i, augmented bad queries i (join.cp.toM s))
    (fun s hn => congrArg test (join.agreement s hn))
  have hr := join.cp.meanR (fun r => test (runtime r))
  have hi := join.cp.meanM (fun m => test (model m.1))
  have hp := R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := M) (Y := OracleAnswer)
    (fun m => test (model m))
  have hm := join.cp.meanM (fun m => if ∃ i, augmented bad queries i m then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hmass : eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, augmented bad queries i (join.cp.toM s)) =
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, augmented bad queries i m) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [hr, hi, hp, hmass] at ht
  exact ht.trans (union_mass bad queries q bound)

/-- Product extension of an existing coupling retains both exact marginals. -/
def extend {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M] (cp : Coupling R M) :
    Coupling R (M × OracleAnswer) where
  S := cp.S × OracleAnswer
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := fun s => cp.toR s.1
  toM := fun s => (cp.toM s.1, s.2)
  meanR := fun f => (R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := cp.S) (Y := OracleAnswer)
    (fun s => f (cp.toR s))).trans (cp.meanR f)
  meanM := by
    intro f
    rw [mean_product, mean_product]
    exact cp.meanM (fun m => mean (fun seed => f (m,seed)))

/-- Containment preserves every old whole-run certificate, with the seed
retained independently. It proves implication, not proper logical inclusion. -/
def of_old {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (runtime : R → V) (model : M → V) (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (queries : M → List Entry) (cp : Coupling R M)
    (agreement : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, old i (cp.toM s)) → runtime (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)) :
    RunJoin runtime model old queries where
  cp := extend cp
  agreement := by
    intro s hn
    exact agreement s.1 (fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => hn ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩)

theorem budget_pow64 : budget (2^64) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^192 := by
  unfold budget
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, show (256 : Nat) = 64+192 from rfl, pow_add]
  field_simp

theorem total_lt_target {q r : Nat} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) (hr : r ≤ 2^64) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +
      QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget q + 2 * budget r < 1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := by
  have h137 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 137)
  have h454 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 454)
  have hf := QueryScanFreshNumerics.fresh_budget_small hq
  have hs : budget r ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 :=
    (budget_mono hr).trans (by rw [budget_pow64]; exact
      QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 192))
  have hsum : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +
      QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget q + 2 * budget r ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by positivity
    linarith
  apply hsum.trans_lt
  have he : 8 / (2 : ℚ)^109 = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^106 := by
    rw [show (109 : Nat) = 106+3 from rfl, pow_add, show (2 : ℚ)^3 = 8 by norm_num]
    field_simp
  rw [he]
  exact one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity)
    (pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 100 < 106))

#print axioms test_bound
#print axioms extend
#print axioms of_old
#print axioms budget_pow64
#print axioms total_lt_target
end R1Z.ProverCommitSeedJoin19

R1Z.ProverCommitObserverQueries19.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
import R1Z.GamesR1PBin
/-! The adversary-only suffix, including failed-attempt exhaustion, of the
fixed games. Honest verifier recomputations are not adversary query calls. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitObserverQueries19
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
open R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (N : Nat) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)

def real (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : List Entry :=
  let H := W.look r.1
  let out := realOut W Pr h B outputs x w H r.2
  match firstGood (fun o : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux => P o.ch ∧ Vp h o.ch w ∧ o.exh = false) out with
  | none => runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) H W.qmax
  | some k => runLog (adv.prog (out k).view (out k).log) H W.qmax

theorem real_bound (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) :
    (real W Pr N P Vp h B outputs adv x w r).length ≤ W.qmax := by
  unfold real
  dsimp only
  split <;> exact RomObserverBin.runLog_length _ _ _

def ideal (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (r : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)) : List Entry :=
  match firstGood (fun c => P (drawW W c)) r.1 with
  | none => runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) (W.look (r.1 ⟨0,hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax
  | some k =>
    let v := sim (drawW W (r.1 k)) (r.2 k)
    runLog (adv.prog v (verLog W x v (r.1 k)))
      (progOracle W x v (r.1 k) (r.1 ⟨0,hN⟩).2.2.2) W.qmax

theorem ideal_bound (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (r : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)) :
    (ideal W N hN P sim adv x r).length ≤ W.qmax := by
  unfold ideal
  split <;> exact RomObserverBin.runLog_length _ _ _

#print axioms real_bound
#print axioms ideal_bound
end R1Z.ProverCommitObserverQueries19

R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion.text:
import R1Z.GamesR1PBin

/-! A lossless quotient/completion of the actual model tape. Completion entropy
is explicit; this does not manufacture entropy from deterministic zero fill. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
open R0Z.JointView R0Z.MaskLayout R0P
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Exactly the raw H1 coordinates ignored by h1Padding. -/
def Ignored : AffCoordinate → Prop
  | .inl _ => False
  | .inr (lane, row, _) => lane = 1 ∧ (row = 0 ∨ CopyActiveRow row)

abbrev Visible := {c : AffCoordinate // ¬ Ignored c}
abbrev Hidden := {c : AffCoordinate // Ignored c}
instance : Fintype Visible := Fintype.ofFinite Visible
instance : Fintype Hidden := Fintype.ofFinite Hidden
abbrev SourceTape (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) :=
  (Visible → F) × EligibleNoise K F
abbrev Padding (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) := Hidden → F

instance {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] (F : Subfield K) :
    Fintype (SourceTape K F) := Fintype.ofFinite _
instance {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] (F : Subfield K) :
    Fintype (Padding K F) := Fintype.ofFinite _

variable {K : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}

def project (t : Tape K F) : SourceTape K F :=
  ((fun c => t.1 c.1), t.2)

def padding (t : Tape K F) : Padding K F := fun c => t.1 c.1

def complete (s : SourceTape K F) (h : Padding K F) : Tape K F :=
  ((fun c => if hc : Ignored c then h ⟨c, hc⟩ else s.1 ⟨c, hc⟩), s.2)

theorem project_complete (s : SourceTape K F) (h : Padding K F) :
    project (complete s h) = s := by
  rcases s with ⟨v, e⟩
  simp only [project, complete, Prod.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · funext c
    exact dif_neg c.2
  · trivial

theorem padding_complete (s : SourceTape K F) (h : Padding K F) :
    padding (complete s h) = h := by
  funext c
  exact dif_pos c.2

theorem complete_project (t : Tape K F) :
    complete (project t) (padding t) = t := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext c
    dsimp [complete, project, padding]
    split <;> rfl
  · rfl

/-- Product completion is a bijection, hence every full tape has one fibre.
The padding coordinate is retained randomness, not a fixed value. -/
def completionEquiv : (SourceTape K F × Padding K F) ≃ Tape K F where
  toFun s := complete s.1 s.2
  invFun t := (project t, padding t)
  left_inv s := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact project_complete _ _
    · exact padding_complete _ _
  right_inv := complete_project

theorem completion_equal_fibres [Fintype K] (t : Tape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : SourceTape K F × Padding K F =>
      complete s.1 s.2 = t)).card = 1 := by
  classical
  have h : (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : SourceTape K F × Padding K F =>
      complete s.1 s.2 = t)) = {completionEquiv.symm t} := by
    ext s
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact completionEquiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply
  rw [h, Finset.card_singleton]

/-- Each quotient fibre is precisely one copy of the ignored-coordinate tape. -/
def quotientFibreEquiv (s : SourceTape K F) :
    {t : Tape K F // project t = s} ≃ Padding K F where
  toFun t := padding t.1
  invFun h := ⟨complete s h, project_complete s h⟩
  left_inv t := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp
    exact (congrArg (fun s => complete s (padding t.1)) t.2.symm).trans
      (complete_project t.1)
  right_inv := padding_complete s

theorem quotient_equal_fibres [Fintype K] (s : SourceTape K F) :
    Fintype.card {t : Tape K F // project t = s} = Fintype.card (Padding K F) :=
  Fintype.card_congr (quotientFibreEquiv s)

/-- The dependent row never reads word 0, including while summing the balance. -/
theorem balance_congr (u v : Fin 1024 → K)
    (same : ∀ r, r ≠ 0 → u r = v r) : balance 0 u = balance 0 v := by
  funext r
  simp only [balance]
  split_ifs
  · apply congrArg Neg.neg
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    exact same s (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hs)
  · exact same r (by assumption)

/-- Changing every ignored H1 coordinate leaves the model H1 padding intact. -/
theorem h1_completion (B : PackBasis F) (t : Tape K F) (h : Padding K F) :
    h1Padding B (Sum.elim t.2 (complete (project t) h).1) =
      h1Padding B (Sum.elim t.2 t.1) := by
  unfold h1Padding
  apply balance_congr
  intro r hr
  by_cases active : CopyActiveRow r
  · simp only [if_pos active]
  · simp only [if_neg active, extensionRaw, Sum.elim_inr]
    congr 1
    funext limb
    have hn : ¬ Ignored (.inr (1, r, limb)) := fun bad => bad.2.elim hr active
    exact congrArg (fun v : F => (v : K)) (dif_neg hn)

#print axioms project_complete
#print axioms padding_complete
#print axioms complete_project
#print axioms completion_equal_fibres
#print axioms quotient_equal_fibres
#print axioms balance_congr
#print axioms h1_completion
end R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion

R1Z.ProverCommitTapeMeasure.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
import R0Z.FsAbortTape

/-! Exact finite measure transport for the H1 quotient. The completion input
contains explicit padding randomness. No source-stream law is assumed here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
open R0Z.JointView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0P
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Uniform independent quotient and padding complete to the uniform full tape. -/
theorem completion_mass (event : Tape K F → Prop) :
    mass (fun s : SourceTape K F × Padding K F => event (complete s.1 s.2)) =
      mass event := by
  exact (mass_equiv (completionEquiv (K := K) (F := F)).symm event).symm

/-- Uniform full-tape projection is uniform on the quotient. -/
theorem quotient_mass (event : SourceTape K F → Prop) :
    mass (fun t : Tape K F => event (project t)) = mass event := by
  rw [← completion_mass]
  simp only [project_complete]
  haveI : Nonempty (Padding K F) := ⟨fun _ => 0⟩
  exact R0Z.FsAbortTape.mass_fst event

/-- Every observable factoring through the quotient has exactly the same law
under any deterministic representative, including zero fill. This is a law
of observables, not uniformity of the completed raw tape. -/
theorem observable_mass {O : Type} (observe : Tape K F → O)
    (invariant : ∀ t h, observe (complete (project t) h) = observe t)
    (choose : SourceTape K F → Padding K F) (event : O → Prop) :
    mass (fun s : SourceTape K F => event (observe (complete s (choose s)))) =
      mass (fun t : Tape K F => event (observe t)) := by
  rw [← quotient_mass (fun s => event (observe (complete s (choose s))))]
  exact mass_congr _ _ (fun t => by rw [invariant])

/-- Ordinary mask columns are retained by the quotient. -/
theorem maskOnly_completion (t : Tape K F) (h : Padding K F) (c : Fin 10) :
    maskOnlyColumns (Sum.elim t.2 (complete (project t) h).1) c =
      maskOnlyColumns (Sum.elim t.2 t.1) c := by
  unfold maskOnlyColumns maskOnlyRaw
  congr 1
  funext r
  exact congrArg (fun v : F => (v : K)) (dif_neg (show ¬ Ignored (.inl (c,r)) from not_false))

/-- G and D are retained at every raw coordinate. -/
theorem extension_completion (B : PackBasis F) (t : Tape K F)
    (h : Padding K F) (lane : Fin 3) (hl : lane ≠ 1) :
    extensionRaw B (Sum.elim t.2 (complete (project t) h).1) lane =
      extensionRaw B (Sum.elim t.2 t.1) lane := by
  funext r
  unfold extensionRaw
  congr 1
  funext limb
  exact congrArg (fun v : F => (v : K)) (dif_neg (fun bad => hl bad.1))

/-- The model affine trace construction factors through the H1 quotient. -/
theorem applyAff_completion (B : PackBasis F) (trace : Trace K)
    (t : Tape K F) (h : Padding K F) :
    applyAff B trace (complete (project t) h).1 = applyAff B trace t.1 := by
  funext c r
  simp only [applyAff]
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact congrFun (maskOnly_completion (t.1, 0) h _) r
  · exact congrArg (fun x => trace c r + x) (congrFun (h1_completion B (t.1, 0) h) r)
  · exact congrFun (congrArg (balance 0)
      (extension_completion B (t.1, 0) h 0 (by decide))) r
  · exact congrFun (congrArg (balance 0)
      (extension_completion B (t.1, 0) h 2 (by decide))) r

#print axioms completion_mass
#print axioms quotient_mass
#print axioms observable_mass
#print axioms maskOnly_completion
#print axioms extension_completion
#print axioms applyAff_completion
end R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion

R1Z.ProverCommitCompletionAdapter.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitTapeMeasure

/-! An exact partial-decoder adapter. It carries padding explicitly, preserves
failures, and transports each individual fibre without an assumed common cF. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
open R0Z.JointView
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {Input K : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}

def completeDecode (decode : Input → Option (SourceTape K F))
    (input : Input × Padding K F) : Option (Tape K F) :=
  (decode input.1).map (fun s => complete s input.2)

theorem completion_failure (decode : Input → Option (SourceTape K F))
    (input : Input × Padding K F) :
    completeDecode decode input = none ↔ decode input.1 = none := by
  cases h : decode input.1 <;> simp only [completeDecode, h, Option.map_none,
    Option.map_some, Option.some_ne_none, iff_self]

theorem completion_fibre (decode : Input → Option (SourceTape K F))
    (input : Input × Padding K F) (t : Tape K F) :
    completeDecode decode input = some t ↔
      decode input.1 = some (project t) ∧ input.2 = padding t := by
  cases h : decode input.1 with
  | none => simp [completeDecode, h]
  | some s =>
    simp only [completeDecode, h, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
    constructor
    · intro eq
      constructor
      · exact (project_complete s input.2).symm.trans (congrArg project eq)
      · exact (padding_complete s input.2).symm.trans (congrArg padding eq)
    · rintro ⟨hs, hp⟩
      rw [hs, hp]
      exact complete_project t

/-- A full-tape fibre has exactly the original quotient fibre, with the unique
padding value required by that output. No extra success/failure factor occurs. -/
def decodedFibreEquiv (decode : Input → Option (SourceTape K F)) (t : Tape K F) :
    {x : Input × Padding K F // completeDecode decode x = some t} ≃
      {x : Input // decode x = some (project t)} where
  toFun x := ⟨x.1.1, ((completion_fibre decode x.1 t).mp x.2).1⟩
  invFun x := ⟨(x.1, padding t), (completion_fibre decode _ t).mpr ⟨x.2, rfl⟩⟩
  left_inv x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (x.1.1, padding t) = x.1
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact ((completion_fibre decode x.1 t).mp x.2).2.symm
  right_inv _ := rfl

theorem decoded_fibre_card [Fintype Input] [Fintype K]
    (decode : Input → Option (SourceTape K F)) (t : Tape K F) :
    Fintype.card {x : Input × Padding K F // completeDecode decode x = some t} =
      Fintype.card {x : Input // decode x = some (project t)} :=
  Fintype.card_congr (decodedFibreEquiv decode t)

/-- Failure witnesses transport unchanged; completion draws no sampler words. -/
theorem completion_exhaustion (decode : Input → Option (SourceTape K F))
    (exhausted₁ exhausted₂ : Input → Prop)
    (source : ∀ x, decode x = none → exhausted₁ x ∨ exhausted₂ x)
    (input : Input × Padding K F) (failure : completeDecode decode input = none) :
    exhausted₁ input.1 ∨ exhausted₂ input.1 :=
  source input.1 ((completion_failure decode input).mp failure)

#print axioms completion_failure
#print axioms completion_fibre
#print axioms decodedFibreEquiv
#print axioms decoded_fibre_card
#print axioms completion_exhaustion
end R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion

R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientLaw.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitCompletionAdapter
import R1Z.CouplingR1P2Bin

/-! Quotient rejection law and independent spare completion. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
open R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {Input K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] {F : Subfield K}
  [Fintype Input] [Nonempty Input]
instance : Nonempty (SourceTape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
instance : Nonempty (Padding K F) := ⟨0⟩

def quotientDecode (decode : Input → Option (Tape K F)) : Input → Option (SourceTape K F) :=
  fun i => (decode i).map project

def completeOrSpare (decode : Input → Option (Tape K F)) (p : Input × Tape K F) : Tape K F :=
  complete ((quotientDecode decode p.1).getD (project p.2)) (padding p.2)

def spareEquiv : (Input × Tape K F) ≃ (Input × SourceTape K F) × Padding K F :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl Input) completionEquiv.symm).trans (Equiv.prodAssoc _ _ _).symm

theorem mp_completeOrSpare (decode : Input → Option (Tape K F)) (c : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ s, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => quotientDecode decode i = some s)).card = c) :
    MP (completeOrSpare decode) := by
  have hd : MP (fun p : Input × SourceTape K F => (quotientDecode decode p.1).getD p.2) :=
    fun f => R0Z.FsAbortTape.mean_decodeOrSpare _ c (fun s => by convert hfib s) f
  have hp := mp_prodMap hd (mp_equiv (Equiv.refl (Padding K F)))
  have hc := mp_comp (mp_comp (mp_equiv (spareEquiv (Input := Input) (F := F))) hp)
    (mp_equiv (completionEquiv (F := F)))
  intro f
  exact hc f

theorem quotient_success (decode : Input → Option (Tape K F)) (i : Input)
    (s : SourceTape K F) (hs : quotientDecode decode i = some s) :
    decode i = some ((decode i).getD (0, 0)) ∧
      project ((decode i).getD (0, 0)) = s := by
  cases hi : decode i with
  | none =>
    simp only [quotientDecode, hi, Option.map_none] at hs
    contradiction
  | some t =>
    simp only [Option.getD_some]
    exact ⟨trivial, Option.some.inj (by simpa only [quotientDecode, hi, Option.map_some] using hs)⟩

/-- Splitting a successful quotient fibre by its unique full-tape padding. -/
def projectedFibreEquiv (decode : Input → Option (Tape K F)) (s : SourceTape K F) :
    {i : Input // quotientDecode decode i = some s} ≃
      (p : Padding K F) × {i : Input // decode i = some (complete s p)} where
  toFun i := ⟨padding ((decode i.1).getD (0, 0)), i.1, by
    have ht := quotient_success decode i.1 s i.2
    exact ht.1.trans (congrArg some ((congrArg (fun q => complete q (padding ((decode i.1).getD (0, 0)))) ht.2).symm.trans (complete_project _)).symm)⟩
  invFun i := ⟨i.2.1, by simp [quotientDecode, i.2.2, project_complete]⟩
  left_inv i := by apply Subtype.ext; rfl
  right_inv i := by
    rcases i with ⟨p, i, hi⟩
    apply Sigma.ext (by simp only [hi, Option.getD_some, padding_complete])
    apply (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_eq (fun j => by
      simp only [hi, Option.getD_some, padding_complete])).mpr
    rfl


theorem full_fibres_imply_quotient (decode : Input → Option (Tape K F)) (c : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ t, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => decode i = some t)).card = c)
    (s : SourceTape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => quotientDecode decode i = some s)).card =
      Fintype.card (Padding K F) * c := by
  have hc : ∀ p : Padding K F, Fintype.card {i : Input // decode i = some (complete s p)} = c := by
    intro p
    simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype] using hfib (complete s p)
  rw [← Fintype.card_subtype, Fintype.card_congr (projectedFibreEquiv decode s), Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [hc, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul]

#print axioms mp_completeOrSpare
#print axioms quotient_success
#print axioms projectedFibreEquiv
#print axioms full_fibres_imply_quotient
end R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion

R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientView.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitTapeMeasure

/-! A quotient endpoint for the actual joint honest view. This covers all
payload cells, not just H1 or one trace coordinate. Commitment source reads
are still a separate identification obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.FsAbortBounds
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux Bat : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  [R0Z.HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

theorem payload_completion (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h) (ch : Challenges K)
    (t : Tape K F) (pad : Padding K F) :
    payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch (complete (project t) pad) =
      payload h B x w ch t := by
  unfold payload R0Z.HonestView.run
  rw [applyAff_completion]
  rfl

theorem view_completion (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h) (ch : Challenges K)
    (t : Tape K F) (pad : Padding K F) :
    view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch (complete (project t) pad) =
      view h B outputs x w ch t := by
  unfold view
  rw [payload_completion]

/-- The entire existing honest view has its exact model law when sampled on
uniform quotient tapes with any chosen ignored-coordinate representative. -/
theorem quotient_view_mass (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h) (ch : Challenges K)
    (choose : SourceTape K F → Padding K F)
    (event : View K CommitHandle Aux Bat → Prop) :
    mass (fun s : SourceTape K F => event (view h B outputs x w ch (complete s (choose s)))) =
      mass (fun t : Tape K F => event (view h B outputs x w ch t)) :=
  observable_mass (view h B outputs x w ch) (view_completion h B outputs x w ch) choose event

#print axioms payload_completion
#print axioms view_completion
#print axioms quotient_view_mass
end R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion

R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientCoupling.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientLaw
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientView
import R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin

/-! The existing real coupling, with only its middle tape completed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientCoupling
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer))

def gMQ (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab × Tape K F :=
  ((gM W Pr eCm a).1, completeOrSpare
    (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2)
    ((e₁Of a.2.1, e₂Of a.2.1), a.2.2.1))

def toMQ {N : ℕ} (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) :
    (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F) :=
  (fun k => (gMQ W Pr eCm (s k)).1, fun k => (gMQ W Pr eCm (s k)).2)

theorem mp_gMQ (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : SourceTape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        quotientDecode (fun e => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) e = some τ)).card = cF) :
    MP (gMQ W Pr eCm) := by
  have hd := mp_completeOrSpare (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
    Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) cF (fun q => by convert hfib q)
  have h1 : MP (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => a.2) := mp_snd
  have h2 : MP (fun p : (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) × (Tape K F × W.Tab) =>
      (eV W Pr p.1, (Equiv.refl (Tape K F × W.Tab)) p.2)) :=
    mp_prodMap (mp_equiv (eV W Pr)) (mp_equiv (Equiv.refl _))
  have h3 := mp_equiv (rearr (A₁ := TRead → OracleAnswer) (A₂ := Fin 3 → OracleAnswer)
    (E := (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) (A₄ := RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (T := Tape K F) (B := W.Tab))
  have h4 := mp_prodMap (mp_equiv (eC W eCm)) hd
  have hc := mp_comp (mp_comp (mp_comp h1 h2) h3) h4
  intro f
  exact hc f

theorem meanM_Q (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : SourceTape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        quotientDecode (fun e => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) e = some τ)).card = cF) (N : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr => f (toMQ W Pr eCm s)) = mean f := by
  have hp := mp_pi (mp_gMQ W Pr eCm cF hfib) N
  have he := mp_equiv (Equiv.arrowProdEquivProdArrow (Fin N) (fun _ => R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab)
    (fun _ => Tape K F))
  exact (mp_comp hp he) f

theorem completed_view (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) :
    view (Bat := R1Bat) h B outputs x w ch (gMQ W Pr eCm a).2 =
      view h B outputs x w ch (gM W Pr eCm a).2 := by
  cases ht : Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of a.2.1) (e₂Of a.2.1) with
  | none => simp only [gMQ, gM, completeOrSpare, quotientDecode, ht,
      Option.map_none, Option.getD_none, complete_project]
  | some t =>
    simpa only [gMQ, gM, completeOrSpare, quotientDecode, ht,
      Option.map_some, Option.getD_some] using view_completion h B outputs x w ch t (padding a.2.2.1)

theorem retryTest_tapes {C T O : Type} (N : ℕ) (Pd : C → Prop) (pub : C → T → O)
    (ext : (Fin N → C) → Fin N → O → ℚ) (fail : (Fin N → C) → ℚ)
    (coins : Fin N → C) (t u : Fin N → T)
    (same : ∀ k, pub (coins k) (t k) = pub (coins k) (u k)) :
    retryTest N Pd pub ext fail (coins, t) = retryTest N Pd pub ext fail (coins, u) := by
  unfold retryTest
  cases hk : firstGood Pd coins with
  | none => rfl
  | some k => exact congrArg (ext coins k) (same k)

theorem middle_completion (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (adv : (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp).Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) :
    middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) adv x w (toMQ W Pr eCm s) =
    middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) adv x w (toMP W Pr eCm s) := by
  apply retryTest_tapes
  intro k
  exact completed_view W Pr eCm h B outputs x w _ (s k)

#print axioms mp_gMQ
#print axioms meanM_Q
#print axioms completed_view
#print axioms retryTest_tapes
#print axioms middle_completion
end R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientCoupling

R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientModel.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientCoupling

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientModel
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.ModelsVR1
  R1Z.FinalR1PBin R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientCoupling
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
/-- The real coupling of the phase-indexed games. -/
def cpQ (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : SourceTape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        quotientDecode (fun e => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) e = some τ)).card = cF) :
    Coupling (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand
      ((Fin (abR1P W N hN).N → (abR1P W N hN).Coins) × (Fin (abR1P W N hN).N → Tape K F)) where
  S := Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN
  toM := toMQ W Pr eCm
  meanR := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
  meanM := meanM_Q W Pr eCm cF hfib N

variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
/-- The real model: every field of `R1RealModelV` for the phase-indexed games. -/
theorem realModel_quotient
    (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (hV : ∀ (w : h.Instance) ch, Vp h ch w ↔ V ch w) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : SourceTape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        quotientDecode (fun e => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) e = some τ)).card = cF)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8) :
    R1RealModelV P h V B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) x (N * n1 W Pr) W.qmax
      (2 ^ 255) (εexhP N L₁ L₂ (N * n1 W Pr)) := by
  intro adv w _
  refine ⟨cpQ W Pr R eCm N hN P Vp h B outputs x w (hc w) cF hfib,
    fun j s => chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (posE W Pr N j), fun _ => True,
    fun j s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N j),
    fun i s => qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s,
    exhQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w, ?_, ?_, ?_, mass_exhQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x hb w L₁ L₂ hex h₁ h₂⟩
  · intro s hH hCE
    change realTest h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) adv x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) =
      middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1P W N hN) adv x w (toMQ W Pr eCm s)
    rw [middle_completion]
    refine agreeP W Pr R eCm N hN P Vp h V B outputs x w adv (hin w) (hc w) hcom (hV w) s ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro p i hch heq
      apply hH
      refine ⟨(posE W Pr N).symm p, i, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact hch
      · show qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s =
          addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact heq
    · intro p p' hne heq
      apply hCE
      left
      rcases lt_trichotomy ((posE W Pr N).symm p) ((posE W Pr N).symm p') with hl | he | hg
      · refine ⟨_, _, hl, Or.inl trivial, ?_⟩
        show addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p)) =
          addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p'))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact heq
      · exact absurd ((posE W Pr N).symm.injective he) hne
      · refine ⟨_, _, hg, Or.inl trivial, ?_⟩
        show addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p')) =
          addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N ((posE W Pr N).symm p))
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact heq.symm
    · intro k hk
      exact hCE (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨k, hk⟩))
    · intro p hp
      exact hCE (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨p, hp⟩))
  · intro j i
    rcases hp : posE W Pr N j with ⟨k, jj | c⟩
    · simp only [hp]
      exact hit_tr W Pr R eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv k jj i
    · simp only [hp]
      exact hit_cm W Pr R eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv hb hop hcom k c i
  · intro j j' hlt _
    exact pair_all W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂ (posE W Pr N j) (posE W Pr N j')
      (fun e => ne_of_lt hlt ((posE W Pr N).injective e))

#print axioms cpQ
#print axioms realModel_quotient
end R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientModel

R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientPrivacy.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientModel

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientPrivacy
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientModel
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
/-- The R1 privacy theorem for the phase-indexed games. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games_quotient (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1)
    (R : RomModel W) (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : SourceTape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        quotientDecode (fun e => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) e = some τ)).card = cF)

vanish on every inactive row, the literal helper is zero there, and

def ActiveEnds (link : CopyLink) : Prop :=
  CopyActiveRow link.producer.row ∧ CopyActiveRow link.consumer.row

local instance activeDec (link : CopyLink) : Decidable (ActiveEnds link) := by
  unfold ActiveEnds
  infer_instance

def checkLink (link : CopyLink) : Bool := decide (ActiveEnds link)
def check (links : List CopyLink) : Bool := links.all checkLink

theorem check_spec (links : List CopyLink) (h : check links = true) :
    ∀ link ∈ links, ActiveEnds link := by
  simpa only [check, List.all_eq_true, checkLink, decide_eq_true_eq] using h

theorem check_append (xs ys : List CopyLink) : check (xs ++ ys) = (check xs && check ys) := by
  exact List.all_append

theorem check_take_drop (xs : List CopyLink) (n : Nat) :
    check xs = (check (xs.take n) && check (xs.drop n)) := by
  rw [← check_append, List.take_append_drop]

theorem rowValues_inactive (t : Trace K) (lam : K) (r : Fin 1024) (hr : ¬ CopyActiveRow r)
    (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (hend : ∀ link ∈ copyLinks, CopyActiveRow (endpoint link).row)

  apply List.sum_eq_zero
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨link, hl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hv
  have hne : ¬ ((endpoint link).row = r ∧ (endpoint link).slot = s) := by
    rintro ⟨he, _⟩
    exact hr (he ▸ hend link hl)
  exact if_neg hne

theorem rowWeights_inactive (pub : Public K) (r : Fin 1024) (hr : ¬ CopyActiveRow r)
    (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (hend : ∀ link ∈ copyLinks, CopyActiveRow (endpoint link).row)
    (s : Fin 2) : copyRowWeights pub r endpoint s = 0 := by
  apply List.sum_eq_zero

  obtain ⟨link, hl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hv

    rintro ⟨he, _⟩

  exact if_neg hne

/-- The literal helper vanishes on every inactive row. -/
theorem helper_inactive_zero (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : ¬ CopyActiveRow r) : helper pub t lam chi r = 0 := by
  have hpw (s : Fin 2) := rowWeights_inactive pub r hr CopyLink.producer
    (fun link hl => (active_registry link hl).1) s
  have hcw (s : Fin 2) := rowWeights_inactive pub r hr CopyLink.consumer
    (fun link hl => (active_registry link hl).2) s
  simp only [helper, copyRowsAt, hpw, hcw, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero]

/-- `helperInactive` for every trace and all λ, χ. -/
theorem helperInactive (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, helper pub t lam chi r = 0 := by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro r hr
  exact helper_inactive_zero pub t lam chi r ((R0Z.TerminalEligible.mem_inactive r).1 hr)

import R0Z.HonestView
import R0P.CopyRegistry
import R0P.PositivityChain

/-! J0b, `helperSum` (LOG D40.4, D42.4): the literal LogUp helper sums to zero
over all 1024 rows for every trace satisfying `CopyLinkBalance`, at all λ, χ.

The argument is a re-indexing.  By `copy_producer_slots_nodup` and
`copy_consumer_slots_nodup` (CopyRegistry) each (row, slot) key carries at most
one producer and at most one consumer endpoint.  Hence the row-slot catalogue
`copyRowValues`/`copyRowWeights` at a key is either that single link's tuple
value and weight, or (0, 0); a (0, 0) slot contributes `(χ − 0)⁻¹ · 0 = 0`.
So `∑_r helper r = ∑_link (χ − p_link)⁻¹ w_link − ∑_link (χ − c_link)⁻¹ w_link`
(`sum_slots`), and `CopyLinkBalance` makes the two terms of every link equal:
a weight-zero link contributes zero on both sides, and an enabled link has
equal producer and consumer tuples, hence equal compressed values.

The zero-inverse (pole) convention is `helper`'s own: `Field.inv 0 = 0`; no
denominator is assumed nonzero, because the cancellation is termwise between
identical terms.  Nothing is assumed beyond `CopyLinkBalance pub t`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.HelperSum
open R0P R0Z.HonestView
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### Re-indexing a slot catalogue with distinct keys -/

/-- The sum, over a list, of the entries keyed at (row r, slot s). -/
def slotSum {α : Type} (L : List α) (row : α → Fin 1024) (slot : α → Fin 2) (g : α → K)
    (r : Fin 1024) (s : Fin 2) : K :=
  (L.map (fun l => if row l = r ∧ slot l = s then g l else 0)).sum

theorem slotSum_nil {α : Type} (row : α → Fin 1024) (slot : α → Fin 2) (g : α → K)
    (r : Fin 1024) (s : Fin 2) : slotSum [] row slot g r s = 0 := rfl

theorem slotSum_cons {α : Type} (a : α) (L : List α) (row : α → Fin 1024) (slot : α → Fin 2)
    (g : α → K) (r : Fin 1024) (s : Fin 2) :
    slotSum (a :: L) row slot g r s =
      (if row a = r ∧ slot a = s then g a else 0) + slotSum L row slot g r s := by
  unfold slotSum
  rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]

theorem slotSum_eq_zero {α : Type} (a : α) (L : List α) (row : α → Fin 1024)
    (slot : α → Fin 2) (g : α → K)
    (hn : (row a, slot a) ∉ L.map (fun l => (row l, slot l))) :
    slotSum L row slot g (row a) (slot a) = 0 := by
  unfold slotSum
  apply List.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  have hne : ¬ (row l = row a ∧ slot l = slot a) := by
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact hn (List.mem_map.2 ⟨l, hl, Prod.ext h1 h2⟩)
  exact if_neg hne

theorem sum_single_slot {α : Type} (a : α) (row : α → Fin 1024) (slot : α → Fin 2) (c : K) :
    ∑ r : Fin 1024, ∑ s : Fin 2, (if row a = r ∧ slot a = s then c else 0) = c := by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (row a), Finset.sum_eq_single (slot a)]
  · exact if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro s _ hs
    exact if_neg (fun h => hs h.2.symm)
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  · intro r _ hr
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun s _ => if_neg (fun h => hr h.1.symm))
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

/-- With distinct (row, slot) keys, the row-slot sum of `(χ − value)⁻¹ · weight`
is the list sum of the same expression per entry.  Empty slots contribute
`(χ − 0)⁻¹ · 0 = 0`. -/
theorem sum_slots {α : Type} (L : List α) (row : α → Fin 1024) (slot : α → Fin 2)
    (v w : α → K) (chi : K) (hn : (L.map (fun l => (row l, slot l))).Nodup) :
    ∑ r : Fin 1024, ∑ s : Fin 2,
        (chi - slotSum L row slot v r s)⁻¹ * slotSum L row slot w r s =
      (L.map (fun l => (chi - v l)⁻¹ * w l)).sum := by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp only [slotSum_nil, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
  | cons a L ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at hn
    have key : ∀ (r : Fin 1024) (s : Fin 2),
        (chi - slotSum (a :: L) row slot v r s)⁻¹ * slotSum (a :: L) row slot w r s =
          (chi - slotSum L row slot v r s)⁻¹ * slotSum L row slot w r s +
            if row a = r ∧ slot a = s then (chi - v a)⁻¹ * w a else 0 := by
      intro r s
      rw [slotSum_cons, slotSum_cons]
      by_cases hc : row a = r ∧ slot a = s
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hc
        rw [slotSum_eq_zero a L row slot v hn.1, slotSum_eq_zero a L row slot w hn.1]
        simp only [and_self, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, sub_zero, mul_zero, zero_add]
      · simp only [if_neg hc, zero_add, add_zero]
    simp only [key, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ih hn.2, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons,
      sum_single_slot]
    exact add_comm _ _

/-! ### The literal helper -/

/-- `helper` in slot-catalogue form (definitional). -/
theorem helper_eq_slotSum (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) (r : Fin 1024) :
    helper pub t lam chi r =
      (∑ s : Fin 2,
        (chi - slotSum copyLinks (fun l => l.producer.row) (fun l => l.producer.slot)
          (fun l => copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t l.tag l.producer)) r s)⁻¹ *
        slotSum copyLinks (fun l => l.producer.row) (fun l => l.producer.slot)
          (fun l => copyLinkWeight l pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant) r s) -
      ∑ s : Fin 2,
        (chi - slotSum copyLinks (fun l => l.consumer.row) (fun l => l.consumer.slot)
          (fun l => copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t l.tag l.consumer)) r s)⁻¹ *
        slotSum copyLinks (fun l => l.consumer.row) (fun l => l.consumer.slot)
          (fun l => copyLinkWeight l pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant) r s := rfl

/-- The row sum of the helper as a per-link difference (no balance used). -/
theorem sum_helper_eq_links (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) :
    ∑ r, helper pub t lam chi r =
      (copyLinks.map (fun l =>
        (chi - copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t l.tag l.producer))⁻¹ *
          copyLinkWeight l pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant)).sum -
      (copyLinks.map (fun l =>
        (chi - copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t l.tag l.consumer))⁻¹ *
          copyLinkWeight l pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant)).sum := by
  simp only [helper_eq_slotSum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [sum_slots copyLinks (fun l => l.producer.row) (fun l => l.producer.slot)
      (fun l => copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t l.tag l.producer))
      (fun l => copyLinkWeight l pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant) chi copy_producer_slots_nodup,
    sum_slots copyLinks (fun l => l.consumer.row) (fun l => l.consumer.slot)
      (fun l => copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t l.tag l.consumer))
      (fun l => copyLinkWeight l pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant) chi copy_consumer_slots_nodup]

/-- J0b `helperSum`: for every trace with `CopyLinkBalance`, at all λ, χ. -/
theorem helperSum_of_balance (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub t)
    (lam chi : K) : ∑ r, helper pub t lam chi r = 0 := by
  rw [sum_helper_eq_links, sub_eq_zero]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro link hl
  by_cases hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant = 0
  · simp only [hw, mul_zero]
  · have h := hb link hl hw
    change copyEndpointTuple t link.tag link.producer =
      copyEndpointTuple t link.tag link.consumer at h
    simp only [h]

#print axioms slotSum
#print axioms slotSum_nil
#print axioms slotSum_cons
#print axioms slotSum_eq_zero
#print axioms sum_single_slot
#print axioms sum_slots
#print axioms helper_eq_slotSum
#print axioms sum_helper_eq_links
#print axioms helperSum_of_balance
end R0Z.HelperSum
