import R0Z.HonestValidity
import R0Z.HelperInactive
import R0Z.HelperSum

/-! J0b assembly (LOG D40.2, D42.4): of the four fields of
`HonestBuilderSound`, `helperInactive` holds for every trace
(`HelperInactive.helperInactive`, a registry fact) and `helperSum` holds for
every trace with `CopyLinkBalance` (`HelperSum.helperSum_of_balance`, from the
CopyRegistry (row, slot) Nodup facts).  What remains of the builder is
`HonestBuilderCore`: base typing, the 28 non-copy production lanes, and
`CopyLinkBalance pub t` on the raw instance trace `t = h.build w` — every
enabled copy link's producer tuple equals its consumer tuple.  This last field
is genuinely about the builder (it says the builder writes the copied cells
consistently); no registry fact implies it. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderSound
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
open R0Z.HonestValidity

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The builder obligations left after J0b's two helper sums are discharged. -/
structure HonestBuilderCore (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) :
    Prop where
  baseTyped : BaseTyped F t
  lanes : ∀ (lam chi : K) (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 → laneOf t pub lam chi B i b = 0
  balance : CopyLinkBalance pub t

theorem honestBuilderSound_of_core (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (hc : HonestBuilderCore F pub B t) : HonestBuilderSound F pub B t :=
  ⟨hc.baseTyped, hc.lanes, R0Z.HelperSum.helperSum_of_balance pub t hc.balance,
    fun lam chi => R0Z.HelperInactive.helperInactive pub t lam chi⟩

/-- The prover-level form. -/
def BuilderCoreOn (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → HonestBuilderCore F x.1 B (h.build w)

theorem builderSoundOn_of_core (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hc : BuilderCoreOn h B x) : BuilderSoundOn h B x :=
  fun w hw => honestBuilderSound_of_core x.1 B (h.build w) (hc w hw)

#print axioms HonestBuilderCore
#print axioms honestBuilderSound_of_core
#print axioms BuilderCoreOn
#print axioms builderSoundOn_of_core
end R0Z.BuilderSound

R0Z.BuilderComplete.text:
import R0Z.BuilderSound

/-! Builder completeness (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-COMPLETE.txt).

There is no concrete witness → trace builder in the Lean model (design §0):
`HonestProver.build` is an uninstantiated field and R0P is entirely in the
trace → witness direction.  This module therefore

* reduces the `lanes` field of `HonestBuilderCore` (laneOf = 0 for lanes
  0..27 at every λ, χ) to `NonCopyHolds`, the seven λ/χ-free production
  families, for every base-typed trace over a field with more than 4,096
  elements (`lanes_iff_nonCopy`, through the proved `lanes_zero_iff_holds`
  and a pole-free χ on the prepared instance);
* gives the constructive shape of the builder: 26 base-field semantic
  columns plus three extension columns (`ofColumns`), for which `baseTyped`
  is a theorem (`baseTyped_ofColumns`);
* states the two remaining builder facts, `NonCopyHolds` and
  `CopyLinkBalance` of the built trace for every witness in the relation,
  as the named refinement premise `BuilderRefines` against the Rust builder;
* gives the honest prover `honestProverOf` whose `build` is that builder,
  and proves `BuilderCoreOn` / `BuilderSoundOn` for it from the premise
  (`builderSoundOn_of_refines`), together with the soundness-side sanity
  check that its builds carry an extracted input note
  (`inputNoteExtracted_of_refines`).

The witness type `W` and relation `Rel` are parameters; the spend-path
instantiation is `W := Wspend`, `Rel := Rspend` (SpendRelation.lean). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderComplete
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
open R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.BuilderSound

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### `lanes` is the non-copy production relation -/

/-- The seven production families that read neither λ, χ nor column 26. -/
def NonCopyHolds (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) : Prop :=
  Holds valueFamily pub t ∧ Holds occupancyFamily pub t ∧ Holds assetFamily pub t ∧
  Holds scheduleFamily pub t ∧ Holds pathFamily pub t ∧ Holds digestFamily pub t ∧
  Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub t

theorem holds_prepare (f : Family K) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Holds f pub (prepare pub t ch) ↔ Holds f pub t := by
  simp only [Holds, rowOpenings_prepare]

theorem prepare_lt26 (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 29)
    (hc : c.val < 26) (b : Fin 1024) : prepare pub t ch c b = t c b := by
  unfold prepare
  exact if_neg (by omega)

theorem baseTyped_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hA : BaseTyped F t) : BaseTyped F (prepare pub t ch) := fun c hc b => by
  rw [prepare_lt26 pub t ch c hc b]
  exact hA c hc b

/-- Lanes 0..27 do not read λ or χ. -/
theorem laneOf_lt_indep (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (lam chi lam' chi' : K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (i : Fin 29) (bits : Fin 10 → Bool) (hi : i.val < 28) :
    laneOf t pub lam chi B i bits = laneOf t pub lam' chi' B i bits := by
  unfold laneOf
  by_cases h4 : i.val < 4
  · simp only [dif_pos h4]
  · simp only [dif_neg h4, dif_pos hi]

/-- The LogUp pole values of a trace at λ: producer row-slot values on the
left, consumer row-slot values on the right. -/
def poleVal (t : Trace K) (lam : K) : (Fin 1024 × Fin 2) ⊕ (Fin 1024 × Fin 2) → K :=
  Sum.elim (fun p => copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.producer p.2)
    (fun p => copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.consumer p.2)

/-- Over a field with more than 4,096 elements, every λ has a pole-free χ:
the poles are at most 1024 rows × 2 slots × 2 endpoints values, so
`poleVal` is not surjective. -/
theorem exists_noPole (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (t : Trace K) (lam : K) :
    ∃ chi : K, NoPole t lam chi := by
  have hns : ¬ Function.Surjective (poleVal t lam) := by
    intro hs
    have h1 := Fintype.card_le_of_surjective (poleVal t lam) hs
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    omega
  simp only [Function.Surjective, not_forall, not_exists] at hns
  obtain ⟨chi, hchi⟩ := hns
  refine ⟨chi, fun b _ s => ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩⟩
  · have e := hchi (Sum.inl (b, s))
    simp only [poleVal, Sum.elim_inl] at e
    exact e h.symm
  · have e := hchi (Sum.inr (b, s))
    simp only [poleVal, Sum.elim_inr] at e
    exact e h.symm

/-- A challenge record with prescribed `sem 0 = λ`, `sem 1 = χ`. -/
def chOf (lam chi : K) : Challenges K :=
  ⟨fun j => if j.val = 0 then lam else chi, fun _ => ⟨(1, 0), by simp⟩, fun _ => 0, ∅⟩

theorem chOf_sem0 (lam chi : K) : (chOf lam chi).sem 0 = lam :=
  show (if (0 : Fin 25).val = 0 then lam else chi) = lam from if_pos rfl

theorem chOf_sem1 (lam chi : K) : (chOf lam chi).sem 1 = chi :=
  show (if (1 : Fin 25).val = 0 then lam else chi) = chi from if_neg (by decide)

/-- All 29 lanes vanish on the prepared instance at a pole-free challenge,
given the non-copy lanes of the raw trace. -/
theorem lanes_prepare_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hnp : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1))
    (hl : ∀ (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 →
      laneOf t pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0) :
    ∀ i b, laneOf (prepare pub t ch) pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0 := by
  intro i b
  by_cases hi : i.val < 28
  · rw [laneOf_prepare_lt pub t ch _ _ B i b hi]
    exact hl i b hi
  · obtain rfl : i = 28 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; omega)
    rw [laneOf_copy]
    exact copyHolds_prepare pub t ch hnp (rowOf b) _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)

/-- `lanes` of `HonestBuilderCore` is exactly `NonCopyHolds`, for base-typed
traces and base public inputs over a field with more than 4,096 elements. -/
theorem lanes_iff_nonCopy (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (hA : BaseTyped F t) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) :
    (∀ (lam chi : K) (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 →
      laneOf t pub lam chi B i b = 0) ↔ NonCopyHolds pub t := by
  obtain ⟨chi0, hnp⟩ := exists_noPole hcard t 0
  let ch := chOf (0 : K) chi0
  have hnp' : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) := by
    rw [chOf_sem0, chOf_sem1]; exact hnp
  have hAp := baseTyped_prepare pub t ch hA
  constructor
  · intro hl
    have hall := lanes_prepare_zero pub B t ch hnp' (fun i b hi => hl _ _ i b hi)
    obtain ⟨hv, ho, ha, hs, hp, hd, hpo, _⟩ :=
      (lanes_zero_iff_holds F B pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) hAp hpub).mp hall
    exact ⟨(holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hv, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 ho,
      (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 ha, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hs,
      (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hp, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hd,
      (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hpo⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, ho, ha, hs, hp, hd, hpo⟩ lam chi i b hi
    have hc : CHolds copyFamily pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) :=
      copyHolds_prepare pub t ch hnp'
    have hall := (lanes_zero_iff_holds F B pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) hAp
      hpub).mpr ⟨(holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hv, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 ho,
        (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 ha, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hs,
        (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hp, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hd,
        (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hpo, hc⟩
    rw [laneOf_lt_indep t pub lam chi (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b hi,
      ← laneOf_prepare_lt pub t ch _ _ B i b hi]
    exact hall i b

/-! ### The builder: constructive shape and refinement premise -/

/-- The builder's output shape: 26 base-field semantic columns (the Rust
`semantic_c1` M31 arrays) and three extension columns 26–28. -/
def ofColumns (c1 : Fin 26 → Fin 1024 → F) (rest : Fin 3 → Fin 1024 → K) : Trace K :=
  fun c r => if h : c.val < 26 then ((c1 ⟨c.val, h⟩ r : F) : K)
    else rest ⟨c.val - 26, by have := c.isLt; omega⟩ r

theorem baseTyped_ofColumns (c1 : Fin 26 → Fin 1024 → F) (rest : Fin 3 → Fin 1024 → K) :
    BaseTyped F (ofColumns c1 rest) := fun c hc b => by
  simp only [ofColumns, dif_pos hc]
  exact (c1 ⟨c.val, hc⟩ b).2

/-- The builder data: a public input and a witness determine the columns.
This is the Rust compile + host_semantic build, uninterpreted. -/
structure BuilderSpec (F : Subfield K) (W : Type) where
  c1 : Public K → W → Fin 26 → Fin 1024 → F
  rest : Public K → W → Fin 3 → Fin 1024 → K

def BuilderSpec.build {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W) (pub : Public K) (w : W) : Trace K :=
  ofColumns (S.c1 pub w) (S.rest pub w)

/-- The refinement premise against the Rust builder: for every witness in
the relation, the built trace satisfies the seven non-copy production
families and every enabled copy link balances. -/
structure BuilderRefines {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) : Prop where
  nonCopy : ∀ pub w, Rel pub w → NonCopyHolds pub (S.build pub w)
  balance : ∀ pub w, Rel pub w → CopyLinkBalance pub (S.build pub w)

/-- The honest prover whose `build` is the builder, on relation instances. -/
def honestProverOf {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop)
    (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : HonestProver K where
  Instance := {p : Public K × W // Rel p.1 p.2}
  transport := transport
  «public» := fun p => p.1.1
  build := fun p => S.build p.1.1 p.1.2

theorem builderCore_of_refines (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (B : PackBasis F) (pub : Public K) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) (w : W) (hw : Rel pub w) :
    HonestBuilderCore F pub B (S.build pub w) :=
  ⟨baseTyped_ofColumns _ _,
    (lanes_iff_nonCopy hcard B pub _ (baseTyped_ofColumns _ _) hpub).2 (hR.nonCopy pub w hw),
    hR.balance pub w hw⟩

theorem builderCoreOn_of_refines (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) : BuilderCoreOn (honestProverOf S Rel transport) B x := by
  rintro ⟨⟨pub, w⟩, hw⟩ hx
  change pub = x.1 at hx
  subst hx
  exact builderCore_of_refines hcard S Rel hR B _ hpub w hw

theorem builderSoundOn_of_refines (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) : BuilderSoundOn (honestProverOf S Rel transport) B x :=
  builderSoundOn_of_core _ B x (builderCoreOn_of_refines hcard S Rel hR transport B x hpub)

/-- Sanity check against soundness: a refined build carries an extracted
input note (R0P `input_note_extracted`), so the premise is the trace-side
image of the payment relation, not an unrelated condition. -/
theorem inputNoteExtracted_of_refines {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W)
    (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel) (pub : Public K) (w : W)
    (hw : Rel pub w) : InputNoteExtracted pub (S.build pub w) := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, ha, hs, hp, hd, hpo⟩ := hR.nonCopy pub w hw
  exact input_note_extracted pub _ hs hp hd ha hpo (hR.balance pub w hw)

#print axioms NonCopyHolds
#print axioms holds_prepare
#print axioms prepare_lt26
#print axioms baseTyped_prepare
#print axioms laneOf_lt_indep
#print axioms poleVal
#print axioms exists_noPole
#print axioms chOf
#print axioms chOf_sem0
#print axioms chOf_sem1
#print axioms lanes_prepare_zero
#print axioms lanes_iff_nonCopy
#print axioms ofColumns
#print axioms baseTyped_ofColumns
#print axioms BuilderSpec.build
#print axioms BuilderRefines
#print axioms honestProverOf
#print axioms builderCore_of_refines
#print axioms builderCoreOn_of_refines
#print axioms builderSoundOn_of_refines
#print axioms inputNoteExtracted_of_refines
end R0Z.BuilderComplete

import R0Z.BuilderModel
import R0P.Schedule

/-! Builder model, block families (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4):
`poseidonScalarFamily` holds on every layout by construction (local rows
1..11 ARE the canonical transitions); `scheduleFamily` holds on the model
because of the block roles chosen in Stage W (sponge initial states, node
pre-states, absorption supports).  The Rust-side content of both is the
refinement obligation that permute_optimized_with_trace / write_sponge /
write_node produce exactly these rows (design §6). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem layout_block' (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16) (h : Fin 57) (l : Nat)
    (hl : l < 16) (r : Fin 1024) (hr : r.val = 16 * h.val + l) :
    layout C c r = blockCell (C.blocks h) l ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
  rw [layout_block C c r hc h (by omega), show r.val % 16 = l by omega]

theorem state_layout (C : Cells K) (block : Fin 57) (r : Fin 16) :
    poseidonState (layout C) block r = fun lane => blockCell (C.blocks block) r.val lane := by
  funext lane
  exact layout_block' C _ lane.isLt block r.val r.isLt _ rfl

theorem blockCell_fun_iter (b : BlockIn K) (l : Nat) (hl : l < 12) :
    (fun lane => blockCell b l lane) = blockIter b l := by
  funext lane
  unfold blockCell
  rw [if_pos hl]

theorem blockCell_fun_absorb (b : BlockIn K) :
    (fun lane => blockCell b 12 lane) = b.absorb := by
  funext lane
  unfold blockCell
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl]

/-- Poseidon holds on every layout: rows 1..11 are the transitions. -/
theorem poseidon_layout (pub : Public K) (C : Cells K) :
    Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub (layout C) := by
  rw [poseidon_scalar_holds_iff]
  intro block row lane
  rw [state_layout, state_layout, state_layout]
  show blockCell (C.blocks block) (row.val + 1) lane =
    poseidonTransition row (fun l => blockCell (C.blocks block) row.val l)
      (fun l => blockCell (C.blocks block) 12 l) lane
  rw [blockCell_fun_iter _ row.val (by omega), blockCell_fun_absorb]
  unfold blockCell
  rw [if_pos (by omega), blockIter.eq_2, dif_pos row.isLt]

theorem poseidon_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  poseidon_layout pub _

/-! ### Schedule -/

theorem row_cell (C : Cells K) (b : Fin 1024) (h57 : b.val / 16 < 57) (c : Fin 16) :
    layout C (c.castAdd 13) b = blockCell (C.blocks ⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩) (b.val % 16) c :=
  layout_block C _ b c.isLt ⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ rfl

theorem nodeIn_pre_lo (l r : Digest K) (c : Fin 16) (hc : c.val < 8) : (nodeIn l r).pre c = 0 := by
  unfold nodeIn
  exact if_pos hc

theorem blockCell_pre (b : BlockIn K) (c : Fin 16) : blockCell b 0 c = b.pre c := rfl

attribute [local irreducible] blockOut blockIter blockDigest treeCur appCur

theorem blocksOf_tree_lo (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57) (h4 : 4 ≤ h.val)
    (h24 : h.val ≤ 24) :
    blocksOf pub w h = treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) (h.val - 4)) ⟨h.val - 4, by omega⟩ := by
  rw [blocksOf, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
    dif_pos h24]

theorem blocksOf_recip (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57) (h27 : 27 ≤ h.val)
    (h29 : h.val ≤ 29) : blocksOf pub w h = recipB pub w (h.val - 27) := by
  rw [blocksOf, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
    dif_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos h29]

theorem blocksOf_app (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57) (h34 : 34 ≤ h.val)
    (h53 : h.val ≤ 53) :
    blocksOf pub w h = appNode pub (appCur pub (outPair pub w) (h.val - 34)) ⟨h.val - 34, by omega⟩ := by
  rw [blocksOf, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
    dif_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
    if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), dif_pos h53]

theorem blocksOf_tree_hi (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57) (h54 : 54 ≤ h.val) :
    blocksOf pub w h = treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) (h.val - 33))
      ⟨h.val - 33, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [blocksOf, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
    dif_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
    if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega)]

theorem outPairB_node (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    ∃ l r : Digest K, outPairB pub w = nodeIn l r := by
  rw [outPairB]
  cases pub.variant
  · exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

/-- Every node-role block (4..24, 33..56) is a node block. -/
theorem blocksOf_node (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57)
    (hn : ScheduleNode h.val) : ∃ l r : Digest K, blocksOf pub w h = nodeIn l r := by
  have h57 := h.isLt
  unfold ScheduleNode at hn
  by_cases ha : h.val ≤ 24
  · rw [blocksOf_tree_lo pub w h (by omega) ha]; exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  · by_cases hb : h.val = 33
    · rw [show h = 33 from Fin.ext hb]; exact outPairB_node pub w
    · by_cases hc : h.val ≤ 53
      · rw [blocksOf_app pub w h (by omega) hc]; exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
      · rw [blocksOf_tree_hi pub w h (by omega)]; exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

/-- Row-12 lanes 8..15 vanish. -/
def HiZero (b : BlockIn K) : Prop := ∀ c : Fin 16, 8 ≤ c.val → b.absorb c = 0

theorem hiZero_lo8 (pre : Fin 16 → K) (d : Digest K) : HiZero (⟨pre, lo8 d⟩ : BlockIn K) := by
  intro c hc
  show lo8 d c = 0
  unfold lo8
  rw [dif_neg (by omega)]

theorem hiZero_node (l r : Digest K) : HiZero (nodeIn l r) := hiZero_lo8 _ _

theorem hiZero_noteB1 (o : Digest K) (v a : K) (s : Digest K) : HiZero (noteB1 o v a s) := by
  intro c hc
  show noteC2 v a s c = 0
  unfold noteC2
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega)]

theorem noteC3_zero (s : Digest K) (c : Fin 16) (hc : 2 ≤ c.val) : noteC3 s c = 0 := by
  unfold noteC3
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

theorem hiZero_noteB2 (o : Digest K) (v a : K) (s : Digest K) : HiZero (noteB2 o v a s) :=
  fun c hc => noteC3_zero s c (by omega)

theorem hiZero_recipB (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (j : Nat) : HiZero (recipB pub w j) := by
  rw [recipB]
  cases pub.variant
  · by_cases h0 : j = 0
    · rw [if_pos h0]; exact hiZero_lo8 _ _
    · by_cases h1 : j = 1
      · rw [if_neg h0, if_pos h1]; exact hiZero_noteB1 _ _ _ _
      · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h1]; exact hiZero_noteB2 _ _ _ _
  · exact fun _ _ => rfl

theorem blocksOf_hiZero (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57) :
    HiZero (blocksOf pub w h) := by
  have h57 := h.isLt
  have hcase : h.val = 0 ∨ h.val = 1 ∨ h.val = 2 ∨ h.val = 3 ∨ (4 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 24) ∨
      h.val = 25 ∨ h.val = 26 ∨ (27 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 29) ∨ h.val = 30 ∨ h.val = 31 ∨
      h.val = 32 ∨ h.val = 33 ∨ (34 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 53) ∨ 54 ≤ h.val := by omega
  rcases hcase with e | e | e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩ | e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩ | e | e | e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩ | e
  · rw [show h = 0 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_lo8 _ _
  · rw [show h = 1 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_lo8 _ _
  · rw [show h = 2 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_noteB1 _ _ _ _
  · rw [show h = 3 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_noteB2 _ _ _ _
  · rw [blocksOf_tree_lo pub w h e1 e2]; exact hiZero_node _ _
  · rw [show h = 25 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_lo8 _ _
  · rw [show h = 26 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_lo8 _ _
  · rw [blocksOf_recip pub w h e1 e2]; exact hiZero_recipB pub w _
  · rw [show h = 30 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_lo8 _ _
  · rw [show h = 31 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_noteB1 _ _ _ _
  · rw [show h = 32 from Fin.ext e]; exact hiZero_noteB2 _ _ _ _
  · rw [show h = 33 from Fin.ext e]
    obtain ⟨l, r, hlr⟩ := outPairB_node pub w
    show HiZero (outPairB pub w)
    rw [hlr]; exact hiZero_node _ _
  · rw [blocksOf_app pub w h e1 e2]; exact hiZero_node _ _
  · rw [blocksOf_tree_hi pub w h e]; exact hiZero_node _ _

theorem recipB_wd (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (j : Nat) (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) :
    recipB pub w j = ⟨0, 0⟩ := by
  rw [recipB, hv]

/-- Absorption support, ScheduleAbsorbs (Schedule.lean:91). -/
theorem blocksOf_absorb_zero (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57) (c : Fin 16)
    (ha : ScheduleAbsorbs pub.variant h.val c.val) : (blocksOf pub w h).absorb c = 0 := by
  unfold ScheduleAbsorbs at ha
  by_cases h2 : c.val < 2
  · rw [if_pos h2] at ha
    obtain ⟨hv, e | e | e⟩ := ha
    · rw [show h = 27 from Fin.ext e]
      show (recipB pub w 0).absorb c = 0
      rw [recipB_wd pub w 0 hv]; rfl
    · rw [show h = 28 from Fin.ext e]
      show (recipB pub w 1).absorb c = 0
      rw [recipB_wd pub w 1 hv]; rfl
    · rw [show h = 29 from Fin.ext e]
      show (recipB pub w 2).absorb c = 0
      rw [recipB_wd pub w 2 hv]; rfl
  · rw [if_neg h2] at ha
    by_cases h8 : c.val < 8
    · rw [if_pos h8] at ha
      rcases ha with e | e | e | ⟨hv, e | e⟩
      · rw [show h = 3 from Fin.ext e]
        exact noteC3_zero _ c (by omega)
      · rw [show h = 32 from Fin.ext e]
        exact noteC3_zero _ c (by omega)
      · rw [show h = 29 from Fin.ext e]
        show (recipB pub w 2).absorb c = 0
        rw [recipB]
        split
        · exact noteC3_zero _ c (by omega)
        · rfl
      · rw [show h = 27 from Fin.ext e]
        show (recipB pub w 0).absorb c = 0
        rw [recipB_wd pub w 0 hv]; rfl
      · rw [show h = 28 from Fin.ext e]
        show (recipB pub w 1).absorb c = 0
        rw [recipB_wd pub w 1 hv]; rfl
    · exact blocksOf_hiZero pub w h c (by omega)

theorem schedule_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    Holds scheduleFamily pub (buildModel pub w) := by
  rw [schedule_holds_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b hb hf c
    have h57 : b.val / 16 < 57 := by unfold ScheduleFull at hf; omega
    rw [buildModel, row_cell _ b h57 c, hb, blockCell_pre]
    show (blocksOf pub w ⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩).pre c = _
    unfold ScheduleFull at hf
    rcases hf with e | e | e | e | e | ⟨hv, e | e⟩
    · rw [show (⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ : Fin 57) = 0 from Fin.ext e, e]
      fin_cases c <;> rfl
    · rw [show (⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ : Fin 57) = 1 from Fin.ext e, e]
      fin_cases c <;> rfl
    · rw [show (⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ : Fin 57) = 25 from Fin.ext e, e]
      cases pub.variant <;> fin_cases c <;> rfl
    · rw [show (⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ : Fin 57) = 30 from Fin.ext e, e]
      fin_cases c <;> rfl
    · rw [show (⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ : Fin 57) = 27 from Fin.ext e, e]
      show (recipB pub w 0).pre c = _
      unfold recipB
      cases pub.variant <;> fin_cases c <;> rfl
    · rw [show (⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ : Fin 57) = 28 from Fin.ext e, e]
      show (recipB pub w 1).pre c = _
      unfold recipB
      rw [hv]
      fin_cases c <;> rfl
    · rw [show (⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ : Fin 57) = 29 from Fin.ext e, e]
      show (recipB pub w 2).pre c = _
      unfold recipB
      rw [hv]
      fin_cases c <;> rfl
  · intro b hb hn c
    have h57 : b.val / 16 < 57 := by unfold ScheduleNode at hn; omega
    have e := row_cell (cellsOf pub w) b h57 (c.castAdd 8)
    rw [buildModel]
    refine Eq.trans e ?_
    rw [hb, blockCell_pre]
    show (blocksOf pub w ⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩).pre (c.castAdd 8) = 0
    obtain ⟨l, r, hlr⟩ := blocksOf_node pub w ⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩ hn
    rw [hlr]
    exact nodeIn_pre_lo l r _ c.isLt
  · intro b hb c ha
    have h57 : b.val / 16 < 57 := by
      unfold ScheduleAbsorbs at ha; split_ifs at ha <;> omega
    rw [buildModel, row_cell _ b h57 c, hb]
    show (blocksOf pub w ⟨b.val / 16, h57⟩).absorb c = 0
    exact blocksOf_absorb_zero pub w _ c ha

#print axioms layout_block'
#print axioms state_layout
#print axioms poseidon_layout

#print axioms blockCell_pre

#print axioms blocksOf_recip

R0Z.BuilderModelDigest.text:
import R0Z.BuilderModelHash
import R0P.Digest

/-! Builder model, public digest binding (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4).
`digestFamily` holds on the model under `DigestPremises`: the public anchor,
nullifier, recipient, change, next root and carry frontier equal the digests
the model computes (the equality checks the Rust builder performs before it
returns, pair_trace.rs:632-662, 593-595, pair_forest_trace.rs:241-243, plus
the afterstate it publishes).  The frozen empty-root lanes and the snapshot
frontier lanes hold by construction; the last empty-root limb needs
characteristic 2^31−1 (M31 add before the lift, EmptyRoots.lean). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem blockCell_11 (b : BlockIn K) (i : Fin 8) (h : i.val < 16) :
    blockCell b 11 ⟨i.val, h⟩ = blockDigest b i := rfl

theorem blockCell_12 (b : BlockIn K) (c : Fin 16) : blockCell b 12 c = b.absorb c := rfl

theorem treeCur_succ (w : ModelWitness K) (leaf : Digest K) (n : Nat) (hn : n < 24) :
    treeCur w leaf (n + 1) = blockDigest (treeNode w (treeCur w leaf n) ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
  rw [treeCur.eq_2, dif_pos hn]

theorem appCur_succ (pub : Public K) (start : Digest K) (n : Nat) (hn : n < 20) :
    appCur pub start (n + 1) = blockDigest (appNode pub (appCur pub start n) ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
  rw [appCur.eq_2, dif_pos hn]

theorem appCur_zero (pub : Public K) (start : Digest K) : appCur pub start 0 = start := by
  rw [appCur.eq_1]

attribute [local irreducible] blockOut blockIter blockDigest treeCur appCur

theorem digest_cell (C : Cells K) (h : Fin 57) (r : Fin 1024) (hr : r.val = 16 * h.val + 11)
    (i : Fin 8) : layout C (i.castAdd 21) r = blockDigest (C.blocks h) i := by
  rw [layout_block' C _ (lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (by norm_num)) h 11 (by norm_num) r hr]
  exact blockCell_11 _ i _

theorem blocksOf_app' (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (h : Fin 57) (j : Nat)
    (hj : h.val = 34 + j) (hj20 : j < 20) :
    blocksOf pub w h = appNode pub (appCur pub (outPair pub w) j) ⟨j, hj20⟩ := by
  rw [blocksOf_app pub w h (by omega) (by omega)]
  have e : (⟨h.val - 34, by omega⟩ : Fin 20) = ⟨j, hj20⟩ := Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
  rw [e, show h.val - 34 = j by omega]

theorem m31_lift [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (s : Nat) :
    (((if s ≥ 0x7fffffff then s - 0x7fffffff else s : Nat)) : K) = (s : K) := by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub h, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff, sub_zero]
  · rfl

theorem emptyRootK_congr (l : Fin 20) (a b : Fin 8) (h : a.val = b.val) :
    emptyRootK (K := K) l a = emptyRootK l b := by
  rw [Fin.ext h]

/-- A zero append bit puts the frozen empty root (with the M31-added tweak on
the last limb) in lanes 8..15 of the node's pre-state. -/
theorem app_pre_zero [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : Public K) (cur : Digest K) (l : Fin 20)
    (hb : appBit pub l.val = false) (i : Fin 8) (hc : 8 + i.val < 16) :
    (appNode pub cur l).pre ⟨8 + i.val, hc⟩ = emptyRootRightTarget l i := by
  unfold appNode appSib ordered nodeIn
  simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  rw [if_neg (show ¬ ((⟨8 + i.val, hc⟩ : Fin 16).val < 8) by simp)]
  unfold emptyRootRightTarget
  by_cases hi : i.val = 7
  · rw [if_pos (show (⟨8 + i.val, hc⟩ : Fin 16).val = 15 by simp; omega),
      if_pos (show i.val + 1 = 8 by omega)]
    have hi7 : i = 7 := Fin.ext hi
    subst hi7
    dsimp only
    rw [m31_lift, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg (show ¬ ((⟨8 + i.val, hc⟩ : Fin 16).val = 15) by simp; omega),
      if_neg (show ¬ (i.val + 1 = 8) by omega)]
    exact emptyRootK_congr l _ i (by simp)

/-- A one append bit puts the snapshot frontier in the absorbed left child. -/
theorem app_absorb_one (pub : Public K) (cur : Digest K) (l : Fin 20)
    (hb : appBit pub l.val = true) (i : Fin 8) (hc : i.val < 16) :
    (appNode pub cur l).absorb ⟨i.val, hc⟩ = pub.snapshotFrontier l i := by
  unfold appNode appSib ordered nodeIn lo8
  simp only [hb, if_true]
  rw [dif_pos i.isLt]

/-- The witness-side premises of the digest family. -/
structure DigestPremises (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) : Prop where
  anchor : pub.anchor = treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) 24
  nullifier : pub.nullifier = nullifierDigest w
  recipient : ∀ r, pub.recipient = some r → r = recipientDigest pub w
  change : pub.change = changeDigest pub w
  nextRoot : pub.nextRoot = appCur pub (outPair pub w) 20
  carry : ∀ hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20,
    pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩ =
      appCur pub (outPair pub w) (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)

theorem blocksOf_carry (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 20) :
    blockDigest (blocksOf pub w ⟨33 + k, by omega⟩) = appCur pub (outPair pub w) k := by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [appCur_zero]
      show blockDigest (outPairB pub w) = outPair pub w
      rfl
  | succ j =>
      rw [blocksOf_app' pub w _ j (by simp; omega) (by omega), appCur_succ pub _ j (by omega)]

theorem digest_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hP : DigestPremises pub w) : Holds digestFamily pub (buildModel pub w) := by
  rw [digest_holds_iff]
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_, fun r hr i => ?_, fun i => ?_, fun level => ⟨fun hz i => ?_,
    fun hnz i => ?_⟩, fun i => ?_, fun hc i => ?_⟩
  · rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ 56 907 rfl i, hP.anchor]
    show blockDigest (treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) 23) ⟨23, by decide⟩) i = _
    exact congrFun (treeCur_succ w _ 23 (by decide)).symm i
  · rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ 26 427 rfl i, hP.nullifier]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ 29 475 rfl i, hP.recipient r hr]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ 32 523 rfl i, hP.change]
    rfl
  · have hb : appBit pub level.val = false := decide_eq_false (fun h => h hz)
    rw [buildModel, layout_block' _ _ (by simp; omega) ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 0 (by decide) _
      (by simp [g2Row]), blockCell_pre]
    show (blocksOf pub w ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩).pre _ = _
    rw [blocksOf_app' pub w _ level.val rfl level.isLt]
    exact app_pre_zero pub _ level hb i _
  · have hb : appBit pub level.val = true := decide_eq_true hnz
    rw [buildModel, layout_block' _ _ (lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (by norm_num)) ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩
      12 (by decide) _ (by simp [g2Row]), blockCell_12]
    show (blocksOf pub w ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩).absorb _ = _
    rw [blocksOf_app' pub w _ level.val rfl level.isLt]
    exact app_absorb_one pub _ level hb i _
  · rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ 53 859 rfl i, hP.nextRoot]
    show blockDigest (appNode pub (appCur pub (outPair pub w) 19) ⟨19, by decide⟩) i = _
    exact congrFun (appCur_succ pub _ 19 (by decide)).symm i
  · rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ ⟨33 + digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, by omega⟩ _
      (by simp [g2Row]) i, hP.carry hc]
    exact congrFun (blocksOf_carry pub w _ hc) i

#print axioms treeCur_succ
#print axioms appCur_succ
#print axioms digest_cell
#print axioms blocksOf_app'
#print axioms m31_lift
#print axioms app_pre_zero
#print axioms app_absorb_one
#print axioms blocksOf_carry
#print axioms digest_model
end R0Z.BuilderModel

R0Z.BuilderModelSentinel.text:
import R0P.PositivityChain
import R0P.Occupancy
import R0P.Digest

/-! The change-sentinel obstruction (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §5).

For a private transfer, any trace satisfying the occupancy and digest
families together with CopyLinkBalance has `pub.change 7 ≠ 0`: copy link
1124073492 (CopyConstants.lean, transfer-only) copies the change digest
(row 523, columns 0..7) into the output occupancy row 1018 (columns 2..9),
whose sentinel equation `A 9 · A 1 − A 0 = 0` with `A 0 = 1` forces
`A 9 ≠ 0`.  The Rust builder enforces the same condition by aborting
(two_outputs, pair_tree_profile.rs:206-226: "a zero sentinel is a retry
condition for note-salt generation").  Rspend (SpendRelation.lean:41) does not
contain it, so no builder can satisfy `BuilderRefines S Rspend` on transfer
witnesses whose change commitment has a zero last limb. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- COPY_LINKS entry 1124073492 (CopyConstants.lean, the third entry of
`copyLinksAfterPositivity`). -/
def changeOccLink : CopyLink := ⟨1124073492, 1, 0, ⟨523, 0, 1⟩, ⟨1018, 0, 11⟩⟩

theorem changeOccLink_mem : changeOccLink ∈ copyLinks :=
  List.mem_append_right _
    (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))))))

theorem change_occ_cell (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) : A 7 523 = A 9 1018 := by
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) changeOccLink pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    show (if pub.variant = .privateTransfer then (1 : K) else 0) ≠ 0
    rw [if_pos hv]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have h := hb changeOccLink changeOccLink_mem hw
  have h7 := congrFun (congrArg Prod.snd h) 7
  have h7' : A 7 523 + ((0 : Nat) : K) = A 9 1018 + ((0 : Nat) : K) := h7
  simpa using h7'

theorem change_sentinel_of_balance (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) : pub.change 7 ≠ 0 := by
  have ho' := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).1 ho
  have hd' := (digest_holds_iff pub A).1 hd
  have hs : A 9 1018 * A 1 1018 - A 0 1018 = 0 := (ho'.1 1018 (Or.inr rfl)).2.1
  have h0 : A 0 1018 = 1 := by
    have := ho'.2.2
    rw [hv] at this
    exact this
  have hc : A 7 523 = pub.change 7 := hd'.2.2.2.1 7
  intro hz
  rw [← change_occ_cell pub A hb hv, hc, hz, h0, zero_mul, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at hs
  exact one_ne_zero hs

#print axioms changeOccLink_mem
#print axioms change_occ_cell
#print axioms change_sentinel_of_balance
end R0Z.BuilderModel

R0Z.BuilderModelBridge.text:
import R0Z.BuilderComplete
import R0Z.BuilderModelAux
import R0Z.BuilderModelDigest
import R0Z.BuilderModelSentinel

/-! The builder model against `BuilderComplete` (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4, §5).

* `nonCopy_model`: `NonCopyHolds pub (buildModel pub w)` from the aux and
  digest premises — the first field of `BuilderRefines` for the model.
* `refines_forces_sentinel`: whatever the builder, `BuilderRefines S Rel`
  forces `pub.change 7 ≠ 0` on every transfer instance of `Rel`; hence the
  relation to instantiate is Rspend strengthened by the non-zero change
  sentinel (the Rust retry condition), not Rspend itself. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P R0Z.BuilderComplete

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem nonCopy_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hA : AuxPremises pub w) (hD : DigestPremises pub w) : NonCopyHolds pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  ⟨value_model pub w hA.conservation, occupancy_model pub w hA, asset_model pub w hA.amount,
    schedule_model pub w, path_model pub w, digest_model pub w hD, poseidon_model pub w⟩

theorem refines_forces_sentinel [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K} {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (pub : Public K) (w : W) (hw : Rel pub w) (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    pub.change 7 ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_, ho, _, _, _, hd, _⟩ := hR.nonCopy pub w hw
  exact change_sentinel_of_balance pub _ ho hd (hR.balance pub w hw) hv

#print axioms nonCopy_model
#print axioms refines_forces_sentinel
end R0Z.BuilderModel

R0Z.BuilderModelBase.text:
import R0Z.BuilderModelHash

/-! Base typing of the builder model (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4 b, choice m5).

Every cell of `buildModel pub w` lies in the base subfield `F` when the
public input (R0P `PublicBase`) and the witness (`WitnessBase`) do.  The
Poseidon round functions preserve `F` (constants are numerals); blocks,
aux records and the layout are closed by structural lemmas over `Cells`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K] (F : Subfield K)

/-! ### Poseidon preserves F -/

theorem foldl_add_mem (l : List K) (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ F) (a : K) (ha : a ∈ F) :
    l.foldl (· + ·) a ∈ F := by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => exact ha
  | cons x xs ih =>
      exact ih (fun y hy => hl y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)) _
        (add_mem ha (hl x List.mem_cons_self))

theorem pow5_mem (x : K) (hx : x ∈ F) : poseidonPow5 x ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonPow5
  exact mul_mem (mul_mem (mul_mem hx hx) (mul_mem hx hx)) hx

theorem mat4_mem (v : Fin 4 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ F) (i : Fin 4) : poseidonMat4 v i ∈ F := by
  have h0 := hv 0; have h1 := hv 1; have h2 := hv 2; have h3 := hv 3
  unfold poseidonMat4
  fin_cases i <;> simp <;>
    repeat' first | assumption | apply add_mem

theorem extLinear_mem (s : Fin 16 → K) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) (i : Fin 16) :
    poseidonExternalLinear s i ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonExternalLinear
  have hm : ∀ (g : Fin 4) (c : Fin 4),
      poseidonMat4 (fun lane : Fin 4 => s ⟨4 * g.val + lane.val, by omega⟩) c ∈ F :=
    fun g c => mat4_mem F _ (fun _ => hs _) c
  exact add_mem (hm _ _) (add_mem (add_mem (add_mem (add_mem (zero_mem _) (hm _ _)) (hm _ _))
    (hm _ _)) (hm _ _))

theorem intLinear_mem (s : Fin 16 → K) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) (i : Fin 16) :
    poseidonInternalLinear s i ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonInternalLinear
  have hp : (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => s j.succ)).foldl (· + ·) 0 ∈ F :=
    foldl_add_mem F _ (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
      exact hs _) 0 (zero_mem _)
  split
  · exact sub_mem hp (hs 0)
  · exact add_mem (add_mem hp (hs 0)) (mul_mem (hs i) (natCast_mem F _))

theorem extInit_mem (r : Fin 4) (l : Fin 16) : poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r l ∈ F := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [poseidonExternalInitial]

theorem extFinal_mem (r : Fin 4) (l : Fin 16) : poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r l ∈ F := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [poseidonExternalFinal]

theorem intConst_mem (r : Fin 14) : poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r ∈ F := by
  fin_cases r <;> simp [poseidonInternalConstants]

theorem fullRound_mem (s c : Fin 16 → K) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ F) (i : Fin 16) :
    poseidonFullRound s c i ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonFullRound
  exact extLinear_mem F _ (fun j => pow5_mem F _ (add_mem (hs j) (hc j))) i

theorem intRound_mem (s : Fin 16 → K) (c : K) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) (hc : c ∈ F) (i : Fin 16) :
    poseidonInternalRound s c i ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonInternalRound
  refine intLinear_mem F _ (fun j => ?_) i
  split
  · exact pow5_mem F _ (add_mem (hs 0) hc)
  · exact hs j

theorem applyRound_mem (r : Fin 22) (s : Fin 16 → K) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) (i : Fin 16) :
    poseidonApplyRound r s i ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonApplyRound
  split
  · exact fullRound_mem F _ _ hs (extInit_mem F _) i
  · split
    · exact intRound_mem F _ _ hs (intConst_mem F _) i
    · exact fullRound_mem F _ _ hs (extFinal_mem F _) i

theorem leadingPair_mem (s a : Fin 16 → K) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ F) (i : Fin 16) :
    poseidonLeadingPair s a i ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonLeadingPair
  have h1 : ∀ j : Fin 16, (if j.val < 8 then s j + a j else s j) ∈ F := fun j => by
    split
    · exact add_mem (hs j) (ha j)
    · exact hs j
  exact fullRound_mem F _ _ (fullRound_mem F _ _ (extLinear_mem F _ h1) (extInit_mem F _))
    (extInit_mem F _) i

theorem transition_mem (r : Fin 11) (s a : Fin 16 → K) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ F)
    (i : Fin 16) : poseidonTransition r s a i ∈ F := by
  unfold poseidonTransition
  split
  · exact leadingPair_mem F _ _ hs ha i
  · exact applyRound_mem F _ _ (applyRound_mem F _ _ hs) i

/-! ### Blocks and layout -/

/-- Both rows a block is built from lie in F. -/
def BlockBase (b : BlockIn K) : Prop := (∀ i, b.pre i ∈ F) ∧ ∀ i, b.absorb i ∈ F

theorem blockIter_mem (b : BlockIn K) (hb : BlockBase F b) (n : Nat) (i : Fin 16) :
    blockIter b n i ∈ F := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => exact hb.1 i
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [blockIter.eq_2]
      split
      · exact transition_mem F _ _ _ ih hb.2 i
      · exact ih i

theorem blockDigest_mem (b : BlockIn K) (hb : BlockBase F b) (i : Fin 8) :
    blockDigest b i ∈ F := blockIter_mem F b hb 11 _

theorem blockOut_mem (b : BlockIn K) (hb : BlockBase F b) (i : Fin 16) :
    blockOut b i ∈ F := blockIter_mem F b hb 11 i

theorem blockCell_mem (b : BlockIn K) (hb : BlockBase F b) (l : Nat) (c : Fin 16) :
    blockCell b l c ∈ F := by
  unfold blockCell
  split
  · exact blockIter_mem F b hb l c
  · split
    · exact hb.2 c
    · exact zero_mem _

/-- Aux records in F (values are naturals, cast). -/
structure CellsBase (C : Cells K) : Prop where
  blocks : ∀ h, BlockBase F (C.blocks h)
  pathBit : ∀ l, (C.path l).bit ∈ F
  pathCur : ∀ l i, (C.path l).current i ∈ F
  pathLeft : ∀ l i, (C.path l).left i ∈ F
  pathRight : ∀ l i, (C.path l).right i ∈ F
  inOcc : C.inOcc.occupied ∈ F ∧ C.inOcc.inverse ∈ F ∧ (∀ i, C.inOcc.commitment i ∈ F) ∧
    C.inOcc.selected ∈ F
  outOcc : C.outOcc.occupied ∈ F ∧ C.outOcc.inverse ∈ F ∧ (∀ i, C.outOcc.commitment i ∈ F) ∧
    C.outOcc.selected ∈ F

theorem occCell_mem (o : OccAux K) (ho : o.occupied ∈ F ∧ o.inverse ∈ F ∧
    (∀ i, o.commitment i ∈ F) ∧ o.selected ∈ F) (c : Fin 16) : occCell o c ∈ F := by
  unfold occCell
  split
  · exact ho.1
  · split
    · exact ho.2.1
    · split
      · exact ho.2.2.1 _
      · split
        · exact ho.2.2.2
        · exact zero_mem _

theorem bitK_mem (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) n i ∈ F := natCast_mem F _

theorem auxCell_mem (C : Cells K) (hC : CellsBase F C) (r : Nat) (c : Fin 16) :
    auxCell C r c ∈ F := by
  have hb : ∀ v : Nat, valueBaseCell (K := K) v c ∈ F := fun v => by
    unfold valueBaseCell
    split
    · exact bitK_mem F _ _
    · split
      · exact natCast_mem F _
      · exact zero_mem _
  have hm : ∀ v : Nat, valueMidCell (K := K) v c ∈ F := fun v => by
    unfold valueMidCell
    split
    · exact bitK_mem F _ _
    · exact zero_mem _
  have hh : ∀ v : Nat, valueHiCell (K := K) v c ∈ F := fun v => by
    unfold valueHiCell
    split
    · exact bitK_mem F _ _
    · exact zero_mem _
  have hpb : ∀ l, pathBaseCell (C.path l) c ∈ F := fun l => by
    unfold pathBaseCell
    split
    · exact hC.pathBit l
    · split
      · exact hC.pathCur l _
      · exact zero_mem _
  have hps : ∀ l, pathSuccCell (C.path l) c ∈ F := fun l => by
    unfold pathSuccCell
    split
    · exact hC.pathLeft l _
    · exact hC.pathRight l _
  have hv : ∀ j, (C.values j : K) ∈ F := fun j => natCast_mem F _
  unfold auxCell
  by_cases hq : 912 ≤ r ∧ r < 1008
  · rw [dif_pos hq]
    by_cases h1 : r % 16 % 4 = 1
    · rw [if_pos h1]; exact hpb _
    · rw [if_neg h1]
      by_cases h2 : r % 16 % 4 = 2
      · rw [if_pos h2]; exact hps _
      · rw [if_neg h2]; exact zero_mem _
  rw [dif_neg hq]
  by_cases e0 : r = 1008
  · rw [if_pos e0]
    exact hb _
  rw [if_neg e0]
  by_cases e1 : r = 1009
  · rw [if_pos e1]
    exact hm _
  rw [if_neg e1]
  by_cases e2 : r = 1010
  · rw [if_pos e2]
    exact hb _
  rw [if_neg e2]
  by_cases e3 : r = 1011
  · rw [if_pos e3]
    exact hm _
  rw [if_neg e3]
  by_cases e4 : r = 1012
  · rw [if_pos e4]
    exact hb _
  rw [if_neg e4]
  by_cases e5 : r = 1013
  · rw [if_pos e5]
    exact hm _
  rw [if_neg e5]
  by_cases e6 : r = 1014
  · rw [if_pos e6]
    split
    · exact hv _
    · split
      · exact hv _
      · split
        · exact sub_mem (hv _) (hv _)
        · exact zero_mem _
  rw [if_neg e6]
  by_cases e7 : r = 1015
  · rw [if_pos e7]
    split
    · exact sub_mem (hv _) (hv _)
    · split
      · exact hv _
      · exact zero_mem _
  rw [if_neg e7]
  by_cases e8 : r = 1016
  · rw [if_pos e8]
    exact hh _
  rw [if_neg e8]
  by_cases e9 : r = 1017
  · rw [if_pos e9]
    exact occCell_mem F _ hC.inOcc c
  rw [if_neg e9]
  by_cases e10 : r = 1018
  · rw [if_pos e10]
    exact occCell_mem F _ hC.outOcc c
  rw [if_neg e10]
  by_cases e11 : r = 1020
  · rw [if_pos e11]
    exact hh _
  rw [if_neg e11]
  by_cases e12 : r = 1022
  · rw [if_pos e12]
    exact hh _
  rw [if_neg e12]

theorem layout_mem (C : Cells K) (hC : CellsBase F C) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) :
    layout C c r ∈ F := by
  unfold layout
  split
  · split
    · exact blockCell_mem F _ (hC.blocks _) _ _
    · exact auxCell_mem F C hC _ _
  · exact zero_mem _

/-! ### The model's cells are in F -/

/-- The witness fields that enter the trace lie in F (Wspend over M31). -/
structure WitnessBase (w : ModelWitness K) : Prop where
  sk : ∀ i, w.sk i ∈ F
  salt : ∀ i, w.salt i ∈ F
  path : ∀ l i, (w.path l).2 i ∈ F
  pairOccupied : w.pairOccupied ∈ F
  pairSecond : ∀ i, w.pairSecond i ∈ F
  pairInverse : w.pairInverse ∈ F
  recipientOwner : ∀ i, w.recipientOwner i ∈ F
  recipientSalt : ∀ i, w.recipientSalt i ∈ F
  changeOwner : ∀ i, w.changeOwner i ∈ F
  changeSalt : ∀ i, w.changeSalt i ∈ F

theorem lo8_mem (d : Digest K) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ F) (l : Fin 16) : lo8 d l ∈ F := by
  unfold lo8
  split
  · exact hd _
  · exact zero_mem _

theorem spongeInit_mem (dom len : Nat) [dom.AtLeastTwo] [len.AtLeastTwo] (l : Fin 16) :
    spongeInit (K := K) (OfNat.ofNat dom) (OfNat.ofNat len) l ∈ F := by
  unfold spongeInit
  split
  · exact ofNat_mem F dom
  · split
    · exact ofNat_mem F len
    · exact zero_mem _

theorem nodeIn_base (l r : Digest K) (hl : ∀ i, l i ∈ F) (hr : ∀ i, r i ∈ F) :
    BlockBase F (nodeIn l r) := by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, lo8_mem F l hl⟩
  show (if i.val < 8 then 0 else if i.val = 15 then r 7 + (0x4153_1005 : K)
      else r ⟨i.val - 8, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩) ∈ F
  split
  · exact zero_mem _
  · split
    · exact add_mem (hr 7) (ofNat_mem F _)
    · exact hr _

theorem ordered_mem (a b : Digest K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ F) (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ F) (bit : Bool) :
    (∀ i, (ordered a b bit).1 i ∈ F) ∧ ∀ i, (ordered a b bit).2 i ∈ F := by
  unfold ordered
  cases bit
  · exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · exact ⟨hb, ha⟩

theorem noteB0_base (o : Digest K) (ho : ∀ i, o i ∈ F) : BlockBase F (noteB0 o) :=
  ⟨spongeInit_mem F 0x41530003 18, lo8_mem F o ho⟩

theorem noteB1_base (o : Digest K) (v a : K) (s : Digest K) (ho : ∀ i, o i ∈ F) (hv : v ∈ F)
    (ha : a ∈ F) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) : BlockBase F (noteB1 o v a s) := by
  refine ⟨blockIter_mem F _ (noteB0_base F o ho) 11, fun l => ?_⟩
  show noteC2 v a s l ∈ F
  unfold noteC2
  split
  · exact hv
  · split
    · exact ha
    · split
      · exact hs _
      · exact zero_mem _

theorem noteB2_base (o : Digest K) (v a : K) (s : Digest K) (ho : ∀ i, o i ∈ F) (hv : v ∈ F)
    (ha : a ∈ F) (hs : ∀ i, s i ∈ F) : BlockBase F (noteB2 o v a s) := by
  refine ⟨blockIter_mem F _ (noteB1_base F o v a s ho hv ha hs) 11, fun l => ?_⟩
  show noteC3 s l ∈ F
  unfold noteC3
  split
  · exact hs _
  · split
    · exact hs _
    · exact zero_mem _

variable {F}

theorem treeCur_mem (w : ModelWitness K) (hw : WitnessBase F w) (leaf : Digest K)
    (hl : ∀ i, leaf i ∈ F) (n : Nat) : ∀ i, treeCur w leaf n i ∈ F := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [treeCur.eq_2]
      split
      · exact blockDigest_mem F _ (nodeIn_base F _ _ (ordered_mem F _ _ ih (hw.path _) _).1
          (ordered_mem F _ _ ih (hw.path _) _).2)
      · exact ih

theorem emptyRootK_mem (l : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) : emptyRootK (K := K) l i ∈ F :=
  natCast_mem F _

theorem appCur_mem (pub : Public K) (hp : PublicBase F pub) (start : Digest K)
    (hs : ∀ i, start i ∈ F) (n : Nat) : ∀ i, appCur pub start n i ∈ F := by
  have hsib : ∀ l i, appSib pub l i ∈ F := fun l i => by
    unfold appSib
    split
    · exact hp.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 l i
    · exact emptyRootK_mem l i
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hs
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [appCur.eq_2]
      split
      · exact blockDigest_mem F _ (nodeIn_base F _ _ (ordered_mem F _ _ ih (hsib _) _).1
          (ordered_mem F _ _ ih (hsib _) _).2)
      · exact ih

theorem dirK_mem (b : Bool) : dirK (K := K) b ∈ F := by
  unfold dirK
  split
  · exact one_mem _
  · exact zero_mem _

section model
variable (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (hp : PublicBase F pub) (hw : WitnessBase F w)
include hp hw

theorem ownerDigest_mem : ∀ i, ownerDigest w i ∈ F :=
  blockDigest_mem F _ ⟨spongeInit_mem F 0x41530001 8, lo8_mem F _ hw.sk⟩

theorem inputLeaf_mem : ∀ i, inputLeaf pub w i ∈ F :=
  blockDigest_mem F _ (noteB2_base F _ _ _ _ (ownerDigest_mem pub w hp hw) (natCast_mem F _)
    hp.2.2.1 hw.salt)

theorem recipB_base (j : Nat) : BlockBase F (recipB pub w j) := by
  rw [recipB]
  cases pub.variant
  · by_cases h0 : j = 0
    · rw [if_pos h0]; exact noteB0_base F _ hw.recipientOwner
    · by_cases h1 : j = 1
      · rw [if_neg h0, if_pos h1]
        exact noteB1_base F _ _ _ _ hw.recipientOwner (natCast_mem F _) hp.2.2.1 hw.recipientSalt
      · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h1]
        exact noteB2_base F _ _ _ _ hw.recipientOwner (natCast_mem F _) hp.2.2.1 hw.recipientSalt
  · exact ⟨fun _ => zero_mem _, fun _ => zero_mem _⟩

theorem changeDigest_mem : ∀ i, changeDigest pub w i ∈ F :=
  blockDigest_mem F _ (noteB2_base F _ _ _ _ hw.changeOwner (natCast_mem F _) hp.2.2.1 hw.changeSalt)

theorem outPairB_base : BlockBase F (outPairB pub w) := by
  rw [outPairB]
  cases pub.variant
  · exact nodeIn_base F _ _ (blockDigest_mem F _ (recipB_base pub w hp hw 2))
      (changeDigest_mem pub w hp hw)
  · exact nodeIn_base F _ _ (changeDigest_mem pub w hp hw) (fun _ => zero_mem _)

theorem treeNode_base (n : Nat) (l : Fin 24) :
    BlockBase F (treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) n) l) :=
  nodeIn_base F _ _ (ordered_mem F _ _ (treeCur_mem w hw _ (inputLeaf_mem pub w hp hw) n)
    (hw.path _) _).1 (ordered_mem F _ _ (treeCur_mem w hw _ (inputLeaf_mem pub w hp hw) n)
    (hw.path _) _).2

theorem appNode_base (n : Nat) (l : Fin 20) :
    BlockBase F (appNode pub (appCur pub (outPair pub w) n) l) := by
  have hsib : ∀ i, appSib pub l i ∈ F := fun i => by
    unfold appSib
    split
    · exact hp.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 l i
    · exact emptyRootK_mem l i
  have hc := appCur_mem pub hp _ (blockDigest_mem F _ (outPairB_base pub w hp hw)) n
  exact nodeIn_base F _ _ (ordered_mem F _ _ hc hsib _).1 (ordered_mem F _ _ hc hsib _).2

attribute [local irreducible] blockOut blockIter blockDigest treeCur appCur

theorem blocksOf_base (h : Fin 57) : BlockBase F (blocksOf pub w h) := by
  have h57 := h.isLt
  have hcase : h.val = 0 ∨ h.val = 1 ∨ h.val = 2 ∨ h.val = 3 ∨ (4 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 24) ∨
      h.val = 25 ∨ h.val = 26 ∨ (27 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 29) ∨ h.val = 30 ∨ h.val = 31 ∨
      h.val = 32 ∨ h.val = 33 ∨ (34 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 53) ∨ 54 ≤ h.val := by omega
  have ho := ownerDigest_mem pub w hp hw
  rcases hcase with e | e | e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩ | e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩ | e | e | e | e | ⟨e1, e2⟩ | e
  · rw [show h = 0 from Fin.ext e]
    exact ⟨spongeInit_mem F 0x41530001 8, lo8_mem F _ hw.sk⟩
  · rw [show h = 1 from Fin.ext e]; exact noteB0_base F _ ho
  · rw [show h = 2 from Fin.ext e]
    exact noteB1_base F _ _ _ _ ho (natCast_mem F _) hp.2.2.1 hw.salt
  · rw [show h = 3 from Fin.ext e]
    exact noteB2_base F _ _ _ _ ho (natCast_mem F _) hp.2.2.1 hw.salt
  · rw [blocksOf_tree_lo pub w h e1 e2]; exact treeNode_base pub w hp hw _ _
  · rw [show h = 25 from Fin.ext e]
    exact ⟨spongeInit_mem F 0x41530002 16, lo8_mem F _ hw.sk⟩
  · rw [show h = 26 from Fin.ext e]
    show BlockBase F (nulB1 w)
    exact ⟨blockOut_mem F (nulB0 w) ⟨spongeInit_mem F 0x41530002 16, lo8_mem F _ hw.sk⟩,
      lo8_mem F _ hw.salt⟩
  · rw [blocksOf_recip pub w h e1 e2]; exact recipB_base pub w hp hw _
  · rw [show h = 30 from Fin.ext e]; exact noteB0_base F _ hw.changeOwner
  · rw [show h = 31 from Fin.ext e]
    exact noteB1_base F _ _ _ _ hw.changeOwner (natCast_mem F _) hp.2.2.1 hw.changeSalt
  · rw [show h = 32 from Fin.ext e]
    exact noteB2_base F _ _ _ _ hw.changeOwner (natCast_mem F _) hp.2.2.1 hw.changeSalt
  · rw [show h = 33 from Fin.ext e]; exact outPairB_base pub w hp hw
  · rw [blocksOf_app pub w h e1 e2]; exact appNode_base pub w hp hw _ _
  · rw [blocksOf_tree_hi pub w h e]; exact treeNode_base pub w hp hw _ _

theorem cellsOf_base : CellsBase F (cellsOf pub w) where
  blocks := blocksOf_base pub w hp hw
  pathBit := fun l => dirK_mem _
  pathCur := fun l => treeCur_mem w hw _ (inputLeaf_mem pub w hp hw) l.val
  pathLeft := fun l => (ordered_mem F _ _ (treeCur_mem w hw _ (inputLeaf_mem pub w hp hw) l.val)
    (hw.path l) _).1
  pathRight := fun l => (ordered_mem F _ _ (treeCur_mem w hw _ (inputLeaf_mem pub w hp hw) l.val)
    (hw.path l) _).2
  inOcc := ⟨hw.pairOccupied, hw.pairInverse, hw.pairSecond, dirK_mem _⟩
  outOcc := by
    show (outOccOf pub w).occupied ∈ F ∧ (outOccOf pub w).inverse ∈ F ∧
      (∀ i, (outOccOf pub w).commitment i ∈ F) ∧ (outOccOf pub w).selected ∈ F
    unfold outOccOf
    cases pub.variant
    · exact ⟨one_mem _, inv_mem (changeDigest_mem pub w hp hw 7), changeDigest_mem pub w hp hw,
        zero_mem _⟩
    · exact ⟨zero_mem _, zero_mem _, fun _ => zero_mem _, zero_mem _⟩

/-- Every cell of the model lies in the base subfield. -/
theorem buildModel_mem (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) : buildModel pub w c r ∈ F :=
  layout_mem F _ (cellsOf_base pub w hp hw) c r

end model

R0Z.BuilderModelCopyKinds.text:
import R0Z.BuilderModelAux
import R0Z.BuilderModelDigest
import R0P.PositivityChain

/-! Copy-link kinds for the builder model (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4 a).

The 136 links of R0P `copyLinks` fall into a few kinds.  This module proves
one symbolic cell lemma per kind, parametrised by the level / block, plus the
handful of one-off cell facts; `BuilderModelCopyPat` (generated) proves the
pattern-pair lemmas and `BuilderModelCopyLinks*` (generated) apply them link
by link.  No cell is evaluated: every lemma rewrites through the block-role
and aux-row lemmas with the heavy definitions irreducible. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### Link plumbing -/

/-- The 16 trace cells of row `r` an endpoint pattern reads. -/
def rv (A : Trace K) (r : Fin 1024) : Fin 16 → K := fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) r

theorem link_of (A : Trace K) (L : CopyLink)
    (h : copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns L.producer.pattern) (rv A L.producer.row) =
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns L.consumer.pattern) (rv A L.consumer.row)) :
    copyProducerTuple A L = copyConsumerTuple A L :=
  Prod.ext rfl h

theorem w1_variant (L : CopyLink) (idx : Nat) (v : Variant) (hk : L.weightKind.val = 1)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) L idx v ≠ 0) : v = .privateTransfer := by
  unfold copyLinkWeight at hw
  rw [hk] at hw
  by_contra hv
  exact hw (if_neg hv)

theorem w2_variant (L : CopyLink) (idx : Nat) (v : Variant) (hk : L.weightKind.val = 2)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) L idx v ≠ 0) : v = .withdrawal := by
  unfold copyLinkWeight at hw
  rw [hk] at hw
  by_contra hv
  exact hw (if_neg hv)

theorem bit_le_one (x : Nat) : (x &&& 1) ≤ 1 := by
  rw [Nat.and_one_is_mod]; omega

theorem w3_bit (L : CopyLink) (idx : Nat) (v : Variant) (hk : L.weightKind.val = 3)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) L idx v ≠ 0) : (idx >>> L.weightLevel &&& 1) = 0 := by
  unfold copyLinkWeight at hw
  rw [hk] at hw
  have hb := bit_le_one (idx >>> L.weightLevel)
  by_contra hne
  have h1 : (idx >>> L.weightLevel &&& 1) = 1 := by omega
  exact hw (by simp only [h1, Nat.sub_self, Nat.cast_zero])

theorem w4_bit (L : CopyLink) (idx : Nat) (v : Variant) (hk : L.weightKind.val = 4)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) L idx v ≠ 0) : (idx >>> L.weightLevel &&& 1) ≠ 0 := by
  unfold copyLinkWeight at hw
  rw [hk] at hw
  intro h0
  exact hw (by simp only [h0, Nat.cast_zero])

theorem appBit_false (pub : Public K) (l : Nat) (h : (pub.nextPairIndex >>> l &&& 1) = 0) :
    appBit pub l = false := decide_eq_false (fun hn => hn h)

theorem appBit_true (pub : Public K) (l : Nat) (h : (pub.nextPairIndex >>> l &&& 1) ≠ 0) :
    appBit pub l = true := decide_eq_true h

/-! ### Node and tweak facts -/

theorem nodeIn_absorb (l r : Digest K) (i : Fin 8) :
    (nodeIn l r).absorb ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = l i := by
  show lo8 l ⟨i.val, _⟩ = l i
  unfold lo8
  rw [dif_pos i.isLt]

theorem nodeIn_pre_lt7 (l r : Digest K) (i : Fin 8) (hi : i.val < 7) :
    (nodeIn l r).pre ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ = r i := by
  show (if (8 + i.val) < 8 then 0 else if 8 + i.val = 15 then r 7 + (0x4153_1005 : K)
    else r ⟨8 + i.val - 8, _⟩) = r i
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp)

theorem nodeIn_pre_15 (l r : Digest K) : (nodeIn l r).pre 15 = r 7 + (0x4153_1005 : K) := rfl

theorem tweak_cancel [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (x : K) :
    x + (0x4153_1005 : K) + ((1051521018 : Nat) : K) = x := by
  rw [add_assoc]
  have h : (0x4153_1005 : K) + ((1051521018 : Nat) : K) = ((0x7fffffff : Nat) : K) := by
    push_cast; norm_num
  rw [h, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff, add_zero]

/-! ### Layout cell access -/

theorem cell_block (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16) (h : Fin 57) (l : Nat) (hl : l < 16)
    (r : Fin 1024) (hr : r.val = 16 * h.val + l) :
    layout C c r = blockCell (C.blocks h) l ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := layout_block' C c hc h l hl r hr

theorem cell_aux (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : 57 ≤ r.val / 16) : layout C c r = auxCell C r.val ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := layout_aux C c r hc hr

/-! ### Membership levels: rows and blocks -/

/-- Block holding the membership node of level l (FH membership_hash_block). -/
def nodeBlock (l : Fin 24) : Nat := if l.val ≤ 20 then 4 + l.val else 33 + l.val

/-- Block whose output is level l's current digest (block 3 = input leaf). -/
def prevBlock (l : Fin 24) : Nat := if l.val = 0 then 3 else if l.val ≤ 21 then 3 + l.val else 32 + l.val

/-- Path aux base row of level l (pool_v1_pair_forest_path_base_row_v1). -/
def pathBase (l : Fin 24) : Nat := 912 + 16 * (l.val / 4) + 1 + 4 * (l.val % 4)

theorem nodeBlock_lt (l : Fin 24) : nodeBlock l < 57 := by
  have := l.isLt; unfold nodeBlock; split <;> omega

theorem prevBlock_lt (l : Fin 24) : prevBlock l < 57 := by
  have := l.isLt; unfold prevBlock; split
  · omega
  · split <;> omega

theorem pathBase_lt (l : Fin 24) : pathBase l + 1 < 1024 := by
  have := l.isLt; unfold pathBase; omega

attribute [local irreducible] blockOut blockIter blockDigest treeCur appCur

theorem blocksOf_node' (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (l : Fin 24) :
    blocksOf pub w ⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ =
      treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) l := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  by_cases h20 : l.val ≤ 20
  · have hv : nodeBlock l = 4 + l.val := by unfold nodeBlock; rw [if_pos h20]
    rw [blocksOf_tree_lo pub w _ (show 4 ≤ nodeBlock l by omega) (show nodeBlock l ≤ 24 by omega)]
    have e : (⟨(⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ : Fin 57).val - 4, by
        show nodeBlock l - 4 < 24; omega⟩ : Fin 24) = l :=
      Fin.ext (show nodeBlock l - 4 = l.val by omega)
    rw [e, show (⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ : Fin 57).val - 4 = l.val from
      (show nodeBlock l - 4 = l.val by omega)]
  · have hv : nodeBlock l = 33 + l.val := by unfold nodeBlock; rw [if_neg h20]
    rw [blocksOf_tree_hi pub w _ (show 54 ≤ nodeBlock l by omega)]
    have e : (⟨(⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ : Fin 57).val - 33, by
        show nodeBlock l - 33 < 24; omega⟩ : Fin 24) = l :=
      Fin.ext (show nodeBlock l - 33 = l.val by omega)
    rw [e, show (⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ : Fin 57).val - 33 = l.val from
      (show nodeBlock l - 33 = l.val by omega)]

theorem prevBlock_digest (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (l : Fin 24) :
    blockDigest (blocksOf pub w ⟨prevBlock l, prevBlock_lt l⟩) =
      treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  by_cases h0 : l.val = 0
  · have e : (⟨prevBlock l, prevBlock_lt l⟩ : Fin 57) = 3 :=
      Fin.ext (by show prevBlock l = 3; unfold prevBlock; rw [if_pos h0])
    rw [e, h0, treeCur.eq_1]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, l.val = k + 1 := ⟨l.val - 1, by omega⟩
    have e : (⟨prevBlock l, prevBlock_lt l⟩ : Fin 57) = ⟨nodeBlock ⟨k, by omega⟩, nodeBlock_lt _⟩ :=
      Fin.ext (by
        show prevBlock l = nodeBlock ⟨k, _⟩
        unfold prevBlock nodeBlock
        rw [if_neg h0]
        split <;> split <;> simp only [] at * <;> omega)
    rw [e, blocksOf_node', hk, treeCur_succ w _ k (by omega)]

/-! ### Path kinds (72 links) -/

theorem pathBase_aux (C : Cells K) (l : Fin 24) (c : Fin 16) :
    auxCell C (pathBase l) c = pathBaseCell (C.path l) c := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  unfold auxCell
  rw [dif_pos (show 912 ≤ pathBase l ∧ pathBase l < 1008 by unfold pathBase; omega),
    if_pos (show pathBase l % 16 % 4 = 1 by unfold pathBase; omega)]
  exact congrArg (fun p : Fin 24 => pathBaseCell (C.path p) c)
    (Fin.ext (show 4 * ((pathBase l - 912) / 16) + pathBase l % 16 / 4 = l.val by
      unfold pathBase; omega))

theorem pathSucc_aux (C : Cells K) (l : Fin 24) (c : Fin 16) :
    auxCell C (pathBase l + 1) c = pathSuccCell (C.path l) c := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  unfold auxCell
  rw [dif_pos (show 912 ≤ pathBase l + 1 ∧ pathBase l + 1 < 1008 by unfold pathBase; omega),
    if_neg (show ¬ ((pathBase l + 1) % 16 % 4 = 1) by unfold pathBase; omega),
    if_pos (show (pathBase l + 1) % 16 % 4 = 2 by unfold pathBase; omega)]
  exact congrArg (fun p : Fin 24 => pathSuccCell (C.path p) c)
    (Fin.ext (show 4 * ((pathBase l + 1 - 912) / 16) + (pathBase l + 1) % 16 / 4 = l.val by
      unfold pathBase; omega))

section model
variable (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)

/-- Path current: digest of the previous block = path base row columns 1..8. -/
theorem pathCur_cell (l : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8) :
    buildModel pub w (i.castAdd 21) ⟨16 * prevBlock l + 11, by have := prevBlock_lt l; omega⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨1 + i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨pathBase l, by have := pathBase_lt l; omega⟩ := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ ⟨prevBlock l, prevBlock_lt l⟩ _ rfl i,
    cell_aux _ _ (by simp only []; omega) _ (by show 57 ≤ pathBase l / 16; unfold pathBase; omega)]
  show blockDigest (blocksOf pub w _) i = auxCell _ (pathBase l) _
  rw [pathBase_aux, prevBlock_digest, pathBaseCell_cur _ _ i (by simp only []; omega)]
  rfl

/-- Path left: successor row columns 0..7 = node block row 12 (absorbed left). -/
theorem pathLeft_cell (l : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8) :
    buildModel pub w ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨pathBase l + 1, pathBase_lt l⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * nodeBlock l + 12, by have := nodeBlock_lt l; omega⟩ := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by simp only []; omega) _
      (by show 57 ≤ (pathBase l + 1) / 16; unfold pathBase; omega),
    cell_block _ _ (by simp only []; omega) ⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ 12 (by decide) _ rfl]
  show auxCell _ (pathBase l + 1) _ = blockCell (blocksOf pub w _) 12 _
  rw [pathSucc_aux, blocksOf_node', blockCell_12, pathSuccCell_left _ _ i rfl]
  exact (nodeIn_absorb _ _ i).symm

/-- Path right, lanes 0..6: successor columns 8..14 = node pre-state lanes 8..14. -/
theorem pathRight_cell (l : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8) (hi : i.val < 7) :
    buildModel pub w ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨pathBase l + 1, pathBase_lt l⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * nodeBlock l, by have := nodeBlock_lt l; omega⟩ := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by simp only []; omega) _
      (by show 57 ≤ (pathBase l + 1) / 16; unfold pathBase; omega),
    cell_block _ _ (by simp only []; omega) ⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ 0 (by decide) _ (by simp)]
  show auxCell _ (pathBase l + 1) _ = blockCell (blocksOf pub w _) 0 _
  rw [pathSucc_aux, blocksOf_node', blockCell_pre, pathSuccCell_right _ _ i rfl]
  exact (nodeIn_pre_lt7 _ _ i hi).symm

/-- Path right, lane 7: the node pre-state carries the tweak, removed by the
consumer offset 1051521018 = p − 0x41531005. -/
theorem pathRight7_cell [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (l : Fin 24) :
    buildModel pub w 15 ⟨pathBase l + 1, pathBase_lt l⟩ =
      buildModel pub w 15 ⟨16 * nodeBlock l, by have := nodeBlock_lt l; omega⟩ +
        ((1051521018 : Nat) : K) := by
  have hl := l.isLt
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _
      (by show 57 ≤ (pathBase l + 1) / 16; unfold pathBase; omega),
    cell_block _ _ (by decide) ⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ 0 (by decide) _ (by simp)]
  show auxCell _ (pathBase l + 1) 15 = blockCell (blocksOf pub w _) 0 15 + _
  rw [pathSucc_aux, blocksOf_node', blockCell_pre, pathSuccCell_right _ _ 7 rfl]
  unfold treeNode
  rw [nodeIn_pre_15, tweak_cancel]
  rfl

/-! ### Append kinds (40 links) -/

theorem app_digest (j : Nat) (hj : j < 20) :
    blockDigest (blocksOf pub w ⟨33 + j, by omega⟩) = appCur pub (outPair pub w) j :=
  blocksOf_carry pub w j hj

/-- Append, bit 0: block 33+j's digest is the left child absorbed by block 34+j. -/
theorem appLeft_cell (j : Nat) (hj : j < 20) (hb : appBit pub j = false) (i : Fin 8) :
    buildModel pub w (i.castAdd 21) ⟨16 * (33 + j) + 11, by omega⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * (34 + j) + 12, by omega⟩ := by
  rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ ⟨33 + j, by omega⟩ _ rfl i,
    cell_block _ _ (by simp only []; omega) ⟨34 + j, by omega⟩ 12 (by decide) _ rfl]
  show blockDigest (blocksOf pub w _) i = blockCell (blocksOf pub w _) 12 _
  rw [app_digest pub w j hj, blockCell_12, blocksOf_app' pub w _ j rfl hj]
  unfold appNode
  rw [nodeIn_absorb]
  simp only [ordered, hb, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

/-- Append, bit 1, lanes 0..6: block 33+j's digest is the right child. -/
theorem appRight_cell (j : Nat) (hj : j < 20) (hb : appBit pub j = true) (i : Fin 8)
    (hi : i.val < 7) :
    buildModel pub w (i.castAdd 21) ⟨16 * (33 + j) + 11, by omega⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * (34 + j), by omega⟩ := by
  rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ ⟨33 + j, by omega⟩ _ rfl i,
    cell_block _ _ (by simp only []; omega) ⟨34 + j, by omega⟩ 0 (by decide) _ (by simp)]
  show blockDigest (blocksOf pub w _) i = blockCell (blocksOf pub w _) 0 _
  rw [app_digest pub w j hj, blockCell_pre, blocksOf_app' pub w _ j rfl hj]
  unfold appNode
  rw [nodeIn_pre_lt7 _ _ i hi]
  simp only [ordered, hb, if_true]

/-- Append, bit 1, lane 7 (tweak removed by the consumer offset). -/
theorem appRight7_cell [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (j : Nat) (hj : j < 20) (hb : appBit pub j = true) :
    buildModel pub w ((7 : Fin 8).castAdd 21) ⟨16 * (33 + j) + 11, by omega⟩ =
      buildModel pub w 15 ⟨16 * (34 + j), by omega⟩ + ((1051521018 : Nat) : K) := by
  rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ ⟨33 + j, by omega⟩ _ rfl 7,
    cell_block _ _ (by decide) ⟨34 + j, by omega⟩ 0 (by decide) _ (by simp)]
  show blockDigest (blocksOf pub w _) 7 = blockCell (blocksOf pub w _) 0 15 + _
  rw [app_digest pub w j hj, blockCell_pre, blocksOf_app' pub w _ j rfl hj]
  unfold appNode
  rw [nodeIn_pre_15, tweak_cancel]
  simp only [ordered, hb, if_true]

end model

import R0Z.BuilderModelCopyKinds

/-! The 24 one-off copy links of the builder model (sponge chaining, digest
reuse, shared absorptions, value/positivity cells, occupancy cells), each as a
named cell lemma.  The only witness premise is `pairRight` (the input pair
leaf's second commitment is the right child of block 4, i.e. the path-0
sibling and bit are the pair's other commitment and selected side). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem blockCell_out (b : BlockIn K) (c : Fin 16) : blockCell b 11 c = blockOut b c := rfl

theorem lo8_lt (d : Digest K) (i : Fin 8) : lo8 d ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = d i := by
  unfold lo8; rw [dif_pos i.isLt]

section model
variable (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)

/-! ### Block-role facts (small structural equalities) -/

theorem pre_2 : (blocksOf pub w 2).pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w 1) := rfl
theorem pre_3 : (blocksOf pub w 3).pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w 2) := rfl
theorem pre_26 : (blocksOf pub w 26).pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w 25) := rfl
theorem pre_31 : (blocksOf pub w 31).pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w 30) := rfl
theorem pre_32 : (blocksOf pub w 32).pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w 31) := rfl

theorem pre_28 (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    (blocksOf pub w 28).pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w 27) := by
  show (recipB pub w 1).pre = blockOut (recipB pub w 0)
  unfold recipB; rw [hv]; rfl

theorem pre_29 (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    (blocksOf pub w 29).pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w 28) := by
  show (recipB pub w 2).pre = blockOut (recipB pub w 1)
  unfold recipB; rw [hv]; rfl

theorem ab_1 (i : Fin 8) :
    (blocksOf pub w 1).absorb ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = blockDigest (blocksOf pub w 0) i :=
  lo8_lt _ i

theorem ab_33pt (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (i : Fin 8) :
    (blocksOf pub w 33).absorb ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = blockDigest (blocksOf pub w 29) i := by
  show (outPairB pub w).absorb _ = blockDigest (recipB pub w 2) i
  unfold outPairB; rw [hv]
  exact lo8_lt _ i

theorem ab_33wd (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) (i : Fin 8) :
    (blocksOf pub w 33).absorb ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = blockDigest (blocksOf pub w 32) i := by
  show (outPairB pub w).absorb _ = _
  unfold outPairB; rw [hv]
  exact lo8_lt _ i

theorem e480 (i : Fin 8) :
    (blocksOf pub w 0).absorb ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = (blocksOf pub w 25).absorb ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ := rfl

theorem e481 (j : Fin 6) :
    (blocksOf pub w 2).absorb ⟨2 + j.val, by omega⟩ = (blocksOf pub w 26).absorb ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ := by
  show noteC2 _ _ w.salt ⟨2 + j.val, _⟩ = lo8 w.salt ⟨j.val, _⟩
  unfold noteC2 lo8
  rw [if_neg (by simp), if_neg (by simp; omega), dif_pos (by simp; omega), dif_pos (by simp; omega)]
  exact congrArg w.salt (Fin.ext (by simp))

theorem e482 (j : Fin 2) :
    (blocksOf pub w 3).absorb ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ = (blocksOf pub w 26).absorb ⟨6 + j.val, by omega⟩ := by
  show noteC3 w.salt ⟨j.val, _⟩ = lo8 w.salt ⟨6 + j.val, _⟩
  unfold noteC3 lo8
  rw [dif_pos (by simp; omega)]
  fin_cases j
  · rfl
  · rfl

attribute [local irreducible] blockOut blockIter blockDigest treeCur appCur

/-! ### Cell kinds -/

theorem chain_cell (h h' : Fin 57) (hpre : (blocksOf pub w h').pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w h))
    (c : Fin 16) :
    buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + 11, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h'.val + 0, by have := h'.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_block _ _ c.isLt h 11 (by decide) _ rfl,
    cell_block _ _ c.isLt h' 0 (by decide) _ rfl]
  show blockCell (blocksOf pub w h) 11 c = blockCell (blocksOf pub w h') 0 c
  rw [blockCell_out, blockCell_pre, hpre]

theorem da_cell (h h' : Fin 57)
    (hab : ∀ i : Fin 8, (blocksOf pub w h').absorb ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = blockDigest (blocksOf pub w h) i)
    (i : Fin 8) :
    buildModel pub w (i.castAdd 21) ⟨16 * h.val + 11, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h'.val + 12, by have := h'.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ h _ rfl i,
    cell_block _ _ (by simp only []; omega) h' 12 (by decide) _ rfl]
  show blockDigest (blocksOf pub w h) i = blockCell (blocksOf pub w h') 12 _
  rw [blockCell_12, hab]

theorem aa_cell (h h' : Fin 57) (c c' : Fin 16)
    (e : (blocksOf pub w h).absorb c = (blocksOf pub w h').absorb c') :
    buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + 12, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ =
      buildModel pub w ⟨c'.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h'.val + 12, by have := h'.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_block _ _ c.isLt h 12 (by decide) _ rfl,
    cell_block _ _ c'.isLt h' 12 (by decide) _ rfl]
  show blockCell (blocksOf pub w h) 12 c = blockCell (blocksOf pub w h') 12 c'
  rw [blockCell_12, blockCell_12, e]

/-! ### Value and positivity cells -/

theorem v483 : buildModel pub w 0 44 = buildModel pub w 10 1008 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_block _ _ (by decide) 2 12 (by decide) _ rfl,
    cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show (blocksOf pub w 2).absorb 0 = auxCell _ 1008 10
  rw [aux_1008]
  rfl

theorem v484 (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    buildModel pub w 0 460 = buildModel pub w 10 1010 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_block _ _ (by decide) 28 12 (by decide) _ rfl,
    cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show (recipB pub w 1).absorb 0 = auxCell _ 1010 10
  rw [aux_1010]
  unfold recipB; rw [hv]
  rfl

theorem v485 : buildModel pub w 0 508 = buildModel pub w 10 1012 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_block _ _ (by decide) 31 12 (by decide) _ rfl,
    cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show (blocksOf pub w 31).absorb 0 = auxCell _ 1012 10
  rw [aux_1012]
  rfl

theorem aux_1014 (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 16) : auxCell C 1014 c =
    (if c.val = 0 then (C.values 0 : K) else if c.val = 1 then (C.values 1 : K)
      else if c.val = 2 then (C.values 0 : K) - (C.values 1 : K) else 0) := by
  simp [auxCell]

theorem aux_1015 (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 16) : auxCell C 1015 c =
    (if c.val = 0 then (C.values 0 : K) - (C.values 1 : K)
      else if c.val = 1 then (C.values 2 : K) else 0) := by
  simp [auxCell]

theorem p486 : buildModel pub w 10 1008 = buildModel pub w 0 1014 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide), cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show auxCell _ 1008 10 = auxCell _ 1014 0
  rw [aux_1008, aux_1014]
  rfl

theorem p487 : buildModel pub w 10 1010 = buildModel pub w 1 1014 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide), cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show auxCell _ 1010 10 = auxCell _ 1014 1
  rw [aux_1010, aux_1014]
  rfl

theorem p488 : buildModel pub w 10 1012 = buildModel pub w 1 1015 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide), cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show auxCell _ 1012 10 = auxCell _ 1015 1
  rw [aux_1012, aux_1015]
  rfl

theorem p489 : buildModel pub w 2 1014 = buildModel pub w 0 1015 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide), cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show auxCell _ 1014 2 = auxCell _ 1015 0
  rw [aux_1014, aux_1015]
  rfl

/-! ### Occupancy cells -/

/-- Witness premise for link 1124073490: the input pair's second commitment
is the right child of the pair node (block 4). -/
def PairRight : Prop := w.pairSecond = (ordered (inputLeaf pub w) (w.path 0).2 (w.path 0).1).2

theorem block4 : blocksOf pub w 4 =
    nodeIn (ordered (inputLeaf pub w) (w.path 0).2 (w.path 0).1).1
      (ordered (inputLeaf pub w) (w.path 0).2 (w.path 0).1).2 := by
  show treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) 0) 0 = _
  rw [treeCur.eq_1]
  rfl

theorem o490 (hR : PairRight pub w) (j : Fin 8) (hj : j.val < 7) :
    buildModel pub w ⟨8 + j.val, by omega⟩ 64 = buildModel pub w ⟨2 + j.val, by omega⟩ 1017 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_block _ _ (by simp only []; omega) 4 0 (by decide) _ rfl,
    cell_aux _ _ (by simp only []; omega) _ (by decide)]
  show blockCell (blocksOf pub w 4) 0 _ = auxCell _ 1017 _
  rw [blockCell_pre, block4, aux_1017, nodeIn_pre_lt7 _ _ j hj, occCell_lane _ j]
  show _ = w.pairSecond j
  rw [hR]

theorem o490_7 [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (hR : PairRight pub w) :
    buildModel pub w 15 64 + ((1051521018 : Nat) : K) = buildModel pub w 9 1017 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_block _ _ (by decide) 4 0 (by decide) _ rfl,
    cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show blockCell (blocksOf pub w 4) 0 15 + _ = auxCell _ 1017 9
  rw [blockCell_pre, block4, aux_1017, nodeIn_pre_15, tweak_cancel,
    show occCell (cellsOf pub w).inOcc 9 = (cellsOf pub w).inOcc.commitment 7 from
      occCell_lane _ 7 (by decide)]
  show _ = w.pairSecond 7
  rw [hR]

theorem o491 : buildModel pub w 0 913 = buildModel pub w 10 1017 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide), cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide)]
  show auxCell _ (pathBase 0) 0 = auxCell _ 1017 10
  rw [pathBase_aux, aux_1017]
  rfl

theorem o492 (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (j : Fin 8) :
    buildModel pub w (j.castAdd 21) 523 = buildModel pub w ⟨2 + j.val, by omega⟩ 1018 := by
  rw [buildModel, digest_cell _ 32 523 rfl j, cell_aux _ _ (by simp only []; omega) _ (by decide)]
  show blockDigest (blocksOf pub w 32) j = auxCell _ 1018 _
  rw [aux_1018, occCell_lane _ j]
  show _ = (outOccOf pub w).commitment j
  unfold outOccOf; rw [hv]
  rfl

theorem o495 (j : Fin 8) (hj : j.val < 7) :
    buildModel pub w ⟨2 + j.val, by omega⟩ 1018 = buildModel pub w ⟨8 + j.val, by omega⟩ 528 := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by simp only []; omega) _ (by decide),
    cell_block _ _ (by simp only []; omega) 33 0 (by decide) _ rfl]
  show auxCell _ 1018 _ = blockCell (outPairB pub w) 0 _
  rw [aux_1018, occCell_lane _ j, blockCell_pre]
  show (outOccOf pub w).commitment j = _
  unfold outOccOf outPairB
  cases pub.variant
  · exact (nodeIn_pre_lt7 _ _ j hj).symm
  · exact (nodeIn_pre_lt7 _ _ j hj).symm

theorem o495_7 [CharP K 0x7fffffff] :
    buildModel pub w 9 1018 = buildModel pub w 15 528 + ((1051521018 : Nat) : K) := by
  rw [buildModel, cell_aux _ _ (by decide) _ (by decide),
    cell_block _ _ (by decide) 33 0 (by decide) _ rfl]
  show auxCell _ 1018 9 = blockCell (outPairB pub w) 0 15 + _
  rw [aux_1018, show occCell (cellsOf pub w).outOcc 9 = (cellsOf pub w).outOcc.commitment 7 from
      occCell_lane _ 7 (by decide), blockCell_pre]
  show (outOccOf pub w).commitment 7 = _
  unfold outOccOf outPairB
  cases pub.variant
  · rw [nodeIn_pre_15, tweak_cancel]
  · rw [nodeIn_pre_15, tweak_cancel]

end model
