import R0Z.SpongeRefine

/-! The extracted sponge writer equals the model's sponge blocks
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §10), relative to the Poseidon plug-in RoundsOk. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem usub (x y : Usize) (h : y.val ≤ x.val) : (Usize.wrapping_sub x y).val = x.val - y.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have hx := x.hSize
  have hs := usize_size_ge
  rw [show x.val + (UScalar.size .Usize - y.val) = (x.val - y.val) + UScalar.size .Usize by omega,
    Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The number of words the sponge absorbs in permutation q. -/
def clenOf (len q : Nat) : Nat := if len - 8 * q < 8 then len - 8 * q else 8

/-- The sponge's model premises: chunk absorptions, chaining, and rounds. -/
structure SpongeLifts (input : Array U32 24#usize) (len : Nat)
    (rounds : Array (Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) 3#usize)
    (B : Nat → R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) : Prop where
  absorb : ∀ q, q < (len + 7) / 8 → ∀ i : Fin 16, (B q).absorb i =
    (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clenOf len q then liftU (K := K) (input.val[8 * q + i.val]!) else 0)
  chain : ∀ q, q + 1 < (len + 7) / 8 → (B (q + 1)).pre = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockOut (B q)
  rounds : ∀ q, q < (len + 7) / 8 → RoundsOk (rounds.val[q]!) (B q)

theorem sponge_loop_model (input : Array U32 24#usize) (len : Usize) (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 24)
    (rounds : Array (Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) 3#usize) (perms : Usize)
    (hperms : perms.val = (len.val + 7) / 8) (B : Nat → R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K)
    (hS : SpongeLifts input len.val rounds B) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Usize) (out : Array U32 768#usize) (state : Array U32 16#usize),
      p.val + n = perms.val →
      (p.val < perms.val → ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (state.val[i.val]!) = (B p.val).pre i) →
      ∃ out', R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_loop input len rounds out state perms p = ok out' ∧
        (∀ q, p.val ≤ q → q < perms.val → ∀ (l c : Fin 16),
          liftU (K := K) (out'.val[q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val)]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockCell (B q) l.val c) ∧
        (∀ k, ¬ (p.val * 256 ≤ k ∧ k < perms.val * 256) → out'.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, p, out, state, h, _ => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun q h1 h2 => by omega, fun k _ => rfl⟩
      rw [R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; omega)]
  | n + 1, p, out, state, h, hst => by
      have hpp : p.val < perms.val := by omega
      have hp3 : p.val < 3 := by omega
      have hlt : p < perms := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; exact hpp
      have h8p : (Usize.wrapping_mul 8#usize p).val = 8 * p.val := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp
      have h8lt : 8 * p.val < len.val := by omega
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub len (Usize.wrapping_mul 8#usize p)).val = len.val - 8 * p.val := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [h8p]; omega), h8p]
      have hp1 : (Usize.wrapping_add p 1#usize).val = p.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨chunk, hch, hchs⟩ := sponge_chunk_spec input p hp3
      -- the clen value and the rest of the step, for either branch
      have step : ∀ clen : Usize, clen.val = clenOf len.val p.val →
          ∃ out', (do
            let a ← Array.index_usize rounds p
            let block ← R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_block state chunk clen a
            let out1 ← R0BlockCopies.place_block out p block
            let state1 ← Array.index_usize a 10#usize
            let p1 ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add p 1#usize)
            R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_loop input len rounds out1 state1 perms p1) = ok out' ∧
          (∀ q, p.val ≤ q → q < perms.val → ∀ (l c : Fin 16),
            liftU (K := K) (out'.val[q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val)]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockCell (B q) l.val c) ∧
          (∀ k, ¬ (p.val * 256 ≤ k ∧ k < perms.val * 256) → out'.val[k]! = out.val[k]!) := by
        intro clen hclen
        obtain ⟨ab, hab, habs⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec chunk clen
        have he : EndsLift state ab (B p.val) := by
          refine ⟨hst hpp, fun i => ?_⟩
          rw [hS.absorb p.val (by omega) i, habs, hclen]
          by_cases c : i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clenOf len.val p.val
          · rw [if_pos c, if_pos c, hchs i.val c.1]
          · rw [if_neg c, if_neg c]; unfold liftU; simp
        have hrp : p.val < (3#usize).val := by simp; omega
        obtain ⟨blk, hblk, hbs⟩ := block_model state ab (rounds.val[p.val]!) (B p.val) he
          (hS.rounds p.val (by omega))
        obtain ⟨o1, ho1, ho1s⟩ := place_loop_spec p hp3 blk 256 0#usize out (by simp)
        have h10 : (10#usize : Usize).val < (11#usize).val := by simp
        have hst' : p.val + 1 < perms.val → ∀ i : Fin 16,
            liftU (K := K) (((rounds.val[p.val]!).val[(10#usize : Usize).val]!).val[i.val]!) =
              (B (p.val + 1)).pre i := by
          intro hq i
          rw [hS.chain p.val (by omega), show (10#usize : Usize).val = 10 by simp]
          exact hS.rounds p.val (by omega) 10 i (by norm_num)
        obtain ⟨out', ho', hcells, hrest⟩ := sponge_loop_model input len hlen rounds perms hperms B hS n
          (Usize.wrapping_add p 1#usize) o1 ((rounds.val[p.val]!).val[(10#usize : Usize).val]!)
          (by rw [hp1]; omega) (by rw [hp1]; exact hst')
        refine ⟨out', ?_, fun q h1 h2 l c => ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩
        · rw [index_ok_gen rounds p hrp]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_block, hab]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [hblk]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [R0BlockCopies.place_block, ho1]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [index_ok_gen (rounds.val[p.val]!) 10#usize h10]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
          exact ho'
        · by_cases e : q = p.val
          · have z0 : (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 := by simp
            rw [hrest _ (by rw [hp1]; omega), ho1s, if_pos (show p.val * 256 + (0#usize : Usize).val ≤
              q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val) ∧ q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val) < p.val * 256 + 256 by
                rw [z0]; omega), e]
            rw [show p.val * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val) - p.val * 256 = l.val * 16 + c.val by omega]
            exact hbs l c
          · exact hcells q (by rw [hp1]; omega) h2 l c
        · have z0 : (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 := by simp
          have hk1 : ¬ ((p.val + 1) * 256 ≤ k ∧ k < perms.val * 256) := fun h' => hk ⟨by omega, h'.2⟩
          have hk2 : ¬ (p.val * 256 + 0 ≤ k ∧ k < p.val * 256 + 256) := fun h' => hk ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
          rw [hrest k (by rw [hp1]; exact hk1), ho1s, z0, if_neg hk2]
      rw [R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_loop, if_pos hlt, hch]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
      by_cases c8 : Usize.wrapping_sub len (Usize.wrapping_mul 8#usize p) < 8#usize
      · rw [if_pos c8]
        have c8' : len.val - 8 * p.val < 8 := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv, hsub] at c8; simpa using c8
        exact step _ (by rw [hsub]; unfold clenOf; rw [if_pos c8'])
      · rw [if_neg c8]
        have c8' : ¬ len.val - 8 * p.val < 8 := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv, hsub] at c8; simpa using c8
        exact step _ (by simp only [clenOf, if_neg c8']; simp)

theorem rep768 (k : Nat) : (((Array.repeat 768#usize 0#u32 : Array U32 768#usize).val[k]! : U32)) = 0#u32 := by
  rw [Array.repeat_val]
  by_cases hk : k < (768#usize : Usize).val
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_pos hk]; rfl
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_neg hk]; rfl

/-- The extracted write_sponge equals the model's sponge blocks, every cell,
given the initial pre-state, the chunk absorptions, the chaining and RoundsOk;
blocks beyond ceil(len/8) are zero. -/
theorem sponge_model (domain : U32) (input : Array U32 24#usize) (len : Usize)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 24) (rounds : Array (Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) 3#usize)
    (B : Nat → R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) (hS : SpongeLifts input len.val rounds B)
    (h0 : ∀ i : Fin 16, (B 0).pre i =
      if i.val = 8 then liftU (K := K) domain else if i.val = 9 then (len.val : K) else 0) :
    ∃ out, R0BlockCopies.write_sponge domain input len rounds = ok out ∧
      (∀ q, q < (len.val + 7) / 8 → ∀ (l c : Fin 16),
        liftU (K := K) (out.val[q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val)]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockCell (B q) l.val c) ∧
      (∀ k, (len.val + 7) / 8 * 256 ≤ k → out.val[k]! = 0#u32) := by
  have hcast : (UScalar.cast .U32 len).val = len.val := by
    rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]; omega)
  obtain ⟨st, hst, hsts⟩ := sponge_init_spec domain (UScalar.cast .U32 len)
  have h7 : (Usize.wrapping_add len 7#usize).val = len.val + 7 := by rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)]; simp
  obtain ⟨perms, hp, hpv⟩ := UScalar.div_spec (Usize.wrapping_add len 7#usize) (y := 8#usize) (by simp)
  have hpv' : perms.val = (len.val + 7) / 8 := by rw [hpv, h7]; simp
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hcells, hrest⟩ := sponge_loop_model input len hlen rounds perms hpv' B hS ((len.val + 7) / 8)
    0#usize (Array.repeat 768#usize 0#u32) st (by simp; omega) (fun _ i => by
      rw [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, h0 i, hsts]
      unfold liftU
      by_cases e8 : i.val = 8
      · rw [if_pos e8, if_pos e8]
      · rw [if_neg e8, if_neg e8]
        by_cases e9 : i.val = 9
        · rw [if_pos e9, if_pos e9, hcast]
        · rw [if_neg e9, if_neg e9]; simp)
  refine ⟨out, ?_, fun q hq l c => hcells q (by simp) (by rw [hpv']; exact hq) l c, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  · rw [R0BlockCopies.write_sponge]
    simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hst]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [show (Usize.wrapping_add len 7#usize) / 8#usize = ok perms from hp]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact ho
  · rw [hrest k (by rw [hpv']; simp; omega), rep768]

#print axioms usub
#print axioms sponge_loop_model
#print axioms sponge_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine

R0Z.NoteSpongeModel.text:
import R0Z.SpongeModel

/-! The extracted sponge writer on the note input (owner ‖ value ‖ asset ‖ salt,
note_input pair_trace.rs:227-234, domain 0x41530003, 18 words) produces
exactly the model's note blocks noteB0/noteB1/noteB2 (blocks 1..3, 27..29,
30..32 of buildModel), relative to RoundsOk for each permutation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The note sponge's model blocks. -/
def noteBlocks (o : R0P.Digest K) (v a : K) (s : R0P.Digest K) : Nat → BlockIn K :=
  fun q => if q = 0 then noteB0 o else if q = 1 then noteB1 o v a s else noteB2 o v a s

/-- The 18 note words lift to (owner, value, asset, salt). -/
structure NoteInputLift (input : Array U32 24#usize) (o : R0P.Digest K) (v a : K) (s : R0P.Digest K) : Prop where
  owner : ∀ i : Fin 8, liftU (K := K) (input.val[i.val]!) = o i
  value : liftU (K := K) (input.val[8]!) = v
  asset : liftU (K := K) (input.val[9]!) = a
  salt : ∀ i : Fin 8, liftU (K := K) (input.val[10 + i.val]!) = s i

theorem note_sponge_model (domain : U32) (hd : domain.val = 0x41530003) (input : Array U32 24#usize)
    (len : Usize) (hl : len.val = 18) (rounds : Array (Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) 3#usize)
    (o : R0P.Digest K) (v a : K) (s : R0P.Digest K) (hin : NoteInputLift input o v a s)
    (hr : ∀ q, q < 3 → RoundsOk (rounds.val[q]!) (noteBlocks o v a s q)) :
    ∃ out, R0BlockCopies.write_sponge domain input len rounds = ok out ∧
      ∀ q, q < 3 → ∀ (l c : Fin 16),
        liftU (K := K) (out.val[q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val)]!) = blockCell (noteBlocks o v a s q) l.val c := by
  have hperm : (len.val + 7) / 8 = 3 := by rw [hl]
  have hS : SpongeLifts input len.val rounds (noteBlocks o v a s) := by
    refine ⟨fun q hq i => ?_, fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => hr q (by omega)⟩
    · rw [hperm] at hq
      have hi := i.isLt
      rw [hl]
      have c0 : clenOf 18 0 = 8 := by decide
      have c1 : clenOf 18 1 = 8 := by decide
      have c2 : clenOf 18 2 = 2 := by decide
      interval_cases q
      · show lo8 o i = _
        unfold lo8
        rw [c0, show 8 * 0 + i.val = i.val by omega]
        by_cases h8 : i.val < 8
        · rw [dif_pos h8, if_pos ⟨h8, h8⟩]; exact (hin.owner ⟨i.val, h8⟩).symm
        · rw [dif_neg h8, if_neg (fun h => h8 h.1)]
      · show noteC2 v a s i = _
        unfold noteC2
        rw [c1]
        by_cases e0 : i.val = 0
        · rw [if_pos e0, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e0]; exact hin.value.symm
        rw [if_neg e0]
        by_cases e1 : i.val = 1
        · rw [if_pos e1, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e1]; exact hin.asset.symm
        rw [if_neg e1]
        by_cases h8 : i.val < 8
        · rw [dif_pos h8, if_pos ⟨h8, by omega⟩, show 8 * 1 + i.val = 10 + (i.val - 2) by omega]
          exact (hin.salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩).symm
        · rw [dif_neg h8, if_neg (fun h => h8 h.1)]
      · show noteC3 s i = _
        unfold noteC3
        rw [c2]
        by_cases e0 : i.val = 0
        · rw [if_pos e0, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e0]; exact (hin.salt 6).symm
        rw [if_neg e0]
        by_cases e1 : i.val = 1
        · rw [if_pos e1, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e1]; exact (hin.salt 7).symm
        rw [if_neg e1, if_neg (by omega)]
    · rw [hperm] at hq
      have hq2 : q < 2 := by omega
      interval_cases q <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hcells, _⟩ := sponge_model domain input len (by omega) rounds (noteBlocks o v a s) hS
    (fun i => by
      show spongeInit 0x4153_0003 18 i = _
      unfold spongeInit liftU
      rw [hd, hl]
      by_cases e8 : i.val = 8
      · rw [if_pos e8, if_pos e8]; norm_num
      · rw [if_neg e8, if_neg e8]
        by_cases e9 : i.val = 9
        · rw [if_pos e9, if_pos e9]; norm_num
        · rw [if_neg e9, if_neg e9])
  exact ⟨out, ho, fun q hq => hcells q (by omega)⟩

#print axioms note_sponge_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine

R0Z.BuilderBlocksModel.text:
import R0Z.NoteSpongeModel
import R0Z.BuilderModelCopyMisc

/-! Every writer-produced Poseidon block of the Rust builder equals the
corresponding buildModel block (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.0).

`RustWriter v R h` is the copy writer that produces block h (write_node for
the 45 node blocks 4..24, 33..56; write_block of zeros for a withdrawal's
blocks 27..29; write_sponge_block for the sponge blocks).  `builder_blocks_model`:
under `BuilderLifts` — RoundsOk for every block (the Poseidon plug-in), the
node children's lifts, and the sponge pre-states / absorptions' lifts — every
cell of every block equals `buildModel pub w` at row 16h+l.  The discharge
lemmas below reduce the sponge pre-state premise to the Rust sponge chaining
(`spre (h+1) = rounds h [10]`, what production does, covered by the
differential test) and to sponge_init, and instantiate the node/absorption
premises for the tree, append and output-pair nodes and the owner and
nullifier sponges. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def NodeKind (h : Nat) : Prop := (4 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 24) ∨ (33 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56)
def ZeroKind (v : R0P.Variant) (h : Nat) : Prop := v = .withdrawal ∧ 27 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 29

instance (h : Nat) : Decidable (NodeKind h) := by unfold NodeKind; infer_instance
instance (v : R0P.Variant) (h : Nat) : Decidable (ZeroKind v h) := by unfold ZeroKind; infer_instance

/-- The Rust inputs of every block (all lifts are premises, see BuilderLifts). -/
structure RustBlocks where
  left : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  right : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  spre : Nat → Array U32 16#usize
  schunk : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  sclen : Nat → Usize
  rounds : Nat → Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize

def zero16 : Array U32 16#usize := Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32

/-- The copy writer that produces block h. -/
def RustWriter (v : R0P.Variant) (R : RustBlocks) (h : Nat) : Result (Array U32 256#usize) :=
  if NodeKind h then R0BlockCopies.write_node (R.left h) (R.right h) (R.rounds h)
  else if ZeroKind v h then R0BlockCopies.write_block zero16 zero16 (R.rounds h)
  else R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_block (R.spre h) (R.schunk h) (R.sclen h) (R.rounds h)

structure BuilderLifts (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks) : Prop where
  rounds : ∀ h : Fin 57, RoundsOk (R.rounds h.val) (blocksOf pub w h)
  node : ∀ h : Fin 57, NodeKind h.val → ∃ L Rr : R0P.Digest K, blocksOf pub w h = nodeIn L Rr ∧
    DigestLift (R.left h.val) L ∧ DigestLift (R.right h.val) Rr ∧
    ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right h.val).val[i]!).val < 2147483647
  spre : ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) ((R.spre h.val).val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w h).pre i
  sabs : ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w h).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val then liftU (K := K) ((R.schunk h.val).val[i.val]!) else 0)

theorem builder_blocks_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks)
    (hL : BuilderLifts pub w R) (h : Fin 57) :
    ∃ b, RustWriter pub.variant R h.val = ok b ∧ ∀ l c : Fin 16,
      liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  have cellEq : ∀ (b : Array U32 256#usize),
      (∀ l c : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) = blockCell (blocksOf pub w h) l.val c) →
      ∀ l c : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
    intro b hb l c
    rw [hb l c, buildModel, cell_block _ _ c.isLt h l.val l.isLt _ rfl]
    rfl
  unfold RustWriter
  by_cases hn : NodeKind h.val
  · rw [if_pos hn]
    obtain ⟨L, Rr, he, hl, hr, hc⟩ := hL.node h hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := node_model (R.left h.val) (R.right h.val) (R.rounds h.val) L Rr hl hr hc
      (he ▸ hL.rounds h)
    exact ⟨b, hb, cellEq b (by rw [he]; exact hs)⟩
  rw [if_neg hn]
  by_cases hz : ZeroKind pub.variant h.val
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    obtain ⟨hv, h1, h2⟩ := hz
    have hzero : blocksOf pub w h = ⟨0, 0⟩ := by
      rw [blocksOf_recip pub w h h1 h2, recipB_wd pub w _ hv]
    have he : EndsLift zero16 zero16 (blocksOf pub w h) := by
      rw [hzero]
      exact ⟨fun i => by show liftU _ = 0; unfold zero16; rw [rep16]; unfold liftU; simp,
        fun i => by show liftU _ = 0; unfold zero16; rw [rep16]; unfold liftU; simp⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model zero16 zero16 (R.rounds h.val) _ he (hL.rounds h)
    exact ⟨b, hb, cellEq b hs⟩
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    obtain ⟨ab, hab, habs⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec (R.schunk h.val) (R.sclen h.val)
    have he : EndsLift (R.spre h.val) ab (blocksOf pub w h) := by
      refine ⟨hL.spre h hn hz, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [hL.sabs h hn hz i, habs]
      by_cases c : i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val
      · rw [if_pos c, if_pos c]
      · rw [if_neg c, if_neg c]; unfold liftU; simp
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model (R.spre h.val) ab (R.rounds h.val) _ he (hL.rounds h)
    refine ⟨b, ?_, cellEq b hs⟩
    rw [R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_block, hab]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb

/-! ### Discharging the premises (mechanical instantiations) -/

/-- Sponge chaining: a Rust pre-state equal to the previous block's final
round lifts to the model's pre-state whenever the model chains (pre_2, pre_3,
pre_26, pre_28/29, pre_31, pre_32). -/
theorem spre_chain (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks) (h : Fin 57) (h' : Fin 57)
    (hr : RoundsOk (R.rounds h.val) (blocksOf pub w h))
    (hchainR : R.spre h'.val = (R.rounds h.val).val[10]!)
    (hchainM : (blocksOf pub w h').pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w h)) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) ((R.spre h'.val).val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w h').pre i := by
  intro i
  rw [hchainR, hchainM]
  exact hr 10 i (by norm_num)

/-- First sponge blocks: sponge_init lifts to the model's spongeInit. -/
theorem spre_init (domain len : U32) (dom l : K) (hd : liftU (K := K) domain = dom)
    (hl : liftU (K := K) len = l) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_init domain len = ok s) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = spongeInit dom l i := by
  obtain ⟨s', hs', hv⟩ := sponge_init_spec domain len
  rw [hs] at hs'
  cases hs'
  intro i
  rw [hv]
  unfold spongeInit
  by_cases e8 : i.val = 8
  · rw [if_pos e8, if_pos e8, hd]
  · rw [if_neg e8, if_neg e8]
    by_cases e9 : i.val = 9
    · rw [if_pos e9, if_pos e9, hl]
    · rw [if_neg e9, if_neg e9]; unfold liftU; simp

/-- A full eight-word chunk lifting to a digest gives lo8 absorption. -/
theorem sabs_lo8 (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize) (hc : clen.val = 8) (D : R0P.Digest K)
    (hD : DigestLift chunk D) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, lo8 D i = (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) := by
  intro i
  unfold lo8
  rw [hc]
  by_cases h8 : i.val < 8
  · rw [dif_pos h8, if_pos ⟨h8, h8⟩]; exact (hD ⟨i.val, h8⟩).symm
  · rw [dif_neg h8, if_neg (fun h => h8 h.1)]

/-- Owner-key sponge (block 0, sk, 8 words). -/
theorem owner_sabs (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize)
    (hc : clen.val = 8) (hD : DigestLift chunk w.sk) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w 0).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) :=
  sabs_lo8 chunk clen hc w.sk hD

theorem owner_spre (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (domain len : U32)
    (hd : domain.val = 0x41530001) (hl : len.val = 8) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_init domain len = ok s) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w 0).pre i :=
  spre_init domain len _ _ (by unfold liftU; rw [hd]; norm_num) (by unfold liftU; rw [hl]; norm_num) s hs

/-- Nullifier sponge (blocks 25, 26: sk then salt, 16 words). -/
theorem nul_sabs0 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize)
    (hc : clen.val = 8) (hD : DigestLift chunk w.sk) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w 25).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) :=
  sabs_lo8 chunk clen hc w.sk hD

theorem nul_sabs1 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize)
    (hc : clen.val = 8) (hD : DigestLift chunk w.salt) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w 26).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) :=
  sabs_lo8 chunk clen hc w.salt hD

theorem nul_spre0 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (domain len : U32)
    (hd : domain.val = 0x41530002) (hl : len.val = 16) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_init domain len = ok s) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w 25).pre i :=
  spre_init domain len _ _ (by unfold liftU; rw [hd]; norm_num) (by unfold liftU; rw [hl]; norm_num) s hs

theorem nul_spre1 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks)
    (hr : RoundsOk (R.rounds 25) (blocksOf pub w 25)) (hchain : R.spre 26 = (R.rounds 25).val[10]!) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) ((R.spre 26).val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w 26).pre i :=
  spre_chain pub w R 25 26 hr hchain (pre_26 pub w)

/-- Tree node blocks: the model's children are the ordered (current, sibling). -/
theorem tree_node_children (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (l : Fin 24) :
    blocksOf pub w ⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ =
      nodeIn (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).1
        (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).2 := by
  rw [blocksOf_node']; rfl

/-- Append node blocks 34..53: the model's children are ordered (current, frontier/empty root). -/
theorem app_node_children (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 20) :
    blocksOf pub w ⟨34 + j, by omega⟩ =
      nodeIn (ordered (appCur pub (outPair pub w) j) (appSib pub ⟨j, hj⟩) (appBit pub j)).1

import R0Z.PoseidonExtracted
import R0Z.WriterRefinePath
import R0Z.WriterRefineOccRow
import R0P.Poseidon

/-! Poseidon refinement, first step (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.4 c).

`R0PoseidonCopy` is the Aeneas extraction of refine/poseidon (the
extraction-friendly copy of permute_optimized_with_trace, differentially
tested against production).  Here: the field operations, pow5, mat4, the
external linear layer and the single full round lift to R0P's
`poseidonPow5`, `poseidonMat4`, `poseidonExternalLinear`,
`poseidonFullRound`, for every u32 input state and constant row (all
reductions are `(u64 expression) % p`, so no canonicity is needed).  Loops
are proved by induction on the remaining iterations; no table or cell is
evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy R0Z.WriterRefine

/-! ### Scalar plumbing -/

theorem u32lt (a : U32) : a.val < 4294967296 := by
  have h := a.hBounds
  rw [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl] at h
  exact h

theorem size64 : UScalar.size .U64 = 18446744073709551616 := by
  rw [UScalar.size_def]; rfl

theorem c64 (a : U32) : (UScalar.cast .U64 a).val = a.val := by
  rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, show UScalarTy.U64.numBits = 64 from rfl]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by have := u32lt a; omega)

theorem c32 (x : U64) (h : x.val < 4294967296) : (UScalar.cast .U32 x).val = x.val := by
  rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem add64v (x y : U64) (m n : Nat) (hx : x.val = m) (hy : y.val = n)
    (h : m + n < 18446744073709551616) : (U64.wrapping_add x y).val = m + n := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_add_val_eq, size64, hx, hy]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem mul64v (x y : U64) (m n : Nat) (hx : x.val = m) (hy : y.val = n)
    (h : m * n < 18446744073709551616) : (U64.wrapping_mul x y).val = m * n := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq, size64, hx, hy]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem v2 : (2#u64 : U64).val = 2 := by simp
theorem v3 : (3#u64 : U64).val = 3 := by simp
theorem v4 : (4#usize : Usize).val = 4 := by simp
theorem v16 : (16#usize : Usize).val = 16 := by simp
theorem z0 : (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 := by simp
theorem z1 : (1#usize : Usize).val = 1 := by simp
theorem z2 : (2#usize : Usize).val = 2 := by simp
theorem z3 : (3#usize : Usize).val = 3 := by simp

theorem pval : (P : U32).val = 2147483647 := by rw [P]; simp
theorem p64 : (UScalar.cast .U64 P).val = 2147483647 := by rw [c64, pval]

theorem rem_ok {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) (h : y.val ≠ 0) :
    (x % y : Result (UScalar ty)) = ok ⟨BitVec.umod x.bv y.bv⟩ := by
  show UScalar.rem x y = _
  unfold UScalar.rem
  rw [if_pos (by simpa using h)]

theorem umod_val {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) :
    (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv y.bv⟩ : UScalar ty).val = x.val % y.val :=
  BitVec.toNat_umod

theorem remP (x : U64) :
    (x % UScalar.cast .U64 P : Result U64) = ok ⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ :=
  rem_ok _ _ (by rw [p64]; omega)

/-! ### u64 shapes of the copy (no wrap) -/

theorem add2_val (a b : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b)).val = a.val + b.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) (by omega)

theorem mul2_val (a b : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b)).val = a.val * b.val := by
  have ha := u32lt a; have hb := u32lt b
  refine mul64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) ?_
  calc a.val * b.val < 4294967296 * 4294967296 := Nat.mul_lt_mul'' ha hb
    _ = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num

theorem sum4_val (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 c)) (UScalar.cast .U64 d)).val = a.val + b.val + c.val + d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) (by omega)) (c64 c) (by omega))
    (c64 d) (by omega)

theorem mat_r0 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 a))
      (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 b))) (UScalar.cast .U64 c)) (UScalar.cast .U64 d)).val
      = 2 * a.val + 3 * b.val + c.val + d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 a) (by omega))
    (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 b) (by omega)) (by omega)) (c64 c) (by omega)) (c64 d) (by omega)

theorem mat_r1 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a)
      (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 b))) (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 c)))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 d)).val = a.val + 2 * b.val + 3 * c.val + d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 b) (by omega))
    (by omega)) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 c) (by omega)) (by omega)) (c64 d) (by omega)

theorem mat_r2 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b))
      (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 c))) (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 d))).val
      = a.val + b.val + 2 * c.val + 3 * d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) (by omega))
    (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 c) (by omega)) (by omega)) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 d) (by omega)) (by omega)

theorem mat_r3 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 a))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 b)) (UScalar.cast .U64 c)) (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 d))).val
      = 3 * a.val + b.val + c.val + 2 * d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 a) (by omega))
    (c64 b) (by omega)) (c64 c) (by omega)) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 d) (by omega)) (by omega)

/-! ### Lifting to K -/

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- Lane `k` of a 16-lane state, lifted. -/
def liftN (s : Array U32 16#usize) (k : Nat) : K := liftU (s.val[k]!)

/-- The lifted state as R0P's `Fin 16 → K`. -/
def liftA (s : Array U32 16#usize) : Fin 16 → K := fun i => liftU (s.val[i.val]!)

/-- R0P's group-`g` matrix output `c`, read through `liftN`. -/
def PM (s : Array U32 16#usize) (g c : Fin 4) : K :=
  R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun lane : Fin 4 => liftN s (4 * g.val + lane.val)) c

variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

theorem cast_mod (n : Nat) : ((n % 2147483647 : Nat) : K) = (n : K) := by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n 2147483647]
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem liftmod (x : U64) :
    liftU (K := K) (UScalar.cast .U32 (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64)) =
      ((x.val : Nat) : K) := by
  unfold liftU
  have hm : (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64).val = x.val % 2147483647 := by
    rw [umod_val, p64]
  have hlt : x.val % 2147483647 < 2147483647 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  rw [c32 _ (by rw [hm]; omega), hm, cast_mod]

theorem add_lift (a b : U32) :
    ∃ z, m31_add a b = ok z ∧ liftU (K := K) z = liftU a + liftU b := by
  rw [m31_add]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [liftmod, add2_val]
  unfold liftU
  push_cast
  rfl

theorem mul_lift (a b : U32) :
    ∃ z, m31_mul a b = ok z ∧ liftU (K := K) z = liftU a * liftU b := by
  rw [m31_mul]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [liftmod, mul2_val]
  unfold liftU
  push_cast
  rfl

theorem pow5_lift (x : U32) :
    ∃ z, pow5 x = ok z ∧ liftU (K := K) z = R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftU x) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsv⟩ := mul_lift (K := K) x x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := mul_lift (K := K) s s
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := mul_lift (K := K) t x
  refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [pow5, hs]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [ht]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hu
  · rw [huv, htv, hsv]
    rfl

/-! ### mat4 -/

theorem mk4 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) (h : [x0, x1, x2, x3].length = (4#usize : Usize).val) :
    (Array.make 4#usize [x0, x1, x2, x3] h).val = [x0, x1, x2, x3] := rfl
theorem gl0 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[0]! = x0 := rfl
theorem gl1 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[1]! = x1 := rfl
theorem gl2 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[2]! = x2 := rfl
theorem gl3 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[3]! = x3 := rfl

theorem pm0 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 0 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 1) + (v 0 + v 1) := rfl
theorem pm1 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 1 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 1) + (v 2 + v 2) := rfl
theorem pm2 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 2 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 3) + (v 2 + v 3) := rfl
theorem pm3 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 3 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 3) + (v 0 + v 0) := rfl

theorem mat4_lift (a b c d : U32) (v : Fin 4 → K) (ha : liftU a = v 0) (hb : liftU b = v 1)
    (hc : liftU c = v 2) (hd : liftU d = v 3) :
    ∃ m, mat4 a b c d = ok m ∧
      liftU (m.val[0]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 0 ∧ liftU (m.val[1]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 1 ∧
      liftU (m.val[2]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 2 ∧ liftU (m.val[3]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 3 := by
  rw [mat4]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mk4, gl0, liftmod, mat_r0, pm0, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mk4, gl1, liftmod, mat_r1, pm1, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mk4, gl2, liftmod, mat_r2, pm2, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mk4, gl3, liftmod, mat_r3, pm3, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring

/-! ### Four consecutive writes -/

theorem set4 {n : Usize} (v : Array U32 n) (i0 i1 i2 i3 : Usize) (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) (b : Nat)
    (h0 : i0.val = b) (h1 : i1.val = b + 1) (h2 : i2.val = b + 2) (h3 : i3.val = b + 3)
    (hb : b + 3 < n.val) :
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b]! = x0 ∧
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b + 1]! = x1 ∧
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b + 2]! = x2 ∧
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b + 3]! = x3 ∧
    ∀ k, k < b → ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[k]! = v.val[k]! := by
  have e3 := set_get' (((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2) i3 x3 (by omega)
  have e2 := set_get' ((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1) i2 x2 (by omega)
  have e1 := set_get' (v.set i0 x0) i1 x1 (by omega)
  have e0 := set_get' v i0 x0 (by omega)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩ <;>
    (rw [e3, e2, e1, e0, h0, h1, h2, h3]; split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega)

/-! ### The S-box loop -/

theorem sbox_loop (s c : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 16 →
      ∃ o, sbox_full_loop s c out i = ok o ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 →
        (i.val ≤ k → liftU (K := K) (o.val[k]!) = R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftN s k + liftN c k)) ∧
        (k < i.val → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, i, out, h => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [sbox_full_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, i, out, h => by
      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) (c.val[i.val]!)
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := pow5_lift (K := K) z
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := sbox_loop s c n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (out.set i y)
        (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun hik => ?_, fun hki => ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [sbox_full_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s i hb, index_ok c i hb, hz, hy, update_ok out i y hb]
        exact ho
      · by_cases e : k = i.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov i.val hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i y hb i.val, if_pos rfl, hyv, hzv]
          rfl
        · exact (hov k hk).1 (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      · rw [(hov k hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i y hb k, if_neg (by omega)]

/-! ### The external layer -/

theorem groups_loop (s : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (g : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), g.val + n = 4 →
      ∃ o, ext_groups_loop s out g = ok o ∧
        (∀ (g' c : Nat) (hg : g' < 4) (hc : c < 4), g.val ≤ g' →
          liftU (K := K) (o.val[4 * g' + c]!) = PM s ⟨g', hg⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩) ∧
        (∀ k, k < 4 * g.val → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, g, out, h => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun g' c hg hc h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ _ => rfl⟩
      rw [ext_groups_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, g, out, h => by
      have hlt : g < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have h4 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g).val = 4 * g.val := by
        rw [umul _ _ (by rw [v4]; omega), v4]
      have h1 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize).val = 4 * g.val + 1 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h4, z1]; omega), h4, z1]
      have h2 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize).val = 4 * g.val + 2 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h4, z2]; omega), h4, z2]
      have h3 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize).val = 4 * g.val + 3 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h4, z3]; omega), h4, z3]
      have hg1 : (Usize.wrapping_add g 1#usize).val = g.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hb0 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [h4, v16]; omega
      have hb1 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by
        rw [h1, v16]; omega
      have hb2 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by
        rw [h2, v16]; omega
      have hb3 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by
        rw [h3, v16]; omega
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hm0, hm1, hm2, hm3⟩ := mat4_lift (K := K)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g).val]!)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize).val]!)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize).val]!)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize).val]!)
        (fun lane : Fin 4 => liftN s (4 * g.val + lane.val))
        (by rw [h4]; rfl) (by rw [h1]; rfl) (by rw [h2]; rfl) (by rw [h3]; rfl)
      have S := set4 out (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g)
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize)
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize)
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize)
        (m.val[0]!) (m.val[1]!) (m.val[2]!) (m.val[3]!) (4 * g.val) h4 h1 h2 h3 (by rw [v16]; omega)
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hoG, hoF⟩ := groups_loop s n (Usize.wrapping_add g 1#usize)
        ((((out.set (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) (m.val[0]!)).set
          (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize) (m.val[1]!)).set
          (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize) (m.val[2]!)).set
          (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize) (m.val[3]!))
        (by rw [hg1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, fun g' c hg hc hle => ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      · rw [ext_groups_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s _ hb0, index_ok s _ hb1, index_ok s _ hb2,
          index_ok s _ hb3, hm, index_ok m 0#usize (by rw [z0, v4]; omega),
          index_ok m 1#usize (by rw [z1, v4]; omega), index_ok m 2#usize (by rw [z2, v4]; omega),
          index_ok m 3#usize (by rw [z3, v4]; omega), update_ok _ _ _ hb0, update_ok _ _ _ hb1,
          update_ok _ _ _ hb2, update_ok _ _ _ hb3, z0, z1, z2, z3]
        exact ho
      · by_cases e : g' = g.val
        · subst e
          rw [hoF _ (by rw [hg1]; omega)]
          have hc' : c = 0 ∨ c = 1 ∨ c = 2 ∨ c = 3 := by omega
          rcases hc' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
          · rw [show 4 * g.val + 0 = 4 * g.val from rfl, S.1]; exact hm0
          · rw [S.2.1]; exact hm1
          · rw [S.2.2.1]; exact hm2
          · rw [S.2.2.2.1]; exact hm3
        · exact hoG g' c hg hc (by rw [hg1]; omega)
      · rw [hoF k (by rw [hg1]; omega)]
        exact S.2.2.2.2 k hk

theorem sums_loop (gr : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (col : Usize) (sums : Array U32 4#usize), col.val + n = 4 →
      ∃ o, ext_sums_loop gr sums col = ok o ∧ ∀ c, c < 4 →
        (col.val ≤ c → liftU (K := K) (o.val[c]!) =
          liftN gr c + liftN gr (4 + c) + liftN gr (8 + c) + liftN gr (12 + c)) ∧
        (c < col.val → o.val[c]! = sums.val[c]!)
  | 0, col, sums, h => by
      refine ⟨sums, ?_, fun c hc => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [ext_sums_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, col, sums, h => by
      have hlt : col < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : col.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hbs : col.val < (4#usize).val := by rw [v4]; omega
      have hc4 : (Usize.wrapping_add 4#usize col).val = 4 + col.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [v4]; omega), v4]
      have hc8 : (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize col).val = 8 + col.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [show (8#usize : Usize).val = 8 by simp]; omega),
          show (8#usize : Usize).val = 8 by simp]
      have hc12 : (Usize.wrapping_add 12#usize col).val = 12 + col.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [show (12#usize : Usize).val = 12 by simp]; omega),
          show (12#usize : Usize).val = 12 by simp]
      have hb4 : (Usize.wrapping_add 4#usize col).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hc4, v16]; omega
      have hb8 : (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize col).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hc8, v16]; omega
      have hb12 : (Usize.wrapping_add 12#usize col).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hc12, v16]; omega
      have hcol1 : (Usize.wrapping_add col 1#usize).val = col.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have step : ∃ X : U32, ext_sums_loop gr sums col =
          ext_sums_loop gr (sums.set col X) (Usize.wrapping_add col 1#usize) ∧
          liftU (K := K) X = liftN gr col.val + liftN gr (4 + col.val) + liftN gr (8 + col.val) +
            liftN gr (12 + col.val) := by
        rw [ext_sums_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok gr col hb, index_ok gr _ hb4, index_ok gr _ hb8,
          index_ok gr _ hb12, remP, update_ok sums col _ hbs]
        refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
        rw [liftmod, sum4_val, hc4, hc8, hc12]
        unfold liftN liftU
        push_cast
        rfl
      obtain ⟨X, hX, hXv⟩ := step
      have hs := set_get' sums col X hbs
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := sums_loop gr n (Usize.wrapping_add col 1#usize) (sums.set col X)
        (by rw [hcol1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, by rw [hX]; exact ho, fun c hc => ⟨fun hle => ?_, fun hlt' => ?_⟩⟩
      · by_cases e : c = col.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov col.val hc).2 (by rw [hcol1]; omega), hs, if_pos rfl]
          exact hXv
        · exact (hov c hc).1 (by rw [hcol1]; omega)
      · rw [(hov c hc).2 (by rw [hcol1]; omega), hs, if_neg (by omega)]

theorem add_loop (gr : Array U32 16#usize) (sums : Array U32 4#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 16 →
      ∃ o, ext_add_loop gr sums out i = ok o ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 →
        (i.val ≤ k → liftU (K := K) (o.val[k]!) = liftN gr k + liftU (sums.val[k % 4]!)) ∧
        (k < i.val → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, i, out, h => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [ext_add_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, i, out, h => by
      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hr : (⟨BitVec.umod i.bv (4#usize : Usize).bv⟩ : Usize).val = i.val % 4 := by
        rw [umod_val, v4]
      have hrb : (⟨BitVec.umod i.bv (4#usize : Usize).bv⟩ : Usize).val < (4#usize).val := by
        rw [hr, v4]; omega
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) (gr.val[i.val]!)
        (sums.val[(⟨BitVec.umod i.bv (4#usize : Usize).bv⟩ : Usize).val]!)
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := add_loop gr sums n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (out.set i z)
        (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun hik => ?_, fun hki => ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [ext_add_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok gr i hb, rem_ok i 4#usize (by rw [v4]; omega),
          index_ok sums _ hrb, hz, update_ok out i z hb]
        exact ho
      · by_cases e : k = i.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov i.val hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i z hb i.val, if_pos rfl, hzv, hr]
          rfl
        · exact (hov k hk).1 (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      · rw [(hov k hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i z hb k, if_neg (by omega)]

theorem ext_unfold (s : Array U32 16#usize) (i : Fin 16) :
    R0P.poseidonExternalLinear (liftA (K := K) s) i =
      PM s ⟨i.val / 4, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩ ⟨i.val % 4, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩ +
        ((((0 + PM s ⟨0, by decide⟩ ⟨i.val % 4, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩) +
          PM s ⟨1, by decide⟩ ⟨i.val % 4, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩) +
          PM s ⟨2, by decide⟩ ⟨i.val % 4, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩) +
          PM s ⟨3, by decide⟩ ⟨i.val % 4, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩) := rfl

/-- The external linear layer of the copy lifts to R0P's `poseidonExternalLinear`. -/
theorem external_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∃ t, external_linear s = ok t ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (t.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonExternalLinear (liftA s) i := by
  obtain ⟨gr, hgr, hG, -⟩ := groups_loop (K := K) s 4 0#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32)
    (by rw [z0])
  obtain ⟨sm, hsm, hS⟩ := sums_loop (K := K) gr 4 0#usize (Array.repeat 4#usize 0#u32) (by rw [z0])
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hT⟩ := add_loop (K := K) gr sm 16 0#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32)
    (by rw [z0])
  refine ⟨t, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · simp only [external_linear, ext_groups, ext_sums, ext_add, hgr, hsm, ht, bind_tc_ok]
  · have hi := i.isLt
    rw [(hT i.val hi).1 (by rw [z0]; omega), (hS (i.val % 4) (by omega)).1 (by rw [z0]; omega),
      ext_unfold]
    have G := hG (i.val / 4) (i.val % 4) (by omega) (by omega) (z0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _))
    have G0 := hG 0 (i.val % 4) (by omega) (by omega) (z0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _))
    have G1 := hG 1 (i.val % 4) (by omega) (by omega) (z0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _))
    have G2 := hG 2 (i.val % 4) (by omega) (by omega) (z0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _))
    have G3 := hG 3 (i.val % 4) (by omega) (by omega) (z0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _))
    rw [Nat.div_add_mod] at G
    rw [show 4 * 0 + i.val % 4 = i.val % 4 by omega] at G0
    rw [show 4 * 1 + i.val % 4 = 4 + i.val % 4 by omega] at G1
    rw [show 4 * 2 + i.val % 4 = 8 + i.val % 4 by omega] at G2
    rw [show 4 * 3 + i.val % 4 = 12 + i.val % 4 by omega] at G3
    rw [← G, ← G0, ← G1, ← G2, ← G3]
    unfold liftN
    ring

/-- **Single full round.**  For every u32 state `s` and constant row `c`, the
extracted copy's `full_round` returns `ok t` and every lane of `t` lifts to
R0P's `poseidonFullRound` of the lifted state and constants. -/
theorem full_round_lift (s c : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∃ t, full_round s c = ok t ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (t.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonFullRound (liftA s) (liftA c) i := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbv⟩ := sbox_loop (K := K) s c 16 0#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32) (by rw [z0])
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := external_lift (K := K) b
  refine ⟨t, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · simp only [full_round, sbox_full, hb, bind_tc_ok, ht]
  · rw [htv i]
    have hfun : liftA (K := K) b = fun lane => R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftA s lane + liftA c lane) :=
      funext fun lane => (hbv lane.val lane.isLt).1 (by rw [z0]; omega)
    rw [hfun]
    rfl

end R0Z.PoseidonRefine

R0Z.PoseidonInternal.text:
import R0Z.PoseidonRefine

/-! Poseidon refinement, internal round (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.4 c).

`internal_round_lift`: the extracted copy's `internal_round s c0 shifts`
returns `ok t` and every lane of `t` lifts to R0P's `poseidonInternalRound`
of the lifted state and constant, for every u32 state and constant, given
two named facts about the shift row (`ShiftsBound`, `ShiftsOk`; they are
the table-correspondence obligation for INTERNAL_SHIFTS and are not
evaluated here).  The part sum is related to R0P's ordered `foldl` over
`List.ofFn` by a generic `ofFn`/`range'` lemma, not by unfolding 15 cells. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy R0Z.WriterRefine

theorem v15 : (15#usize : Usize).val = 15 := by simp

theorem usub (a b : Usize) (h : b.val ≤ a.val) : (Usize.wrapping_sub a b).val = a.val - b.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have ha : a.val < UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [UScalar.size_def]; exact a.hBounds
  rw [show a.val + (UScalar.size .Usize - b.val) = (a.val - b.val) + UScalar.size .Usize by omega,
    Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

theorem sub64 (x y : U64) (h : y.val ≤ x.val) : (U64.wrapping_sub x y).val = x.val - y.val := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_sub_val_eq, size64]
  have hx : x.val < 18446744073709551616 := by
    have := x.hBounds; rw [show UScalarTy.U64.numBits = 64 from rfl] at this; exact this
  rw [show x.val + (18446744073709551616 - y.val) = (x.val - y.val) + 18446744073709551616 by omega,
    Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

theorem shl64 (x : U64) (sh : U32) (hx : x.val < 4294967296) (hs : sh.val ≤ 16) :
    (U64.wrapping_shl x sh).val = x.val * 2 ^ sh.val := by
  show (U64.wrapping_shl x sh).bv.toNat = x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ sh.val
  rw [U64.wrapping_shl_bv_eq, show sh.val % 64 = sh.val by omega]
  show (x.bv <<< sh.val).toNat = _
  rw [BitVec.toNat_shiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h1 : x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ sh.val ≤ x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ 16 :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hs)
  have h2 : x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ 16 < 4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 :=
    Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hx (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 : Nat) < 2 ^ 64 := by norm_num
  omega

theorem lane_val (full x sh : U32) (hs : sh.val ≤ 16) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 full) (U64.wrapping_shl (UScalar.cast .U64 x) sh)).val =
      full.val + x.val * 2 ^ sh.val := by
  have hsh := shl64 (UScalar.cast .U64 x) sh (by rw [c64]; exact u32lt x) hs
  rw [c64] at hsh
  have h1 : x.val * 2 ^ sh.val ≤ x.val * 2 ^ 16 :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hs)
  have h2 : x.val * 2 ^ 16 < 4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (u32lt x) (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 : Nat) + 4294967296 < 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have := u32lt full
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 full) hsh (by omega)

theorem lane0_val (part s0 : U32) (h : s0.val ≤ part.val + 2147483647) :
    (U64.wrapping_sub (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 part) (UScalar.cast .U64 P))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 s0)).val = part.val + 2147483647 - s0.val := by
  have hadd := add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 part) p64 (by have := u32lt part; omega)
  rw [sub64 _ _ (by rw [hadd, c64]; exact h), hadd, c64]

theorem canon_mod (x : U64) :
    (UScalar.cast .U32 (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64)).val < 2147483647 := by
  have hm : (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64).val = x.val % 2147483647 := by
    rw [umod_val, p64]
  have hlt : x.val % 2147483647 < 2147483647 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  rw [c32 _ (by rw [hm]; omega), hm]
  exact hlt

theorem mul_canon (a b : U32) : ∃ z, m31_mul a b = ok z ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  rw [m31_mul]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  exact ⟨_, rfl, canon_mod _⟩

theorem pow5_canon (x z : U32) (h : pow5 x = ok z) : z.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1, -⟩ := mul_canon x x
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2, -⟩ := mul_canon s1 s1
  obtain ⟨s3, hs3, hc⟩ := mul_canon s2 x
  have e : pow5 x = ok s3 := by
    rw [pow5, hs1]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; rw [hs2]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; exact hs3
  rw [e] at h
  injection h with h'
  rw [← h']
  exact hc

theorem ofFn_range' {α : Type} : ∀ (n s : Nat) (f : Fin n → α) (g : Nat → α),
    (∀ i : Fin n, f i = g (s + i.val)) → List.ofFn f = (List.range' s n).map g
  | 0, s, f, g, _ => by rw [List.ofFn_zero]; rfl
  | n + 1, s, f, g, h => by
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, ofFn_range' n (s + 1) (fun i => f i.succ) g
        (fun i => by rw [h i.succ, Fin.val_succ, show s + (i.val + 1) = s + 1 + i.val by omega]),
        h 0, Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero]
      rfl

/-- The shift row's entries are at most 16 (so `x << shift` stays below 2^48). -/
def ShiftsBound (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) : Prop := ∀ j, j < 15 → (shifts.val[j]!).val ≤ 16

/-- The shift row equals R0P's `poseidonInternalShifts` (the INTERNAL_SHIFTS table obligation). -/
def ShiftsOk (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 15, (shifts.val[j.val]!).val = R0P.poseidonInternalShifts j

        v i * ((1 <<< R0P.poseidonInternalShifts ⟨i.val - 1, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩ : Nat) : K) :=

theorem part_loop (s : Array U32 16#usize) :

        rfl

    ∃ part, int_part_sum s = ok part ∧ part.val < 2147483647 ∧
      liftU (K := K) part = (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => liftA (K := K) s j.succ)).foldl (· + ·) 0 := by
  have h0 : (0#u64 : U64).val = 0 := by simp
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hrv⟩ := part_loop (K := K) s 15 1#usize 0#u64 (by rw [z1]) (by rw [h0]; omega)
  have hof : List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => liftA (K := K) s j.succ) = (List.range' 1 15).map (liftN s) :=
    ofFn_range' 15 1 _ _ (fun j => by

      rw [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_comm])

  refine ⟨_, rfl, canon_mod _, ?_⟩

theorem lin_loop (s : Array U32 16#usize) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) (full : U32)
    (hsb : ShiftsBound shifts) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 16 → 1 ≤ i.val →
      ∃ o, internal_linear_loop s shifts full out i = ok o ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 →
        (i.val ≤ k → liftU (K := K) (o.val[k]!) =
          liftU full + liftN s k * (2 : K) ^ (shifts.val[k - 1]!).val) ∧
        (k < i.val → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, i, out, h, _ => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [internal_linear_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]

      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac

      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 1#usize).val = i.val - 1 := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [z1]; omega), z1]
      have hsb' : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 1#usize).val < (15#usize).val := by rw [hsub, v15]; omega

          internal_linear_loop s shifts full (out.set i X) (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) ∧
          liftU (K := K) X = liftU full + liftN s i.val * (2 : K) ^ (shifts.val[i.val - 1]!).val := by
        rw [internal_linear_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s i hb, index_ok shifts _ hsb', remP, update_ok out i _ hb]
        refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
        rw [liftmod, lane_val _ _ _ (hsb _ (by rw [hsub]; omega)), hsub]
        unfold liftN liftU
        push_cast
        rfl
      obtain ⟨X, hX, hXv⟩ := step
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := lin_loop s shifts full hsb n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (out.set i X)
        (by rw [hi1]; omega) (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, by rw [hX]; exact ho, fun k hk => ⟨fun hik => ?_, fun hki => ?_⟩⟩
      · by_cases e : k = i.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov i.val hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i X hb i.val, if_pos rfl]
          exact hXv
        · exact (hov k hk).1 (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      · rw [(hov k hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i X hb k, if_neg (by omega)]

/-- The internal linear layer of the copy lifts to R0P's `poseidonInternalLinear`
(lane 0 needs the canonical-lane-0 fact `h0`). -/
theorem internal_linear_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize)
    (h0 : (s.val[0]!).val < 2147483647) (hsb : ShiftsBound shifts) (hsh : ShiftsOk shifts) :
    ∃ t, internal_linear s shifts = ok t ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (t.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonInternalLinear (liftA s) i := by
  obtain ⟨part, hp, hpc, hpv⟩ := part_lift (K := K) s
  obtain ⟨full, hf, hfv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) part (s.val[0]!)
  have hle : (s.val[0]!).val ≤ part.val + 2147483647 := by omega
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [z0, v16]; omega
  have step : ∃ X0 : U32, internal_linear s shifts =
      internal_linear_loop s shifts full ((Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32).set 0#usize X0) 1#usize ∧
      liftU (K := K) X0 = liftU part - liftU (s.val[0]!) := by
    rw [internal_linear]
    simp only [hp, lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s 0#usize hb0, z0, hf, remP, update_ok _ 0#usize _ hb0]
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [liftmod, lane0_val _ _ hle]
    unfold liftU
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle, Nat.cast_add, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0, hX0v⟩ := step
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := lin_loop (K := K) s shifts full hsb 15 1#usize
    ((Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32).set 0#usize X0) (by rw [z1]) (le_of_eq z1.symm)
  refine ⟨o, by rw [hX0]; exact ho, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hi := i.isLt
  by_cases hi0 : i.val = 0
  · rw [lin_unfold, dif_pos hi0, hi0, (hov 0 (by omega)).2 (lt_of_lt_of_eq Nat.zero_lt_one z1.symm),
      set_get' _ 0#usize X0 hb0 0, z0, if_pos rfl, hX0v, hpv]
    rfl
  · have hs := hsh ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩
    dsimp only at hs
    rw [lin_unfold, dif_neg hi0, (hov i.val hi).1 (by rw [z1]; omega), hfv, hpv, hs, Nat.shiftLeft_eq,
      Nat.one_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rfl

/-- **Single internal round.**  For every u32 state `s` and constant `c0`, and a
shift row satisfying the named table facts, the extracted copy's
`internal_round` returns `ok t` and every lane of `t` lifts to R0P's
`poseidonInternalRound` of the lifted state and constant. -/
theorem internal_round_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) (c0 : U32) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize)
    (hsb : ShiftsBound shifts) (hsh : ShiftsOk shifts) :
    ∃ t, internal_round s c0 shifts = ok t ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (t.val[i.val]!) =
        R0P.poseidonInternalRound (liftA s) (liftU c0) i := by
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [z0, v16]; omega
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) (s.val[0]!) c0
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := pow5_lift (K := K) z
  have hyc := pow5_canon z y hy
  have hset := set_get' s 0#usize y hb0
  have h0 : ((s.set 0#usize y).val[0]!).val < 2147483647 := by
    rw [hset 0, z0, if_pos rfl]; exact hyc
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := internal_linear_lift (K := K) (s.set 0#usize y) shifts h0 hsb hsh
  refine ⟨t, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [internal_round]
    simp only [index_ok s 0#usize hb0, z0, bind_tc_ok, hz, hy, update_ok s 0#usize y hb0]
    exact ht
  · rw [htv i]
    have hfun : liftA (K := K) (s.set 0#usize y) =
        fun lane => if lane = 0 then R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftA s 0 + liftU c0) else liftA s lane := by
      funext lane
      show liftU ((s.set 0#usize y).val[lane.val]!) = _
      rw [hset lane.val, z0]
      by_cases hl : lane = 0
      · have hv : lane.val = 0 := by rw [hl]; rfl
        rw [if_pos hv, if_pos hl, hyv, hzv]
        rfl
      · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (lane.val = 0) from fun h => hl (Fin.ext h)), if_neg hl]
        rfl
    rw [hfun]
    rfl

end R0Z.PoseidonRefine

import R0Z.PoseidonConstLift
import R0Z.BlockRefine

/-! Poseidon refinement, composition (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.5 (2), (3)).

`apply_round_lift`: the copy's `apply_round s r` lifts to R0P's
`poseidonApplyRound r` for every r < 22 (the three branches use
full_round_lift / internal_round_lift and the generated constant lifts).
`leading_pair_lift`: absorb loop, leading external layer and rounds 0, 1.
`perm_rounds_lift`: under `EndsLift pre absorb B`, `perm_rounds pre absorb`
returns rounds with `RoundsOk rounds B` — the loop invariant is that rows
0..k-1 lift to `blockIter B (r+1)` and the running state to `blockIter B k`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy R0Z.WriterRefine

/-! ### Generic array plumbing -/

theorem update_ok_a {α : Type} {n : Usize} (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (h : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.update v i x = ok (v.set i x) := by
  unfold Array.update
  have hl : i.val < v.val.length := by rw [v.property]; exact h
  rw [Array.getElem?_Usize_eq, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hl]
  rfl

theorem set_get_a {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize} (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) (k : Nat) :
    (v.set i x).val[k]! = if k = i.val then x else v.val[k]! := by
  rw [Array.set_val_eq]
  have hl : i.val < v.val.length := by rw [v.property]; exact hi
  by_cases hk : k = i.val
  · subst hk
    rw [if_pos rfl, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_set_self hl]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hk, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm hk)]

theorem v11 : (11#usize : Usize).val = 11 := by simp
theorem v14 : (14#usize : Usize).val = 14 := by simp
theorem v18 : (18#usize : Usize).val = 18 := by simp

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### R0P-side unfoldings (no constant is read) -/

theorem ar_init (rr : Fin 22) (h : rr.val < 4) (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonApplyRound rr v = R0P.poseidonFullRound v (R0P.poseidonExternalInitial ⟨rr.val, h⟩) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonApplyRound
  exact dif_pos h

theorem ar_int (rr : Fin 22) (h4 : ¬ rr.val < 4) (h18 : rr.val < 4 + 14) (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonApplyRound rr v =
      R0P.poseidonInternalRound v (R0P.poseidonInternalConstants ⟨rr.val - 4, by omega⟩) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonApplyRound
  rw [dif_neg h4, dif_pos h18]

theorem ar_fin (rr : Fin 22) (h4 : ¬ rr.val < 4) (h18 : ¬ rr.val < 4 + 14) (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonApplyRound rr v =
      R0P.poseidonFullRound v (R0P.poseidonExternalFinal ⟨rr.val - 4 - 14, by omega⟩) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonApplyRound
  rw [dif_neg h4, dif_neg h18]

theorem trans_zero (h : 0 < 11) (s a : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonTransition ⟨0, h⟩ s a = R0P.poseidonLeadingPair s a := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonTransition
  exact if_pos rfl

theorem trans_succ (k : Nat) (hk : k < 11) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) (s a : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonTransition ⟨k, hk⟩ s a =
      R0P.poseidonApplyRound ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩ (R0P.poseidonApplyRound ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩ s) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonTransition
  exact if_neg hk0

theorem iter_zero (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) : R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B 0 = B.pre := rfl

theorem iter_succ (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 11) :
    R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (k + 1) =
      R0P.poseidonTransition ⟨k, hk⟩ (R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B k) B.absorb := by
  first
  | exact dif_pos hk
  | simp only [R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter, dif_pos hk]

variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

/-! ### apply_round -/

theorem apply_round_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) (round : Usize) (hr : round.val < 22) :
    ∃ t, apply_round s round = ok t ∧
      liftA (K := K) t = R0P.poseidonApplyRound ⟨round.val, hr⟩ (liftA s) := by
  by_cases h4 : round.val < 4
  · have hlt : round < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
    have hb : round.val < (4#usize).val := by rw [v4]; exact h4
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) s (EXTERNAL_INITIAL.val[round.val]!)
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [apply_round, if_pos hlt, index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_INITIAL round hb]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      exact ht
    · have e : liftA (K := K) t = _ := funext htv
      have ec : liftA (K := K) (EXTERNAL_INITIAL.val[round.val]!) =
          R0P.poseidonExternalInitial ⟨round.val, h4⟩ := funext (ei_rows ⟨round.val, h4⟩)
      rw [e, ec]
      exact (ar_init ⟨round.val, hr⟩ h4 (liftA s)).symm
  · have hlt4 : ¬ round < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
    by_cases h18 : round.val < 18
    · have hlt18 : round < 18#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val = round.val - 4 := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [v4]; omega), v4]
      have hb : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val < (14#usize).val := by rw [hsub, v14]; omega
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := internal_round_lift (K := K) s
        (INTERNAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val]!) INTERNAL_SHIFTS
        internal_shifts_bound internal_shifts_ok
      refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [apply_round, if_neg hlt4, if_pos hlt18]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok INTERNAL _ hb]
        exact ht
      · have e : liftA (K := K) t = _ := funext htv
        have ec : liftU (K := K) (INTERNAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val]!) =
            R0P.poseidonInternalConstants ⟨round.val - 4, by omega⟩ := by
          rw [hsub]; exact ic_all ⟨round.val - 4, by omega⟩
        rw [e, ec]
        exact (ar_int ⟨round.val, hr⟩ h4 (by show round.val < 4 + 14; omega) (liftA s)).symm
    · have hlt18 : ¬ round < 18#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val = round.val - 4 - 14 := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [v18]; omega), v18]; omega
      have hb : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val < (4#usize).val := by rw [hsub, v4]; omega
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) s
        (EXTERNAL_FINAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val]!)
      refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [apply_round, if_neg hlt4, if_neg hlt18]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_FINAL _ hb]
        exact ht
      · have e : liftA (K := K) t = _ := funext htv
        have ec : liftA (K := K) (EXTERNAL_FINAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val]!) =
            R0P.poseidonExternalFinal ⟨round.val - 4 - 14, by omega⟩ := by
          rw [hsub]; exact funext (ef_rows ⟨round.val - 4 - 14, by omega⟩)
        rw [e, ec]
        exact (ar_fin ⟨round.val, hr⟩ h4 (by show ¬ round.val < 4 + 14; omega) (liftA s)).symm

/-! ### Leading pair -/

theorem absorb_loop (pre absorb : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 8 →
      ∃ o, absorb_into_loop pre absorb out i = ok o ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 →
        (i.val ≤ k → k < 8 → liftU (K := K) (o.val[k]!) = liftU (pre.val[k]!) + liftU (absorb.val[k]!)) ∧
        (¬ (i.val ≤ k ∧ k < 8) → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, i, out, h => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun h1 h2 => absurd h1 (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [absorb_into_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, i, out, h => by
      have hlt : i < 8#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) (pre.val[i.val]!) (absorb.val[i.val]!)
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := absorb_loop pre absorb n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (out.set i z)
        (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun hik hk8 => ?_, fun hn => ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [absorb_into_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok pre i hb, index_ok absorb i hb, hz, update_ok out i z hb]
        exact ho
      · by_cases e : k = i.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov i.val hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i z hb i.val, if_pos rfl]
          exact hzv
        · exact (hov k hk).1 (by rw [hi1]; omega) hk8
      · rw [(hov k hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i z hb k, if_neg (by omega)]

theorem leading_pair_lift (pre absorb c0 c1 : Array U32 16#usize)
    (h0 : ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (c0.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 0 i)
    (h1 : ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (c1.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 1 i) :
    ∃ t, leading_pair pre absorb c0 c1 = ok t ∧
      liftA (K := K) t = R0P.poseidonLeadingPair (liftA pre) (liftA absorb) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := absorb_loop (K := K) pre absorb 8 0#usize pre (by rw [z0])
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsv⟩ := external_lift (K := K) a
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, ht1v⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) s c0
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2, ht2v⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) t1 c1
  refine ⟨t2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [leading_pair]
    simp only [absorb_into, ha, bind_tc_ok, hs, ht1, ht2]
  · have ea : liftA (K := K) a =
        fun lane => if lane.val < 8 then liftA pre lane + liftA absorb lane else liftA pre lane := by
      funext lane
      by_cases hl : lane.val < 8
      · rw [if_pos hl]
        exact (hav lane.val lane.isLt).1 (z0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _)) hl
      · rw [if_neg hl]
        show liftU (a.val[lane.val]!) = liftU (pre.val[lane.val]!)
        rw [(hav lane.val lane.isLt).2 (by rw [z0]; omega)]
    have es : liftA (K := K) s = _ := funext hsv
    have e1 : liftA (K := K) t1 = _ := funext ht1v
    have e2 : liftA (K := K) t2 = _ := funext ht2v
    have ec0 : liftA (K := K) c0 = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 0 := funext h0
    have ec1 : liftA (K := K) c1 = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 1 := funext h1
    rw [e2, e1, es, ea, ec0, ec1]
    rfl

/-! ### perm_rounds -/

theorem perm_loop (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (k : Usize) (rounds : Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) (state : Array U32 16#usize),
      k.val + n = 11 → 1 ≤ k.val →
      (∀ (r : Nat) (i : Fin 16), r < k.val →
        liftU (K := K) ((rounds.val[r]!).val[i.val]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (r + 1) i) →
      liftA (K := K) state = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B k.val →
      ∃ out, perm_rounds_loop rounds state k = ok out ∧ RoundsOk out B
  | 0, k, rounds, state, h, _, hinv, _ => by
      refine ⟨rounds, ?_, fun r i hr => hinv r i (by omega)⟩
      rw [perm_rounds_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, k, rounds, state, h, hk1, hinv, hst => by
      have hlt : k < 11#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hkb : k.val < (11#usize).val := by rw [v11]; omega
      have h2k : (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k).val = 2 * k.val := by
        rw [umul _ _ (by rw [z2]; omega), z2]
      have h2k1 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k) 1#usize).val = 2 * k.val + 1 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h2k, z1]; omega), h2k, z1]
      have hkk : (Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize).val = k.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := apply_round_lift (K := K) state (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k)
        (by rw [h2k]; omega)
      obtain ⟨s1, hs1, hs1v⟩ := apply_round_lift (K := K) a
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k) 1#usize) (by rw [h2k1]; omega)
      have f1 : (⟨(Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k).val, by rw [h2k]; omega⟩ : Fin 22) =
          ⟨2 * k.val, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext h2k
      have f2 : (⟨(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k) 1#usize).val, by rw [h2k1]; omega⟩ :
          Fin 22) = ⟨2 * k.val + 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext h2k1
      have hnew : liftA (K := K) s1 = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (k.val + 1) := by
        rw [hs1v, hav, hst, iter_succ B k.val (by omega), trans_succ k.val _ (by omega), f1, f2]
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hR⟩ := perm_loop B n (Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize) (rounds.set k s1) s1
        (by rw [hkk]; omega) (by rw [hkk]; omega)
        (fun r i hr => by
          rw [hkk] at hr
          rw [set_get_a rounds k s1 hkb r]
          by_cases e : r = k.val
          · rw [if_pos e, e]
            exact congrFun hnew i
          · rw [if_neg e]
            exact hinv r i (by omega))
        (by rw [hkk]; exact hnew)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, hR⟩
      rw [perm_rounds_loop, if_pos hlt]
      simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, ha, hs1, update_ok_a rounds k s1 hkb]
      exact ho

/-- **RoundsOk for the copy.**  If the Rust pre-state and absorption lift to the
model block, the extracted copy's `perm_rounds` returns rounds satisfying
`RoundsOk` for that block. -/
theorem perm_rounds_lift (pre absorb : Array U32 16#usize) (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K)
    (he : EndsLift pre absorb B) :
    ∃ rounds, perm_rounds pre absorb = ok rounds ∧ RoundsOk rounds B := by
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (4#usize).val := by rw [z0, v4]; omega
  have hb1 : (1#usize : Usize).val < (4#usize).val := by rw [z1, v4]; omega
  have hb11 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (11#usize).val := by rw [z0, v11]; omega
  obtain ⟨st, hst, hstv⟩ := leading_pair_lift (K := K) pre absorb
    (EXTERNAL_INITIAL.val[(0#usize : Usize).val]!) (EXTERNAL_INITIAL.val[(1#usize : Usize).val]!)
    (fun i => by rw [z0]; exact ei_rows 0 i) (fun i => by rw [z1]; exact ei_rows 1 i)
  have hpre : liftA (K := K) pre = B.pre := funext he.pre
  have habs : liftA (K := K) absorb = B.absorb := funext he.absorb
  have h1 : liftA (K := K) st = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B 1 := by
    show liftA st = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (0 + 1)
    rw [hstv, hpre, habs, iter_succ B 0 (by omega), iter_zero, trans_zero]
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hR⟩ := perm_loop (K := K) B 10 1#usize
    ((Array.repeat 11#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32)).set 0#usize st) st
    (by rw [z1]) (le_of_eq z1.symm)
    (fun r i hr => by
      rw [z1] at hr
      obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
      rw [set_get_a _ 0#usize st hb11 0, z0, if_pos rfl]
      exact congrFun h1 i)
    (by rw [z1]; exact h1)
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hR⟩
  rw [perm_rounds]
  simp only [index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_INITIAL 0#usize hb0, index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_INITIAL 1#usize hb1,
    bind_tc_ok, hst, update_ok_a _ 0#usize st hb11]
  exact ho

end R0Z.PoseidonRefine
