import R0Z.WriterRefineValue

/-! The extracted value-aux writer, outer loop over the three values
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

/-- Which value (0, 1, 2) owns local row r; 3 = none. -/
def jOf (r : Nat) : Nat :=
  if r = 0 then 0 else if r = 1 then 0 else if r = 12 then 0
  else if r = 2 then 1 else if r = 3 then 1 else if r = 14 then 1
  else if r = 4 then 2 else if r = 5 then 2 else if r = 8 then 2 else 3

/-- The value cells written by values j0..2 over a block `blk`. -/
def OuterVal (vals : Nat → Nat) (j0 : Nat) (blk : Nat → Nat) (k : Nat) : Nat :=
  if jOf (k / 16) < 3 ∧ j0 ≤ jOf (k / 16) then
    (if k % 16 < 10 then vals (jOf (k / 16)) / 2 ^ tOf (2 * jOf (k / 16)) k % 2
     else if k % 16 = 10 ∧ k / 16 = 2 * jOf (k / 16) then vals (jOf (k / 16)) else blk k)
  else blk k

theorem rowJ (j r : Nat) (hj : j < 3) :
    (r = 2 * j ∨ r = 2 * j + 1 ∨ r = xr (2 * j)) ↔ jOf r = j := by
  by_cases hr : r < 15
  · interval_cases r <;> interval_cases j <;> decide
  · have h3 : jOf r = 3 := by
      unfold jOf
      rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
        if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    have hx : xr (2 * j) ≤ 14 := by unfold xr; split_ifs <;> omega
    rw [h3]
    constructor
    · intro h; omega
    · intro h; omega

theorem inRows_iff (j k : Nat) (hj : j < 3) :
    InRows (2 * j) k ↔ jOf (k / 16) = j ∧ k % 16 < 10 := by
  unfold InRows
  rw [rowJ j (k / 16) hj]

theorem jOf_base (j : Nat) (hj : j < 3) : jOf (2 * j) = j := by
  unfold jOf; interval_cases j <;> rfl

theorem value_outer (values : Array U32 3#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (j : Usize) (block : Array U32 256#usize), j.val + n = 3 →
      ∃ b', write_value_block_loop0 values block j = ok b' ∧
        ∀ k, (b'.val[k]!).val =
          OuterVal (fun i => (values.val[i]!).val) j.val (fun k => (block.val[k]!).val) k
  | 0, j, block, h => by
      refine ⟨block, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_value_block_loop0, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
      · unfold OuterVal; rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  | n + 1, j, block, h => by
      have hj3 : j.val < 3 := by omega
      have hlt : j < 3#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have h2j : (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 2 * j.val := umul _ _ (by simp; omega)
      have hbase : (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 0 ∨ (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 2 ∨
          (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 4 := by rw [h2j]; omega
      have h16 : (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize).val = 2 * j.val * 16 :=
        by rw [umul _ _ (by rw [h2j]; simp; omega), h2j]; simp
      have h10 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize)
          10#usize).val = 2 * j.val * 16 + 10 := by rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h16]; simp; omega), h16]; simp
      have hj1 : (Usize.wrapping_add j 1#usize).val = j.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hi10 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize)
          10#usize).val < (256#usize).val := by rw [h10]; simp; omega
      let raw := values.val[j.val]!
      obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hs1⟩ := value_inner raw (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) hbase 30 0#u32 block
        (by simp)
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hs⟩ := value_outer values n (Usize.wrapping_add j 1#usize)
        (b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize)
          10#usize) raw) (by rw [hj1]; omega)
      refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_value_block_loop0, if_pos hlt, index_ok values j (by simpa using hj3)]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        rw [hb1]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok b1 _ _ hi10]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hb'
      · have ha : ∀ k, ((b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j)
            16#usize) 10#usize) raw).val[k]!).val = (if k = 2 * j.val * 16 + 10 then raw.val else
            (if InRows (2 * j.val) k then raw.val / 2 ^ tOf (2 * j.val) k % 2 else (block.val[k]!).val)) := by
          intro k
          rw [set_get' b1 _ _ hi10 k, h10]
          split
          · rfl
          · rw [hs1 k, h2j]
            simp only [show (0#u32 : U32).val = 0 by simp, Nat.zero_le, and_true]
        rw [hs k, hj1]
        unfold OuterVal
        simp only [ha]
        have f1 := inRows_iff j.val k hj3
        have hraw : raw.val = (values.val[j.val]!).val := rfl
        simp only [f1, hraw]
        by_cases hk : jOf (k / 16) = j.val
        · simp only [hk, true_and, le_refl, and_true]
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
        · have nk : ¬ k = 2 * j.val * 16 + 10 := by
            intro e; apply hk; rw [e, show (2 * j.val * 16 + 10) / 16 = 2 * j.val by omega]
            exact jOf_base _ hj3
          simp only [hk, nk, false_and, if_false]
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

#print axioms rowJ
#print axioms inRows_iff
#print axioms value_outer
end R0Z.WriterRefine

import R0Z.WriterRefineValueBlock
import R0Z.WriterRefineOccRow
import R0Z.BuilderModelCopyMisc

/-! The extracted value-aux writer computes the model's value rows
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9): `write_value_block values` returns `ok b` and every
lifted cell of block 63 outside the occupancy rows 9 and 10 equals the model's
`auxCell C (1008 + r) c`, for a characteristic-(2^31−1) field and values below
2^30 equal to the model's `C.values`; rows 9 and 10 are zero. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

theorem m31_sub_spec (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2 ^ 30) (hb : b.val < 2 ^ 30) :
    ∃ z, m31_sub a b = ok z ∧ z.val = (if b.val ≤ a.val then a.val - b.val else a.val + 2147483647 - b.val) := by
  have hP : (P : U32).val = 2147483647 := by rw [P]; simp
  have h1 : (U32.wrapping_add a P).val = a.val + 2147483647 := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq, hP]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by rw [UScalar.size_def]; simp; omega)
  have h2 : (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add a P) b).val = a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq, h1, UScalar.size_def]
    simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]
    rw [show a.val + 2147483647 + (2 ^ 32 - b.val) = (a.val + 2147483647 - b.val) + 2 ^ 32 by omega,
      Nat.add_mod_right]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  rw [m31_sub]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases hs : U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add a P) b >= P
  · rw [if_pos hs]
    have hs' : 2147483647 ≤ a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, hP, h2] at hs; exact hs
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq, h2, hP, UScalar.size_def]
    simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]
    rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    rw [show a.val + 2147483647 - b.val + (2 ^ 32 - 2147483647) = (a.val - b.val) + 2 ^ 32 by omega,
      Nat.add_mod_right]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  · rw [if_neg hs]
    have hs' : ¬ 2147483647 ≤ a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, hP, h2] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [h2, if_neg (by omega)]⟩

/-- The cells of the value block (rows 6 and 7 hold the conservation cells). -/
def FinalVal (vals : Nat → Nat) (k : Nat) : Nat :=
  if k = 96 then vals 0 else if k = 97 then vals 1
  else if k = 98 ∨ k = 112 then (if vals 1 ≤ vals 0 then vals 0 - vals 1 else vals 0 + 2147483647 - vals 1)
  else if k = 113 then vals 2 else OuterVal vals 0 (fun _ => 0) k

theorem value_block (values : Array U32 3#usize) (hv : ∀ i, i < 3 → (values.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 30) :
    ∃ b, write_value_block values = ok b ∧
      ∀ k, (b.val[k]!).val = FinalVal (fun i => (values.val[i]!).val) k := by
  obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hs1⟩ := value_outer values 3 0#usize (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  have h0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (3#usize).val := by simp
  have h1 : (1#usize : Usize).val < (3#usize).val := by simp
  have h2 : (2#usize : Usize).val < (3#usize).val := by simp
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := m31_sub_spec (values.val[(0#usize : Usize).val]!) (values.val[(1#usize : Usize).val]!)
    (hv 0 (by simp)) (hv 1 (by simp))
  have e96 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize).val = 96 := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp)]; simp
  have e97 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 1#usize).val = 97 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e96]; simp), e96]; simp
  have e98 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 2#usize).val = 98 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e96]; simp), e96]; simp
  have e112 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize).val = 112 := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp)]; simp
  have e113 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize) 1#usize).val = 113 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e112]; simp), e112]; simp
  have lt : ∀ (i : Usize) (n : Nat), i.val = n → n < 256 → i.val < (256#usize).val := by
    intro i n h hn; rw [h]; simpa using hn
  let v0 := values.val[(0#usize : Usize).val]!
  let v1 := values.val[(1#usize : Usize).val]!
  let v2 := values.val[(2#usize : Usize).val]!
  let c1 := b1.set (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) v0
  let c2 := c1.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 1#usize) v1
  let c3 := c2.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 2#usize) z
  let c4 := c3.set (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize) z
  let c5 := c4.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize) 1#usize) v2
  refine ⟨c5, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · rw [write_value_block]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
    rw [hb1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [index_ok values _ h0, index_ok values _ h1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hz]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e96 (by omega))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e97 (by omega))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e98 (by omega))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e112 (by omega))]

theorem tOf_rc (b r c : Nat) (hc : c < 16) :
    tOf b (r * 16 + c) = if r = b then c else if r = b + 1 then 10 + c else 20 + c := by
  unfold tOf
  rw [show (r * 16 + c) / 16 = r by omega, show (r * 16 + c) % 16 = c by omega]

theorem ov_rc (vals : Nat → Nat) (r c : Nat) (hc : c < 16) :
    OuterVal vals 0 (fun _ => 0) (r * 16 + c) =
      if jOf r < 3 then (if c < 10 then vals (jOf r) / 2 ^ tOf (2 * jOf r) (r * 16 + c) % 2
        else if c = 10 ∧ r = 2 * jOf r then vals (jOf r) else 0) else 0 := by
  unfold OuterVal
  rw [show (r * 16 + c) / 16 = r by omega, show (r * 16 + c) % 16 = c by omega]
  by_cases h : jOf r < 3
  · rw [if_pos ⟨h, Nat.zero_le _⟩, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h' => h h'.1), if_neg h]

import R0Z.WriterRefineValueModel

/-! The extracted aux-block writer (value aux + both occupancy rows) computes
block 63 of the model (rows 1008..1023), cell by cell (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem aux_block_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (values : Array U32 3#usize) (input output : OccRecord)
    (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K) (hv : ValueLifts values C) (hi : OccLifts input C.inOcc)
    (ho : OccLifts output C.outOcc) :
    ∃ b, write_aux_block values input output = ok b ∧
      ∀ (r c : Fin 16), liftU (K := K) (b.val[r.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        R0Z.BuilderModel.auxCell C (1008 + r.val) c := by
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0, hs0⟩ := value_block values hv.small
  have n9 : (9#usize : Usize).val = 9 := by simp
  have n10 : (10#usize : Usize).val = 10 := by simp
  obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hr1, hu1⟩ := occ_row_model b0 9#usize (by rw [n9]; omega) input C.inOcc hi
    (fun c hc => by rw [n9]; exact value_rows_zero values b0 hs0 9 (Or.inl rfl) c hc)
  obtain ⟨b2, hb2, hr2, hu2⟩ := occ_row_model b1 10#usize (by rw [n10]; omega) output C.outOcc ho
    (fun c hc => by
      rw [n10, hu1 _ (by rw [n9]; omega)]
      exact value_rows_zero values b0 hs0 10 (Or.inr rfl) c hc)
  refine ⟨b2, ?_, fun r c => ?_⟩
  · rw [write_aux_block, hb0]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hb1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb2
  · have hc := c.isLt
    by_cases e10 : r.val = 10
    · have := hr2 c
      rw [n10] at this
      rw [e10, this, show (1008 + 10 : Nat) = 1018 by norm_num, R0Z.BuilderModel.aux_1018]
    rw [hu2 _ (by rw [n10]; omega)]
    by_cases e9 : r.val = 9
    · have := hr1 c
      rw [n9] at this
      rw [e9, this, show (1008 + 9 : Nat) = 1017 by norm_num, R0Z.BuilderModel.aux_1017]
    rw [hu1 _ (by rw [n9]; omega)]
    have hr := r.isLt
    obtain ⟨rv, hrv⟩ : ∃ rv, r.val = rv := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hrv]
    rw [hrv] at e9 e10 hr
    interval_cases rv
    · exact value_row_0 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_1 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_2 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_3 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_4 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_5 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_6 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_7 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_8 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact absurd rfl e9
    · exact absurd rfl e10
    · exact value_row_11 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_12 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_13 values C hv b0 hs0 c
    · exact value_row_14 values C hv b0 hs0 c

R0Z.WriterRefinePathModel.text:
import R0Z.WriterRefinePathBlock

/-! The extracted path-aux writer equals the model's path rows 912..1007
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The Rust inputs lift to the model's path records. -/
structure PathLifts (bits : Array U32 24#usize) (cur l r : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize)
    (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K) : Prop where
  bit : ∀ v : Fin 24, liftU (K := K) (bits.val[v.val]!) = (C.path v).bit
  current : ∀ (v : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8), liftU (K := K) ((cur.val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = (C.path v).current i
  left : ∀ (v : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8), liftU (K := K) ((l.val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = (C.path v).left i
  right : ∀ (v : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8), liftU (K := K) ((r.val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = (C.path v).right i

theorem rep0 (k : Nat) : (((Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32 : Array U32 1536#usize).val[k]! : U32)) = 0#u32 := by
  rw [Array.repeat_val]
  by_cases hk : k < (1536#usize : Usize).val
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_pos hk]; rfl
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_neg hk]; rfl

theorem liftU_zero : liftU (K := K) 0#u32 = 0 := by unfold liftU; simp

theorem path_block_model (bits : Array U32 24#usize) (cur l r : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize)
    (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K) (hp : PathLifts bits cur l r C) :
    ∃ b, write_path_block bits cur l r = ok b ∧
      ∀ (rr : Nat) (hr : rr < 96) (c : Fin 16), liftU (K := K) (b.val[rr * 16 + c.val]!) =
        R0Z.BuilderModel.auxCell C (912 + rr) c := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := path_block_loop bits cur l r 24 0#usize (Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  refine ⟨b, by rw [write_path_block]; exact hb, fun rr hr c => ?_⟩
  have hc := c.isLt
  rw [hs, rep0]
  simp only [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, Nat.zero_le, true_and]
  unfold R0Z.BuilderModel.auxCell
  rw [dif_pos (show 912 ≤ 912 + rr ∧ 912 + rr < 1008 by omega)]
  have hk16 : (rr * 16 + c.val) / 16 = rr := by omega
  have hlv : lvl (rr * 16 + c.val) = 4 * ((912 + rr - 912) / 16) + (912 + rr) % 16 / 4 := by
    unfold lvl; omega
  have hlv24 : lvl (rr * 16 + c.val) < 24 := by unfold lvl; omega
  by_cases a1 : (912 + rr) % 16 % 4 = 1
  · rw [if_pos a1]
    have hw : InWin (rr * 16 + c.val) := by unfold InWin; omega
    rw [if_pos ⟨hw, hlv24⟩]
    have hpb : pbase (lvl (rr * 16 + c.val)) = rr * 16 := by unfold pbase lvl; omega
    have e : (⟨4 * ((912 + rr - 912) / 16) + (912 + rr) % 16 / 4, by omega⟩ : Fin 24) =
        ⟨lvl (rr * 16 + c.val), hlv24⟩ := Fin.ext hlv.symm
    rw [e]
    unfold PV R0Z.BuilderModel.pathBaseCell
    rw [hpb]
    by_cases c0 : c.val = 0
    · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos c0]
      exact hp.bit ⟨_, hlv24⟩
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg c0]
      by_cases c9 : c.val < 9
      · rw [if_pos (by omega), dif_pos c9]
        rw [show rr * 16 + c.val - rr * 16 - 1 = (⟨c.val - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin 8).val by simp <;> omega]
        exact hp.current ⟨_, hlv24⟩ _
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), dif_neg c9]
        exact liftU_zero
  · rw [if_neg a1]
    by_cases a2 : (912 + rr) % 16 % 4 = 2
    · rw [if_pos a2]
      have hw : InWin (rr * 16 + c.val) := by unfold InWin; omega
      rw [if_pos ⟨hw, hlv24⟩]
      have hpb : pbase (lvl (rr * 16 + c.val)) = rr * 16 - 16 := by unfold pbase lvl; omega
      have e : (⟨4 * ((912 + rr - 912) / 16) + (912 + rr) % 16 / 4, by omega⟩ : Fin 24) =
          ⟨lvl (rr * 16 + c.val), hlv24⟩ := Fin.ext hlv.symm
      rw [e]
      unfold PV R0Z.BuilderModel.pathSuccCell
      rw [hpb, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
      by_cases c8 : c.val < 8
      · rw [if_pos (by omega), dif_pos c8]
        rw [show rr * 16 + c.val - (rr * 16 - 16) - 16 = (⟨c.val, c8⟩ : Fin 8).val by simp <;> omega]
        exact hp.left ⟨_, hlv24⟩ _
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega), dif_neg c8]
        rw [show rr * 16 + c.val - (rr * 16 - 16) - 24 = (⟨c.val - 8, by omega⟩ : Fin 8).val by simp <;> omega]
        exact hp.right ⟨_, hlv24⟩ _
    · rw [if_neg a2]
      have hw : ¬ InWin (rr * 16 + c.val) := by unfold InWin; omega
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hw h.1)]
      exact liftU_zero

#print axioms path_block_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine

R0Z.BuilderWitnessTrace.text:
import R0Z.BuilderWitnessTree
import R0Z.WriterRefineAuxBlock
import R0Z.WriterRefinePathModel

/-! The witness-level Rust-copy builder, part 3: aux rows and the whole trace
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §12 (2)).

The path aux arrays (bits, current, left, right per level), the value triple
and the two occupancy records are computed from the records and the copy's
digests; `PathLifts`, `ValueLifts` and both `OccLifts` become theorems.  The
output occupancy inverse is the glue function `invR` (x^(p-2) mod p, the
value M31::inv returns); its lift is the field inverse given the named fact
`Nat.Prime 2147483647` (Fermat).  `copyCell W P c r` assembles the 29 x 1024
trace from the 57 chained copy blocks, the path block (rows 912..1007) and the
aux block (rows 1008..1023), columns 16..28 zero; `builder_witness_model`:
every component returns `ok` and every cell lifts to `buildModel pub (toModel W)`.
Not modelled: the Rust bank merge (rows 544..863 written into the late bank
and merged; `merge_model` covers the merge itself). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

def arr24 {α : Type} (f : Fin 24 → α) : Array α 24#usize := ⟨List.ofFn f, by simp⟩

theorem arr24_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Fin 24 → α) (i : Nat) (h : i < 24) :
    (arr24 f).val[i]! = f ⟨i, h⟩ := by
  show (List.ofFn f)[i]! = _
  rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_ofFn, dif_pos h]
  rfl

def levelPair (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (l : Fin 24) : Array U32 8#usize × Array U32 8#usize :=
  orderedR (okOr (treeCurR W P l.val) zero8) (W.sibs.val[l.val]!) (bitB W l.val)

def curArr (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize :=
  arr24 (fun l => okOr (treeCurR W P l.val) zero8)
def leftArr (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize :=
  arr24 (fun l => (levelPair W P l).1)
def rightArr (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize :=
  arr24 (fun l => (levelPair W P l).2)

def valuesArr (W : RustWitness) : Array U32 3#usize := ⟨[W.inputValue, W.outputValue, W.changeValue], by simp⟩

/-- x^(p-2) mod p as a u32 (glue for M31::inv in two_outputs). -/
def invR (x : U32) : U32 := ⟨BitVec.ofNat 32 (x.val ^ 2147483645 % 2147483647)⟩

def inRec (W : RustWitness) : R0WriterCopies.OccRecord :=
  ⟨W.pairOccupied, W.pairInverse, W.pairSecond, W.bits.val[0]!, true⟩

def outRec (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : R0WriterCopies.OccRecord :=
  match P.variant with
  | .privateTransfer =>
      ⟨1#u32, invR ((okOr (changeDR W P) zero8).val[7]!), okOr (changeDR W P) zero8, 0#u32, false⟩
  | .withdrawal => ⟨0#u32, 0#u32, zero8, 0#u32, false⟩

def pathR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Result (Array U32 1536#usize) :=
  R0WriterCopies.write_path_block W.bits (curArr W P) (leftArr W P) (rightArr W P)

def auxR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Result (Array U32 256#usize) :=
  R0WriterCopies.write_aux_block (valuesArr W) (inRec W) (outRec W P)

def blockR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (h : Nat) : Array U32 256#usize :=
  okOr (RustWriterChain P.variant (rustChunks W P) h) (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32)

/-- **The assembled copy trace** (29 columns x 1024 rows of u32). -/
def copyCell (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) : U32 :=
  if c.val < 16 then
    if r.val < 912 then (blockR W P (r.val / 16)).val[(r.val % 16) * 16 + c.val]!
    else if r.val < 1008 then (okOr (pathR W P) (Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32)).val[(r.val - 912) * 16 + c.val]!
    else (okOr (auxR W P) (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32)).val[(r.val - 1008) * 16 + c.val]!
  else 0#u32

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

theorem invR_lift (hp : Nat.Prime 2147483647) (x : U32) :
    liftU (K := K) (invR x) = (liftU (K := K) x)⁻¹ := by
  have hv : (invR x).val = x.val ^ 2147483645 % 2147483647 := by
    show (BitVec.ofNat 32 _).toNat = _
    rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_trans (Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)) (by norm_num))
  unfold liftU
  rw [hv, R0Z.PoseidonRefine.cast_mod, Nat.cast_pow]
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 2147483647) := ⟨hp⟩
  by_cases ha : ((x.val : Nat) : K) = 0
  · rw [ha, zero_pow (by norm_num), inv_zero]
  · have hz : ((x.val : ZMod 2147483647)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply ha
      rw [← map_natCast (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl 2147483647) K) x.val, hz, map_zero]
    have h2 := congrArg (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl 2147483647) K) (ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one hz)
    rw [map_pow, map_natCast, map_one] at h2
    refine eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left ?_
    rw [← pow_succ]
    exact h2

section trace
variable (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (pub : R0P.Public K) (hP : PubCorr P pub) (hW : WitnessOk W)

include hP hW in
theorem rust_path_lifts : PathLifts (K := K) W.bits (curArr W P) (leftArr W P) (rightArr W P)
    (cellsOf pub (toModel W)) := by
  refine ⟨fun v => ?_, fun v i => ?_, fun v i => ?_, fun v i => ?_⟩
  · show liftU (W.bits.val[v.val]!) = dirK (decide ((W.bits.val[v.val]!).val ≠ 0))
    unfold dirK liftU
    rcases hW.bits v.val v.isLt with h0 | h1
    · rw [h0]; simp
    · rw [h1]; simp
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, -⟩ := treeCur_lift W P pub hP hW v.val (by omega)
    show liftU (((curArr W P).val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = treeCur _ _ v.val i
    rw [curArr, arr24_get _ _ v.isLt]
    dsimp only
    rw [hc, okOr_ok]
    exact hcl i
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, hcc⟩ := treeCur_lift W P pub hP hW v.val (by omega)
    have ol := ordered_lift c (W.sibs.val[v.val]!) _ (digK (K := K) (W.sibs.val[v.val]!)) (bitB W v.val)
      hcl (fun i => rfl) hcc (hW.sibs _ v.isLt)
    show liftU (((leftArr W P).val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = _
    rw [leftArr, arr24_get _ _ v.isLt]
    dsimp only [levelPair]
    rw [hc, okOr_ok]
    exact ol.1 i
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, hcc⟩ := treeCur_lift W P pub hP hW v.val (by omega)
    have ol := ordered_lift c (W.sibs.val[v.val]!) _ (digK (K := K) (W.sibs.val[v.val]!)) (bitB W v.val)
      hcl (fun i => rfl) hcc (hW.sibs _ v.isLt)
    show liftU (((rightArr W P).val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = _
    rw [rightArr, arr24_get _ _ v.isLt]
    dsimp only [levelPair]
    rw [hc, okOr_ok]
    exact ol.2.1 i

include hW in
theorem rust_value_lifts : ValueLifts (K := K) (valuesArr W) (cellsOf pub (toModel W)) := by
  have hv := hW.values
  refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · have : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact hv.1
    · exact hv.2.1
    · exact hv.2.2
  · obtain ⟨iv, hi⟩ := i
    have : iv = 0 ∨ iv = 1 ∨ iv = 2 := by omega
    rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · show W.inputValue.val % 2 ^ 30 = _; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hv.1
    · show W.outputValue.val % 2 ^ 30 = _; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hv.2.1
    · show W.changeValue.val % 2 ^ 30 = _; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hv.2.2

include hW in
theorem rust_in_occ : OccLifts (K := K) (inRec W) (cellsOf pub (toModel W)).inOcc := by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, fun i => rfl, ?_⟩
  show liftU (W.bits.val[0]!) = dirK (decide ((W.bits.val[0]!).val ≠ 0))
  unfold dirK liftU
  rcases hW.bits 0 (by omega) with h0 | h1
  · rw [h0]; simp
  · rw [h1]; simp

include hP hW in
theorem rust_out_occ (hp : Nat.Prime 2147483647) :
    OccLifts (K := K) (outRec W P) (cellsOf pub (toModel W)).outOcc := by
  show OccLifts (outRec W P) (outOccOf pub (toModel W))
  unfold outRec outOccOf
  rw [hP.variant]
  cases hv : pub.variant
  · obtain ⟨dc, hdc, hdcl, -⟩ := noteDigest_lift pub (toModel (K := K) W) (chunksOf W P)
      (chunks_sabs W P pub hP hW) 32 (nk 32 (by omega)) (zk _ 32 (by omega))
    replace hdc : changeDR W P = ok dc := hdc
    rw [hdc, okOr_ok]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hdcl, ?_⟩
    · show liftU (K := K) 1#u32 = 1; unfold liftU; simp
    · show liftU (K := K) (invR (dc.val[7]!)) = (changeDigest pub (toModel W) 7)⁻¹
      rw [invR_lift hp]
      exact congrArg (·⁻¹) (hdcl 7)
    · show (0 : K) = 0; rfl
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, zero8_lift, ?_⟩
    · show liftU (K := K) 0#u32 = 0; unfold liftU; simp
    · show liftU (K := K) 0#u32 = 0; unfold liftU; simp
    · show (0 : K) = 0; rfl

include hP hW in
/-- **The witness-level copy builder equals the model.**  Every component of the
composition returns `ok`, and every cell of the assembled trace lifts to
`buildModel pub (toModel W)`. -/
theorem builder_witness_model (hp : Nat.Prime 2147483647) :
    (∀ h : Fin 57, ∃ b, RustWriterChain P.variant (rustChunks W P) h.val = ok b) ∧
    (∃ pb, pathR W P = ok pb) ∧ (∃ ab, auxR W P = ok ab) ∧
    ∀ (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024), liftU (K := K) (copyCell W P c r) = buildModel pub (toModel W) c r := by
  obtain ⟨pb, hpb, hpbv⟩ := path_block_model W.bits (curArr W P) (leftArr W P) (rightArr W P)
    (cellsOf pub (toModel (K := K) W)) (rust_path_lifts W P pub hP hW)
  obtain ⟨ab, hab, habv⟩ := aux_block_model (valuesArr W) (inRec W) (outRec W P)
    (cellsOf pub (toModel (K := K) W)) (rust_value_lifts W pub hW) (rust_in_occ W pub hW)
    (rust_out_occ W P pub hP hW hp)
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ⟨pb, hpb⟩, ⟨ab, hab⟩, fun c r => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := builder_witness_blocks W P pub hP hW h
    exact ⟨b, hb⟩
  have hr := r.isLt
  by_cases hc : c.val < 16
  · by_cases h912 : r.val < 912
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hbv⟩ := builder_witness_blocks W P pub hP hW ⟨r.val / 16, by omega⟩
      have e : copyCell W P c r = b.val[(r.val % 16) * 16 + c.val]! := by
        unfold copyCell
        rw [if_pos hc, if_pos h912]
        show (okOr (RustWriterChain P.variant (rustChunks W P) (r.val / 16)) _).val[_]! = _
        rw [show (RustWriterChain P.variant (rustChunks W P) (r.val / 16)) = ok b from hb, okOr_ok]
      rw [e]
      have := hbv ⟨r.val % 16, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ ⟨c.val, hc⟩
      rw [this]
      congr 1
      exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
    · by_cases h1008 : r.val < 1008
      · have e : copyCell W P c r = pb.val[(r.val - 912) * 16 + c.val]! := by
          unfold copyCell
          rw [if_pos hc, if_neg h912, if_pos h1008, show pathR W P = ok pb from hpb, okOr_ok]
        rw [e, hpbv (r.val - 912) (by omega) ⟨c.val, hc⟩, buildModel,
          layout_aux _ c r hc (by omega), show 912 + (r.val - 912) = r.val by omega]
      · have e : copyCell W P c r = ab.val[(r.val - 1008) * 16 + c.val]! := by
          unfold copyCell
          rw [if_pos hc, if_neg h912, if_neg h1008, show auxR W P = ok ab from hab, okOr_ok]
        have := habv ⟨r.val - 1008, by omega⟩ ⟨c.val, hc⟩
        rw [e, this, buildModel, layout_aux _ c r hc (by omega)]
        dsimp only
        rw [show 1008 + (r.val - 1008) = r.val by omega]
  · have e : copyCell W P c r = 0#u32 := by unfold copyCell; rw [if_neg hc]
    rw [e, buildModel, layout_high _ c r (by omega)]
    unfold liftU; simp

end trace

#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.invR_lift
#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.rust_path_lifts
#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.rust_out_occ
#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.builder_witness_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine

R0Z.M31Prime.text:
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasPrimality
import Mathlib.Tactic.ReduceModChar
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum.Prime

/-! `Nat.Prime 2147483647` by a Lucas certificate (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §13 (3)).

Witness 7; p - 1 = 2 · 3² · 7 · 11 · 31 · 151 · 331.  Each power
7^((p-1)/q) in ZMod p is reduced by `reduce_mod_char`, which uses Mathlib's
`evalNatPowMod` (binary exponentiation with certified steps, intermediate
values < p²); the seven small primes by norm_num.  No trial division and no
unbounded numeral is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z

theorem m31_prime : Nat.Prime 2147483647 := by
  refine lucas_primality 2147483647 7 ?_ ?_
  · show (7 : ZMod 2147483647) ^ 2147483646 = 1
    reduce_mod_char
  · intro q hq hdvd
    have hfac : 2147483647 - 1 = 2 * 3 * 3 * 7 * 11 * 31 * 151 * 331 := by norm_num
    rw [hfac] at hdvd
    simp only [hq.dvd_mul, Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq Nat.prime_two,
      Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq Nat.prime_three,
      Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq (show Nat.Prime 7 by norm_num),
      Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq (show Nat.Prime 11 by norm_num),
      Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq (show Nat.Prime 31 by norm_num),
      Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq (show Nat.Prime 151 by norm_num),
      Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq (show Nat.Prime 331 by norm_num)] at hdvd
    rcases hdvd with ((((((rfl | rfl) | rfl) | rfl) | rfl) | rfl) | rfl) | rfl

R0Z.BuilderWitnessMerged.text:
import R0Z.BuilderWitnessTrace
import R0Z.WriterRefineMerge
import R0Z.M31Prime

/-! The witness-level copy builder with the bank merge (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §13 (2)).

As in pair_trace.rs, the 20 append blocks (34..53, rows 544..863) are written
into a separate late bank and every other row into the stable bank; the
extracted `merge_check` / `merge_copy` (pair_forest_trace.rs:281-314) combine
them.  Both banks are 16 x 1024 column-major (index = column * 1024 + row).
`builder_witness_merged`: the shape check passes, the merge returns `ok`, and
every cell of the merged trace (columns 16..28 zero) lifts to
`buildModel pub (toModel W)`.  `Nat.Prime 2147483647` is now `R0Z.m31_prime`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

theorem n16384 : (16384#usize : Usize).val = 16384 := by simp

def arrT (f : Fin 16384 → U32) : Array U32 16384#usize :=
  ⟨List.ofFn f, by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact n16384.symm⟩

theorem arrT_val (f : Fin 16384 → U32) : (arrT f).val = List.ofFn f := by rw [arrT]

theorem arrT_get (f : Fin 16384 → U32) (i : Nat) (h : i < 16384) : (arrT f).val[i]! = f ⟨i, h⟩ := by
  rw [arrT_val, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_ofFn, dif_pos h]
  exact Option.getD_some

/-- The unmerged cell table, column-major. -/
def cellT (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (k : Fin 16384) : U32 :=
  copyCell W P ⟨k.val / 1024, by omega⟩ ⟨k.val % 1024, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩

/-- The stable bank: every row outside 544..863. -/
def stableBank (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Array U32 16384#usize :=
  arrT (fun k => if LateRow k.val then 0#u32 else cellT W P k)

/-- The late bank: the append blocks 34..53 in rows 544..863, zero elsewhere. -/
def lateBank (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Array U32 16384#usize :=
  arrT (fun k => if LateRow k.val then
      (blockR W P (k.val % 1024 / 16)).val[(k.val % 1024 % 16) * 16 + k.val / 1024]!
    else 0#u32)

def mergedR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Result (Array U32 16384#usize) :=
  R0WriterCopies.merge_copy (stableBank W P) (lateBank W P)

/-- **The merged copy trace** (29 x 1024). -/
def copyCellMerged (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) : U32 :=
  if c.val < 16 then (okOr (mergedR W P) (Array.repeat 16384#usize 0#u32)).val[c.val * 1024 + r.val]!
  else 0#u32

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

theorem builder_witness_merged (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (pub : R0P.Public K)
    (hP : PubCorr P pub) (hW : WitnessOk W) :
    R0WriterCopies.merge_check (stableBank W P) (lateBank W P) = ok true ∧
    (∃ out, mergedR W P = ok out) ∧
    (∀ h : Fin 57, ∃ b, RustWriterChain P.variant (rustChunks W P) h.val = ok b) ∧
    (∃ pb, pathR W P = ok pb) ∧ (∃ ab, auxR W P = ok ab) ∧
    ∀ (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024),
      liftU (K := K) (copyCellMerged W P c r) = buildModel pub (toModel W) c r := by
  obtain ⟨hblk, hpath, haux, hcell⟩ := builder_witness_model W P pub hP hW R0Z.m31_prime
  let M : Nat → U32 := fun k => if h : k < 16384 then cellT W P ⟨k, h⟩ else 0#u32
  have hs : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (stableBank W P).val[k]! = if LateRow k then 0#u32 else M k := by
    intro k hk
    rw [stableBank, arrT_get _ k hk]
    show (if LateRow k then 0#u32 else cellT W P ⟨k, hk⟩) = if LateRow k then 0#u32 else
      (if h : k < 16384 then cellT W P ⟨k, h⟩ else 0#u32)
    rw [dif_pos hk]
  have hl : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (lateBank W P).val[k]! = if LateRow k then M k else 0#u32 := by
    intro k hk
    rw [lateBank, arrT_get _ k hk]
    show (if LateRow k then _ else 0#u32) = if LateRow k then
      (if h : k < 16384 then cellT W P ⟨k, h⟩ else 0#u32) else 0#u32
    rw [dif_pos hk]
    by_cases hr : LateRow k
    · rw [if_pos hr, if_pos hr]
      unfold LateRow at hr
      unfold cellT copyCell
      dsimp only
      rw [if_pos (show k / 1024 < 16 by omega), if_pos (show k % 1024 < 912 by omega)]
    · rw [if_neg hr, if_neg hr]
  obtain ⟨hchk, out, hout, houtv⟩ := merge_model M (stableBank W P) (lateBank W P) hs hl
  refine ⟨hchk, ⟨out, hout⟩, hblk, hpath, haux, fun c r => ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : c.val < 16
  · have hk : c.val * 1024 + r.val < 16384 := by have := r.isLt; omega
    have e : copyCellMerged W P c r = cellT W P ⟨c.val * 1024 + r.val, hk⟩ := by
      unfold copyCellMerged
      rw [if_pos hc, show mergedR W P = ok out from hout, okOr_ok, houtv _ hk]
      show (if h : c.val * 1024 + r.val < 16384 then cellT W P ⟨_, h⟩ else 0#u32) = _
      rw [dif_pos hk]
    rw [e]
    have e2 : cellT W P ⟨c.val * 1024 + r.val, hk⟩ = copyCell W P c r := by
      unfold cellT
      have h1 : (⟨(c.val * 1024 + r.val) / 1024, by omega⟩ : Fin 29) = c := Fin.ext (by show (c.val * 1024 + r.val) / 1024 = c.val; have := r.isLt; omega)
      have h2 : (⟨(c.val * 1024 + r.val) % 1024, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ : Fin 1024) = r :=
        Fin.ext (by show (c.val * 1024 + r.val) % 1024 = r.val; have := r.isLt; omega)
      rw [h1, h2]
    rw [e2]
    exact hcell c r
  · have e : copyCellMerged W P c r = copyCell W P c r := by
      unfold copyCellMerged copyCell
      rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc]
    rw [e]
    exact hcell c r

#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.builder_witness_merged
end R0Z.WriterRefine

R1Z.BuilderRefinement.text:
import R0Z.BuilderModelRefines
import R0Z.BuilderWitnessMerged

/-! The four privacy builder fields for the extracted merged writer composition.

The trace here is the lifted output of `copyCellMerged`, not `buildModelSpec`.
`Admitted` makes the remaining caller obligations explicit: public/record
correspondence, word ranges, and the semantic model relation. It is NOT a
claim that the shipped compile functions imply those obligations. In particular
neither the generated Rust glue nor the compile entry points are extracted by
this module. See BUILDER-REFINEMENT-20261021.md for that boundary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderRefinement
open R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.BuilderComplete
open R0Z.BuilderModel R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderSound

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

/-- The actual extracted merged writer output, with stage-H columns zero. -/
def mergedTrace (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Trace K :=
  fun c r => liftU (copyCellMerged W P c r)

/-- Caller obligations, not a replacement definition of the deployed relation. -/
structure Admitted (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Prop where
  publicCorr : PubCorr P pub
  words : WitnessOk W
  semantic : ModelRel F pub (toModel W)

/-- A relation instance retaining the public input and the exact Rust records. -/
structure Instance (F : Subfield K) where
  pub : Public K
  witness : RustWitness
  rustPublic : RustPublic
  admitted : Admitted F pub witness rustPublic

/-- The prover model builds the extracted output directly. Transport is explicit. -/
def prover (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : HonestProver K where
  Instance := Instance F
  transport := π
  «public» := fun w => w.pub
  build := fun w => mergedTrace w.witness w.rustPublic

theorem mergedTrace_eq_model (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (pub : Public K)
    (hP : PubCorr P pub) (hW : WitnessOk W) :
    mergedTrace W P = buildModel pub (toModel W) := by
  funext c r
  exact (builder_witness_merged W P pub hP hW).2.2.2.2.2 c r

/-- All four fields for the extracted output. No field is assumed in `Admitted`. -/
theorem sound_merged (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (pub : Public K) (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic)
    (h : Admitted F pub W P) : HonestBuilderSound F pub B (mergedTrace W P) := by
  rw [mergedTrace_eq_model W P pub h.publicCorr h.words]
  have hc := builderCore_of_refines hcard (buildModelSpec F) (ModelRel F)
    (builderRefines_model F) B pub h.semantic.pubBase (toModel W) h.semantic
  rw [buildModelSpec_build F pub (toModel W) h.semantic.pubBase h.semantic.witBase] at hc
  exact honestBuilderSound_of_core pub B _ hc

/-- The D46/D51 premise is now discharged for the extracted composition on
`Admitted` inputs, for every public fibre (including an empty fibre). -/
theorem builderSoundOn (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    BuilderSoundOn (prover F π) B x := by
  intro w hw
  change w.pub = x.1 at hw
  change HonestBuilderSound F x.1 B (mergedTrace w.witness w.rustPublic)
  rw [← hw]
  exact sound_merged hcard F B w.pub w.witness w.rustPublic w.admitted

theorem prover_public (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (w : Instance F) :
    (prover F π).public w = w.pub := rfl

theorem prover_build (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (w : Instance F) :
    (prover F π).build w = mergedTrace w.witness w.rustPublic := rfl

theorem prover_transport (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) :
    (prover F π).transport = π := rfl

#print axioms mergedTrace_eq_model
#print axioms sound_merged
#print axioms builderSoundOn
#print axioms prover_public
#print axioms prover_build
#print axioms prover_transport
end R1Z.BuilderRefinement

import R0Z.BuilderModelHash
import R0P.Semantics

/-! Symbolic identification of the builder's block endpoints with the spend
semantics. No concrete permutation or recurrence is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderSemanticBridge
open R0P R0Z.BuilderModel
variable {K : Type} [Field K]
attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation blockIter layout cellsOf

/-- A block endpoint is the canonical permutation of the absorbed input. -/
theorem blockOut_endpoint (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (b : BlockIn K) :
    blockOut b = poseidonPermutation
      (fun lane => if lane.val < 8 then b.pre lane + b.absorb lane else b.pre lane) := by
  let C : Cells K := { cellsOf pub w with blocks := fun _ => b }
  have h := poseidon_scalar_holds_output pub (layout C) (poseidon_layout pub C) 0
  have h0 : poseidonState (layout C) 0 0 = b.pre := by
    rw [state_layout]
    exact funext (fun lane => blockCell_pre b lane)
  have h12 : poseidonState (layout C) 0 12 = b.absorb := by
    rw [state_layout]
    exact blockCell_fun_absorb b
  have hi : poseidonAbsorbedInput (layout C) 0 =
      (fun lane => if lane.val < 8 then b.pre lane + b.absorb lane else b.pre lane) := by
    change (fun lane => if lane.val < 8 then
      poseidonState (layout C) 0 0 lane + poseidonState (layout C) 0 12 lane
      else poseidonState (layout C) 0 0 lane) = _
    rw [h0, h12]
  rw [state_layout] at h
  have h11 : ((11 : Fin 16) : Nat) = 11 := rfl
  rw [h11] at h
  rw [blockCell_fun_iter _ 11 (by omega), hi] at h
  exact h

/-- Model and spend semantics use the same sponge initial state. -/
theorem spongeInit_eq (dom len : K) :
    R0Z.BuilderModel.spongeInit dom len = R0P.spongeInit dom len := by
  funext l
  have e8 : ((8 : Fin 16) : Nat) = 8 := rfl
  have e9 : ((9 : Fin 16) : Nat) = 9 := rfl
  simp only [R0Z.BuilderModel.spongeInit, R0P.spongeInit, Fin.ext_iff, e8, e9]

/-- A rate-eight chunk in a model block is one semantic sponge step. -/
theorem blockOut_sponge (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (pre : Fin 16 → K) (chunk : Digest K) :
    blockOut ⟨pre, lo8 chunk⟩ = spongeStep pre chunk := by
  rw [blockOut_endpoint pub w]
  unfold spongeStep absorb
  congr 1
  funext l
  by_cases hl : l.val < 8 <;> simp [hl, lo8]

/-- The owner-key endpoint is the spend relation's owner hash. -/
theorem ownerDigest_eq (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    ownerDigest w = ownerKey w.sk := by
  unfold ownerDigest ownerB blockDigest ownerKey digestOf
  rw [blockOut_sponge pub w, spongeInit_eq]
  rfl

/-- The nullifier endpoint uses the same two sponge chunks. -/
theorem nullifierDigest_eq (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    nullifierDigest w = nullifierHash w.sk w.salt := by
  unfold nullifierDigest nulB1 nulB0 blockDigest nullifierHash digestOf
  rw [blockOut_sponge pub w, blockOut_sponge pub w, spongeInit_eq]
  rfl

/-- The model's second note chunk, embedded at rate eight. -/
theorem noteC2_eq (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) :
    noteC2 value asset salt = lo8 (fun i : Fin 8 =>
      if i.val = 0 then value else if i.val = 1 then asset
      else salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩) := by
  funext l
  fin_cases l <;> simp [noteC2, lo8]

/-- The final note chunk contains just the remaining two salt limbs. -/
theorem noteC3_eq (salt : Digest K) :
    noteC3 salt = lo8 (fun i : Fin 8 =>
      if h : i.val < 2 then salt ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0) := by
  funext l
  fin_cases l <;> simp [noteC3, lo8]

/-- All three note blocks implement the semantic note commitment. -/
theorem noteDigest_eq (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (owner : Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) :
    noteDigest owner value asset salt = noteCommitment owner value asset salt := by
  unfold noteDigest noteB2 noteB1 noteB0 blockDigest noteCommitment digestOf
  rw [noteC3_eq, blockOut_sponge pub w, noteC2_eq,
    blockOut_sponge pub w, blockOut_sponge pub w, spongeInit_eq]
  rfl

/-- The input commitment's owner is the hash of the secret key. -/
theorem inputLeaf_eq (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    inputLeaf pub w = noteCommitment (ownerKey w.sk)
      (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt := by
  unfold inputLeaf
  rw [noteDigest_eq pub w, ownerDigest_eq pub w]

/-- The change endpoint is the semantic change commitment. -/
theorem changeDigest_eq (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    changeDigest pub w = noteCommitment w.changeOwner
      (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt := by
  exact noteDigest_eq pub w _ _ _ _

/-- The transfer recipient endpoint is the semantic recipient commitment. -/
theorem recipientDigest_eq (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    recipientDigest pub w = noteCommitment w.recipientOwner
      (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt := by
  unfold recipientDigest recipB
  rw [hv]
  exact noteDigest_eq pub w _ _ _ _

/-- The node tweak uses addition in the writer and subtraction in R0P. -/
theorem nodeDigest_eq [CharP K 2147483647] (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (left right : Digest K) : blockDigest (nodeIn left right) = nodeCompress left right := by
  have hp : (2147483647 : K) = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero K 2147483647
  have ht : (0x41531005 : K) = -(1051521018 : K) := by linear_combination hp
  unfold blockDigest nodeCompress digestOf
  rw [blockOut_endpoint pub w]
  apply congrArg (fun s : Fin 16 → K => fun i : Fin 8 => s (i.castAdd 8))
  congr 1
  funext l
  by_cases hl : l.val < 8
  · simp [nodeIn, lo8, hl]
  · simp [nodeIn, lo8, hl, ht, sub_eq_add_neg]

/-- Every membership prefix agrees, without evaluating the recurrence. -/
theorem treeCur_eq [CharP K 2147483647] (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (leaf : Digest K) (n : Nat) : treeCur w leaf n = merkleRootAux leaf w.path n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [treeCur, merkleRootAux]
    split_ifs with hn
    · rw [treeNode, nodeDigest_eq pub w, ih]
      cases hb : (w.path ⟨n, hn⟩).1 <;> simp [ordered, merkleStep]
    · exact ih

#print axioms blockOut_endpoint
#print axioms spongeInit_eq
#print axioms blockOut_sponge
#print axioms ownerDigest_eq
#print axioms nullifierDigest_eq
#print axioms noteC2_eq
#print axioms noteC3_eq
#print axioms noteDigest_eq
#print axioms inputLeaf_eq
#print axioms changeDigest_eq
#print axioms recipientDigest_eq
#print axioms nodeDigest_eq
#print axioms treeCur_eq
end R1Z.BuilderSemanticBridge

R1Z.BuilderSpendRelation.text:
import R1Z.BuilderSemanticBridge
import R0Z.BuilderModelRefines
import SpendRelation

/-! The D50 relation `Rspend⁺` implies the builder's semantic premises.
This identifies mathematical witnesses; it does not extract Rust's admission
checks, records function, public projection, or structural glue. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderSpendRelation
open R0P R0Z.BuilderModel R1Z.BuilderSemanticBridge
open AspisR1 AspisR1.SpendRelation AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K] [CharP K 2147483647]
attribute [local irreducible] blockOut blockDigest poseidonPermutation

/-- The spend witness has exactly the fields read by the model. -/
def modelWitness (w : Witness K) : ModelWitness K where
  inputValue := w.inputValue
  outputValue := w.outputValue
  changeValue := w.changeValue
  sk := w.sk
  salt := w.salt
  path := w.path
  pairFirst := w.pair.firstCommitment
  pairOccupied := w.pair.secondOccupied
  pairSecond := w.pair.secondCommitment
  pairInverse := w.pair.secondOccupancyInverse
  recipientOwner := w.recipientOwner
  recipientSalt := w.recipientSalt
  changeOwner := w.changeOwner
  changeSalt := w.changeSalt

/-- Privacy's strengthened relation, as adopted in D50. -/
def RspendPlus (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Prop :=
  Rspend pub w ∧ (pub.variant = .privateTransfer → pub.change 7 ≠ 0)

theorem aux_of_spend (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (h : RspendPlus pub w) :
    AuxPremises pub (modelWitness w) where
  conservation := h.1.2.2.1
  pairValid := by
    have hv := h.1.2.1.valid
    exact ⟨hv.1, sub_eq_zero.mpr hv.2.1, hv.2.2.1, hv.2.2.2⟩
  spendable := by
    have hs := h.1.2.1.spendable
    cases hb : (w.path 0).1
    · simp [dirK, modelWitness, hb]
    · have he : w.pair.secondOccupied = 1 := by
        simpa only [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied, hb, if_true] using hs
      simp [dirK, modelWitness, hb, he]
  changeSentinel := by
    intro hv
    rw [changeDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w)]
    change changeCommitment pub w 7 ≠ 0
    rw [← h.1.2.2.2.1]
    exact h.2 hv
  amount := by
    intro hv a ha
    have ho := h.1.2.2.2.2.1
    unfold variantOutput at ho
    rw [hv] at ho
    exact (Option.some.inj (ha.symm.trans ho))

/-- PairRight is forced by selection and the first path sibling, not assumed. -/
theorem pairRight_of_spend (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    PairRight pub (modelWitness w) := by
  unfold PairRight
  rw [inputLeaf_eq pub (modelWitness w)]
  change w.pair.secondCommitment =
    (ordered (noteCommitment (ownerKey w.sk) (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt)
      (w.path 0).2 (w.path 0).1).2
  rw [← h.2.1.commitment, h.2.1.sibling]
  cases hb : (w.path 0).1 <;> simp [ordered, PairLeaf.selectedCommitment]

/-- Append prefixes are the same recurrence with the same frozen roots. -/
theorem appCur_eq (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (leaf : R0P.Digest K) (n : Nat) :
    appCur pub leaf n = AppendPath.pathPrefix pub leaf n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [appCur, AppendPath.pathPrefix]
    split_ifs with hn
    · rw [appNode, nodeDigest_eq pub w, ih]
      cases hb : appBit pub n
      · have hz : digestBitZero pub ⟨n, hn⟩ := by
          simpa only [appBit, decide_eq_false_iff_not, ne_eq, not_not] using hb
        simp only [appSib, hb, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, ordered,
          AppendPath.step, if_pos hz]
        rfl
      · have hz : ¬ digestBitZero pub ⟨n, hn⟩ := of_decide_eq_true hb
        simp only [appSib, hb, if_true, ordered,
          AppendPath.step, if_neg hz]
    · exact ih

/-- The output-pair binding follows from the variant and public commitments. -/
theorem outputPair_eq (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    outputPair pub = some (outPair pub (modelWitness w)) := by
  have hchange := h.2.2.2.1
  have hout := h.2.2.2.2.1
  cases hv : pub.variant
  · unfold variantOutput at hout
    rw [hv] at hout
    unfold outputPair outPair outPairB
    rw [hv, hout, Option.map_some, nodeDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w),
      recipientDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w) hv, changeDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w)]
    rw [hchange]
    rfl
  · unfold outputPair outPair outPairB
    rw [hv, nodeDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w), changeDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w), hchange]
    rfl

/-- Every public digest premise is derived from Rspend, including the carry. -/
theorem digest_of_spend (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    DigestPremises pub (modelWitness w) where
  anchor := by
    rw [treeCur_eq pub (modelWitness w), inputLeaf_eq pub (modelWitness w)]
    exact h.2.1.membership
  nullifier := by
    rw [nullifierDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w)]
    exact h.2.1.nullifier
  recipient := by
    intro r hr
    cases hv : pub.variant
    · have ho := h.2.2.2.2.1
      unfold variantOutput at ho
      rw [hv] at ho
      rw [recipientDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w) hv]
      exact Option.some.inj (hr.symm.trans ho)
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, haw, hnone⟩ := PublicOptionShape.withdrawal_shape pub hv h.1
      rw [hnone] at hr
      contradiction
  change := by
    rw [changeDigest_eq pub (modelWitness w)]
    exact h.2.2.2.1
  nextRoot := by
    obtain ⟨pair, hp, hr, hc⟩ := h.2.2.2.2.2
    rw [outputPair_eq pub w h] at hp
    have he := Option.some.inj hp
    rw [← he, ← appCur_eq pub (modelWitness w)] at hr
    exact hr
  carry := by
    intro hc
    obtain ⟨pair, hp, hr, hcarry⟩ := h.2.2.2.2.2
    rw [outputPair_eq pub w h] at hp
    have he := Option.some.inj hp
    rw [appCur_eq pub (modelWitness w), he]
    exact hcarry hc

/-- T4 at the semantic boundary: the D51 premises follow from Rspend⁺ and
base-field membership; no auxiliary/digest/PairRight hypothesis remains. -/
theorem modelRel_of_spend [Fintype K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
    (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K)
    (hp : PublicBase F pub) (hw : WitnessBase F (modelWitness w))
    (h : RspendPlus pub w) : ModelRel F pub (modelWitness w) :=
  ⟨hp, hw, aux_of_spend pub w h, digest_of_spend pub w h.1, pairRight_of_spend pub w h.1⟩

#print axioms aux_of_spend
#print axioms pairRight_of_spend
#print axioms appCur_eq
#print axioms outputPair_eq
#print axioms digest_of_spend
#print axioms modelRel_of_spend
end R1Z.BuilderSpendRelation

R1J.SpendWitnessMap.text:
import R0Z.BuilderWitnessMerged
import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

/-! (d) The Wspend⁺ → RustWitness / RustPublic / ModelWitness map, T1–T3 (DESIGN-BUILD-
INTEGRATION §10.4; DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §12.6).  Stated on ModelWitness-shaped records over the
concrete field `M31Exact`, so this module needs no spend-path module (SpendRelation waits for
the X/R1X decision; T4 composes there).

* `toRust`, `toRustPub`: canonical u32 words of the M31 coordinates (`ZMod.val`), bits 0/1 from
  the path directions, the empty-root table as words;
* `ι := ZMod.castHom`: the carrier map into any `K` of characteristic `p`;
* T1 `toModel_toRust`: `toModel (toRust w) = mapW ι w`;
* T2 `witnessOk_toRust`: `WitnessOk (toRust w)`;
* T3 `pubCorr_toRustPub`: `PubCorr (toRustPub pub) (mapPub ι pub)`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1J.SpendWitnessMap
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel R0Z.WriterRefine

abbrev F := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact

instance : NeZero AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P := ⟨by norm_num [AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P]⟩

theorem val_lt_p (x : F) : x.val < 2147483647 := ZMod.val_lt x

theorem lt_u32 {n : ℕ} (h : n < 2147483647) : n < 2 ^ UScalarTy.U32.numBits := by
  have h32 : (2 : ℕ) ^ UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 4294967296 := rfl
  omega

/-! ### Words and arrays -/

def w32 (x : F) : U32 := UScalar.ofNatCore x.val (lt_u32 (val_lt_p x))

theorem w32_val (x : F) : (w32 x).val = x.val := UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _

def v32 (v : Fin (2 ^ 30)) : U32 :=
  UScalar.ofNatCore v.val (lt_u32 (lt_trans v.isLt (by norm_num)))

theorem v32_val (v : Fin (2 ^ 30)) : (v32 v).val = v.val := UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _

def d32 (d : Fin 8 → F) : Array U32 8#usize := arr8 (fun i => w32 (d i))

def arr24 {α : Type} (f : Fin 24 → α) : Array α 24#usize := ⟨List.ofFn f, by simp⟩
def arr20 {α : Type} (f : Fin 20 → α) : Array α 20#usize := ⟨List.ofFn f, by simp⟩

theorem arr24_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Fin 24 → α) (l : ℕ) (h : l < 24) :
    (arr24 f).val[l]! = f ⟨l, h⟩ := by
  show (List.ofFn f)[l]! = _
  rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_ofFn, dif_pos h]
  rfl

theorem arr20_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Fin 20 → α) (l : ℕ) (h : l < 20) :
    (arr20 f).val[l]! = f ⟨l, h⟩ := by
  show (List.ofFn f)[l]! = _
  rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_ofFn, dif_pos h]
  rfl

theorem arr8_getF (f : Fin 8 → U32) (i : Fin 8) : (arr8 f).val[i.val]! = f i := by
  rw [arr8_get f i.val i.isLt]

theorem arr24_getF {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Fin 24 → α) (l : Fin 24) :
    (arr24 f).val[l.val]! = f l := by
  rw [arr24_get f l.val l.isLt]

theorem arr20_getF {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Fin 20 → α) (l : Fin 20) :
    (arr20 f).val[l.val]! = f l := by
  rw [arr20_get f l.val l.isLt]

theorem d32_canon (d : Fin 8 → F) : Canon8 (d32 d) := by
  intro i hi
  rw [d32, arr8_get _ i hi, w32_val]
  exact val_lt_p _

/-! ### The carrier map and the model-side images -/

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [CharP K 2147483647]

def ι : F →+* K := ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl _) K

theorem ι_apply (x : F) : (ι : F →+* K) x = ((x.val : ℕ) : K) := by
  rw [ι, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val]

theorem liftU_w32 (x : F) : liftU (K := K) (w32 x) = (ι : F →+* K) x := by
  rw [liftU, w32_val, ι_apply]

theorem digK_d32 (d : Fin 8 → F) : digK (K := K) (d32 d) = fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (d i) := by
  funext i
  rw [digK, d32, arr8_getF, liftU_w32]

theorem val30_v32 (v : Fin (2 ^ 30)) : val30 (v32 v) = v := by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [val30, v32_val]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt v.isLt

def mapW (w : ModelWitness F) : ModelWitness K where
  inputValue := w.inputValue
  outputValue := w.outputValue
  changeValue := w.changeValue
  sk := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.sk i)
  salt := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.salt i)
  path := fun l => ((w.path l).1, fun i => (ι : F →+* K) ((w.path l).2 i))
  pairFirst := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.pairFirst i)
  pairOccupied := (ι : F →+* K) w.pairOccupied
  pairSecond := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.pairSecond i)
  pairInverse := (ι : F →+* K) w.pairInverse
  recipientOwner := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.recipientOwner i)
  recipientSalt := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.recipientSalt i)
  changeOwner := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.changeOwner i)
  changeSalt := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (w.changeSalt i)

def mapPub (pub : R0P.Public F) : R0P.Public K where
  variant := pub.variant
  anchor := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (pub.anchor i)
  nullifier := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (pub.nullifier i)
  assetId := (ι : F →+* K) pub.assetId
  recipient := pub.recipient.map (fun d i => (ι : F →+* K) (d i))
  change := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (pub.change i)
  withdrawalAmount := pub.withdrawalAmount.map (ι : F →+* K)
  nextPairIndex := pub.nextPairIndex
  snapshotFrontier := fun l i => (ι : F →+* K) (pub.snapshotFrontier l i)
  nextRoot := fun i => (ι : F →+* K) (pub.nextRoot i)
  nextFrontier := fun l i => (ι : F →+* K) (pub.nextFrontier l i)

/-! ### The Rust records -/

def toRust (w : ModelWitness F) : RustWitness where
  inputValue := v32 w.inputValue
  outputValue := v32 w.outputValue
  changeValue := v32 w.changeValue
  sk := d32 w.sk
  salt := d32 w.salt
  bits := arr24 (fun l => if (w.path l).1 then 1#u32 else 0#u32)
  sibs := arr24 (fun l => d32 (w.path l).2)
  pairFirst := d32 w.pairFirst
  pairOccupied := w32 w.pairOccupied
  pairSecond := d32 w.pairSecond
  pairInverse := w32 w.pairInverse
  recipientOwner := d32 w.recipientOwner
  recipientSalt := d32 w.recipientSalt
  changeOwner := d32 w.changeOwner
  changeSalt := d32 w.changeSalt

/-- The pair_empty_roots table is canonical (each word below `p`). -/
theorem emptyRoot_lt : ∀ (l : Fin 21) (i : Fin 8), R0P.emptyRootsNat l i < 2147483647 := by
  unfold R0P.emptyRootsNat
  decide

def emptyWord (l : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) : U32 :=
  UScalar.ofNatCore (R0P.emptyRootsNat l.castSucc i) (lt_u32 (emptyRoot_lt _ _))

def toRustPub (pub : R0P.Public F) : RustPublic where
  variant := pub.variant
  asset := w32 pub.assetId
  nextPairIndex := pub.nextPairIndex
  frontier := arr20 (fun l => d32 (pub.snapshotFrontier l))
  empty := arr20 (fun l => arr8 (emptyWord l))

/-! ### T1-T3 -/

/-- T1: the named witness map of the privacy builder, applied to the Rust record of an
M31 witness, is that witness carried into `K`. -/
theorem toModel_toRust (w : ModelWitness F) : toModel (K := K) (toRust w) = mapW w := by
  unfold toModel toRust mapW
  congr 1
  all_goals first
    | exact val30_v32 _
    | exact digK_d32 _
    | exact liftU_w32 _
    | skip
  funext l
  simp only [arr24_getF, digK_d32]
  generalize w.path l = p
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  cases b <;> exact Prod.ext (by first | rfl | simp) rfl

/-- T2: the Rust record of an M31 witness satisfies the builder's range facts. -/
theorem witnessOk_toRust (w : ModelWitness F) : WitnessOk (toRust w) where
  values := ⟨by show (v32 w.inputValue).val < _; rw [v32_val]; exact w.inputValue.isLt,
    by show (v32 w.outputValue).val < _; rw [v32_val]; exact w.outputValue.isLt,
    by show (v32 w.changeValue).val < _; rw [v32_val]; exact w.changeValue.isLt⟩
  bits := by
    intro l hl
    show ((arr24 (fun l => if (w.path l).1 then 1#u32 else 0#u32)).val[l]!).val = 0 ∨
      ((arr24 (fun l => if (w.path l).1 then 1#u32 else 0#u32)).val[l]!).val = 1
    rw [arr24_get _ l hl]
    cases (w.path ⟨l, hl⟩).1
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  sibs := by
    intro l hl
    show Canon8 ((arr24 (fun l => d32 (w.path l).2)).val[l]!)
    rw [arr24_get _ l hl]
    exact d32_canon (w.path ⟨l, hl⟩).2

/-- T3: the public-input correspondences for the Rust public record of an M31 statement. -/
theorem pubCorr_toRustPub (pub : R0P.Public F) : PubCorr (toRustPub pub) (mapPub (K := K) pub) where
  variant := rfl
  asset := liftU_w32 _
  next := rfl
  frontier := by
    intro l i
    show liftU (((arr20 (fun l => d32 (pub.snapshotFrontier l))).val[l.val]!).val[i.val]!) = _
    simp only [arr20_getF, d32, arr8_getF, liftU_w32]
    rfl
  empty := by
    intro l i
    show liftU (((arr20 (fun l => arr8 (emptyWord l))).val[l.val]!).val[i.val]!) = _
    simp only [arr20_getF, arr8_getF]
    rw [liftU, emptyWord, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    rfl
  frontierCanon := by
    intro l
    show Canon8 ((arr20 (fun l => d32 (pub.snapshotFrontier l))).val[l.val]!)
    rw [arr20_getF]
    exact d32_canon _
  emptyCanon := by
    intro l i hi
    show ((((arr20 (fun l => arr8 (emptyWord l))).val[l.val]!)).val[i]!).val < 2147483647
    rw [arr20_getF, arr8_get _ i hi, emptyWord, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    exact emptyRoot_lt _ _

end R1J.SpendWitnessMap

#print axioms R1J.SpendWitnessMap.emptyRoot_lt
#print axioms R1J.SpendWitnessMap.toModel_toRust
#print axioms R1J.SpendWitnessMap.witnessOk_toRust
#print axioms R1J.SpendWitnessMap.pubCorr_toRustPub

R1Z.BuilderCanonical.text:
import R1Z.BuilderRefinement
import R1Z.BuilderSpendRelation
import R1J.SpendWitnessMap

/-! Canonical M31 witnesses and public inputs for the extracted composition.
The honest relation is Rspend⁺ on the embedded fields. In particular the
instance subtype contains no ModelRel, BuilderSoundOn or trace validity proof.
The shipped Rust records/public/glue identification remains a separate source
obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderCanonical
open R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.BuilderModel R0Z.WriterRefine
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap R1Z.BuilderSpendRelation
open AspisR1.SpendRelation
variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

/-- Carry a semantic spend witness from M31 into K. -/
def liftWitness (w : Wspend) : Witness K where
  inputValue := w.inputValue
  outputValue := w.outputValue
  changeValue := w.changeValue
  sk := fun i => ι (w.sk i)
  salt := fun i => ι (w.salt i)
  path := fun l => ((w.path l).1, fun i => ι ((w.path l).2 i))
  pair := ⟨fun i => ι (w.pair.firstCommitment i), ι w.pair.secondOccupied,
    fun i => ι (w.pair.secondCommitment i), ι w.pair.secondOccupancyInverse⟩
  recipientOwner := fun i => ι (w.recipientOwner i)
  recipientSalt := fun i => ι (w.recipientSalt i)
  changeOwner := fun i => ι (w.changeOwner i)
  changeSalt := fun i => ι (w.changeSalt i)

theorem modelWitness_lift (w : Wspend) :
    modelWitness (liftWitness (K := K) w) = mapW (modelWitness w) := rfl

/-- Every M31 image belongs to every subfield of characteristic-p K. -/
theorem image_mem (F : Subfield K) (a : R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) : ι a ∈ F := by
  rw [ι_apply]
  exact natCast_mem F _

theorem witnessBase_lift (F : Subfield K) (w : Wspend) :
    WitnessBase F (modelWitness (liftWitness w)) where
  sk := fun _ => image_mem F _
  salt := fun _ => image_mem F _
  path := fun _ _ => image_mem F _
  pairOccupied := image_mem F _
  pairSecond := fun _ => image_mem F _
  pairInverse := image_mem F _
  recipientOwner := fun _ => image_mem F _
  recipientSalt := fun _ => image_mem F _
  changeOwner := fun _ => image_mem F _
  changeSalt := fun _ => image_mem F _

theorem publicBase_map (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) :
    PublicBase F (mapPub pub) := by
  refine ⟨fun _ => image_mem F _, fun _ => image_mem F _, image_mem F _, ?_,
    fun _ => image_mem F _, ?_, fun _ _ => image_mem F _, fun _ => image_mem F _,
    fun _ _ => image_mem F _⟩
  · intro r hr i
    change pub.recipient.map (fun d i => (ι : R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F →+* K) (d i)) = some r at hr
    cases ho : pub.recipient with
    | none => simp only [ho, Option.map_none] at hr; contradiction
    | some d =>
      rw [ho, Option.map_some] at hr
      cases hr
      exact image_mem F _
  · intro a ha
    change pub.withdrawalAmount.map (ι : R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F →+* K) = some a at ha
    cases ho : pub.withdrawalAmount with
    | none => simp only [ho, Option.map_none] at ha; contradiction
    | some d =>
      rw [ho, Option.map_some] at ha
      cases ha
      exact image_mem F _

/-- Named canonical record maps; the words are exactly those of T1–T3. -/
def rustWitness (w : Wspend) : RustWitness := toRust (modelWitness w)
def rustPublic (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) : RustPublic := toRustPub pub

/-- The lifted extracted trace is the semantic model on the embedded witness. -/
theorem canonical_trace (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) (w : Wspend) :
    BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (rustWitness w) (rustPublic pub) =
      buildModel (mapPub (K := K) pub) (modelWitness (liftWitness w)) := by
  rw [BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace_eq_model (rustWitness w) (rustPublic pub) (mapPub pub)
    (pubCorr_toRustPub pub) (witnessOk_toRust (modelWitness w))]
  rw [rustWitness, toModel_toRust, ← modelWitness_lift]

/-- No semantic model premise is assumed: it is derived from Rspend⁺. -/
theorem admitted_of_spend (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F)
    (w : Wspend) (h : RspendPlus (mapPub pub) (liftWitness (K := K) w)) :
    BuilderRefinement.Admitted F (mapPub pub) (rustWitness w) (rustPublic pub) where
  publicCorr := pubCorr_toRustPub pub
  words := witnessOk_toRust (modelWitness w)
  semantic := by
    rw [rustWitness, toModel_toRust, ← modelWitness_lift]
    exact modelRel_of_spend F _ _ (publicBase_map F pub) (witnessBase_lift F w) h

/-- Mathematical honest instances of the embedded Rspend⁺ relation. -/
def Instance : Type :=
  {p : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F × Wspend //
    RspendPlus (mapPub (K := K) p.1) (liftWitness p.2)}

/-- The builder is the extracted merged writer composition on canonical records. -/
def prover (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : HonestProver K where
  Instance := Instance (K := K)
  transport := π
  «public» := fun p => mapPub p.val.1
  build := fun p => BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (rustWitness p.val.2) (rustPublic p.val.1)

/-- All four BuilderSoundOn fields for canonical Rspend⁺ instances, with no
ModelRel, base-typing, lane, or helper hypothesis. -/
theorem builderSoundOn (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    BuilderSoundOn (prover π) B x := by
  intro p hp
  change mapPub p.val.1 = x.1 at hp
  change HonestBuilderSound F x.1 B
    (BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (rustWitness p.val.2) (rustPublic p.val.1))
  rw [← hp]
  exact BuilderRefinement.sound_merged hcard F B _ _ _
    (admitted_of_spend F p.val.1 p.val.2 p.property)

#print axioms modelWitness_lift
#print axioms image_mem
#print axioms witnessBase_lift
#print axioms publicBase_map
#print axioms canonical_trace
#print axioms admitted_of_spend
#print axioms builderSoundOn
end R1Z.BuilderCanonical

R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical.text:
import R1Z.BuilderCanonical

/-! Lossless decoding of all raw witness fields. The range conditions are
explicit caller obligations; this does not infer them from Rust admission. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderModel
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap

structure CanonicalWords (w : RustWitness) : Prop where
  shape : WitnessOk w
  sk : Canon8 w.sk
  salt : Canon8 w.salt
  pairFirst : Canon8 w.pairFirst
  pairOccupied : w.pairOccupied.val < 2147483647
  pairSecond : Canon8 w.pairSecond
  pairInverse : w.pairInverse.val < 2147483647
  recipientOwner : Canon8 w.recipientOwner
  recipientSalt : Canon8 w.recipientSalt
  changeOwner : Canon8 w.changeOwner
  changeSalt : Canon8 w.changeSalt

theorem array_ext {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize} (a b : Array α n)
    (h : ∀ i, i < n.val → a.val[i]! = b.val[i]!) : a = b := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply List.ext_getElem (a.property.trans b.property.symm)
  intro i hi hj
  simpa only [getElem!_pos a.val i hi, getElem!_pos b.val i hj] using
    h i (by simpa only [a.property] using hi)

theorem word_roundtrip (x : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) :
    w32 (liftU (K := F) x) = x := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [w32_val]
  change (x.val : ZMod 2147483647).val = x.val
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]

theorem value_roundtrip (x : U32) (hx : x.val < 2^30) :
    v32 (val30 x) = x := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [v32_val]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx

theorem digest_roundtrip (d : Array U32 8#usize) (hd : Canon8 d) :
    d32 (digK (K := F) d) = d := by
  apply array_ext
  intro i hi
  rw [d32, arr8_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
  exact word_roundtrip _ (hd i (by simpa using hi))

/-- Every one of the fifteen raw witness fields is retained, with no modular
aliasing of values, direction bits, pair coordinates or digest limbs. -/
theorem records_roundtrip (w : RustWitness) (hw : CanonicalWords w) :
    toRust (toModel (K := F) w) = w := by
  unfold toRust toModel
  congr 1
  · exact value_roundtrip _ hw.shape.values.1
  · exact value_roundtrip _ hw.shape.values.2.1
  · exact value_roundtrip _ hw.shape.values.2.2
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.sk
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.salt
  · apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [R1J.SpendWitnessMap.arr24_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    change (if decide ((w.bits.val[i]!).val ≠ 0) then 1#u32 else 0#u32).val =
      (w.bits.val[i]!).val
    obtain hz | ho := hw.shape.bits i (by simpa using hi)
    · rw [hz]; rfl
    · rw [ho]; rfl
  · apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [R1J.SpendWitnessMap.arr24_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
    exact digest_roundtrip _ (hw.shape.sibs i (by simpa using hi))
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.pairFirst
  · exact word_roundtrip _ hw.pairOccupied
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.pairSecond
  · exact word_roundtrip _ hw.pairInverse
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.recipientOwner
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.recipientSalt
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.changeOwner
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.changeSalt

/-- The semantic witness read from the raw records, including the first
commitment (which is not discarded by modelWitness). -/
def witness (w : RustWitness) : AspisR1.SpendRelation.Wspend :=
  let m := toModel (K := F) w
  { inputValue := m.inputValue, outputValue := m.outputValue, changeValue := m.changeValue,
    sk := m.sk, salt := m.salt, path := m.path,
    pair := ⟨m.pairFirst, m.pairOccupied, m.pairSecond, m.pairInverse⟩,
    recipientOwner := m.recipientOwner, recipientSalt := m.recipientSalt,
    changeOwner := m.changeOwner, changeSalt := m.changeSalt }

theorem witness_model (w : RustWitness) :
    BuilderSpendRelation.modelWitness (witness w) = toModel (K := F) w := rfl

theorem canonical_witness (w : RustWitness) (hw : CanonicalWords w) :
    BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (witness w) = w := records_roundtrip w hw

#print axioms word_roundtrip
#print axioms value_roundtrip
#print axioms digest_roundtrip
