R1Z.BuilderPublicCanonical.text:
import R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical

/-! Public record reconstruction, including the exact frozen empty roots.
PubCorr is over M31 here, so its equality retains canonical-word identity.
The runtime still owes PubCorr for the computed pair_empty_roots result. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderPublicCanonical
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderModel
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical

theorem frozen_word (l : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) :
    w32 (emptyRootK (K := F) l i) = emptyWord l i := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [w32_val, emptyWord, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  change ((R0P.emptyRootsNat l.castSucc i : Nat) : ZMod 2147483647).val = _
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (emptyRoot_lt _ _)]

/-- Reconstruct every public-record field. Empty roots are fixed by PubCorr,
not inferred from arbitrary-root record projection equivalence. -/
theorem public_roundtrip (p : RustPublic) (pub : R0P.Public F)
    (hp : PubCorr p pub) (ha : p.asset.val < 2147483647) :
    toRustPub pub = p := by
  unfold toRustPub
  congr 1
  · exact hp.variant.symm
  · rw [← hp.asset]
    exact word_roundtrip _ ha
  · exact hp.next.symm
  · apply array_ext
    intro l hl
    rw [arr20_get _ l (by simpa using hl)]
    apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [d32, arr8_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
    rw [← hp.frontier ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩]
    exact word_roundtrip _ (hp.frontierCanon ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ i (by simpa using hi))
  · apply array_ext
    intro l hl
    rw [arr20_get _ l (by simpa using hl)]
    apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [arr8_get _ i (by simpa using hi), ← frozen_word]
    rw [← hp.empty ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩]
    exact word_roundtrip _ (hp.emptyCanon ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ i (by simpa using hi))

#print axioms frozen_word
#print axioms public_roundtrip
end R1Z.BuilderPublicCanonical

R1Z.BuilderFieldNormalization.text:
import R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical

/-! Field interpretation, rather than raw-byte equality, is the source
handoff needed by HonestProver.build. No canonical key/owner/salt-word bound
is assumed. This also covers admitted noncanonical output-owner words. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderFieldNormalization
open R0P R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderModel R1J.SpendWitnessMap
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

theorem decoded_witness (w : RustWitness) :
    BuilderSpendRelation.modelWitness
      (BuilderCanonical.liftWitness (K := K) (BuilderRecordCanonical.witness w)) =
      toModel (K := K) w := by
  rw [BuilderCanonical.modelWitness_lift, BuilderRecordCanonical.witness_model]
  simp only [mapW, toModel, digK, liftU, map_natCast]
  rfl

/-- Arbitrary raw key, salt, owner and pair words give the same K-valued
trace as their canonical M31 decoding. Only the existing WitnessOk shape
and public correspondence of the raw mapper are required. -/
theorem trace_normalization
    (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic) (pub : Public F)
    (hw : WitnessOk w) (hp : PubCorr p (mapPub (K := K) pub)) :
    BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (K := K) w p =
      BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace
        (BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (BuilderRecordCanonical.witness w))
        (BuilderCanonical.rustPublic pub) := by
  rw [BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace_eq_model w p (mapPub pub) hp hw,
    BuilderCanonical.canonical_trace, decoded_witness]

#print axioms decoded_witness
#print axioms trace_normalization
end R1Z.BuilderFieldNormalization

R1Z.BuilderSource.text:
import R1Z.BuilderCanonical
import D18Transport

/-! The source handoff after the semantic builder proof.

The S2 coefficient transport is D18's involution (TAU=[3,4,2,0,1]).
`SourceIdentification` states precisely the source facts still needed before
calling a Rust prover an instance of this theorem. No such certificate for
the shipped compile functions is constructed here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderSource
open R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.HonestValidity
variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

/-- S2 uses D18. It maps logical rows to coefficient positions; its inverse
is the same digit permutation, as proved by rowNat_involutive. -/
def π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024 := AspisR1.rowEquiv

/-- This orientation agrees with `Variant::coefficients`: coefficient j
is the physical semantic row `row(j)`. -/
theorem coefficients (t : Trace K) (c : Fin 29) (j : Fin 1024) :
    R0P.SemSource.coeffsOf π t c j = t c (AspisR1.row j) := rfl

/-- Reindexing the coefficients restores every raw semantic row. -/
theorem rows_coefficients (t : Trace K) :
    R0P.SemSource.rowsOf π (R0P.SemSource.coeffsOf π t) = t :=
  R0P.SemSource.rowsOf_coeffsOf π t

/-- The fully instantiated mathematical honest builder. -/
def prover : HonestProver K := BuilderCanonical.prover π

theorem public_map (w : BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K)) :
    (prover (K := K)).public w = R1J.SpendWitnessMap.mapPub w.val.1 := rfl

theorem build_map (w : BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K)) :
    (prover (K := K)).build w = BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace
      (BuilderCanonical.rustWitness w.val.2) (BuilderCanonical.rustPublic w.val.1) := rfl

theorem transport_map : (prover (K := K)).transport = π := rfl

/-- The builder premise is a theorem for this fixed π and canonical relation. -/
theorem builderSoundOn (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    BuilderSoundOn prover B x := BuilderCanonical.builderSoundOn hcard F π B x

/-- A source-only certificate: the map into the adopted honest relation,
public projection, raw trace output, and S2 transport. It assumes no lane,
base-typing, copy-balance, or helper fact. -/
structure SourceIdentification (source : HonestProver K)
    (toInstance : source.Instance → BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K)) : Prop where
  public_eq : ∀ w, source.public w = prover.public (toInstance w)
  build_eq : ∀ w, source.build w = prover.build (toInstance w)
  transport_eq : source.transport = π

/-- The exact remaining source identification is sufficient to discharge
D46/D51 for the supplied source h. This theorem is conditional, not a
certificate for the shipped Rust entry points. -/
theorem builder_refinement_D46_D51 (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (source : HonestProver K)
    (toInstance : source.Instance → BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K))
    (identification : SourceIdentification source toInstance) :
    BuilderSoundOn source B x := by
  intro w hw
  rw [identification.build_eq w]
  exact builderSoundOn hcard F B x (toInstance w) ((identification.public_eq w).symm.trans hw)

#print axioms coefficients
#print axioms rows_coefficients
#print axioms public_map
#print axioms build_map
#print axioms transport_map
#print axioms builderSoundOn
#print axioms builder_refinement_D46_D51
end R1Z.BuilderSource

R1Z.BuilderProtocolInstance.text:
import R1Z.BuilderSource
import R1Z.PrivacyR1FinalProtocol

/-! The constructed protocol's canonical honest builder. This module proves
model facts, not successful admission by the deployed Rust compiler. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderProtocolInstance
open R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.HonestValidity
local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact
local instance : CharP K 2147483647 :=
  charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K).injective
    AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

theorem field_large : 4096 < Fintype.card K := by
  have hc : Fintype.card (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) ≤ Fintype.card K :=
    Fintype.card_le_of_injective (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K)
      (RingHom.injective _)
  rw [ZMod.card] at hc
  have hp : AspisCircleGroupOrder.P = 2147483647 := rfl
  rw [hp] at hc
  omega

theorem builder_sound {CommitHandle : Type} {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    BuilderSoundOn BuilderSource.prover B x :=
  BuilderSource.builderSoundOn field_large F B x

/-- No transport premise is needed for the four raw-trace soundness fields.
This fibre-local source join is sufficient even when source instances outside
this public fibre have no canonical instance. It is not a Rust certificate. -/
def RustBuilderJoin {CommitHandle : Type} (source : HonestProver K)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, source.public w = x.1 → ∃ p : BuilderCanonical.Instance («K» := K),
    BuilderSource.prover.public p = x.1 ∧ source.build w = BuilderSource.prover.build p

theorem builder_sound_of_join {CommitHandle : Type} {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (source : HonestProver K)
    (join : RustBuilderJoin source x) : BuilderSoundOn source B x := by
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨p, hp, ht⟩ := join w hw
  rw [ht]
  exact builder_sound B x p hp

theorem join_of_identification {CommitHandle : Type}
    (source : HonestProver K) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (toInstance : source.Instance → BuilderCanonical.Instance («K» := K))
    (identification : BuilderSource.SourceIdentification source toInstance) :
    RustBuilderJoin source x := by
  intro w hw
  exact ⟨toInstance w, (identification.public_eq w).symm.trans hw,
    identification.build_eq w⟩

#print axioms field_large
#print axioms builder_sound
#print axioms builder_sound_of_join
#print axioms join_of_identification
end R1Z.BuilderProtocolInstance

R1Z.BuilderRuntimeJoin.text:
import R1Z.BuilderPublicCanonical
import R1Z.BuilderFieldNormalization
import R1Z.BuilderProtocolInstance

/-! Assemble SourceIdentification from raw runtime records and admission.
No lane, helper, trace-validity or BuilderSoundOn field is assumed. The
runtime witness of this structure for the shipped compiler is still open. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderRuntimeJoin
open R0P R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.ZkStatement
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap BuilderRecordCanonical
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

/-- One named remaining Rust join. Data is the compiler's raw word records
and full semantic public projection. Proofs must concern those same records.
The empty-root obligation is explicitly in publicCorr.empty; arbitrary-root
mapper equivalence cannot supply it. `admission` includes D50's sentinel.
Only WitnessOk's value/bit/sibling bounds are required, not canonical
key/owner/salt/pair words. The build handoff uses field-trace normalization,
so the two optional byte-roundtrip lemmas below are not assembly premises.
This record contains neither a source-identification certificate nor any of
the four soundness conclusions it is used to derive. -/
structure RustRuntimeJoin (source : HonestProver K) where
  publicInput : source.Instance → Public F
  witnessRecord : source.Instance → RustWitness
  publicRecord : source.Instance → RustPublic
  words : ∀ w, WitnessOk (witnessRecord w)
  publicCorr : ∀ w, PubCorr (publicRecord w) (mapPub (K := K) (publicInput w))
  admission : ∀ w, BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus
    (mapPub (K := K) (publicInput w))
    (BuilderCanonical.liftWitness (witness (witnessRecord w)))
  public_eq : ∀ w, source.public w = mapPub (publicInput w)
  raw_trace_eq : ∀ w, source.build w =
    BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (witnessRecord w) (publicRecord w)
  transport_eq : source.transport = BuilderSource.π

variable {source : HonestProver K}

def toInstance (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) (w : source.Instance) :
    BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K) :=
  ⟨(join.publicInput w, witness (join.witnessRecord w)), join.admission w⟩

theorem witness_record (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) (w : source.Instance)
    (hw : CanonicalWords (join.witnessRecord w)) :
    BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (toInstance join w).val.2 = join.witnessRecord w :=
  canonical_witness _ hw

theorem public_record (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) (w : source.Instance)
    (hp : PubCorr (join.publicRecord w) (join.publicInput w))
    (ha : (join.publicRecord w).asset.val < 2147483647) :
    BuilderCanonical.rustPublic (toInstance join w).val.1 = join.publicRecord w :=
  BuilderPublicCanonical.public_roundtrip _ _ hp ha

/-- Complete final assembly of the three original SourceIdentification
fields. The primitive runtime join is explicit, not constructed for Rust. -/
def sourceIdentification (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) :
    BuilderSource.SourceIdentification source (toInstance join) where
  public_eq := join.public_eq
  build_eq := by
    intro w
    rw [join.raw_trace_eq w, BuilderSource.build_map]
    exact BuilderFieldNormalization.trace_normalization _ _ _ (join.words w) (join.publicCorr w)
  transport_eq := join.transport_eq

theorem builder_refinement_D46_D51 {CommitHandle : Type}
    (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (Fbase : Subfield K)
    (B : PackBasis Fbase) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) : BuilderSoundOn source B x :=
  BuilderSource.builder_refinement_D46_D51 hcard Fbase B x source
    (toInstance join) (sourceIdentification join)

#print axioms witness_record
#print axioms public_record
#print axioms sourceIdentification
#print axioms builder_refinement_D46_D51
end R1Z.BuilderRuntimeJoin

namespace R1Z.BuilderProtocolBounds

    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
variable (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire)

/-- The numerical protocol envelope does not require public base membership,
a witness, builder soundness or a source execution coupling. -/
theorem error_bound (L₁ L₂ : ℕ)
    (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (hb₁ : (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁)
    (hb₂ : (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂) :

      (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486 ≤
      1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^137 + 1 / 2^454 := by
  let W := (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire

  have he := R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin.binary_exhaustion_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hc hb₁ hb₂
  have hq : W.qmax ≤ 2^64 := Nat.le_refl _

  have hn' : modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ ≤ 1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^137 := by
    simpa only [modelError, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_zero, pow_two,
      zero_mul, zero_div] using hn
  change modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ + _ ≤ _
  linarith [query_error_le]

def tabulate {α : Type} (n : Usize) (f : Nat → α) : Array α n :=
  ⟨List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n.val => f i.val), by simp⟩

theorem tabulate_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (n : Usize) (f : Nat → α)
    (i : Nat) (hi : i < n.val) : (tabulate n f).val[i]! = f i := by
  simp [tabulate, hi]

theorem update_gen {α : Type} {n : Usize} (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) : Array.update v i x = ok (v.set i x) := by
  unfold Array.update
  rw [Array.getElem?_Usize_eq, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa [v.property] using hi)]
  rfl

theorem set_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize}
    (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (j : Nat) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    (v.set i x).val[j]! = if j = i.val then x else v.val[j]! := by
  simp only [Array.set_val_eq]
  by_cases h : j = i.val
  · subst j
    simp [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_set_self (show i.val < v.val.length by simpa [v.property] using hi)]
  · simp [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, h]

def Prefix {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize}
    (v target : Array α n) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, j < k → j < n.val → v.val[j]! = target.val[j]!

    (v target : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val)
    (h : Prefix v target i.val) :
    Prefix (v.set i target.val[i.val]!) target (i.val + 1) := by
  intro j hj hn
  rw [set_get _ _ _ _ hi]
  split
  · next e => exact congrArg (fun k => target.val[k]!) e.symm
  · next e => exact h j (by omega) hn

theorem prefix_done {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize}
    (v target : Array α n) (h : Prefix v target n.val) : v = target := by
  apply BuilderRecordCanonical.array_ext
  intro j hj
  exact h j hj hj

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Lexicographic completed-cell invariant, avoiding concrete matrix reduction. -/
def Cells {n : Usize} (m target : Array (Array U32 8#usize) n)
    (level lane : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, i < n.val → j < 8 → (i < level ∨ i = level ∧ j < lane) →
    (m.val[i]!).val[j]! = (target.val[i]!).val[j]!

theorem cells_step {n : Usize} (m target : Array (Array U32 8#usize) n)
    (level lane : Usize) (hl : level.val < n.val) (hj : lane.val < 8)
    (h : Cells m target level.val lane.val) :
    Cells (m.set level ((m.val[level.val]!).set lane
      (target.val[level.val]!).val[lane.val]!)) target level.val (lane.val + 1) := by
  intro i j hi hj' hc
  rw [set_get _ _ _ _ hl]
  by_cases e : i = level.val
  · rw [if_pos e, set_get _ _ _ _ (by simpa using hj)]
    split
    · next ej => subst i; subst j; rfl
    · next ej =>
        rw [← e]
        exact h i j hi hj' (Or.inr ⟨e, by omega⟩)
  · rw [if_neg e]
    exact h i j hi hj' (Or.inl (by omega))

theorem cells_next {n : Usize} (m target : Array (Array U32 8#usize) n)
    (level : Nat) (h : Cells m target level 8) : Cells m target (level + 1) 0 := by
  intro i j hi hj hc
  apply h i j hi hj
  omega

theorem cells_done {n : Usize} (m target : Array (Array U32 8#usize) n)
    (h : Cells m target n.val 0) : m = target := by
  apply BuilderRecordCanonical.array_ext
  intro i hi
  apply BuilderRecordCanonical.array_ext
  intro j hj
  exact h i j hi (by simpa using hj) (Or.inl hi)

          apply ih (8 - (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val) (by omega)
            _ (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize) (by omega)
          · simpa [hn, hzero] using cells_step sibs (siblings input) level lane (by simpa using hl) hlt hs
          · rfl
        · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.le_equiv] using ht)]
          simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
          have hv := sub_val level 21#usize (by simp; omega)
          simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hv
          rw [index_ok_gen _ _ (by simp only [hv]; simp; omega)]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [index_ok _ lane (by simpa using hlt)]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, hv]
          simp only [hzero, if_false, ht] at hrow
          rw [← hrow]
          rw [Array.index_mut_usize, index_ok_gen sibs level (by simpa using hl)]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [update_gen _ lane _ (by simpa using hlt)]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
          have hn := next_val lane (by omega)
          apply ih (8 - (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val) (by omega)
            _ (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize) (by omega)
          · simpa [hn, hzero] using cells_step sibs (siblings input) level lane (by simpa using hl) hlt hs
          · rfl
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      have e : lane.val = 8 := by omega
      exact ⟨sibs, rfl, by simpa [e] using hs⟩

theorem bits_get (input : Input) (level : Usize) (hl : level.val < 24) :
    (bits input).val[level.val]! =
      if level = 0#usize then core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from input.pair.selected_second
      else if level ≤ 20#usize then
        U32.wrapping_shr input.pair.membership.index
          (UScalar.cast .U32 (Usize.wrapping_sub level 1#usize)) &&& 1#u32
      else core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from input.super_root_directions.val[level.val-21]! := by
  dsimp only [bits]
  rw [List.getElem!_ofFn _ _ (by simpa using hl)]
  dsimp only
  by_cases hz : level.val = 0
  · have he : level = 0#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by simpa using hz)
    simp only [he, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, if_true]
  · have he : level ≠ 0#usize := fun e => hz (by rw [e]; rfl)
    simp only [hz, he, if_false]
    by_cases ht : level.val ≤ 20
    · have he' : level ≤ 20#usize := by simpa [UScalar.le_equiv] using ht
      simp only [ht, he', if_true]
      congr 2
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      have hv : (Usize.wrapping_sub level 1#usize).val = level.val - 1 := by
        simpa using sub_val level 1#usize (by simp; omega)
      have hc : (UScalar.cast .U32 (Usize.wrapping_sub level 1#usize)).val = level.val - 1 := by
        rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, hv]
        exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by simp; omega)
      simpa only [U32.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hc.symm
    · have he' : ¬level ≤ 20#usize := by simpa [UScalar.le_equiv] using ht
      simp only [ht, he', if_false]

/-- One extracted outer iteration, after eliminating only its read branches. -/
theorem level_step (input : Input) (bs : Array U32 24#usize) (ss : Matrix24)
    (level : Usize) (hl : level.val < 24) :
    records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop0
      input.super_root_siblings input.super_root_directions input.pair bs ss level = (do
      let bs1 ← Array.update bs level (bits input).val[level.val]!
      let (p, ss1) ← records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop0_loop0
        input.super_root_siblings input.pair ss level 0#usize
      records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop0
        input.super_root_siblings input.super_root_directions p bs1 ss1
        (Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize)) := by
  rw [records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop0,
    if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hl), bits_get input level hl]
  by_cases hz : level = 0#usize
  · simp only [hz, if_true, bind_tc_ok, lift]
  · simp only [hz, if_false]
    by_cases ht : level ≤ 20#usize
    · simp only [ht, if_true, bind_tc_ok, lift]
    · simp only [ht, if_false, bind_tc_ok, lift]
      have htn : ¬level.val ≤ 20 := by simpa [UScalar.le_equiv] using ht
      have hv := sub_val level 21#usize (by simp; omega)
      rw [index_ok_gen _ _ (by simp only [hv]; simp; omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, hv, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]

theorem level_spec (input : Input) (bs : Array U32 24#usize) (ss : Matrix24)
    (level : Usize) (hl : level.val ≤ 24)
    (hb : Prefix bs (bits input) level.val)
    (hs : Cells ss (siblings input) level.val 0) :
    records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop0
      input.super_root_siblings input.super_root_directions input.pair bs ss level =
      ok (input.pair, bits input, siblings input) := by
  generalize eqr : 24 - level.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing level bs ss with
  | h remaining ih =>
    by_cases hlt : level.val < 24
    · rw [level_step input bs ss level hlt,
        update_gen bs level _ (by simpa using hlt)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      obtain ⟨s, hloop, hs'⟩ := lane_spec input ss level 0#usize hlt (by simp) hs
      rw [hloop]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      have hn := next_val level hlt
      apply ih (24 - (Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize).val) (by omega)
        _ _ (Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize) (by omega)
      · simpa [hn] using prefix_step bs (bits input) level (by simpa using hlt) hb
      · simpa [hn] using cells_next s (siblings input) level.val hs'
      · rfl
    · rw [records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop0,
        if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      have eq24 : level.val = (24#usize : Usize).val := by simp; omega
      rw [prefix_done bs (bits input) (by simpa [eq24] using hb),
        cells_done ss (siblings input) (by simpa [eq24] using hs)]

theorem from_zero (input : Input) (bs : Array U32 24#usize) (ss : Matrix24) :
    records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop0
      input.super_root_siblings input.super_root_directions input.pair bs ss 0#usize =
      ok (input.pair, bits input, siblings input) :=
  level_spec input bs ss 0#usize (by simp)
    (by intro j hj; simp at hj) (by intro i j hi hj hc; simp at hc)

#print axioms sub_val
#print axioms pair_selected
#print axioms lane_spec
#print axioms bits_get
#print axioms level_step
#print axioms level_spec
#print axioms from_zero
end R1Z.BuilderRecordsPath

R1Z.BuilderRecordsRecipient.text:
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsExtracted

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordsRecipient
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisBuilderRecordsReference
open R0Z.WriterRefine
open pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray
abbrev Note := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1

def owner (rec : Option Note) : Array U32 8#usize :=
  match rec with | none => ZERO8 | some r => r.owner_key

def salt (rec : Option Note) : Array U32 8#usize :=
  match rec with | none => ZERO8 | some r => r.salt

/-- Symbolic suffix induction: each iteration fills one lane and preserves
all earlier lanes, and the optional recipient itself is unchanged. -/
theorem loop_spec (rec : Option Note) (ro rs : Array U32 8#usize)
    (lane : Usize) (hl : lane.val ≤ 8)
    (hnone : rec = none → ro = ZERO8 ∧ rs = ZERO8)
    (ho : Prefix ro (owner rec) lane.val) (hs : Prefix rs (salt rec) lane.val) :
    records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop1 rec ro rs lane =
      ok (rec, owner rec, salt rec) := by
  generalize he : 8 - lane.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing lane ro rs with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop1]
    by_cases hlt : lane.val < 8
    · have test : lane < 8#usize := by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt
      rw [if_pos test]
      have hn := next_val lane (by omega)
      cases rec with
      | none =>
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hnone rfl
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        apply ih (8 - (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val) (by omega)
          ZERO8 ZERO8 (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize) (by omega)
        · exact fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        · exact fun _ _ _ => rfl
        · exact fun _ _ _ => rfl
        · rfl
      | some r =>
        dsimp only
        rw [index_ok r.owner_key lane (by simpa using hlt)]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_gen ro lane _ (by simpa using hlt)]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [index_ok r.salt lane (by simpa using hlt)]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_gen rs lane _ (by simpa using hlt)]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        apply ih (8 - (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val) (by omega)
          _ _ (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize) (by omega)
        · intro h; cases h
        · simpa [hn, owner] using prefix_step ro (owner (some r)) lane (by simpa using hlt) ho
        · simpa [hn, salt] using prefix_step rs (salt (some r)) lane (by simpa using hlt) hs
        · rfl
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      have e : lane.val = 8 := by omega
      rw [prefix_done ro (owner rec) (by simpa [e] using ho),
        prefix_done rs (salt rec) (by simpa [e] using hs)]

#print axioms loop_spec
end R1Z.BuilderRecordsRecipient

import R1Z.BuilderRecordsMatrix
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsExtracted

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordsPublic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisBuilderRecordsReference R0Z.WriterRefine
open pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray
abbrev Snapshot := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1
abbrev Matrix20 := Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize
abbrev Roots := Array (Array U32 8#usize) 21#usize

def empty20 (empty : Roots) : Matrix20 := tabulate 20#usize (fun i => empty.val[i]!)

theorem lane_spec (s : Snapshot) (empty : Roots) (front emp : Matrix20)
    (level lane : Usize) (hl : level.val < 20) (hj : lane.val ≤ 8)
    (hf : Cells front s.frontier level.val lane.val)
    (he : Cells emp (empty20 empty) level.val lane.val) :
    ∃ f e, records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop2_loop0
      s empty front emp level lane = ok (s, f, e) ∧
      Cells f s.frontier level.val 8 ∧ Cells e (empty20 empty) level.val 8 := by
  generalize eqr : 8 - lane.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing lane front emp with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop2_loop0]
    by_cases hlt : lane.val < 8
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      rw [index_ok_gen s.frontier level (by simpa using hl)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [index_ok _ lane (by simpa using hlt)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [Array.index_mut_usize, index_ok_gen front level (by simpa using hl)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [update_gen _ lane _ (by simpa using hlt)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [index_ok_gen empty level (by simp; omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [index_ok _ lane (by simpa using hlt)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [Array.index_mut_usize, index_ok_gen emp level (by simpa using hl)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [update_gen _ lane _ (by simpa using hlt)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
      have hn := next_val lane (by omega)
      apply ih (8 - (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val) (by omega)
        _ _ (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize) (by omega)
      · simpa [hn] using cells_step front s.frontier level lane (by simpa using hl) hlt hf
      · have ht : (empty20 empty).val[level.val]! = empty.val[level.val]! :=
          tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hl)
        rw [← ht]
        simpa [hn] using cells_step emp (empty20 empty) level lane (by simpa using hl) hlt he
      · rfl
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      have e : lane.val = 8 := by omega
      exact ⟨front, emp, rfl, by simpa [e] using hf, by simpa [e] using he⟩

theorem level_spec (s : Snapshot) (empty : Roots) (front emp : Matrix20)
    (level : Usize) (hl : level.val ≤ 20)
    (hf : Cells front s.frontier level.val 0)
    (he : Cells emp (empty20 empty) level.val 0) :
    records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop2 s empty front emp level =
      ok (s, s.frontier, empty20 empty) := by
  generalize eqr : 20 - level.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing level front emp with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop2]
    by_cases hlt : level.val < 20
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      obtain ⟨f, e, hloop, hfront, hemp⟩ := lane_spec s empty front emp level 0#usize hlt (by simp) hf he
      rw [hloop]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
      have hn := next_val level (by omega)
      apply ih (20 - (Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize).val) (by omega)
        _ _ (Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize) (by omega)
      · simpa [hn] using cells_next f s.frontier level.val hfront
      · simpa [hn] using cells_next e (empty20 empty) level.val hemp
      · rfl
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      have eq20 : level.val = (20#usize : Usize).val := by simp; omega
      rw [cells_done front s.frontier (by simpa [eq20] using hf),
        cells_done emp (empty20 empty) (by simpa [eq20] using he)]

theorem from_zero (s : Snapshot) (empty : Roots) (front emp : Matrix20) :
    records_reference.records_reference_with_roots_loop2 s empty front emp 0#usize =
      ok (s, s.frontier, empty20 empty) :=
  level_spec s empty front emp 0#usize (by simp)
    (by intro i j hi hj hc; simp at hc) (by intro i j hi hj hc; simp at hc)

#print axioms lane_spec
#print axioms level_spec
#print axioms from_zero
end R1Z.BuilderRecordsPublic

R1Z.BuilderExtractedRecords.text:
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsExtracted
import R1Z.BuilderFieldNormalization

/-! The nominal type adapter from the extracted owned-reference records to
all fields of the R1Z word-level builder. No record field is reconstructed
from another or dropped. Public next_pair_index is interpreted as its U64
value, and the source transfer flag selects the semantic variant. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderExtractedRecords
open R0P R0Z.WriterRefine R1J.SpendWitnessMap
abbrev RW := AspisBuilderRecordsReference.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RW
abbrev RP := AspisBuilderRecordsReference.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RP

def rawWitness (w : RW) : RustWitness where
  inputValue := w.input_value
  outputValue := w.output_value
  changeValue := w.change_value
  sk := w.sk
  salt := w.salt
  bits := w.bits
  sibs := w.sibs
  pairFirst := w.pair_first
  pairOccupied := w.pair_occupied
  pairSecond := w.pair_second
  pairInverse := w.pair_inverse
  recipientOwner := w.recipient_owner
  recipientSalt := w.recipient_salt
  changeOwner := w.change_owner
  changeSalt := w.change_salt

def rawPublic (p : RP) : RustPublic where
  variant := if p.transfer then .privateTransfer else .withdrawal
  asset := p.asset
  nextPairIndex := p.next_pair_index.val
  frontier := p.frontier
  empty := p.empty

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

/-- The full extracted record types feed the canonical builder without any
canonicality hypothesis on owner/key/salt/pair words. Empty roots remain in
the explicit PubCorr premise until the runtime helper certificate is joined.
This holds for every returned record pair, not only a selected input fixture. -/
theorem reference_trace (w : RW) (p : RP) (pub : Public F)
    (hw : WitnessOk (rawWitness w))
    (hp : PubCorr (rawPublic p) (mapPub (K := K) pub)) :
    BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (K := K) (rawWitness w) (rawPublic p) =
      BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace
        (BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (BuilderRecordCanonical.witness (rawWitness w)))
        (BuilderCanonical.rustPublic pub) :=
  BuilderFieldNormalization.trace_normalization _ _ _ hw hp

#print axioms reference_trace
end R1Z.BuilderExtractedRecords

import R1Z.BuilderRecordsPath
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsRecipient
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsPublic
import R1Z.BuilderExtractedRecords

/-! Total, all-field refinement of the D90 owned reference. The reference is
not the shipped function: its source equality is the separate named P6 route. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordsReference
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisBuilderRecordsReference R0Z.WriterRefine
open pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray
abbrev Input := BuilderRecordsPath.Input
abbrev Note := BuilderRecordsRecipient.Note
abbrev Snapshot := BuilderRecordsPublic.Snapshot
abbrev Roots := BuilderRecordsPublic.Roots

def witness (input : Input) (out : U32) (rec : Option Note) (chg : Note) : RW where
  input_value := input.pair.value
  output_value := out
  change_value := chg.value
  sk := input.pair.nullifier_key
  salt := input.pair.salt
  bits := BuilderRecordsPath.bits input
  sibs := BuilderRecordsPath.siblings input
  pair_first := input.pair.pair_leaf.first_commitment
  pair_occupied := input.pair.pair_leaf.second_occupied
  pair_second := input.pair.pair_leaf.second_commitment
  pair_inverse := input.pair.pair_leaf.second_occupancy_inverse
  recipient_owner := BuilderRecordsRecipient.owner rec
  recipient_salt := BuilderRecordsRecipient.salt rec
  change_owner := chg.owner_key
  change_salt := chg.salt

def publicRecord (rec : Option Note) (s : Snapshot) (asset : U32) (empty : Roots) : RP where
  transfer := rec.isSome
  asset := asset
  next_pair_index := s.next_pair_index
  frontier := s.frontier
  empty := BuilderRecordsPublic.empty20 empty

theorem raw_owned (d : Array U32 8#usize) : records_reference.raw_owned d = ok d := by
  rw [records_reference.raw_owned]
  rw [index_ok d 0#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok d 1#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok d 2#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok d 3#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok d 4#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok d 5#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok d 6#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok d 7#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  congr 1
  apply BuilderRecordCanonical.array_ext
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i < 8 := by simpa using hi
  interval_cases i <;> rfl

/-- No success premise, range premise, or array/loop equality is assumed.
All 20 fields are computed, for every machine-word input and both variants. -/
theorem records (input : Input) (out : U32) (rec : Option Note) (chg : Note)
    (s : Snapshot) (asset : U32) (empty : Roots) :
    records_reference.records_reference_with_roots input out rec chg s asset empty =
      ok (witness input out rec chg, publicRecord rec s asset empty) := by
  rw [records_reference.records_reference_with_roots, BuilderRecordsPath.from_zero]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderRecordsRecipient.loop_spec rec ZERO8 ZERO8 0#usize (by simp)
    (fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) (by intro j hj; simp at hj) (by intro j hj; simp at hj)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderRecordsPublic.from_zero]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [raw_owned, bind_tc_ok]
  cases rec <;> rfl

/-- The exact returned record types now feed field normalization. Admission
and the actual empty-root helper meaning remain separately named obligations. -/
theorem normalized_trace
    {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]
    (input : Input) (out : U32) (rec : Option Note) (chg : Note)
    (s : Snapshot) (asset : U32) (empty : Roots) (pub : R0P.Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F)
    (hw : WitnessOk (BuilderExtractedRecords.rawWitness (witness input out rec chg)))
    (hp : PubCorr (BuilderExtractedRecords.rawPublic (publicRecord rec s asset empty))
      (R1J.SpendWitnessMap.mapPub (K := K) pub)) :
    BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (K := K)
      (BuilderExtractedRecords.rawWitness (witness input out rec chg))
      (BuilderExtractedRecords.rawPublic (publicRecord rec s asset empty)) =
      BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace
        (BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (BuilderRecordCanonical.witness
          (BuilderExtractedRecords.rawWitness (witness input out rec chg))))
        (BuilderCanonical.rustPublic pub) :=
  BuilderExtractedRecords.reference_trace _ _ _ hw hp

#print axioms raw_owned
#print axioms records
#print axioms normalized_trace
end R1Z.BuilderRecordsReference

R1Z.BuilderStdModels.text:
import Aeneas.Std
import Aeneas.Tactic.RustAttributes

/-! Standard-library adapters for the five unsupported bank externals.
The array adapter calls a mutable closure in increasing index order and
threads its state. Map.next calls the underlying iterator once and only
calls the closure on Some. Range membership short-circuits its comparisons.
These are definitions with kernel-checked specifications, not postulates. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderStdModels
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

variable {T C I A B : Type}

def fromFnLoop (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Std.Usize T) :
    List Std.Usize → C → Result (List T × C)
  | [], c => ok ([], c)
  | i :: is, c => do
      let (x, c') ← f.call_mut c i
      let (xs, c'') ← fromFnLoop f is c'
      ok (x :: xs, c'')

def indices (n : Std.Usize) : List Std.Usize :=
  List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n.val => Std.Usize.ofNatCore i.val
    (lt_trans i.isLt n.hBounds))

def fromFn (n : Std.Usize) (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Std.Usize T)
    (c : C) : Result (Aeneas.Std.Array T n) := do
  let (xs, _) ← fromFnLoop f (indices n) c
  if h : xs.length = n.val then ok ⟨xs, h⟩ else .fail .panic

def iterMap (_it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (_f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A B) (i : I) (c : C) :
    Result (core.iter.adapters.map.Map I C) := ok ⟨i, c⟩

def mapNext (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A B) (m : core.iter.adapters.map.Map I C) :
    Result (Option B × core.iter.adapters.map.Map I C) := do
  let (x, i') ← it.next m.iter
  match x with
  | none => ok (none, ⟨i', m.f⟩)
  | some x => do
      let (y, c') ← f.call_mut m.f x

  rw [shift_count_mod64]

import R1Z.BuilderRecordsReference
import R1Z.BuilderBankExtracted

/-! P6 composition boundary. `FieldsEqual` is the proposition certified by
D90's six Kani projections. It is a named hypothesis, never a Lean axiom.
The checked reference computation then transports all bank outputs, including
failure/divergence and the merge flag, through the axiom-free std models.
This is record-substitution equality, not yet Parts-to-copyCell refinement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordsP6
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisBuilderRecordsReference
open pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder BuilderRecordsReference

structure FieldsEqual (w : RW) (p : RP) (v : RW) (q : RP) : Prop where
  input_value : w.input_value = v.input_value
  output_value : w.output_value = v.output_value
  change_value : w.change_value = v.change_value
  sk : w.sk = v.sk
  salt : w.salt = v.salt
  bits : w.bits = v.bits
  sibs : w.sibs = v.sibs
  pair_first : w.pair_first = v.pair_first
  pair_occupied : w.pair_occupied = v.pair_occupied
  pair_second : w.pair_second = v.pair_second
  pair_inverse : w.pair_inverse = v.pair_inverse
  recipient_owner : w.recipient_owner = v.recipient_owner
  recipient_salt : w.recipient_salt = v.recipient_salt
  change_owner : w.change_owner = v.change_owner
  change_salt : w.change_salt = v.change_salt
  transfer : p.transfer = q.transfer
  asset : p.asset = q.asset
  next_pair_index : p.next_pair_index = q.next_pair_index
  frontier : p.frontier = q.frontier
  empty : p.empty = q.empty

theorem FieldsEqual.eq {w v : RW} {p q : RP} (e : FieldsEqual w p v q) :
    w = v ∧ p = q := by
  constructor
  · cases w; cases v
    cases e
    congr <;> assumption
  · cases p; cases q
    cases e
    congr <;> assumption

/-- The exact P6 route combines a successful extracted reference execution
with D90's pointwise equality certificate. No proof of source admission is
encoded here. The root table is shared by both sides, as in D90. -/
def Route (w : RW) (p : RP) (input : Input) (out : U32) (rec : Option Note)
    (chg : Note) (s : Snapshot) (asset : U32) (empty : Roots) : Prop :=
  ∃ v q, records_reference.records_reference_with_roots input out rec chg s asset empty =
    ok (v,q) ∧ FieldsEqual w p v q

theorem route_records {w : RW} {p : RP} {input : Input} {out : U32} {rec : Option Note}
    {chg : Note} {s : Snapshot} {asset : U32} {empty : Roots}
    (p6 : Route w p input out rec chg s asset empty) :
    w = witness input out rec chg ∧ p = publicRecord rec s asset empty := by
  obtain ⟨v, q, h, eq⟩ := p6
  rw [BuilderRecordsReference.records] at h
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
  exact eq.eq

abbrev BankRW := AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RW
abbrev BankRP := AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RP

def bankWitness (w : RW) : BankRW where
  input_value := w.input_value
  output_value := w.output_value
  change_value := w.change_value
  sk := w.sk
  salt := w.salt
  bits := w.bits
  sibs := w.sibs
  pair_first := w.pair_first
  pair_occupied := w.pair_occupied
  pair_second := w.pair_second
  pair_inverse := w.pair_inverse
  recipient_owner := w.recipient_owner
  recipient_salt := w.recipient_salt
  change_owner := w.change_owner
  change_salt := w.change_salt

def bankPublic (p : RP) : BankRP where
  transfer := p.transfer
  asset := p.asset
  next_pair_index := p.next_pair_index
  frontier := p.frontier
  empty := p.empty

/-- Equality of the entire extracted bank computation with the approved std
models: stable, late, merged and merge-check flag, not just selected cells.
It does not assert equality of either side with copyCellMerged. -/
theorem route_banks {w : RW} {p : RP} {input : Input} {out : U32} {rec : Option Note}
    {chg : Note} {s : Snapshot} {asset : U32} {empty : Roots}
    (p6 : Route w p input out rec chg s asset empty) :
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.merged_banks
      (bankWitness w) (bankPublic p) =
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.merged_banks
      (bankWitness (witness input out rec chg)) (bankPublic (publicRecord rec s asset empty)) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, hp⟩ := route_records p6
  rw [hw, hp]

#print axioms FieldsEqual.eq
#print axioms route_records
#print axioms route_banks
end R1Z.BuilderRecordsP6

import R1Z.BuilderBankShape
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsPath

/-! The actual extracted bank dispatcher reads the Parts table cellwise.
No assumption about the origin or cryptographic meaning of Parts is made. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderBankCells
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

def cell (pt : Parts) (c r : Nat) : U32 :=
  if c < 16 then
    if r < 912 then (pt.blocks.val[r/16]!).val[(r%16)*16+c]!
    else if r < 1008 then pt.path.val[(r-912)*16+c]!
    else pt.aux.val[(r-1008)*16+c]!
  else 0#u32

theorem vec_index {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val < v.val.length) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) v i = ok v.val[i.val]! := by
  rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index]
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize
  change (match v.val[i.val]? with | none => fail .arrayOutOfBounds | some x => ok x) = _
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
  simp only [getElem!_pos v.val i.val hi]

theorem copy_cell (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57)
    (c r : Usize) (hr : r.val < 1024) :
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.copy_cell pt c r =
      ok (cell pt c.val r.val) := by
  rw [AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.copy_cell]
  simp only [C1_COLS, PATH_ROW0, AUX_ROW0]
  unfold cell
  by_cases hc : c.val < 16
  · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hc), if_pos hc]
    by_cases hpath : r.val < 912
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hpath), if_pos hpath]
      obtain ⟨q,hq,vq⟩ := UScalar.div_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp)
      rw [hq]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [vec_index _ q (by simp only [hblocks, vq]; simp; omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      obtain ⟨rem,hrem,vrem⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp))
      rw [hrem]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
      have vq' : q.val = r.val/16 := by simpa using vq
      have vr : rem.val = r.val%16 := by simpa using vrem
      have vm : (Usize.wrapping_mul rem 16#usize).val = (r.val%16)*16 := by
        rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp only [vr, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
      have va : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul rem 16#usize) c).val =
          (r.val%16)*16+c.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vm]; omega), vm]
      rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [va]; simp; omega)]
      simp only [vq',va]
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hpath), if_neg hpath]
      by_cases haux : r.val < 1008
      · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using haux), if_pos haux]
        simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
        have vs : (Usize.wrapping_sub r 912#usize).val = r.val-912 := by
          simpa using BuilderRecordsPath.sub_val r 912#usize (by simp; omega)
        have vm : (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 912#usize) 16#usize).val =
            (r.val-912)*16 := by
          rw [umul _ _ (by rw [vs]; simp; omega), vs]; rfl
        have va : (Usize.wrapping_add
            (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 912#usize) 16#usize) c).val =
            (r.val-912)*16+c.val := by
          rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vm]; omega),vm]
        rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [va]; simp; omega)]
        simp only [va]
      · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using haux), if_neg haux]
        simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
        have vs : (Usize.wrapping_sub r 1008#usize).val = r.val-1008 := by
          simpa using BuilderRecordsPath.sub_val r 1008#usize (by simp; omega)
        have vm : (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 1008#usize) 16#usize).val =
            (r.val-1008)*16 := by
          rw [umul _ _ (by rw [vs]; simp; omega),vs]; rfl
        have va : (Usize.wrapping_add
            (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 1008#usize) 16#usize) c).val =
            (r.val-1008)*16+c.val := by
          rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vm]; omega),vm]
        rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [va]; simp; omega)]
        simp only [va]
  · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hc), if_neg hc]

#print axioms vec_index
#print axioms copy_cell
end R1Z.BuilderBankCells

theorem next_some (r : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (h : r.start.val < r.end.val) :

  obtain ⟨⟨opt,after⟩,hr,ho,hs⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_Usize_none_spec r h)

R1Z.BuilderBankStep.text:
import R1Z.BuilderBankRange
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderBankStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder
open BuilderBankCells
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Bank := Array U32 16384#usize

def stableValue (pt : Parts) (k : Nat) : U32 :=
  if LateRow k then 0#u32 else cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024)
def lateValue (pt : Parts) (k : Nat) : U32 :=
  if LateRow k then cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024) else 0#u32

theorem late_cell (pt : Parts) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 16384) (h : LateRow k) :
    cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024) =
      (pt.blocks.val[k%1024/16]!).val[(k%1024%16)*16+k/1024]! := by
  unfold LateRow at h
  rw [cell, if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]

theorem step (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57) (stable late : Bank)
    (iter after : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (k : Usize) (hk : k.val < 16384)
    (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter = ok (some k,after)) :
    merged_banks_loop iter pt stable late =
      merged_banks_loop after pt
        (stable.set k (stableValue pt k.val)) (late.set k (lateValue pt k.val)) := by
  rw [merged_banks_loop,next]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderBankShape.late_row]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases hlate : LateRow k.val
  · have hrows := hlate
    unfold LateRow at hrows
    simp only [hlate,decide_true,if_true,stableValue,lateValue]
    rw [update_ok stable k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨r,hr,vr⟩ := rem1024 k
    rw [hr]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨q,hq,vq⟩ := UScalar.div_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp)
    rw [hq]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    have vr' : r.val = k.val%1024 := by simpa using vr
    have vq' : q.val = k.val%1024/16 := by simpa [vr'] using vq
    rw [vec_index _ q (by rw [hblocks,vq']; omega)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨m,hm,vm⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp))
    rw [hm]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,lift]
    obtain ⟨c,hc,vc⟩ := UScalar.div_spec k (y := 1024#usize) (by simp)
    rw [hc]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,lift]
    have vm' : m.val = k.val%1024%16 := by simpa [vr'] using vm
    have vc' : c.val = k.val/1024 := by simpa using vc
    have vprod : (Usize.wrapping_mul m 16#usize).val = (k.val%1024%16)*16 := by
      rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp only [vm',UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    have vsum : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul m 16#usize) c).val =
        (k.val%1024%16)*16+k.val/1024 := by
      rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vprod,vc']; omega),vprod,vc']
    rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [vsum]; simp; omega)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok late k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,vsum,vq']
    rw [late_cell pt k.val hk hlate]
  · simp only [hlate,decide_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,stableValue,lateValue]
    obtain ⟨c,hc,vc⟩ := UScalar.div_spec k (y := 1024#usize) (by simp)
    rw [hc]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨r,hr,vr⟩ := rem1024 k
    rw [hr]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [BuilderBankCells.copy_cell pt hblocks c r (by simpa [vr] using Nat.mod_lt k.val (by decide : 0 < 1024))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok stable k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok late k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    have vc' : c.val = k.val/1024 := by simpa using vc
    simp only [vc',vr]

#print axioms late_cell
#print axioms step
end R1Z.BuilderBankStep

import R1Z.BuilderBankExtracted
import R0Z.BuilderWitnessMerged

/-! Symbolic identification of the actual extracted merge callees with the
existing checked writers. No bank cell is enumerated or concretely reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderBankMerge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
abbrev Bank := Array U32 16384#usize

theorem model_count : R0WriterCopies.TRACE_CELLS = ok 16384#usize := by
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hv⟩ := trace_cells
  have he : t = 16384#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by simpa using hv)
  simpa only [he] using ht

theorem source_count : AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.TRACE_CELLS =
    ok 16384#usize := by
  rw [AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.TRACE_CELLS, ← R0WriterCopies.TRACE_CELLS]
  exact model_count

theorem copy_loop (stable late out : Bank) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ 16384) :
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_copy_loop stable late out i =
      R0WriterCopies.merge_copy_loop stable late out i := by
  generalize he : 16384-i.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i out with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_copy_loop,
      R0WriterCopies.merge_copy_loop]
    simp only [source_count, model_count, bind_tc_ok, lift]
    by_cases hit : i.val < 16384
    · have ht : i < 16384#usize := by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hit
      simp only [if_pos ht]
      have hn : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val+1 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by simp; omega)]; rfl
      have hnext : ∀ out : Bank,
          AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_copy_loop stable late out
            (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) =
          R0WriterCopies.merge_copy_loop stable late out (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) := by
        intro out
        exact ih (16384-(Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val) (by omega)
          out (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (by omega) rfl
      simp only [hnext]
    · simp only [if_neg (show ¬i < 16384#usize by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hit)]

theorem copy (stable late : Bank) :
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_copy stable late =
      R0WriterCopies.merge_copy stable late := by
  exact copy_loop stable late (Array.repeat 16384#usize 0#u32) 0#usize (by simp)

theorem check_loop (stable late : Bank) (flag : Bool) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ 16384) :
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_check_loop stable late flag i =
      R0WriterCopies.merge_check_loop stable late flag i := by
  generalize he : 16384-i.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i flag with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_check_loop,
      R0WriterCopies.merge_check_loop]
    simp only [source_count, model_count, bind_tc_ok, lift]
    by_cases hit : i.val < 16384
    · have ht : i < 16384#usize := by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hit
      simp only [if_pos ht]
      have hn : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val+1 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by simp; omega)]; rfl
      have hnext : ∀ flag : Bool,
          AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_check_loop stable late flag
            (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) =
          R0WriterCopies.merge_check_loop stable late flag (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) := by
        intro flag
        exact ih (16384-(Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val) (by omega)
          flag (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (by omega) rfl
      simp only [hnext]
    · simp only [if_neg (show ¬i < 16384#usize by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hit)]

theorem check (stable late : Bank) :
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.merge_check stable late =
      R0WriterCopies.merge_check stable late :=
  check_loop stable late true 0#usize (by simp)

#print axioms source_count
#print axioms model_count
#print axioms copy_loop
#print axioms copy
#print axioms check_loop
#print axioms check
end R1Z.BuilderBankMerge

import R1Z.BuilderStdModels

/-! Order-preserving finite iterator collection. The trace premise specifies
only Iterator.next results, not a correctness conclusion for the bank. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderStdModels
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
variable {I A B C : Type}

inductive FiniteTrace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A) :
    I → List A → Prop
  | done (i i' : I) (h : it.next i = ok (none, i')) : FiniteTrace it i []
  | step (i i' : I) (x : A) (xs : List A)
      (h : it.next i = ok (some x, i')) (tail : FiniteTrace it i' xs) :
      FiniteTrace it i (x :: xs)

theorem collect_trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (i : I) (xs : List A) (ht : FiniteTrace it i xs) (acc : List A) :
    alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList it i acc = ok (acc.reverse ++ xs) := by
  induction ht generalizing acc with
  | done i i' h =>
      rw [alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList, h]
      simp
  | step i i' x xs h tail ih =>
      rw [alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList, h]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [ih]
      simp [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]

def mappedIterator (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A B) :
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator (core.iter.adapters.map.Map I C) B where
  next := mapNext it f

theorem mapped_trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A B) (g : A → B)
    (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (g x, c))
    (i : I) (xs : List A) (ht : FiniteTrace it i xs) (c : C) :
    FiniteTrace (mappedIterator it f) ⟨i, c⟩ (xs.map g) := by
  induction ht with
  | done i i' h =>
      exact .done _ ⟨i', c⟩ (mapNext_none it f ⟨i, c⟩ i' h)
  | step i i' x xs h tail ih =>
      have hs : (mappedIterator it f).next ⟨i, c⟩ =
          ok (some (g x), ⟨i', c⟩) :=
        mapNext_some it f ⟨i, c⟩ i' x (g x) c h (hf c x)
      exact FiniteTrace.step _ _ _ _ hs ih

theorem collect_mapped_trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A B) (g : A → B)
    (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (g x, c))
    (i : I) (xs : List A) (ht : FiniteTrace it i xs) (c : C) :
    alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList (mappedIterator it f) ⟨i, c⟩ [] =
      ok (xs.map g) := by
  exact collect_trace _ _ _ (mapped_trace it f g hf i xs ht c) []

#print axioms collect_trace
#print axioms mapped_trace
#print axioms collect_mapped_trace
end R1Z.BuilderStdModels

import R1Z.BuilderRecordsExtracted

/-! Successful owned-reference mapping preserves the explicit output/change
values and asset. This is a theorem about the extracted reference only;
shipped-records equivalence and the canonical witness map remain separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordsFields
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisBuilderRecordsReference
open pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

theorem bind_ok_inv {α β : Type} {x : Result α} {f : α → Result β} {t : β}
    (h : (do let a ← x; f a) = ok t) : ∃ a, x = ok a ∧ f a = ok t := by
  cases x with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a, rfl, by simpa using h⟩
  | fail e => simp at h
  | div => simp at h

theorem fixed_fields
    (input : pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1)
    (out : U32) (rec : Option pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (chg : pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (snapshot : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (asset : aspis_core.field.M31)
    (empty : Array (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) 21#usize)
    (w : RW) (p : RP)
    (h : records_reference.records_reference_with_roots
      input out rec chg snapshot asset empty = ok (w, p)) :
    w.output_value = out ∧ w.change_value = chg.value ∧ p.asset = asset := by
  unfold records_reference.records_reference_with_roots at h
  obtain ⟨⟨pair, bits, sibs⟩, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨⟨rec1, owner, salt⟩, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨⟨snapshot1, frontier, empty1⟩, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨sk, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨salt1, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨first, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨second, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨owner1, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨salt2, _, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

#print axioms bind_ok_inv
#print axioms fixed_fields
end R1Z.BuilderRecordsFields

import R1Z.BuilderBankRange
import R1Z.BuilderStdCollect
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsFields

/-! A successful mapped range collection has the exact range length even
when the mapper is partial. No totality of the cryptographic callee is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderBankCollect
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result BuilderStdModels BuilderRecordsFields
variable {C T : Type}
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev MapRange (C : Type) := core.iter.adapters.map.Map Range C

def mapped (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize T) :
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator (MapRange C) T :=
  mappedIterator (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize) f

theorem collect_length (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize T)
    (r : Range) (c : C) (acc out : List T)
    (hbound : r.start.val ≤ r.end.val)
    (h : alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList (mapped f) ⟨r,c⟩ acc = ok out) :
    out.length = acc.length + (r.end.val-r.start.val) := by
  generalize he : r.end.val-r.start.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing r c acc out with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList] at h
    by_cases hlt : r.start.val < r.end.val
    · obtain ⟨after,hn,hs,he'⟩ := BuilderBankRange.next_some r hlt
      have hm : (mapped f).next ⟨r,c⟩ = (do
          let (v,c') ← f.call_mut c r.start
          ok (some v,⟨after,c'⟩)) := by
        change mapNext _ f ⟨r,c⟩ = _
        rw [mapNext]
        simp only [core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange]
        rw [hn]; rfl
      rw [hm] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨v,c'⟩,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv (by simpa only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok] using h)
      have ht := ih (after.end.val-after.start.val) (by rw [he']; omega)
        after c' (v::acc) out (by rw [he']; omega) h rfl
      simp only [List.length_cons] at ht
      rw [he'] at ht
      omega
    · have hn := BuilderBankRange.next_none r (by omega)
      have hm : (mapped f).next ⟨r,c⟩ = ok (none,⟨r,c⟩) := by
        change mapNext _ f ⟨r,c⟩ = _
        rw [mapNext]
        simp only [core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange]
        rw [hn]; rfl
      rw [hm] at h
      simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
      have hout : out = acc.reverse := (Result.ok.inj h).symm
      rw [hout,List.length_reverse]
      omega

theorem vector_length (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize T)
    (r : Range) (c : C) (out : alloc.vec.Vec T) (hbound : r.start.val ≤ r.end.val)
    (h : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default (mapped f)
      (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec T) ⟨r,c⟩ = ok out) :
    out.val.length = r.end.val-r.start.val := by
  unfold core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
    core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.from_iter at h
  simp only [core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator.Blanket.into_iter,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨xs,hxs,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  by_cases hb : xs.length ≤ Usize.max
  · rw [dif_pos hb] at h
    have ho := congrArg Subtype.val (Result.ok.inj h)
    rw [← ho]
    simpa using collect_length f r c [] xs hbound hxs
  · rw [dif_neg hb] at h
    cases h

theorem parts_blocks_length
    (w : AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RW)
    (p : AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RP)
    (pt : AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.Parts)
    (h : AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.parts w p = ok pt) :
    pt.blocks.val.length = 57 := by
  unfold AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.parts at h
  simp only [AspisBuilderGlueSource.core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.map.default,
    iterMap,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨blocks,hblocks,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  have hlen := vector_length
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.parts.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeArrayU32256
    ⟨0#usize,57#usize⟩ (w,p) blocks (by simp) hblocks
  obtain ⟨⟨cur,l,r⟩,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨path,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨inRec,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨outRec,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨aux,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  have hp := congrArg
    AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.Parts.blocks (Result.ok.inj h)
  rw [← hp]
  simpa using hlen

#print axioms collect_length
#print axioms vector_length
#print axioms parts_blocks_length
end R1Z.BuilderBankCollect

R1Z.BuilderBankMaterialization.text:
import R1Z.BuilderBankStep
import R1Z.BuilderBankMerge
import R1Z.BuilderBankCollect

/-! Full bank materialization from an arbitrary well-sized Parts record.
The 16,384 writes are proved by one symbolic prefix induction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderBankMaterialization
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open AspisBuilderGlueSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder
open BuilderBankStep BuilderRecordsArray
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def stableModel (pt : Parts) : Bank := tabulate 16384#usize (stableValue pt)
def lateModel (pt : Parts) : Bank := tabulate 16384#usize (lateValue pt)

theorem loop (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57)
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (stable late : Bank)
    (hend : iter.end = 16384#usize) (hstart : iter.start.val ≤ 16384)
    (hs : Prefix stable (stableModel pt) iter.start.val)
    (hl : Prefix late (lateModel pt) iter.start.val) :
    merged_banks_loop iter pt stable late = ok (stableModel pt,lateModel pt) := by
  generalize he : 16384-iter.start.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing iter stable late with
  | h remaining ih =>
    by_cases hit : iter.start.val < 16384
    · obtain ⟨after,hnext,hval,hafterend⟩ := BuilderBankRange.next_some iter (by simpa [hend] using hit)
      rw [BuilderBankStep.step pt hblocks stable late iter after iter.start hit hnext]
      have hsval : stableValue pt iter.start.val = (stableModel pt).val[iter.start.val]! :=
        (tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hit)).symm
      have hlval : lateValue pt iter.start.val = (lateModel pt).val[iter.start.val]! :=
        (tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hit)).symm
      rw [hsval,hlval]
      apply ih (16384-after.start.val) (by omega) after _ _ (hafterend.trans hend) (by omega)
      · simpa only [hval] using prefix_step stable (stableModel pt) iter.start (by simpa using hit) hs
      · simpa only [hval] using prefix_step late (lateModel pt) iter.start (by simpa using hit) hl
      · rfl
    · rw [merged_banks_loop,BuilderBankRange.next_none iter (by simpa [hend] using (show 16384 ≤ iter.start.val by omega))]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      have hv : iter.start.val = (16384#usize : Usize).val := by simp; omega
      rw [prefix_done stable (stableModel pt) (by simpa only [hv] using hs),
        prefix_done late (lateModel pt) (by simpa only [hv] using hl)]

theorem from_zero (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57) (stable late : Bank) :
    merged_banks_loop ⟨0#usize,16384#usize⟩ pt stable late = ok (stableModel pt,lateModel pt) :=
  loop pt hblocks _ stable late rfl (by simp)
    (by intro j hj; simp at hj) (by intro j hj; simp at hj)

/-- This isolates precisely the remaining Parts computation. Once `parts`
returns a well-sized record, every stable/late/merged cell and merge flag is
identified with the existing checked writers; no array equality is assumed. -/
theorem banks_of_parts (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts)
    (hp : parts w p = ok pt) :
    merged_banks w p = (do
      let flag ← R0WriterCopies.merge_check (stableModel pt) (lateModel pt)
      let merged ← R0WriterCopies.merge_copy (stableModel pt) (lateModel pt)
      ok (flag,stableModel pt,lateModel pt,merged)) := by
  have hblocks := BuilderBankCollect.parts_blocks_length w p pt hp
  rw [merged_banks,hp]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderBankMerge.source_count]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [from_zero pt hblocks]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,BuilderBankMerge.check,BuilderBankMerge.copy]

/-- Actual successful Parts computation gives the full-bank std table,
including a successful merge check. This needs no semantic admission premise. -/
theorem banks_table (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts) (hp : parts w p = ok pt) :
    ∃ merged, merged_banks w p = ok (true,stableModel pt,lateModel pt,merged) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 16384 → merged.val[k]! = BuilderBankCells.cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024) := by
  let M : Nat → U32 := fun k => BuilderBankCells.cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024)
  have hs : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (stableModel pt).val[k]! = if LateRow k then 0#u32 else M k := by
    intro k hk
    exact tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hk)
  have hl : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (lateModel pt).val[k]! = if LateRow k then M k else 0#u32 := by
    intro k hk
    exact tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hk)
  obtain ⟨hcheck,merged,hmerged,hcells⟩ := merge_model M (stableModel pt) (lateModel pt) hs hl
  refine ⟨merged,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [banks_of_parts w p pt hp,hcheck]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hmerged]
    rfl
  · exact hcells

#print axioms from_zero
#print axioms banks_of_parts
#print axioms banks_table
end R1Z.BuilderBankMaterialization

/-! A fixed-event execution join cannot follow from builder facts alone
while the source experiment remains arbitrary. This is a typed obstruction
to deleting the release's execution premise without a concrete source law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderExecutionBoundary
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem constant_mismatch_forces_full_bad
    {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (e : ModelExecutionJoin (fun _ : R => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : M => (1 : ℚ)) bad) :
    eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) = 1 := by
  have hall : ∀ s : e.cp.S, ∃ i, bad i (e.cp.toM s) := by
    intro s
    by_contra hn
    have h := e.agreement s hn
    norm_num at h
  have ht := e.cp.meanM (fun m : M => @ite ℚ (∃ i, bad i m) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0)
  simp only [hall,if_true,mean_const] at ht
  simpa [eventMass] using ht.symm

theorem no_constant_mismatch_join
    {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (hsmall : eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) < 1) :
    ¬ Nonempty (ModelExecutionJoin (fun _ : R => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : M => (1 : ℚ)) bad) := by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  rw [constant_mismatch_forces_full_bad bad e] at hsmall
  exact (lt_irrefl (1 : ℚ)) hsmall

/-! Explicit std models for the successful-source admission extraction.

mutable predicate state between calls. No opaque declaration is introduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderAdmissionStd
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

variable {T C E O U V : Type}

def mapErr (f : core.ops.function.FnOnce O E V)
    (r : core.result.Result T E) (c : O) : Result (core.result.Result T V) :=
  match r with
  | .Ok x => ok (.Ok x)
  | .Err e => do let e' ← f.call_once c e; ok (.Err e')

/-- Return the first stopping truth value and consumed element count. -/
def scan (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T Bool) (stop : Bool) :
    List T → C → Result (Bool × Nat)
  | [], _ => ok (!stop, 0)
  | x :: xs, c => do
      let (b,c') ← f.call_mut c x
      if b = stop then ok (b,1)
      else do let (b',n) ← scan f stop xs c'; ok (b',n+1)

def iterScan (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T Bool) (stop : Bool)
    (it : core.slice.iter.Iter T) (c : C) : Result (Bool × core.slice.iter.Iter T) := do
  let (b,n) ← scan f stop (it.slice.val.drop it.i) c
  ok (b,{it with i := it.i+n})

def all (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T Bool) := iterScan f false
def any (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T Bool) := iterScan f true

theorem mapErr_ok (f : core.ops.function.FnOnce O E V) (x : T) (c : O) :
    mapErr f (.Ok x) c = ok (.Ok x) := rfl

theorem scan_pure (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T Bool) (g : T → Bool)
    (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (g x,c))
    (stop : Bool) (xs : List T) (c : C) :
    ∃ b n, scan f stop xs c = ok (b,n) ∧ n ≤ xs.length ∧
      (b ≠ stop ↔ ∀ x ∈ xs, g x ≠ stop) := by
  induction xs generalizing c with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨!stop,0,rfl,by simp,?_⟩
      cases stop <;> simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      rw [scan, hf]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      by_cases h : g x = stop
      · rw [if_pos h]
        refine ⟨g x,1,rfl,by simp,?_⟩
        simp [h]
      · rw [if_neg h]
        obtain ⟨b,n,hs,hn,hb⟩ := ih c
        rw [hs]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact ⟨b,n+1,rfl,by simpa using Nat.add_le_add_right hn 1,by simpa [h] using hb⟩

theorem iterScan_pure (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T Bool) (g : T → Bool)
    (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (g x,c))
    (stop : Bool) (it : core.slice.iter.Iter T) (c : C) :
    ∃ b after, iterScan f stop it c = ok (b,after) ∧
      after.slice = it.slice ∧ it.i ≤ after.i ∧ after.i ≤ max it.i it.slice.val.length ∧
      (b ≠ stop ↔ ∀ x ∈ it.slice.val.drop it.i, g x ≠ stop) := by
  obtain ⟨b,n,hs,hn,hb⟩ := scan_pure f g hf stop (it.slice.val.drop it.i) c
  refine ⟨b,{it with i := it.i+n},?_,rfl,by dsimp; omega,?_,hb⟩
  · rw [iterScan, hs]; rfl
  · dsimp only
    simp only [List.length_drop] at hn
    omega

#print axioms scan_pure
#print axioms iterScan_pure
end R1Z.BuilderAdmissionStd

theorem bool_word (b : Bool) :
    (core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from b).val = 0 ∨
      (core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from b).val = 1 := by
  cases b <;> simp [core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from]

theorem low_bit (x : U32) : (x &&& 1#u32).val = 0 ∨ (x &&& 1#u32).val = 1 := by
  have hb : x.val % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  simp only [UScalar.val_and, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, Nat.and_one_is_mod]
  omega

theorem bits_boolean (input : Input) (l : Nat) (hl : l < 24) :
    ((BuilderRecordsPath.bits input).val[l]!).val = 0 ∨ ((BuilderRecordsPath.bits input).val[l]!).val = 1 := by
  let i : Usize := Usize.ofNatCore l (by
    simpa [UScalar.size_def] using lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : l < 2^32) R0Z.WriterRefine.usize_size_ge)
  have hi : i.val = l := UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _
  have hg := BuilderRecordsPath.bits_get input i (by omega)
  rw [hi] at hg
  rw [hg]
  split
  · exact bool_word _
  · split
    · exact low_bit _
    · exact bool_word _

/-- No canonicality of key/owner/salt/pair words is required: only sibling
words are constrained by WitnessOk. Both selected pair siblings are admitted
by the pair-leaf validator; super-root siblings by the forest caller. -/
theorem witness_ok (input : Input) (out : U32) (rec : Option Note) (chg : Note)
    (values : input.pair.value.val < 2^30 ∧ out.val < 2^30 ∧ chg.value.val < 2^30)
    (first : Canon8 input.pair.pair_leaf.first_commitment)
    (second : Canon8 input.pair.pair_leaf.second_commitment)
    (membership : ∀ l, l < 20 → Canon8 input.pair.membership.siblings.val[l]!)
    (superRoot : ∀ l, l < 3 → Canon8 input.super_root_siblings.val[l]!) :
    WitnessOk (BuilderExtractedRecords.rawWitness (witness input out rec chg)) where
  values := values
  bits := bits_boolean input
  sibs := by
    intro l hl
    change Canon8 ((BuilderRecordsPath.siblings input).val[l]!)
    rw [BuilderRecordsPath.siblings, tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hl)]
    split
    · split
      · exact first
      · exact second
    · split
      · exact membership _ (by omega)
      · exact superRoot _ (by omega)

  aux : pt.aux = okOr (auxR w p) (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32)

theorem cell_eq (pt : Parts) (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (hc : Content pt w p) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) :
    BuilderBankCells.cell pt c.val r.val = copyCell w p c r := by
  unfold BuilderBankCells.cell copyCell
  split
  · split
    · rw [hc.blocks (r.val/16) (by omega)]
    · split
      · rw [hc.path]
      · rw [hc.aux]
  · rfl

/-- Bank splitting and merging preserves every canonical raw cell for all
records, independently of semantic admission. -/
theorem canonical_merge_cell (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) :
    copyCellMerged w p c r = copyCell w p c r := by
  let M : Nat → U32 := fun k => if h : k < 16384 then cellT w p ⟨k,h⟩ else 0#u32
  have hs : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (stableBank w p).val[k]! = if LateRow k then 0#u32 else M k := by
    intro k hk
    rw [stableBank,arrT_get _ k hk]
    dsimp only [M]
    rw [dif_pos hk]
  have hl : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (lateBank w p).val[k]! = if LateRow k then M k else 0#u32 := by
    intro k hk
    rw [lateBank,arrT_get _ k hk]
    dsimp only [M]
    rw [dif_pos hk]
    by_cases hr : LateRow k
    · rw [if_pos hr,if_pos hr]
      unfold LateRow at hr
      unfold cellT copyCell
      dsimp only
      rw [if_pos (show k/1024 < 16 by omega),if_pos (show k%1024 < 912 by omega)]
    · rw [if_neg hr,if_neg hr]
  obtain ⟨_,out,hout,hcells⟩ := merge_model M (stableBank w p) (lateBank w p) hs hl
  by_cases hc : c.val < 16
  · have hk : c.val*1024+r.val < 16384 := by have := r.isLt; omega
    unfold copyCellMerged
    rw [if_pos hc,show mergedR w p = ok out from hout,okOr_ok,hcells _ hk]
    dsimp only [M]
    rw [dif_pos hk]
    unfold cellT
    have h1 : (⟨(c.val*1024+r.val)/1024,by omega⟩ : Fin 29) = c := by
      apply Fin.ext; dsimp; have := r.isLt; omega
    have h2 : (⟨(c.val*1024+r.val)%1024,Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ : Fin 1024) = r := by
      apply Fin.ext; dsimp; have := r.isLt; omega
    rw [h1,h2]
  · unfold copyCellMerged copyCell
    rw [if_neg hc,if_neg hc]

/-- Column-major readout with the thirteen padding columns made explicit. -/
def columnCell (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) : U32 :=
  if c.val < 16 then flat.val[c.val*1024+r.val]! else 0#u32

theorem banks_columns (rw : RW) (rp : RP) (pt : Parts)
    (hp : parts rw rp = ok pt) (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (hc : Content pt w p) :
    ∃ merged, merged_banks rw rp = ok (true,BuilderBankMaterialization.stableModel pt,
      BuilderBankMaterialization.lateModel pt,merged) ∧
      ∀ c r, columnCell merged c r = copyCellMerged w p c r := by
  obtain ⟨merged,hm,hcells⟩ := BuilderBankMaterialization.banks_table rw rp pt hp
  refine ⟨merged,hm,fun c r => ?_⟩
  rw [canonical_merge_cell]
  unfold columnCell
  by_cases h : c.val < 16
  · rw [if_pos h,hcells _ (by have := r.isLt; omega)]
    have hd : (c.val*1024+r.val)/1024 = c.val := by have := r.isLt; omega
    have hr : (c.val*1024+r.val)%1024 = r.val := by have := r.isLt; omega
    rw [hd,hr]
    exact cell_eq pt w p hc c r
  · rw [if_neg h]
    unfold copyCell
    rw [if_neg h]

#print axioms cell_eq
#print axioms canonical_merge_cell
#print axioms banks_columns
end R1Z.BuilderPartsContent

import R1Z.BuilderStdCollect
