/-! Order-preserving Slice iterator collection by symbolic suffix induction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderSliceCollect
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result BuilderStdModels

variable {T : Type}

theorem slice_trace (s : Slice T) (i : Nat) :
    FiniteTrace (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter T)
      ⟨s,i⟩ (s.val.drop i) := by
  generalize he : s.val.length-i = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i with
  | h remaining ih =>
    by_cases hi : i < s.val.length
    · rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi]
      apply FiniteTrace.step _ ⟨s,i+1⟩
      · change core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next ⟨s,i⟩ = _
        unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next
        simp only [Slice.len_val]
        rw [dif_pos hi]
        rfl
      · exact ih (s.val.length-(i+1)) (by omega) (i+1) rfl
    · rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by omega)]
      apply FiniteTrace.done _ ⟨s,i⟩
      change core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next ⟨s,i⟩ = _
      unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next
      simp only [Slice.len_val]
      rw [dif_neg hi]

def suffix (s : Slice T) (i : Nat) : alloc.vec.Vec T :=
  ⟨s.val.drop i,by simpa only [List.length_drop] using (Nat.sub_le s.val.length i).trans s.property⟩

theorem collect_identity {C : Type}
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T T)
    (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (x,c))
    (s : Slice T) (i : Nat) (c : C) :
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
      (mappedIterator (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter T) f)
      (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec T) ⟨⟨s,i⟩,c⟩ = ok (suffix s i) := by
  have ht := collect_mapped_trace (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter T)
    f id hf ⟨s,i⟩ (s.val.drop i) (slice_trace s i) c
  simp only [List.map_id] at ht
  unfold core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
    core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.from_iter
  simp only [core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator.Blanket.into_iter,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ht]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [dif_pos (show (s.val.drop i).length ≤ Usize.max from (suffix s i).property)]
  rfl

import R1Z.BuilderStdModels

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderStdModels
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
variable {T C : Type}

theorem indices_bound (n : Std.Usize) (i : Std.Usize) (hi : i ∈ indices n) :
    i.val < n.val := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hi
  simpa only [Std.Usize.ofNatCore_val_eq] using j.isLt

theorem fromFnLoop_pure_on (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Std.Usize T)
    (g : Std.Usize → T) (is : List Std.Usize) (c : C)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ is, f.call_mut c i = ok (g i, c)) :
    fromFnLoop f is c = ok (is.map g, c) := by
  induction is with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i is ih =>
      apply fromFnLoop_cons
      · exact h i (by simp)
      · exact ih (fun j hj => h j (by simp [hj]))

theorem fromFn_bounded (n : Std.Usize) (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Std.Usize T)
    (g : Std.Usize → T) (c : C)
    (h : ∀ i, i.val < n.val → f.call_mut c i = ok (g i, c)) :
    fromFn n f c = ok (Aeneas.Std.Array.make n
      ((indices n).map g) (by simp [indices])) := by
  have ht := fromFnLoop_pure_on f g (indices n) c
    (fun i hi => h i (indices_bound n i hi))
  unfold fromFn
  rw [ht]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  have hl : ((indices n).map g).length = n.val := by simp only [List.length_map, indices, List.length_ofFn]
  rw [dif_pos hl]
  rfl

#print axioms indices_bound
#print axioms fromFnLoop_pure_on
#print axioms fromFn_bounded
end R1Z.BuilderStdModels

  rw [index_ok_gen empty level (by simp; omega)]

def wordWitness (w : RW) : RustWitness where
  inputValue := w.input_value
  outputValue := w.output_value
  changeValue := w.change_value
  sk := w.sk
  salt := w.salt
  bits := w.bits
  sibs := w.sibs
  pairFirst := w.pair_first
  pairOccupied := w.pair_occupied
  pairSecond := w.pair_second
  pairInverse := w.pair_inverse
  recipientOwner := w.recipient_owner
  recipientSalt := w.recipient_salt
  changeOwner := w.change_owner
  changeSalt := w.change_salt

def wordPublic (p : RP) : RustPublic where
  variant := if p.transfer then .privateTransfer else .withdrawal
  asset := p.asset
  nextPairIndex := p.next_pair_index.val
  frontier := p.frontier
  empty := p.empty

def inputRecord (w : RW) : AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.OccRecord :=
  ⟨w.pair_occupied,w.pair_inverse,w.pair_second,w.bits.val[0]!,true⟩

theorem in_record (w : RW) : in_rec w = ok (inputRecord w) := by
  rw [in_rec,index_ok w.bits 0#usize (by decide)]
  rfl

theorem input_correspondence (w : RW) :
    BuilderPrimitiveWriters.occRecord (inputRecord w) = inRec (wordWitness w) := rfl

theorem zero_digest : ZERO8 = zero8 := by
  unfold ZERO8 zero8 arr8
  rfl

theorem aux_callee_withdrawal (w : RW) (p : RP) (hp : p.transfer = false) :
    (do
      let i ← in_rec w
      let o ← out_rec w p
      AspisBuilderGlueSource.aspis_r0_writer_copies.write_aux_block
        (Array.make 3#usize [w.input_value,w.output_value,w.change_value]) i o) =
      auxR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) := by
  rw [in_record,out_rec,hp]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderPrimitiveWriters.write_aux_block]
  unfold auxR outRec wordPublic
  simp only [hp,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
  simp only [BuilderPrimitiveWriters.occRecord,zero_digest]
  rfl

theorem parts_aux_withdrawal (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts)
    (hp : p.transfer = false) (h : parts w p = ok pt) :
    auxR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) = ok pt.aux := by
  unfold parts at h
  obtain ⟨m,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨blocks,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨⟨cur,l,r⟩,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨path,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  rw [← aux_callee_withdrawal w p hp]
  obtain ⟨i,hi,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨o,ho,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨aux,ha,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  have he := congrArg Parts.aux (Result.ok.inj h)
  rw [hi,ho]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ha]
  exact congrArg Result.ok he

theorem parts_aux_content_withdrawal (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts)
    (hp : p.transfer = false) (h : parts w p = ok pt) :
    pt.aux = okOr (auxR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)) (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) := by
  rw [parts_aux_withdrawal w p pt hp h,okOr_ok]

#print axioms input_correspondence
#print axioms aux_callee_withdrawal
#print axioms parts_aux_withdrawal

import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientLaw
import R1Z.CommitReadsR1
import R1J.SamplerLawSpend

/-! The exact accepted M31 word carrier, with its two raw-word preimages.
No finite stream or tape is enumerated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
local notation "p" => AspisCircleGroupOrder.P
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]

def sourceBase : Subfield K := (algebraMap (ZMod p) K).fieldRange

def baseEquiv : Fin p ≃ sourceBase (K := K) :=
  (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv.trans
    (Equiv.ofInjective (algebraMap (ZMod p) K) (RingHom.injective _))

def accepted (w : Word) : Option (sourceBase (K := K)) :=
  if h : w.val % 2^31 < p then some (baseEquiv ⟨w.val % 2^31, h⟩) else none

theorem accepted_failure (w : Word) : accepted (K := K) w = none ↔ rejB w = true := by
  unfold accepted
  rw [rejB_iff]
  have hm := Nat.mod_lt w.val (show 0 < 2^31 by positivity)
  split_ifs with h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
    change w.val % 2^31 < 2^31-1 at h
    omega
  · simp only [true_iff]
    change ¬ w.val % 2^31 < 2^31-1 at h
    omega

theorem accepted_fibre (a : sourceBase (K := K)) (w : Word) :
    accepted w = some a ↔ w.val % 2^31 = (baseEquiv.symm a).val := by
  unfold accepted
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Option.some.injEq, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
    intro eq
    have ha := (baseEquiv.symm a).isLt
    rw [eq] at h
    exact h ha

theorem accepted_equal_fibres (a : sourceBase (K := K)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Word => accepted w = some a)).card = 2 := by
  let v := (baseEquiv.symm a).val
  have hv : v < 2^31-1 := (baseEquiv.symm a).isLt
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Word => accepted w = some a)) =
      {⟨v, by omega⟩, ⟨v + 2^31, by omega⟩} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, accepted_fibre,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, Fin.ext_iff]
    have hw := w.isLt
    change w.val % 2^31 = v ↔ w.val = v ∨ w.val = v + 2^31
    omega
  rw [eq]
  apply Finset.card_pair
  intro same
  have bad := congrArg Fin.val same
  dsimp at bad
  omega

#print axioms baseEquiv
#print axioms accepted_failure
#print axioms accepted_fibre
#print axioms accepted_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier

R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier

/-! Exact successful fibres for a consuming rejection stream. Successful
limbs consume only through their accepted word; no 16-word padding per limb. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def step {B T A V : Type} (d : B → Option A) (more : T → Option (A × V))
    (less : T → Option V) (bt : B × T) : Option (A × V) :=
  match d bt.1 with
  | none => more bt.2
  | some a => (less bt.2).map (fun v => (a,v))

theorem step_fibre_card {B T A V : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype T]
    (d : B → Option A) (more : T → Option (A × V)) (less : T → Option V) (out : A × V) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun bt => step d more less bt = some out)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = none)).card *
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => more t = some out)).card +
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = some out.1)).card *
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => less t = some out.2)).card := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun bt => step d more less bt = some out)) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = none)) ×ˢ
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => more t = some out))) ∪
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = some out.1)) ×ˢ
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => less t = some out.2))) := by
    ext bt
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_product]
    rcases bt with ⟨b,t⟩
    cases hd : d b with
    | none => simp [step, hd]
    | some a =>
      cases hl : less t with
      | none => simp [step, hd, hl]
      | some v => simp [step, hd, hl, Prod.ext_iff]
  rw [eq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product]
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro bt h₁ h₂
  have hnone := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp h₁).1).2
  have hsome := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp h₂).1).2
  rw [hnone] at hsome
  contradiction

def Values (A : Type) : Nat → Type
  | 0 => PUnit
  | n+1 => A × Values A n

variable {W A : Type} [Fintype W]

def decodeWords (d : W → Option A) : (n L r : Nat) → (Fin n → W) → Option (Values A L)
  | 0, 0, _, _ => some PUnit.unit
  | 0, _+1, _, _ => none
  | _+1, 0, _, _ => some PUnit.unit
  | _+1, _+1, 0, _ => none
  | n+1, L+1, r+1, ws =>
    step d (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16)
      (ws 0, fun j => ws j.succ)

def wordTailEquiv (W : Type) (n : Nat) : (Fin (n+1) → W) ≃ W × (Fin n → W) where
  toFun ws := (ws 0, fun j => ws j.succ)
  invFun bt := Fin.cons bt.1 bt.2
  left_inv ws := by funext i; exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  right_inv bt := rfl

def consumingFibreEquiv (d : W → Option A) (n L r : Nat) (out : Values A (L+1)) :
    {ws : Fin (n+1) → W // decodeWords d (n+1) (L+1) (r+1) ws = some out} ≃
    {bt : W × (Fin n → W) //
      step d (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16) bt = some out} where
  toFun ws := ⟨wordTailEquiv W n ws.1, ws.2⟩
  invFun bt := ⟨(wordTailEquiv W n).symm bt.1, bt.2⟩
  left_inv ws := Subtype.ext ((wordTailEquiv W n).left_inv ws.1)
  right_inv bt := Subtype.ext ((wordTailEquiv W n).right_inv bt.1)

def fibreSize (q c₀ c₁ : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, 0, _ => 1
  | 0, _+1, _ => 0
  | n+1, 0, _ => q^(n+1)
  | _+1, _+1, 0 => 0
  | n+1, L+1, r+1 => c₀ * fibreSize q c₀ c₁ n (L+1) r + c₁ * fibreSize q c₀ c₁ n L 16

/-- Variable-consumption rejection has equal successful fibres. -/
theorem sequential_equal_fibres (d : W → Option A) (c₀ c₁ : Nat)
    (hz : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = none)).card = c₀)
    (ha : ∀ a, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = some a)).card = c₁)
    (n L r : Nat) (out : Values A L) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n L r ws = some out)).card =
      fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n L r := by
  induction n generalizing L r with
  | zero =>
    cases L with
    | zero => cases out; simp [decodeWords, fibreSize]
    | succ L => simp [decodeWords, fibreSize]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases L with
    | zero => cases out; simp [decodeWords, fibreSize, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
    | succ L =>
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [decodeWords, fibreSize]
      | succ r =>
        have hc := Fintype.card_congr (consumingFibreEquiv d n L r out)
        simp only [Fintype.card_subtype] at hc
        have hs := @step_fibre_card W (Fin n → W) A (Values A L) inferInstance inferInstance d
          (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16) out
        have he := congrArg₂ Nat.add (congrArg₂ Nat.mul hz (ih (L+1) r out))
          (congrArg₂ Nat.mul (ha out.1) (ih L 16 out.2))
        have he' :
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = none)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n (L+1) r t = some out)).card +
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = some out.1)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n L 16 t = some out.2)).card =
            fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ (n+1) (L+1) (r+1) := by
          convert he using 4 <;> first
          | rfl
          | (congr 1; ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and])
          | simp only [fibreSize]
        calc
          _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun bt : W × (Fin n → W) =>
              step d (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16) bt = some out)).card := by
                convert hc using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ext z <;>
                  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = none)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n (L+1) r t = some out)).card +
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = some out.1)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n L 16 t = some out.2)).card := by
                convert hs using 4 <;> congr 1 <;> ext z <;>
                  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          _ = _ := he'

#print axioms step_fibre_card
#print axioms wordTailEquiv
#print axioms consumingFibreEquiv
#print axioms sequential_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres

R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialArrays.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def valuesEquiv (A : Type) : (n : Nat) → Values A n ≃ (Fin n → A)
  | 0 => {
      toFun := fun _ => Fin.elim0
      invFun := fun _ => PUnit.unit
      left_inv := fun v => by cases v; rfl
      right_inv := fun f => by funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i }
  | n+1 => {
      toFun := fun v => Fin.cons v.1 (valuesEquiv A n v.2)
      invFun := fun f => (f 0, (valuesEquiv A n).symm (fun j => f j.succ))
      left_inv := fun v => by
        apply Prod.ext
        · rfl
        · exact (valuesEquiv A n).symm_apply_apply v.2
      right_inv := fun f => by
        funext i
        refine Fin.cases rfl (fun j => ?_) i
        exact congrFun ((valuesEquiv A n).apply_symm_apply (fun j => f j.succ)) j }

variable {W A : Type} [Fintype W]

def arrayDecode (d : W → Option A) (n L r : Nat) (ws : Fin n → W) : Option (Fin L → A) :=
  (decodeWords d n L r ws).map (valuesEquiv A L)

theorem array_equal_fibres (d : W → Option A) (c₀ c₁ : Nat)
    (hz : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = none)).card = c₀)
    (ha : ∀ a, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = some a)).card = c₁) (n L r : Nat) (out : Fin L → A) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws : Fin n → W => arrayDecode d n L r ws = some out)).card =
      fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n L r := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws : Fin n → W => arrayDecode d n L r ws = some out)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => decodeWords d n L r ws = some ((valuesEquiv A L).symm out))) := by
    ext ws
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, arrayDecode]
    cases h : decodeWords d n L r ws with
    | none => simp
    | some v =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
      exact (valuesEquiv A L).apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply
  rw [eq]
  exact sequential_equal_fibres d c₀ c₁ hz ha n L r _

def pairDecode (d : W → Option A) (n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ : Nat)
    (ws : (Fin n₁ → W) × (Fin n₂ → W)) : Option ((Fin L₁ → A) × (Fin L₂ → A)) := do
  let a ← arrayDecode d n₁ L₁ 16 ws.1
  let b ← arrayDecode d n₂ L₂ 16 ws.2
  pure (a,b)

theorem pair_equal_fibres (d : W → Option A) (c₀ c₁ : Nat)
    (hz : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = none)).card = c₀)
    (ha : ∀ a, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = some a)).card = c₁) (n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ : Nat) (out : (Fin L₁ → A) × (Fin L₂ → A)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => pairDecode d n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ ws = some out)).card =
      fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n₁ L₁ 16 * fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n₂ L₂ 16 := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => pairDecode d n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ ws = some out)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => arrayDecode d n₁ L₁ 16 ws = some out.1)) ×ˢ
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => arrayDecode d n₂ L₂ 16 ws = some out.2)) := by
    ext ws
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_product]
    cases h₁ : arrayDecode d n₁ L₁ 16 ws.1 <;>
      cases h₂ : arrayDecode d n₂ L₂ 16 ws.2 <;> simp [pairDecode, h₁, h₂, Prod.ext_iff]
  rw [eq, Finset.card_product, array_equal_fibres d c₀ c₁ hz ha, array_equal_fibres d c₀ c₁ hz ha]

#print axioms valuesEquiv
#print axioms array_equal_fibres
#print axioms pair_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres

R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientLaw

/-! A lossless field-coordinate carrier for the source's five sampled arrays.
The ordering of the Rust caller's cells is a separate execution identity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev FreeRow := {r : Fin 1024 // r ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ CopyActiveRow r}
instance : Fintype FreeRow := Fintype.ofFinite _
variable {K : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}

abbrev Samples (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) :=
  (EligibleCell → F) × ((Fin 10 × Fin 1024 → F) ×
    ((Fin 1024 × Fin 4 → F) × ((FreeRow × Fin 4 → F) × (Fin 1024 × Fin 4 → F))))

def toTape (s : Samples K F) : Tape K F :=
  ((fun c => match c with
    | .inl cr => s.2.1 cr
    | .inr (lane,row,limb) =>
      if lane = 0 then s.2.2.1 (row,limb)
      else if lane = 1 then
        if hr : row ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ CopyActiveRow row then s.2.2.2.1 (⟨row,hr⟩,limb) else 0
      else s.2.2.2.2 (row,limb)), s.1)

def fromQuotient (s : SourceTape K F) : Samples K F :=
  (s.2, (fun cr => s.1 ⟨.inl cr, by simp only [Ignored, not_false_eq_true]⟩),
    (fun rl => s.1 ⟨.inr (0,rl.1,rl.2), by simp [Ignored]⟩),
    (fun rl => s.1 ⟨.inr (1,rl.1.1,rl.2), by
      intro bad
      exact bad.2.elim rl.1.2.1 rl.1.2.2⟩),
    (fun rl => s.1 ⟨.inr (2,rl.1,rl.2), by simp [Ignored]⟩))

theorem from_to (s : Samples K F) : fromQuotient (project (toTape s)) = s := by
  rcases s with ⟨noise,masks,g,h1,d⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext rl; simp only [fromQuotient, project, toTape, ite_true]
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext rl
    simp only [fromQuotient, project, toTape, show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide,
      if_false, ite_true]
    rw [dif_pos rl.1.2]
  · funext rl
    simp only [fromQuotient, project, toTape, show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide,
      show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide, if_false]

theorem to_from (s : SourceTape K F) : project (toTape (fromQuotient s)) = s := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext c
    rcases c with ⟨c,hc⟩
    cases c with
    | inl cr => rfl
    | inr coord =>
      rcases coord with ⟨lane,row,limb⟩
      have hr : lane = 1 → row ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ CopyActiveRow row := by
        intro hl
        exact ⟨fun h0 => hc ⟨hl, Or.inl h0⟩, fun ha => hc ⟨hl, Or.inr ha⟩⟩
      have cases : lane = 0 ∨ lane = 1 ∨ lane = 2 := by
        have := lane.isLt
        omega
      rcases cases with hl | hl | hl
      · subst lane; rfl
      · subst lane
        simp only [project, toTape, fromQuotient, show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide,
          if_false, ite_true, dif_pos (hr rfl)]
      · subst lane; rfl
  · rfl

def sourceCarrierEquiv : Samples K F ≃ SourceTape K F where
  toFun s := project (toTape s)
  invFun := fromQuotient
  left_inv := from_to
  right_inv := to_from

/-- Mapping all five actual arrays into the quotient loses no field sample. -/
theorem source_fibre_card {Input : Type} [Fintype Input] [Fintype K]
    (decode : Input → Option (Samples K F)) (s : SourceTape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (decode i).map sourceCarrierEquiv = some s)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => decode i = some (fromQuotient s))).card := by
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  cases hi : decode i with
  | none => simp
  | some a => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
              exact sourceCarrierEquiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply

#print axioms from_to
#print axioms to_from
#print axioms sourceCarrierEquiv
#print axioms source_fibre_card
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier

R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialArrays
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier
import R1Z.FinalR1PBin

/-! A finite sequential word decoder for the raw source sample families.
Its field law is unconditional; matching its coordinate order to the shipped
caller is deliberately not asserted by these definitions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
  R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres R1Z.FinalR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Stream1Coord := EligibleCell ⊕ ((Fin 10 × Fin 1024) ⊕
  ((Fin 1024 × Fin 4) ⊕ (FreeRow × Fin 4)))
abbrev Stream2Coord := Fin 1024 × Fin 4
def L₁ : Nat := Fintype.card Stream1Coord
def L₂ : Nat := Fintype.card Stream2Coord
def E₁ : Nat := 2 * L₁
def E₂ : Nat := 2 * L₂

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
local notation "F" => sourceBase (K := K)

def streamCarrierEquiv : ((Stream1Coord → F) × (Stream2Coord → F)) ≃ Samples K F where
  toFun s := ((fun c => s.1 (.inl c)), (fun c => s.1 (.inr (.inl c))),
    (fun c => s.1 (.inr (.inr (.inl c)))), (fun c => s.1 (.inr (.inr (.inr c)))), s.2)
  invFun s := ((fun c => match c with
    | .inl c => s.1 c
    | .inr (.inl c) => s.2.1 c
    | .inr (.inr (.inl c)) => s.2.2.1 c
    | .inr (.inr (.inr c)) => s.2.2.2.1 c), s.2.2.2.2)
  left_inv s := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext c; rcases c with c | c | c | c <;> rfl
    · rfl
  right_inv s := rfl

def arrayCarrierEquiv : ((Fin L₁ → F) × (Fin L₂ → F)) ≃ SourceTape K F :=
  ((Equiv.prodCongr
    (Equiv.arrowCongr (Fintype.equivFin Stream1Coord).symm (Equiv.refl F))
    (Equiv.arrowCongr (Fintype.equivFin Stream2Coord).symm (Equiv.refl F))).trans
      streamCarrierEquiv).trans sourceCarrierEquiv

abbrev Inputs := (Fin E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin E₂ → OracleAnswer)
def inputEquiv : Inputs ≃ ((Fin (E₁*8) → R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word) ×
    (Fin (E₂*8) → R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word)) :=
  Equiv.prodCongr (wordsE E₁) (wordsE E₂)

def quotientDecoder (e : Inputs) : Option (SourceTape K F) :=
  (pairDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂ (inputEquiv e)).map arrayCarrierEquiv

theorem map_equiv_some {T U : Type} (eqv : T ≃ U) (o : Option T) (u : U) :
    o.map eqv = some u ↔ o = some (eqv.symm u) := by
  cases o with
  | none => simp
  | some t => simpa only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] using eqv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply

theorem fibre_transport {I J T U : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (e : I ≃ J) (q : T ≃ U) (decode : J → Option T) (u : U) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (decode (e i)).map q = some u)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => decode j = some (q.symm u))).card := by
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun i _ => e i)
  · intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
      (map_equiv_some q _ u).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
  · intro i _ j _ eq
    exact e.injective eq
  · intro j hj
    refine ⟨e.symm j, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply j⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (map_equiv_some q _ u).mpr ?_⟩
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2

def quotientFibreSize : Nat :=
  fibreSize (2^32) 2 2 (E₁*8) L₁ 16 * fibreSize (2^32) 2 2 (E₂*8) L₂ 16

theorem rejected_fibre :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word => accepted (K := K) w = none)).card = 2 := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word => accepted (K := K) w = none)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => R1Z.CommitReadsR1.rejB w = true)) := by
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, accepted_failure]
  rw [eq, R1Z.CommitReadsR1.card_rej]

attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂ E₁ E₂ arrayCarrierEquiv sourceBase

/-- Exact quotient fibres, without an assumed cF or padded-limb decoding. -/
theorem quotient_equal_fibres (s : SourceTape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Inputs => quotientDecoder e = some s)).card = quotientFibreSize := by
  have ht := fibre_transport inputEquiv (arrayCarrierEquiv (K := K))
    (pairDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂) s
  have hp := pair_equal_fibres (accepted (K := K)) 2 2 (rejected_fibre (K := K))
    (fun a => by convert accepted_equal_fibres (K := K) a) (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂ ((arrayCarrierEquiv (K := K)).symm s)
  calc
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => pairDecode (accepted (K := K))
        (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂ ws = some ((arrayCarrierEquiv (K := K)).symm s))).card := by
      convert ht using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ext z <;>
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, quotientDecoder]
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [quotientFibreSize, R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word, Fintype.card_fin] using hp

#print axioms streamCarrierEquiv
#print axioms arrayCarrierEquiv
#print axioms inputEquiv
#print axioms map_equiv_some
#print axioms fibre_transport
#print axioms rejected_fibre
#print axioms quotient_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder

R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin.text:
import R1Z.CommitReadsR1

/-! Arithmetic joins of the actual commitment-budget predicates. These facts
reduce redundant premises; they do not identify a universal source read log. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1

theorem exact_block_budget (E L : Nat) (capacity : 16 * L ≤ E * 8)
    (blocks : E ≤ 2 * L) : E = 2 * L := by omega

theorem counter_bounds (E₁ E₂ L₁ L₂ : Nat) (cells : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (blocks₁ : E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (blocks₂ : E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂) :
    E₁ ≤ 2^64 ∧ E₂ ≤ 2^64 := by
  rcases cells with ⟨first, second⟩
  constructor <;> omega

/-- With the counts fixed, choosing the actual worst-case budgets discharges
both capacity and upper block inequalities, and their counter obligations. -/
theorem canonical_budgets (L₁ L₂ : Nat) (cells : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) :
    16 * L₁ ≤ (2 * L₁) * 8 ∧ 16 * L₂ ≤ (2 * L₂) * 8 ∧
    2 * L₁ ≤ 2^64 ∧ 2 * L₂ ≤ 2^64 := by
  have counters := counter_bounds (2*L₁) (2*L₂) L₁ L₂ cells le_rfl le_rfl
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega, counters⟩

/-- Universal counter distinctness below the budget, before any LE64 encoding.
This does not identify which blocks a particular source execution reads. -/
theorem no_counter_wrap (E L₁ L₂ : Nat) (cells : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (blocks : E ≤ 2 * L₁) (i j : Fin E) :
    i.val % 2^64 = j.val % 2^64 ↔ i = j := by
  have bound := (counter_bounds E 0 L₁ L₂ cells blocks (by omega)).1
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt bound),
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt bound), Fin.ext_iff]

#print axioms exact_block_budget
#print axioms counter_bounds
#print axioms canonical_budgets
#print axioms no_counter_wrap
end R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin

R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCounts.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
import R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin

/-! Universal coordinate counts for the sequential source model. The source
caller identity/read-log completeness are not inferred from cardinal bounds. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier

def noiseIndex (c : EligibleCell) : Fin 16 × Fin 1024 :=
  (⟨c.1.1.val, c.2.1⟩, c.1.2)

theorem noiseIndex_injective : Function.Injective noiseIndex := by
  intro a b eq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun v : Fin 16 × Fin 1024 => v.1.val) eq
  · exact congrArg (fun z : Fin 16 × Fin 1024 => z.2) eq

theorem source_counts : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.RCommitCount L₁ L₂ := by
  have hn := Fintype.card_le_of_injective noiseIndex noiseIndex_injective
  have hr : Fintype.card FreeRow ≤ 1024 := by
    convert Fintype.card_le_of_injective (Subtype.val : FreeRow → Fin 1024) Subtype.val_injective using 1
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  
  simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] at hn
  constructor
  · dsimp only [L₁]
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_sum]
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  · simp only [L₂, Stream2Coord, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]

attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂

theorem source_budgets :
    16 * L₁ ≤ E₁ * 8 ∧ 16 * L₂ ≤ E₂ * 8 ∧
    E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁ ∧ E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂ ∧ E₁ ≤ 2^64 ∧ E₂ ≤ 2^64 := by
  have h := R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin.canonical_budgets L₁ L₂ source_counts
  simpa only [E₁, E₂] using And.intro h.1 (And.intro h.2.1 (And.intro (Nat.le_refl (2*L₁)) (And.intro (Nat.le_refl (2*L₂)) h.2.2)))

#print axioms noiseIndex_injective
#print axioms source_counts
#print axioms source_budgets
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder

R1Z.PrivacyR1AcctBasis.text:
import R1Z.PrivacyR1Headline
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCounts

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyR1AcctBasis
open AspisWideTower AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
abbrev K := WideExact
abbrev F := ProverCommitWordCarrier.sourceBase (K := K)
def i : K := ⟨⟨⟨0, 1⟩, 0⟩, 0⟩
def u : K := ⟨⟨0, 1⟩, 0⟩

theorem base_coordinates (a : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) :
    algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K a = ⟨⟨⟨a, 0⟩, 0⟩, 0⟩ := by
  have he : algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K =
      (algebraMap QM31Exact K).comp ((algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact).comp
        (algebraMap M31Exact CM31Exact)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [he]
  rfl

def basis : R0P.PackBasis F := by
  refine ⟨i, u, ?_⟩
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hs
  obtain ⟨a₀, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp ha
  obtain ⟨b₀, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hb
  obtain ⟨c₀, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hc
  obtain ⟨d₀, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hd
  have h0 := congrArg (fun z : K => z.re.re.re) hs
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : K => z.re.re.im) hs
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z : K => z.re.im.re) hs
  have h3 := congrArg (fun z : K => z.re.im.im) hs
  simp only [base_coordinates] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  dsimp [i, u] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_one, QuadraticAlgebra.im_one, zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, add_zero, one_mul, mul_one] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  simp [h0, h1, h2, h3]

theorem i_sq : basis.i * basis.i = -1 := by
  change i * i = -1
  have hi : i = algebraMap QM31Exact K (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact cm31I) := rfl
  rw [hi, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, cm31I_mul_self, map_neg, map_one, map_neg, map_one]

theorem u_sq : basis.u * basis.u = 2 + basis.i := by
  change u * u = 2 + i
  change (⟨⟨0, 1⟩, 0⟩ : K) * ⟨⟨0, 1⟩, 0⟩ = 2 + ⟨⟨⟨0, 1⟩, 0⟩, 0⟩
  norm_num [QuadraticAlgebra.mk_mul_mk, qm31R]
  rfl

theorem packing_laws : R0Z.K4.PackField basis := by
  constructor
  · rw [i_sq]; exact F.neg_mem F.one_mem
  · exact ⟨2, 1, (by simpa only [one_add_one_eq_two] using F.add_mem F.one_mem F.one_mem), F.one_mem, by simpa only [mul_one] using u_sq⟩

#print axioms base_coordinates
#print axioms basis
#print axioms i_sq
#print axioms u_sq
#print axioms packing_laws
end R1Z.PrivacyR1AcctBasis

R1Z.PrivacyR1AcctModel.text:

/-! Explicit protocol accounting specialization. The log, opening data and

  E₂ := E₂

import R1Z.PrivacyR1HeadlineAcct

/-! Canonical logical opening model. Query order is the fixed finite-set list order;
its two normalized batches split at eleven queries. No source identity is
asserted by constructing this model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseWireLog2Bin
open R0P R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement
  R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
  R1Z.PrivacyR1Final R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
local notation "K" => PrivacyR1AcctBasis.K
local notation "F" => PrivacyR1AcctBasis.F
local notation "B" => PrivacyR1AcctBasis.basis
attribute [local irreducible] PrivacyR1AcctBasis.basis
  PhaseLeafEncodingBin.c1Leaf PhaseLeafEncodingBin.c2Leaf PhaseLeafEncodingBin.foldedLeaf
  AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded q1
variable {CommitHandle Aux : Type}

/-- D88's leaf encoder fixes S2; select that same transport in the view. -/
def honest (h : HonestProver K) : HonestProver K :=
  { h with transport := AspisR1.rowEquiv }

def foldedIndex (u : Fib) : Fib := ⟨u.val / 4, by have := u.isLt; omega⟩
def treeFib (qs : Finset Fib) (T : Fin 3) : Finset Fib :=
  if T.val = 2 then qs.image foldedIndex else qs

def batchQueries (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 2) : Finset Fib :=
  (if b.val = 0 then ch.queries.toList.take 11 else ch.queries.toList.drop 11).toFinset

def fib (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 3 → Finset Fib := treeFib ch.queries

def batchFib (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 2) : Fin 3 → Finset Fib :=
  treeFib (batchQueries ch b)

/-- Finite-set conversion is symbolic; no large carrier is evaluated. -/
def reads (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 2) : List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :=
  (EventsR1PBin.batchReadSet (batchFib ch b)).toList

def opens (ch : Challenges K) : List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) := reads ch 0 ++ reads ch 1

theorem query_union (ch : Challenges K) :
    batchQueries ch 0 ∪ batchQueries ch 1 = ch.queries := by
  unfold batchQueries
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, ite_true, if_neg (by decide : ¬ (1 = 0))]
  rw [← List.toFinset_append, List.take_append_drop, Finset.toList_toFinset]

theorem fibre_union (ch : Challenges K) (T : Fin 3) :
    fib ch T = batchFib ch 0 T ∪ batchFib ch 1 T := by
  unfold fib batchFib treeFib
  split
  · rw [← Finset.image_union, query_union]
  · exact (query_union ch).symm

theorem reads_nodup (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 2) : (reads ch b).Nodup :=
  Finset.nodup_toList _

theorem reads_coverage (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :
    c ∈ reads ch b ↔ openedQ (batchFib ch b) c := by
  simp only [reads, Finset.mem_toList, EventsR1PBin.mem_batchReadSet]

/-- Leaf bytes reconstructed from the logical disclosed cells. -/
def viewLeaf (v : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  if T.val = 0 then PhaseLeafEncodingBin.openedC1 v.2 u
  else if T.val = 1 then PhaseLeafEncodingBin.openedC2 v.2 u
  else if hu : u.val < 65536 then (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    v.2 (.bat (.folded ⟨4*u.val+s.val, by omega⟩)))).map UInt8.ofFin
  else List.replicate 128 0

variable (h : HonestProver K)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)

theorem leaf_view (w : (honest h).Instance) (τ : Tape K F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) (hu : u ∈ fib ch T) :
    PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding B (honest h) w x τ ch T u =
      viewLeaf (view (honest h) B outputs x w ch τ) T u := by
  rw [PhaseLeafEncodingBin.honest_leaves]
  unfold viewLeaf
  dsimp only [view, R0Z.JointView.payload]
  by_cases h0 : T.val = 0
  · have hq : u ∈ ch.queries := by
      simpa only [fib, treeFib, h0, if_neg (by decide : ¬ (0 = 2))] using hu
    simp only [h0, if_true]
    exact PhaseLeafEncodingBin.c1_view (honest h).transport rfl x.1 B
      (applyEligible ((honest h).build w) τ.2) τ.1 ch u hq
  · by_cases h1 : T.val = 1
    · have hq : u ∈ ch.queries := by
        simpa only [fib, treeFib, h1, if_neg (by decide : ¬ (1 = 2))] using hu
      simp only [h1, if_true]
      exact PhaseLeafEncodingBin.c2_view (honest h).transport rfl x.1 B
        (applyEligible ((honest h).build w) τ.2) τ.1 ch u hq
    · have h2 : T.val = 2 := by omega
      have hm : u ∈ ch.queries.image foldedIndex := by
        simpa only [fib, treeFib, h2, if_true] using hu
      obtain ⟨q, hq, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hm
      have hv : q.val / 4 = u.val := congrArg Fin.val he
      have hb : u.val < 65536 := by have := q.isLt; omega
      simp only [h0, h1, if_false, dif_pos hb]
      exact PhaseLeafEncodingBin.folded_view (honest h).transport x.1 B
        (applyEligible ((honest h).build w) τ.2) τ.1 ch u hb
        (fun s => ⟨q, hq, by dsimp; omega⟩)

/-- Only roots, disclosed leaves and ancestor nodes are serialized. Their
addresses contain neither private attempt secrets nor the statement digest. -/
def entry (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer)
    (v : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) : List UInt8 × OracleAnswer :=
  ((match c with
    | .inl T => nodeBytes rest (rootChild T)
    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T,u))))) =>
      [0x10, treeTag T] ++ viewLeaf v T u ++ R1Z.LensR1.ans (rest (qSalt T u))
    | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T,n))))) => nodeBytes rest (childQ T n)
    | _ => []), ansC roots rest c)

def log (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer)
    (v : View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) (ch : Challenges K) : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) :=
  (opens ch).map (entry rest roots v)

/-- One source boundary: the Rust ordered verifier read serialization must
be exactly this logical encoding, including ordering, multiplicity and bytes. -/
def RustSerializationJoin
    (rust : (RIdx → OracleAnswer) → (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) →
      View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat → Challenges K → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) : Prop :=
  rust = log


theorem opened_union (a b : Fin 3 → Finset Fib) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :
    openedQ (fun T => a T ∪ b T) c ↔ openedQ a c ∨ openedQ b c := by
  rcases c with T | (b' | i | ⟨T,u⟩ | ⟨T,u⟩ | ⟨T,n⟩)
  · simp only [openedQ, true_or]
  · simp only [openedQ, false_or]
  · simp only [openedQ, false_or]
  · simp only [openedQ, false_or]
  · exact Finset.mem_union
  · simp only [openedQ, Finset.mem_union]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu | hu, he⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨u, hu, he⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨u, hu, he⟩
    · rintro (⟨u, hu, he⟩ | ⟨u, hu, he⟩)
      · exact ⟨u, Or.inl hu, he⟩
      · exact ⟨u, Or.inr hu, he⟩

theorem opens_coverage (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) :
    c ∈ opens ch ↔ openedQ (fib ch) c := by
  rw [opens, List.mem_append, reads_coverage, reads_coverage]
  have he : fib ch = fun T => batchFib ch 0 T ∪ batchFib ch 1 T :=
    funext (fibre_union ch)
  rw [he, opened_union]

theorem entry_grammar (w : (honest h).Instance) (τ : Tape K F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (c : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx) (hc : openedQ (fib ch) c) :
    entry rest roots (view (honest h) B outputs x w ch τ) c =
      (gram pub tag (PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding B
        (honest h) w x τ ch) sec d rest
          (cposOf (E₁ := PrivacyR1AcctModel.E₁) (E₂ := PrivacyR1AcctModel.E₂) c),
        ansC roots rest c) := by
  rcases c with T | (b | i | ⟨T,u⟩ | ⟨T,u⟩ | ⟨T,n⟩)
  · rfl
  · exact False.elim hc
  · exact False.elim hc
  · exact False.elim hc
  · simp only [entry, cposOf, gram]
    rw [leaf_view h outputs x w τ ch T u hc]
  · rfl

variable (template : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
local notation "base" => PrivacyR1AcctModel.base template log
local notation "W" => PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) (honest h) B outputs x)
variable (decode : (Fin PrivacyR1AcctModel.E₁ → OracleAnswer) →
  (Fin PrivacyR1AcctModel.E₂ → OracleAnswer) → Option (Tape K F))
local notation "seed" => PrivacyR1AcctModel.seed W decode fib opens
local notation "Pr" => PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) (honest h) B outputs x seed)

def batches : RWireBatches W Pr where
  fib := batchFib
  reads := reads
  concatenation := fun _ => rfl
  nodup := reads_nodup
  coverage := reads_coverage
  fibre_union := fibre_union

theorem ordered_log (w : (honest h).Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)

import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCounts

/-! Decoder/packing cannot add failure. Exhaustion identification with the
shipped caller's cursor remains a source execution obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
open R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂ E₁ E₂ arrayCarrierEquiv sourceBase

theorem quotient_failure (e : Inputs) : quotientDecoder (K := K) e = none ↔
    arrayDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₁*8) L₁ 16 (inputEquiv e).1 = none ∨
    arrayDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₂*8) L₂ 16 (inputEquiv e).2 = none := by
  cases h₁ : arrayDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₁*8) L₁ 16 (inputEquiv e).1 <;>
    cases h₂ : arrayDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₂*8) L₂ 16 (inputEquiv e).2 <;>
      simp [quotientDecoder, pairDecode, h₁, h₂]

#print axioms quotient_failure
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder

R1Z.ProverCommitCursor.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceFailure

/-! Exact finite decoder/cursor failure classification. No source caller
identity is assumed by this module. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCursor
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
  R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier

def runFrom {N : Nat} (ws : Fin N → Word) (p : Nat) : Nat → Option Nat
  | 0 => some p
  | L+1 => (tryLimb ws p 16).bind (fun q => runFrom ws q L)

theorem runFrom_succ {N : Nat} (ws : Fin N → Word) (L p : Nat) :
    runFrom ws p (L+1) = (runFrom ws p L).bind (fun q => tryLimb ws q 16) := by
  induction L generalizing p with
  | zero => cases ht : tryLimb ws p 16 <;> simp [runFrom, ht]
  | succ L ih =>
    change (tryLimb ws p 16).bind (fun q => runFrom ws q (L+1)) =
      ((tryLimb ws p 16).bind (fun q => runFrom ws q L)).bind (fun q => tryLimb ws q 16)
    rw [Option.bind_assoc]
    congr 1
    funext q
    exact ih q

theorem runFrom_zero {N : Nat} (ws : Fin N → Word) (L : Nat) :
    runFrom ws 0 L = limbPos ws L := by
  induction L with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ L ih => rw [runFrom_succ, ih]; rfl

def cursor {N : Nat} (ws : Fin N → Word) (p L r : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match L with
  | 0 => some p
  | L+1 => (tryLimb ws p r).bind (fun q => runFrom ws q L)

theorem cursor_step {N : Nat} (ws : Fin N → Word) (p L r : Nat) :
    cursor ws p (L+1) (r+1) =
      if rejB (getW ws p) = true then cursor ws (p+1) (L+1) r
      else cursor ws (p+1) L 16 := by
  change ((if rejB (getW ws p) = true then tryLimb ws (p+1) r else some (p+1)).bind (fun q => runFrom ws q L)) = _
  split
  · rfl
  · cases L <;> rfl

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

theorem decoder_cursor {N : Nat} (ws : Fin N → Word)
    (n L r p : Nat) (tail : Fin n → Word)
    (hword : ∀ i, tail i = getW ws (p+i.val))
    (hbudget : L ≠ 0 → 16*(L-1)+r ≤ n) :
    decodeWords (accepted (K := K)) n L r tail = none ↔ cursor ws p L r = none := by
  induction n generalizing L r p with
  | zero =>
    cases L with
    | zero => simp [decodeWords, cursor]
    | succ L =>
      have hb := hbudget (by omega)
      have hr : r = 0 := by omega
      subst r
      simp [decodeWords, cursor, tryLimb]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases L with
    | zero => simp [decodeWords, cursor]
    | succ L =>
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [decodeWords, cursor, tryLimb]
      | succ r =>
        have hw : tail 0 = getW ws p := by simpa using hword 0
        have ht : ∀ i : Fin n, tail i.succ = getW ws (p+1+i.val) := by
          intro i
          simpa only [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm 1] using hword i.succ
        have hb := hbudget (by omega)
        have hmore := ih (L+1) r (p+1) (fun i => tail i.succ) ht (by intro _; omega)
        have hless := ih L 16 (p+1) (fun i => tail i.succ) ht (by intro h; omega)
        rw [cursor_step]
        cases hd : accepted (K := K) (tail 0) with
        | none =>
          have hj : rejB (getW ws p) = true := by
            rw [← hw]; exact (accepted_failure (K := K) (tail 0)).mp hd
          simpa only [decodeWords, step, hd, if_pos hj] using hmore
        | some a =>
          have hj : ¬ rejB (getW ws p) = true := by
            intro h
            have hf := (accepted_failure (K := K) (tail 0)).mpr (show rejB (tail 0) = true by rwa [hw])
            rw [hd] at hf
            contradiction
          simp only [decodeWords, step, hd, if_neg hj]
          cases hv : decodeWords (accepted (K := K)) n L 16 (fun i => tail i.succ) with
          | none => exact ⟨fun _ => hless.mp hv, fun _ => rfl⟩
          | some v =>
            constructor
            · intro h; cases h
            · intro h
              have hf := hless.mpr h
              rw [hv] at hf
              contradiction

theorem decoder_exhausted {N : Nat} (ws : Fin N → Word) (L : Nat)
    (hbudget : 16*L ≤ N) :
    arrayDecode (accepted (K := K)) N L 16 ws = none ↔ Exhausted ws L := by
  have h := decoder_cursor (K := K) ws N L 16 0 ws
    (by intro i; simp [getW, i.isLt]) (by intro h; omega)
  have hc : cursor ws 0 L 16 = limbPos ws L := by
    cases L with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ L => exact runFrom_zero ws (L+1)
  simpa only [arrayDecode, Option.map_eq_none_iff, hc, Exhausted] using h

#print axioms runFrom_succ
#print axioms runFrom_zero
#print axioms cursor_step
#print axioms decoder_cursor
#print axioms decoder_exhausted
end R1Z.ProverCommitCursor

/-! A symbolic successful input prevents vacuous all-failure fibre laws. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem constant_success {W A : Type} (d : W → Option A) (w : W) (a : A)
    (hw : d w = some a) (n L r : Nat) (hL : L ≤ n) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ out, decodeWords d n L r (fun _ => w) = some out := by
  induction n generalizing L r with
  | zero =>
    have h : L = 0 := by omega
    subst L
    exact ⟨PUnit.unit, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    cases L with
    | zero => exact ⟨PUnit.unit, rfl⟩
    | succ L =>
      obtain ⟨out, hout⟩ := ih L 16 (by omega) (by omega)
      cases r with
      | zero => omega
      | succ r =>
        exact ⟨(a,out), by simp only [decodeWords, step, hw, hout, Option.map_some] <;> rfl⟩

#print axioms constant_success
end R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
open R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂ arrayCarrierEquiv sourceBase

theorem decoder_has_success : ∃ (e : Inputs) (s : R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion.SourceTape K (sourceBase (K := K))),
    quotientDecoder e = some s := by
  let a := (baseEquiv (K := K)) (0 : Fin AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)
  have ha : accepted (K := K) (0 : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word) = some a := by
    simp only [accepted, Fin.val_zero, Nat.zero_mod, dif_pos (NeZero.pos AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)]
    rfl
  have hL₁ : L₁ ≤ E₁*8 := by unfold E₁; omega
  have hL₂ : L₂ ≤ E₂*8 := by unfold E₂; omega
  obtain ⟨v₁,h₁⟩ := constant_success (accepted (K := K)) 0 a ha (E₁*8) L₁ 16 hL₁ (by omega)
  obtain ⟨v₂,h₂⟩ := constant_success (accepted (K := K)) 0 a ha (E₂*8) L₂ 16 hL₂ (by omega)
  let ws := ((fun _ : Fin (E₁*8) => (0 : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word)),
    (fun _ : Fin (E₂*8) => (0 : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word)))
  refine ⟨inputEquiv.symm ws, arrayCarrierEquiv ((valuesEquiv _ L₁) v₁, (valuesEquiv _ L₂) v₂), ?_⟩
  simp [quotientDecoder, pairDecode, arrayDecode, ws, h₁, h₂]

#print axioms decoder_has_success

R1Z.ProverCommitSectionObstruction.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitCompletionAdapter

/-! A quotient representative preserves observable laws, but no deterministic
section alone supplies equal fibres over the original full-tape carrier. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
open R0Z.JointView
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- An actually ignored H1 dependent-row limb. -/
def hiddenCell : Hidden := ⟨.inr (1,0,0), ⟨rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩⟩

theorem section_missing (choose : SourceTape K F → Padding K F) (s : SourceTape K F) :
    ∃ t : Tape K F, ∀ x : SourceTape K F, complete x (choose x) ≠ t := by
  let pad := Function.update (choose s) hiddenCell (choose s hiddenCell + 1)
  refine ⟨complete s pad, ?_⟩
  intro x eq
  have visible := congrArg project eq
  rw [project_complete, project_complete] at visible
  subst x
  have hidden := congrFun (congrArg padding eq) hiddenCell
  rw [padding_complete, padding_complete] at hidden
  have impossible : choose s hiddenCell = choose s hiddenCell + 1 := by
    simpa only [pad, Function.update_self] using hidden
  exact one_ne_zero (add_left_cancel (a := choose s hiddenCell)
    (show choose s hiddenCell + 1 = choose s hiddenCell + 0 by rw [← impossible, add_zero]))

/-- Equal fibres for raw tapes cannot follow from a uniform quotient alone.
A true protocol quotient endpoint, or additional source randomness, is needed. -/
theorem deterministic_section_not_equal_fibres
    (choose : SourceTape K F → Padding K F) (s : SourceTape K F) :
    ¬ ∃ cF : Nat, ∀ t : Tape K F,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : SourceTape K F => complete x (choose x) = t)).card = cF := by
  rintro ⟨cF, uniform⟩
  obtain ⟨missing, absent⟩ := section_missing choose s
  have empty : (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : SourceTape K F =>
      complete x (choose x) = missing)) = ∅ := by
    ext x
    simp [absent x]
  have zero : cF = 0 := by
    have eq := uniform missing
    rw [empty, Finset.card_empty] at eq
    exact eq.symm
  have positive : 0 < (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : SourceTape K F =>
      complete x (choose x) = complete s (choose s))).card := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
    exact ⟨s, by simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]⟩
  rw [uniform, zero] at positive
  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl 0) positive

#print axioms section_missing
#print axioms deterministic_section_not_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion

R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientStrict.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientLaw
import R1Z.ProverCommitSectionObstruction

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
open R0Z.JointView
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- A deterministic section satisfies the quotient law but fails every full law. -/
theorem quotient_law_strict (choose : SourceTape K F → Padding K F) :
    (∀ s : SourceTape K F, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : SourceTape K F =>
      quotientDecode (fun q => some (complete q (choose q))) i = some s)).card = 1) ∧
    ¬ ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ t : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : SourceTape K F =>
      some (complete i (choose i)) = some t)).card = c := by
  constructor
  · intro s
    have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : SourceTape K F =>
        quotientDecode (fun q => some (complete q (choose q))) i = some s)) = {s} := by
      ext i
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, quotientDecode,
        Option.map_some, project_complete, Option.some.injEq, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rw [eq, Finset.card_singleton]
  · simpa only [Option.some.injEq] using
      deterministic_section_not_equal_fibres choose (0, 0)

#print axioms quotient_law_strict
end R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion

R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCallerLaw.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceSuccess
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientStrict

/-! Exact model-to-endpoint law and strictness on the actual two-stream input
carrier. The caller equation below is the still-unproved source frontier. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
open R0Z.JointView R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
local notation "F" => sourceBase (K := K)
attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂ E₁ E₂ arrayCarrierEquiv sourceBase

theorem quotient_premise_of_caller (decode : Inputs → Option (Tape K F))
    (caller : ∀ e, quotientDecode decode e = quotientDecoder e) (s : SourceTape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun e => quotientDecode decode e = some s)).card = quotientFibreSize := by
  have eq := funext caller
  rw [eq]
  convert quotient_equal_fibres (K := K) s

def representativeDecoder (e : Inputs) : Option (Tape K F) :=
  (quotientDecoder e).map (fun s => complete s 0)

theorem representative_quotient (e : Inputs) :
    quotientDecode (representativeDecoder (K := K)) e = quotientDecoder e := by
  cases hs : quotientDecoder (K := K) e <;>
    simp only [quotientDecode, representativeDecoder, hs, Option.map_none, Option.map_some, project_complete]

/-- A strictness witness on the same byte-block inputs as the protocol. -/
theorem source_representative_not_full_fibres [Fintype K] :
    ¬ ∃ c : Nat, ∀ t : Tape K F,
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Inputs => representativeDecoder e = some t)).card = c := by
  rintro ⟨c,uniform⟩
  obtain ⟨input,s,success⟩ := decoder_has_success (K := K)
  obtain ⟨missing,absent⟩ := section_missing (fun _ : SourceTape K F => 0) s
  have not_image : ∀ e : Inputs, representativeDecoder (K := K) e ≠ some missing := by
    intro e eq
    cases hs : quotientDecoder (K := K) e with
    | none => simp only [representativeDecoder, hs, Option.map_none, reduceCtorEq] at eq
    | some q =>
      have same : complete q 0 = missing := Option.some.inj (by
        simpa only [representativeDecoder, hs, Option.map_some] using eq)
      exact absent q same
  have empty : (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Inputs => representativeDecoder (K := K) e = some missing)) = ∅ := by
    ext e
    simp [not_image e]
  have zero : c = 0 := by
    have eq := uniform missing
    rw [empty, Finset.card_empty] at eq
    exact eq.symm
  have positive : 0 < (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Inputs =>
      representativeDecoder (K := K) e = some (complete s 0))).card := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
    exact ⟨input, by simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      representativeDecoder, success, Option.map_some]⟩
  rw [uniform, zero] at positive
  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl 0) positive

#print axioms quotient_premise_of_caller
#print axioms representative_quotient
#print axioms source_representative_not_full_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder

R1Z.ProverCommitSourceExhaustion.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitCursor
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCallerLaw

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
open R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
  R1Z.ProverCommitCursor R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.FinalR1PBin
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂ E₁ E₂ arrayCarrierEquiv

/-- Exact failure classification on the existing block-answer carriers. -/
theorem quotient_exhausted (e : Inputs) : quotientDecoder (K := K) e = none ↔
    Exhausted (wordsE E₁ e.1) L₁ ∨ Exhausted (wordsE E₂ e.2) L₂ := by
  rw [quotient_failure]
  have h₁ := decoder_exhausted (K := K) ((inputEquiv e).1) L₁ (by
    unfold E₁; omega)
  have h₂ := decoder_exhausted (K := K) ((inputEquiv e).2) L₂ (by
    unfold E₂; omega)
  exact or_congr h₁ h₂

/-- The sole source premise here is the same caller equation needed for
the quotient fibre law; no separate failure/cursor premise is necessary. -/
theorem caller_exhausted (decode : Inputs → Option (R0Z.JointView.Tape K
    (R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier.sourceBase (K := K))))
    (caller : ∀ e, quotientDecode decode e = quotientDecoder e) (e : Inputs) :
    decode e = none ↔
      Exhausted (wordsE E₁ e.1) L₁ ∨ Exhausted (wordsE E₂ e.2) L₂ := by
  have hnone : decode e = none ↔ quotientDecode decode e = none := by
    cases hd : decode e <;> simp [quotientDecode, hd]
  rw [hnone, caller e]
  exact quotient_exhausted e

#print axioms quotient_exhausted
#print axioms caller_exhausted
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder

R1Z.ProverCommitCallerInstance.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceExhaustion

/-! A typed source equation suffices for the fibre, exhaustion and numerical
premises together. This interface is not a certificate of a Rust caller. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCallerInstance
open R0P R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.JointView R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
local notation "F" => R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier.sourceBase (K := K)
variable {W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux}

def blockTransport {n m : Nat} (eq : n = m) :
    (Fin n → OracleAnswer) ≃ (Fin m → OracleAnswer) :=
  Equiv.arrowCongr (finCongr eq) (Equiv.refl OracleAnswer)

def inputsTransport (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h₁ : Pr.E₁ = E₁) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ = E₂) :
    ((Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer)) ≃ Inputs :=
  Equiv.prodCongr (blockTransport h₁) (blockTransport h₂)

structure CallerLaw (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) : Prop where
  blocks₁ : Pr.E₁ = E₁
  blocks₂ : Pr.E₂ = E₂
  quotient : ∃ coordinates : SourceTape K F ≃ SourceTape K F, ∀ e,
    quotientDecode (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) e =
      (quotientDecoder (inputsTransport Pr blocks₁ blocks₂ e)).map coordinates

attribute [local irreducible] E₁ E₂ L₁ L₂

theorem fibres (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (law : CallerLaw Pr)
    (s : SourceTape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun e => quotientDecode (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) => Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2) e = some s)).card =
      quotientFibreSize := by
  let eqv := inputsTransport Pr law.blocks₁ law.blocks₂
  obtain ⟨coordinates, caller⟩ := law.quotient
  calc
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Inputs => quotientDecoder e = some (coordinates.symm s))).card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij (fun e _ => eqv e)
      · intro e he
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
          (map_equiv_some coordinates _ s).mp ((caller e).symm.trans (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2)⟩
      · intro a _ b _ h; exact eqv.injective h
      · intro e he
        refine ⟨eqv.symm e, ?_, eqv.apply_symm_apply e⟩
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        rw [caller, eqv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact (map_equiv_some coordinates _ s).mpr (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
    _ = _ := by
      convert R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder.quotient_equal_fibres (K := K) (coordinates.symm s) using 1
      congr 1
      ext e
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

theorem exhausted_transport {n m : Nat} (eq : n = m)
    (e : Fin n → OracleAnswer) (L : Nat) :
    R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (wordsE m (blockTransport eq e)) L ↔
      R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Exhausted (wordsE n e) L := by
  cases eq
  rfl

theorem exhaustion (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (law : CallerLaw Pr) :
    RExh Pr L₁ L₂ := by
  intro e₁ e₂ hnone
  obtain ⟨coordinates, caller⟩ := law.quotient
  have hm : (quotientDecoder (K := K) (inputsTransport Pr law.blocks₁ law.blocks₂ (e₁,e₂))).map coordinates = none := by
    rw [← caller]
    simp only [quotientDecode, hnone, Option.map_none]
  have hq : quotientDecoder (K := K) (inputsTransport Pr law.blocks₁ law.blocks₂ (e₁,e₂)) = none := by
    cases hd : quotientDecoder (K := K) (inputsTransport Pr law.blocks₁ law.blocks₂ (e₁,e₂)) with
    | none => rfl
    | some v => simp only [hd, Option.map_some, reduceCtorEq] at hm
  have h := (quotient_exhausted _).mp hq
  exact h.imp ((exhausted_transport law.blocks₁ e₁ L₁).mp)
    ((exhausted_transport law.blocks₂ e₂ L₂).mp)

theorem budgets (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (law : CallerLaw Pr) :
    Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64 ∧ Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64 ∧
    16*L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁*8 ∧ 16*L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂*8 ∧
    R1Z.CommitReadsR1.RCommitCount L₁ L₂ ∧
    Pr.E₁ ≤ 2*L₁ ∧ Pr.E₂ ≤ 2*L₂ := by
  rw [law.blocks₁, law.blocks₂]
  exact ⟨source_budgets.2.2.2.2.1, source_budgets.2.2.2.2.2,
    source_budgets.1, source_budgets.2.1, source_counts,
    source_budgets.2.2.1, source_budgets.2.2.2.1⟩

#print axioms blockTransport
#print axioms inputsTransport
#print axioms fibres
#print axioms exhausted_transport
#print axioms exhaustion
#print axioms budgets
end R1Z.ProverCommitCallerInstance

import R1Z.ProverCommitReferenceSource

/-! Composition without unrolling the sampler. The relational step premise is
explicit: a Kani receipt is not an axiom or an imported Lean source theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSamplerComposition

/-- A stopped sampler carries its value and no longer consumes words. -/
def carry {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S) : Option A × S → Option A × S
  | (some a, s) => (some a, s)
  | (none, s) => step s

/-- Exactly n carried transitions, including absorbing successful states. -/
def run {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S) : Nat → Option A × S → Option A × S
  | 0, x => x
  | n+1, x => run step n (carry step x)

/-- The actual early-return loop shape, with n remaining tries. -/
def early {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S) : Nat → S → Option A × S
  | 0, s => (none, s)
  | n+1, s => match step s with
    | (some a, t) => (some a, t)
    | (none, t) => early step n t

theorem run_success {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S)
    (n : Nat) (a : A) (s : S) : run step n (some a, s) = (some a, s) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => exact ih

theorem early_eq_run {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S)
    (n : Nat) (s : S) : early step n s = run step n (none, s) := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [early, run, carry]
    cases h : step s with
    | mk value t =>
      cases value with
      | none => exact ih t
      | some a => exact (run_success step n a t).symm

/-- Invariant-restricted relational composition. Both transitions preserve the
valid-state invariant, so one local equality suffices for every loop length. -/
theorem run_refines {S A : Type} (left right : S → Option A × S)
    (valid : S → Prop)
    (same : ∀ s, valid s → left s = right s)
    (closed : ∀ s, valid s → valid (left s).2)
    (n : Nat) (x : Option A × S) (hx : valid x.2) :
    run left n x = run right n x := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases x with ⟨value, s⟩
    cases value with
    | some a => rw [run_success, run_success]
    | none =>
      simp only [run, carry]
      rw [← same s hx]
      exact ih (left s) (closed s hx)

theorem sixteen_tries {S A : Type} (left right : S → Option A × S)
    (valid : S → Prop)
    (same : ∀ s, valid s → left s = right s)
    (closed : ∀ s, valid s → valid (left s).2)
    (s : S) (hs : valid s) :
    early left 16 s = run right 16 (none, s) := by
  rw [early_eq_run]
  exact run_refines left right valid same closed 16 (none, s) hs

#print axioms run_success
#print axioms early_eq_run
#print axioms run_refines
#print axioms sixteen_tries
end R1Z.ProverCommitSamplerComposition

/-- The extracted carried transition, retaining all monadic errors. -/
def step (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (s : State × Sample) : Result (State × Sample) := do
  match s.2 with
  | .Ok _ => ok s
  | .Err _ =>

    let candidate ← lift (word &&& 2147483647#u32)

      let (after, sampled) ← step hash domain (state, result)

  | Ok value =>

      step, lift, bind_tc_ok]
  | Err error =>
    simp only [prover_commit_reference.limb_loop.body, running, if_true,
      step, lift, aspis_core.field.P, bind_assoc_eq, bind_tc_ok]
    cases h : prover_commit_reference.next hash domain state with
    | fail error => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨word, after⟩
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
      by_cases accepted : word &&& 2147483647#u32 < 2147483647#u32 <;>

    step hash domain (state, .Ok a) = ok (state, .Ok a) := rfl

/-- Kleisli iteration composes source-step equalities including fail/div.
This is the monadic counterpart of the early-return composition theorem. -/
def iterate {S : Type} (body : S → Result S) : Nat → S → Result S
  | 0, s => ok s
  | n+1, s => do let t ← body s; iterate body n t

theorem iterate_refines {S : Type} (left right : S → Result S)
    (same : ∀ s, left s = right s) (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    iterate left n s = iterate right n s := by
  have e : left = right := funext same
  rw [e]

/-- A finite loop body with its remaining-tries rank made explicit. -/
def rankedBody {S : Type} (body : S → Result S) (x : S × Nat) :
    Result (ControlFlow (S × Nat) S) :=
  match x.2 with
  | 0 => ok (done x.1)
  | n+1 => do let t ← body x.1; ok (cont (t,n))

/-- Symbolic induction identifies a real Aeneas loop with finite composition. -/
theorem loop_eq_iterate {S : Type} (body : S → Result S) (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    loop (rankedBody body) (s,n) = iterate body n s := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rw [loop]; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [loop]
    simp only [rankedBody, iterate]
    cases h : body s with
    | ok t => simpa only [bind_tc_ok] using ih t
    | fail error => rfl
    | div => rfl

theorem extracted_sixteen (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (left : State × Sample → Result (State × Sample))
    (same : ∀ s, left s = step hash domain s) (s : State × Sample) :
    loop (rankedBody left) (s,16) = iterate (step hash domain) 16 s := by
  rw [loop_eq_iterate]
  exact iterate_refines left (step hash domain) same 16 s

def collect {S : Type} (step : S → Result (Sample × S)) :
    Nat → S → Result (core.result.Result (List U32) Error × S)
  | 0, s => ok (.Ok [], s)
  | n+1, s => do
    let (sample, after) ← step s
    match sample with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e, after)
    | .Ok a =>
      let (tail, final) ← collect step n after
      match tail with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err e, final)
      | .Ok values => ok (.Ok (a::values), final)

    (same : ∀ s, left s = right s) (n : Nat) (s : S) :

  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl

    simp only [collect, same]
    cases h : right s with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok pair =>

      | Ok a => simp only [bind_tc_ok, ih]

      (transition hash domain) 16 (.Err .MaskSampleExhausted, s)) n state := by

  exact R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.caller_step_induction hash domain

    (do

    cases sample with

import AspisR1ProverStreams.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource
open AspisR1ProverStreams
abbrev Bytes32 := Aeneas.Std.Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Hash := Slice (Slice U8) → Result Bytes32

def blockSlices (domain : Slice U8) (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64) : Slice (Slice U8) :=
  Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 3#usize [domain,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice seed,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes counter)])

theorem mask_block (hash : Hash) (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64) :
    state_only_hiding.state_only_mask_expander_block hash seed counter =
      hash (blockSlices state_only_hiding.MASK_EXPAND_DOMAIN seed counter) := by
  simp [state_only_hiding.state_only_mask_expander_block, blockSlices, lift]

theorem source_block (hash : Hash) (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64) :
    state_only_entropy.profile21_source_expander_block hash seed counter =
      hash (blockSlices state_only_entropy.PROFILE21_SOURCE_EXPAND_DOMAIN seed counter) := by
  simp [state_only_entropy.profile21_source_expander_block, blockSlices, lift]

def seedSlices (binding : Bytes32) (context : Aeneas.Std.Array U8 81#usize)
    (entropy : Bytes32) : Slice (Slice U8) :=
  Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 4#usize [state_only_hiding.MASK_SEED_DOMAIN,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice binding, Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice context,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice entropy])

theorem mask_seed (hash : Hash) (binding entropy : Bytes32)
    (context : aspis_core.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyHidingContext)
    (encoded : Aeneas.Std.Array U8 81#usize)
    (nonzero : core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      entropy (Aeneas.Std.Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) = ok false)
    (encode : aspis_core.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyHidingContext.encode context = ok encoded) :
    state_only_hiding.derive_state_only_mask_seed_from_entropy_ref hash binding context entropy =
      (do let answer ← hash (seedSlices binding encoded entropy)
          ok (.Ok answer)) := by
  simp [state_only_hiding.derive_state_only_mask_seed_from_entropy_ref,
    nonzero, encode, seedSlices, lift]

#print axioms source_block
#print axioms mask_seed

import R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource
import R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitStreamBytes
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource AspisR1ProverStreams
abbrev byte := R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes.byte

def wireBytes (s : Slice (Slice U8)) : List UInt8 :=
  (s.val.flatMap (fun x => x.val)).map byte

theorem block_bytes (domain : Slice U8) (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64) :
    wireBytes (blockSlices domain seed counter) =
      domain.val.map byte ++ seed.val.map byte ++ LayoutR1PBin.le64 counter.val := by
  simp [wireBytes, blockSlices, Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice, Aeneas.Std.Array.make,
    List.map_append, List.append_assoc, R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes.le64_source]

theorem mask_domain :
    state_only_hiding.MASK_EXPAND_DOMAIN.val.map byte = LayoutR1PBin.dExp1 := by
  unfold state_only_hiding.MASK_EXPAND_DOMAIN
  rfl

theorem source_domain :
    state_only_entropy.PROFILE21_SOURCE_EXPAND_DOMAIN.val.map byte = LayoutR1PBin.dExp2 := by
  unfold state_only_entropy.PROFILE21_SOURCE_EXPAND_DOMAIN
  rfl

theorem mask_seed_domain :
    state_only_hiding.MASK_SEED_DOMAIN.val.map byte = LayoutR1PBin.dMaskSeed := by
  unfold state_only_hiding.MASK_SEED_DOMAIN
  rfl

/-- This is the bounded machine step used at refill, not a claim that an
unrestricted wrapping counter never repeats. Source read-count transport
must supply the bound for every actual refill. -/
theorem counter_step (counter : U64) (bound : counter.val + 1 < 2^64) :
    (core.num.U64.wrapping_add counter 1#u64).val = counter.val + 1 := by
  rw [core.num.U64.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have one : (1#u64).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [one, UScalar.size, UScalarTy.U64_numBits_eq]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt bound

/-- The source's four-byte slices partition a 32-byte block into eight words.
No enumeration of a large finite carrier is involved. -/
def wordByteEquiv : (Fin 8 × Fin 4) ≃ Fin 32 := finProdFinEquiv

theorem word_byte_index (word : Fin 8) (limb : Fin 4) :
    (wordByteEquiv (word,limb)).val = 4*word.val + limb.val := by
  change limb.val + 4*word.val = 4*word.val + limb.val
  omega

import R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps
import R1Z.ProverCommitStreamBytes

/-! Universal oracle-support theorem for the extracted scalar/tower reference.
Only expander frames can affect its result. This does not identify the outer
material producer, its read order, or tree/binding/seed/salt coverage. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitReferenceReads
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State Hash transition)
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource (blockSlices Bytes32)

theorem next_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (state : State)
    (same : left (blockSlices domain state.seed state.counter) =
      right (blockSlices domain state.seed state.counter)) :
    prover_commit_reference.next left domain state =
      prover_commit_reference.next right domain state := by
  unfold blockSlices at same
  simp only [prover_commit_reference.next, lift]
  by_cases h : state.word = 8#usize
  · simp only [h, if_true, bind_tc_ok, same]
  · simp only [h, if_false]

theorem transition_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (s : R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.Sample × State) :
    transition left domain s = transition right domain s := by
  rcases s with ⟨sample, state⟩
  cases sample with
  | Ok value => rfl
  | Err error =>
    simp only [transition, prover_commit_reference.try_step,
      next_support left right domain state (same state.seed state.counter)]

theorem scalar_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (state : State) :
    prover_commit_reference.limb_caller left domain state =
      prover_commit_reference.limb_caller right domain state := by
  rw [R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.caller_step_induction,
    R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.caller_step_induction]
  exact R1Z.ProverCommitExtractedStep.iterate_refines _ _
    (transition_support left right domain same) 16 _

theorem all_calls_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (n : Nat) (state : State) :
    R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps.collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller left domain) n state =
    R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps.collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller right domain) n state := by
  exact R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps.collect_congr _ _
    (scalar_support left right domain same) n state

theorem tower_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (state : State) :
    prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller left domain state =
      prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller right domain state := by
  simp only [prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller,
    scalar_support left right domain same]

#print axioms next_support
#print axioms transition_support
#print axioms scalar_support
#print axioms all_calls_support
#print axioms tower_support
end R1Z.ProverCommitReferenceReads
