      (idealSeedQueries template outputs x rust observer_program adv)))

/-- Every previous certificate still suffices. The independent seed is added
by product extension, so this is an actual implication between premises. -/
theorem legacy_refinement_implies
    (old : LegacyRustProverRefinement template outputs x rust observer_program) :
    RustProverRefinement template outputs x rust observer_program := by
  constructor
  · intro adv w hw
    let join := Classical.choice (old.1 adv w hw)
    exact ⟨ProverCommitFuelJoin22.of_seed (ProverCommitSeedJoin19.of_old _ _ _ _ join.cp join.agreement)⟩
  · intro adv
    let join := Classical.choice (old.2 adv)
    exact ⟨ProverCommitFuelJoin22.of_seed (ProverCommitSeedJoin19.of_old _ _ _ _ join.cp join.agreement)⟩


/-- Deletion-free implication: every previously valid deployed refinement
also satisfies the enlarged fixed event. No concrete source join is asserted. -/
theorem seed_refinement_implies
    (old : PrivacyR1HeadlineDeployed.RustProverRefinement template outputs x rust observer_program) :
    RustProverRefinement template outputs x rust observer_program := by
  constructor
  · intro adv w hw
    exact ⟨ProverCommitFuelJoin22.of_seed (Classical.choice (old.1 adv w hw))⟩
  · intro adv
    exact ⟨ProverCommitFuelJoin22.of_seed (Classical.choice (old.2 adv))⟩

PV_DIAG2_Effects.text:
import Init

/-! Diagnostic carrier: effects survive every terminal case. A frame is an
opaque machine observation, never replaced by an environment-enable bit.
This is an instrumentation specification, not an implementation assumption. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_DIAG2
inductive Error where
 | Parse | Semantic | Transcript | Relation | Merkle | Query | Checkpoint
 | Allocation | Rejected | AttemptsExhausted | Entropy
 deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def spelling : Error → String
 | .Parse => "Parse"
 | .Semantic => "Semantic"
 | .Transcript => "Transcript"
 | .Relation => "Relation"
 | .Merkle => "Merkle"
 | .Query => "Query"
 | .Checkpoint => "Checkpoint"
 | .Allocation => "Allocation"
 | .Rejected => "Rejected"
 | .AttemptsExhausted => "AttemptsExhausted"
 | .Entropy => "Entropy"

/-- `entered` and `rejected` are administrative source-control records, not
new writes. Their existing L1 occurrence law is reused, not re-proved here. -/
inductive Effect where
 | entered : Nat → Effect
 | rejected : Nat → Effect
 | stdout : String → Effect
 | stderr : String → Effect
 | returned : Error → Effect
 | capture : List Nat → Effect
 | panic : String → List Nat → Effect
 | oom : Nat → List Nat → Effect
 | foreign : String → List Nat → Effect
 deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Terminal (A : Type) where
 | value : A → Terminal A
 | panic : String → List Nat → Terminal A
 | oom : Nat → List Nat → Terminal A
 | diverge : Terminal A
 deriving Repr

structure Execution (A : Type) where
 effects : List Effect
 terminal : Terminal A
 deriving Repr

def prepend {A : Type} (prior : List Effect) (x : Execution A) : Execution A :=
 ⟨prior ++ x.effects, x.terminal⟩

def bind {A B : Type} (x : Execution A) (f : A → Execution B) : Execution B :=
 match x.terminal with
 | .value a => prepend x.effects (f a)
 | .panic msg pcs => ⟨x.effects, .panic msg pcs⟩
 | .oom size pcs => ⟨x.effects, .oom size pcs⟩
 | .diverge => ⟨x.effects, .diverge⟩

/-- `stderr` records the requested formatted write; partial/failed I/O is a
separate native effect, not a guarantee that these bytes are delivered.
Ordinary anyhow Debug can append a trace. Keep that suffix as an input
requiring its own law; do not pretend the unit variant determines frames. -/
def reportError (e : Error) (frames : List Nat) (renderedTrace : String)
    (captureEnabled : Bool) : Execution Nat :=
 ⟨(if captureEnabled then [.capture frames] else []) ++ [.returned e] ++
   [.stderr ("Error: " ++ spelling e ++ renderedTrace ++ "\n")], .value 1⟩

/-- Unit-variant content has no witness operand. Occurrence and frames are
separate obligations, represented by separate arguments above. -/
theorem message_public (left right : Error) (sameVariant : left = right) :
 spelling left = spelling right := congrArg spelling sameVariant

theorem report_disabled (e : Error) (frames : List Nat) :
 reportError e frames "" false =
 ⟨[.returned e, .stderr ("Error: " ++ spelling e ++ "\n")], .value 1⟩ := by
 simp [reportError]

theorem disabled_frames_irrelevant (e : Error) (a b : List Nat) :
 reportError e a "" false = reportError e b "" false := by
 rw [report_disabled, report_disabled]

/-- The returned-error formatter/report stage contributes no events to an
already successful main result. Effects produced before main are retained. -/
def terminate (result : Except Error Unit) (frames : List Nat) (suffix : String)
    (enabled : Bool) : Execution Nat :=
 match result with
 | .ok () => ⟨[], .value 0⟩
 | .error e => reportError e frames suffix enabled

theorem success_report_silent (frames : List Nat) (suffix : String) (enabled : Bool) :
 (terminate (.ok ()) frames suffix enabled).effects = [] := rfl

theorem error_report_exact (e : Error) (frames : List Nat) :
 terminate (.error e) frames "" false =
 ⟨[.returned e, .stderr ("Error: " ++ spelling e ++ "\n")], .value 1⟩ :=
 report_disabled e frames

/-- No successful-return premise is silently used for panic or OOM. -/
theorem bind_panic {A B : Type} (events : List Effect) (msg : String) (pcs : List Nat)
    (f : A → Execution B) :
 bind ⟨events, .panic msg pcs⟩ f = ⟨events, .panic msg pcs⟩ := rfl

theorem bind_oom {A B : Type} (events : List Effect) (size : Nat) (pcs : List Nat)
    (f : A → Execution B) :
 bind ⟨events, .oom size pcs⟩ f = ⟨events, .oom size pcs⟩ := rfl

/-- A pre-existing effect is retained when a later operation panics. -/
theorem prior_panic {A : Type} (prior tail : List Effect) (msg : String) (pcs : List Nat) :
 prepend prior (⟨tail, .panic msg pcs⟩ : Execution A) =
 ⟨prior ++ tail, .panic msg pcs⟩ := rfl

#print axioms message_public
#print axioms report_disabled
#print axioms disabled_frames_irrelevant
#print axioms success_report_silent
#print axioms error_report_exact
#print axioms bind_panic
#print axioms bind_oom
#print axioms prior_panic
end PV_DIAG2

PV_DIAG3_Execution.text:
import Init
/-! Diagnostic execution carrier. These are specifications, not native
instances. Unlike diag2, abort and divergent prependes do not run unwind glue.
No effects or final state are erased by an abnormal terminal. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_DIAG3
abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
structure Panic where
 message : Bytes
 frames : List Nat
 thread : Bytes
 location : Bytes
 deriving DecidableEq, Repr
structure Crash where
 reason : Bytes
 registers : Bytes
 memory : Bytes
 frames : List Nat
 deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Event where
 | requested (fd : Nat) (bytes : Bytes)
 | delivered (fd : Nat) (bytes : Bytes)
 | returned (bytes : Bytes)
 | capture (frames : List Nat)
 | panic (value : Panic)
 | crash (value : Crash)
 | allocation (size align : Nat)
 | foreign (bytes : Bytes) (frames : List Nat)
 deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Exit (A : Type) where
 | value (a : A)
 | panic (p : Panic)
 | abort (c : Crash)
 | diverge
 deriving Repr
structure Execution (S A : Type) where
 events : List Event
 state : S
 exit : Exit A
 deriving Repr
abbrev Op (S A : Type) := S → Execution S A
variable {S A B C : Type}
def pure (a : A) : Op S A := fun s => ⟨[],s,.value a⟩
def prepend (es : List Event) (x : Execution S A) : Execution S A :=
 ⟨es ++ x.events,x.state,x.exit⟩
def bind (x : Execution S A) (f : A → Op S B) : Execution S B :=
 match x.exit with
 | .value a => prepend x.events (f a x.state)
 | .panic p => ⟨x.events,x.state,.panic p⟩
 | .abort c => ⟨x.events,x.state,.abort c⟩
 | .diverge => ⟨x.events,x.state,.diverge⟩
def sequence (x : Op S A) (f : A → Op S B) : Op S B := fun s => bind (x s) f


theorem prepend_nil (x : Execution S A) : prepend [] x = x := by cases x; rfl
#print axioms prepend_nil

theorem prepend_append (a b : List Event) (x : Execution S A) :
 prepend (a++b) x = prepend a (prepend b x) := by
 cases x; simp [prepend,List.append_assoc]
#print axioms prepend_append

theorem bind_value (es : List Event) (s : S) (a : A) (f : A → Op S B) :
 bind ⟨es,s,.value a⟩ f = prepend es (f a s) := rfl
#print axioms bind_value

theorem bind_panic (es : List Event) (s : S) (p : Panic) (f : A → Op S B) :
 bind ⟨es,s,.panic p⟩ f = ⟨es,s,.panic p⟩ := rfl
#print axioms bind_panic

theorem bind_abort (es : List Event) (s : S) (c : Crash) (f : A → Op S B) :
 bind ⟨es,s,.abort c⟩ f = ⟨es,s,.abort c⟩ := rfl
#print axioms bind_abort

theorem bind_diverge (es : List Event) (s : S) (f : A → Op S B) :
 bind ⟨es,s,.diverge⟩ f = ⟨es,s,.diverge⟩ := rfl
#print axioms bind_diverge

theorem pure_bind (a : A) (s : S) (f : A → Op S B) :
 bind (pure a s) f = f a s := by simp [bind,pure,prepend]
#print axioms pure_bind

theorem bind_pure (x : Execution S A) : bind x pure = x := by
 cases x with | mk es s ex => cases ex <;> simp [bind,pure,prepend]
#print axioms bind_pure

theorem bind_prepend (es : List Event) (x : Execution S A) (f : A → Op S B) :
 bind (prepend es x) f = prepend es (bind x f) := by
 cases x with | mk xs s ex => cases ex <;> simp [bind,prepend,List.append_assoc]
#print axioms bind_prepend

theorem bind_assoc (x : Execution S A) (f : A → Op S B) (g : B → Op S C) :
 bind (bind x f) g = bind x (fun a s => bind (f a s) g) := by
 cases x with
 | mk es s ex =>
   cases ex with
   | value a => exact bind_prepend es (f a s) g
   | panic p => rfl
   | abort c => rfl
   | diverge => rfl
#print axioms bind_assoc

theorem bind_state_after_normal (es : List Event) (s : S) (a : A)
 (f : A → Op S B) : (bind ⟨es,s,.value a⟩ f).state = (f a s).state := rfl
#print axioms bind_state_after_normal

theorem bind_events_after_normal (es : List Event) (s : S) (a : A)
 (f : A → Op S B) : (bind ⟨es,s,.value a⟩ f).events = es ++ (f a s).events := rfl
#print axioms bind_events_after_normal
end PV_DIAG3

import PV_DIAG2_Effects
import PV_DIAG3_Execution
/-! Lossless observation alphabet. File operations include failed/partial requests;
wall-time is its exact serialized representation, not rounded/zeroed time.
Query/rejection prefixes and every retained side channel remain ordered. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
inductive FileOp where
 | create (path : Bytes) (mode : Nat)
 | write (path requested delivered : Bytes)
 | sync (path : Bytes)
 | failed (path message : Bytes)
 deriving Repr
inductive Event where
 | file (op : FileOp)
 | returnedJson (json : Bytes)
 | stdout (requested delivered : Bytes)
 | diagnostic2 (effect : PV_DIAG2.Effect)
 | diagnostic3 (effect : PV_DIAG3.Event)
 | attempts (count : Nat)
 | proveWallSeconds (serialized : Bytes)
 | query (address answer : Bytes)
 | rejected (attempt : Nat)
 | retained (channel payload : Bytes)
 deriving Repr
inductive Terminal (A : Type) where
 | success (value : A)
 | failure (error : Bytes)
 | panic (value : PV_DIAG3.Panic)
 | abort (value : PV_DIAG3.Crash)
 | diverge
 deriving Repr
structure Trace (A : Type) where
 events : List Event
 terminal : Terminal A
 deriving Repr
/-- Each divergent execution is represented by ALL its finite prefixes, not
one fixed empty prefix. The same carrier also includes every failure prefix. -/
abbrev PrefixFamily (I A : Type) := I → Trace A

def files : List Event → List FileOp := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .file op => some op | _ => none

def json : List Event → List Bytes := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .returnedJson b => some b | _ => none

def stdout : List Event → List (Bytes × Bytes) := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .stdout a b => some (a,b) | _ => none

def diagnostics2 : List Event → List PV_DIAG2.Effect := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .diagnostic2 a => some a | _ => none

def diagnostics3 : List Event → List PV_DIAG3.Event := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .diagnostic3 a => some a | _ => none

def counts : List Event → List Nat := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .attempts n => some n | _ => none

def times : List Event → List Bytes := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .proveWallSeconds b => some b | _ => none

def oracle : List Event → List (Bytes × Bytes) := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .query a b => some (a,b) | _ => none

def rejections : List Event → List Nat := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .rejected n => some n | _ => none

def sideChannels : List Event → List (Bytes × Bytes) := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .retained a b => some (a,b) | _ => none

theorem files_append (a b : List Event) : files (a++b) = files a ++ files b :=
 List.filterMap_append
#print axioms files_append
end PV_RJ4IDB

PV_RJ4IDB_Decoder.text:
import PV_RJ4IDB_Channels
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
structure Observation (A : Type) where
 /-- Retains cross-channel order even when projections alone would not. -/
 ordered : List Event
 terminal : Terminal A
 fileWrites : List FileOp
 returnedJSON : List Bytes
 stdoutJSON : List (Bytes × Bytes)
 errorsStderr2 : List PV_DIAG2.Effect
 errorsStderr3 : List PV_DIAG3.Event
 attemptCounts : List Nat
 prove_wall_seconds : List Bytes
 queryPrefix : List (Bytes × Bytes)
 rejectionPrefix : List Nat
 retainedSideChannels : List (Bytes × Bytes)
 deriving Repr

def decoder {A : Type} (t : Trace A) : Observation A :=
 ⟨t.events,t.terminal,files t.events,json t.events,stdout t.events,
 diagnostics2 t.events,diagnostics3 t.events,counts t.events,times t.events,
 oracle t.events,rejections t.events,sideChannels t.events⟩

theorem decoder_injective {A : Type} (l r : Trace A) :
 decoder l = decoder r → l = r := by
 intro h
 have he := congrArg Observation.ordered h
 have ht := congrArg Observation.terminal h
 cases l; cases r; cases he; cases ht; rfl

theorem failure_prefix (es : List Event) (e : Bytes) :
 (decoder (⟨es,.failure e⟩ : Trace Unit)).ordered = es := rfl

theorem divergence_prefix (es : List Event) :
 (decoder (⟨es,.diverge⟩ : Trace Unit)).ordered = es := rfl

theorem panic_prefix (es : List Event) (p : PV_DIAG3.Panic) :
 (decoder (⟨es,.panic p⟩ : Trace Unit)).ordered = es := rfl

theorem abort_prefix (es : List Event) (p : PV_DIAG3.Crash) :
 (decoder (⟨es,.abort p⟩ : Trace Unit)).ordered = es := rfl
#print axioms decoder_injective
#print axioms failure_prefix
#print axioms divergence_prefix
#print axioms panic_prefix
#print axioms abort_prefix
end PV_RJ4IDB

import PV_RJ4IDB_Decoder
/-! Native channel records, with separate file and terminal constructors.
These are observations of native executions; producing the records from the
deployed program is owned by runjoin/diag/L1 as recorded in OPEN-INPUTS.md. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
inductive NativeEvent where
 | proofWrite (path requested delivered : Bytes)
 | statementWrite (path requested delivered : Bytes)
 | otherFile (op : FileOp)
 | returned (json : Bytes)
 | printed (requested delivered : Bytes)
 | diag2 (effect : PV_DIAG2.Effect)
 | diag3 (effect : PV_DIAG3.Event)
 | count (attempts : Nat)
 | wall (serializedSeconds : Bytes)
 | oracle (address answer : Bytes)
 | rejection (attempt : Nat)
 | side (name payload : Bytes)
 deriving Repr

def translateEvent : NativeEvent → Event
 | .proofWrite p a b => .file (.write p a b)
 | .statementWrite p a b => .file (.write p a b)
 | .otherFile f => .file f
 | .returned j => .returnedJson j
 | .printed a b => .stdout a b
 | .diag2 e => .diagnostic2 e
 | .diag3 e => .diagnostic3 e
 | .count n => .attempts n
 | .wall b => .proveWallSeconds b
 | .oracle a b => .query a b
 | .rejection n => .rejected n
 | .side a b => .retained a b

structure NativeTrace (A : Type) where
 events : List NativeEvent
 terminal : Terminal A

def modelTrace {A : Type} (t : NativeTrace A) : Trace A :=
 ⟨t.events.map translateEvent,t.terminal⟩

def nativeFiles : List NativeEvent → List FileOp := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with
 | .proofWrite p a b => some (.write p a b)
 | .statementWrite p a b => some (.write p a b)
 | .otherFile f => some f
 | _ => none

def nativeJSON : List NativeEvent → List Bytes := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .returned j => some j | _ => none

def nativeStdout : List NativeEvent → List (Bytes × Bytes) := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .printed a b => some (a,b) | _ => none

def nativeDiag2 : List NativeEvent → List PV_DIAG2.Effect := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .diag2 a => some a | _ => none

def nativeDiag3 : List NativeEvent → List PV_DIAG3.Event := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .diag3 a => some a | _ => none

def nativeCounts : List NativeEvent → List Nat := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .count n => some n | _ => none

def nativeTimes : List NativeEvent → List Bytes := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .wall b => some b | _ => none

def nativeOracle : List NativeEvent → List (Bytes × Bytes) := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .oracle a b => some (a,b) | _ => none

def nativeRejections : List NativeEvent → List Nat := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .rejection n => some n | _ => none

def nativeSide : List NativeEvent → List (Bytes × Bytes) := List.filterMap fun e =>
 match e with | .side a b => some (a,b) | _ => none
end PV_RJ4IDB

import PV_RJ4IDB_NativeChannels
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
/-- Explicit composition of the native visible channels. Bytes and event order
are retained; no file success, suppressed error, zero time or empty prefix is
chosen. Native acquisition of each channel remains a named owning-line input. -/
def nativeObservation {A : Type} (t : NativeTrace A) : Observation A :=
 ⟨t.events.map translateEvent,t.terminal,nativeFiles t.events,nativeJSON t.events,
 nativeStdout t.events,nativeDiag2 t.events,nativeDiag3 t.events,nativeCounts t.events,
 nativeTimes t.events,nativeOracle t.events,nativeRejections t.events,nativeSide t.events⟩

theorem native_factorization {A : Type} (t : NativeTrace A) :
 nativeObservation t = decoder (modelTrace t) := by
 simp only [nativeObservation,decoder,modelTrace,nativeFiles_translation,
 nativeJSON_translation,nativeStdout_translation,nativeDiag2_translation,
 nativeDiag3_translation,nativeCounts_translation,nativeTimes_translation,
 nativeOracle_translation,nativeRejections_translation,nativeSide_translation]

theorem success_factorization {A : Type} (es : List NativeEvent) (value : A) :
 nativeObservation ⟨es,.success value⟩ = decoder (modelTrace ⟨es,.success value⟩) :=
 native_factorization _

theorem failure_factorization (es : List NativeEvent) (error : Bytes) :
 nativeObservation (⟨es,.failure error⟩ : NativeTrace Unit) =
 decoder (modelTrace ⟨es,.failure error⟩) := native_factorization _

theorem divergence_factorization (es : List NativeEvent) :
 nativeObservation (⟨es,.diverge⟩ : NativeTrace Unit) =
 decoder (modelTrace ⟨es,.diverge⟩) := native_factorization _

theorem panic_factorization (es : List NativeEvent) (p : PV_DIAG3.Panic) :
 nativeObservation (⟨es,.panic p⟩ : NativeTrace Unit) =
 decoder (modelTrace ⟨es,.panic p⟩) := native_factorization _

theorem abort_factorization (es : List NativeEvent) (c : PV_DIAG3.Crash) :
 nativeObservation (⟨es,.abort c⟩ : NativeTrace Unit) =
 decoder (modelTrace ⟨es,.abort c⟩) := native_factorization _

/-- This covers every native prefix family, including each emitting prefix of
an infinite run. The index set is arbitrary and need not be finite. -/
theorem all_prefixes {I A : Type} (family : I → NativeTrace A) :
 ∀ i, nativeObservation (family i) = decoder (modelTrace (family i)) :=
 fun i => native_factorization (family i)
#print axioms native_factorization
#print axioms success_factorization
#print axioms failure_factorization
#print axioms divergence_factorization
#print axioms panic_factorization
#print axioms abort_factorization
#print axioms all_prefixes
end PV_RJ4IDB

R1Z.PV_W_Threading.text:
import Init
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_W_Threading

/-- Errors and divergence retain the effects already performed. This is not
ExceptT over StateT, which would erase the post-state on failure. -/
inductive Outcome (E A : Type) where
  | ok (value : A)
  | fail (error : E)
  | div
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Run (W C E A : Type) where
  outcome : Outcome E A
  world : W
  calls : List (W × C)

abbrev M (W C E A : Type) := W → Run W C E A
variable {W C E A B D : Type}

def lift (r : Outcome E A) : M W C E A := fun w => ⟨r,w,[]⟩
def bind (m : M W C E A) (k : A → M W C E B) : M W C E B := fun w =>
  let a := m w
  match a.outcome with
  | .ok x => let b := k x a.world; ⟨b.outcome,b.world,a.calls ++ b.calls⟩
  | .fail e => ⟨.fail e,a.world,a.calls⟩
  | .div => ⟨.div,a.world,a.calls⟩

/-- Any world-free callback lifts, but the theorem asserts purity of its
interpretation, not native purity of the callback's Rust referent. -/
def liftCallback {I : Type} (f : I → Outcome E A) (x : I) : M W C E A := lift (f x)

theorem lift_frame (r : Outcome E A) (w : W) :
    (lift (C := C) r w).world = w ∧ (lift (C := C) r w).calls = [] := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

theorem lift_bind (r : Outcome E A) (k : A → Outcome E B) :
    bind (lift r) (fun a => lift (k a)) =
      (lift (C := C) (match r with | .ok a => k a | .fail e => .fail e | .div => .div) : M W C E B) := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem bind_ok (m : M W C E A) (k : A → M W C E B)
    (w : W) (a : A) (h : (m w).outcome = .ok a) :
    bind m k w = ⟨(k a (m w).world).outcome, (k a (m w).world).world,
      (m w).calls ++ (k a (m w).world).calls⟩ := by
  simp only [bind,h]

theorem bind_fail (m : M W C E A) (k : A → M W C E B)
    (w : W) (e : E) (h : (m w).outcome = .fail e) :
    bind m k w = ⟨.fail e,(m w).world,(m w).calls⟩ := by
  simp only [bind,h]

theorem bind_div (m : M W C E A) (k : A → M W C E B)
    (w : W) (h : (m w).outcome = .div) :
    bind m k w = ⟨.div,(m w).world,(m w).calls⟩ := by
  simp only [bind,h]

theorem bind_assoc (m : M W C E A) (k : A → M W C E B)
    (h : B → M W C E D) : bind (bind m k) h = bind m (fun a => bind (k a) h) := by
  funext w
  cases hm : (m w).outcome with
  | fail e => simp only [bind,hm]
  | div => simp only [bind,hm]
  | ok a =>
    cases hk : (k a (m w).world).outcome <;>
      simp only [bind,hm,hk,List.append_assoc]

/-- Every call is recorded at its own pre-world, in execution order. -/
def emit (c : C) (step : W → Outcome E A × W) : M W C E A := fun w =>
  ⟨(step w).1,(step w).2,[(w,c)]⟩

inductive Threaded (step : W → C → W → Prop) : W → List (W × C) → W → Prop where
  | nil (w : W) : Threaded step w [] w
  | cons {w next last : W} {c : C} {cs : List (W × C)} :
      step w c next → Threaded step next cs last → Threaded step w ((w,c)::cs) last

theorem threaded_append {step : W → C → W → Prop} {w mid last : W}
    {xs ys : List (W × C)} (left : Threaded step w xs mid)
    (right : Threaded step mid ys last) : Threaded step w (xs ++ ys) last := by
  induction left with
  | nil => exact right
  | cons h _ ih => exact .cons h (ih right)

def Valid (step : W → C → W → Prop) (m : M W C E A) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, Threaded step w (m w).calls (m w).world

theorem valid_lift (step : W → C → W → Prop) (r : Outcome E A) :
    Valid step (lift r) := fun w => .nil w

theorem valid_emit (step : W → C → W → Prop) (c : C)
    (f : W → Outcome E A × W) (law : ∀ w, step w c (f w).2) :
    Valid step (emit c f) := fun w => .cons (law w) (.nil _)

/-- Named compositional threading law, including failure/divergence prefixes.
It applies to a caller only after its individual control-flow correspondence
has been proved; it is not that correspondence itself. -/
theorem valid_bind (step : W → C → W → Prop) (m : M W C E A)
    (k : A → M W C E B) (hm : Valid step m) (hk : ∀ a, Valid step (k a)) :
    Valid step (bind m k) := by
  intro w
  cases h : (m w).outcome with
  | ok a => rw [bind_ok m k w a h]; exact threaded_append (hm w) (hk a _)
  | fail e => rw [bind_fail m k w e h]; exact hm w
  | div => rw [bind_div m k w h]; exact hm w

/-- A pure lift cannot represent even one advancing effect. -/
theorem no_lift_advancing (m : M W C E A) (w : W) (h : (m w).world ≠ w) :
    ∀ r : Outcome E A, lift r w ≠ m w := by
  intro r eq
  exact h (congrArg Run.world eq).symm

/-- A post-hoc decoder of returned values cannot recover a call trace when
one and two calls have the same return. This does not exclude syntax-directed
sidecar interpretation, which must retain calls before evaluation erases them. -/
theorem no_trace_decoder (r : Outcome E A) (w : W) (c : C) :
    ¬ ∃ decode : Outcome E A → List (W × C),
      decode r = [(w,c)] ∧ decode r = [(w,c),(w,c)] := by
  intro ⟨decode,one,two⟩
  have lengths := congrArg List.length (one.symm.trans two)
  exact (by decide : (1 : Nat) ≠ 2) lengths

#print axioms bind_assoc
#print axioms lift_frame
#print axioms lift_bind
#print axioms bind_ok
#print axioms bind_fail
#print axioms bind_div
#print axioms threaded_append
#print axioms valid_lift
#print axioms valid_emit
#print axioms valid_bind
#print axioms no_lift_advancing
#print axioms no_trace_decoder
end R1Z.PV_W_Threading

R1Z.PV_W_Syntax.text:
import R1Z.PV_W_Threading
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_W_Syntax
open PV_W_Threading
universe u

/-- Reification retains control flow before a Result evaluator erases calls.
The operation family retains each call's actual argument and return type. -/
inductive Program (Op : Type → Type u) (E A : Type) : Type (max 1 u) where
  | pure (a : A)
  | failure (e : E)
  | diverge
  | call {B : Type} (op : Op B) (next : B → Program Op E A)

variable {Op : Type → Type u} {W C E A B : Type}
abbrev Interpreter (Op : Type → Type u) (W C E : Type) :=
  {B : Type} → Op B → M W C E B

def eval (ops : Interpreter Op W C E) : Program Op E A → M W C E A
  | .pure a => lift (.ok a)
  | .failure e => lift (.fail e)
  | .diverge => lift .div
  | .call op next => bind (ops op) (fun a => eval ops (next a))

def thenDo (p : Program Op E A) (k : A → Program Op E B) : Program Op E B :=
  match p with
  | .pure a => k a
  | .failure e => .failure e
  | .diverge => .diverge
  | .call op next => .call op (fun a => thenDo (next a) k)

theorem eval_thenDo (ops : Interpreter Op W C E)
    (p : Program Op E A) (k : A → Program Op E B) :
    eval ops (thenDo p k) = bind (eval ops p) (fun a => eval ops (k a)) := by
  induction p with
  | pure a => rfl
  | failure e => rfl
  | diverge => rfl
  | call op next ih =>
    simp only [thenDo,eval]
    rw [bind_assoc]
    congr 1
    funext a
    exact ih a

/-- Independent big-step execution judgment: each successful call hands its
post-state to the selected continuation; failed/nonreturning calls stop it. -/
def Executes (ops : Interpreter Op W C E) :
    Program Op E A → W → Run W C E A → Prop
  | .pure a, w, r => r = ⟨.ok a,w,[]⟩
  | .failure e, w, r => r = ⟨.fail e,w,[]⟩
  | .diverge, w, r => r = ⟨.div,w,[]⟩
  | .call op k, w, r =>
    match (ops op w).outcome with
    | .ok a => ∃ tail : Run W C E A,
        Executes ops (k a) (ops op w).world tail ∧
        r = ⟨tail.outcome,tail.world,(ops op w).calls ++ tail.calls⟩
    | .fail e => r = ⟨.fail e,(ops op w).world,(ops op w).calls⟩
    | .div => r = ⟨.div,(ops op w).world,(ops op w).calls⟩

theorem execution_sound (ops : Interpreter Op W C E)
    {p : Program Op E A} {w : W} {r : Run W C E A}
    (h : Executes ops p w r) : eval ops p w = r := by
  induction p generalizing w r with
  | pure a => exact h.symm
  | failure e => exact h.symm
  | diverge => exact h.symm
  | call op k ih =>
    cases returns : (ops op w).outcome with
    | ok a =>
      obtain ⟨tail,rest,eq⟩ := (show ∃ tail : Run W C E A,
        Executes ops (k a) (ops op w).world tail ∧
        r = ⟨tail.outcome,tail.world,(ops op w).calls ++ tail.calls⟩ by
          simpa only [Executes,returns] using h)
      change bind (ops op) (fun a => eval ops (k a)) w = _
      rw [bind_ok _ _ _ _ returns,ih a rest]
      exact eq.symm
    | fail e =>
      change bind (ops op) (fun a => eval ops (k a)) w = _
      rw [bind_fail _ _ _ _ returns]
      exact (show r = _ by simpa only [Executes,returns] using h).symm
    | div =>
      change bind (ops op) (fun a => eval ops (k a)) w = _
      rw [bind_div _ _ _ returns]
      exact (show r = _ by simpa only [Executes,returns] using h).symm

theorem execution_complete (ops : Interpreter Op W C E)
    (p : Program Op E A) (w : W) : Executes ops p w (eval ops p w) := by
  induction p generalizing w with
  | pure a => rfl
  | failure e => rfl
  | diverge => rfl
  | call op k ih =>
    cases h : (ops op w).outcome with
    | ok a =>
      simp only [Executes,h]
      exact ⟨eval ops (k a) (ops op w).world,ih a _,bind_ok _ _ _ _ h⟩
    | fail e => simp only [Executes,eval,PV_W_Threading.bind,h]
    | div => simp only [Executes,eval,PV_W_Threading.bind,h]

theorem eval_valid (ops : Interpreter Op W C E) (step : W → C → W → Prop)
    (leaves : ∀ {B : Type} (op : Op B), Valid step (ops op))
    (p : Program Op E A) : Valid step (eval ops p) := by
  induction p with
  | pure a => exact valid_lift step _
  | failure e => exact valid_lift step _
  | diverge => exact valid_lift step _
  | call op k ih => exact valid_bind step _ _ (leaves op) ih

/-- Exact outcome, post-world and ordered pre-world tags of an operational
execution, proved by control-flow composition, not concrete run reduction. -/
theorem execution_exact (ops : Interpreter Op W C E) (step : W → C → W → Prop)

R1Z.PV_W_SourceSyntax.text:
import R1Z.PV_W_Syntax
import R1Z.ProverRwFullFuns
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_W_SourceSyntax
open PV_W_Syntax PV_W_Threading
open ProverRwFull
open Aeneas.Std
variable [ExternalTypes]

/-- A call thunk retains its arguments before evaluation. The world
interpreter is independent of erase: evaluating this thunk under a fixed
ExternalFuns dictionary is used ONLY for the source-syntax correspondence. -/
structure Op (A : Type) where
  label : String
  source : ExternalFuns → Aeneas.Std.Result A

abbrev P (A : Type) := Program Op Aeneas.Std.Error A

instance : Monad P where
  pure := Program.pure
  bind := thenDo

def invoke {A : Type} (label : String) (f : ExternalFuns → Aeneas.Std.Result A) : P A :=
  .call ⟨label,f⟩ .pure

def erase (ops : ExternalFuns) {A : Type} : P A → Aeneas.Std.Result A
  | .pure a => .ok a
  | .failure e => .fail e
  | .diverge => .div
  | .call op k => Aeneas.Std.bind (op.source ops) (fun a => erase ops (k a))

theorem erase_invoke {A : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns) (label : String)
    (f : ExternalFuns → Aeneas.Std.Result A) : erase ops (invoke label f) = f ops := by
  cases h : f ops <;> simp only [erase,invoke,h,Aeneas.Std.bind]

theorem erase_thenDo {A B : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns)
    (p : P A) (k : A → P B) :
    erase ops (thenDo p k) =
      Aeneas.Std.bind (erase ops p) (fun a => erase ops (k a)) := by
  induction p with
  | pure a => rfl
  | failure e => rfl
  | diverge => rfl
  | call op next ih =>
    cases h : op.source ops <;> simp only [thenDo,erase,h,Aeneas.Std.bind,ih]

theorem erase_bind {A B : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns)
    (p : P A) (k : A → P B) :
    erase ops (p >>= k) = Aeneas.Std.bind (erase ops p) (fun a => erase ops (k a)) :=
  erase_thenDo ops p k

theorem source_bind_congr {A B : Type} (m : Aeneas.Std.Result A)
    (left right : A → Aeneas.Std.Result B) (h : ∀ a, left a = right a) :
    Aeneas.Std.bind m left = Aeneas.Std.bind m right :=
  congrArg (Aeneas.Std.bind m) (funext h)

/- Restrict proof search to a syntactic bind on both sides. Unrestricted
higher-order congrArg search can invent binds and loop at a non-bind goal. -/
open Lean Elab Tactic in
elab "pv_source_bind" : tactic => do
  let target ← instantiateMVars (← getMainTarget)
  unless target.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do throwError "expected equality"
  let args := target.getAppArgs
  let isBind (e : Expr) := e.isAppOf ``Aeneas.Std.bind || e.isAppOf ``Bind.bind
  unless isBind args[1]! && isBind args[2]! do throwError "expected two source binds"
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| (apply source_bind_congr; intro x)))

theorem erase_pure {A : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns) (a : A) :
    erase ops (Program.pure a : P A) = .ok a := rfl

theorem erase_coreResult {A X Y : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns)
    (r : core.result.Result X Y) (onOk : X → P A) (onErr : Y → P A) :
    erase ops (match r with | .Ok x => onOk x | .Err e => onErr e) =
      match r with | .Ok x => erase ops (onOk x) | .Err e => erase ops (onErr e) := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem erase_controlFlow {A X Y : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns)
    (r : core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow X Y) (onBreak : X → P A) (onContinue : Y → P A) :
    erase ops (match r with | .Break x => onBreak x | .Continue y => onContinue y) =
      match r with | .Break x => erase ops (onBreak x) | .Continue y => erase ops (onContinue y) := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem erase_ite {A : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns) (p : Prop) [Decidable p]
    (yes no : P A) : erase ops (if p then yes else no) =
      if p then erase ops yes else erase ops no := by
  by_cases h : p <;> simp only [h,↓reduceIte]

/-- The source-side dictionary is used at each syntactic call. This theorem
asserts a faithful value erasure, never native purity of the call thunk. -/
def resultOutcome {A : Type} : Aeneas.Std.Result A → Outcome Aeneas.Std.Error A
  | .ok a => .ok a
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def sourceInterpreter (ops : ExternalFuns) : Interpreter Op Unit Unit Aeneas.Std.Error :=
  fun op => PV_W_Threading.lift (resultOutcome (op.source ops))

theorem source_value {A : Type} (ops : ExternalFuns) (p : P A) :
    (eval (sourceInterpreter ops) p ()).outcome = resultOutcome (erase ops p) := by
  induction p with
  | pure a => rfl
  | failure e => rfl
  | diverge => rfl
  | call op k ih =>
    cases h : op.source ops with
    | ok a => simpa only [eval,sourceInterpreter,PV_W_Threading.lift,PV_W_Threading.bind,resultOutcome,h,erase,Aeneas.Std.bind] using ih a
    | fail e => simp only [eval,sourceInterpreter,PV_W_Threading.lift,PV_W_Threading.bind,resultOutcome,h,erase,Aeneas.Std.bind]
    | div => simp only [eval,sourceInterpreter,PV_W_Threading.lift,PV_W_Threading.bind,resultOutcome,h,erase,Aeneas.Std.bind]

#print axioms erase_invoke
#print axioms erase_thenDo
#print axioms erase_bind
#print axioms source_bind_congr
#print axioms erase_pure
#print axioms erase_coreResult
#print axioms erase_controlFlow
#print axioms erase_ite
#print axioms source_value
end R1Z.PV_W_SourceSyntax

R1Z.PV_RunJoin_WorldDecode33.text:
import R1Z.PV_W_SourceSyntax
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_WorldDecode33
open PV_W_Threading
variable {W C A View : Type}

/-- The old Result-only interface retains post-world on returned values but
forgets it on source failure/divergence. Its adequacy must be proved. -/
def returned (r : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A) : Aeneas.Std.Result (A × W) :=
  match r.outcome with
  | .ok a => .ok (a,r.world)
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

/-- Necessary for each complete disclosed/oracle decoder separately. No
native trace, error payload or failure event is weakened by this statement. -/
theorem same_result (decode : Aeneas.Std.Result (A × W) → View)
    (observe : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → View)
    (law : ∀ r, decode (returned r) = observe r)
    (left right : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A) (same : returned left = returned right) :
    observe left = observe right := by
  rw [← law left,← law right,same]

theorem source_failure (decode : Aeneas.Std.Result (A × W) → View)
    (observe : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → View)
    (law : ∀ r, decode (returned r) = observe r)
    (left right : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A) (e : Aeneas.Std.Error)
    (hl : left.outcome = .fail e) (hr : right.outcome = .fail e) :
    observe left = observe right := by
  apply same_result decode observe law left right
  simp only [returned,hl,hr]

theorem source_divergence (decode : Aeneas.Std.Result (A × W) → View)
    (observe : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → View)
    (law : ∀ r, decode (returned r) = observe r)
    (left right : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A)
    (hl : left.outcome = .div) (hr : right.outcome = .div) :
    observe left = observe right := by
  apply same_result decode observe law left right
  simp only [returned,hl,hr]

/-- A Result-only decoder cannot be supplied if one fixed interpreted body
has same-result runs with different complete observations. This is a
conditional obstruction, not a checked counterexample to deployed code. -/
theorem no_decoder (observe : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → View)
    (left right : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A) (same : returned left = returned right)
    (different : observe left ≠ observe right) :
    ¬ ∃ decode : Aeneas.Std.Result (A × W) → View, ∀ r, decode (returned r) = observe r := by
  intro ⟨decode,law⟩
  exact different (same_result decode observe law left right same)

#print axioms same_result
#print axioms source_failure
#print axioms source_divergence
#print axioms no_decoder
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_WorldDecode33

R1Z.PV_RJDec_Factor.text:
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_WorldDecode33
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RJDec_Factor
open PV_W_Threading PV_RunJoin_WorldDecode33
variable {W C A V : Type}

/-- The precise missing obligation on reachable runs. It compares the entire
observation, including failure and divergence prefixes. -/
def Fibres (reachable : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → Prop)
    (observe : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → V) : Prop :=
  ∀ l r, reachable l → reachable r → returned l = returned r → observe l = observe r

/-- A Result decoder exists exactly when the complete observation factors
through that Result on the admitted runs. This theorem supplies no native
instance of the right-hand side. -/
theorem exists_iff [Nonempty V]
    (reachable : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → Prop)
    (observe : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → V) :
    (∃ decode : Aeneas.Std.Result (A × W) → V,
      ∀ r, reachable r → decode (returned r) = observe r) ↔ Fibres reachable observe := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨decode,law⟩ l r hl hr same
    rw [← law l hl,← law r hr,same]
  · intro fibres
    let decode := fun out : Aeneas.Std.Result (A × W) =>
      if h : ∃ r, reachable r ∧ returned r = out then observe (Classical.choose h)
      else Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
    refine ⟨decode,?_⟩
    intro r hr
    have h : ∃ s, reachable s ∧ returned s = returned r := ⟨r,hr,rfl⟩
    dsimp only [decode]
    rw [dif_pos h]
    exact fibres _ r (Classical.choose_spec h).1 hr (Classical.choose_spec h).2

theorem pair_iff {U : Type}
    (reachable : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → Prop)
    (disclosed : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → V)
    (oracle : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → U) :
    Fibres reachable (fun r => (disclosed r,oracle r)) ↔
      Fibres reachable disclosed ∧ Fibres reachable oracle := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun l r hl hr same => congrArg Prod.fst (h l r hl hr same),
      fun l r hl hr same => congrArg Prod.snd (h l r hl hr same)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd,ho⟩ l r hl hr same
    exact Prod.ext (hd l r hl hr same) (ho l r hl hr same)

#print axioms exists_iff
#print axioms pair_iff
end R1Z.PV_RJDec_Factor

R1Z.PV_RJDec_ResultCases.text:
import R1Z.PV_RJDec_Factor
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RJDec_ResultCases
open PV_W_Threading PV_RunJoin_WorldDecode33 PV_RJDec_Factor
variable {W C A V : Type}

/-- Success retains the value and final world, but no outcome retains calls
in the old carrier. Failure/divergence retain neither world nor calls. -/
theorem returned_eq (l r : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A) :
    returned l = returned r ↔
      (∃ a, l.outcome=.ok a ∧ r.outcome=.ok a ∧ l.world=r.world) ∨
      (∃ e, l.outcome=.fail e ∧ r.outcome=.fail e) ∨
      (l.outcome=.div ∧ r.outcome=.div) := by
  cases l with | mk lo lw lc =>
    cases r with | mk ro rw rc =>
      cases lo <;> cases ro <;> simp [returned,eq_comm]

/-- An exhaustive obligation, including outer fail/div and every inner
Result rejection carried as an ordinary successful value of A. -/
theorem fibres_iff
    (reachable : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → Prop)
    (observe : Run W C Aeneas.Std.Error A → V) :
    Fibres reachable observe ↔
      (∀ l r a, reachable l → reachable r → l.outcome=.ok a →
        r.outcome=.ok a → l.world=r.world → observe l=observe r) ∧
      (∀ l r e, reachable l → reachable r → l.outcome=.fail e →
        r.outcome=.fail e → observe l=observe r) ∧
      (∀ l r, reachable l → reachable r → l.outcome=.div →
        r.outcome=.div → observe l=observe r) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro l r a hl hr hol hor hw
      exact h l r hl hr ((returned_eq l r).mpr (.inl ⟨a,hol,hor,hw⟩))
    · intro l r e hl hr hol hor
      exact h l r hl hr ((returned_eq l r).mpr (.inr (.inl ⟨e,hol,hor⟩)))
    · intro l r hl hr hol hor
      exact h l r hl hr ((returned_eq l r).mpr (.inr (.inr ⟨hol,hor⟩)))
  · rintro ⟨hs,hf,hd⟩ l r hl hr same
    rcases (returned_eq l r).mp same with ⟨a,hol,hor,hw⟩ | ⟨e,hol,hor⟩ | ⟨hol,hor⟩
    · exact hs l r a hl hr hol hor hw
    · exact hf l r e hl hr hol hor
    · exact hd l r hl hr hol hor
#print axioms returned_eq
#print axioms fibres_iff
end R1Z.PV_RJDec_ResultCases

PV_RJ4IDB_SourceTrace.text:
import PV_RJ4IDB_Decoder
import R1Z.PV_RJDec_ResultCases
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
open R1Z.PV_W_Threading
variable {W A : Type}
def outcomeTerminal (render : Aeneas.Std.Error → Bytes) :
 Outcome Aeneas.Std.Error A → Terminal A
 | .ok a => .success a
 | .fail e => .failure (render e)
 | .div => .diverge
/-- Each source call is already a full visible event, recorded at its own world.
The trace does not discard rejected-call prefixes or terminal failure prefixes. -/
def sourceTrace (render : Aeneas.Std.Error → Bytes)
 (r : Run W Event Aeneas.Std.Error A) : Trace A :=
 ⟨r.calls.map Prod.snd,outcomeTerminal render r.outcome⟩

def actualObservation (render : Aeneas.Std.Error → Bytes)
 (r : Run W Event Aeneas.Std.Error A) : Observation A :=
 ⟨r.calls.map Prod.snd,outcomeTerminal render r.outcome,
 files (r.calls.map Prod.snd),json (r.calls.map Prod.snd),stdout (r.calls.map Prod.snd),
 diagnostics2 (r.calls.map Prod.snd),diagnostics3 (r.calls.map Prod.snd),
 counts (r.calls.map Prod.snd),times (r.calls.map Prod.snd),
 oracle (r.calls.map Prod.snd),rejections (r.calls.map Prod.snd),sideChannels (r.calls.map Prod.snd)⟩
/-- Exact factorization for the event-interpreted source carrier, on every
reachable path and every finite divergent prefix. Native trace association is
an owning-line input, never an assumption that this conclusion holds. -/
theorem actual_factors (render : Aeneas.Std.Error → Bytes)
 (r : Run W Event Aeneas.Std.Error A) :
 actualObservation render r = decoder (sourceTrace render r) := rfl

theorem result_fibres_exact (reachable : Run W Event Aeneas.Std.Error A → Prop)
 (render : Aeneas.Std.Error → Bytes) :
 R1Z.PV_RJDec_Factor.Fibres reachable (actualObservation render) ↔
 (∀ l r a, reachable l → reachable r → l.outcome=.ok a → r.outcome=.ok a →
 l.world=r.world → l.calls.map Prod.snd=r.calls.map Prod.snd) ∧
 (∀ l r e, reachable l → reachable r → l.outcome=.fail e → r.outcome=.fail e →
 l.calls.map Prod.snd=r.calls.map Prod.snd) ∧
 (∀ l r, reachable l → reachable r → l.outcome=.div → r.outcome=.div →
 l.calls.map Prod.snd=r.calls.map Prod.snd) := by
 rw [R1Z.PV_RJDec_ResultCases.fibres_iff]
 constructor
 · rintro ⟨hs,hf,hd⟩
   exact ⟨fun l r a hl hr hol hor hw => congrArg Observation.ordered (hs l r a hl hr hol hor hw),
    fun l r e hl hr hol hor => congrArg Observation.ordered (hf l r e hl hr hol hor),
    fun l r hl hr hol hor => congrArg Observation.ordered (hd l r hl hr hol hor)⟩
 · rintro ⟨hs,hf,hd⟩
   refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
   · intro l r a hl hr hol hor hw
     have he := hs l r a hl hr hol hor hw
     simp only [actualObservation,hol,hor,he]
   · intro l r e hl hr hol hor
     have he := hf l r e hl hr hol hor
     simp only [actualObservation,hol,hor,he]
   · intro l r hl hr hol hor
     have he := hd l r hl hr hol hor
     simp only [actualObservation,hol,hor,he]
#print axioms actual_factors
#print axioms result_fibres_exact
end PV_RJ4IDB

PV_EVH_Interface.text:
import PV_RJ4IDB_NativeFactor
import PV_RJ4IDB_SourceTrace
import R1Z.ProverCommitFuelJoin22
/-! adopted by owner decision D502/D478. Event-retaining interface; the deployed
Runtime and headline remain unchanged. The timing reconstruction proof is
reused from PV_L1C_TimingKey, whose cached object was deleted by that line.
All acquisition, causal-prefix and joint noise laws remain ordinary P links. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_EVH_Interface
open PV_RJ4IDB R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R1Z
def timingSlot : NativeEvent → NativeEvent
 | .wall _ => .wall []
 | e => e

def restoreTimes : List NativeEvent → List PV_RJ4IDB.Bytes → Option (List NativeEvent × List PV_RJ4IDB.Bytes)
 | [],ts => some ([],ts)
 | .wall _ :: _,[] => none
 | .wall _ :: es,t::ts => (restoreTimes es ts).map (fun p => (.wall t::p.1,p.2))
 | e::es,ts => (restoreTimes es ts).map (fun p => (e::p.1,p.2))

theorem restore_times (es : List NativeEvent) (tail : List PV_RJ4IDB.Bytes) :
 restoreTimes (es.map timingSlot) (nativeTimes es ++ tail) = some (es,tail) := by
 induction es with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons e es ih =>
   simp only [nativeTimes] at ih
   cases e <;> simp only [List.map_cons,timingSlot,nativeTimes,List.filterMap_cons,
     List.cons_append,List.nil_append,restoreTimes,ih,Option.map_some]

def timingKey {A : Type} (t : NativeTrace A) :
 (List NativeEvent × Terminal A) × List PV_RJ4IDB.Bytes :=
 ((t.events.map timingSlot,t.terminal),nativeTimes t.events)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: Counts, oracle, allocation/address/physical/durable/environment events and
cross-channel order stay in the context. No success conditioning occurs. -/
theorem timing_key_injective {A : Type} : Function.Injective (@timingKey A) := by
 intro l r h
 have hs := congrArg (fun p => p.1.1) h
 have ht := congrArg (fun p => p.1.2) h
 have hw := congrArg Prod.snd h
 have hl := restore_times l.events []
 have hr := restore_times r.events []
 have he : l.events = r.events := by
   have hx : some (l.events,([] : List PV_RJ4IDB.Bytes)) = some (r.events,[]) := by
     rw [← hl,← hr]
     change restoreTimes (l.events.map timingSlot) (nativeTimes l.events ++ []) =
       restoreTimes (r.events.map timingSlot) (nativeTimes r.events ++ [])
     rw [show l.events.map timingSlot = r.events.map timingSlot from hs,
       show nativeTimes l.events = nativeTimes r.events from hw]
   exact congrArg Prod.fst (Option.some.inj hx)
 cases l; cases r; cases he; cases ht; rfl


/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: option-B signal accompanies the ENTIRE ordered observation.
Every finite divergence prefix is a separate invocation of this interface. -/
def observe {A Signal : Type} (signal : Signal) (trace : NativeTrace A) :
    Signal × Observation A := (signal, nativeObservation trace)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: a public completion kernel. Env supplies joint environmental
and timing noise; it is not witness input. Public is fixed by the invocation.
complete must generate timings AND their copies in JSON/stdout consistently. -/
structure Completion (Public Signal Env Core A : Type) where
  signal : Public → Env → Signal
  complete : Public → Signal → Env → Core → NativeTrace A

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: the same signal on the original good common samples. Its
witness independence requires the public environment marginal link as well. -/
def Link_Signal {S Signal : Type} (bad : S → Prop) (real sim : S → Signal) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, ¬bad s → real s = sim s

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: all ordered non-wall context, timing slots and terminals,
including partial writes, errors, aborts and divergence prefixes. -/
def Link_Context {S A : Type} (bad : S → Prop)
    (real sim : S → NativeTrace A) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, ¬bad s → (timingKey (real s)).1 = (timingKey (sim s)).1

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478 D166: exact JOINT timing on the SAME D163 coupling; not
marginal timing, constant time, or elapsed time declared public. -/
def Link_Timing {S A : Type} (bad : S → Prop)
    (real sim : S → NativeTrace A) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, ¬bad s → nativeTimes (real s).events = nativeTimes (sim s).events

theorem full_agreement {S A Signal : Type} (bad : S → Prop)
    (real sim : S → NativeTrace A) (rs ss : S → Signal)
    (context : Link_Context bad real sim) (timing : Link_Timing bad real sim)
    (signal : Link_Signal bad rs ss) :
    ∀ s, ¬bad s → observe (rs s) (real s) = observe (ss s) (sim s) := by
  intro s hs
  have ht : real s = sim s := timing_key_injective
    (Prod.ext (context s hs) (timing s hs))
  rw [ht, signal s hs]

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478 D163 adapter. No field is added to the three-field trust list;
the coupling retains both marginals and exactly the original bad event. -/
def eventJoin {R M A Signal : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (real : R → NativeTrace A) (sim : M → NativeTrace A)
    (rs : R → Signal) (ss : M → Signal)
    (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry)
    (cp : R0Z.FsAbort.Coupling R ((M × OracleAnswer) × ProverCommitFuelJoin22.Tape))
    (context : Link_Context (fun s => ∃ i, ProverCommitFuelJoin22.bad old queries i (cp.toM s))
      (fun s => real (cp.toR s)) (fun s => sim (cp.toM s).1.1))
    (timing : Link_Timing (fun s => ∃ i, ProverCommitFuelJoin22.bad old queries i (cp.toM s))
      (fun s => real (cp.toR s)) (fun s => sim (cp.toM s).1.1))
    (signal : Link_Signal (fun s => ∃ i, ProverCommitFuelJoin22.bad old queries i (cp.toM s))
      (fun s => rs (cp.toR s)) (fun s => ss (cp.toM s).1.1)) :
    ProverCommitFuelJoin22.RunJoin (fun r => observe (rs r) (real r))
      (fun m => observe (ss m) (sim m)) old queries where
  cp := cp
  agreement := full_agreement _ _ _ _ _ context timing signal

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: source/native event association, covering failures and
all finite divergence prefixes without any Result-fibre requirement. -/
def Link_Source {W A : Type} (render : Aeneas.Std.Error → PV_RJ4IDB.Bytes)
    (run : R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Run W Event Aeneas.Std.Error A)
    (native : NativeTrace A) : Prop := sourceTrace render run = modelTrace native

theorem source_observation {W A : Type} (render : Aeneas.Std.Error → PV_RJ4IDB.Bytes)
    (run : R1Z.PV_W_Threading.Run W Event Aeneas.Std.Error A)
    (native : NativeTrace A) (link : Link_Source render run native) :
    actualObservation render run = nativeObservation native := by
  rw [actual_factors, show sourceTrace render run = modelTrace native from link,
    ← native_factorization]

#print axioms restore_times
#print axioms timing_key_injective
#print axioms full_agreement
#print axioms eventJoin
#print axioms source_observation
end PV_EVH_Interface

PV_EVH_Core.text:
import R1Z.ProverCommitDeployedFuel22
import PV_EVH_Interface
/-! adopted by owner decision D502/D478. A conditional event-retaining headline.
The historical Result-only endpoint and the simulator are unchanged. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_EVH_Core

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: both adaptive queries and the final decision see the full
ordered trace and public failure signal; no successful-return restriction. -/
structure Observer (Signal A : Type) where
  program : Signal × Observation A → OProg
  decide : Signal × Observation A → Bool

variable (completion : Completion Public Signal Env (ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) A)
    (pubData : Public) (env : Env)

def completed (v : ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) : Signal × Observation A :=
  observe (completion.signal pubData env)
    (completion.complete pubData (completion.signal pubData env) env v)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: arbitrary event observers are pulled back to existing
adaptive model observers. Source causality/reachability is a separate P link. -/
def observer (adv : Observer Signal A) : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux where
  prog := fun v oracleLog => adv.program (completed completion pubData env ⟨v,oracleLog⟩)
  decide := fun v => adv.decide (completed completion pubData env v)

def modelReal (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance) (r : (source).RealRand) :
    Signal × Observation A :=
  completed completion pubData env ((source).real h B outputs
    (observer completion pubData env adv) x w r)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478 ideal experiment: unchanged simE followed by the public joint
trace/timing completion; the simulator produces the ordered failure prefixes
too. There is no witness argument to this experiment or its completion. -/
def ideal (adv : Observer Signal A) (r : (source).IdealRand) : Signal × Observation A :=
  completed completion pubData env ((source).ideal (simE (h).transport B outputs x)
    (observer completion pubData env adv) x r)

variable (native : Env → Observer Signal A → (h).Instance → R → NativeTrace A)
    (nativeSignal : Env → Observer Signal A → (h).Instance → R → Signal)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478 real experiment: full native events survive failure,
divergence, panic and abort, rather than being reconstructed from Result. -/
def real (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance) (r : R) : Signal × Observation A :=
  observe (nativeSignal env adv w r) (native env adv w r)

def seedQueries (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance) :
    (source).RealRand → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry :=
  ProverCommitObserverQueries19.real W Pr 8
    (P_R1 (h).transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h B outputs
    (ProverCommitReencode16.observer ProverCommitReencode16.encode
      (observer completion pubData env adv)) x w

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478 named links, not a proof of the native instance. cp is the
D163 common sample with EXACT QueryScan, seed and fuel coordinates. Every
field is ordinary proof work P; the existing trust list T is unchanged. -/
structure Links (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance) where
  cp : Coupling R (((source).RealRand × OracleAnswer) × ProverCommitFuelJoin22.Tape)
  context : Link_Context
    (fun s => ∃ i, ProverCommitFuelJoin22.bad
      (QueryScanRealLazyBound.realBad W Pr 8 h B outputs x w)
      (seedQueries template outputs x completion pubData env adv w) i (cp.toM s))
    (fun s => native env adv w (cp.toR s))
    (fun s => completion.complete pubData (completion.signal pubData env) env
      ((source).real h B outputs (observer completion pubData env adv) x w (cp.toM s).1.1))
  timing : Link_Timing
    (fun s => ∃ i, ProverCommitFuelJoin22.bad
      (QueryScanRealLazyBound.realBad W Pr 8 h B outputs x w)
      (seedQueries template outputs x completion pubData env adv w) i (cp.toM s))
    (fun s => native env adv w (cp.toR s))
    (fun s => completion.complete pubData (completion.signal pubData env) env
      ((source).real h B outputs (observer completion pubData env adv) x w (cp.toM s).1.1))
  signal : Link_Signal
    (fun s => ∃ i, ProverCommitFuelJoin22.bad
      (QueryScanRealLazyBound.realBad W Pr 8 h B outputs x w)
      (seedQueries template outputs x completion pubData env adv w) i (cp.toM s))
    (fun s => nativeSignal env adv w (cp.toR s))
    (fun _ => completion.signal pubData env)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: the composed event join, conditional on three distinct links. -/
def joined (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance)
    (links : Links template outputs x completion pubData env native nativeSignal adv w) :
    ProverCommitFuelJoin22.RunJoin
      (real env native nativeSignal adv w)
      (modelReal template outputs x completion pubData env adv w)
      (QueryScanRealLazyBound.realBad W Pr 8 h B outputs x w)
      (seedQueries template outputs x completion pubData env adv w) :=
  eventJoin _ _ _ _ _ _ links.cp links.context links.timing links.signal

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: definitionally the current deployed headline bound. -/
def bound : ℚ :=
  modelError (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x)) (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x seed)) L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486 + QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget (8 * n1 (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x)) (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x seed)) + 1) + 2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + 2 * ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: the SAME bound and numeric envelope as the
current headline, with no added timing term under exact joint timing links. -/
theorem privacy_headline_events_model
    (links : ∀ (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance), (h).public w = x.1 →
      Links template outputs x completion pubData env native nativeSignal adv w) :
    (∀ (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance), (h).public w = x.1 →
      |mean (fun r => bit (adv.decide (real env native nativeSignal adv w r))) -
        mean (fun r => bit (adv.decide (ideal template outputs x completion pubData env adv r)))| ≤
      bound template outputs x) ∧
    modelError (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x)) (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x seed)) L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486 + QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget (8 * n1 (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x)) (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x seed)) + 1) + 2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + 2 * ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge ≤
      1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^137 + 1 / 2^454 + QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget (8 * n1 (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x)) (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x seed)) + 1) + 2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + 2 * ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge ∧
    modelError (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x)) (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x seed)) L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486 + QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget (8 * n1 (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseWire.toWire (wire base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x)) (R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.R1PhaseProver.toProver (prover base (List.length (R1Wire.pubBytes base x)) h B outputs x seed)) + 1) + 2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + 2 * ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge < 1 / 2^100 := by
  have model := PrivacyR1HeadlineOwnedClosed.Admitted.FixedObserver.privacy_headline_admitted
    template outputs x
  have caller := ProverCommitOwnedEndpoint.caller_law template input outputs x
  obtain ⟨hc₁,hc₂,hs₁,hs₂,hcount,hb₁,hb₂⟩ := ProverCommitCallerInstance.budgets Pr caller
  have hM := ProverCommitModelCore16.read_bound W Pr L₁ L₂ hcount hb₁ hb₂
  have hk := QueryScanFreshNumerics.lazy_budget_le_fresh hM
    (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (8 * n1 W Pr)))
  constructor
  · intro adv w hw
    have hr₀ := ProverCommitFuelJoin22.test_bound
      (joined template outputs x completion pubData env native nativeSignal adv w (links adv w hw))
      (fun run => bit (adv.decide run))
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩) (2^64)
      (fun r => ProverCommitObserverQueries19.real_bound W Pr 8
        (P_R1 (h).transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h B outputs _ x w r)
    have hscan : 8 * scanProbability ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
      simpa only [mul_one_div] using
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left scan_probability_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 8)
    have hr := hr₀.trans (add_le_add (add_le_add
      ((ProverCommitModelCore16.real_bad_mass base h B outputs x seed hc₁ hc₂ w).trans
        (add_le_add (le_refl _) hscan)) (le_refl (ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64)))) (le_refl ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge))
    obtain ⟨hpub, hs⟩ := PrivacyR1HeadlineOwnedClosed.Admitted.builder_premises (x := x) w hw
    have core := ProverCommitModelCore16.core_privacy base h B outputs x seed hB hpub hs
      ProverCommitSourceDecoder.quotientFibreSize (by
        intro τ
        convert ProverCommitCallerInstance.fibres Pr caller τ using 2
        ext e
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and])
      L₁ L₂ (ProverCommitCallerInstance.exhaustion Pr caller)
      hc₁ hc₂ hs₁ hs₂ coins
      (PhaseWireLog2Bin.batches input outputs x template decode)
      (PhaseWireLog2Bin.ordered_log input outputs x template decode) hcount hb₁ hb₂
    have mid := ProverCommitReencode16.privacy_transport _ _ _ _ _ _
      ProverCommitReencode16.encode _ _ _ _ _ core
    have hmid := mid (observer completion pubData env adv) w hw
    have t₁ := abs_sub_le
      (mean (fun r => bit (adv.decide (real env native nativeSignal adv w r))))
      (mean (realTest h B outputs source (observer completion pubData env adv) x w))
      (mean (idealTestS source (observer completion pubData env adv) x
        (simE (h).transport B outputs x)))
    have spare : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 +
        ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge := by
      unfold ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge
      positivity
    calc _ ≤ (QueryScanRealLazyBound.lazyBudget (8 * n1 W Pr) + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 +
          ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge) +
          modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ := t₁.trans (add_le_add hr hmid)
         _ ≤ ((QueryScanRealLazyBound.lazyBudget (8 * n1 W Pr) + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 +
          ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge) +
          modelError W Pr L₁ L₂) +
          (8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 + ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) +
          ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge) := le_add_of_nonneg_right spare
         _ = modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486 +
           QueryScanRealLazyBound.lazyBudget (8 * n1 W Pr) +
           2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget (2^64) + 2 * ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge := by ring
         _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (le_refl _) hk) (le_refl _)) (le_refl _)

  · constructor
    · exact add_le_add (add_le_add model.2.1 (le_refl _)) (le_refl _)
    · apply (add_le_add (add_le_add model.2.1 (le_refl _)) (le_refl _)).trans_lt

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: shared public noise is averaged jointly, without conditioning
on success, a failure code, or a favourable clock value. -/
theorem average_bound {E R I : Type} [Fintype E] [Nonempty E]
    [Fintype R] [Fintype I] (real : E → R → ℚ) (ideal : E → I → ℚ) (ε : ℚ)
    (per_env : ∀ e, |mean (real e) - mean (ideal e)| ≤ ε) :
    |mean (fun p : E × R => real p.1 p.2) -
      mean (fun p : E × I => ideal p.1 p.2)| ≤ ε := by
  rw [R0Z.LawTransport.mean_product, R0Z.LawTransport.mean_product,
    R0Z.FsGood.mean_sub]
  exact (R0Z.FsGood.abs_mean_le _).trans
    ((R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mean_mono' _ _ per_env).trans_eq (R0Z.FsAbort.mean_const ε))

    [Fintype Env] [Nonempty Env]

    (pubData : Public)
    (native : Env → Observer Signal A → (h).Instance → R → NativeTrace A)
    (nativeSignal : Env → Observer Signal A → (h).Instance → R → Signal)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478 real experiment with public environment marginal. Native
association with this product is OPEN; it is not inferred from signal marginals. -/
def realExperiment (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance)
    (r : Env × R) : Signal × Observation A :=
  PV_EVH_Core.real r.1 native nativeSignal adv w r.2

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478 joint ideal experiment: sample public environment/noise and
simE coins, then generate all ordered channels using the same completion. -/
def idealExperiment (adv : Observer Signal A) (r : Env × (source).IdealRand) :
    Signal × Observation A :=
  PV_EVH_Core.ideal template outputs x completion pubData r.1 adv r.2

theorem privacy_headline_events_joint
    (links : ∀ env (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance), (h).public w = x.1 →
      Links template outputs x completion pubData env native nativeSignal adv w)
    (adv : Observer Signal A) (w : (h).Instance) (hw : (h).public w = x.1) :
    |mean (fun r => bit (adv.decide (realExperiment native nativeSignal adv w r))) -
      mean (fun r => bit (adv.decide
        (idealExperiment template outputs x completion pubData adv r)))| ≤
      PV_EVH_Core.bound template outputs x := by
  exact average_bound (E := Env) (R := R) (I := (source).IdealRand)
    (fun env r => bit (adv.decide (PV_EVH_Core.real env native nativeSignal adv w r)))
    (fun env r => bit (adv.decide
      (PV_EVH_Core.ideal template outputs x completion pubData env adv r)))
    (PV_EVH_Core.bound template outputs x)
    (fun env => (PV_EVH_Core.privacy_headline_events_model template outputs x completion pubData env
      native nativeSignal (links env)).1 adv w hw)

import PV_EVH_Interface
/-! adopted by owner decision D502/D478. An explicit residual charge if exact
joint trace simulation cannot be established. This module never claims that
the residual is zero, negligible, or covered by an existing event. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_EVH_Residual
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsStatement PV_RJ4IDB PV_EVH_Interface
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: charge ONLY additional disagreement outside the old event.
This covers timing, its JSON/stdout copies, failures, order and terminals. -/
def traceResidual {S V : Type} [Fintype S] (bad : S → Prop) (real sim : S → V) : ℚ :=
  eventMass (fun s => ¬bad s ∧ real s ≠ sim s)

theorem with_residual {S V : Type} [Fintype S] (bad : S → Prop)
    (real sim : S → V) (test : V → ℚ)
    (bounded : ∀ v, 0 ≤ test v ∧ test v ≤ 1) :
    |mean (fun s => test (real s)) - mean (fun s => test (sim s))| ≤
      eventMass bad + traceResidual bad real sim := by
  have h := until_bad (fun s => test (real s)) (fun s => test (sim s))
    (fun _ => bounded _) (fun _ => bounded _)
    (fun s => bad s ∨ (¬bad s ∧ real s ≠ sim s)) (by
      intro s hs
      have hb : ¬bad s := fun h => hs (Or.inl h)
      have he : real s = sim s := Classical.byContradiction (fun h => hs (Or.inr ⟨hb,h⟩))
      exact congrArg test he)
  exact h.trans (eventMass_or_le _ _)

theorem exact_links_zero {S A Signal : Type} [Fintype S]
    (bad : S → Prop) (real sim : S → NativeTrace A) (rs ss : S → Signal)
    (context : Link_Context bad real sim) (timing : Link_Timing bad real sim)
    (signal : Link_Signal bad rs ss) :
    traceResidual bad (fun s => observe (rs s) (real s))
      (fun s => observe (ss s) (sim s)) = 0 := by
  have agree := full_agreement bad real sim rs ss context timing signal
  unfold traceResidual eventMass
  trans mean (fun _ : S => (0 : ℚ))
  · apply congrArg mean
    funext s
    apply if_neg
    rintro ⟨hb,hn⟩
    exact hn (agree s hb)
  · simp only [mean, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_div]

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: named public-environment association. Native joint entropy
and environment marginals must be identified with the shared public product;
separate signal or clock marginal equality is insufficient. -/
def Link_PublicEnvironment {N E C : Type} [Fintype N] [Fintype E] [Fintype C]
    (actual : N → E × C) : Prop :=
  R0Z.EqualLaws actual (fun p : E × C => p)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: native option-B signal law must be witness independent for
all equal-public witnesses. This marginal law alone never proves prefix privacy. -/
def Link_PublicSignal {W P N E Signal : Type} [Fintype N] [Fintype E]
    (pub : W → P) (p : P) (actual : W → N → Signal) (signal : E → Signal) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, pub w = p → R0Z.EqualLaws (actual w) signal

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: progressive completion cannot rewrite events already shown
to the observer. Source association and the native query schedule are still
required; this necessary prefix law does not supply those facts. -/
def Link_CausalPrefix {E V L A : Type}
    (complete : E → V → List L → NativeTrace A) : Prop :=
  ∀ e v log suffix, List.IsPrefix (complete e v log).events
    (complete e v (log ++ suffix)).events

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: exact native adaptive-program association at every
reachable source prefix. Both families range over actual invocation/prefix
indices; the expected observation is not allowed to contain future data. -/
def Link_ObserverProgram {I O : Type} (actual : I → R1Z.GamesR1.OProg)
    (expected : I → O) (program : O → R1Z.GamesR1.OProg) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, actual i = program (expected i)

/-- adopted by owner decision D502/D478: if an exact surrogate theorem is available but the actual
joint trace differs, its additional term is explicit. No <2^-100 conclusion
is transferred without a separate bound for deltaTrace. -/
theorem headline_plus_trace {S I : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype I]
    (actual exact : S → ℚ) (ideal : I → ℚ) (B deltaTrace : ℚ)
    (trace_link : |mean actual - mean exact| ≤ deltaTrace)
    (headline : |mean exact - mean ideal| ≤ B) :
    |mean actual - mean ideal| ≤ B + deltaTrace := by
  have h := (abs_sub_le (mean actual) (mean exact) (mean ideal)).trans
    (add_le_add trace_link headline)
  simpa only [add_comm] using h

#print axioms with_residual
#print axioms exact_links_zero
#print axioms headline_plus_trace
end PV_EVH_Residual

PV_RJ4IDB_TraceBind.text:
import PV_RJ4IDB_Decoder
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
variable {A B C : Type}
def pure (a : A) : Trace A := ⟨[],.success a⟩
def prepend (es : List Event) (t : Trace A) : Trace A := ⟨es++t.events,t.terminal⟩
def bind (t : Trace A) (f : A → Trace B) : Trace B :=
 match t.terminal with
 | .success a => prepend t.events (f a)
 | .failure e => ⟨t.events,.failure e⟩
 | .panic p => ⟨t.events,.panic p⟩
 | .abort c => ⟨t.events,.abort c⟩
 | .diverge => ⟨t.events,.diverge⟩

theorem bind_prepend (es : List Event) (t : Trace A) (f : A → Trace B) :
 bind (prepend es t) f = prepend es (bind t f) := by
 cases t with | mk xs ex => cases ex <;> simp [bind,prepend,List.append_assoc]

theorem bind_assoc (t : Trace A) (f : A → Trace B) (g : B → Trace C) :
 bind (bind t f) g = bind t (fun a => bind (f a) g) := by
 cases t with
 | mk es ex => cases ex with
   | success a => exact bind_prepend es (f a) g
   | failure e => rfl
   | panic p => rfl
   | abort c => rfl
   | diverge => rfl

theorem bind_failure (es : List Event) (e : Bytes) (f : A → Trace B) :
 bind ⟨es,.failure e⟩ f = ⟨es,.failure e⟩ := rfl

theorem bind_divergence (es : List Event) (f : A → Trace B) :
 bind ⟨es,.diverge⟩ f = ⟨es,.diverge⟩ := rfl
#print axioms bind_prepend
#print axioms bind_assoc
#print axioms bind_failure
#print axioms bind_divergence
end PV_RJ4IDB

PV_RJ4IDB_ClientSuffix.text:
import PV_RJ4IDB_TraceBind
/-! The deployed normal suffix's order, with complete leaf executions as inputs.
No leaf I/O or time value is made successful, silent, or public by definition. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
structure ClientSuffix where
 writeProof : Trace Unit
 writeStatement : Unit → Trace Unit
 makeReturnedJSON : Unit → Trace Bytes
 printStdout : Bytes → Trace Unit

def planSuffix (o : ClientSuffix) : Trace Bytes :=
 bind o.writeProof (fun u => bind (o.writeStatement u) o.makeReturnedJSON)

def mainSuffix (o : ClientSuffix) : Trace Unit :=
 bind (planSuffix o) o.printStdout

theorem main_order (o : ClientSuffix) :
 mainSuffix o = bind o.writeProof (fun u =>
 bind (o.writeStatement u) (fun v => bind (o.makeReturnedJSON v) o.printStdout)) := by
 unfold mainSuffix planSuffix
 rw [bind_assoc]
 congr 1
 funext u
 exact bind_assoc (o.writeStatement u) o.makeReturnedJSON o.printStdout

theorem statement_failure_preserves_proof (o : ClientSuffix) (es fs : List Event)
 (error : Bytes) (hp : o.writeProof = ⟨es,.success ()⟩)
 (hs : o.writeStatement () = ⟨fs,.failure error⟩) :
 mainSuffix o = ⟨es++fs,.failure error⟩ := by
 rw [main_order,hp]
 simp [bind,hs,prepend]

theorem json_divergence_preserves_files (o : ClientSuffix) (a b c : List Event)
 (hp : o.writeProof = ⟨a,.success ()⟩)
 (hs : o.writeStatement () = ⟨b,.success ()⟩)
 (hj : o.makeReturnedJSON () = ⟨c,.diverge⟩) :
 mainSuffix o = ⟨a++(b++c),.diverge⟩ := by
 rw [main_order,hp]
 simp [bind,hs,hj,prepend]
#print axioms main_order
#print axioms statement_failure_preserves_proof
#print axioms json_divergence_preserves_files
end PV_RJ4IDB

PV_RJ4IDB_Publication.text:
import PV_RJ4IDB_ClientSuffix
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_RJ4IDB
/-- runjoin owns publish_compact's proof equation. The produced proof is data,
not an assumption that the complete actual observation equals its decoder. -/
structure PublicationInput where
 afterstate : Bytes
 publish_compact : Bytes
 statement : Bytes
 proofPath : Bytes
 statementPath : Bytes

def proofBytes (p : PublicationInput) := p.afterstate ++ p.publish_compact
/-- These are REQUESTS. Delivery, file/open errors and cleanup come from the
native file operations; their traces are never replaced by these requests. -/
def requestedPublication (p : PublicationInput) : List Event :=
 [.file (.write p.proofPath (proofBytes p) []),
  .file (.write p.statementPath p.statement [])]

theorem proof_statement_order (p : PublicationInput) : files (requestedPublication p) =
 [.write p.proofPath (p.afterstate++p.publish_compact) [],
  .write p.statementPath p.statement []] := rfl

theorem publication_append_prefix (p : PublicationInput) (prior : List Event) :
 files (prior ++ requestedPublication p) = files prior ++
 [.write p.proofPath (p.afterstate++p.publish_compact) [],
  .write p.statementPath p.statement []] := by
 rw [files_append,proof_statement_order]
#print axioms proof_statement_order
#print axioms publication_append_prefix
end PV_RJ4IDB

headline. The historical Result-only privacy_headline_deployed is unchanged.

  · exact (PV_EVH_Core.privacy_headline_events_model template outputs x
