import R1Z.BuilderCanonical

/-! Mathematical records with the literal public fixture witness constants
from r0_fixture.rs / v7_pair_forest_fixture.rs. The native record/byte mapping
is a separate obligation. Hashes stay symbolic throughout this module. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords
open R0P AspisR1 AspisR1.SpendRelation AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
abbrev M := R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F

def digest (seed : Nat) : R0P.Digest M := fun i => (seed + 17*i.val + 1 : Nat)

def path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest M := fun i =>
  if i.val = 0 then (false,digest 900)
  else if i.val < 21 then
    (decide (((0x54321 : Nat) >>> (i.val-1)) &&& 1 = 1),digest (2000 + 20*(i.val-1)))
  else (decide (i.val ≠ 22),digest (3000 + 100*(i.val-21)))

def pair : PairLeaf M where
  firstCommitment := noteCommitment (ownerKey (digest 10)) 1000 77 (digest 100)
  secondOccupied := 1
  secondCommitment := digest 900
  secondOccupancyInverse := (digest 900 7)⁻¹

def witness (withdrawal : Bool) : Wspend where
  inputValue := ⟨1000,by decide⟩
  outputValue := if withdrawal then ⟨250,by decide⟩ else ⟨600,by decide⟩
  changeValue := if withdrawal then ⟨750,by decide⟩ else ⟨400,by decide⟩
  sk := digest 10
  salt := digest 100
  path := path
  pair := pair
  recipientOwner := digest 300
  recipientSalt := digest 400
  changeOwner := if withdrawal then digest 700 else digest 500
  changeSalt := if withdrawal then digest 800 else digest 600

def base (withdrawal : Bool) : Public M where
  variant := if withdrawal then .withdrawal else .privateTransfer
  anchor := merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey (digest 10)) 1000 77 (digest 100)) path
  nullifier := nullifierHash (digest 10) (digest 100)
  assetId := 77
  recipient := if withdrawal then none else some
    (noteCommitment (witness withdrawal).recipientOwner (witness withdrawal).outputValue.val
      77 (witness withdrawal).recipientSalt)
  change := noteCommitment (witness withdrawal).changeOwner (witness withdrawal).changeValue.val
    77 (witness withdrawal).changeSalt
  withdrawalAmount := if withdrawal then some 250 else none
  nextPairIndex := 0
  snapshotFrontier := fun i => AppendNode.frozenEmpty i.castSucc
  nextRoot := fun _ => 0
  nextFrontier := fun i => AppendNode.frozenEmpty i.castSucc

def outputPair (withdrawal : Bool) : R0P.Digest M :=
  if withdrawal then nodeCompress (base withdrawal).change (fun _ => 0)
  else nodeCompress (noteCommitment (witness withdrawal).recipientOwner
    (witness withdrawal).outputValue.val 77 (witness withdrawal).recipientSalt)
    (base withdrawal).change

def attachAppend {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (pair : R0P.Digest K) : Public K :=
  { pub with
    nextRoot := AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair 20
    nextFrontier := fun l => if l.val = digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex then
      AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair l.val else pub.snapshotFrontier l }

theorem prefix_seal {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (pair leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (n : Nat) :
    AppendPath.pathPrefix (attachAppend pub pair) leaf n = AppendPath.pathPrefix pub leaf n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [AppendPath.pathPrefix]
    split
    · rw [ih]
      rfl
    · exact ih

theorem seal_append {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (pub : Public K) (pair : R0P.Digest K)
    (output : SpendRelation.outputPair pub = some pair) : AppendBinding (attachAppend pub pair) := by
  refine ⟨pair,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact output
  · exact (prefix_seal pub pair pair 20).symm
  · intro hc
    change (if digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex = digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex then
      AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex) else _) = _
    rw [if_pos rfl,prefix_seal]
    rfl

def fixturePublic (withdrawal : Bool) : Public M := attachAppend (base withdrawal) (outputPair withdrawal)

theorem pair_valid : pair.Valid := by
  have sentinel : digest 900 7 ≠ 0 := by
    change (1020 : ZMod 2147483647) ≠ 0
    intro zero
    have values := congrArg (fun a : ZMod 2147483647 => a.val) zero
    change 1020 = 0 at values
    omega
  change 1*(1-1) = (0 : M) ∧ digest 900 7 * (digest 900 7)⁻¹ = 1 ∧
    (1-1)*(digest 900 7)⁻¹ = 0 ∧ ∀ lane, (1-1)*digest 900 lane = 0
  simp only [sub_self,mul_zero,zero_mul,mul_inv_cancel₀ sentinel,true_and,implies_true]

theorem input_relation (withdrawal : Bool) :
    InputWitnessCore.Relation (fixturePublic withdrawal) (witness withdrawal).inputValue.val
      (witness withdrawal).sk (witness withdrawal).salt
      (witness withdrawal).path (witness withdrawal).pair where
  valid := pair_valid
  spendable := rfl
  commitment := rfl
  sibling := rfl
  nullifier := rfl
  membership := rfl

theorem append (withdrawal : Bool) : AppendBinding (fixturePublic withdrawal) := by
  apply seal_append
  cases withdrawal <;> rfl

theorem spend (withdrawal : Bool) : Rspend (fixturePublic withdrawal) (witness withdrawal) := by
  refine ⟨?_,input_relation withdrawal,?_,rfl,?_,append withdrawal⟩
  · cases withdrawal
    · exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨rfl,rfl,?_⟩
      change (some (250 : M)) ≠ some 0
      simpa only [ne_eq,Option.some.injEq] using (show (250 : M) ≠ 0 by
        change (250 : ZMod 2147483647) ≠ 0
        intro zero
        have values := congrArg (fun a : ZMod 2147483647 => a.val) zero
        change 250 = 0 at values
        omega)
  · cases withdrawal <;> decide
  · cases withdrawal <;> rfl

theorem withdrawal_spendPlus : BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus (fixturePublic true) (witness true) := by
  refine ⟨spend true,?_⟩
  intro impossible
  cases impossible

/-- Transfer retains precisely the adopted D50 change-sentinel obligation;
no concrete Poseidon recurrence is unfolded to conceal that remaining check. -/
theorem transfer_spendPlus (sentinel : (fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0) :
    BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus (fixturePublic false) (witness false) :=
  ⟨spend false,fun _ => sentinel⟩

#print axioms prefix_seal
#print axioms seal_append
#print axioms pair_valid
#print axioms input_relation
#print axioms append
#print axioms spend
#print axioms withdrawal_spendPlus
#print axioms transfer_spendPlus
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords

/-! Explicit coordinate maps for spend data. These definitions work for an
arbitrary scalar function, including the base-coordinate projection. They
do not assert preservation of the spend equations by an arbitrary function. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap
open AspisR1

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation
variable {K L M : Type}

def digest (f : K → L) (d : R0P.Digest K) : R0P.Digest L := fun i => f (d i)

def path (f : K → L) (p : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest L := fun i => ((p i).1, digest f (p i).2)

def pair (f : K → L) (p : PairLeaf K) : PairLeaf L :=
  { firstCommitment := digest f p.firstCommitment
    secondOccupied := f p.secondOccupied
    secondCommitment := digest f p.secondCommitment
    secondOccupancyInverse := f p.secondOccupancyInverse }

def witness (f : K → L) (w : Witness K) : Witness L :=
  { inputValue := w.inputValue
    outputValue := w.outputValue
    changeValue := w.changeValue
    sk := digest f w.sk
    salt := digest f w.salt
    path := path f w.path
    pair := pair f w.pair
    recipientOwner := digest f w.recipientOwner
    recipientSalt := digest f w.recipientSalt
    changeOwner := digest f w.changeOwner
    changeSalt := digest f w.changeSalt }

def mapPublic (f : K → L) (p : Public K) : Public L :=
  { variant := p.variant
    anchor := digest f p.anchor
    nullifier := digest f p.nullifier
    assetId := f p.assetId
    recipient := p.recipient.map (digest f)
    change := digest f p.change
    withdrawalAmount := p.withdrawalAmount.map f
    nextPairIndex := p.nextPairIndex
    snapshotFrontier := fun i => digest f (p.snapshotFrontier i)
    nextRoot := digest f p.nextRoot
    nextFrontier := fun i => digest f (p.nextFrontier i) }

theorem witness_id (w : Witness K) : witness id w = w := by
  cases w
  rfl

theorem witness_comp (f : K → L) (g : L → M) (w : Witness K) :
    witness g (witness f w) = witness (g ∘ f) w := by
  rfl

theorem mapPublic_id (p : Public K) : mapPublic id p = p := by
  rcases p with ⟨v, a, n, asset, recipient, change, amount, index, frontier, root, next⟩
  cases recipient <;> cases amount <;> rfl

theorem mapPublic_comp (f : K → L) (g : L → M) (p : Public K) :
    mapPublic g (mapPublic f p) = mapPublic (g ∘ f) p := by
  rcases p with ⟨v, a, n, asset, recipient, change, amount, index, frontier, root, next⟩
  cases recipient <;> cases amount <;> rfl

import R0P.Semantics

/-! Field-homomorphism naturality for the scalar Poseidon model. These lemmas
are purely algebraic: no field characteristic, constant correspondence, or
finite-field computation is assumed. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap

open R0P

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

abbrev State (K : Type) := Fin 16 → K
abbrev Digest (K : Type) := Fin 8 → K

def mapState (s : State K) : State L := fun i => f (s i)
def mapDigest (d : Digest K) : Digest L := fun i => f (d i)

theorem map_poseidonPow5 (x : K) :
    f (poseidonPow5 x) = poseidonPow5 (f x) := by
  simp [poseidonPow5]

theorem map_poseidonMat4 (s : Fin 4 → K) (i : Fin 4) :
    f (poseidonMat4 s i) = poseidonMat4 (fun i => f (s i)) i := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [poseidonMat4, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonExternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonExternalLinear s) =
      poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonExternalLinear, mapState]
  simp_rw [map_add, map_zero, map_poseidonMat4]

theorem map_foldl_add (xs : List K) (init : K) :
    f (xs.foldl (· + ·) init) = (xs.map f).foldl (· + ·) (f init) := by
  induction xs generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons]
      rw [ih, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonInternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalLinear s) =
      poseidonInternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonInternalLinear, mapState]
  have hxs : (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => s j.succ)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => f (s j.succ)) := by
    simp
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · simp only [dif_pos hi, map_sub]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]
  · simp only [dif_neg hi, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]

theorem map_poseidonFullRound (s c : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c) =
      poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c) := by
  unfold poseidonFullRound
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun lane => poseidonPow5 (s lane + c lane)) =
        (fun lane => poseidonPow5
          (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s lane + mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c lane)) := by
    funext i
    simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonInternalRound (s : State K) c :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c) =
      poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c) := by
  unfold poseidonInternalRound
  rw [map_poseidonInternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun i =>
        if i = 0 then poseidonPow5 (s 0 + c) else s i) =
      (fun i => if i = 0 then poseidonPow5
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s 0 + f c)
        else mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s i) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
    · simp [mapState, hi]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonExternalInitial (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonExternalFinal (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonInternalConstants (r : Fin 14) :
    f (poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r) =
      poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r := by
  fin_cases r <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_fullRoundFold (cs : List (State K)) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
      (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
                (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c)) := by rw [map_poseidonFullRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

theorem map_internalRoundFold (cs : List K) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
      (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c)) := by
                rw [map_poseidonInternalRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

theorem map_poseidonPermutation (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation s) =
      poseidonPermutation (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  unfold poseidonPermutation
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).foldl
        poseidonFullRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).foldl
          poseidonInternalRound
          ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).foldl
            poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear s)))) =
    (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r)).foldl
      poseidonFullRound
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r)).foldl
        poseidonInternalRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r)).foldl
          poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s))))
  have hi : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalInitial f r))
  have hc : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact map_poseidonInternalConstants f r)
  have hf : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalFinal f r))
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hf]
  rw [map_internalRoundFold, hc]
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hi]
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]

theorem map_nodeCompress (a b : Digest K) :
    mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f (nodeCompress a b) =
      nodeCompress (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f a)
        (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f b) := by
  change (fun i : Fin 8 => f (poseidonPermutation (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)) = _
  have hinput : mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) =
    (fun l => if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
      else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
      else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)) := by
    funext l
    dsimp only [mapState]
    split_ifs with hlow hlast
    · rfl
    · rw [map_sub]
      exact congrArg (fun z : L => f (b 7) - z) (map_natCast f 1051521018)
    · rfl
  funext i
  let inK : State K := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
    else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
    else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩
  let inL : State L := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
    else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
    else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation inK)
      ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = poseidonPermutation inL ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  rw [congrFun (map_poseidonPermutation f inK) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩]
  rw [hinput]

#print axioms map_poseidonPow5
#print axioms map_poseidonMat4

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap

/-! Ring-hom naturality for the R0 note-hash and 24-level Merkle functions.
These are algebraic transport lemmas only; they do not connect a runtime field
parser or a Rust trace to the generic semantic model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap

open R0P R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

theorem map_spongeInit (domain len : K) :
    mapState f (spongeInit domain len) =
      spongeInit (f domain) (f len) := by
  funext lane
  by_cases h8 : lane = 8
  · subst lane
    simp [mapState, spongeInit]
  · by_cases h9 : lane = 9
    · subst lane
      simp [mapState, spongeInit, h8]
    · simp [mapState, spongeInit, h8, h9]

theorem map_absorb (s : State K) (chunk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapState f (absorb s chunk) =
      absorb (mapState f s) (mapDigest f chunk) := by
  funext lane
  by_cases h : lane.val < 8 <;>
    simp [mapState, mapDigest, absorb, h, map_add]

theorem map_spongeStep (s : State K) (chunk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapState f (spongeStep s chunk) =
      spongeStep (mapState f s) (mapDigest f chunk) := by
  unfold spongeStep
  rw [map_poseidonPermutation, map_absorb]

theorem map_digestOf (s : State K) :
    mapDigest f (digestOf s) = digestOf (mapState f s) := by
  rfl

theorem map_ownerKey (sk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (mapDigest f sk) := by
  unfold ownerKey
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeInit]
  simp only [map_ofNat]

theorem map_nullifierHash (sk salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (nullifierHash sk salt) =
      nullifierHash (mapDigest f sk) (mapDigest f salt) := by
  unfold nullifierHash
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep, map_spongeInit]
  simp only [map_ofNat]

theorem map_noteCommitment (pk : R0P.Digest K) (value asset : K)
    (salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) =
      noteCommitment (mapDigest f pk) (f value) (f asset) (mapDigest f salt) := by
  unfold noteCommitment
  let chunk2K : R0P.Digest K := fun i =>
    if i.val = 0 then value else if i.val = 1 then asset
      else salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩
  let chunk2L : R0P.Digest L := fun i =>
    if i.val = 0 then f value else if i.val = 1 then f asset
      else mapDigest f salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩
  let chunk3K : R0P.Digest K := fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 2 then salt ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0
  let chunk3L : R0P.Digest L := fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 2 then mapDigest f salt ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0
  have hchunk2 : mapDigest f chunk2K = chunk2L := by
    funext i
    change f (chunk2K i) = chunk2L i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [chunk2K, chunk2L, mapDigest]
  have hchunk3 : mapDigest f chunk3K = chunk3L := by
    funext i
    change f (chunk3K i) = chunk3L i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [chunk3K, chunk3L, mapDigest]
  change mapDigest f
      (digestOf (spongeStep (spongeStep (spongeStep
        (spongeInit (0x4153_0003 : K) 18) pk) chunk2K) chunk3K)) = _
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep,
    map_spongeInit, hchunk2, hchunk3]
  simp only [map_ofNat, chunk2L, chunk3L]

def mapPath (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest L :=
  fun level => ((path level).1, mapDigest f (path level).2)

theorem map_merkleStep (cur : R0P.Digest K) (bit : Bool)
    (sibling : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (merkleStep cur bit sibling) =
      merkleStep (mapDigest f cur) bit (mapDigest f sibling) := by
  cases bit <;> simp [merkleStep, map_nodeCompress]

theorem map_merkleRootAux (cur : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    ∀ n, mapDigest f (merkleRootAux cur path n) =
      merkleRootAux (mapDigest f cur) (mapPath f path) n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold merkleRootAux
      by_cases h : n < 24
      · simp only [dif_pos h]
        rw [map_merkleStep, ih]
        simp [mapPath]
      · simp only [dif_neg h]
        exact ih

theorem map_merkleRoot (leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (mapDigest f leaf) (mapPath f path) := by
  unfold merkleRoot
  exact map_merkleRootAux f leaf path 24

#print axioms map_absorb
#print axioms map_spongeStep
#print axioms map_digestOf
#print axioms map_ownerKey

#print axioms map_noteCommitment

#print axioms map_merkleRootAux
#print axioms map_merkleRoot

end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap
import R1AppendPath

/-! Ring-hom naturality for the public append binding. This transports the
public append equations through an injective field map; it adds no statement
about how the public values were produced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap
open AspisR1

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation
open R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

theorem digest_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact hf (congrFun h i)

theorem digest_nodeCompress (a b : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (nodeCompress a b) =
      nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f a) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f b) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (nodeCompress a b) =
    nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f a) (PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f b)
  exact PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.map_nodeCompress f a b

theorem digest_zero :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (fun _ : Fin 8 => (0 : K)) =
      (fun _ : Fin 8 => (0 : L)) := by
  funext i
  exact map_zero f

theorem map_frozenEmpty (level : Fin 21) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendNode.frozenEmpty (K := K) level) =
      AppendNode.frozenEmpty (K := L) level := by
  funext i
  dsimp [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest, AppendNode.frozenEmpty]
  exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_step (pub : Public K) (level : Fin 20) (cur : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.step pub level cur) =
      AppendPath.step (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) level
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f cur) := by
  unfold AppendPath.step
  change
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
      (if digestBitZero pub level then
        nodeCompress cur (AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc)
       else
        nodeCompress (pub.snapshotFrontier level) cur) =
    (if digestBitZero pub level then
      nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f cur) (AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc)
     else
      nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.snapshotFrontier level))
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f cur))
  by_cases h : digestBitZero pub level
  · simp only [if_pos h]
    rw [digest_nodeCompress, map_frozenEmpty]
  · simp only [if_neg h]
    exact digest_nodeCompress f _ _

theorem map_pathPrefix (pub : Public K) (leaf : R0P.Digest K) (n : Nat) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub leaf n) =
      AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f leaf) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold AppendPath.pathPrefix
      by_cases hn : n < 20
      · simp only [dif_pos hn]
        rw [map_step, ih]
      · simp only [dif_neg hn]
        exact ih

theorem map_outputPair (pub : Public K) :
    outputPair (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) =
      (outputPair pub).map (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f) := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
        simp [outputPair, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr,
          digest_nodeCompress]
  | withdrawal =>
      simp [outputPair, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv,
        digest_nodeCompress, digest_zero]

theorem appendBinding_map_iff (pub : Public K) :
    AppendBinding (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) ↔ AppendBinding pub := by
  have hf : Function.Injective f := f.injective
  have hd : Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) :=
    digest_injective f hf
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨pairL, hpairL, hrootL, hcarryL⟩
    cases hpair : outputPair pub with
    | none =>
        rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpair] at hpairL
        cases hpairL
    | some pairK =>
        have hpairMapped :
            outputPair (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) =
              some (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) := by
          rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpair]
          rfl
        have hpairValue : pairL = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK :=
          Option.some.inj (hpairL.symm.trans hpairMapped)
        refine ⟨pairK, hpair, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply hd
          calc
            PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pub.nextRoot =
                (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextRoot := rfl
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL 20 := hrootL
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
                  (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) 20 := by rw [hpairValue]
            _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK 20) :=
                  (map_pathPrefix f pub pairK 20).symm
        · intro hc
          have hcMapped : digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex < 20 := by
            simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hc
          have hfrontier :
              PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
                (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩) =
              AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL
                (digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := by
            simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hcarryL hcMapped
          apply hd
          calc
            PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
                (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩) =
              AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL
                (digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := hfrontier
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
                  (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex) := by
                    rw [hpairValue]
                    rfl
            _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
                  (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)) :=
                    (map_pathPrefix f pub pairK (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)).symm
  · rintro ⟨pairK, hpairK, hrootK, hcarryK⟩
    refine ⟨PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpairK]
      rfl
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextRoot = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pub.nextRoot := rfl
        _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK 20) := congrArg _ hrootK
        _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) 20 := map_pathPrefix f pub pairK 20
    · intro hc
      have hcK : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20 := by
        simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hc
      calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextFrontier
            ⟨digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex, hc⟩ =
          PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hcK⟩) := rfl
        _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
              (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)) :=
                congrArg (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f) (hcarryK hcK)
        _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK)
              (digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := by
                rw [map_pathPrefix]
                rfl

R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendRelationMap.text:
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap

/-! Ring-hom transport for the complete spend relation. This is a coordinate
embedding equivalence for already mapped witnesses; it does not claim that
arbitrary projections preserve witness validity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendRelationMap
open AspisR1

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]

theorem map_eq_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x y : K) : f x = f y ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hf h
  · intro h
    exact congrArg f h

theorem map_zero_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x : K) : f x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
  rw [← map_zero f]
  exact map_eq_iff f hf x 0

theorem digest_injective (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact hf (congrFun h i)

theorem pair_valid_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : PairLeaf K) : (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f p).Valid ↔ p.Valid := by
  rcases p with ⟨firstCommitment, secondOccupied, secondCommitment,
    secondOccupancyInverse⟩
  change
    (f secondOccupied * (f secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
      f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩) * f secondOccupancyInverse =
        f secondOccupied ∧
      (1 - f secondOccupied) * f secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane, (1 - f secondOccupied) * f (secondCommitment lane) = 0) ↔
    (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
      secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse = secondOccupied ∧
      (1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane, (1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane = 0)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have h1' : f (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1)) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h1
    have h2' : f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse) =
        f secondOccupied := by simpa [map_mul] using h2
    have h3' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h3
    refine ⟨(map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h1', (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h2',
      (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h3', ?_⟩
    intro lane
    have h4' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h4 lane
    exact (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h4'
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have h1' : f (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1)) = f 0 := congrArg f h1
    have h2' : f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse) =
        f secondOccupied := congrArg f h2
    have h3' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse) = f 0 := congrArg f h3
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h1'
    · simpa [map_mul] using h2'
    · simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h3'
    · intro lane
      have h4' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane) = f 0 :=
        congrArg f (h4 lane)
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h4'

theorem pair_spendable_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : PairLeaf K) (b : Bool) :
    (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f p).SelectedSlotIsSpendable b ↔
      p.SelectedSlotIsSpendable b := by
  cases b with
  | false => simp [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied,
      PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair]
  | true =>
      change f p.secondOccupied = 1 ↔ p.secondOccupied = 1
      rw [← map_one f]
      exact map_eq_iff f hf _ _

theorem canonical_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) :
    PublicOptionShape.canonical (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) ↔
      PublicOptionShape.canonical pub := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;> cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [PublicOptionShape.canonical, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr, ha,
          map_zero_iff f hf]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;> cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [PublicOptionShape.canonical, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr, ha,
          map_zero_iff f hf]

theorem map_digest_noteCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pk : R0P.Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) =
      noteCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pk) (f value)
        (f asset) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f salt) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) = _
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_noteCommitment f pk value asset salt

theorem map_digest_ownerKey (f : K →+* L) (sk : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f sk) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (ownerKey sk) = _
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_ownerKey f sk

theorem map_digest_nullifier (f : K →+* L)
    (sk salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (nullifierHash sk salt) =
      nullifierHash (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f sk) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f salt) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (nullifierHash sk salt) = _
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_nullifierHash f sk salt

theorem map_digest_merkleRoot (f : K →+* L) (leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f leaf) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
    merkleRoot (PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f leaf) (PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.mapPath f path)
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_merkleRoot f leaf path

theorem relation_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) (value : K) (sk salt : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) (pair : PairLeaf K) :
    InputWitnessCore.Relation (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (f value)
      (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f sk) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f salt)
      (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair) ↔
    InputWitnessCore.Relation pub value sk salt path pair := by
  let d := PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
  have howner : d (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (d sk) := by
    simpa [d] using map_digest_ownerKey f sk
  have hnote : d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) =
      noteCommitment (d (ownerKey sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) := by
    simpa [d] using map_digest_noteCommitment f (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt
  have hroot : ∀ leaf, d (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (d leaf) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by
    intro leaf
    simpa [d] using map_digest_merkleRoot f leaf path
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcommitMap : d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
      calc
        d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
            (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).selectedCommitment (path 0).1 := by
              cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
        _ = noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) := h.commitment
        _ = d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
              rw [← howner]
              exact hnote.symm
    have hsiblingMap : d ((path 0).2) =
        d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) := by
      cases hb : (path 0).1 <;>
        simpa [d, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair, hb] using h.sibling
    have hnullifierMap : d pub.nullifier = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := by
      calc
        d pub.nullifier = (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nullifier := rfl
        _ = nullifierHash (d sk) (d salt) := h.nullifier
        _ = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := (map_digest_nullifier f sk salt).symm
    have hmembershipMap : d pub.anchor = d (merkleRoot
        (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) := by
      calc
        d pub.anchor = (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).anchor := rfl
        _ = merkleRoot
              (noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := h.membership
        _ = merkleRoot (d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by rw [← howner, hnote.symm]
        _ = d (merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) :=
              (hroot _).symm
    refine ⟨(pair_valid_map_iff f hf pair).mp h.valid,
      (pair_spendable_map_iff f hf pair (path 0).1).mp h.spendable,
      (digest_injective f hf hcommitMap), ?_,
      digest_injective f hf hnullifierMap,
      digest_injective f hf hmembershipMap⟩
    exact digest_injective f hf hsiblingMap
  · intro h
    have hcommitMap : d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := congrArg d h.commitment
    have hsiblingMap : d ((path 0).2) =
        d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) :=
      congrArg d h.sibling
    have hnullifierMap : d pub.nullifier = d (nullifierHash sk salt) :=
      congrArg d h.nullifier
    have hmembershipMap : d pub.anchor = d (merkleRoot
        (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) :=
      congrArg d h.membership
    have hmappedNote : noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
      rw [← howner]
      exact hnote.symm
    refine ⟨(pair_valid_map_iff f hf pair).mpr h.valid,
      (pair_spendable_map_iff f hf pair (path 0).1).mpr h.spendable,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
          (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).selectedCommitment (path 0).1 =
              d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) := by cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
          _ = d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := hcommitMap
          _ = noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) :=
              hmappedNote.symm
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path 0).2 = d ((path 0).2) := rfl
        _ = d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) := hsiblingMap
        _ = if (path 0).1 then (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).firstCommitment
              else (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).secondCommitment := by cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nullifier = d pub.nullifier := rfl
        _ = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := hnullifierMap
        _ = nullifierHash (d sk) (d salt) := map_digest_nullifier f sk salt
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).anchor = d pub.anchor := rfl
        _ = d (merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) := hmembershipMap
        _ = merkleRoot (d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := hroot _
        _ = merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by rw [hmappedNote.symm]

theorem map_changeCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) =
      changeCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := by
  simpa [changeCommitment, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest, map_digest_noteCommitment] using
    (map_digest_noteCommitment f w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K)
      pub.assetId w.changeSalt)

theorem map_recipientCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (recipientCommitment pub w) =
      recipientCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := by
  simpa [recipientCommitment, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest, map_digest_noteCommitment] using
    (map_digest_noteCommitment f w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K)
      pub.assetId w.recipientSalt)

theorem variantOutput_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    variantOutput (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔
      variantOutput pub w := by
  have hd : Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) :=
    digest_injective f hf
  have hcast : f (w.outputValue.val : K) = (w.outputValue.val : L) := by simp
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient with
      | none => simp [variantOutput, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr]
      | some r =>
          simp only [variantOutput, hv, hr, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
            Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
          change PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f r =
              recipientCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔
            r = recipientCommitment pub w
          constructor
          · intro h
            apply hd
            calc
              PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f r =
                  recipientCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := h
              _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (recipientCommitment pub w) :=
                  (map_recipientCommitment f pub w).symm
          · intro h
            rw [h, map_recipientCommitment]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount with
      | none => simp [variantOutput, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, ha]
      | some amount =>
          simp only [variantOutput, hv, ha, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
            Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
          change f amount = (w.outputValue.val : L) ↔ amount = (w.outputValue.val : K)
          rw [← hcast]
          exact map_eq_iff f hf _ _

theorem rspend_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    Rspend (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔ Rspend pub w := by
  have hf : Function.Injective f := f.injective
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hcanonical, hrelation, hbalance, hchange, hvariant, happend⟩
    have hvalue : f (w.inputValue.val : K) = (w.inputValue.val : L) := by simp
    refine ⟨(canonical_map_iff f hf pub).mp hcanonical, ?_,
      ?_, ?_, (variantOutput_map_iff f hf pub w).mp hvariant,
      (PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap.appendBinding_map_iff f pub).mp happend⟩
    · have hm := (relation_map_iff f hf pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt
        w.path w.pair).mp (by simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness, hvalue] using hrelation)
      simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness] using hm
    · simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness] using hbalance
    · apply digest_injective f hf
      calc
        PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.change) =
            changeCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := hchange
        _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) := (map_changeCommitment f pub w).symm
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hcanonical, hrelation, hbalance, hchange, hvariant, happend⟩
    have hvalue : f (w.inputValue.val : K) = (w.inputValue.val : L) := by simp
    refine ⟨(canonical_map_iff f hf pub).mpr hcanonical, ?_,
      ?_, ?_, (variantOutput_map_iff f hf pub w).mpr hvariant,
      (PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap.appendBinding_map_iff f pub).mpr happend⟩
    · have hm := (relation_map_iff f hf pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt
        w.path w.pair).mpr hrelation
      simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness, hvalue] using hm
    · simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness] using hbalance
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).change = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pub.change := rfl
        _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) := congrArg (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f) hchange
        _ = changeCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := map_changeCommitment f pub w

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendRelationMap
import R1Z.BuilderSource

/-! Explicit canonical mathematical fixture instances. Association with
released Rust public records/bytes remains named; no arbitrary x is silently
identified with these records. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureFibres
open R0P AspisR1 AspisR1.SpendRelation

theorem lift_spendPlus (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) (w : Wspend)
    (valid : RspendPlus pub w) : RspendPlus (mapPub (K := K) pub) (liftWitness w) := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · change Rspend (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic ι pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness ι w)
    exact (PV_RunJoin_SpendRelationMap.rspend_map_iff ι pub w).mpr valid.1
  · intro variant zero
    apply valid.2 variant
    apply (ι : R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F →+* K).injective
    change ι (pub.change 7) = ι 0
    simpa only [R1J.SpendWitnessMap.mapPub,map_zero] using zero

def withdrawal : BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K) :=
  ⟨(PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic true,PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.witness true),
    lift_spendPlus _ _ PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.withdrawal_spendPlus⟩

def transfer (sentinel : (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0) :
    BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K) :=
  ⟨(PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false,PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.witness false),
    lift_spendPlus _ _ (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.transfer_spendPlus sentinel)⟩

theorem withdrawal_public :
    (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public withdrawal =
      mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic true) := rfl

theorem transfer_public (sentinel : (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0) :
    (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public (transfer sentinel) =
      mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false) := rfl

/-- Explicit remaining fixture laws. These are not discharged by the
canonical constructors. The public equations refer to the actual chosen
statements; the transfer sentinel is the D50 mathematical guard. -/
structure FixturePremises {CommitHandle : Type}
    (transferX withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop where
  transfer_public_V047 : transferX.1 = mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false)
  withdrawal_public_V047 : withdrawalX.1 = mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic true)
  transfer_sentinel_V047 : (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0

theorem release_fibres {CommitHandle : Type}
    (transferX withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement K CommitHandle)
    (premises : FixturePremises transferX withdrawalX) :
    ∃ wt ww : (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).Instance,
      (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public wt = transferX.1 ∧
      (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public ww = withdrawalX.1 := by
  exact ⟨transfer premises.transfer_sentinel_V047,withdrawal,
    (transfer_public _).trans premises.transfer_public_V047.symm,
    withdrawal_public.trans premises.withdrawal_public_V047.symm⟩

cells. No whole sponge/recurrence kernel reduction is used. -/

open R0P PV_RunJoin_Sentinel PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords

def middle : Fin 8 → Scalar := fun i =>
  if i.val = 0 then 400 else if i.val = 1 then 77 else digest 600 ⟨i.val-2,by omega⟩

def tail : Fin 8 → Scalar := fun i =>
  if h : i.val < 2 then digest 600 ⟨i.val+6,by omega⟩ else 0

theorem first_absorb : absorb (spongeInit 0x41530003 18) (digest 500) = s_0_0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

theorem middle_absorb : absorb s_0_23 middle = s_1_0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

theorem tail_absorb : absorb s_1_23 tail = s_2_0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

theorem value : (fixturePublic false).change 7 = (351017421 : Scalar) := by
  change noteCommitment (digest 500) 400 77 (digest 600) 7 = _
  simp only [noteCommitment,spongeStep]
  change digestOf (poseidonPermutation (absorb
    (poseidonPermutation (absorb
      (poseidonPermutation (absorb (spongeInit 0x41530003 18) (digest 500))) middle)) tail)) 7 = _
  rw [first_absorb,permutation_0,middle_absorb,permutation_1,tail_absorb,permutation_2]
  rfl

theorem nonzero : (fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0 := by
  rw [value]
  intro zero
  have values := congrArg (fun a : ZMod 2147483647 => a.val) zero
  change 351017421 = 0 at values
  omega

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureFibres
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_TransferSentinel
import R1Z.PrivacyR1AcctBasis

/-! Concrete nonempty mathematical fibres at the headline field. Native
public-record/byte association remains explicit, one equation per fixture. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_CanonicalFixtures
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords
abbrev Scalar := PrivacyR1AcctBasis.K

local instance : CharP Scalar 2147483647 :=
  charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) Scalar).injective
    AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

def transfer : BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := Scalar) :=
  PV_RunJoin_FixtureFibres.transfer PV_RunJoin_TransferSentinel.nonzero

def withdrawal : BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := Scalar) := PV_RunJoin_FixtureFibres.withdrawal

theorem transfer_public :
    (BuilderSource.prover (K := Scalar)).public transfer = mapPub (fixturePublic false) := rfl

theorem withdrawal_public :
    (BuilderSource.prover (K := Scalar)).public withdrawal = mapPub (fixturePublic true) := rfl

/-- The two remaining V047 associations. The transfer-sentinel field in the
predecessor FixturePremises is now proved, so it is not an input here. These
equations must be proved for the actual released public records. -/
structure Association {CommitHandle : Type}
    (transferX withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement Scalar CommitHandle) : Prop where
  transfer_public_V047 : transferX.1 = mapPub (fixturePublic false)
  withdrawal_public_V047 : withdrawalX.1 = mapPub (fixturePublic true)

theorem predecessor_premises {CommitHandle : Type}
    {transferX withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement Scalar CommitHandle}
    (association : Association transferX withdrawalX) :
    PV_RunJoin_FixtureFibres.FixturePremises transferX withdrawalX :=
  ⟨association.transfer_public_V047,association.withdrawal_public_V047,
    PV_RunJoin_TransferSentinel.nonzero⟩

theorem fibres {CommitHandle : Type}
    {transferX withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement Scalar CommitHandle}
    (association : Association transferX withdrawalX) :
    (BuilderSource.prover (K := Scalar)).public transfer = transferX.1 ∧
      (BuilderSource.prover (K := Scalar)).public withdrawal = withdrawalX.1 :=
  ⟨transfer_public.trans association.transfer_public_V047.symm,
    withdrawal_public.trans association.withdrawal_public_V047.symm⟩

/-- Non-vacuity of these explicit mathematical fixture statements, for every
choice of handles. This does not identify handles or bytes with native output. -/
theorem mathematical_fibres {CommitHandle : Type} (transferHandle withdrawalHandle : CommitHandle) :
    let transferX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement Scalar CommitHandle := (mapPub (fixturePublic false),transferHandle)
    let withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement Scalar CommitHandle := (mapPub (fixturePublic true),withdrawalHandle)
    ∃ wt ww : (BuilderSource.prover (K := Scalar)).Instance,
      (BuilderSource.prover (K := Scalar)).public wt = transferX.1 ∧
      (BuilderSource.prover (K := Scalar)).public ww = withdrawalX.1 :=
  ⟨transfer,withdrawal,transfer_public,withdrawal_public⟩

import PV_2TNV_ByteEncoding
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_CanonicalFixtures
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.PV_2TNV_PublicEncoding
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open R1Z R1J.SpendWitnessMap
open PV_2TNV_ByteEncoding
abbrev M := R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.M
abbrev K := R1Z.PrivacyR1AcctBasis.K
local instance : CharP K 2147483647 :=
  charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K).injective
    AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

/-- Read one little-endian field word at its source byte offset. -/
def word (bytes : List U8) (off : Nat) : M :=
  littleEndian ((bytes.drop off).take 4)
def digest (bytes : List U8) (off : Nat) : R0P.Digest M :=
  fun i => word bytes (off + 4*i.val)

/-- The payment projection deliberately has no snapshot/afterstate fields. -/
def payment (bytes : List U8) : R0P.Digest M × R0P.Digest M × M ×
    R0P.Digest M × R0P.Digest M :=
  (digest bytes 80, digest bytes 112, word bytes 144,
    digest bytes 152, digest bytes 184)

/-- Equality of complete native payment suffixes, before any field mapping. -/
theorem payment_association :
    payment (JHb_DataRequest.bytes.drop 104) =
      payment (JFx_DataPublic00.bytes.drop 1664) :=
  congrArg payment payment_same

/-- Transfer-13's headline public projection. Context keys and sequences remain
in the enclosing native byte record; the spend public retains index/frontiers. -/
def nativePublic : R0P.Public M where
  variant := .privateTransfer
  anchor := (payment (JFx_DataPublic00.bytes.drop 1664)).1
  nullifier := (payment (JFx_DataPublic00.bytes.drop 1664)).2.1
  assetId := (payment (JFx_DataPublic00.bytes.drop 1664)).2.2.1
  recipient := some (payment (JFx_DataPublic00.bytes.drop 1664)).2.2.2.1
  change := (payment (JFx_DataPublic00.bytes.drop 1664)).2.2.2.2

theorem anchor_eq : nativePublic.anchor = (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).anchor := by
  rw [PV_2TNV_PublicLiterals.anchor]
  change d43 = merkleRootAux
    (noteCommitment (ownerKey (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.digest 10)) 1000 77

  change d44 = nullifierHash (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.digest 10)
    (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.digest 100)
  rw [PV_RunJoin_FixtureHashModel.nullifier]
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

theorem asset_eq : nativePublic.assetId = (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).assetId :=
  PV_2TNV_PublicLiterals.asset

theorem recipient_eq : nativePublic.recipient =
    (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).recipient := by
  rw [PV_2TNV_PublicLiterals.recipient]
  change some d45 = some (noteCommitment (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.digest 300)
    600 77 (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.digest 400))
  rw [PV_RunJoin_OutputValues16.recipient]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

theorem change_eq : nativePublic.change = (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).change := by
  rw [PV_2TNV_PublicLiterals.change_value]
  change d46 = noteCommitment (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.digest 500)
    400 77 (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.digest 600)
  rw [PV_RunJoin_OutputValues16.transfer_change]
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

/-- Transport the input/output core while retaining the new append obligation.
This is a helper, not a claimed wrapper-to-headline theorem. -/
theorem spendPlus (append : AppendBinding nativePublic) :
    BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus nativePublic (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.witness false) := by
  obtain ⟨_,rel,conservation,changeLaw,variant,_⟩ := PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.spend false
  refine ⟨⟨⟨rfl,rfl⟩,?_,conservation,?_,?_,append⟩,?_⟩
  · exact {
      valid := rel.valid
      spendable := rel.spendable
      commitment := by rw [asset_eq]; exact rel.commitment
      sibling := rel.sibling
      nullifier := nullifier_eq.trans rel.nullifier
      membership := by rw [asset_eq,anchor_eq]; exact rel.membership }
  · unfold changeCommitment at *
    rw [change_eq,asset_eq]
    exact changeLaw
  · change nativePublic.recipient = some (recipientCommitment nativePublic _)
    change (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).recipient =
      some (recipientCommitment (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false) _) at variant
    unfold recipientCommitment at *
    rw [recipient_eq,asset_eq]
    exact variant
  · intro _
    rw [change_eq]
    exact PV_RunJoin_TransferSentinel.nonzero

  AspisCircleGroupOrder.P

theorem live_index : littleEndian ((JHb_DataLane.value.val.drop 88).take 8) =
 nativePublic.nextPairIndex :=
 congrArg littleEndian PV_2TNV_WorldData.lane_snapshot_index

theorem live_frontier (i : Fin 20) :
 digest JHb_DataLane.value.val (128+32*i.val) =
 digest JFx_DataPublic00.bytes (336+32*i.val) :=
 PV_RJ4IDB_ByteWindow.digest_window _ _ 128 336 640 (32*i.val)
 PV_2TNV_WorldData.lane_snapshot_frontier (by have hi := i.isLt; omega)

/-- The source caller's payment comes from the request, while its live index
and frontier come from the lane record. The candidate afterstate remains the
pinned transfer-13 output record. Native decoder/compiler binding is separate. -/
def livePublic : R0P.Public M :=
 {PV_RJ4IDB_CallerPublic.requestPublic with
 nextPairIndex := littleEndian ((JHb_DataLane.value.val.drop 88).take 8)
 snapshotFrontier := fun i => digest JHb_DataLane.value.val (128+32*i.val)}

theorem live_public_eq : livePublic = nativePublic := by
 have hf : (fun i : Fin 20 => digest JHb_DataLane.value.val (128+32*i.val)) =
   (fun i : Fin 20 => digest JFx_DataPublic00.bytes (336+32*i.val)) := by
  funext i
  exact live_frontier i
 unfold livePublic
 rw [live_index,hf,PV_RJ4IDB_CallerPublic.request_public_eq]
 rfl

 (caller_to_transfer13 native_handle)
